### [1] [Words Before Pixels: Selective Modality Routing for Vision-Language Model Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00608)
*Laura Yao,Haochen Zhang,Jinhao Duan,Sijia Liu,Tianlong Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出以数据为中心视角重审VLM遗忘问题，通过模态分解实验揭示文本表示更利于抑制不安全指令跟随、纯文本遗忘会削弱视觉 grounding 的权衡，并提出梯度引导的逐样本模态路由策略 ModRoute。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM遗忘研究多聚焦目标函数设计，默认"输入中含像素就用图像-文本原形式遗忘"；作者质疑该假设，指出遗忘样本应如何表示（图像/文本/多模态）同样关键。

Method: 构造模态分解版VLM基准（image-only、text-only、multimodal），在相同样本上做受控模态混合实验；据此提出ModRoute：基于梯度的逐样本模态路由，将高"视觉压力"样本选择性转为纯文本形式，其余保留多模态。

Result: 在VLGuard + LLaVA-1.5-7B上，ModRoute在γ=0.5时取得最高的遗忘-效用复合分0.847，比最佳随机切换高2.5%，比纯多模态或纯文本遗忘高≥46%。

Conclusion: 有效的VLM遗忘不仅取决于优化目标，还取决于遗忘数据的模态组成与逐样本模态路由；数据表示设计是VLM遗忘的关键维度。

Abstract: Vision-language model (VLM) unlearning is often treated as an objective-design problem: given multimodal forget data, the goal is to optimize a loss that removes undesirable behavior while preserving retained capabilities. We argue that this view overlooks an equally important data-centric question: how should each forget example be represented before optimization? Existing methods typically keep image-conditioned failures in their original image-text form, implicitly assuming that pixels are the right route for unlearning whenever pixels appear in the input. We challenge this assumption by constructing modality-decomposed versions of VLM benchmarks, enabling controlled comparisons among image-only, text-only, and multimodal representations of the same examples. Our modality-mixing experiments show that unsafe instruction-following behavior is more effectively suppressed through textual representations than through images alone, while purely text-only unlearning can still weaken visual grounding when the target behavior depends on visual evidence. Motivated by this trade-off, we introduce ModRoute, a gradient-guided per-sample modality routing strategy that selectively converts high visual-pressure examples to text-only form while keeping the remaining examples multimodal. Notably, on VLGuard with LLaVA-1.5-7B, ModRoute has the strongest composite unlearning-utility score of 0.847 at $γ=0.5$, a 2.5% improvement over the best random-switching score and $\geq$46% better than pure multimodal or text unlearning. Overall, our results show that effective VLM unlearning depends not only on the objective, but also on the composition and per-sample modality routing of the unlearning data.

</details>


### [2] [Selecting or Solving? What Best-of-N Verification Delivers in Video Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00507)
*Martin Q. Ma,Yuxiao Qu,Ruslan Salakhutdinov,Louis-Philippe Morency,Paden Tomasello,Juan Pino*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文将 best-of-N 视频推理流水线的单一"超越多数投票的差值"拆分为两个效应：验证器选择增益（Selection Increment, SI）与其自身独立解题能力；在五个长视频基准上发现 SI 对最弱验证器最大，而"胜过多数投票"只在验证器足够强时成立。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频复杂问答本质是 grounding 问题，答案取决于几秒证据，VLM 远低于人类水平。常见做法是 best-of-N：采样多条 CoT 答案，再由第二个模型重看视频挑选。该流程只用"超越多数投票的差值"这一个 headline 数字报告，该数字混淆了两种部署后果相反的效应：验证器在候选中做选择的增益，以及它若自己解题本可带来的增益。

Method: 提出 Selection Increment (SI) 指标：选择准确率减去同一验证器在"不提供候选"条件下的准确率，并与相对 self-consistency（多数投票）的差值并列测量；在五个长视频基准上系统评测不同强度验证器（含最弱与前沿模型），并在 Video-Holmes 的同一候选池上对比两种指标的分化。

Result: SI 在最弱验证器上最大——独立解题能力差的验证器留给候选改进的空间最多；"超越多数投票"呈相反趋势：投票接近上限时无验证器能超越，低于上限时仅最强验证器可超越。Video-Holmes 同一候选池上，弱验证器从候选中获 +19.3 点却仍低于投票 7.1 点，前沿验证器增益最小却胜过投票。最弱验证器在 EgoSchema 上出现按选项列表位置而非视频内容选择的失败模式。

Conclusion: SI 作为"能力分"会把未能超越多数投票的验证器排到榜首，因此不能单独用作 merit score；作为审计工具，它能指出 headline 数字究竟来自哪种效应。结论提示 best-of-N 报告应同时给出 SI 与相对多数投票的差值。

Abstract: Answering a complex question about a long video is a grounding problem: the answer turns on a few seconds of evidence, and vision-language models remain well below human accuracy at finding them. The standard way to spend extra test-time compute on this kind of video reasoning is best-of-N selection: sample several chain-of-thought answers from a fixed model, then let a second model re-watch the video and pick one. Such pipelines are reported by a single headline number, their margin over a majority vote. That number conflates two effects with opposite deployment consequences: the benefit the second model adds by selecting among candidates, and the benefit it would have supplied by solving the question itself. We separate them, measuring the Selection Increment (SI) -- selection accuracy minus the same verifier's accuracy with the candidates withheld -- alongside the margin over self-consistency, across five long-video benchmarks. The Selection Increment is largest for the weakest verifiers: a verifier that solves poorly on its own leaves the candidates the most room to help. Beating the majority vote follows the opposite profile: where the vote already sits near its ceiling no verifier we test improves on it; below that ceiling only the strongest do. On Video-Holmes, the two come apart on a single pool of candidates -- a weak verifier gains +19.3 points from the candidates yet lands 7.1 points below the vote, while the frontier verifier gains the least and beats the vote. The weakest verifier also shows a failure mode: on EgoSchema it picks by where an option sits in the list rather than by what the video shows. Read as a merit score, SI puts a verifier that fails to beat a majority vote at the top of its ranking; read as an audit, it says which of the two effects a headline number delivers. Code is available at https://github.com/facebookresearch/best-n-selection-video-reasoning.

</details>


### [3] [Real-VAS: a Real-World Video Amodal Segmentation Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00430)
*Finlay G. C. Hudson,William A. P. Smith*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Real-VAS——基于真实图像视频合成的、大规模零样本评测数据集，通过可编程一致的生成流程为真实视频提供精确的非模态（amodal）真值，覆盖动态遮挡与多种容器交互场景，用于严格评估非模态视频目标分割模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有amodal视频目标分割研究受限于数据集匮乏：真实场景数据缺乏精确真值标注，而合成数据虽真值精确却缺少真实复杂度，二者难以兼得。

Method: 构建数据生成pipeline，使目标掩码、遮挡边界与合成图像均源自同一无遮挡源，无需人工估计或昂贵三维重建；数据集分两类场景：动态遮挡（合成两段运动物体片段）与Container类别（On Surface Containment、Articulated Containment、Mobile Containment），后者依据容器跟踪变换模拟物体运动以生成精确真值；定位为零样本评测基准。

Result: 形成兼具真实视频复杂性与合成级真值精度的多样化、有挑战性的amodal分割评测基准Real-VAS；数据集与生成代码将公开。

Conclusion: 通过可编程一致的真值生成方式，Real-VAS弥补了真实性与标注精度之间的鸿沟，为amodal视频目标分割提供可控、可复现且具挑战性的标准化评测平台。

Abstract: Amodal video object segmentation is fundamentally limited by the absence of datasets that combine real-world complexity with precise ground-truth annotations. To address this, we present Real Video Amodal Segmentation (Real-VAS), a new large-scale, zero-shot evaluation dataset built from composited real-image video. We introduce a novel data generation pipeline that enables the creation of programmatically consistent amodal ground truth for real-world footage, in which the object mask, occlusion boundary, and composited image are all derived from a single unoccluded source, without relying on human estimation or expensive 3D reconstruction. Our dataset is structured into two challenging scenarios: dynamic Occlusion, created by compositing two clips of moving objects, and a unique Container category featuring complex, physically constrained interactions. These container scenarios--On Surface Containment, Articulated Containment, and Mobile Containment--allow us to generate precise ground truth by simulating an object's motion based on its container's tracked transformation. As a result, Real-VAS provides a diverse and challenging benchmark for evaluating amodal segmentation models on realistic video with the precision of synthetic data. The dataset and our generation code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [4] [SIEVE: Preserving Cross-Image Evidence via Depth-Aware Token Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00351)
*Nitish Shukla,Surgan Jandial,Nhat-Tan Bui,Arun Ross*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SIEVE 是一个免训练、单次前向的视觉 token 压缩框架，跨图像与解码器深度联合分配视觉 token 预算，在多图、单图与视频基准上以极低预算取得最优平均性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多图 VLM 处理长视觉序列计算开销大；压缩需同时保留跨图像互补证据并使不同图像的 token 彼此区分。全局选择会使与问题相关的图像被欠表示，而早期解码层剪枝可能在多模态处理充分前删除相关内容，但现有方法把大部分预算花在这些早期层上。

Method: 1) 将每张图池化为紧凑空间网格以降低早期处理成本；2) 在等额逐图配额下，用 prompt 注意力渐进选择代表性 token，并将未选 token 聚合到同图像内的相似代表上，从而保证每张图被表示且 token 跨图隔离，同时精化保留表示；3) 用闭式调度设定各层保留数量，以逼近规定的跨层平均 token 预算。整体为免训练、单次前向。

Result: 在四个 VLM 骨干上，6.25% 预算下于五个多图与四个单图基准取得最高平均，并在两个视频基准取得最高均值。LLaVA-OneVision-7B 上，6.25% 与 12.5% 预算分别超最强基线 9.96 与 9.03 分；12.5% 时超未压缩模型 2.01 分，prefill FLOPs 减少 6.6 倍。

Conclusion: 跨图像与跨深度联合分配视觉 token 预算、并在等额逐图配额下做注意力引导的渐进选择与同图聚合，可在免训练条件下显著降低多图 VLM 的 prefill 计算，同时保持甚至提升精度。

Abstract: Multi-image vision-language models (VLMs) incur substantial computation when processing long visual sequences. Compressing these sequences must preserve complementary evidence across images and keep tokens from different images separate. Global selection can underrepresent question-relevant images, and pruning in early decoder layers risks removing relevant content before sufficient multimodal processing, yet existing methods spend most of the budget on these early layers. We propose SIEVE, a training-free, single-pass framework that jointly allocates visual tokens across images and decoder depth. SIEVE first pools each image into a compact spatial grid to reduce early processing cost. It then progressively selects representatives using prompt attention under equal per-image quotas and aggregates unselected tokens into similar representatives from the same image. These operations keep every image represented and its tokens separate from other images, while refining the retained representations. A closed-form schedule sets retention counts to target a prescribed average token budget across decoder layers. Across four VLM backbones, SIEVE achieves the highest average at a 6.25% budget on five multi-image benchmarks and four single-image benchmarks, and the highest mean on two video benchmarks. On LLaVA-OneVision-7B, it outperforms the strongest baseline by 9.96 and 9.03 points at 6.25% and 12.5% budgets, and at 12.5% it exceeds the uncompressed model by 2.01 points with 6.6x fewer prefill FLOPs.

</details>


### [5] [Seeing the Unseen: Unified Visible--Invisible Motion for Physically Consistent Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00293)
*Mingyang Bao,Fangda Ye,Xihao Chen,Bobo Li,Jason Li,Shengqiong Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"Seeing the Unseen"统一框架，将物理动力学学习与视频合成解耦为两阶段：先用轻量图神经网络粒子模拟器PGDS预测3D运动轨迹，再通过可见–不可见运动场VIMF注入扩散生成器，实现物理一致的视频生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成视觉质量高但缺乏对底层物理过程的显式建模，导致动力学不一致；既有方法或依赖强假设的模拟器，或仅用粗粒度语义引导，难以有效将物理先验注入生成模型。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1) 基于粒子的图动力学模拟器PGDS，轻量且从数据中学习可泛化的物理交互，预测合理的三维运动轨迹；(2) 可见–不可见运动场VIMF，同时刻画输入帧中可观测的运动与随物体动力学随时间涌现的潜在运动，形成结构化运动引导；(3) 将轨迹整合进扩散生成器。

Result: 大量实验表明，相较强基线，在运动准确性、交互一致性和减少物理伪影方面均有提升。

Conclusion: 通过"学习物理动力学＋注入视频合成"的解耦设计及VIMF表示，可为扩散视频生成提供比传统物理信号更完整、结构化的运动引导，兼顾视觉连贯性与物理一致性。

Abstract: Recent advances in video generation have achieved impressive visual quality, yet they often fail to produce physically consistent dynamics due to the lack of explicit modeling of underlying physical processes. Existing approaches either rely on simulators with strong assumptions or use coarse semantic guidance, and further struggle to effectively inject physical priors into generation models. In this work, we propose Seeing the Unseen, a unified framework for physics-grounded video generation. Our approach decomposes the problem into two stages: learning physical dynamics and injecting them into video synthesis. First, we introduce a lightweight Particle-based Graph Dynamics Simulator (PGDS) that learns generalizable physical interactions from data and predicts plausible 3D motion trajectories. Second, we propose a Visible--Invisible Motion Field (VIMF) that captures both motion observable in the input frame and motion that emerges over time due to object dynamics. This representation enables more complete and structured motion guidance compared to conventional physical signals. By integrating these trajectories into a diffusion-based generator, our method produces videos that are both visually coherent and physically consistent. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved motion accuracy, interaction consistency, and reduced physical artifacts compared to strong baselines.

</details>


### [6] [AdaptAD: Foundation Model Adaptation with Missing Modality Robustness for Alzheimer's Disease Staging Across the Disease Continuum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00084)
*Dawa Chyophel Lepcha,Sophie A. Martin,Pierrick Coupé,Shabbir Syed Abdul*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AdaptAD 用 16 张解剖定位的 2.5-D 切片读取 T1 扫描，并以 LoRA 微调冻结的 ImageNet ViT-B/16（仅训练 3.5M/89M 参数），结合可缺失的形态学 token 融合双专家，在 ADNI/OASIS-3 上实现了对 CN/MCI/AD 全连续期的参数高效分期，且无需 FreeSurfer 形态学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单一结构 MRI 上对 AD 全连续期（CN→MCI→痴呆）分期困难：3-D 网络在小样本上易过拟合，且 FreeSurfer 形态学数据常不可得。需要一种可扩展、低标注依赖、可临床部署的方案。

Method: 将配准后的 T1 表示为穿过内侧颞叶的 16 张 2.5-D 切片；冻结 ImageNet 预训练 ViT-B/16 并施加 LoRA，仅训练 3.5M/89M 参数；形态学特征以 token 形式输入，缺失时用可学习的 [MISSING] token，由缺失感知堆叠器融合两个专家。预注册协议下，在 ADNI 597 名受试者（29% 无 FreeSurfer）的相同 5 折划分上比较 10 种方法，采用 Holm 校正的配对 bootstrap 检验；锁定模型在 OASIS-3 993 人上一次性测试。

Result: ADNI 三分类 macro-AUC 0.745（95% CI 0.709–0.781），排名第一并显著优于全量微调、ShaSpec 和 3-D CNN；OASIS-3 上达 0.780（0.748–0.814），在 CDR 标签上 0.804，显著优于所有 3-D 与图像-表格方法。LoRA 以 1/25 可训练参数匹敌全量微调；去除形态学对外部 macro-AUC 影响 <0.003；疾病评分在诊断组内与 MMSE、CDR-SB 相关，可分层 MCI→痴呆进展（log-rank p<0.001），显著性集中于内侧颞叶与脑室周围区域。

Conclusion: 参数高效的 2-D 基础模型可仅凭常规 T1 扫描、无需形态学即完成 AD 全连续期分期，为记忆门诊部署提供了可扩展路径。

Abstract: Staging Alzheimer's disease (AD) across its continuum, from cognitively normal (CN) through mild cognitive impairment (MCI) to dementia from a single structural MRI remains difficult because 3-D networks overfit small cohorts, and FreeSurfer morphometry is often unavailable. We present AdaptAD, which reads a registered T1-weighted scan as 16 anatomically placed 2.5-D slices through the medial temporal lobe and adapts a frozen ImageNet-pretrained ViT-B/16 with low-rank adaptation (LoRA), training 3.5 M of 89 M parameters. Morphometry enters as tokens when present, or as a learned [MISSING] token, and a missing-aware stacker fuses both experts. Under a pre-registered protocol, ten methods were compared for three-class CN/MCI/AD staging on identical 5-fold splits of 597 ADNI participants, 29% without FreeSurfer, with Holm-corrected paired bootstrap tests. The locked model was tested once on 993 OASIS-3 participants (988 scored by every method). On ADNI, AdaptAD achieved a three-class macro-AUC of 0.745 (95% CI 0.709 to 0.781), ranking first and significantly exceeding full fine-tuning, ShaSpec and a 3-D CNN. On OASIS-3 it reached 0.780 (0.748 to 0.814), and on the CDR-based label (0.804) it significantly outperformed every 3-D and image-tabular method. LoRA matched full fine-tuning with 25 times fewer trainable parameters, and removing morphometry changed external macro-AUC by less than 0.003. The disease score tracked MMSE and CDR-SB within diagnostic groups and stratified MCI-to-dementia progression (log-rank p < 0.001), while saliency concentrated in medial temporal and periventricular regions. A parameter-efficient 2-D foundation model can therefore stage the full AD continuum from a routine T1 scan without morphometry, offering a scalable route to memory-clinic deployment.

</details>


### [7] [HistGramBench: Measuring Structural Recovery When Multimodal Models Redraw Historical Mathematical Diagrams as TikZ](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00081)
*Minh Quang Tran,Carter He,Cameron Bloch,Zitai Huang,Thien Truong Vo,Trong Nguyen Tran,Isaac Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 HistGramBench 基准，含 1551–1933 年间 8 种语言 95 部著作中的 2,507 幅数学图形，用跨厂商双模型共识事实校验 AI 重绘的程序化图形，最佳模型仅恢复约五分之三的几何事实。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字图书馆中的古旧数学书籍图为扫描图像，内容不可检索；将其重绘为简短绘图程序可记录点线圆关系，但印刷图版缺乏可对照的源代码，因此需要一个可量化评估的基准。

Method: 构建 HistGramBench：2,507 幅图、95 部著作、1551–1933 年、8 种语言。对每幅图，由不同厂商的两个 AI 模型就读者可提取的几何事实（如平行、两线交点）达成一致，并将每次重绘在模型自绘图形上与这些事实比对。评估六个低成本 AI 模型。

Result: 最佳模型恢复约 3/5 的几何事实；漏检主要源于程序从未生成图形；平行与相切关系最难复现。

Conclusion: HistGramBench 为历史学家与图书馆员提供了衡量此类工具何时可使旧数学图形可检索的手段。

Abstract: Digital libraries preserve mathematical books printed from the sixteenth to the twentieth century, but the lettered diagrams in them, the figures on which Euclidean proofs depend, remain scanned images whose content cannot be searched. Redrawing such a diagram as a short drawing program would record which points lie on which lines and circles. But a printed plate offers no source code against which the redrawing could be checked. We introduce HistGramBench, a benchmark of 2,507 diagrams from 95 works printed between 1551 and 1933 in eight languages. For each diagram, two AI models from different providers agree on the facts a reader takes from the figure, such as which lines are parallel or where two lines meet, and every redrawing is checked against those facts on the model's own drawing. We evaluate six affordable AI models. The best recovers about three fifths of these facts, and most of what the models miss comes from programs that never produce a drawing. Parallels and tangencies are the hardest relations to reproduce. HistGramBench gives historians and librarians a way to measure when such tools can make old mathematical diagrams searchable.

</details>


### [8] [Sequential Transfer Learning for Plant Disease Recognition Across Perennial Crop Domains Using MobileNetV2-CBAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00080)
*Ropkathaa Choudhury*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文检验了基于CBAM增强的轻量级MobileNetV2所学习的病害识别表征，能否在多年生作物间顺序迁移复用（Walnut→Cashew→Coffee→Mango），并在六作物异质基准上验证其性能衰减规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多局限于单一源域到目标域的孤立迁移，缺乏对"顺序性、渐进式"知识复用及其在目标域异质性上升时预测行为变化的实证刻画，本文旨在填补该空白。

Method: 采用轻量级MobileNetV2+M卷积块注意力模块（CBAM）框架，以核桃为基线，按Cashew、Coffee、Mango顺序进行序贯迁移，每一阶段均复用前一模型表征并在独立测试集上以互补分类指标评估；最后在异质的ABCGMP六作物基准上验证。

Abstract: Purpose: This study investigates whether a learned disease-recognition representation can be progressively reused across distinct perennial crop domains and how its predictive behaviour changes as target-domain heterogeneity increases.
  Design/methodology/approach: A lightweight MobileNetV2 framework enhanced with the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) was evaluated through sequential transfer from Walnut to Cashew, Coffee and Mango, followed by validation on the heterogeneous ABCGMP six-crop benchmark. Each stage used the preceding model representation and was evaluated on an independent test set using complementary classification measures.
  Findings: Test accuracy increased from 75.76% for the Walnut baseline to 84.85% after CBAM integration, followed by 90.67% on Cashew, 100.00% on Coffee and 99.50% on Mango. The final ABCGMP evaluation achieved 88.44% accuracy, 81.49% Balanced Accuracy and 0.9949 ROC-AUC. The results show that substantial predictive capability was retained through successive crop transfers, while broader multi-crop heterogeneity introduced a measurable performance constraint.
  Originality: The study provides an empirical characterisation of sequential knowledge reuse across multiple perennial crop domains using a common lightweight attention-enhanced representation, extending evaluation beyond isolated source-to-target transfer.

</details>


### [9] [From Zero to OCR: A Data-Centric Framework for Unsupported Low-Resource Scripts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00078)
*Faizan Iqbal,Haq Nawaz Malik,Hafsah Pervaiz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出以数据为中心的OCR构建框架，仅用无标注文本语料与数字字体为低资源文字构建端到端OCR，在克什米尔语（Nastaliq）上实现词级0.39% CER并公开模型、代码与285,864张合成行图像数据集。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Optical character recognition (OCR) remains inaccessible to many low-resource scripts because annotated document images are unavailable and synthetic training data can fail to preserve script-specific visual structure. A synthetic data engine renders word, line and page images with correct complex-script shaping and automatically derived labels; a YOLOv8 word detector and a convolutional recurrent recognizer trained with connectionist temporal classification learn from these images; and a stage-gate evaluation protocol isolates recognition error before detection is introduced. We demonstrate the framework on Kashmiri, a Perso-Arabic Nastaliq script with approximately 6.8 million speakers that none of six widely used OCR engines supports. Three line-level recognizers, including one transferred from Arabic, stalled between 41% and 79% character error rate (CER), motivating a word-level formulation; subsequent improvements came primarily from rendering fidelity, diacritic-preserving crop margins and tuned non-maximum suppression. The resulting system achieves 0.39% CER on held-out words, 10.0% on synthetic pages and 13.5% on browser-rendered digital pages, and establishes reference results of 18.45% on typeset book pages and 49.8% on degraded historical documents. We publicly release the trained models, the inference code and a synthetic dataset of 285,864 Kashmiri text-line images, and we describe a step-by-step procedure for building OCR for other unsupported scripts.

</details>


### [10] [CRaFT-XDet: Causal and Robust Fusion Transformer for Dual-Energy X-ray Prohibited Item Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00072)
*Moinul Hossain,Munshaibur Rahman Mahin,Taskin Khaleque,Mohammad Sakib Mahmood,M. F. Mridha,Md. Jakir Hossen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CRaFT-XDet——一个基于因果推断与物理先验的X射线违禁品检测框架，将检测重构为衰减驱动模态变化下的不变表征学习，实现实时、跨扫描仪鲁棒检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: X射线安检图像存在严重物体重叠、扫描仪相关的域偏移，以及因行李杂乱构成的虚假相关。现有检测器多依赖外观驱动的监督，缺乏对因果机制的建模，导致鲁棒性与跨扫描仪泛化能力不足。

Method: 提出Scanner-Invariant Causal Detection形式化（定理1），证明在标准可识别性假设下，按扫描仪环境划分最小化因果不变正则（CIR）目标可逼近干预分布P(Y|do(Xobj))。框架集成三部分：(i)因果特征解耦以抑制上下文引发的捷径；(ii)物理启发的正则化以强制材料一致的嵌入；(iii)基于Transformer的跨能量交互建模，用于杂乱场景下的结构化推理。

Result: 模型29.2M参数、89.5 GFLOPs、345 FPS（1.7ms推理），可实时部署。SIXray五折交叉验证达0.9389 mAP@0.5与0.8021 mAP@0.5:0.95。无域自适应情况下在OPIXray、HiXray保持强跨数据集性能。类别无关二分类威胁检测recall 93.92%、mean IoU 0.9031。

Conclusion: 因果不变表征学习结合物理先验可有效缓解X射线检测中的虚假相关与扫描仪域偏移，在保持实时性的同时兼顾精度与跨域泛化，适用于漏检代价高的安全关键筛查场景。

Abstract: Automated prohibited item detection in X-ray security imagery is fundamentally constrained by severe object overlap, scanner-dependent domain shifts, and spurious correlations induced by cluttered baggage composition. Existing detectors largely rely on appearance-driven supervision, limiting their robustness and cross-scanner generalisation. We introduce CRaFT-XDet, a causality-grounded and physics- motivated detection framework that reformulates X-ray threat detection as invariant representation learning under attenuation-driven modality variation. Our approach is grounded in a Scanner-Invariant Causal Detection formalisation (Theorem 1), which establishes that minimising the proposed Causal Invariance Regularisation (CIR) objective across partitioned scanner environments approximates the interventional distribution P (Y | do(Xobj)) under standard identifiability assumptions, providing a principled causal formulation for dual-energy X-ray detection. CRaFT-XDet integrates: (i) causal feature disentanglement to suppress context-induced shortcuts; (ii) physics-motivated regularisation to enforce material-consistent embeddings; and (iii) transformer-based cross-energy interaction modelling for structured reasoning in cluttered scenes. With 29.2 M parameters, 89.5 GFLOPs, and 345 FPS (1.7 ms inference), CRaFT-XDet is real-time deployable. Trained on SIXray with five-fold cross-validation, the framework achieves 0.9389 mAP@0.5 and 0.8021 mAP@0.5:0.95. Without domain adaptation, CRaFT-XDet maintains strong cross- dataset performance on OPIXray and HiXray, indicating robust generalization across heterogeneous scanner distributions. In category-agnostic binary threat detection, the model attains 93.92% recall and 0.9031 mean IoU, highlighting reliability in safety-critical screening where missed detections are costly.

</details>


### [11] [Not All Minorities Are Equal: Fairness Outcomes in Private Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00059)
*Cohen Archbold,Usman Hassan,Sen-ching Samson Cheung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究差分隐私（DP）训练对生成模型中人脸群体与视觉属性表征公平性的影响：更强隐私会不成比例地损害部分弱势群体，但该效应无法仅由数据代表性解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DP为AI系统中的个体提供形式化隐私保护，但其对生成模型公平性的影响尚不清楚；作者希望厘清隐私保护训练如何改变人口统计群体与视觉属性在生成模型中的表征。

Method: 在两个面部图像数据集上，设置多个隐私预算（隐私强度）水平，训练隐私保护的生成模型，并系统评估不同人口统计群体与视觉属性的生成质量与效用（表征表现）。

Result: 更强的隐私保护会不成比例地降低某些弱势群体的质量与效用，放大既有差异；但表征程度不能解释全部现象——若干充分代表的属性同样显著退化，而部分代表性不足的属性相对稳健。

Conclusion: 隐私保护学习的影响不能仅由数据代表性解释，可能取决于被学习信息的特征及其交互；评估生成模型时需同时考虑隐私与公平性。

Abstract: Differential privacy (DP) provides formal guarantees for protecting individuals in artificial intelligence systems, but its consequences for fairness in generative models remain poorly understood. We investigate how privacy-preserving training affects the representation of demographic groups and visual attributes in generative models of human faces. Across two facial image datasets and multiple privacy levels, we find that stronger privacy can disproportionately degrade the quality and utility of some underrepresented groups, suggesting that privacy can amplify existing disparities. However, representation alone does not explain these effects: several well-represented attributes also experience substantial degradation, while some underrepresented attributes remain comparatively robust. These findings show that the impact of privacy-preserving learning cannot be explained solely by data representation and may depend on the characteristics and interactions of the information being learned. Our results highlight the need to consider both privacy and fairness when evaluating generative models.

</details>


### [12] [SIMIT: Self-Improving Vision-Language Models via Imagination at Test-Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00053)
*Mehmet Onurcan Kaya,Desmond Elliott,Dim P. Papadopoulos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SIMIT 是一个测试时自我改进框架：模型在回答无标签测试查询前，先自造与该查询相关的（问题, 答案, 图像）训练数据，通过多阶段验证与难度过滤保证练习数据质量，并可用上下文（SIMIT-ICL）或权重更新（SIMIT-FT）方式改进模型，在17个基准上平均相对提升约 +7.20%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时方法要么仅靠更长推理或重复采样而不改变模型，要么用多数投票/自判断正确性作为奖励更新模型，但这类奖励会强化既有错误；且目标是在无标注、无外部模型条件下提升特定测试集表现。

Method: 先指定答案再生成对应图像，合成多样 (question, answer, image) 三元组；结合原生图像生成与可扩展技能库（文档、图表、示意图等结构化视觉）；多阶段验证确保图像支持所赋答案，难度过滤保留有信息量样本；自适应预算按查询置信度分配样本量。产物用于 SIMIT-ICL（上下文）或 SIMIT-FT（参数微调）。

Result: 在17个多样基准上优于现有自我改进方法；最佳配置相对 BAGEL-7B 取得 +7.20% 平均相对增益，无训练的 SIMIT-ICL 达 +6.98%。

Conclusion: 通过“自造可控答案的练习数据”替代易强化错误的自我奖励信号，测试时自我改进可在无标注、无外部模型条件下取得稳定提升。

Abstract: We introduce SIMIT, a test-time self-improvement framework in which a vision-language model creates its own query-specific training data before answering an unlabeled test query. Our goal is to improve performance on a given target test set without annotations or external models. To pursue this goal, some test-time methods improve answers through longer reasoning or repeated sampling but leave the model unchanged. Others update the model using rewards based on majority agreement among multiple candidate answers or the model's own judgments of correctness, but such rewards can reinforce existing mistakes. SIMIT instead imagines similar problems whose solutions it controls: a model need not correctly solve the target query to construct useful practice examples. It synthesizes diverse (question, answer, image) triplets by specifying each answer before realizing its image. To support diverse multimodal tasks, SIMIT combines native image generation with an extensible skill library for structured visuals, including documents, charts, and diagrams. Within this pipeline, multi-stage verification checks that images support their assigned answers, while difficulty filtering retains informative examples. Adaptive budgeting further targets this practice by allocating more samples to queries the model is less confident in answering. The resulting data can improve the model in-context (SIMIT-ICL) or in-weight (SIMIT-FT). Across 17 diverse benchmarks, SIMIT outperforms existing self-improvement methods. Its best configuration achieves a +7.20% mean relative gain over BAGEL-7B, while training-free SIMIT-ICL achieves +6.98%.

</details>


### [13] [Multimodal Cross-Condition Learning for Temporal Sentence Grounding in Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00033)
*Allen He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出多模态交叉条件学习MCCL，通过视频前缀适配器(VPA)与句条件适配器(SCADA)实现视觉→语言→视觉的有序双向条件交换，并在两个数据集上系统比较骨干与时序模块及四种条件模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时序句子定位虽通过句条件视觉适配满足了"视觉表征保留查询相关证据"的要求，但语言表征仍独立于视频，未体现句子所处视觉语境，缺乏从视觉到语言的条件化。

Method: MCCL：VPA将池化视觉上下文转换为连续token序列，作为前缀条件注入冻结的DistilBERT编码器；配合SCADA构成视觉→语言→视觉的有序交换。实验覆盖两种视频骨干、LSTM与Mamba时序模块、四种条件模式，在Charades-STA与ActivityNet Captions上评估。

Result: Charades-STA全部四种设置下，双向条件比更强的单向模式提升1.6–2.3 mIoU。ActivityNet Captions呈不同规律：I3D–Mamba下双向更优，而C3D下视频→文本单向条件更强。相对对应基线报告描述性增益。

Conclusion: 将单向视觉适配扩展为可配置的多模态框架，验证了双向条件化的有效性与数据集依赖性——最优条件方向随骨干与模态特性而异。

Abstract: Temporal sentence grounding requires a video representation that preserves query-relevant evidence and a sentence representation that reflects the visual context in which it is interpreted. Prior end-to-end grounding addresses the first requirement through sentence-conditioned visual adaptation, but leaves the language representation independent of the video. This work proposes Multimodal Cross-Condition Learning (MCCL). Its Video Prefix Adapter (VPA) converts pooled visual context into a sequence of continuous tokens that condition a frozen DistilBERT encoder. Combined with the Sentence Conditioned Adapter (SCADA), VPA supports an ordered exchange from vision to language and back to vision. A comprehensive study examines two video backbones, LSTM and Mamba temporal modules, and four conditioning modes on two datasets. Bidirectional conditioning exceeds the stronger one-way mode by 1.6--2.3 mIoU points in all four Charades-STA settings. ActivityNet Captions exhibits a different pattern: bidirectionality helps I3D--Mamba, whereas video-to-text conditioning is stronger with C3D. The study extends one-way visual adaptation into a configurable multimodal framework and reports descriptive gains over the corresponding baselines.

</details>


### [14] [Diagnosing Prototype Estimation in Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning: Training-Free Geometry Selection and Unlabeled-Query Prototype Rectification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00022)
*Md Tanvir Hossain Saikat,Md Akib Haider,Md. Tahmid Islam Tomal,Md Hasanul Kabir*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在冻结特征FSCIL中，新类原型均值估计的有限样本噪声是残余性能差距的主要来源；据此提出仅用支持集的ShrinkSel选择器与批式转导的Query Prototype Rectification (QPR)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冻结视觉编码器使原型头在FSCIL中具竞争力，但残余差距究竟来自五样本新类均值的噪声，还是来自分类器重拟合，尚不清楚；作者希望拆解这一有序差距的归因。

Method: 在相同特征上构造回顾式匹配反事实：固定余弦评分，先将每个五样本新类均值替换为全数据均值，再拟合线性探针；辅以样本数（shot）与类级诊断。提出ShrinkSel：仅用支持集在原型半径与协方差收缩构成的空间上选择，该族以共享LDA为精确回退端点。进一步提出QPR：批式转导，用门控无标签查询更新新类方向，同时保持已选几何。

Result: 十六个强编码器-数据集对上，均值替换解释了该有序差距的大部分；shot与类级诊断支持有限样本机制，而较弱的仅基类编码器不满足该判据。ShrinkSel在十五对上的LDA基础上提升0.04–1.52点，并在Aircraft上选中LDA端点。CLIP ViT-B/16上QPR增益1.21–2.03点，逐查询自排除仍保留收益，说明提升不依赖自包含；同时QPR以可测的基类代价修复稀缺新类原型，在支持样本充足或类群极小时增益减弱。

Conclusion: 原型估计可用的证据量是冻结特征FSCIL的核心约束；对均值噪声的归因诊断可直接转化为低开销的几何选择与转导修正。

Abstract: Frozen visual encoders make prototype heads competitive in few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL), but it remains unclear how much of the residual head gap is sensitive to noisy novel-class means rather than to the subsequent changes introduced by classifier refitting. On identical features, we construct a retrospective matched counterfactual: first replace each five-shot novel mean with its complete-data counterpart under fixed cosine scoring, then fit a linear probe. Across sixteen strong encoder dataset pairs, mean replacement accounts for the majority of this ordered gap. Shot and classwise diagnostics support a finite-sample mechanism, whereas a weaker base-only encoder does not satisfy the same criterion. This diagnosis motivates ShrinkSel, a support-only selector over prototype radius and covariance shrinkage whose family contains shared LDA as an exact fallback. Across sixteen evaluated pairs, it improves LDA on fifteen by 0.04-1.52 points and selects the exact LDA endpoint on Aircraft. We further introduce Query Prototype Rectification (QPR), a batch-transductive extension that uses gated unlabeled queries to update novel directions while preserving the selected geometry. On CLIP ViT-B/16, QPR adds 1.21-2.03 points; exact query-wise self-exclusion retains the benefit, showing that the gains do not require self-inclusion. The update repairs scarce novel prototypes at a measurable base-class cost and weakens with plentiful supports or very small cohorts. Thus, the evidence available for prototype estimation is a central constraint in frozen-feature FSCIL.

</details>


### [15] [Intervenable Concept Dynamics for Video Activity Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00020)
*Patrick Knab,David Steinmann,Giovanni De Felice,Felix Divo,Udo Schlegel,Wolfgang Stammer,Sascha Marton,Christian Bartelt*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TRACE-CBM，将概念瓶颈模型扩展到未来活动预测，通过稀疏时空图精化概念并用递归预测概念状态演化，兼具可解释与可编辑性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念瓶颈模型（CBM）只用观测输入来锚定概念，无法刻画物体、动作及其交互随时间变化时概念激活如何演化，因而难以用于未来活动预测。

Method: TRACE-CBM：先用稀疏时空图精化观测到的概念激活；再以先前活动分布为条件递归预测未来概念状态；最后用共享活动分类器同时解码观测与预测状态。推理时支持无需更新参数即可编辑概念值、活动激活与学习到的边。

Result: 观测活动Top-1较概念类方法提升1.2–8.5个百分点；H3预测Top-1与匹配的黑箱预测器差距仅1.9–2.2个百分点。概念节点编辑可纠正25.6–34.4%的初始错误H3预测且不翻转原本正确的预测；概念引导在最高90.0%的情况下达到目标活动。

Conclusion: 将概念瓶颈扩展到时间维度的概念状态演化建模是可行的，可在保持接近黑箱预测性能的同时提供可检查、可干预的时空关系依赖。

Abstract: Concept bottleneck models route predictions through human-understandable concepts, making their intermediate states inspectable and editable. Extending this model family to forecasting requires modeling how concept activations evolve over time as objects, actions, and their interactions change, yet existing CBMs ground concepts only in observed inputs and do not forecast their future evolution. We study this problem using videos of ongoing activities and forecast future activities through a named-concept state. We propose TRACE-CBM (Temporal Relational Activity Concept Evolution), which first refines observed concept activations with sparse spatio-temporal graphs. It then recursively predicts future concept states, conditioning each transition on the prior activity distribution, and decodes both observed and predicted states with a shared activity classifier. At inference time, the model supports editing concept values, activity activations, and learned edges without parameter updates, exposing the relational spatio-temporal dependencies used for forecasting. Across multiple datasets, TRACE improves observed-activity Top-1 accuracy over concept-based methods by 1.2-8.5 percentage points and attains H3 forecast Top-1 accuracy within 1.9-2.2 points of matched black-box forecasters. Intervention experiments show concept-node edits correct 25.6-34.4% of initially incorrect H3 forecasts without flipping initially correct ones, and concept steering achieves the requested target activity in up to 90.0% of cases.

</details>


### [16] [SpatialVec: A Unified Representation Learning Framework for Geospatial Objects with Boundary-Aware Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00111)
*Samya Acharja,Kanchan Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SpatialVec：边界感知的空间表示学习框架，通过自适应采样几何边界及邻域并用Transformer编解码器重建几何，生成点/折线/多边形统一的紧凑几何感知表示，显著提升复杂拓扑关系保留与下游任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空间编码方法难以保留细粒度拓扑信息，尤其对折线、多边形等复杂几何的交互；它们对边界结构和局部空间上下文建模不足，导致几何边界附近对拓扑敏感的关系在学习到的嵌入空间中表征不足，复杂空间交互建模困难。

Method: 提出SpatialVec：自适应采样几何边界及其周边区域以捕获细粒度几何结构；采用基于Transformer的编码器-解码器，通过几何重建任务进行训练；输出对点、折线、多边形统一适用的紧凑、几何感知表示。

Result: 在两个真实世界数据集上的实证评估表明，SpatialVec大幅提升了对涉及多边形交互的困难拓扑关系的保留能力，并在下游预测与分类任务上显著优于最先进基线。

Conclusion: 边界感知采样与几何重建式训练可有效弥补现有空间编码在细粒度拓扑建模上的不足，为GeoAI中的拓扑感知空间推理提供统一、高效的表示学习方法。

Abstract: Spatial representation learning is essential for Geospatial Artificial Intelligence (GeoAI) applications, enabling machine learning models to capture the geometry, location, and spatial relationships of geographic entities such as points, polylines, and polygons. Existing spatial encoding methods often struggle to preserve fine-grained topological information, particularly for interactions involving complex geometries such as polylines and polygons. These approaches inadequately capture boundary structure and local spatial context, causing topology-sensitive relationships near geometry boundaries to be underrepresented in the learned embedding space. Consequently, accurately modeling complex spatial interactions remains a significant challenge for downstream spatial reasoning tasks. To fill the gap, we introduce SpatialVec, a boundary-aware spatial representation learning framework that adaptively samples geometry boundaries and their surrounding regions, capturing fine-grained geometric structures critical for topology-aware spatial reasoning. A transformer-based encoder-decoder trained through geometry reconstruction produces compact, geometry-aware, and unified representations for points, polylines, and polygons. Empirical evaluation on two real-world datasets shows that SpatialVec substantially improves the preservation of challenging topological relationships involving polygonal interactions and outperforms state-of-the-art baselines significantly on downstream prediction and classification tasks.

</details>


### [17] [A New Formulation of the Elastica Model with Application to Image Inpainting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00110)
*Zuoqiang Shi,Xue-Cheng Tai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出基于曲线二值表示的新Euler弹性（elastica）模型：用一个简单卷积公式计算曲率，使能量转化为加权全变差，从而获得高效的分裂Bregman/ALM算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Elastica能量是建模与处理曲线、界面的重要工具，但在level-set或相场表示下，曲率项使能量非线性、非凸（level-set情形还不可微），最小化非常困难。作者希望规避这一困难。

Method: 采用曲线的±1二值函数表示，将曲率写成简单公式：沿曲线Γ，曲率为 -(1/(C0ε))(Rε*φ)+O(ε)，其中Rε是半径ε球内的径向核，C0为显式常数，不含φ的导数，卷积用FFT计算。所得能量为加权全变差，形式上推广了ROF模型；同一曲率公式亦可得到相场型模型。结合FFT与分裂Bregman迭代（此处等价于增广拉格朗日法ALM），子问题为用共轭梯度求解的线性系统或显式逐点公式。

Result: 在二值图像修复（inpainting）上的数值实验表明所提算法有效。

Conclusion: 基于二值表示的曲率卷积公式为elastica模型提供了线性、可微、易实现的新表述，并配合FFT+Bregman/ALM得到高效算法，是一种有前景的ROF推广框架（相场版本亦可由此导出）。

Abstract: Curves and interfaces play a central role in computer vision and image processing, and Euler's elastica energy is one of the most successful tools to model and manipulate them. In this paper, we propose a new formulation of the elastica model based on a binary representation of curves. The key ingredient is a very simple formula for the curvature: if $φ$ is the $\pm1$ binary function associated with a curve $Γ$, then along $Γ$ the curvature is given by $-\frac{1}{C_0ε}\left(R_ε*φ\right)+O(ε)$, where $R_ε$ is a radial kernel supported in a ball of radius $ε$ and $C_0$ is an explicit constant. No derivative of $φ$ is involved and the convolution is evaluated by FFT. The resulting energy is a weighted total variation, so that formally the new formulation is a generalization of the well-known ROF model; a phase field type model is obtained from the same curvature formula. Combining FFT with the split Bregman iteration, which for the present problem coincides with an augmented Lagrangian method (ALM), we obtain efficient algorithms whose subproblems are either linear systems solved by conjugate gradient or explicit pointwise formulas. Numerical experiments on the inpainting of binary images are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms.

</details>


### [18] [A Novel Lightweight Multi-Scale Branching Encoder for Few-Shot Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00099)
*Oriod Malo,Alexandre Xavier Falcão,Laurent Najman*

Main category: cs.CV

Abstract: Few-Shot Learning (FSL) addresses classification scenarios in which only a small number of labeled examples are available for each class. This paper presents the Sum12 Multi-Scale branching encoder, a lightweight convolutional architecture designed to improve the embedding stage of Prototypical Networks without substantially increasing computational cost. The encoder uses seven parallel convolutional branches whose kernel-size combinations sum to 12, allowing local and broader spatial structures to be represented within a unified Multi-Scale feature space. The proposed architecture was evaluated on Omniglot, CIFAR- FS, FC100, and miniImageNet under controlled few-shot learning protocols and compared with the original Prototypical Network encoder and Inception-inspired branch variants. Additional ablation studies have investigated fusion strategies, dilated convolutions, branch compositions, and receptive field budget. Beyond few-shot learning, the encoder was also tested on the MedMNIST 2D benchmark to assess its behavior in conventional supervised medical image classification. Across these experiments, Sum12 generally improved the low-shot classification performance with respect to the basic ProtoNet encoder while preserving a compact model size. These properties suggest that the proposed encoder may be suitable for low-data visual recognition and resource-constrained intelligent imaging applications. However, complete end-to- end validation on the target embedded platform, including resolution of the observed implementation discrepancies, remains future work.

</details>

*Juan Diego Castaño Molina,Borja García de Soto*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Pano2BIM——一种几何约束的VLM智能体，从平面图（已知房间尺寸）与单张360°全景照片生成LOD 200的近似IFC4模型，实现快速低成本as-built BIM构建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字孪生需要准确、及时反映物理现状的BIM，但as-built模型生成与维护成本高、人工密集；图像方法缺乏结构化BIM信息，VLM又难以可靠地完成度量级物体定位。

Abstract: Digital twins require accurate, up-to-date building information models (BIM) that reflect physical conditions, yet generating and maintaining as-built models remains costly and labor-intensive. Emerging image-based methods can capture visual appearance without inherently producing structured BIM information, while vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with reliable metric object placement. This paper presents Pano2BIM, a geometry-constrained VLM agent that generates approximate IFC4 models at Level of Development (LOD) 200 from a floor plan with known room dimensions and a single 360-degree photograph. The VLM identifies landmarks and objects, while deterministic tools estimate camera pose, compute metric positions through ray casting, and check spatial constraints. An optional second stage enriches the presentation model through render-and-compare feedback without modifying the primary furniture geometry. In a preliminary evaluation on one laboratory, the proposed Measure workflow achieved a mean furniture-footprint intersection over union (IoU) of 0.53, compared with 0.44 for a single-response baseline using identical modeling instructions, and matched an average of 4.0 versus 2.3 of seven fixed furniture elements across three runs. Centroid disagreements were similar for the four elements consistently identified by both approaches. The measurement stage averaged 3.8 minutes and USD 1.63 in API costs per run, while the complete demonstrated workflow required approximately 42 minutes and USD 11. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of rapid, low-cost as-built BIM generation, with potential applications in maintaining digital twins that reflect changing physical conditions.

</details>


### [20] [Rethinking Feature Perturbation for Single-Source Domain Generalization: A Representation-Space Analysis and Spectral Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00091)
*Badr-Eddine Benelmostafa,Sohaib Baroud*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出四维表征空间描述符（$D_F$、$D_R$、$\\Theta_{Task}$、$\\Theta_{Subspace}$）作为分析特征扰动的实证框架，并据此设计非学习的傅里叶相位扰动方法DISP，在目标检测的SSDG任务上取得较强OOD性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单源域泛化(SSDG)中的特征扰动方法多以任务性能而非其所引起的表征变化来评价，缺乏可测量、可比较的扰动刻画方式，导致扰动机制难以解释与可控设计。

Method: 构建四维表征空间描述符：特征位移$D_F$、关系位移$D_R$、任务区域比率$\\Theta_{Task}$、子空间偏离$\\Theta_{Subspace}$，作为经验分析框架刻画现有扰动机制；作为案例研究提出Dual-Invariant Spectral Perturbation (DISP)——一种非学习的傅里叶相位扰动，显式控制相位幅度$\\rho$、通道耦合$\\kappa$与频率支撑$\\mathcal{M}$，并经验分析这些控制量对描述符的影响。

Result: 在两个涉及风格与天气偏移的目标检测设定中观察到不同的几何轮廓，较强OOD表现的配置集中于描述符空间的有界区域内；DISP在实验中取得较强OOD性能，并可通过上述描述符解释其控制量的作用。

Conclusion: 该工作不主张存在普适最优几何或最优区域，而是表明可通过表征空间描述符比较扰动，并为在无目标域访问条件下识别与更强SSDG性能相关区域提供动机；作者希望这一视角推动SSDG特征扰动走向更可解释、可控且可检验的方法。

Abstract: Feature perturbation is widely used in single-source domain generalization (SSDG), yet it is typically evaluated by task performance rather than by the representation changes it induces. We investigate whether perturbations can be compared through measurable descriptors of these changes. We introduce a four-dimensional representation-space description comprising feature displacement $D_F$, relational displacement $D_R$, a task-region ratio $Θ_{\mathrm{Task}}$, and subspace deviation $Θ_{\mathrm{Subspace}}$. We use these descriptors as an empirical analysis framework, not as a universal geometry, to characterize existing perturbation mechanisms. Across two object-detection settings involving style and weather shifts, we observe distinct geometric profiles and a concentration of relatively strong out-of-domain (OOD) configurations within a bounded region of the descriptor space. These findings do not establish a universal optimum but motivate investigating whether regions associated with stronger SSDG performance can be identified without target-domain access. As a case study, we introduce Dual-Invariant Spectral Perturbation (DISP), a non-learned Fourier-phase perturbation with explicit controls over phase magnitude $ρ$, channel coupling $κ$, and frequency support $\mathcal{M}$. We empirically examine how these controls affect the proposed descriptors. DISP achieves strong OOD performance in our experiments, illustrating how explicit perturbation controls can be analyzed through a representation-space description. We hope this viewpoint can contribute to more interpretable, controllable, and ultimately testable approaches to feature perturbation in SSDG.

</details>


### [21] [AegisBench: Auditing Aerial Search-and-Rescue Person Detection Under the Conditions It Is Deployed In](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00077)
*Amogh Vinaykumar,Prem Kamasani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出AegisBench基准，用于量化无人机人员检测器在灾害场景中的鲁棒性差距。通过四类灾害、九种物理动机腐蚀、三个严重度，在HERIDAL与SARD上评测Faster R-CNN、YOLOv11、RT-DETR，共168种条件，并揭示低光照下召回率的灾难性失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 应急救援机构正采用无人机人员检测以更快搜寻失踪者，但现有基准均在平静、晴朗的白天采集，而实际触发部署的任务却发生在洪水、野火、风暴和夜间。这种训练/评测环境与实际作业环境之间的错配尚未被系统量化，作者希望用统一评测填补该空白。

Method: 构建AegisBench：从四类灾害族中选取九种具物理动机的腐蚀，每类设三个严重度，且严重度在声明的图像统计量或物理量上单调；应用于HERIDAL与SARD两个航空搜救数据集。选取三种架构迥异的检测器（Faster R-CNN、YOLOv11、RT-DETR），由同一评测器在168种条件下评分，置信度阈值在干净验证集上冻结，模拟实际部署方式，并辅以无阈值mAP与三种训练随机种子的稳健性验证，另用300张真实夜间无人机图像做外部验证。

Result: 鲁棒性高度不均衡。低光照为极端情形：4.5档曝光损失使三种检测器在两个数据集上召回率均降至恰好为零，该结论在无阈值mAP与三种随机种子下均成立，并在300张真实夜间图像上复现（759人中仅检出2人）。幸存检测大多仍落在目标上，故失效是"静默"的——空帧与"有人但看不见"的帧难以区分。在较温和低光照下微调可在留出严重度上恢复0.06–0.19召回，但对其他条件产生架构相关的代价，且不能迁移到真实夜间影像。空间类腐蚀在两个数据集上排序不一致，作者指出无法仅归因于飞行高度，因其参数随帧尺寸而非人体尺寸缩放。

Conclusion: AegisBench揭示现有无人机人员检测基准与灾害实际工况之间存在显著且不均衡的鲁棒性缺口，其中低光照失效尤为隐蔽危险。作者公开腐蚀引擎、评测流程与全部逐条件结果，作为面向此类系统评测的审计工具，并指出腐蚀参数按帧尺寸缩放带来的可比性局限。

Abstract: Drone-based person detection is being adopted by emergency-management agencies to find missing people faster than ground teams can. The benchmarks behind that adoption were collected in calm, clear daylight, while the missions that trigger deployment happen in floods, wildfires, storms, and at night. AegisBench measures that gap. It applies nine physically motivated corruptions from four disaster families, each at three severities monotone in a declared image statistic or physical quantity, to two aerial search-and-rescue datasets, HERIDAL and SARD. Three architecturally distinct detectors (Faster R-CNN, YOLOv11, RT-DETR) are scored across 168 conditions by one shared evaluator, at confidence thresholds frozen on clean validation data as a fielded system would run. Robustness is highly uneven. Low light is the extreme case: a 4.5-stop exposure loss drives recall to exactly zero for all three detectors on both datasets, a result that holds under threshold-free mAP and across three training seeds, and is mirrored on 300 real night drone images, where 2 of 759 people are found. Surviving detections largely stay on target, so the failure is silent: an empty frame looks the same as one whose occupants the system cannot see. Fine-tuning on milder low-light levels recovers 0.06 to 0.19 recall at the held-out severity, at an architecture-dependent cost on other conditions, and does not transfer to real night imagery. Spatial corruptions rank differently on the two datasets, which we cannot attribute to altitude alone because their parameters scale with frame size rather than person size. We release the corruption engine, evaluation pipeline, and all per-condition results as an audit instrument for anyone evaluating these systems.

</details>


### [22] [When frequency domain classification is superior to spatial](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00073)
*Yanir Harel,Shalom Rosner,Ronit D. Gross,Tal Halevi,Shilo Glam,Ella Koresh,Ido Kanter*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文指出频域分类精度下降源于缺乏局部特征，并据此构建频域+空域混合模型以提升分类精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代图像分类模型主要依赖局部特征与特征提取，这在空域表现良好但在频域表现不佳，尽管两种表示包含相同信息。作者意图解释频域精度下降的原因。

Method: 在频域中进行局部交换实验，观察其对逆空域精度的影响；使用含全局特征的空域数据集检验频域精度；据此构建混合模型，将仅在频域训练的模型与仅在空域训练的模型组合，并采用VGG与ViT架构在ImageNet-100、WikiArt、DTD、FMD、PSVRT、KTH-TIPS2-b数据集上训练评估。

Result: 频域局部数据交换显著降低其逆空域精度（甚至低于频域本身），而频域精度基本保持不变；含全局特征的空域数据集在频域取得更高精度；混合模型实现了更高的分类精度。

Abstract: Modern image classification models largely rely on local characteristics and feature extraction for their predictions. This focused approach works well in the spatial domain, but reportedly falls short in the frequency domain, even though both representations contain the same information. This study demonstrates that the significant reduction in accuracy in the frequency domain stems from the lack of local features. Locally swapping data in the frequency domain significantly decreases its inverse spatial domain accuracy, even below that of the frequency domain; however, the frequency domain accuracy remains relatively constant. Moreover, the use of datasets containing global features in the spatial domain yields higher accuracy in the frequency domain. Using these results, a hybrid model is constructed, combining one model trained only in the frequency domain and another trained only in the spatial domain to achieve higher classification accuracy. The proposed visual geometry group (VGG) and vision transformer (ViT) architectures are trained on the ImageNet-100, WikiArt, DTD, FMD, PSVRT, and KTH-TIPS2-b datasets and evaluated.

</details>


### [23] [BreastXAgent: A lightweight agentic explainability framework for breast density classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00065)
*Muhammad Turab,Raja Vavekanand,Knooz Fatima*

Main category: cs.CV

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 乳腺密度分类的深度学习模型通常只输出标签与置信度，缺乏可解释且安全的说明性输出；直接使用LLM生成报告时，容易对Grad-CAM可视化与临床含义作出超出证据的过度断言，存在安全风险。

Conclusion: Agentic护栏可在不修改底层分类器的前提下，实现安全、结构化的解释生成；仅靠提示词约束不足以保证忠实性，需结合路由与规则级护栏。

Abstract: Deep learning models for breast density classification typically return only a label and confidence score. Strict prompting and LangGraph routing improved safety but did not eliminate violations. The full BreastXAgent achieved 100% safety pass rate, zero overclaims, and highest utility score. Results demonstrate that agentic guardrails enable safe, structured explanation generation without modifying the underlying classifier.

*Weiqi Zhang,Yongquan Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DDEL框架，将集成学习的行为反馈引入数据集蒸馏的迭代更新中，并在三个医学影像数据集上进行了初步验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统上数据集蒸馏（DD）与集成学习（EL）是串行使用的：蒸馏出的数据固定后集成模型才进行学习，蒸馏过程无法感知集成的表现。作者希望打通二者，使集成在源数据上的表现反馈到蒸馏更新中。

Method: DDEL闭环框架：每一轮先训练集成模型，在源数据上测量损失和预测分歧（prediction disagreement），再用这些信号指导下一轮数据更新；实现上采用分布匹配（distribution matching）与一个同质的三成员集成。

Conclusion: 结果为DD-EL反馈方向提供了初步证据；其计算开销与鲁棒性仍需受控评估，尚未证明稳定优于开环基线。

Abstract: Dataset distillation (DD) reduces a training set to a small set of examples, while ensemble learning (EL) combines predictions from several models. When applied in sequence, the distilled set remains fixed as the ensemble learns. We introduce DDEL, a framework that feeds ensemble behavior back into distillation. Each round trains the ensemble, measures loss and prediction disagreement on the source data, and uses these signals to guide the next data update. We implement this loop with distribution matching and a homogeneous three-member ensemble.
  Preliminary experiments cover skin lesion classification (ISIC 2019), treatment-response prediction (I-SPY1), and binary two-year prognosis classification (NSCLC-Radiomics). With the same images-per-class budget as the open-loop comparison, DDEL reaches balanced accuracy 0.3471 on ISIC and mean ROC-AUC 0.5120 and 0.5597 on I-SPY1 and NSCLC. The I-SPY1 difference is small, and the ISIC trajectory shows that more rounds do not consistently improve performance. These results offer initial evidence for studying DD-EL feedback, with its computational cost and robustness still requiring controlled evaluation.

</details>


### [25] [From Clips to Streams: A Unified Framework for Streaming Sign Language Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00055)
*Hoang Quan Dang,Xin Shen,Yanbin Liu,Xin Yu,Ling Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文定义流式手语翻译（Streaming SLT）任务，并提出首个端到端框架StreamSLST，通过可变形Transformer并行解码联合完成连续视频中的手语分割与翻译。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SLT研究多聚焦于预分割片段，脱离真实连续通信场景；从片段走向流需要同时发现并翻译连续未裁剪视频中的语言事件。级联式"先分割后翻译"方案存在误差传播问题。

Method: 提出StreamSLST：基于Deformable Transformer的并行解码策略，单次前向联合优化时间分割与翻译；引入句子感知滑动窗口采样器（Sentence-aware Sliding Window Sampler）将连续流裁剪为可训练单元以支持长视频可扩展训练；设计三模态视觉-语言预训练（Tri-modal Visual-Language Pretraining）阶段，在联合优化前对齐姿态动态与文本语义。

Result: 在BOBSL、How2Sign两个真实流式数据集及新构建的Streaming-Phoenix-2014T、Streaming-CSL-Daily两个合成流式基准上实验，StreamSLST持续优于匹配的级联分割-翻译流水线；分析表明联合优化学到了更宽、更利于翻译的时间支撑区域，简单扩展或缩放标注跨度无法复现该效果。

Conclusion: 工作建立了连续手语理解的首个稳健基准，为可及的真实世界通信接口铺路；代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Sign Language Translation (SLT) research has typically focused on pre-segmented clips, a constraint that disconnects models from the continuous reality of real-world communication. To bridge the gap from clips to streams, we formally define Streaming SLT, a realistic task demanding the joint discovery and translation of linguistic events from continuous, untrimmed video inputs. To address this challenge, we propose StreamSLST, the first end-to-end framework for Streaming Sign Language Segmentation and Translation via Deformable Transformer architecture. Unlike cascaded approaches that suffer from error propagation, StreamSLST employs a parallel decoding strategy to jointly optimize temporal segmentation and translation in a single pass. To enable scalable training on long-form videos, we incorporate a Sentence-aware Sliding Window Sampler that crops continuous streams into trainable units. We further design a Tri-modal Visual-Language Pretraining stage that aligns pose dynamics with textual semantics before joint optimization. To support comprehensive evaluation, we conduct experiments on two real-world streaming datasets, BOBSL and How2Sign, together with two newly constructed synthetic streaming benchmarks, Streaming-Phoenix-2014T and Streaming-CSL-Daily. The results demonstrate that StreamSLST consistently outperforms a matched cascaded segmentation-then-translation pipeline. Interestingly, our analysis reveals that joint optimization learns wider, translation-effective temporal support that simple expansion or rescaling of the annotated spans fails to reproduce. Our work establishes the first robust benchmark for continuous sign language understanding and paves the way for accessible real-world communication interfaces. The source code and data are available at https://github.com/streamsl/StreamSLST.

</details>

*Santosh Pant*

TL;DR: 该论文用相同单时相Sentinel-2像素系统检验了农业地块范围分割基准中的两个常见做法——用耕地覆盖代理替代真实地块标签、以逐像素光谱基线作对照——对结论的影响，并比较冻结主干/解码器与全参数微调的GeoFM表现。结果表明代理标签会显著抬高任务可分性，U-Net基线在多数设定下领先，冻结解码器常可与微调等效且参数更省，因此解读GeoFM排名前需审计标签与基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GeoFM农业地块范围分割基准常依赖ESA WorldCover等耕地覆盖代理标签，并与逐像素光谱基线比较；作者怀疑这些选择会系统性影响GeoFM相对结论，需在受控条件下量化其影响。

Result: 代理标签使RF AUROC由0.55–0.82升至0.79–0.96；真实标签下U-Net达0.89–0.98 AUROC，并在六区域中五个区域的点AUROC高于Prithvi冻结线性探针；12个区域×模型单元中9个在ε=0.02下TOST等效，肯尼亚为共同失败案例（正样本约0.1%像素，微调更优）；30迁移矩阵中U-Net在AUROC与AP上整体领先；排除肯尼亚后两个冻结解码器优于其微调版本，冻结TerraMind与U-Net无AUROC差异；Prithvi冻结解码器可训练参数约为全微调的1/110。

Conclusion: 解读GeoFM排名前应审计标签与基线，并优先测试冻结解码器而非默认全微调；结论限于单时相、逐像素地块范围分割，不适用于地块边界或实例勾绘。

Abstract: Geospatial foundation-model (GeoFM) benchmarks for agricultural field-extent segmentation often rely on cropland land-cover proxies and compare against per-pixel spectral baselines. We measure how these choices affect conclusions using identical single-date Sentinel-2 pixels from six countries. Replacing polygon-derived field labels with ESA WorldCover cropland raises random-forest AUROC from 0.55-0.82 to 0.79-0.96, showing that the proxy creates a more spectrally separable task. On the actual field-extent labels, a from-scratch U-Net reaches 0.89-0.98 AUROC and has higher point AUROC than a Prithvi frozen linear probe in five of six regions. We then compare a frozen backbone and full fine-tuning using the same decoder for Prithvi and TerraMind, with ten matched seeds. At $\varepsilon=0.02$ AUROC, 9 of 12 region$\times$model cells are TOST-equivalent. Kenya is the common failure case: positives cover roughly 0.1% of pixels, and full fine-tuning performs better for both models. Cross-region results are less favorable to frozen models. On AUROC and average precision (AP), the U-Net leads the full 30-transfer matrix, while an exploratory analysis excluding Kenya finds that both frozen decoders outperform their fine-tuned counterparts; no AUROC difference is detected between frozen TerraMind and the U-Net in that subset. For Prithvi, a frozen decoder trains about $110\times$ fewer parameters than full fine-tuning. These results argue for auditing labels and baselines before interpreting GeoFM rankings, and for testing a frozen decoder before assuming that full fine-tuning will help. ### [27] [SparseWAM: Driving World-Action Models are Worth 16 Register Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00044)
*Yixiang Yang,Lizhong Zhang,Xingyu Zhang,Zhiwen Chen,Jie Ling,Qiankun Yu,Xingliang Liu,Yang Lei,Zhipeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SparseWAM 提出在每帧仅 16 个 token 的稀疏 register 空间内进行世界模型预测，实现低延迟且保留 test-time imagination 的规划框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于视频生成器的 WAM 需在推理时生成稠密未来视频，延迟过高；而高效变体在部署时丢弃 world 分支，丧失测试时想象能力；即使改用 patch 级 DINO/JEPA 特征，仍存在长 token 序列并编码决策无关信息的问题。

Method: 以冻结 DINOv2 特征压缩得到每帧仅 16 个 token 的稀疏 register 空间，并通过联合"规划-评分"预训练使该空间聚焦决策相关信息；在此空间上采用模态解耦的 Mixture-of-Transformers，配合因果注意力掩码，使 action token 可条件于想象出的未来 register。

Result: 在 NAVSIM v1 上达 92.6 PDMS，NAVSIM v2 上达 90.1 EPDMS，NavHard 上达 39.6，延迟仅 164 ms，约为 DriveVA 的 1/5。

Conclusion: 稀疏 register 空间在保持显式"先想象后行动"推理的同时显著降低延迟，并支持低成本多模态采样，验证了该表示的高效性。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) transfer scene-dynamics priors to planning by jointly forecasting future scenes and ego trajectories. However, WAMs built on video generators must generate dense future videos at inference, incurring prohibitive latency, while efficient variants discard the world branch at deployment and thus forgo test-time imagination. Even when dense video latents are replaced with patch-level DINO or JEPA features, these representations still involve long token sequences and encode decision-irrelevant information. We therefore propose SparseWAM, which forecasts in a sparse register space of only 16 tokens per frame, compressed from frozen DINOv2 features and shaped by joint planning-and-scoring pretraining to concentrate decision-relevant information. Within this space, SparseWAM employs a modality-decoupled Mixture-of-Transformers with a causal attention mask that lets action tokens condition on imagined future registers, retaining explicit imagine-then-act reasoning at deployment. Its compactness further enables low-cost multimodal sampling. As a result, our SparseWAM achieves 92.6 PDMS on NAVSIM v1, 90.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, and 39.6 on NavHard at only 164 ms latency, roughly 1/5 that of DriveVA, demonstrating the efficiency of the sparse register space. Code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>

*M. J. Marapperuma,B. V. K. I. Vidanage*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于深度学习的植物病原识别虽准确，但依赖大规模标注数据且为黑箱操作，限制了灵活性与透明性，亟需一种数据需求低、可解释的替代方案。

Method: 构建混合检测框架：采用OWL开发水果病害综合本体，形式化编码症状表型、光谱表型（HSV）与形态表型等植物病理知识；由知识引导图像处理流水线，在专家规则下完成诊断，无需大规模训练集；并对本体进行结构合理性与实用性的计算验证评估。

Conclusion: 知识驱动方法可在自动水果病害诊断中提供准确、透明且可扩展的解决方案，克服深度学习对大规模标注数据的依赖与黑箱局限。

Abstract: Efficiency and reliability in the timely identification of phytopathogens would help minimize crop loss in agricultural sectors but existing deep learning based methods, although accurate, would require a large annotated dataset and are black-boxed in their operation, thus, restricting flexibility and transparency. The current paper presents a hybrid detection framework that is able to overcome these drawbacks through the unified real-time vision with a semantic knowledge base. Web Ontology Language (OWL) was used to develop a comprehensive ontology of the disease of fruits that formally codifies phytopathological knowledge, such as symptom phenotype, spectral phenotype (HSV), and morphological phenotype. Such knowledge-guided configuration guides the image processing pipeline, making it possible to diagnose using this knowledge under expert specified rules without a large training dataset. The ontology underwent a computationally verified test of its structural soundness and commonsensical practical usefulness and scored an overall of 7.4/10. On the public set of MangoFruitDDS, the diagnostic performance was an F1 Score of 85.00%, precision of 85.00%, and a recall of 85.23%. These findings are very competitive and similar to other known deep learning models like the VGG16 that prove that the knowledge-driven approach provides an accurate, transparent, and scalable solution on automated fruit disease diagnosis.

</details>


### [29] [Selective Positional Allocation for Noise-Robust Query Retrieval in Small-Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00035)
*Yangchen Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SPAR检测框架，将位置先验视为可分配资源，通过选择性位置嵌入、前景门控解码与双路径采样卷积提升遥感小目标检测性能，并显著压缩解码器层数与参数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航空与遥感图像中的微小目标检测瓶颈更多来自位置先验在前景/背景界定模糊区域上的分布方式，而非骨干网络的表征能力；同时小目标证据极度稀疏。

Method: 核心为选择性位置嵌入SPE（可解释嵌入+激活条可视化，便于检查与超参调优）；编码端MOHFE融合热图调制位置信号与类别、框级证据，得到更紧凑的多尺度特征；解码端HIDQ以前景门控在查询解码前剔除背景主导候选；DPSConv以两条几何互补采样路径增强检索表征。热图监督全部源自既有检测目标，仅训练期使用，无需额外标注，推理为普通前向且无额外梯度开销。

Result: 在DOTA、DIOR、VisDrone、PASCAL VOC、NWPU VHR-10、AITOD上验证：相较基线最高提升9.1个百分点，解码器由8层缩短至3层，参数量减少59.4%（66.3M vs 163M）。

Conclusion: 将位置线索建模为可分配资源并配合前景门控与互补采样，可在无需额外标注与推理开销的前提下，同时提升遥感小目标检测精度并大幅精简模型结构。

Abstract: In aerial and remote-sensing imagery, detecting tiny targets is frequently hampered less by the representational capacity of the backbone network than by the manner in which positional priors are distributed across ill-defined foreground and background regions. We introduce SPAR (Selective Positional Allocation and Retrieval), a detection framework that re-conceptualizes positional cues as an allocatable resource: they are intensified at semantically meaningful locations while responses driven by scene clutter are actively attenuated. At the heart of SPAR lies Selective Positional Embedding (SPE), an interpretable embedding mechanism paired with an activation-bar visualization that facilitates direct inspection and hyper-parameter tuning. The encoder branch, termed MOHFE, fuses heatmap-modulated positional signals with category-specific and box-level evidence to yield more compact multi-scale features; the decoder branch, termed HIDQ, employs a foreground gating operation to discard background-dominated candidates prior to query decoding. To cope with the extreme sparsity of small-object evidence, we additionally design DPSConv (Dual-Path Sampling Convolution), which augments retrieval-oriented representations through two geometrically complementary sampling routes. Notably, all heatmap supervision is derived from existing detection objectives and consumed exclusively during training, requiring no auxiliary heatmap annotations and leaving inference as an ordinary forward pass with no additional gradient overhead. Comprehensive evaluations on DOTA, DIOR, VisDrone, PASCAL VOC, NWPU VHR-10, and AITOD demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed design: relative to the baseline, SPAR attains an improvement of up to 9.1 percentage points, shortens the decoder from eight layers to three, and reduces model parameters by 59.4% (66.3M versus 163M).

</details>

*Quang-Thinh Nguyen,Duy-Khang Do,Tam V. Nguyen,Minh-Triet Tran,Trung-Nghia Le*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SketchBloom 提出一种免训练的稀疏线稿外扩框架，结合预训练栅格外扩、风格迁移引导与逐实例矢量优化，输出可编辑的 Bezier 笔画 SVG。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏线稿外扩需同时保持轮廓连贯性与笔画风格一致性，现有方法难以兼顾；且端到端训练任务专用网络成本高。

Method: 训练免费框架：自适应隐空间混合平衡内容轮廓与参考纹理；由参考图构建笔画词表，初始化轮廓引导与 DINO-attention 引导的笔画，分别针对结构与纹理优化后，经轮廓强调的多重融合合并为单一 SVG。
