Conclusion: 贡献在于面向线稿外扩的合成流程设计而非新网络；该协议评估矢量合成能力，而非端到端外扩或参考风格优越性。

Abstract: Outpainting sparse sketches while preserving contour coherence and stroke style remains challenging. We present SketchBloom, a training-free framework that combines pretrained raster outpainting and style-transfer guidance with per-instance vector optimization. Given a sketch, a scene prompt, and an optional reference style, it produces an editable Scalable Vector Graphic (SVG) composed of Bezier strokes. Adaptive latent blending balances content contours and reference texture without model retraining. A reference-derived stroke vocabulary initializes contour- and DINO-attention-guided strokes, which are optimized separately for structure and texture before contour-emphasizing multiply fusion. As in prior optimization-based vector sketching, no task-specific network is trained; our contribution is the synthesis design specialized to sketch outpainting. On LineArtOut-1K, comprising 1,024 input and style combinations, SketchBloom improves perceptual, semantic, and structural fidelity over the evaluated vector baselines when all methods vectorize the same outpainted raster. This protocol evaluates vector synthesis rather than end-to-end outpainting or reference-style superiority. Runtime is approximately six minutes per pair on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU. Project page: https://khangcntn123.github.io/SketchBloom/

</details>


### [31] [Structured Channel Network Pruning with Bi-Sparse Matrix Factorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00566)
*Jingjing Liu,Ziyang Wang,Xianchao Xiu,Wanquan Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出双稀疏矩阵分解（BSMF）的结构化通道剪枝方法，将卷积权重建模为共享基上的输出通道系数，用行向ℓ2,p与列向ℓ2,q（p,q∈[0,1)）正则联合刻画共享冗余与个体通道贡献，并用ADMM求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有结构化通道剪枝多基于单个滤波器幅值计算通道重要性分数，难以区分"共享冗余"与"个体通道贡献"，从而影响剪枝判别的准确性。

Method: 将卷积权重矩阵分解为共享基与输出通道系数的乘积形式；对系数分别施加行向ℓ₂,p范数与列向ℓ₂,q范数正则（p,q∈[0,1)，文献中尚未探索）；构建非凸优化问题，基于ADMM设计高效更新方案，各子问题均有闭式解；由学到的因子重构卷积滤波器并丢弃冗余通道，得到紧凑CNN。

Result: 在CIFAR-10与ImageNet-1K上的大量实验表明，BSMF在实现显著网络压缩的同时保持较高的重构精度（原文摘要未给出具体数值）。

Conclusion: 基于低秩/稀疏矩阵分解的通道重要性建模可同时捕捉共享与个体冗余，配合ADMM闭式求解，是一种有效的结构化剪枝框架；代码已开源。

Abstract: Structured channel pruning for convolutional neural networks (CNNs) plays an important role in pattern recognition and deep learning. Nevertheless, existing methods usually calculate channel importance scores based on the magnitudes of individual filters, making it difficult to distinguish shared redundancy from individual channel contributions. To tackle this limitation, we propose a novel structured channel pruning method termed bi-sparse matrix factorization (BSMF). Specifically, BSMF characterizes the convolutional weight matrix as output-channel coefficients over a shared basis with row-wise $\ell_{2,p}$-norm and column-wise $\ell_{2,q}$-norm regularization terms, respectively. Note that $p,q\in[0,1)$, which, to our best knowledge, has not been explored in the literature. To solve the resulting non-convex optimization problem, we develop an efficient update scheme built upon the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM), in which all subproblems admit closed-form solutions. After that, a compact CNN is obtained by reconstructing the convolutional filters from the learned factors and discarding the redundant channels. Extensive experiments on the CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-1K datasets demonstrate that our proposed BSMF achieves significant network compression while maintaining high reconstruction accuracy. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/xianchaoxiu/BSMF

</details>


### [32] [PAM-Mamba - Efficient Dense Action Detection using Mamba](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00423)
*Dhruvraj Singh Rawat,Faegheh Sardari,Armin Mustafa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PAM-Mamba 是一种线性时间 O(T) 的密集动作检测架构，基于 Mamba 与多分支时序编码器，在参数减少 61-63% 的情况下取得具竞争力的 mAP。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer 方法精度高但自注意力 O(T²) 复杂度限制了对长未裁剪视频的可扩展性；同时需在降低参数量的同时保持密集动作检测的定位精度。

Method: 采用 Mamba 构建 O(T) 多分支时序编码器，包含：门控可学习位置编码 GLPE（标量门初始化为零，训练初期不注入位置信号）；Hub-and-Spoke Funnel（在 PAT 非层级多尺度设计上引入从全分辨率输入到各粗分支的直接残差）；Bi-TemBa 双向时序 Mamba（先用浅层时序卷积模块提取局部运动线索，再做级联双向 Mamba 扫描，反向扫描精化正向表示）；以及基于预测熵的不确定性 Mixup 伙伴选择策略。

Result: 在 PAT 评估实现下取得 26.82（Charades I3D）、34.59（Charades CLIP）、46.56（MultiTHUMOS I3D）、46.92 mAP（MultiTHUMOS CLIP），参数量 26.1-27.9M，较 PAT 减少 61-63%。

Conclusion: 以线性复杂度替代二次自注意力可在显著降低参数量的同时维持密集动作检测性能，验证了 Mamba 在该任务上的可行性与高效性。

Abstract: Dense action detection requires precisely localising multiple overlapping actions in long untrimmed videos. Transformer-based methods achieve strong accuracy but their $O(T^2)$ self-attention cost limits scalability. We present PAM-Mamba, a linear-time $O(T)$ architecture built on Mamba with a multi-branch temporal encoder. Gated Learnable Positional Encoding (GLPE) controls positional signal injection via a scalar gate initialised to zero, starting training without added positional signal. A Hub-and-Spoke Funnel extends the non-hierarchical multi-scale design of PAT with a direct residual from the original full-resolution input to each coarse branch, providing each coarse branch with a projection of the input features. Bi-TemBa (Bidirectional Temporal Mamba) first extracts local motion cues with a shallow Temporal Convolution Module, then applies a cascaded bidirectional Mamba scan; the backward pass refines the forward-scanned representation from the opposite direction, giving each temporal position access to context from both directions in linear time. Uncertainty-Based Mixup uses prediction entropy to guide the selection of mixup partners. Using the PAT evaluation implementation, we obtain 26.82 (Charades I3D), 34.59 (Charades CLIP), 46.56 (MultiTHUMOS I3D), and 46.92 mAP (MultiTHUMOS CLIP), with 26.1-27.9M parameters, 61-63% fewer than PAT.

</details>


### [33] [Adversarial robustness does not entail human-aligned categorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00715)
*Itay Reznik,Raz Lapid,Moshe Sipper,Tal Golan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究用GAN优化生成1008张"争议刺激"，比较4个（及17个额外）鲁棒ImageNet分类器与60名被试的二选一类别判断。结果显示鲁棒模型对个体单试次选择的预测接近随机（48.6–51.3%），远低于他人多数判断的预测准确率（85.0–86.8%）；模型—人类一致性（67.3%）显著低于人类—人类一致性（81.3%）。结论：对抗鲁棒性并不保证人类对齐的类别行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对抗训练已被证明能改善人工视觉与生物视觉在某些方面的对应关系，但鲁棒分类器是否获得与人类一致的分类行为尚不清楚。作者希望检验"对抗鲁棒性"与"人类对齐性"是否为可分离的属性。

Method: 在预训练GAN的隐空间优化潜在输入，生成1008个能诱发鲁棒ImageNet分类器两两之间高置信度分歧的"争议刺激"。比较ResNet-101、ViT-B、ConvNeXt-L、Swin-L四个鲁棒分类器与60名被试的二选一类别判断；并扩展到未参与刺激生成的17个RobustBench模型。分析包括个体单试次预测准确率、多数判断预测准确率、结合模型预测强度与被试自报置信度的建模，以及模型—被试一致率与人类—人类一致率的对比。

Result: 模型对个体单试次选择的预测准确率接近随机（48.6–51.3%），而其他被试多数判断的预测准确率为85.0–86.8%。仅在两个卷积模型上，结合预测强度与被试置信度后发现弱的正向模型—人类对应。对所有鲁棒分类器（含17个额外RobustBench模型），模型对人类反应的预测虽高于随机，但低于他人多数判断的预测；17个模型平均模型—被试一致率为67.3%，同一批图像上人类—人类一致率为81.3%。

Conclusion: 研究发现模型特异的对齐失败，以及一种跨越鲁棒分类器持续存在、且显著大于人类观察者之间分歧的模型—人类错配。对抗鲁棒性本身不足以保证人类对齐的分类行为，鲁棒性与人类对齐性应作为视觉识别系统的两个独立属性分别评估。

Abstract: Adversarial training can improve some forms of correspondence between artificial and biological vision, but whether robust classifiers acquire human-aligned classification behavior remains unclear. We generated 1,008 controversial stimuli by optimizing latent inputs to a pretrained GAN to elicit high-confidence disagreements between pairs of robust ImageNet classifiers. We compared four adversarially robust ImageNet classifiers - ResNet-101, ViT-B, ConvNeXt-L, and Swin-L - with two-alternative category judgments from 60 participants. We first evaluated each classifier on stimuli optimized to elicit disagreement with another model. Across classifiers, accuracy in predicting individual participants' single-trial category choices was near chance (48.6-51.3%), whereas majority judgments from other participants predicted responses with 85.0-86.8% accuracy. An analysis incorporating model prediction strength and participants' reported confidence found weak positive model-human correspondence for the two convolutional models. On stimuli optimized for disagreement between other model pairs, all four robust classifiers predicted human responses above chance but less accurately than predictions based on other participants' majority judgments; the same pattern held for 17 additional RobustBench models not used in stimulus generation. Across these 17 models, mean model-participant agreement was 67.3%, versus 81.3% mean participant-participant agreement on the same images. These results identify model-specific failures of human alignment and a model-human mismatch that persists across robust classifiers and substantially exceeds disagreement among human observers. Our findings show that adversarial robustness alone does not guarantee human-aligned categorization and suggest that robustness and human alignment should be evaluated as distinct properties of visual recognition systems.

</details>


### [34] [OCRia-1 Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00092)
*Aman Rangapur,Antonio Jimeno Yepes,Daniel Bustamante,Nutchapol Dendumrongsup,Sebastián G. Acosta,Pierre-Loïc Doulcet,Simon Suo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OCRia-1 是一个 4B 文档解析视觉语言模型，通过高质量数据策划、维度专用可验证奖励的 SFT+RLVR 训练，在表格结构、图表数据与文本格式保真上超越包括 35B 模型与 Mistral OCR 4.1 在内的对比系统，ParseBench 均分 0.87，并以块扩散投机解码等工程优化实现约 4700 tokens/s 的单请求解码速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统文档解析在合并单元格与跨行表头、数千单元格的超大表格、图表数据以及粗体/斜体/上下标等有意义的文本格式上表现薄弱，而这些细节对业务关键型文档分析至关重要。论文旨在构建一个能在上述难点上保持结构保真、同时兼顾推理效率的文档解析模型。

Method: 以数据质量与奖励设计为核心：合成页面为长表格与富格式提供精确真值，真实页面通过以 PDF 文本层为锚的流水线进行转写，强调质量与多样性优先于规模；设计针对表格重建、图表数据抽取、文本格式保真的维度专用奖励；先做监督微调（SFT），再用带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）精调。推理侧采用块扩散投机器（block-diffusion speculator）、量化与自定义 kernel 加速。

Result: 在表格、图表与文本格式三个维度上取得所评估系统（含 35B 模型与 Mistral OCR 4.1）中的最高分；四维 ParseBench 平均得分 0.87，次优系统为 0.75。单张 B200 GPU、单请求下解码约 4700 tokens/s，约为基座模型在原生 vLLM 上的 9 倍，是同类中已发表最快的文档解析 VLM。

Conclusion: 性能提升主要归因于侧重质量与多样性而非数量的数据策划，配合维度级可验证奖励的 SFT+RLVR 训练范式；同时表明小参数模型在精细数据与工程优化支撑下，可在解析精度与解码吞吐上同时超越更大规模系统。

Abstract: We introduce OCRia-1, a 4B vision-language model (VLM) for document parsing that excels at preserving table structure, extracting chart data and retaining text formatting. OCRia-1 handles content that has traditionally been challenging in document parsing: merged cells and spanning headers, tables with thousands of cells, chart data, and meaningful text formatting such as bold, italics, subscripts and superscripts, preserving details needed for business-critical document analysis. At the time of this report, it achieves the highest scores on tables, charts and text formatting among the systems evaluated, including a 35B model and Mistral OCR 4.1. Its mean ParseBench score over the four dimensions we evaluate is 0.87, against 0.75 for the next-best system.
  We emphasize data quality and reward design in training OCRia-1. Synthetic pages provide exact ground truth for long tables and rich formatting, while real pages are transcribed using a pipeline grounded in the PDF text layer. We attribute OCRia-1's performance primarily to careful data curation that prioritizes quality and diversity over quantity. Dimension-specific rewards evaluate table reconstruction, chart-data extraction and text-formatting fidelity. We train the model on the curated data using supervised fine-tuning (SFT), then refine it through reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR).
  To our knowledge, OCRia-1 is the fastest published document-parsing VLM in its class, decoding at about 4,700 tokens per second with a single request on one B200 GPU, about nine times faster than the base model on stock vLLM. This is achieved through a block-diffusion speculator, quantization and custom kernels.

</details>


### [35] [Spoofing the Latent State: Imperceptible Goal-Image Attacks Derail Planning in LeWorldModel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00427)
*Kunal Bhosikar,Nicole Meng,Charu Sharma,Yingjie Lao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究 JEPA 类视觉世界模型（以 LeWM 为例）的测试时鲁棒性，发现其潜空间度量被任务相关物体状态主导且高度非线性缠绕，单帧 ε=4/255 的白盒对抗扰动即可伪造物体位姿，使 Push-T 规划成功率从 87% 降至 32%，且该漏洞在四个标准基准上普遍存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: JEPA 被提出作为控制的通用视觉世界模型，其规划依赖潜空间欧氏距离作为代价界面，但这一"潜度量是否可信、是否鲁棒"的关键假设缺乏检验，作者因此针对该规划接口开展测试时鲁棒性分析。

Method: 以 LeWM（SIGReg 抗坍塌、端到端像素训练、平方欧氏距离规划）为对象，在 Push-T 上定量剖析学习到的潜度量结构（单像素位移的影响、位姿交换对场景距离的贡献占比、流形几何特性），并施加白盒 ℓ∞ 对抗扰动（ε=4/255、8/255）于目标图像/实时观测帧，与同量级及两倍量级的均匀随机噪声对照，在 Push-T、Two-Room、Reacher、OGBench-Cube 四个基准上评估规划性能退化。

Result: 潜距离被任务相关物体状态强烈主导：方块平移一个像素造成的嵌入位移是智能体等价位移的 3 倍，仅交换方块位姿即占场景对距离的 99%；但位姿信息分布在弯曲的高维流形上而非固定线性子空间，编码器无法事后线性编辑。ε=4/255 的扰动在 73%–95% 的场景中使编码器把方块识别为攻击者指定的任意位姿，同时不干扰智能体状态编码；扰动目标图像或实时观测均使 Push-T 成功率从 87% 降至 32%，而两倍幅度的均匀随机噪声影响可忽略。ε=8/255 时在全部环境中弥合 82%–97% 的平方潜距离，规划退化程度与各任务对被伪造实体的依赖度成正比。

Conclusion: 基于潜欧氏距离的 JEPA 规划接口存在系统性对抗脆弱性：扰动可通过非线性的位姿流形直接劫持目标匹配度量，且难以用简单的潜空间编辑修复；该问题跨基准普遍，提示此类世界模型需在度量设计与编码鲁棒性层面重新审视，而非仅依赖抗坍塌正则化。

Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) have recently emerged as general-purpose visual world models for control. A prominent example is LeWorldModel (LeWM), which trains end-to-end from pixels using an isotropic Gaussian anti-collapse regularizer (SIGReg) and plans by minimizing the squared Euclidean distance between predicted and goal embeddings. In this work, we investigate the test-time robustness of this latent planning interface. Analyzing the learned metric on Push-T, we first find that task-relevant object state heavily dominates latent distance: shifting the block by a single pixel displaces the embedding $3\times$ further than an equivalent agent shift, and swapping the block pose alone accounts for $99\%$ of the distance between scene pairs. However, because this pose information is distributed across a curved, high-dimensional manifold rather than a fixed linear subspace, the encoder cannot be trivially edited post-hoc to isolate or redirect it. We next demonstrate that this geometry is highly vulnerable at test time. A white-box $\ell_\infty$ perturbation of just $ε{=}4/255$ applied to a single input frame causes the encoder to register the block at an arbitrary, attacker-chosen pose in $73$--$95\%$ of scenes without disturbing the encoded agent state. Perturbing either the goal image or the live camera observation drops Push-T planning success from $87\%$ to $32\%$, whereas uniform random noise at twice the magnitude has negligible impact. This vulnerability persists across all four standard LeWM benchmarks (Push-T, Two-Room, Reacher, and OGBench-Cube). At $ε{=}8/255$, the attack bridges $82$--$97\%$ of the squared latent distance to the target embedding in every environment, inducing planning degradation proportional to each task's reliance on the spoofed entity.

</details>


### [36] [LoD-Loc v4: Towards Generalized Aerial Visual Localization via Panoptic LoD 3D Map Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00704)
*Shuaibang Peng,Chengming Zhang,Juelin Zhu,Xia Li,Xiaoya Cheng,Zeyu Cui,Shen Yan,Maojun Zhang,Yu Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出LoD-Loc v4，通过构建融合OSM、DEM与LoD资产的统一全景LoD三维地图，将航空视觉定位重构为全景配准任务，并借助新构建的AirPan数据集训练具备零样本泛化能力的分割模型，从而在无建筑场景下仍保持可靠定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LoD三维地图的航空视觉定位方法几乎完全依赖建筑物要素，在农村或欠发达地区建筑稀疏甚至缺失时会出现灾难性定位失败。

Method: 1) 融合OSM、DEM与LoD资产构建统一的全景LoD三维地图；2) 将定位问题重构为全景配准任务：把查询图像解析为离散的建筑物"thing"实例与连续的道路、植被、水体等"stuff"区域，与地图进行整体对齐以鲁棒优化相机位姿；3) 设计自动化流水线构建AirPan数据集（约8.5万张图像、像素级标注），用于训练全景分割模型并实现零样本泛化。

Result: 大量实验表明LoD-Loc v4显著优于当前SOTA基线；尤其在无建筑场景中仍能维持可靠定位，完全克服了以往以建筑为中心范式的灾难性失败。

Conclusion: 引入全景"thing+stuff"场景要素与统一全景LoD地图，可突破建筑依赖瓶颈，提升航空视觉定位在多样地理环境下的鲁棒性与泛化能力。

Abstract: Aerial visual localization over Level-of-Detail (LoD) 3D Maps has recently gained significant traction due to its global scalability, storage efficiency, and privacy-preserving nature. However, existing methods rely almost exclusively on building elements, which leads to catastrophic localization failures in rural or undeveloped areas where buildings are sparse or non-existent. To address this, we construct a unified Panoptic LoD 3D Map by fusing OpenStreetMap (OSM), Digital Elevation Models (DEM), and LoD assets, reformulating the problem as a panoptic registration task. By parsing the query image into discrete building `thing' instances and continuous `stuff' regions comprising road, vegetation, and water, we establish a holistic alignment with this map to robustly optimize the camera pose. To enable reliable panoptic perception, we develop a new automated pipeline that constructs AirPan - the largest aerial panoptic segmentation dataset to date, comprising 85k images with pixel-accurate annotations. This empowers our panoptic segmentation model to exhibit remarkable zero-shot generalization capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LoD-Loc v4 consistently outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines by a significant margin. Most notably, it successfully maintains reliable localization in building-less scenarios, completely overcoming the catastrophic failures of prior building-centric paradigms.

</details>


### [37] [Content-Preserving Principal Feature Blending for Training-Free Style Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00683)
*Le-Hoang Bui,Hoang-Nguyen Cao,Trung-Nghia Le,Minh-Triet Tran,Dinh-Khoi Vo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的CoPFB方法，通过从干净生成分支估计低秩内容基并去除风格残差中的内容对齐分量，缓解视觉自回归模型风格个性化中的内容泄漏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参考图风格个性化需复现风格外观同时保留内容提示指定的主体；但在视觉自回归模型中，主导的参考特征会携带物体与空间信息，导致内容泄漏。

Method: CoPFB为免训练方法：从干净生成分支估计低秩内容基，剔除风格残差中与内容对齐的分量；在前两个自回归尺度采用秩一混合，随后三个尺度采用更弱的内容投影精修。无微调、无可学习参数。

Conclusion: 以内容基投影的方式可有效抑制参考特征的内容泄漏，在几乎不损失风格相似度的前提下稳定提升内容保真与综合表现，且无需训练即可即插即用。

Abstract: Reference-based style personalization should reproduce the appearance of a style reference while preserving the subject specified by a content prompt. In visual autoregressive models, dominant reference features can also carry object and spatial information, causing content leakage. We propose Content-Preserving Principal Feature Blending (CoPFB), a training-free method that estimates a low-rank content basis from a clean generation branch and removes the content-aligned component of the style residual. CoPFB applies rank-one blending at the first two autoregressive scales, followed by weaker content-projected refinement at the next three scales. On 1,900 combinations of Parti content prompts and FineStyle reference images, CoPFB improves text alignment from 0.293 to 0.297 and the harmonic score from 0.391 to 0.393 over PFB+SAC, while style similarity decreases from 0.590 to 0.577. CoPFB requires no fine-tuning or learnable parameters. Project page: https://vdkhoi20.github.io/CoPFB/.

</details>


### [38] [ROD-Dataset: A Pedestrian-Perspective Benchmark of Urban Obstacle Classes for YOLO-Based Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00681)
*Abtin Zandi,Ariyan Azami,Bardia Sabagh Kermani,Parsa Abbasian,Roza Ganjipour,Sarvin Nami,Hamed Farbeh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ROD数据集（24,000+图像、40,000+标注障碍物、25类），统一29个公开数据集并新增德黑兰与多伦多两个城市的平视图像，用于行人视角实时障碍物检测，并用六个轻量YOLO模型建立基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉受损者和注意力分散的行人都面临人行道障碍风险，但现有视觉系统只能识别训练过的障碍。现有数据存在缺陷：公开基准多来自车载、航拍或固定平台；通用检测器忽略导致绊倒的街道设施；行人相关数据集局限于单一地区且类别体系不兼容，因此缺少合适的训练集。

Method: 构建ROD数据集：超过24,000张图像、40,000个标注障碍物、25个类别，涵盖车辆、行人以及楼梯、井盖、交通锥、长椅等通用检测器忽略的街道设施。将29个公开数据集统一到单一分类体系，并补充来自德黑兰和多伦多两个大洲对比城市的平视图像。所有标签经人工核验，每个采集批次需通过轻量检测器可学习的预筛选。以六个轻量YOLO（nano/tiny）模型进行基准评测，并报告全部25类的逐类召回率。

Abstract: Two groups of pedestrians face avoidable risk on the city sidewalk: people living with visual impairment, who reach an obstacle before anything warns them, and people walking with divided attention, who register a hazard late or not at all. Because the recall and mAP rankings disagree, selecting a model by mAP does not minimize missed obstacles, so per-class recall is reported for all 25 classes.

Main category: cs.CV

  <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 在多个基准上实验验证了DGC的有效性与优良特性：(1)簇中心为真实感合成样本，可直接解释；(2)推理成本随簇数对数增长，O(log K)，可扩展至极大K；(3)正则化Wasserstein距离提供平滑良态的优化目标，促进稳定收敛，而l2损失易收敛至较差局部最优；(4)随机邻域选择避免了多步前向中的密度偏移。

Conclusion: DGC通过离散生成建模统一聚类与生成，兼顾可解释簇中心、对数级推理复杂度与稳定训练，具备良好的可扩展性；代码已开源。

Abstract: In this paper, we formulate clustering analysis as discrete generative modeling. Specifically, when the generator is restricted to a finite candidate space, the generated samples naturally emerge as the most representative prototypes of the underlying data distribution. To model such a discrete candidate space, we employ a Discrete Distribution Network (DDN). However, DDN suffers from unstable training due to its hard nearest-neighbor selection. To stabilize training and encourage geometric consistency, we replace DDN's l2 loss between images with regularized Wasserstein distance between the empirical distributions of real and generated images. The resulting framework, termed Discrete Generative Clustering (DGC), offers four notable advantages: 1) the learned cluster centers are directly interpretable, as they are realistic synthetic samples; 2) the inference cost scales logarithmically with the number of clusters, i.e., O(log K), making the method scalable to extremely large K; 3) the regularized Wasserstein distance provides a smooth and well-behaved optimization objective that facilitates stable convergence, whereas DDN's l2 loss tends to converge to poor local optima; and 4) DGC replaces DDN's nearest-neighbor selection with random-neighbor selection, which avoids the density shift problem during multi-step forward. Abstract: Incomplete imaging coverage limits sample sizes for multimodal cognitive prediction. Task-plus-resting-state fusion achieved the highest mean R^2 for fluid (0.2222) and total cognition (0.3665), while structural-plus-resting-state led for crystallized cognition (0.3706), yielding R^2 gains of 0.0805, 0.1180, and 0.0890 over covariate-only references. These findings support using partially observed cohorts for model development to achieve modest fusion gains. Abstract: Multi-modal fusion algorithms combining conventional frame-based cameras and event cameras have recently attracted substantial research attention. Typically, existing approaches convert event streams into frames, voxels, or tensors, and then learn the required spatiotemporal information from these transformed event representations for fusion with conventional frame-camera data. Obviously, such paradigms only exploit the limited representational capacity of event data. Moreover, standard training pipelines fail to fully leverage diverse model parameters obtained throughout the learning process. In this paper, we propose a novel mutual distillation method leveraging multi-view teacher network weights to better integrate multiple event representations and achieve model-parameter level fusion. Specifically, we employ multiple encoders to extract different types of event representations and perform mutual knowledge distillation at both the feature-level and logit-level in this process. Afterwards, we perform a dynamic hierarchical model merge strategy on the model parameters from the first stage to yield a unified multi-modal RGB-Event representation model. *Yuhao Xue,Jiuan Zhou,Yu Cheng,Zhaoxia Yin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SAMP：面向扩散模型的自适应鲁棒水印框架，通过全局裕量调节与脆弱性敏感分配，动态调整去噪过程中的嵌入强度与水印维度优化优先级，在恢复精度0.993的同时将PSNR提升16.8%、LPIPS降低47.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型使高保真视觉生成普及，也降低了伪造门槛、使内容溯源复杂化。现有水印方法在去噪全程使用固定嵌入强度，并对所有水印维度一视同仁，导致部分维度已可靠时仍引入多余失真，而更易受后续扰动影响的维度又得不到充分强化。因此鲁棒水印需同时自适应嵌入强度与水印维度间的优化优先级。

Method: 提出SAMP自自适应框架，含两个组件：1）全局裕量调节（global margin regulation），依据目标码字与竞争码字之间的分离度，并结合对常见攻击影响的估计，调整嵌入强度；2）脆弱性敏感分配（vulnerability-sensitive allocation），识别易被局部扰动削弱的水印维度并赋予更高优化优先级。

Result: 平均信息恢复精度达0.993；相较SOTA方法，PSNR提升16.8%，LPIPS降低47.1%。

Conclusion: 结果验证了SAMP在实现可靠且高质量的扩散水印方面的有效性，表明嵌入强度与维度优先级的联合自适应是提升鲁棒性与视觉质量权衡的关键。

Abstract: Diffusion models have made high-fidelity visual generation widely accessible, while also lowering the barrier to producing convincing visual forgeries and complicating content provenance. Existing watermarking methods typically use a fixed embedding strength throughout denoising or treat all watermark dimensions equally. As a result, they may introduce unnecessary distortion when some watermark dimensions are already reliable, while failing to sufficiently reinforce those that are more vulnerable to subsequent perturbations. Therefore, robust watermarking requires adapting both the embedding strength during denoising and the optimization priority across watermark dimensions. To address this problem, we present SAMP, a self-adaptive framework consisting of global margin regulation and vulnerability-sensitive allocation. Global margin regulation adjusts the embedding strength according to the separation between the target codeword and competing codewords, together with the estimated effects of common attacks. Vulnerability-sensitive allocation identifies watermark dimensions that are more easily weakened by local perturbations and gives them higher optimization priority. Experimental results demonstrate that SAMP achieves an average information recovery accuracy of 0.993. Compared with state-of-the-art methods, SAMP improves PSNR by 16.8% and reduces LPIPS by 47.1%. These results validate the effectiveness of SAMP for reliable and high-quality diffusion watermarking.

</details>

*Yibo Zhao,Ao Qu,Xuan Jiang,Jiahao Xu,Keane Ong,Hang Jiang,Zhaofeng Wu,Dingyi Zhuang,Yihong Tang,Kaichen Zhou,Jinhua Zhao,Paul Pu Liang*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Understanding what happens in a video is not sufficient for socially responsive multimodal systems: such systems also aim to relate what a person observes to how that person responds. Existing video benchmarks largely evaluate events, temporal reasoning, or people depicted in the video, while affective and viewer-response datasets often focus on emotion labels, aggregate responses, or prediction from the stimulus alone. This leaves an underexplored question: can current multimodal models ground an observed viewer reaction in the stimulus context associated with it? We introduce ReactionBench, a human-anchored benchmark for reaction-specific video understanding. Built from a candidate pool of 31,834 synchronized stimulus-reaction clips spanning 433 hours and eight domains, ReactionBench evaluates three complementary abilities: ranking the intensity of a viewer's reactions within a video, matching a reaction to its temporally aligned stimulus, and explaining the concrete stimulus cues linked to that reaction. Human annotation provides 14,894 ratings over 3,257 moments, and the frozen evaluation comprises 250 intensity profiles, 112 matching items, and 200 rationale items with 447 blind-written human references. Across seven multimodal models, reaction-specific grounding remains challenging: the best model reaches 50.9% accuracy on four-way stimulus-reaction matching, while GPT-5 shows no detectable loss under reaction substitution.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Plant disease detection using deep learning has achieved remarkable accuracies exceeding 99% on benchmark datasets. However, these metrics may mask a critical vulnerability: models may be taking advantage of false background correlations instead of learning real pathological features. This study presents a systematic investigation of background bias in plant disease detection through a two-stage training framework with quantitative validation. We propose a three-condition evaluation protocol testing models on original, leaf-only, and background-only images to directly measure background dependency. Our approach combines standard transfer learning using EfficientNet-B0 and manipulation of background information during optimization. Experimental results on the PlantVillage dataset (20,638 images, 15 disease classes) show that while our model achieves 98.97% accuracy on the original images and maintains 96.62% accuracy on leaf-only images, the performance drops to 23.58% on background-only images. The calculated background bias (BBC) coefficient of 0.762 indicates that a large part of the model's predictive performance depends on leaf-related features rather than background distortions. This research offers clear evidence that even with the most advanced models, environmental shortcuts can be leveraged, and this highlights the importance of bias evaluation. The approach that has been used has laid a foundation for the development of agricultural AI that is ready for deployment. The implementation, models, and evaluation process are all publicly available.

</details>

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出以去卷积白化图像噪声残差空间分布的方式去除生成器特定指纹，缓解取证偏差，从而显著提升AI生成图像检测器在分布外（未见生成器）条件下的泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测方法在分布外测试下表现不佳：检测器在与训练集不同的生成器上缺乏鲁棒性。其根源在于检测器依赖生成器特定指纹，形成真实/生成图像来源间的取证偏差（forensic bias），损害泛化。

Conclusion: 对噪声残差空间分布做白化可有效抑制生成器特定指纹带来的取证偏差，是一种简单而有效的预处理手段，可显著改善AI生成图像检测的跨生成器泛化能力。

Abstract: Current AI-generated image detection methods struggle in out-of-distribution testing conditions because detectors are usually not robust when evaluated on generators not included in the training set. This new training process can be approximated by pre-processing involving a deconvolution operation designed to remove correlated noise patterns inducing loss of generalization. Indeed, we show that whitening the spatial distribution of the image noise residuals can significantly improve the performance of detectors on images coming from generators unseen during training. In particular, an end-to-end CNN model trained on whitened image residuals improves detection by 12.6% on average compared to a training involving original images.

</details>

Abstract: According to the World Health Organization, at least 2.2 billion people worldwide live with visual impairment, including tens of millions with severe vision loss. These dual challenges motivate lightweight, smartphone-based solutions that combine accessibility with low latency. </details>

Abstract: Deep learning models for brain tumor diagnosis need to do more than achieve high classification accuracy. These components are brought together in NeuroScan AI, a real-time web application. ### [49] [Gaussifier: Fast 2D Gaussian Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00032)
*Yunlai Zhou,Yu Yin,Michael W. Jenkins,Yehe Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Gaussifier：一种轻量级前馈框架，实现快速高保真的2D高斯分解，可在60+ FPS下达到40.73/38.61 dB PSNR（Kodak-24/DIV2K）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2D高斯虽能以数千帧每秒渲染，但拟合单张图像需数秒优化，只能离线使用；现有前馈方法虽快，但精度低且缺乏单图微调能力。

Method: 从单图拟合数据学习高斯中心的密度图；采用等质量Voronoi划分，使每个Voronoi单元内密度近似相等来放置高斯；再用无状态、可复用的网络进行少量迭代精化输出。

Result: 在Kodak-24/DIV2K上达40.73/38.61 dB PSNR、超60 FPS；同等高斯数量下超越所有前馈基线3.0–15.6 dB；用更少高斯仍领先最强基线2.5–3.5 dB；相同数量下，需单图拟合的基线达到其PSNR需26–326倍时间。

Abstract: 2D Gaussians render images at thousands of frames per second. However, fitting an image takes seconds of optimization. This confines 2D Gaussians to offline use. Feedforward methods are faster but less accurate without per-image fine-tuning. We present Gaussifier, a lightweight feedforward framework for 2D Gaussian decomposition. We learn a density map of Gaussian centers from per-image fitting data. Equal-mass Voronoi places Gaussians so that each Voronoi cell holds approximately equal density. A stateless, reusable network then refines the output in a few iterations. Gaussifier reaches 40.73/38.61\,dB PSNR on Kodak-24/DIV2K at over 60 FPS. At the same Gaussian count, it exceeds every feedforward baseline by 3.0 to 15.6\,dB in PSNR. With fewer Gaussians than any baseline, it still leads the strongest one by 2.5 to 3.5\,dB. At the same count, baselines with their own per-image fitting need 26 to 326 times longer to reach its PSNR. Gaussifier makes high-fidelity 2D Gaussian images fast and light enough for real-time applications. We release code, weights and a browser-based WebGPU demo at https://github.com/Gaussifier/gaussifier.

</details>

*Arda Mamur,Matthias Seibold,Christoph Laux,Florian Wanivenhaus,Philipp Fürnstahl*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 分析13例内镜下腰椎减压手术（13.2 h）的术者实时口述，构建无标注流水线将其转为带时间戳的手术线索并做表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 3,171条话语中1,201条（37.9%）保留为手术线索，57.6%为非手术性被剔除；线索涉及器械60.7%、解剖48.0%、动作57.1%，98.5%至少含其一；39%（472/1,201）为指令类；467条人工核验的器械请求全部早于器械入野，中位提前8.2 s；术语转写错误影响18.0%的保留线索。

Abstract: Manual annotation remains the principal bottleneck in surgical video understanding. Live intraoperative narration by the operating surgeon is a scalable alternative that requires no manual annotation, but the information it contains has not been characterized. We analyzed 13 endoscopic lumbar spine decompression procedures (13.2 h) by two senior spine surgeons, using time-synchronized close-mic German audio. An annotation-free pipeline (word-level speech recognition, deterministic correction of surgical-term errors, utterance fusion, LLM-based translation to English, and relevance filtering) converted speech into time-stamped procedural cues labelled with the surgical entities they reference and their speech act. Of 3,171 utterances, 1,201 (37.9%) were retained as procedural cues, while 57.6% were non-procedural and removed. Retained cues referenced instruments (60.7%), anatomy (48.0%) and surgical actions (57.1%), and 98.5% carried at least one of these. 39% of cues (472 of 1,201) were directives, mainly instrument requests and commands. All 467 manually verified instrument requests preceded the instrument's appearance in the field, by a median of 8.2 s. Domain-term transcription corruption affected 18.0% of retained cues. Live narration is thus a dense, annotation-free supervisory signal describing instruments, anatomy, actions and team coordination, but it is noisy and temporally displaced from the events it names, and this displacement must be modelled before safe downstream use.

</details>


### [51] [The Margin Knows the Background: Uneven Abstention in Frozen Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00026)
*Satwik Sai Prakash Sahoo,Bibhor Puhan,Shubhankar Mahanta*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究冻结视觉-语言模型（CLIP、SigLIP）中选择性预测的置信度分数如何造成群体覆盖不均：分数与群体标签的独立性等价于各阈值下覆盖相等；分数选择的效果依数据集而定，且群体在排名中被推低的幅度比群体可识别性更好地预测覆盖差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单一置信度阈值在拒答不确定样本时，会不成比例地拒答某些群体的样本，造成群体覆盖不均；但不同置信度分数（margin、最大logit等）为何产生此类不平衡、以及这种效应是否随数据集变化，尚缺乏机制性解释。

Method: 将一类分数（含margin、最大logit）表示为最高两类logit的平均值与差值，分析哪一分量携带群体信息；证明"每个阈值下群体覆盖相等"等价于分数与群体归属独立；以随机化margin作为基线，判断覆盖差距的缩减是否超过加噪所能达到的水平；分数选择在测试前固定，在Waterbirds（含配对背景替换）与NICO++上评估，并用Spearman相关比较"群体排名下移幅度"和"群体可识别性"对覆盖差距的预测能力。

Result: Waterbirds上，80%覆盖率时margin造成的覆盖差距是最大logit的2.5–5.5倍，其群体信号位于差值分量，配对背景替换可移动该信号，而最大logit总体误差更高；NICO++上，最大logit反而使最差上下文误差升高5.4–6.6个点，对OpenAI CLIP相对随机基线无改善。两数据集上，群体排名下移幅度对覆盖差距的预测（Spearman 0.88、0.92）优于单纯的群体可识别性（0.61、0.65）。

Conclusion: 某个分数在某一数据集上拒答更均衡，并不意味着在另一数据集上同样有效；应结合随机化基线，同时评估群体覆盖与选择性风险。

Abstract: Selective prediction allows a model to abstain on uncertain inputs, but a single confidence threshold can disproportionately reject examples from particular groups. We study how confidence scores produce this imbalance in frozen vision-language models (OpenAI CLIP, LAION CLIP, SigLIP). We express a family of scores, including the margin and maximum logit, through the average and the difference of the two highest class logits, and ask which carries group information. We show that equal group coverage at every threshold is equivalent to independence between the score and group membership. A randomized margin baseline tests whether a reduction in coverage disparity beats what adding noise achieves. With score choices fixed before testing, the effect of choice depends on the dataset. On Waterbirds, the margin creates coverage gaps 2.5 to 5.5 times larger than maximum logit at 80% coverage, its group signal is in the difference component, and paired background swaps show the background moves it, although maximum logit increases overall error. On NICO++, maximum logit instead increases worst-context error by 5.4 to 6.6 points and offers no improvement over the randomized baseline for OpenAI CLIP. Across both datasets, how far a score pushes a group down its ranking tracks the coverage gap (Spearman 0.88, 0.92) better than plain group identifiability (0.61, 0.65). These results explain why a score that abstains more evenly on one dataset may be less effective on another and motivate judging group coverage and selective risk together against randomized baselines.

</details>

*Wenbin Shen,Zhichao Lian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GILA方法，从冻结预训练编码器的不同深度提取全局表示，经层间自注意力建模交互并自适应聚合，以提升AI生成图像检测与跨数据集泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型快速发展使AI生成图像逼近真实图像，检测面临生成器快速迭代、数据分布变化大、跨数据集泛化有限等挑战；现有基于预训练视觉编码器的方法主要使用最后一层全局表示，中间层有用信息未被充分利用。

Method: GILA从冻结编码器的不同深度提取全局表示，通过层间自注意力建模各层表示间交互，并对得到的上下文化表示进行自适应聚合；方法不依赖特定预训练目标，且无需微调预训练编码器。

Result: 在三种不同预训练目标的视觉骨干、十个已见生成器及三个外部数据集上评估，结果表明GILA更好地利用预训练编码器的多层信息，提升了检测性能与跨数据集泛化能力。

Conclusion: 多层全局表示的层间交互与自适应聚合是提升AI生成图像检测及跨数据集泛化的有效途径，且具备良好的骨干与预训练目标无关性。

Abstract: The rapid development of generative models has made AI-generated images increasingly close to real images. It has also brought several challenges to detectors, including rapid generator updates, large changes in data distribution, and limited cross-dataset generalization. Many existing methods based on pretrained vision encoders primarily use the global representation from the last layer, potentially leaving useful information from intermediate layers underexplored. To address this issue, we propose Global Inter-Layer Aggregation (GILA). GILA extracts global representations from different depths of a frozen encoder, models interactions among layer representations through inter-layer self-attention, and adaptively aggregates the resulting contextualized representations. The method is not tied to a single pretraining objective and does not require fine-tuning the pretrained encoder. We evaluated GILA on three vision backbones with different pretraining objectives, ten seen generators, and three external datasets. The experimental results show that GILA makes better use of multi-layer information in pretrained encoders and improves detection performance and cross-dataset generalization.

</details>


### [53] [SFA: A Statistical Physics-Inspired Diffusion Transformer for Efficient and High-Quality Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00027)
*Zixuan Huang,Tianhao You,Guozhang Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Scale-Free Attention（SFA），利用无标度空间层级对远端区域逐级粗化聚合，实现前向与反向均为 O(N log N) 复杂度的注意力机制，在保持生成质量的同时大幅加速高分辨率扩散 Transformer。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散 Transformer 在高分辨率图像生成中表现优异，但注意力计算随 token 数呈二次增长，加速注意力与保持生成质量之间存在突出矛盾。作者受统计物理与自然界广泛存在的无标度（scale-free）规律启发，寻求一种兼具局部精细交互与远距离高效建模的注意力设计。

Method: SFA 在无标度空间层级上保留细粒度局部交互，同时以逐步变粗的尺度汇总远端区域；具体采用均值池化、token 计数校正，以及在层级上共享的 softmax，使前向与反向均达到 O(N log N) 复杂度，并用 Triton 实现算核。实验涵盖在 ImageNet 256×256 上从头训练 PixelFlow、FFHQ 对比、Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium 与预训练 PixelFlow 的微调实验。

Result: 262,144 token 下，Triton 实现相对 FlashAttention 获得 357.3× 前向与 265.6× 反向加速。PixelFlow 从头训练 40 轮后，SFA 在五种注意力机制（含 full attention）中生成质量最佳，FID-50k 由 full attention 的 13.25 降至 12.51，且优势在 80 轮时仍保持；在 FFHQ 上优于其他高效注意力方法。Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium 替换注意力后，在匹配微调预算下保持原 full attention 的生成质量；预训练 PixelFlow 微调得到类似结果。

Conclusion: SFA 将无标度结构确立为高效高质扩散 Transformer 的有效设计原则：在不牺牲生成质量的前提下实现显著的注意力加速，并在从头训练与预训练微调两种范式下均得到验证。

Abstract: Diffusion transformers have achieved remarkable success in image generation, but accelerating attention while preserving generation quality remains a major challenge at high resolutions. Inspired by statistical physics and the widespread occurrence of scale-free laws in nature, we introduce Scale-Free Attention (SFA), which preserves fine local interactions while summarizing distant regions at progressively coarser scales. For $N$ tokens, mean pooling, token-count correction, and a shared softmax over a scale-free spatial hierarchy give SFA $O(N\log N)$ complexity in both forward and backward passes. Our Triton implementation achieves $357.3\times$ forward and $265.6\times$ backward attention speedups over FlashAttention at 262,144 tokens. After 40 epochs of PixelFlow training from scratch on ImageNet at $256\times256$ resolution, SFA achieves the best generation quality among five attention mechanisms, including full attention. Fréchet inception distance evaluated on 50,000 generated samples (FID-50k) improves from 13.25 for full attention to 12.51, and the advantage over full attention persists through 80 epochs. SFA also achieves the best generation quality among the compared efficient-attention methods on Flickr-Faces-HQ (FFHQ). Beyond training from scratch, Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium with attention replaced by SFA retains the generation quality of its full-attention counterpart under matched fine-tuning budgets. We obtain similar results when fine-tuning pretrained PixelFlow on ImageNet. SFA establishes scale-free structure as an effective design principle for efficient, high-quality diffusion transformers.

</details>


### [54] [LF-VideoQA: Evaluating Long-Video Understanding with Long-Form Theory-of-Mind Questions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00383)
*Shaden Shaar,Bradon Thymes,Majd Aldaye,Claire Cardie,Bharath Hariharan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LF-VideoQA，一个面向长叙事影片的开放式长视频问答数据集，基于心理理论（ToM）问题设计，自动生成6,300+问答与评分rubric，实验显示现有开源VLM在该任务上表现显著不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长视频QA数据集多只需简短答案或选项选择，把长视频理解简化为检索式定位；真正困难的是跨数小时内容综合证据并说明各部分如何关联，这类能力缺乏对应评测基准。

Method: 以角色信念依赖其全部所见所闻为原理构造ToM问题：对剧本标注场景事件及各角色的一阶信念与元信念，借助LLM生成（问题、答案、rubric）三元组并做自动验证；共6,300+问题，覆盖94部近期影片，每题需跨平均23分钟场景推理，并提供题目专属rubric用于召回与精度打分；以人工研究验证质量，并在三种设置下评测四类开源VLM。

Result: 任务极具挑战：（i）可访问剧本的oracle仍远不能给出完整答案；（ii）最佳非oracle模型召回率仅约为oracle的一半；（iii）与以往长视频基准不同，字幕/说明文本不如原始视频，说明问题依赖视觉证据；（iv）召回是主要瓶颈，答案遗漏大量rubric要求的要点。

Conclusion: 开放式长视频推理应被作为综合与整合任务来评测，而非检索；LF-VideoQA为ToM驱动的长叙事视频理解提供了可自动扩展且质量可验证的基准，并揭示当前VLM的核心短板在于证据召回与整合。

Abstract: The hardest part of understanding a long video is not pinpointing any one moment but synthesizing many, e.g., answering a question that requires tracking what develops across hours of content and articulating how the pieces fit together. To date, most long-video QA datasets require only a short answer or a multiple-choice selection, oversimplifying the long-video understanding task to retrieval. We introduce LF-VideoQA, a dataset for long-form, open-ended question answering over long narrative videos built on theory-of-mind questions: a character's belief depends on everything they have seen or been told, so each question demands assembling and reasoning from evidence distributed across the video. The dataset contains more than 6,300 questions on 94 recent films; each requires reasoning over scenes spanning an average of 23 minutes and comes with a question-specific rubric for recall and precision scoring. The dataset is created entirely automatically by annotating screenplays with scene events and each character's first-order beliefs and meta-beliefs, then generating (question, answer, rubric) triples through LLM-based question generation and verification; human studies validate their quality. We evaluate four families of state-of-the-art open-source VLMs across three settings and find the task highly challenging: (i) even an oracle with access to the screenplay falls well short of complete answers; (ii) the best non-oracle model attains barely half of the recall level of the oracle; (iii) unlike on prior long-video benchmarks, captions and subtitles underperform the video itself, indicating that the questions need visual evidence; and (iv) recall is the predominant bottleneck, with answers omitting many required rubric claims.

</details>


### [55] [Déjà Vu: Cycle-Consistent Re-ranking for Semantic Correspondence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00328)
*Xiaoran Zhang,Huidong Liu,Yang Liu,Chien-Chih Wang,Jinfa Huang,Lingkai Kong,Bryan Wang,Yan Gao,Hongdong Li,Alex Wong,James S. Duncan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Déjà Vu，一个用于语义对应的测试时解码模块，将匹配从贪心top-1选择重构为"召回-重排"问题，利用自适应候选集与分级循环一致性重排提升匹配准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大预训练模型特征具备强零样本对应能力，但最终匹配被简化为贪心top-1最近邻选择，形成"解码瓶颈"：正确对应常出现在前若干候选（如30个）中，其召回率远超top-1准确率，说明瓶颈在解码而非表征本身。

Method: 将语义对应建模为recall-then-rerank：先根据相似度分布的不确定性自适应提名候选集（模糊时更大、自信时更小），再用分级循环一致性分数重排——将每个候选反向匹配回源图，并按反向匹配落点与原关键点的距离进行惩罚。模块仅作用于基方法已计算的相似度矩阵，可作为即插即用组件。

Result: 在SPair-71k、其几何子集和PF-Pascal上，于无监督与弱监督设定下一致提升三个代表性基线，SPair-71k最高+1.8 PCK@0.10，PF-Pascal最高+3.4 PCK@0.15，Keypoint Average Precision下最高+4.9。

Conclusion: 语义对应的主要限制来自top-1解码而非特征表征；通过轻量的自适应召回加循环一致性重排可在不改变基方法特征的前提下稳定获得增益，验证了"召回-重排"范式的有效性。

Abstract: We propose \emph{Déjà Vu}, a test-time decoding module for semantic correspondence. Matching semantically equivalent keypoints across images of the same object category is challenging due to variations in appearance, viewpoint, and scale. While features from large pretrained vision models carry strong zero-shot correspondence ability, existing methods reduce final matching to greedy top-$1$ nearest-neighbor selection. We show that the correct correspondence appears among the top-ranked candidates far more often than top-$1$ matching achieves: with $30$ candidates, zero-shot features exceed the top-$1$ accuracy of a supervised model. This reveals a \textit{decoding bottleneck} rather than a limit of the representation. Motivated by this observation, we formulate semantic correspondence as a \textit{recall-then-rerank} problem. Our method first nominates an adaptive candidate set, larger when the similarity distribution is ambiguous and smaller when it is confident, then re-ranks the candidates with a graded cycle-consistency score: each candidate is matched back to the source image and penalized by how far its reverse match lands from the original keypoint. The module operates entirely on the similarity matrix already computed by the base method. It consistently improves three representative baselines on SPair-71k, its geometric subset, and PF-Pascal under both unsupervised and weakly supervised settings, with gains of up to $+1.8$ PCK@0.10 on SPair-71k and $+3.4$ PCK@0.15 on PF-Pascal, and $+4.9$ under Keypoint Average Precision.

</details>

*Jiehui Tang,Yunlong Yu,Zhao Wang,Jungong Han*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有材质重绑定方法在视觉条件中结构与外观线索相互耦合，难以兼顾材质保真度与结构保持。作者识别出目标条件同时携带几何与原始外观、参考条件包含材质线索与物体特异结构，导致"角色纠缠"问题。

Method: 基于扩散图像编辑器的免训练框架RATR，为两条件分配互补角色并在去噪过程中协调其影响：(1) 反照率解析的表面释放机制，抑制目标原有表面外观、保留几何线索，得到结构导向条件；(2) 材质证据隔离机制，强化参考图中的材质线索、削弱物体特异结构干扰，得到互补的材质导向条件。

Result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果。

Conclusion: 通过解耦条件的结构与外观角色，RATR为材质重绑定中保真度与结构保持的平衡提供了免训练的解耦式条件协调思路。

Abstract: Material rebinding aims to transfer the material appearance from a reference image while preserving the target object's geometry and identity. Existing methods typically struggle to balance material fidelity with structural preservation due to the coupled influence of structural and appearance cues in their visual conditions. We identify role entanglement in the target and reference conditions as a contributing factor the target condition carries both geometry and its original appearance while the reference condition contains material cues alongside object-specific structure. To address this issue, we propose RATR, a training-free material rebinding method built on a diffusion-based image editor that assigns complementary roles to the two conditions and coordinates their influence during denoising. To make the target condition primarily convey structure, we introduce an albedo-resolved surface release mechanism, which suppresses the target's original surface appearance while retaining geometric cues, yielding a structure-oriented condition for material transfer. On the reference side, the designed material evidence isolation mechanism emphasizes material cues while reducing interference from object-specific structure, yielding a complementary material-oriented condition.

</details>


### [57] [SASFormer: Stage-Aware Selective Attention Transformer for All-in-One Blind Image Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00523)
*Xiangpeng Tian,Mingyang Li,Fajing Liu,Xiaofeng Wang,Xiaohai He,Chao Ren*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SASFormer，一种阶段感知选择性注意力Transformer，编码器用混合通道-空间注意力建模，解码器用自适应选择性注意力重建，在3/5/11种退化设置下取得强性能且参数高效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有一体化图像复原方法（混合注意力、提示学习、路由机制）主要增强退化自适应性，却对各网络阶段采用相似的特征建模策略，忽视了编码与解码在不同退化下对表征需求的差异。

Method: 遵循阶段感知设计原则：编码器采用成熟的混合通道-空间注意力构建保内容、退化感知的表征；解码器采用自适应选择性注意力。为此提出自适应选择性通道自注意力（ASCSA，做自适应查询-通道选择与注意力掩码）和自适应选择性空间自注意力（ASSSA，跨多窗口尺寸自适应融合空间注意力）；并用紧凑隐式提示调制选择过程，无需显式退化标签。

Result: 在3、5、11种退化设置下的大量实验表明SASFormer复原性能强且参数效率良好；阶段级表征分析与消融实验验证了阶段感知设计与解码端自适应选择的有效性。

Conclusion: 按阶段区分表征需求、在解码端引入自适应选择性注意力，是一体化盲图像复原中兼顾性能与参数效率的有效设计方向。

Abstract: All-in-one image restoration aims to recover high-quality images from multiple degradation types using a single unified model. Recent methods improve unified restoration with hybrid attention, prompt learning, or routing mechanisms, but generally focus on enhancing degradation adaptivity while employing similar feature modeling strategies across network stages. Consequently, the distinct representation requirements of encoding and decoding under diverse degradations remain insufficiently explored. In this paper, we propose SASFormer, a Stage-Aware Selective Attention Transformer for all-in-one blind image restoration. SASFormer follows a stage-aware design principle: the encoder uses established hybrid channel-spatial attention to build robust content-preserving and degradation-aware representations, while the decoder employs adaptive selective attention for restoration-oriented reconstruction. To address the stage-specific requirements of decoder reconstruction, we develop Adaptive Selective Channel Self-Attention (ASCSA) and Adaptive Selective Spatial Self-Attention (ASSSA), enabling the decoder to dynamically identify restoration-relevant channel responses and spatial contexts. Specifically, ASCSA performs adaptive query-channel selection and attention masking, while ASSSA adaptively integrates spatial attention across multiple window sizes. Compact implicit prompts further modulate the selection process without requiring explicit degradation labels. Extensive experiments on 3-, 5-, and 11-degradation settings demonstrate that SASFormer achieves strong restoration performance with favorable parameter efficiency. Moreover, stage-wise representation analysis and ablation studies provide empirical support for the proposed stage-aware design and the effectiveness of decoder-side adaptive selection.

</details>


### [58] [A Straight Line Is Not a Camera Pose: Auditing Short-Clip Pose Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00482)
*Xinyi Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 现有绝对轨迹误差（ATE）的对齐方式使"恒速直线"这一无图像基线在Sintel上优于多数先进模型；作者从理论上揭示ATE的两个缺陷，并提出姿态锚定的ATE（pose-anchored ATE）作为修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ATE是SLAM与三维重建中衡量相机运动精度的标准指标，但其对齐机制可能使指标失真：位移恒速直线基线在Sintel协议下优于11个近期模型中的10个，说明指标未能反映真实几何质量，需要诊断并提出更可靠的度量。

Method: 从两方面分析ATE对齐：(1) 位置对齐会把恒速预测投射到真实轨迹的最佳拟合直线上，使直线得分等于路径回归残差，据此提出残差信噪比（SNR）判据，预测"向恒速拟合靠拢是否会降低ATE"；(2) 位置-only对齐忽略相机朝向，作者将轨迹相对朝向旋转30°做扰动实验。修正方案为把对齐中的旋转拟合到预测朝向，得到pose-anchored ATE。

Result: SNR判据分别正确预测1056个模型-片段对中95%、792个留出对中98%、1034个ScanNet对中97%的结果，并区分Sintel（SNR中位数0.86）与TUM、ScanNet、全长Bonn与Wild-SLAM（2.7–27，直线化会使所有模型ATE上升）。旋转扰动下ATE不变但所有模型的静态点重投影变差，且按ATE排名第二的直线基线在几何均值重投影上最差。Pose-anchored ATE开销0.17 ms/clip（原ATE 0.11 ms），在Sintel上把所有无图像参考排在所有模型之下，在旋转与直线化下跟踪重投影误差（Spearman 0.61 vs ATE的0.32），大体保持模型排序，并与10帧平移RPE、DTE在旋转与参考测试上持平。

Conclusion: ATE的位置-only对齐既会奖励无几何意义的恒速直线预测，又对相机朝向不敏感，因而"低ATE不等于好几何"。Pose-anchored ATE以极小计算代价同时修复这两点，是更可靠的相机运动精度度量。

Abstract: The absolute trajectory error (ATE) is the standard measure of camera-motion accuracy, from SLAM to feed-forward 3D reconstruction. On the common Sintel protocol, a constant-velocity straight line using no images has a lower mean ATE than 10 of 11 recent models re-run with official code. Two properties of ATE's alignment explain this. First, it maps any constant-velocity prediction onto the best-fitting line through the true path, so the line scores the path's regression residual. A residual signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) criterion predicts when moving a prediction towards its constant-velocity fit lowers ATE. It gives the outcome for 95% of 1056 model-clip pairs, 98% of 792 held-out pairs and 97% of 1034 ScanNet pairs, and it separates Sintel (median SNR 0.86) from TUM, ScanNet and full-length Bonn and Wild-SLAM (2.7 to 27), where straightening raises every model's mean ATE. Second, position-only alignment ignores where cameras look: rotating a trajectory by 30 degrees against its orientations leaves ATE unchanged, yet worsens the reprojection of static points for every model on Sintel, TUM and ScanNet in the main setting, and the line, second by mean ATE on Sintel, places them worst by geometric mean: a lower ATE need not mean better geometry. Fitting the alignment's rotation to the predicted orientations gives pose-anchored ATE, a one-function change in ATE's units costing 0.17 ms per clip (ATE: 0.11 ms). It ranks every image-free reference below every model on Sintel, tracks the reprojection error under rotation and straightening, where ATE does not (Spearman 0.61 vs. 0.32), largely preserves the models' order, and ties 10-frame translational relative pose error (RPE) and the discernible trajectory error (DTE) on our rotation and reference tests. Code, predictions and results will be released.

</details>


### [59] [OpenMidnight: Closing the Performance Gap Between Open and Proprietary Pathology Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00064)
*Ratna Sagari Grandhi,Anis Chihoub,Ryan Kim,Daniel Z. Kaplan,Chao Feng,Anish Dulal,Leema Krishna Murali,Rohitkumar Datchanamourty,Nevasini Sasikumar,Debojyoti Das,Ahmed Hassayoune,Rhizo Nymph,Anas Zafar,Connor Lane,Benjamin Warner,Hassan Muhammad,Tanishq Mathew Abraham,Paul S. Scotti*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有病理基础模型（如 Midnight）依赖专有数据、算力需求大，且训练代码与预处理流程未公开，导致难以独立验证和后续方法学发展。作者希望通过公开数据与开源代码降低复现门槛。

Method: 在 TCGA 约 12,000 张公开全切片图像上进行病理预训练，编码器以 DINOv2 预训练权重初始化；预训练仅消耗约 320 H100 GPU 小时，相比 Midnight 报告算力降低 34 倍；在 THUNDER 基准的 16 个分类与 4 个分割数据集上评估，并开展消融实验考察初始化、数据量、模型规模与组织构成的影响。

Result: THUNDER 上取得最高平均分割 Dice（69.7），在 14 个模型中综合排名第 4，超过 Midnight；在多项任务上性能与使用更大规模数据训练的模型持平或更优。消融实验给出了初始化、数据量、模型规模和组织构成对下游性能影响的经验证据。

Conclusion: 开源训练代码、预处理流程与模型权重，可显著降低可复现研究门槛，并为构建有竞争力的病理基础模型提供可参考的训练配方；表明公开数据与高效预训练即可获得具竞争力的性能。

Abstract: Pathology foundation models offer transferable representations for a range of downstream tasks in computational pathology, but reliance on proprietary data, substantial compute requirements, and limited availability of training code and preprocessing pipelines hinder independent validation and further methodological development. We present OpenMidnight 1.1, an open-source replication and refinement of Midnight trained on approximately 12,000 publicly available whole-slide images from The Cancer Genome Atlas. Using an encoder initialized with pretrained DINOv2 weights, OpenMidnight 1.1 uses approximately 320 H100 GPU-hours for pathology pretraining, a 34-fold reduction relative to the compute reported for Midnight. Across 16 classification and four segmentation datasets in THUNDER, OpenMidnight 1.1 achieves the highest mean segmentation Dice (69.7) and ranks fourth among 14 models, ahead of Midnight, with performance that matches or exceeds models trained on substantially larger datasets in several tasks. Our ablation studies additionally examine how initialization, data volume, model size, and tissue composition affect downstream performance, providing empirical evidence to inform the development of future training recipes. Our release of the training code, preprocessing pipeline, and model weights lowers barriers to reproducible research and further development of competitive pathology foundation models.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: We introduce Complexity-Diversity Building Metrics (CDBM), twelve interpretable descriptors for building massings represented as vertical extrusions. They measure how strongly geometric detail is expressed (complexity) and how unevenly it varies across one- and two-dimensional elements (diversity). Computed for 482,241,306 OpenStreetMap buildings and compared with 3D Building Metrics (3DBM) and the LION shape latent on task-specific samples, CDBM is tested on function, region, contextual relevance, real-generated discrimination, human preference and geometry-conditioned generation. With gradient boosting, CDBM best separates generated from mapped massings and best matches human preference; with logistic regression it matches 3DBM on realism. 3DBM leads on the other three tasks. As generation targets, the descriptors show that models struggle to produce strongly expressed and heterogeneous forms. CDBM complements existing indicators.

</details>


### [61] [DTP-OPSD: Reinforcement Learning with Distractor-Aware Temporal-Privilege On-Policy Self-Distillation for Temporal Video Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00120)
*Zhaoyu Chen,Yongwei Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DTP-OPSD强化学习框架，通过干扰感知的时间特权在线自蒸馏，解决GRPO在困难样本上组内奖励全为零导致无梯度信号的问题，仅用300条难样本即在三个TVG基准上取得8B开源模型最优mIoU。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序视频定位（TVG）中，当同一视频含多个重复、相似或相反事件时任务极难；此时GRPO采样的全部回复可能均未命中目标、tIoU全为零，组内相对优势全为0，策略梯度信号完全缺失。

Method: 1) 学生模型看原始视频并做on-policy生成；共享权重的教师模型看"特权视频"——目标窗口用红色全帧边框标注、同视频干扰窗口用蓝色全帧边框标注。2) 蒸馏损失采用教师对学生已生成前缀的token级Jensen-Shannon散度，提供稠密监督，在GRPO无梯度时仍有效。3) 自适应门控：教师不优于学生时抑制蒸馏；对"教师更好但学生rollout全为0 tIoU"的组加强蒸馏。4) 通过VLM筛选+人工核验构建精简的强干扰训练集（仅300条）。

Result: 在Charades-TimeLens、ActivityNet-TimeLens、QVHighlights-TimeLens上mIoU分别达55.93、54.77、66.71，为对比开源8B模型最高；相较同数据训练的纯GRPO，12项指标全面提升，R1@0.7分别提升1.28、1.62、1.78。

Conclusion: 稠密token级JS蒸馏可作为零奖励困境的有效补充信号，配合特权视频中的干扰标注与自适应蒸馏强度控制，能以极少额外数据显著提升TVG性能；代码将开源。

Abstract: Temporal Video Grounding (TVG) aims to localize the start and end times of an event described by a language query in a video. The task becomes particularly challenging when the same video contains multiple repeated, similar, or opposite events. On these hard examples, all responses sampled by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) may miss the target and receive zero temporal Intersection-over-Union (tIoU). Their group-relative advantages are then all zero, leaving no useful policy gradient signal. To address this, we propose DTP-OPSD, a reinforcement learning framework with distractor-aware temporal-privilege on-policy self-distillation. The student observes the clean video and generates responses on-policy, while a shared-weight teacher observes a privileged video in which the target window is marked by red full-frame borders and same-video distractor windows by blue full-frame borders. For the distillation loss, the teacher evaluates student-generated prefixes and provides dense token-level Jensen-Shannon divergence supervision. This supervision remains informative even when GRPO provides no policy gradient signal. We suppress distillation when the teacher does not outperform the student and strengthen it for groups where the teacher performs better but all student rollouts receive zero tIoU. We also construct a compact hard-interference training set through VLM screening and human verification. With only 300 additional post-training examples, DTP-OPSD achieves the highest mIoU among the compared open-source 8B models on Charades-TimeLens, ActivityNet-TimeLens, and QVHighlights-TimeLens, reaching 55.93, 54.77, and 66.71, respectively. Compared with Pure GRPO trained on the same data, DTP-OPSD improves all 12 reported metrics, with R1@0.7 gains of 1.28, 1.62, and 1.78 points on the three benchmarks. Code will be released at https://github.com/nian1125/DTP-OPSD

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构神经影像预测认知能力受高维性与脑形态几何复杂性制约；传统方法将区域形态学展平为表格特征，无法显式刻画空间关系。

Conclusion: 标准化结构MRI可提供任务特异性认知预测信息，稀疏拓扑与绝对尺度为可迁移的架构归纳偏置，为基于MRI的神经发育评估奠定基础。

Abstract: Predicting cognitive abilities from structural neuroimaging remains challenging due to the high dimensionality and geometric complexity of brain morphology. Conventional models typically flatten regional morphometry into tabular features, failing to explicitly represent spatial relationships. We propose a Spatial-Topological Graph Neural Network (ST-GNN) to predict four distinct cognitive phenotypes across large pediatric cohorts (N = 2,378 to 2,424). By projecting regional morphometry onto a population-level standardized spatial graph, ST-GNN restricts message passing to defined neighboring regions. Evaluations demonstrate that ST-GNN effectively fuses spatial morphology with systemic covariates, outperforming linear baselines and topology-free deep models. Ablations reveal that imposing a sparse geometric topology (K-nearest neighbors) and utilizing global feature scaling - which preserves absolute morphometric scale - outperform fully connected networks and region-normalized approaches. These choices provide transferable architectural inductive biases, revealing differences between computational routing and morphometric feature attribution. Integrated Gradients analysis identified distinct morphological features consistent with neuroanatomical evidence, such as cerebellar volume for working memory and superior frontal surface area for executive function. These findings suggest standardized structural MRI provides useful information for task-specific cognitive prediction, establishing a foundation for MRI-based neurodevelopmental assessment.

</details>


### [63] [Detector-Integrated Multi-Cue Association for Occlusion-Aware UAV Multi-Object Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00105)
*Shu-Hung Chou,Trong-An Bui,Wei-Ming Chen,Hsin-Piao Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出检测器集成的多线索跟踪框架，在YOLOv8n颈部挂接轻量投影头，借助ROIAlign单次前向同时输出检测与嵌入，并融合运动、IoU、外观代价，在UAVDT上取得三项指标最优且IDSW较DeepSORT降低58.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机视角下车辆目标小、外观相似且频繁遮挡，易引发身份切换（IDSW）。DeepSORT类外观跟踪器依赖独立ReID网络，逐目标推理限制运行速度，且小目标/遮挡目标的外观特征不可靠。

Method: 1) 在YOLOv8n检测器颈部附加轻量投影头，通过ROIAlign提取目标嵌入，实现检测与嵌入的单次前向推理；2) 设计多线索关联代价，融合运动、IoU与外观距离，权重由消融实验确定；3) 引入低分检测救援机制与外观记忆保护机制。

Result: 在UAVDT基准上，MOTA 28.33、HOTA 31.16、IDF1 38.18，速度82.59 FPS；三项指标均为对比跟踪器中最佳，IDSW相比DeepSORT降低58.4%。

Conclusion: 将ReID嵌入与检测解耦为共享骨干的单阶段输出，可兼顾精度与实时性；多线索关联与低分救援、记忆保护能有效抑制小目标及遮挡场景下的身份切换。

Abstract: Multi-object tracking (MOT) in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery is challenging because vehicles are small, visually similar, and frequently occluded, which leads to identity switches (IDSW). Appearance-based trackers such as DeepSORT rely on a standalone re-identification (ReID) network, whose per-target inference limits runtime speed, while the appearance of small or occluded vehicles remains unreliable. This paper proposes a detector-integrated multi-cue tracking framework. Lightweight projection heads are attached to the neck of the YOLOv8n detector to extract target embeddings through ROIAlign, producing detections and embeddings in a single forward pass. A multi-cue association cost then combines motion, IoU, and appearance distances with weights determined through ablation, complemented by low-score rescue and appearance-memory protection. On the UAVDT benchmark, the proposed method achieves a MOTA of 28.33, a HOTA of 31.16, and an IDF1 of 38.18 at 82.59 FPS, the best among the compared trackers in all three metrics, and reduces IDSW by 58.4\% compared with DeepSORT.

</details>


### [64] [Demystifying Prompt Stealing Attacks against Synthetic Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00102)
*Junyan Huang,Sanskar Agmain,Chen Gong,Yan Pang,FNU Suya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出V-PSA视频提示窃取攻击：结合恢复的caption与DDIM反演、Null-Text反演构造参考轨迹，从单个公开视频中导出可复用输入，实现高保真重建与受控编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 创作者公开生成视频以宣传和销售作品，但示例可能被用于未授权复现与定制；现有仅恢复prompt的评估可能低估攻击者复现公开生成内容的能力。

Method: 将captioning与prompt优化方法适配为视频提示窃取攻击；分析仅恢复prompt的保真度局限；提出V-PSA：用恢复的caption与DDIM反演在独立生成器下构建参考轨迹，再用Null-Text反演优化逐步无条件嵌入以减小重建偏差；所得输入在修改caption时亦可引导生成；构建含12,000视频-prompt对（3个受害生成器、4个prompt来源）的基准。

Result: V-PSA在目标与重建视频间达到约0.9的视频相似度，显著优于仅prompt基线（约0.6），并支持保持目标结构与运动的多项受控变体；将反演导出输入用于图像PSA也可提升重建效果。

Conclusion: 仅依赖prompt恢复的评估会低估攻击者重建公开生成输出的能力；反演导出的可复用输入是提升重建与编辑保真度的关键。

Abstract: Creators publicly showcase generated content to advertise and sell their work, but these examples may also enable unauthorized reproduction and customization. We study whether an adversary can derive reusable inputs from a single public video for faithful reconstruction and controlled editing, without access to the original prompt or generator. We adapt captioning and prompt optimization approaches to video prompt stealing attacks (PSAs) and find that prompt recovery alone provides limited reconstruction fidelity. Even the original prompt produces different spatial and temporal realizations when the initial noise changes. Using an independent generator enlarges the reconstruction gap, as reusing the original prompt and seed can still produce substantially different videos. We propose V-PSA, which uses a recovered caption and DDIM inversion to construct a reference trajectory under an independent generator. Null-Text Inversion then optimizes per-step unconditional embeddings to reduce deviations from this trajectory during reconstruction. The resulting inputs also guide generation when the caption is modified, supporting edits that change selected content while preserving the target's layout and motion. We construct a benchmark containing 12,000 video-prompt pairs from three victim generators and four prompt sources. V-PSA achieves video-to-video similarity around 0.9 between target and reconstructed videos, substantially improving over prompt-only baselines with similarity score of 0.6, and supports multiple controlled variations that preserve the target's structure. Additional experiments show that augmenting prior image PSAs with inversion-derived inputs also improves reconstruction. Our results show that evaluations restricted to prompt recovery can underestimate an attacker's ability to reconstruct public generative outputs.

</details>


### [65] [CRAFT: Corrective and Robust Multi-Agent Framework for Text-to-Parametric CAD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00076)
*Mohammed Musthafa Rafi,Anushrut Jignasu,Mahdi Saraeian,Chinmay Hegde,Aditya Balu,Adarsh Krishnamurthy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CRAFT，一个无需任务特定训练的多智能体框架，通过JSON中间表示保留符号参数化表达式，将自然语言直接转换为可编辑的参数化OpenSCAD程序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Text-to-CAD生成可提升机械CAD的可及性，但现有方法在数据依赖与输出保真度间存在权衡：有监督方法依赖大规模文本-模型配对数据集，而零样本提示策略脆弱，且往往丢失下游编辑与定制所需的参数化结构。

Method: CRAFT采用纠正性、鲁棒的multi-agent架构：核心为贯穿生成过程的JSON中间表示，携带符号参数化表达式；结合语义理解、参数化规划、编译、渲染、自纠正与组件级验证，构成分层恢复流程，并利用多视图视觉反馈检测与修复几何错误。

Result: 在NopSCADlib、ABC和Slice-100K三个数据集上，CRAFT在感知与几何质量上可与直接零样本基线相竞争，同时展现出显著更多的可编辑参数化结构。

Conclusion: CRAFT在无需任务特定训练的前提下，兼顾了零样本方法的灵活性与监督方法的保真度，通过保留参数化结构实现了更利于下游编辑的CAD生成，为文本到CAD生成提供了有效折中方案。

Abstract: Text-to-CAD generation has the potential to make mechanical CAD more accessible, but existing approaches face a trade-off between data dependence and output fidelity. Supervised methods rely on large paired text-model datasets, while zero-shot prompting strategies are often brittle and tend to lose the parametric structure needed for downstream editing and customization. We present CRAFT, a corrective and robust multi-agent framework that produces parametric OpenSCAD programs from natural language without task-specific training. At its core is a JSON intermediate representation that carries symbolic parametric expressions throughout the generation process, so the resulting models remain editable and retain their parametric structure. CRAFT combines semantic understanding, parametric planning, compilation, rendering, self-correction, and component-level verification within a layered recovery process, using multi-view visual feedback to detect and repair geometric errors. Across NopSCADlib, ABC, and Slice-100K, CRAFT is competitive with direct zero-shot baselines in perceptual and geometric quality while exposing substantially more editable parametric structure.

</details>


### [66] [When Morphs Look Better: Face Image Quality as a Training-Free Signal for Morphing Attack Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00074)
*Hao Peng,Fu Bo,Mahmoud Elshirbeny,Guray Ozgur*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文在FRLL与FEI两个数据集的20个morphing攻击集（含5个扩散模型攻击集）上，将17种FIQA方法的质量分数直接用作MAD判定分数，并预先固定分数方向，系统评估FIQA作为无morph训练的MAD信号的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FIQA被提出可作为无需morph相关训练的MAD信号；但已有工作常在某质量指标方向反转能降低误差时直接反转向，掩盖了"morph质量分数高于真脸"这一失效情形，因此需要在不做结果导向翻转的前提下公平检验FIQA的检测能力。

Method: 将17种覆盖现有各FIQA类别的方法在FRLL与FEI的20个morphing攻击集上评估，每个质量分数直接作为MAD决策分数；依据各方法定义预先固定分数方向，不进行事后翻转；以D-EER为主要指标，并考察真脸与morph分数的可分性、攻击类型依赖性以及跨数据集阈值迁移。

Result: FRLL上DifFIQA(R)平均D-EER为11.42%，与CLIB-FIQA、eDifFIQA(L)共同明显优于其他方法；但分数可分性强并不代表检测好：在扩散类攻击上最多有11/17种方法给morph更高质量，且研究中最大的反向分离对应最差检测结果；性能强烈依赖攻击类型，GraFIQs(L)在DCMorph与Arc2Morph上最佳却在landmark类与GAN类攻击上表现差。FEI上最低平均D-EER为39.75%，且在一个数据集真脸数据上设定的阈值无法迁移到另一数据集。

Conclusion: FIQA可作为MAD信号但可靠性有限：方向一致的分数是评估前提，类间可分性不能替代检测性能；方法选择须与具体攻击类型匹配，阈值也缺乏跨数据集泛化性，FIQA-based MAD仍需更稳健的设计。

Abstract: Face image quality assessment (FIQA) estimates the utility of a face image for automated face recognition and has been proposed as a morphing attack detection (MAD) signal that requires no morph-specific training. We evaluate 17 FIQA methods from all current FIQA categories on 20 morphing attack sets from two datasets, FRLL and FEI, including five diffusion-based attack sets. Each quality score is used directly as a MAD decision score. Unlike prior work, which inverted a quality measure when this lowered its error, we fix the score direction of each method in advance from its definition, so that cases in which morphs receive higher quality than bona fide samples remain visible. On FRLL, DifFIQA(R) achieves a mean D-EER of 11.42%, and together with CLIB-FIQA and eDifFIQA(L) clearly outperforms all other FIQA methods. A strong separation of bona fide and morph scores does not imply good detection performance: on the diffusion-based attacks, up to 11 of 17 methods assign higher quality to morphs than to bona fide samples, and the largest reversed separation in the study coincides with the worst detection result of the study. Performance also depends strongly on the attack: GraFIQs(L), the best detector of DCMorph and Arc2Morph on FRLL, performs poorly on the landmark-based and GAN-based attacks. On FEI, the lowest mean D-EER is 39.75%, and a threshold set on the bona fide data of one dataset does not transfer to the other.

</details>


### [67] [Comparing Monocular and Multi-View 3D Pedestrian Reconstruction Strategies for Urban Intersection Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00066)
*Kauan Mariani,Matheus Carvalho,Joel Perca,João Rulff,Jorge Poco*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 比较从多相机路口场景中提取行人运动描述符（3D姿态、度量轨迹、身高、步速）的两种方案：单目学习式流水线与标定多视角几何流水线，并用无参考指标做对比与选型建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市交叉口行人运动分析对交通安全评估、出行规划与智慧城市感知至关重要，需要物理可解释的度量级描述符。但固定路侧相机存在斜视、远距离、频繁遮挡，且缺少3D真值与跨相机身份标注，如何在真实场景中可靠获得这些描述符尚不清楚。

Method: 在同一多相机交叉口数据集上构建并对比两条流水线：①单目学习式——文本提示分割+跟踪+学习式3D人体估计；②标定多视角几何式——2D姿态估计+跟踪+跨相机关联+三角化。因无3D真值，采用无参考评价准则：行人覆盖率、人体测量学合理性、步速分布、计算开销与失效模式。

Result: 两条路线呈互补权衡：学习式流水线部署简单、覆盖行人更多，但存在尺度歧义与系统性身高压缩；几何流水线更高效地给出度量重建，但依赖标定、丢弃仅被单相机观测的行人，并在密集人群中产生严重离群点。

Conclusion: 给出面向任务的重建策略选择与相机基础设施配置的实践性指导：按目标分析对度量精度、覆盖率和成本的需求权衡两类方法，并结合标定质量与相机冗余度进行系统设计。

Abstract: Understanding how pedestrians move and interact at urban intersections is central to traffic-safety assessment, mobility planning, and smart-city sensing. Such analyses rely on physically grounded descriptions of motion: 3D body pose, metric trajectories, and pose-derived descriptors such as stature and walking speed. Recovering these from fixed roadside cameras is difficult: viewpoints are oblique and long-range, occlusions are frequent, and neither ground-truth 3D pose nor cross-camera identity labels are typically available. We compare two strategies for deriving pedestrian motion descriptors from a multi-camera intersection dataset: a monocular learned pipeline that combines text-prompted segmentation, tracking, and learned 3D body estimation, and a calibrated multi-view geometric pipeline that combines 2D pose estimation, tracking, cross-camera association, and triangulation. Because 3D ground truth is unavailable, we evaluate both with reference-free criteria relevant to intersection analysis: pedestrian coverage, anthropometric plausibility, walking-speed distributions, computational cost, and failure modes. The two strategies exhibit complementary trade-offs. The learned pipeline is simpler to deploy and covers more pedestrians, but suffers from scale ambiguity and systematic height compression; the geometric pipeline yields metric reconstructions more efficiently, but requires calibration, discards pedestrians seen by only one camera, and can produce severe outliers in dense crowds. We distill these findings into practical guidance for selecting a reconstruction strategy and configuring camera infrastructure according to the target analysis task.

</details>


### [68] [SemaNorm: Stain Normalization via Semantic and Morphology Alignment for Robust Cross-Hospital Computational Pathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00056)
*Subhankar Chattoraj,Sawon Pratiher,Arijit Ghosh,Prashant Khare,Writankar Kundu,Karan Vishwakarma,Preha Handa,Kirti Rashmi,Hubert Konik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出自监督染色规范化方法SemaNorm，通过基础模型一致性损失与可微细胞核结构损失，在保持形态与语义的前提下实现染色标准化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 染色差异是计算病理学中域偏移的主要来源，但现有归一化方法主要优化颜色一致性，未显式保留形态结构和诊断语义。

Method: SemaNorm为自监督染色规范化器，从强扰动输入恢复干净切片，避免配对迁移、对抗训练不稳定与恒等坍缩；并结合冻结的病理基础模型一致性损失与可微细胞核结构损失，以保持语义与细胞组织。

Result: 在Camelyon17-WILDS与NCT-CRC-HE-100K上，以跨医院肿瘤分类、细胞图形态指标及独立基础编码器的语义稳定性评估：OOD准确率较最强归一化基线提升5.9%，较无归一化提升13.5%，形态保持最佳。

Conclusion: 形态与语义感知的优化可作为仅优化颜色的染色归一化的原则性替代方案。

Abstract: Stain variability remains a major source of domain shift in computational pathology, yet existing normalization methods largely optimize color consistency without explicitly preserving morphology or diagnostic semantics. We propose SemaNorm, a self-supervised stain canonicalization stain normalizer to recover clean patches from strongly perturbed inputs, avoiding paired transfer, adversarial instability, and identity collapse. It further combines a frozen pathology foundation-model consistency loss with a differentiable nuclei-structure loss to preserve semantic and cellular organization. SemaNorm is evaluated across Camelyon17-WILDS and NCT-CRC-HE-100K using cross-hospital tumor classification, cell-graph morphology metrics, and semantic stability measured with an independent held-out foundation encoder. SemaNorm improves out-of-distribution accuracy by 5.9% over the strongest normalization baseline and by 13.5% over no normalization, while achieving the best morphology preservation. Independent foundation-model and cell-graph analyses further confirm improved semantic and structural stability. These results establish morphology- and semantics-aware optimization as a principled alternative to color-only stain normalization.

</details>


### [69] [Keyframes First, Motion Second: Revisiting Compressed-Domain Video Captioning under Limited Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00048)
*Asok B K,Ashim Nepal,Loknath Regmi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过受控实验检验压缩域视频描述模型(如CoCap)中运动分支的价值：在有限监督下,从头训练的运动编码器无显著收益,而改进关键帧读出(微调SigLIP 2注意力池化头)带来+5.4 CIDEr且解码更快。结论是"关键帧优先,运动其次"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CoCap类压缩域视频描述器直接从H.264码流读取I帧,并用从头训练的运动与残差编码器把运动矢量、残差转为动作token;但该运动分支带来额外解码时间与监督需求,二者在边缘设备上均稀缺。作者追问:在监督有限的条件下,运动分支何时才值得。

Method: 在VATEX的2,500个训练片段上做受控研究:固定SigLIP 2关键帧编码器(冻结)、GPT-2解码器与训练计划,仅改变解码器接收的视觉token,共34种配置;报告留出测试集CIDEr,配以配对bootstrap置信区间与三个随机种子。另在MSVD完整划分上以CoCap自身视频编码复现。

Result: 从头训练的运动编码器无显著收益:CoCap式动作token使CIDEr变化-0.55(95% CI [-2.3, +1.2]),其余六种运动用法亦无帮助;若以48倍caption样本训练的模型热启动,平均+1.3 CIDEr但跨种子不显著,且仅在关键帧token冻结时成立。微调SigLIP 2注意力池化头可+5.4 CIDEr,1–8个此类token在每个种子上均优于16个CoCap式token,且仅解码I帧(7.3 ms vs 44–114 ms/片段)。MSVD上读出式方案领先14.2 CIDEr,动作token无可靠增益。

Conclusion: 在有限监督下,关键帧读出优先,运动信息其次;提升关键帧特征表示比引入从头训练的运动分支更具性价比与效率。

Abstract: Compressed-domain video captioners such as CoCap read the H.264 bitstream directly: a pretrained encoder reads the keyframes (I-frames), while motion and residual encoders, trained from scratch, turn the codec's motion vectors and residuals into action tokens. This motion branch costs decoding time and supervision, both scarce on edge devices. We ask when it pays off under limited supervision. In a controlled study on 2,500 VATEX training clips, we fix a frozen SigLIP 2 keyframe encoder, a GPT-2 caption decoder and the training schedule, vary only the visual tokens the decoder receives (34 configurations), and report held-out test CIDEr with paired bootstrap intervals and three seeds. Motion encoders trained from scratch bring no measurable benefit: CoCap-style action tokens change CIDEr by -0.55 (95% CI [-2.3, +1.2]), and six other uses of motion do not help. Warm-started from a model trained on 48x the caption samples, they add +1.3 CIDEr on average, though not significantly across seeds, and only while the keyframe tokens stay frozen. Reading the keyframes better matters more: fine-tuning SigLIP 2's own attention-pooling head adds 5.4 CIDEr, and one to eight such tokens beat the 16 CoCap-style tokens on every seed while decoding only I-frames (7.3 ms instead of 44-114 ms per clip). The same holds on MSVD's full split in CoCap's own video encoding, where the readout leads by 14.2 CIDEr and action tokens bring no reliable gain, also with clean single-reference motion vectors. Under limited supervision, keyframes come first and motion second.

</details>


### [70] [TopoMix: Continuous Spatial Mixing for Long-Tailed Data Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00047)
*Yefan Wang,Yusen Wu,Zihui Ling,Jianyuan Ni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TopoMix：一种无训练的空间连续混合增强方法，用低分辨率随机控制网格经双三次插值与随机非线性塑形生成平滑空间变化掩码，进行逐元素图像混合与标签重加权，在长尾识别上稳定优于代表性混合基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于混合的增强（如固定全局比例混合或硬空间替换）缺乏局部变化空间；在长尾识别中，少数类对增强样本质量尤为敏感，这一局限更加明显。

Method: 训练无关（training-free）增强：构建平滑的空间变化掩码——由低分辨率随机控制网格、双三次插值、随机非线性塑形三步生成；该掩码同时用于逐元素图像混合与标签重加权。不引入可训练参数或辅助网络。

Result: 在标准长尾基准上，方法一致优于代表性的基于混合的基线，表明平滑空间混合是长尾识别的有效增强策略。

Conclusion: 以连续空间混合替代固定混合，可在输入空间提供更灵活的混合方式，且无需额外参数与训练成本，为长尾识别提供简洁有效的增强方案。

Abstract: Most mixing-based augmentation methods improve generalization through a simple idea: combine two training samples with a fixed global ratio or a hard spatial replacement. While effective, this design leaves little room for local variation, which becomes a more visible limitation in long-tailed recognition, where minority classes are especially sensitive to the quality of augmented samples. We propose TopoMix, a training-free augmentation method that replaces fixed mixing with continuous spatial mixing. TopoMix constructs a smooth spatially varying mask from a low-resolution random control grid, bicubic interpolation, and stochastic non-linear shaping, and uses this mask for element-wise image mixing and label reweighting. Without introducing trainable parameters or auxiliary networks, TopoMix offers a simple way to make mixing more flexible in the input space. Experiments on standard long-tailed benchmarks show that it consistently improves over representative mixing-based baselines, indicating that smooth spatial mixing is an effective augmentation strategy for long-tailed recognition.

</details>


### [71] [Circumpolar Wall-to-Wall Detection of Retrogressive Thaw Slumps with Scarce Labels and Extreme Class Imbalance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00046)
*Yili Yang,Heidi Rodenhizer,Robb Young,Brendan M. Rogers,Marlena Bartkus,Stefano Potter,Greg Fiske,Scott Zolkos,Wenwen Li,Chia-Yu Hsu,Luigi Marini,Todd C. Nicholson,Benjamin C. Maglio,Jennifer Watts,Anna Liljedahl,Susan M. Natali*

Main category: cs.CV
