Second, a revised backprojection process incorporating two weighting factors is introduced to counteract the nonlinearity inherent in conventional backprojection, leading to a simplified PSF formulation. Third, to circumvent the computational burden of 3D image space filtering,an approximate method by linearizing the coordinate relationship in Fourier space under some assumptions is developed that transfers the 3D filtering operation to the 2D projection space. This approach facilitates the derivation of a formally simple yet effective 2D direc?tional filter, which integrates a 2D von Hann window and a 2D sinc window. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method produces reconstructions with superior contrast, sharper boundaries,and fewer superimposition artifacts compared to CL-FBP and CL?FDK. Moreover, it enables more accurate recovery of internal structures, such as bubble defects and electronic components.

</details>


### [105] [Learning to Group and Order: Cross-Instance Self-Supervised RL for Vision-Centric MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00892)
*Songming Yang,Hong-Tao Yu,Xiu-Shen Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GO-SSL，一种跨实例"拼图"自监督强化学习框架，通过混合两个视觉实例的局部元素并让模型按来源分组且恢复组内顺序，构建可验证奖励用于以视觉为中心的MLLM后训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自监督视觉前置任务主要利用实例内结构，对跨实例判别和细粒度比较提供的监督有限，难以产生更丰富的可验证奖励信号。

Method: 给定两个视觉实例，将其局部元素打乱混合，训练模型按来源实例分组并恢复各组内部顺序，从而把实例级比较与空间/时序/几何结构恢复耦合；通过多样化配对、多次打乱及"由随机到困难"的课程学习，把同一无标注数据转化为更丰富的可验证监督。主要实例化为跨图像拼图，并扩展到3D深度与视频时序排序。

Result: 在多个基准上稳定优于基线MLLM及已有自监督后训练方法，在细粒度感知与空间理解上提升明显；跨模型规模与模型家族的评测支持其泛化性。

Conclusion: 跨实例比较可为MLLM提供有效的自监督RL信号，提升可迁移的视觉理解能力。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has become an important paradigm for improving multimodal large language models (MLLMs), especially with automatically verifiable rewards. Self-supervised visual pretext tasks provide such rewards without human annotations. However, existing methods mainly exploit within-instance structure, offering limited supervision for cross-instance discrimination and fine-grained comparison. We introduce Group-and-Order Self-Supervised Reinforcement Learning (GO-SSL), a cross-instance jigsaw framework for vision-centric MLLM post-training. Given two visual instances, GO-SSL mixes their local elements and trains the model to group them by instance of origin while recovering the order within each group, coupling instance-level comparison with spatial, temporal, or geometric structure recovery. This paired formulation turns the same unlabeled data into richer verifiable supervision through diverse pairings, shuffles, and a random-to-hard curriculum. We instantiate GO-SSL mainly on cross-image jigsaw tasks and further extend it to 3D depth and video temporal ordering. Across diverse benchmarks, GO-SSL consistently improves over the base MLLM and prior self-supervised post-training baselines, with clear gains in fine-grained perception and spatial understanding. Further evaluations across model scales and families support its generality. These results suggest that cross-instance comparison provides a useful self-supervised RL signal for improving transferable visual understanding in MLLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/SEU-VIPGroup/GO-SSL.

</details>


### [106] [Toward Counterfactual Learning for Selective Re-Examination in Agentic Visual Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00848)
*Ao Chen,Shengchao Chen,Yan Luximon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ReSee 基准与 CARE 方法，用反事实优势对"是否继续观察"这一决策进行决策级强化学习监督，提升高分辨率图像视觉搜索的准确率与决策选择性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率图像视觉搜索要求 VLM 同时决定"看哪里"和"是否还需再看一次"。现有 prompting、示范与基于结果(outcome-based)的 RL 虽能促使模型复查，但并未直接监督"在特定搜索状态下的复查是否有益"，缺乏细粒度、状态相关的信用分配。

Method: 1) 构建 ReSee 基准：3,227 条视觉搜索轨迹、8,827 个显式"提交或复查"决策，并通过反事实裁决(counterfactual adjudication)区分"应继续观察"与"应提交作答"的状态。2) 提出 CARE（Counterfactual Advantage for Re-Examination）：对同一搜索状态下 commit 与 re-examine 两种判定下的配对续写进行比较，用代价感知(cost-aware)的回报差估计追加观察的反事实价值，并仅将优势分配至对应判定 token，实现决策级、局部化的信用分配。

Result: 实验显示现有 VLM 的复查选择性有限；在两个骨干网络上，CARE 相比 GRPO 显著提升准确率与决策选择性，并在 6 个未见 OOD 基准上取得更高准确率且视觉请求更少。

Conclusion: 将"是否复查"形式化为可反事实评估的决策级问题，并配合 token 局部化的反事实优势 RL，是提升 VLM 视觉搜索效率与选择性的有效途径。

Abstract: Visual search over high-resolution images requires a vision-language model (VLM) not only to determine where to inspect, but also whether another observation is warranted before committing to an answer. Existing prompting, demonstrations, and outcome-based reinforcement learning can encourage re-examination, yet do not directly supervise whether it is beneficial at a particular search state. We introduce ReSee, a benchmark of re-examination decisions comprising 3,227 visual-search trajectories and 8,827 explicit commit-or-re-examine decisions, with counterfactual adjudication that distinguishes states where additional inspection is warranted from those where commitment is preferable. Building on this formulation, we propose CARE (Counterfactual Advantage for Re-Examination), a decision-level reinforcement learning method that compares paired continuations under commit and re-examine verdicts from the same search state. Their cost-aware return difference estimates the counterfactual value of an additional observation and is assigned only to the corresponding verdict tokens, providing localized credit for whether search should continue. Experiments expose limited re-examination selectivity in existing VLMs and show that CARE significantly improves accuracy and decision selectivity over GRPO across two backbones, with higher accuracy and fewer visual requests on six unseen OOD benchmarks.

</details>


### [107] [Beyond Temporal Overlap: Consumer-Aware Evaluation of Sign-Language Segmentation across Three Corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00823)
*Guohou Zhang,Kalin Stefanov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文质疑手语切分常用的重叠度（IoU）指标，考察下游冻结识别器与重叠度指标是否偏好同一分段器，并提出四轴评估框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有手语切分评估以人工标注边界为准，无法反映切片是否保留了识别器所需的视觉证据，也无法反映分段器是否生成过多片段，因此需要检验重叠度指标与实际下游消费（逐片段打标签的冻结识别器）的一致性。

Method: 评估三种切分架构、三个随机种子、三个语料共27个输出；通过受控的边界编辑，将"删除手语证据"与"增加周边上下文"两种效应分离；比较重叠度、识别准确率与序列错误（WER）在模型选择上的一致性。

Result: 重叠度平均上可预测识别性能，但不总能决定模型选择：在相同IoU下，不同识别器可能偏好更短或更长的片段。真实输出呈两种运行机制——DGS上重叠度、识别与序列错误选出同一模型；BSL上基于识别的选择恢复并识别出更多参考手语词，但WER升高；Dicta-Sign呈现相反权衡，WER选择使词表内WER降低31.17个点但漏掉更多可识别手语词。

Conclusion: 切分器评估应基于时间一致性、参考手语词恢复、片段识别与序列错误四个维度，而非仅依赖重叠度。

Abstract: Sign-language segmentation divides continuous signing into clips. In this study, the downstream consumer is a frozen recognizer that assigns one sign label to each predicted clip. Existing metrics instead compare predicted clips with manually annotated boundaries. They do not directly measure whether a clip preserves the visual evidence needed by the recognizer or whether the segmenter produces too many clips. We therefore ask whether overlap metrics and this consumer prefer the same segmenter. We evaluate 27 outputs from three segmentation architectures, three random seeds, and three corpora. Controlled boundary edits separate the effect of removing sign evidence from that of adding surrounding context. Overlap predicts recognition on average, but it does not always determine model choice. At the same intersection-over-union, different recognizers can prefer the shorter or the longer clip. The real outputs reveal two operating regimes. On DGS, overlap, recognition, and sequence error select the same model. On BSL, recognition-based selection recovers and recognizes more reference signs but increases word error rate (WER). Dicta-Sign shows the reverse trade-off: WER selection reduces in-vocabulary WER by 31.17 points but misses more recognizable signs. Segmenters should therefore be evaluated on four axes: temporal agreement, reference recovery, clip recognition, and sequence error, rather than on overlap alone.

</details>


### [108] [SEALECT: Scene-Conditioned Pose Priors for Plausible Maritime Vessel Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01688)
*Faisal Mohammad,Mohamed Younis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SEALECT：面向海事图像合成增强的场景条件化目标检索，联合视觉相似性、姿态/尺度先验与场景几何一致性，提升插入可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海事图像中几何约束强，仅依赖外观的检索会导致物理上不合理的船舶插入，因此需要场景条件化的检索。

Method: 统一评分=神经相似度+场景条件姿态先验+观测姿态一致性；构建海事场景-姿态库，以无参数核函数对姿态与尺度先验做非参数化场景条件建模。

Result: 七个海事基准上召回率超SigLIP 2（+0.14）；免训练先验以极小召回代价将约束违反减半以上，优于GALA-style、DiscoFOS；盲测端到端合成中六法中排名第一，与CLIP、DiscoFOS、DINO统计持平。

Conclusion: 场景几何与姿态先验对合成长度受限的检索至关重要，可在几乎不损召回的前提下显著提升几何合理性。

Abstract: We address scene-conditioned object retrieval for compositional augmentation in maritime imagery, where strong geometric constraints make appearance-only retrieval produce physically implausible vessel insertions. We propose SEALECT, a retrieval framework that jointly models visual compatibility, vessel pose, scale, and scene geometry through a unified score combining neural similarity, scene-conditioned pose priors, and observed-pose consistency. We construct a maritime scene-pose library and model the pose and scale priors nonparametrically, as a kernel that conditions each prior continuously on the scene with no learned parameters. Across seven maritime benchmarks, our trained scene-conditioned retriever exceeds the strongest appearance encoder (SigLIP 2) in recall (+0.14), and the training-free prior raises geometric plausibility further at negligible recall cost, more than halving the constraint violations of appearance retrieval and outperforming learned foreground-search baselines (GALA-style, DiscoFOS). In a blind study of end-to-end composites (BootPlace placement, DiffHarmony harmonization), SEALECT ranks first among six methods, ahead of random and GALA-style selection and statistically tied with CLIP, DiscoFOS, and DINO.

</details>


### [109] [Leveraging 2D Foundation Priors for Generalized Category Discovery under Test-Time Adaptation in 3D LiDAR Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01682)
*Hanqi Chen,Chaoqi Chen,Tian Ji,Hui Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出两阶段框架解决3D LiDAR语义分割中的GCD-TTA问题：先基于几何密度自适应聚合局部特征并在全局类原型一致性约束下获得可靠伪标签，再将类别发现建模为最优传输分配，并融合2D视觉基础模型语义特征以缓解域偏移下的特征坍缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶场景要求3D LiDAR语义分割能适应环境变化并识别未见类别，故测试时自适应下的广义类别发现（GCD-TTA）至关重要。现有工作将GCD与TTA割裂处理，而3D点云语义信息有限，二者结合在域偏移下易发生特征坍缩。

Method: 两阶段框架。第一阶段：依据几何密度变化自适应聚合局部3D特征，并在全局类级原型一致性约束下获取可靠伪标签。第二阶段：将类别发现转化为最优传输分配过程，实现新类别的全局一致性聚类；同时融合2D视觉基础模型的语义特征与3D点云特征，丰富语义信息并提升特征空间可分性。

Result: 在Synth4D→SemanticKITTI、SynLiDAR→SemanticKITTI、Synth4D→nuScenes上实验有效；统一评测协议下，在10个benchmark划分中的9个取得最佳整体mIoU，相较最强的复现基线最高提升12.21个点。

Conclusion: 将GCD与TTA统一为两阶段框架，并结合2D-3D特征融合，可有效缓解域偏移下的特征坍缩，显著提升3D LiDAR语义分割的泛化类别发现性能。

Abstract: In autonomous driving, 3D LiDAR semantic segmentation is expected to adapt to evolving environments and recognize previously unseen categories, making generalized category discovery under test-time adaptation (GCD-TTA) an important problem. However, existing works treat GCD and TTA separately, while the limited semantic information in 3D point clouds makes GCD-TTA under domain shift more prone to feature collapse when combining GCD with TTA. To address this issue, we propose a two-stage framework for GCD-TTA in 3D LiDAR semantic segmentation. Specifically, in the first stage, we adaptively aggregate local 3D features according to geometric density variations and obtain reliable pseudo labels under a global class-wise prototype consistency constraint. In the second stage, we cast category discovery as an optimal transport assignment process for globally consistent grouping of novel categories. Meanwhile, semantic features from 2D vision foundation models are fused with 3D point cloud features to enrich 3D semantic information and promote a more separable feature space. Extensive experiments on Synth4D to SemanticKITTI, SynLiDAR to SemanticKITTI, and Synth4D to nuScenes demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework. Under a unified evaluation protocol, our method achieves the best overall mIoU on 9 out of 10 benchmark splits and improves the overall mIoU by up to 12.21 points over the strongest re-implemented baseline.

</details>


### [110] [MMCoT$^3$: Empowering 3D Scene Understanding with 3D-Text Interleaved Multi-Modal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01676)
*Yongqi Shan,Yifan Wang,Yunzhi Zhuge,Lijun Wang,Huchuan Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出首个面向3D场景理解的3D-文本交错式思维链框架MMCoT³，通过显式交替文本推理与任务相关3D证据、歧义感知证据聚合机制及大规模3D专用CoT指令数据集PointCoT，在六个基准上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D大语言模型存在两大局限：(i) 在复杂3D场景中缺乏可靠的 grounded 多步推理能力；(ii) 以文本为中心的推理范式缺乏文本推理与视觉证据间的有效交互，导致无法验证中间推理、难以区分相似物体实例并易产生幻觉。

Method: 1) 提出3D-文本交错思维链（CoT）框架，将文本推理步骤与任务相关的3D证据显式交错，使模型在推理全程可查询场景观测；2) 针对3D场景中一个文本提及可能对应多个候选物体的多实例歧义问题，设计歧义感知证据聚合机制，用查询引导的交叉注意力融合候选物体token，并将证据与歧义线索共同注入推理过程；3) 构建大规模3D专用CoT指令微调数据集PointCoT，约176.2K样本，覆盖描述生成、问答、对话与规划四类任务。

Result: 在六个基准上的大量实验表明，该方法性能一致提升并达到当前最优（SOTA）结果，验证了歧义感知的3D-文本交错推理在3D场景理解中的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过将3D证据与文本推理交错结合并显式建模多实例歧义，可有效缓解3D大语言模型的中间推理不可验证、实例混淆与幻觉问题，为3D场景理解提供新的推理范式。

Abstract: Understanding and reasoning over 3D scenes from point clouds is essential for a broad range of AI applications. Recent 3D large language models have shown promising results, yet they still face two fundamental limitations: (i) insufficient capability for grounded multi-step reasoning in complex 3D scenes, and (ii) a text-centric inference paradigm that lacks effective interaction between textual reasoning and visual evidence. As a result, these models often fail to verify intermediate inferences, disambiguate similar object instances, and avoid hallucinations. To address these limitations, we propose MMCoT$^3$, the first 3D-Text Interleaved Chain-of-Thought (CoT) framework for 3D scene understanding. The core idea is to explicitly interleave textual reasoning with task-relevant 3D evidence, enabling the model to consult scene observations throughout the reasoning process. In addition, since a textual mention in 3D scenes may correspond to multiple candidate objects, naive object-mention alignment can inject incorrect evidence and mislead subsequent reasoning. To mitigate this multi-instance ambiguity, we design an ambiguity-aware evidence aggregation mechanism that uses query-guided cross-attention to fuse candidate object tokens and inject both evidence and ambiguity cues into the reasoning process. To better equip the model with multi-step reasoning capability, we further develop PointCoT, a large-scale 3D-specific CoT instruction tuning dataset with approximately 176.2K instances spanning captioning, question answering, dialogue, and planning tasks. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks show that our method consistently improves performance and achieves state-of-the-art results, validating the effectiveness of our proposed ambiguity-aware 3D-text interleaved reasoning for 3D scene understanding.

</details>


### [111] [AbacusGS: Gaussian Splatting without Per-Splat Sorting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01534)
*Jiacheng Ding,Yanliang Qi,Cong Guo,Peihua Mai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AbacusGS 将 3DGS 场景的混合顺序预存储到场景布局中（八叉树箱 + 写时选定轴排序），每帧仅需对可见箱排序并用一次点积决定正/反向读取，从而消除 CPU 逐 splat 排序开销，在 13 个标准场景上平均仅损失 0.13 dB PSNR，OpenGL CPU 排序渲染器提速 4.5 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS 每帧都需按深度对全部 splat 排序；在采用硬件光栅化绘制、CPU 排序的查看器（多为网页与移动端）中，排序占据大部分帧时间，成为主要性能瓶颈。

Method: 将 splat 分组为至多 128 个 splat 的八叉树箱，每个箱在写入时按选定轴预存有序排列；每帧只对可见箱排序，每个箱用一次点积判定正向或反向读取；通过短时间的顺序感知微调将已有 3DGS 模型转换，且保持 3DGS 的 over 算子不变。另提出每 splat 17 字节的紧凑格式与复用同一顺序的 CUDA tile 渲染器。

Result: 在 13 个标准场景上，相比同等微调的 3DGS 模型平均 PSNR 下降 0.13 dB；在 CPU 排序的 OpenGL 查看器中，帧渲染速度是逐 splat 排序的 4.5 倍。

Conclusion: 通过把混合顺序编码进场景布局并仅在箱级别排序，AbacusGS 在几乎无质量损失的前提下大幅降低 CPU 排序开销，并适配紧凑存储与 CUDA tile 渲染，代码将开源。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting sorts every splat by depth in every frame. Viewers that draw splats with the hardware rasterizer and sort them on the CPU, as most web and mobile viewers do, spend most of the frame time in this sort. We present AbacusGS, which stores the blending order of a 3DGS scene in the scene layout. AbacusGS groups the splats into octree boxes of at most 128 splats and stores each box in order along an axis chosen at write time. In each frame, AbacusGS sorts only the visible boxes, and one dot product per box decides whether the box is read forward or backward. A short order-aware fine-tuning converts an existing 3DGS model, and the over operator of 3DGS stays unchanged. On 13 standard scenes, AbacusGS loses 0.13 dB PSNR on average against an equally fine-tuned 3DGS model. In an OpenGL viewer that orders splats on the CPU, AbacusGS renders frames 4.5 times faster than per-splat sorting. We also present a compact format of 17 bytes per splat and a CUDA tile renderer that use the same order. The code will be released.

</details>


### [112] [When Does Latent Prediction Error Support Physical Surprise Claims in Video World Models?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01815)
*Anton Hristov,Aleksandar Slavov,Vasil Vasilev*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个评估框架，用于区分三类问题：冻结表征中包含什么信息、其如何组织外观与物理差异、以及什么因素会改变模型自身的预测误差；并以 IntPhys2、Physion++、Kubric 上的实验表明，视频世界模型的预测误差并不能可靠地衡量"物理惊奇"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究常将视频世界模型的预测误差直接视为"物理惊奇"（physical surprise）信号，但误差同样可能来源于外观、静态内容、运动或单纯的预测难度。因此需要系统性地拆解误差来源，检验"预测误差≈物理不合理性"这一隐含假设是否成立。

Method: 提出三层评估框架：(1) 冻结表征中可解码的信息（比较潜空间预测、掩码像素重建、简单视觉统计三类表征）；(2) 潜空间几何结构（外观变化相对视频间差异的幅度、跨场景方向一致性、深层中与物理变化的子空间重叠度）；(3) 模型自身预测误差的驱动因素（动作条件模型中的错误动作、外观变化；Physion++ 中重复单帧、整体变色；Kubric 中不可能事件 vs 可能事件）。

Result: 在 IntPhys2 上外观信息易于解码，V-JEPA2 仅携带"事件是否可能"的适度信息；随层数加深，外观变化幅度相对减小、方向跨场景更一致、与物理变化的子空间重叠降低。动作条件模型中错误动作会提升误差，但外观变化同样引发显著响应。Physion++ 中重复单帧可比原始片段误差更高，整体变色则可降低误差。Kubric 中不可能事件的误差可低于可能事件，固定误差阈值会将大量可能事件误判为不可能。

Conclusion: 模型能够表征物理信息并对错误动作作出反应，但其原生预测误差并不能可靠度量物理惊奇；预测误差受外观与低层统计因素强烈混杂，使用固定阈值进行物理合理性判定会产生大量误判。评估世界模型时应显式分离表征内容、几何组织与误差来源。

Abstract: Prediction errors from video world models are often treated as physical surprise, but they can also reflect appearance, static content, motion, or ordinary prediction difficulty. We present an evaluation framework that separates what frozen representations contain, how they organize appearance and physical differences, and what changes a model's own prediction error. On IntPhys2, a benchmark of physically possible and impossible events, we compare representations from latent prediction, masked pixel reconstruction, and simple visual statistics. Appearance remains easy to decode, while V-JEPA2 exposes modest information about whether events are possible or impossible. Looking at the latent geometry, appearance changes become smaller compared with differences between videos, their directions line up more consistently across scenes, and their overlap with physical changes decreases in deeper layers. Across action-conditioned models, incorrect actions raise prediction error, while appearance changes also produce substantial responses. In Physion++ video clips, repeating a single frame can produce higher error than the original clip, while changing color throughout the clip can lower it. Using Kubric, a simulation and rendering framework, we find that impossible events can produce lower error than possible events. A fixed error threshold also incorrectly flags many possible events as impossible. A model can therefore represent physical information and respond to incorrect actions without its native prediction error reliably measuring physical surprise.

</details>


### [113] [SurgQ-VLM: Question-Conditioned Dual-Stream Compression and Answer-Type-Aware Reinforcement for Surgical Video Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01913)
*Dhruv Makwana,Ananya Mantravadi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SurgQ-VLM 两阶段手术视频问答模型：阶段一训练问题条件化的慢/快双流压缩器（视觉 token 压缩 49 倍），阶段二用 GRPO 与答案类型感知奖励后训练；在 Cholec80/CholecT50 的 21,840 题测试集上达到 0.779 关键词准确率，BLEU-4 较零样本提升 10 倍，GRPO 再增 2.5pp。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手术视频问答需推理阶段、器械动作与事件时序，但现有方法多基于单帧与封闭标签，无法表达时长、顺序与计数；视频模型对所有片段采用同质压缩、忽略问题信息，丢弃时序证据；且答案结构异质（二元、分类、多标签、计数、句-时序五类），缺乏统一训练信号。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1) 为 LoRA 适配的 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 训练问题条件化慢/快双流压缩器，通过交叉注意力使两流均以问题为条件，每片段视觉 token 相对原始 ViT patch 压缩 49 倍（相对 merge 后主干 token 压缩 11 倍）；(2) 采用 GRPO 后训练，配合答案类型感知奖励，按答案结构匹配指标（标签集用 micro-F1、计数用归一化误差、时序窗口用内容-时间混合评分）。

Result: 在 Cholec80 与 CholecT50 上封存的 21,840 题测试集上，关键词准确率 0.779，BLEU-4 相对零样本提升约 10 倍；GRPO 带来 2.5pp K-Acc 提升，其中 2.0pp 归因于答案类型感知奖励，增益集中于结构困难类型，且答案格式未变（ROUGE-L 稳定）。

Conclusion: 问题条件化的双流压缩与答案类型感知的 GRPO 奖励能有效兼顾效率与异质答案结构的评测一致性，显著提升手术视频问答性能，尤其改善计数与时序类难题，代码已开源。

Abstract: Reasoning about surgical video -- which phase is underway, which instruments act, and when events occur -- underpins operative documentation, workflow analysis, and skill assessment. Yet surgical visual question answering is still largely built on single frames and closed labels that cannot express a duration, an ordering, or a count, and the video models that lift the frame limit typically compress every clip the same way regardless of the question, discarding the temporal evidence the answer needs. Worse, the answers are structurally heterogeneous, spanning five incompatible structures -- binary, classification, multi-label, counting, and sentence-temporal -- that no single training signal scores uniformly well. We propose SurgQ-VLM, a two-stage model for surgical video question answering. Stage 1 trains a question-conditioned dual-stream (slow/fast) compressor for a LoRA-adapted Qwen2.5-VL-7B: cross-attention conditions both streams on the question, and each clip's visual tokens shrink 49x from the raw ViT patches (11x vs. post-merge backbone tokens). Stage 2 post-trains with GRPO under an answer-type-aware reward that scores each question on the metric matching its answer structure (micro-F1 for label sets, normalised error for counts, a content-timing blend for temporal windows). On a sealed 21,840-question test split over Cholec80 and CholecT50, SurgQ-VLM reaches 0.779 keyword accuracy and a 10x BLEU-4 gain over zero-shot; GRPO adds 2.5 pp K-Acc (2.0 pp attributable to the answer-type-aware reward), concentrated in the structurally hard types, with answer format unchanged (ROUGE-L). Code is available at https://github.com/DhruvMakwana/SurgQ-VLM.

</details>


### [114] [Learning-to-Memorize: Dynamic Context Management for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01858)
*Haowei Zhu,Qijie Wang,Jia Li,Xing Wang,Tianyu Zhao,Jiexi Wang,Xurui Peng,Xinglong Wu,Junhai Yong,Bin Wan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出可学习上下文记忆管理框架 L2M，动态保留/驱逐/演化历史帧，缓解自回归长视频生成的误差累积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频生成在短视频上表现优异，但长时生成因逐帧依赖不完美前帧而产生误差累积。现有静态上下文管理（滑窗缓存丢弃早期帧、固定 sink 帧永久保留初始内容）要么丢失长程上下文，要么将生成锚定在过时信息上，导致保真度下降、运动停滞与多样性降低。

Method: L2M 由三部分组成：(1) 重要性预测路由器，估计每个历史帧的相关性；(2) 退化感知训练，提升对噪声/损坏上下文的鲁棒性；(3) 动态记忆初始化与演化机制，用基于 EMA 的重要性分数更新长期记忆，使高质量帧替代陈旧锚点。训练采用教师-学生蒸馏目标加稀疏正则，在固定 KV-cache 预算下高效保留最有信息量的上下文。

Result: 大量实验表明，L2M 在长时程视频生成质量与时间一致性上优于现有基线。

Conclusion: L2M 为长自回归视频生成的上下文记忆管理提供了一种可学习策略，突破了静态缓存设计的固有局限。

Abstract: Autoregressive video generation has achieved impressive results on short clips, yet generating long videos remains challenging due to error accumulation over extended horizons, where each predicted frame depends on potentially imperfect previous frames. Existing approaches typically rely on static context management strategies, such as sliding-window caches that discard early frames or fixed sink frames that permanently preserve initial content. These designs either lose critical long-range context or anchor generation to outdated information, which can lead to degraded fidelity, motion stagnation, and reduced diversity. In this paper, we propose Learning to Memorize (L2M), a learned context memory management framework that dynamically retains, evicts, and evolves historical frames according to predicted importance. The framework consists of an importance prediction router that estimates the relevance of each historical frame, degradation-aware training that improves robustness to noisy or corrupted context, and a dynamic memory initialization and evolution mechanism that updates long-term memory using exponential moving average (EMA) importance scores. This allows high-quality frames to replace stale anchors and enables memory to adapt naturally to scene evolution. Trained with a teacher-student distillation objective and sparsity regularization, L2M makes efficient use of a fixed KV-cache budget while preserving the most informative contextual information. Extensive experiments demonstrate that L2M improves long-horizon video generation quality and temporal consistency over existing baselines, providing a learned strategy for context memory management in long autoregressive video generation.

</details>


### [115] [RIFT: Residual-Informed Flow Transfer for One-Step Generative Video Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01791)
*Qizhe Wang,Jiaye Fu,Feng Ye,Haocheng Tang,Zetian Song,Chuanmin Jia,Siwei Ma,Jiaqi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RIFT单步生成式视频压缩框架，用残差几何诱导器把预训练flow预测转化为内容自适应的恢复更新，解决压缩退化与flow匹配扰动轨迹的方向失配问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式视频压缩借助预训练时空先验重建编码丢失细节，但编解码器引起的退化与flow-matching模型所学扰动轨迹之间存在显著差距；作者指出存在“压缩依赖的方向失配”，仅靠基于退化强度的时间步校准无法解决——压缩潜变量在不同码率点高度对齐，而重建残差的幅度与方向差异很大。

Method: RIFT（Residual-Informed Flow Transfer）框架，核心为残差几何诱导器（RGI）：利用解码器可见的codec线索，将预训练flow预测转换为内容自适应恢复更新；RGI融合flow时间步条件、学习的全频带残差强度估计，以及内容条件的方向与增益调制，使更新的方向与幅度匹配压缩依赖的残差几何，实现单步生成式压缩。

Result: 在三个公开视频压缩基准上，RIFT优于对比的生成式视频压缩方法；代码已公开。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模压缩残差的几何结构而非单纯依赖退化强度的时间步校准，可有效桥接codec退化与flow轨迹之间的失配，单步推理即可取得领先的生成式视频压缩性能。

Abstract: Recent advances in video generation have enabled generative video compression to reconstruct details lost during coding using pretrained spatiotemporal priors. However, a substantial gap remains between codec-induced degradation and the perturbation trajectories learned by flow-matching models. In this paper, we identify a compression-dependent directional mismatch that degradation-strength-based timestep calibration alone cannot resolve. Compressed latents remain strongly aligned across codec operating points, while their reconstruction residuals vary substantially in magnitude and direction. To bridge this gap, we propose RIFT, a Residual-Informed Flow Transfer framework for one-step generative video compression. At its core, RIFT introduces a Residual Geometry Inducer (RGI) that converts the pretrained flow prediction into a content-adaptive restoration update using decoder-visible codec cues. RGI integrates flow-timestep conditioning with a learned full-band residual-strength estimate and content-conditioned direction and gain modulation, aligning the orientation and magnitude of the update with the compression-dependent residual geometry. Extensive experiments on three public video compression benchmarks show that RIFT outperforms competing generative video compression methods. The code is publicly available on RIFT.

</details>


### [116] [Detection Instead of Inversion: T1-T2 Microstructure Quantification With Detection Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01790)
*Sebastian Endt,Fatih Özkan,Marion I. Menzel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将T1-T2相关MRI的逐体素谱重建转化为目标检测任务，用DETR从64个TI/TE信号直接预测由T1、T2和信号占比定义的微结构组分集合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统T1-T2相关MRI需逐体素重建完整T1-T2谱，依赖病态且耗时的逆拉普拉斯变换；同时希望在不引入生物模型的前提下量化微结构组分。

Method: 把组分集合视为待检测的"目标"，用Detection Transformer接收64维TI/TE信号输入，直接输出一组组分参数（T1、T2、信号占比），并采用mAP@10作为评估指标。

Result: 仿真数据上mAP@10达76.8%，优于此前模型设计（53.8%）与正则化NNLS（66.1%）；在组分数量、组分信号占比和SNR的几乎全部设置下均优于NNLS，且重建速度比NNLS快数个数量级。

Conclusion: 将T1-T2谱重建重新表述为集合预测/目标检测问题可行且有效，在精度与速度上均超越传统NNLS，代码已开源可完全复现。

Abstract: T1-T2 correlation MRI has strong potential to quantify microstructural compartments without imposing a biological model. Traditionally, full T1-T2 spectra per voxel are reconstructed with an ill-conditioned and time-consuming Inverse Laplace Transform. We propose to view this challenge as an object detection task: A Detection Transformer (DETR) takes 64 TI/TE signals and directly predicts a set of compartments specified by T1, T2, and signal fraction. We achieve a mean average precision mAP@10 of 76.8% on simulated data, outperforming both our previous model design (53.8%) and regularized NNLS (66.1%). We show that our DETR approach outperforms NNLS in almost every setting across compartment count, compartmental signal fraction, and SNR. Reconstruction is orders of magnitude faster than NNLS. The results are fully reproducible from our public code: github.com/SebastianEndtTHI/t1t2-detr

</details>


### [117] [OCBI: Order-Sensitive Cross-Branch Interaction for Image Manipulation Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01783)
*Zhouli Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OCBI 通过建模 RGB 引导跨注意力与取证自注意力两种组合顺序之间的差异（交换子）来增强图像篡改定位，在五个干净测试集上宏平均 PixelF1 达 0.5773（较基线 +0.43 个百分点），在 21 种数据集-变换条件下平均 PixelF1 提升 0.95 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 篡改定位需融合语义结构与取证痕迹。分支内空间混合与 RGB 引导的跨分支混合在交换组合顺序时会产生不同消息，而现有 Co-Transformers 未建模该顺序差异带来的信息。

Method: 提出 OCBI（Co-Transformers 扩展）：①局部跨分支融合模块以 RGB 引导交叉注意力与取证自注意力的交换子，为特征迁移加入可学习的带符号修正；②逐像素自适应多尺度聚合在预测前融合空间上下文；沿用 Co-Transformers 主干与监督方式。

Result: 以仅 CASIA 任务训练、50 轮预算、末轮评估设置与重训 Co-Transformers 对比：五个干净测试集宏平均 PixelF1 为 0.5773，超基线 0.43 个百分点；在 JPEG 压缩、高斯模糊、缩放三类变换、三个数据集共 21 种条件下平均 PixelF1 超基线 0.95 个百分点。

Conclusion: 显式建模跨分支组合顺序的不交换性可带来稳定的定位增益，且对压缩、模糊、缩放等后处理具有更强鲁棒性；但绝对性能与提升幅度仍有限，干净集增益较小。

Abstract: Image manipulation localization combines semantic structure with forensic traces to identify modified pixels. Within-branch spatial mixing and RGB-guided cross-branch mixing can produce different messages when composed in opposite orders. We propose OCBI, an extension of Co-Transformers that models the discrepancy between these two composition orders for localization. A local cross-branch fusion module uses the commutator of RGB-guided cross-attention and forensic self-attention to add a learnable signed correction to feature transfer. Pixelwise adaptive multiscale aggregation then combines spatial contexts before prediction. OCBI uses the Co-Transformers backbone and supervision. We compare OCBI with retrained Co-Transformers using CASIA-only task training, a 50-epoch budget, and final-epoch evaluation. Across five clean test datasets, OCBI achieves a macro PixelF1 of 0.5773, exceeding the baseline by 0.43 percentage points. Under JPEG compression, Gaussian blur, and resizing on three datasets, its average PixelF1 over 21 dataset-transformation conditions exceeds the baseline by 0.95 percentage points.

</details>


### [118] [Resolve, Clear, or Defer: Training-Free Active Prototype Triage for Ecological Detection Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01466)
*Anirudh Potlapally,Brijesh Nanda Brunda Yogananda,Jianyang Gu,Maanav Jajodia,Luke Meyers,Wei-Lun Chao,Hari Subramoni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无需训练的主动原型分流（active prototype triage），将已审核的检测结果作为可复用证据，用于自动确认前景类、清除背景误检、或对证据不足的样本推迟给专家审核。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生态监测中相机陷阱与航空调查产生海量图像，高召回动物检测器虽能批量定位候选动物，但仍产生大量需专家复核的检测（误检、歧义、难以定种）。穷举式复核成本过高，核心问题从"找到动物"转向"决定复核哪些样本、如何复用复核结果、以及何时不应自动决策"。

Method: 训练无关的原型分流框架：以已复核检测作为证据，通过原型匹配实现三类决策——确认受支持的前景类、清除可能的背景误检、推迟证据不足样本。使用不同预训练表征分别提供前景证据（BioCLIP2）与背景证据（DINOv3）；对比基线为置信度阈值化的多类k-NN与不确定性采样的逻辑回归；并研究原型选择（采集策略）对证据传播可靠性的影响。

Result: 在相机陷阱与航空数据集上，前景识别与误检剔除受益于不同预训练表征：BioCLIP2提供前景证据、DINOv3提供背景证据，可减少前景误清除并提升自动前景召回。推迟证据不足样本可避免强制决策带来的更高错误率。相比k-NN与逻辑回归基线，原型分流在前景召回上更优，且复核负担相当或更低；即使类别已被充分表示，原型选择仍显著影响证据传播的可靠性。

Conclusion: 当动物定位达到高召回后，瓶颈不再是检测本身，而是审核样本的选择、已审核证据的复用方式，以及识别证据不足时推迟人工决策的机制；原型分流为此提供了无需训练、可解释且高效的解决路径。

Abstract: Ecological monitoring increasingly relies on camera traps and aerial surveys that generate large image collections. High-recall animal detectors can localize candidate animals at scale. However, they also produce many detections that still require expert review, including false positives, ambiguous cases, and animals difficult to identify at the species level. Since exhaustive review requires substantial effort, we propose training-free active prototype triage, where reviewed detections become reusable evidence to (1) Resolve supported foreground classes, (2) Clear likely background false positives, or (3) Defer insufficiently supported cases for expert review. Across camera-trap and aerial datasets, foreground recognition and false-positive rejection benefit from different pretrained representations: BioCLIP2 provides foreground evidence while DINOv3 provides background evidence, reducing erroneous foreground clearing while improving automatic foreground recovery. Deferring unsupported cases avoids the higher error rates caused by forced decisions. Compared with confidence-thresholded multiclass k-NN and uncertainty-sampling logistic regression, prototype triage improves foreground recovery while maintaining competitive or lower review burden. Acquisition goes beyond class discovery: even after classes are represented, prototype choice determines how reliably evidence propagates through the remaining detections. Our results suggest that once animal localization reaches high recall, the challenge shifts from finding animals to deciding which examples to review, how to reuse them, and when evidence does not support an automatic decision.

</details>


### [119] [See, Think, Use: Diagnosing Perception and Reasoning Failures in VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01467)
*Jiacheng Ding,Yanliang Qi,Cong Guo,Peihua Mai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 See, Think, Use 协议：无需权重、仅每样本多问两个问题，即可把 VLM 的每个答案归因到「看」、或不依赖图像的推理本身、或对感知的使用，用于诊断瓶颈阶段并把测试时算力导向失败阶段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准只看最终答案，无法区分答案是基于图像感知还是猜测/记忆先验，开发者也难以判断该改进哪个阶段；同时测试时算力分配缺少阶段级依据。

Method: 三项探针：(1) 定位探针——要求给出每个实例的框，衡量 seeing；(2) 文本替换探针——用文字描述替代图像作答，衡量 thinking；(3) Use——在反事实图像对上测量答案跟随模型自身感知的比例，因两图问题与先验相同，故无需答案标签。每样本仅增两问，黑盒可测。

Result: 在 2 个模型家族、6 个数据集上：有效干预手段随任务族而变；答案通常跟随感知，唯有图像与常见先验冲突时失效，而先定位可修复（前提是框正确）；按测得阶段分配算力接近最优均匀策略且成本更低，并在干预能提升短板阶段时优于同算力的随机分配。

Conclusion: 阶段级归因可把「答案正确」拆解为看、思、用三者，为模型诊断与测试时算力分配提供可操作依据；代码、提示与逐题输出将公开。

Abstract: We present See, Think, Use, a protocol that traces each answer of a vision-language model to perception, reasoning or the use of perception. The diagnosis shows a developer which stage to improve and directs test-time compute to the stage that fails. Benchmarks score the final answer, and an answer that rests on the image earns the same credit as a guess or a memorized prior. The protocol asks the model two extra questions per item and needs no access to its weights. A localization probe asks for a box around every instance and measures seeing, and a text-replacement probe answers from a description and measures thinking. Use is the rate at which the answer follows the model's own perception across counterfactual image pairs. The rate needs no answer labels, because the question and its prior are the same on both images. On two model families and six datasets the protocol shows that the knob that helps follows the task family. Answers follow the model's perception except on images that contradict a common prior, and asking the model to localize first repairs this failure when its boxes are right. Allocating compute by the measured stages comes close to the best uniform policy at lower cost and beats a random allocation of the same compute wherever a knob raises the short stage. We will release the code, the prompts and the per-question outputs.

</details>


### [120] [RadPose: ISAC-based RF 3D Human Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01400)
*Geo Jie Zhou,Kunzhe Song,Ruxin Lin,Huacheng Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 RadPose，一个基于单站全双工 ISAC 的学习框架，使毫米波通信设备从标准 OFDM 信号中提取 CIR 生成 3D 射频点云，实现无需专用硬件的 3D 人体姿态估计，精度可与专用雷达方法媲美且在遮挡与未见场景中表现稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相机与 LiDAR 在恶劣光照和遮挡下姿态估计困难；毫米波雷达虽对光照与遮挡鲁棒，但依赖专用硬件与授权频谱，可扩展性差。作者希望复用现有毫米波通信设备完成感知任务。

Method: 利用单站全双工操作从标准 OFDM 通信信号中直接提取信道冲激响应（CIR），生成 3D 射频点云；采用跨帧 Transformer 姿态推理网络，含语义引导的空间注意力与目标驱动的时序注意力做鲁棒时空聚合；并加入基于图卷积的关节感知逆运动学精化模块，约束骨架拓扑、骨长一致性与解剖合理性。

Result: 大量实验表明 RadPose 精度与最先进雷达方法相当，并在未见场景和遮挡场景下保持稳健性能；数据集与源码已开源。

Conclusion: 通信信号可用于高精度 3D 人体姿态感知，验证了 ISAC 在无附加传感硬件条件下的可行性，为可扩展的普适人体感知提供新路径。

Abstract: Human pose estimation under adverse lighting and occlusion conditions remains challenging for camera- and LiDAR-based systems. Although mmWave radars provide robustness to illumination and occlusion, they rely on dedicated hardware and licensed spectrum, limiting scalability. In this paper, we present RadPose, a learning-based monostatic integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) framework that enables mmWave communication devices to perform 3D human pose estimation. Unlike specialized radars, RadPose leverages monostatic full-duplex operation to extract channel impulse responses (CIRs) directly from standard OFDM communication signals, generating 3D radio point clouds without additional sensing hardware. To address the sparsity and noise of RF observations, RadPose employs a cross-frame transformer-based pose inference network with semantic-guided spatial attention and target-driven temporal attention for robust spatio-temporal aggregation. It further adopts a joint-aware inverse kinematics refinement module based on graph convolution to enforce skeletal topology, bone-length consistency, and anatomical plausibility. Extensive experiments demonstrate RadPose achieves competitive accuracy compared to state-of-the-art radar-based approaches while maintaining robust performance in unseen and occluded scenarios. The dataset and source code are available at https://github.com/Geo-Chou/RadPose.

</details>


### [121] [Vocabulary Aligned Explanations for Computer Vision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01391)
*Erfan Mirhaji,Nikhil Krishnaswamy,Jill Zarestky,Lisa Mason,Nathaniel Blanchard,Sarath Sreedharan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FLUENT框架，用领域特定概念、视觉证据和专家逻辑规则来解释图像分类，并对规则做不确定性感知的置信度排序与可视化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以精度为目标优化的视觉模型并不保证学到并利用人类可理解、领域特定的概念与规则，因此需要一种以领域术语表达的可解释性方法。

Method: FLUENT为事后（post-hoc）框架：对专家编写的规则进行排序，规则由必需、可选替代与缺失概念联合构成；结合预测标签与概念状态及经验估计的似然与概念先验以容忍预测误差；在规则所涉概念的满足赋值上计算支持度并归一化为相对置信度；选取规则后，用遮挡式高亮展示查询图像中正向概念，用检索参考图像中的局部样例展示负向概念。

Result: 实现对候选解释的排序与相对置信度输出，并提供正/负概念的可视化证据，帮助不熟悉该领域的终端用户理解解释中概念所指的视觉形态。

Conclusion: FLUENT将领域知识与模型精度相结合，以应用领域词汇给出视觉概念高亮与显式规则置信度来解释图像。

Abstract: Optimizing vision models for accuracy does not force the model to learn and utilize human-understandable and domain-specific concepts and rules. We propose explaining image classifications through domain-specific concepts, visual evidence, and expert knowledge expressed as logical rules. We introduce FLUENT (Framework for Localized, Uncertainty-Aware Explanations in Normative Terminology), a post-hoc framework that ranks expert-authored rules combining jointly required, alternative, and absent concepts. To account for prediction errors, FLUENT combines predicted labels and concept states with empirically estimated likelihoods and concept priors. It scores each rule by calculating support over satisfying assignments to the concepts mentioned in that rule, then normalizes these scores to express relative confidence among candidate explanations. The selected rule is illustrated through occlusion-based highlights for positive concept mentions in the query image and localized examples in retrieved reference images for negative mentions. These illustrations are intended to show end users unfamiliar with the domain what the concepts named in an explanation look like. FLUENT combines domain knowledge and model accuracy, and delivers visual concept highlights and explicit rule confidence to explain an image in the vocabulary of an application domain.

</details>


### [122] [Fréchet Oral Distance: A Coordinate-Free Metric and Benchmark for Speech-Driven Oral Animation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01705)
*Jaehong Myung,Seungho Eum,Hyunjung Chung,Unsang Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Fréchet Oral Distance (FOD)，基于口腔运动编码器(OME)嵌入与TIMIT-Vis参考分布来客观评价语音驱动的面部/口型动画生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音驱动的面部与口型动画已广泛应用于教育、言语治疗和医疗等领域，但缺乏客观、可复现的生成质量评价方法，现有评价依赖昂贵设备或主观评估。

Method: 构建FOD度量：利用Oral Motion Encoder提取生成结果的口腔运动嵌入，并与TIMIT-Vis参考分布计算Fréchet距离，从而在嵌入空间中衡量生成分布与真实分布的差异。

Result: 实验表明FOD得到的模型排序与基于坐标的Lip Vertex Error (LVE)相近，且与用户偏好趋势一致，验证了其有效性。

Conclusion: FOD提供了无需昂贵设备与主观评价的客观、可复现基准方法，并可扩展用于多种2D/3D生成模型的比较。

Abstract: Recently, speech-driven facial and oral animation technologies have been used in various fields such as education, speech therapy, and healthcare. But methods to objectively evaluate the quality of generated results are still limited. Accordingly, we propose the Fréchet Oral Distance (FOD), which uses embeddings from an Oral Motion Encoder (OME) and a TIMIT-Vis reference distribution. In experiments, FOD reproduced model rankings similar to the coordinate-based metric, Lip Vertex Error (LVE), and showed trends consistent with user preference. Our framework provides objective and reproducible benchmarking without relying on expensive equipment or subjective evaluation, and it can be extended to compare a variety of 2D/3D models.

</details>


### [123] [Restoring Semantic Fidelity for Training-Free High-Resolution Image Generation in Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01696)
*Junjie Li,Zengbin Wang,Gaoxiang Li,Muyi Sun,Yixin Zhang,Man Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练框架，通过文本-视觉尺度解耦注意力(TVSDA)与结构-细节引导(SDG)解决DiT文本到图像模型超分辨率生成时的语义退化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DiT-based文本到图像模型直接用于超出训练分辨率时会遭遇严重语义退化，有意义的语义内容消失；现有免训练高分辨率方法虽可缓解但语义退化未根本解决，细节退化；常用结构引导方法缺乏对中间轨迹结构与细节的建模。

Method: 两模块的免训练框架：(1) TVSDA：保留文本token的全局感受野，同时使图像token感受野与训练分辨率对齐，恢复高分辨率下生成语义内容的能力；(2) SDG：通过尺度维与时间维引导显式建模结构信息和精细细节，克服传统低分辨率引导的局限。

Result: 大量实验表明，相较现有免训练DiT高分辨率生成方法，本方法在结构连贯性与细节保真度上均显著提升。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 语义退化可通过解耦文本与视觉token的尺度感受野有效缓解，结合跨尺度/跨时刻的结构-细节引导，可在免训练条件下实现高质量高分辨率图像生成。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-based text-to-image models have recently achieved remarkable success in image synthesis. However, when directly applied beyond their training resolution, these models often suffer from severe semantic degradation, where meaningful semantic content disappears. Although existing training-free high-resolution generation methods can mitigate this issue, the inherent semantic degradation at high resolutions remains largely unresolved, leading to degraded fine-grained details. Furthermore, widely used structural guidance methods lack modeling of the structure and details in the intermediate trajectory, which degrades the quality of the generated results. In this paper, we propose a training-free framework for high-resolution image generation to address these challenges. First, we propose a text-visual scale-decoupled attention (TVSDA) module, which restores the model's ability to generate semantically meaningful content at high resolutions by preserving the global receptive field of text tokens while aligning the receptive field of image tokens with the training resolution. Second, we propose a structure-detail guidance (SDG) strategy that explicitly models structural information and fine details through scale-wise and temporal-wise guidance, overcoming the limitations of conventional low-resolution guidance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly improves both structural coherence and detail fidelity over existing training-free DiT-based high-resolution generation approaches. The code is available at https://github.com/ljjcoder/Restoring-Semantic-Fidelity.

</details>


### [124] [GaitFM: A Cross-Modal Foundation Model for Wearable Gait Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01684)
*Yize Cai,Zhiqing Hong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GaitFM是跨模态步态评估基础模型，通过迁移大规模视觉模型知识并在约4000名受试者、123万步态窗口的无标注IMU数据上预训练，在18项步态相关任务及不同传感器配置下展现强泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于日常可穿戴IMU的深度学习为步态评估提供了低成本、可及方案，但IMU测量在个体、佩戴位置与设备配置间差异大，而现有模型多基于小规模同质数据集、针对特定临床任务开发，鲁棒性与泛化性不足。

Method: 提出GaitFM跨模态基础模型：从大规模视觉模型迁移知识，并在大规模构建的无标注IMU数据集（约4000名参与者、123万个步态窗口，涵盖多样临床与日常场景、传感器模态与身体位置）上进行自监督预训练。

Result: 在18项步态相关任务上表现强劲，包括3项步态参数估计、14项疾病与步态异常检测、1项临床结局预测；并能在临床常用及日常可穿戴设备的不同传感器配置与佩戴位置间泛化。

Conclusion: 视觉知识迁移可有效提升基于传感器的步态评估性能，为缓解传感器与医学领域的数据稀缺问题提供了新路径。

Abstract: Gait assessment supports the diagnosis, monitoring, and prognosis of diverse movement-related conditions, such as neurological and musculoskeletal disorders. Recent advances in deep learning using everyday wearable inertial measurement units (IMUs) offer an accessible and low-cost approach to automated gait assessment. However, IMU measurements vary substantially across individuals, body locations, and device configurations, while existing deep learning models are typically developed using small, homogeneous datasets for specific clinical tasks, limiting their robustness and generalizability in diverse real-world contexts. Here we present GaitFM, a cross-modal foundation model for gait assessment using IMU sensors. GaitFM improves the generalizability of gait assessment by transferring knowledge from large vision models and pretraining on unlabeled IMU sensor data. We pretrain GaitFM on a large curated dataset comprising about 4,000 participants and 1.23 million gait windows across diverse clinical and daily conditions, sensor modalities, and body locations. GaitFM demonstrates strong performance across 18 gait-related tasks, including 3 gait parameter estimation tasks, 14 disease and gait abnormality detection tasks, and 1 clinical outcome prediction task. Furthermore, GaitFM generalizes across different sensor configurations and body locations, including those commonly used in clinical settings and everyday wearable devices. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of transferring visual knowledge in improving sensor-based gait assessment performance, offering a new promising pathway for addressing data scarcity in the sensor and medical domains.

</details>


### [125] [UA-Depth: Uncertainty-Aware Depth Restoration for Material-Agnostic Object Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01645)
*Rui Cao,Jia-Hui Pan,Yin Zhang,Qiwei Meng,Jiapeng Li,Gang Wang,Runsong Zhu,Wei Chen,Chi-Wing Fu,Jiangliu Wang,Yun-Hui Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UA-Depth：迭代协同细化深度与逐像素不确定性的深度修复框架，用不确定性门控特征抑制不可靠线索，并借助冻结深度基础模型先验与两阶段MAD加权对数深度尺度归一化，在八数据集零样本基准上取得最佳平均排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商用RGB-D相机在透明、反射、半透明等非朗伯物体上会产生空洞、结构化噪声与深度偏置；多数修复方法仅输出单张深度图，对噪声区与可靠区一视同仁，忽略区域不确定性，且零样本泛化不足。

Method: 提出不确定性感知的深度修复框架：迭代联合细化深度与逐像素不确定性，并以不确定性门控特征抑制不可靠线索以获得稳定更新；采用冻结深度基础模型作为先验初始化缺失/不可靠深度；使用两阶段MAD加权对数深度尺度归一化，降低相对深度转度量深度对齐中的离群偏置。

Result: 构建覆盖多场景、多材质、多传感器的八数据集零样本基准；在该基准上取得代表性基线中最佳平均排名，在透明与反射物体主导的数据集上增益尤为显著；利用预测不确定性在类别级6D位姿估计与6D抓取合成下游任务上取得提升。

Conclusion: 逐像素不确定性建模与基础模型先验、鲁棒尺度对齐相结合，可有效提升非朗伯场景下的零样本深度修复质量，并将不确定性转化为下游位姿与抓取任务的性能收益。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation requires accurate metric depth, yet commodity RGB-D cameras often fail on non-Lambertian objects such as transparent, reflective, and translucent materials, producing holes, structured noise, and biased depth. Most restoration methods produce only a single depth map, treating noisy and reliable regions uniformly for downstream tasks while ignoring regional uncertainty. We present UA-Depth, an uncertainty-aware depth restoration framework that iteratively co-refines depth and pixel-wise uncertainty, and uses uncertainty-gated features to suppress unreliable cues for stable updates. To strengthen zero-shot behavior, UA-Depth leverages a frozen depth foundation model as a prior to initialize missing or unreliable depth, and applies two-stage MAD-weighted log-depth scale normalization to reduce outlier bias in relative-to-metric alignment. We introduce an eight-dataset zero-shot benchmark across diverse scenes, materials, and sensors. Across these benchmarks, UA-Depth achieves the best mean rank among representative baselines, with particularly strong gains on datasets dominated by transparent and reflective objects. Beyond depth metrics, we demonstrate downstream improvements in category-level 6D pose estimation and 6D grasp synthesis by exploiting the predicted uncertainty. \emph{Code, models, and data for training and evaluation will be released upon publication.}

</details>


### [126] [Special and General Computational Aesthetics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01626)
*Ganqing Luo,Chuan Li,Liaoruxing Zhang,Xin Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文厘清计算美学内部结构与邻近概念关系，提出"特殊计算美学（SCA）"与"一般计算美学（GCA）"两级范围界定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算美学与计算艺术、AI艺术、AI美学、AIGC、计算创造力等概念交织，若不区分范围、目标与方法，易被窄化为图像美学质量评估，或被泛化为"AI介入艺术"的伞形术语，导致学科边界模糊。

Method: 概念分析与边界划分：剖析计算美学内部结构及与邻近概念的关系，提出两级范围框架。SCA聚焦美学测量（美学属性的计算识别与表征、人类美学评价预测）与美学过程建模（描述、检验、解释审美感知与判断的形成）；GCA在此核心上扩展出"美学生成"，即以计算美学模型引导的艺术生成。以AI算法与模型开展的相关研究定义为AI美学；并援引冯鹏关于美、审美经验与艺术可计算性的论述作为理论参照。

Result: 形成"特殊核心—一般扩展"的层次结构：美学测量对应"审美感知"，美学过程建模对应"审美理解"，美学生成构成一般扩展；计算美学任务亦可采用非AI方法，故计算美学不等于AI美学；"美学生成"与AIGC、AI艺术、计算创造力相交，仅当计算美学模型实质性约束、引导或优化作品生成时才归入GCA。

Conclusion: 两级范围界定为计算美学提供了可操作的概念边界，避免窄化与泛化，并澄清其与AI美学、AIGC、AI艺术、计算创造力等的从属与交叉关系。

Abstract: Computational aesthetics is a field at the intersection of computer science, artificial intelligence, aesthetics, and other disciplines. As AI has developed, the field has formed relations of inclusion, intersection, or support with computational art, AI art, AI aesthetics, AI-generated content (AIGC), computational creativity, affective computing, and neuroaesthetics. Without distinguishing scope, objectives, and methods, it may be narrowed to image aesthetic quality assessment or expanded into an umbrella term for AI's involvement in art.
  We analyze its internal structure and its relations with neighboring concepts, and propose a two-level scope: special computational aesthetics (SCA) and general computational aesthetics (GCA). SCA centers on aesthetic measurement and aesthetic process modeling. The former primarily corresponds to "Aesthetic Perception": computationally identifying and representing aesthetic attributes and predicting human aesthetic evaluations; the latter primarily to "Aesthetic Understanding": computationally describing, testing, and explaining how human aesthetic perception and judgment are formed. GCA extends this core to include "Aesthetic Generation," namely artistic generation guided by computational aesthetic models. Some computational aesthetic tasks can also use non-AI methods. Research in this scope using AI algorithms and models we define as AI aesthetics, which may involve the special core and the general extension. "Aesthetic Generation" intersects with AIGC, AI art, and computational creativity, but belongs to the general extension defined here only when computational aesthetic models substantively constrain, guide, or optimize artwork generation. We also draw on Feng Peng's discussion of the computability of beauty, aesthetic experience, and art as a theoretical reference for clarifying boundaries between computational aesthetics and related concepts.

</details>


### [127] [Recoverability-Aware Evaluation of Diffusion Video Inpainting and Object Removal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01578)
*Yanliang Qi,Jiacheng Ding,Cong Guo,Peihua Mai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出"可恢复性分层评估"与"证据引导采样(EGS)"，将视频擦除评测中的"复制"与"生成"分开，实验表明扩散式擦除器在DAVIS上浪费了可观测内容，且无训练复用仅在颜色来自干净视频轨迹时才有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频擦除(object removal)指标对整个hole统一打分，但hole内不同像素的可观测程度差异极大：部分像素在其他帧可见（可复制），部分从未可见（需生成）。整体打分混合了复制与生成两种能力，无法诊断模型究竟擅长哪一类。

Method: 1) 可恢复性分层评估：在干净视频上运行点跟踪器，按每个hole像素是否被观测及观测距离进行分层，以"复制参考"为基准，分层报告保真度与时间稳定性；2) 证据引导采样EGS：无训练地将跟踪得到的颜色混合进视频扩散擦除器的干净潜变量预测中。

Result: DAVIS上，在内容于数帧外可见的区域，三个扩散擦除器相对流传播的感知优势缩小（对E2FGVI-HQ的LPIPS双重差分+0.046~+0.056），真实配对拍摄对其中两个呈相同趋势；其DAVIS hole warping误差为ProPainter的2~4倍；沿干净视频轨迹复制可使可恢复区域LPIPS下降1/4~2/5。EGS在留出DAVIS上、颜色取自干净视频轨迹时分别弥合了相对于复制参考差距的43%与56%；而以掩码输入轨迹取色时，预注册确证实验显示在MiniMax-Remover上无增益、在ROSE上有损失。

Conclusion: 扩散式擦除器在DAVIS上未充分利用可观测内容；混合评测掩盖了这一缺陷，分层评估可揭示复制与生成能力的分野；无训练的证据复用（EGS）目前仅在轨迹证据来自干净视频时成立，尚不稳健。

Abstract: Video inpainting for object removal is scored over the whole hole, although the background behind the object is visible in other frames of the shot for some hole pixels and in no frame for others. A whole-hole score therefore mixes copying with generation and cannot show which of the two a remover does well. To separate the two, we propose recoverability-stratified evaluation, in which a point tracker run on the clean video labels each hole pixel by whether and how far away it is observed, so that fidelity and temporal stability can be reported per stratum against a copy reference. To reuse the observed content, we also propose evidence-guided sampling (EGS), which blends tracked colors into the clean-latent prediction of a video diffusion remover without training. On DAVIS, the perceptual advantage of three diffusion removers over flow propagation shrinks where the content is visible a few frames away (LPIPS difference-in-differences +0.046 to +0.056 against E2FGVI-HQ), and real paired captures show the same pattern for two of them. Their DAVIS hole warping error is two to four times that of ProPainter, and copying along clean-video tracks lowers their recoverable LPIPS by a quarter to two fifths. EGS closes 43% and 56% of the gap to this copy reference on held-out DAVIS when its colors come from clean-video tracks. With colors tracked on the masked input, a pre-registered confirmation finds no gain on MiniMax-Remover and a loss on ROSE. Diffusion removers thus leave observed content unused on DAVIS, and training-free reuse does not yet hold with tracked evidence.

</details>


### [128] [Text-Assisted Event Stream Visual Place Recognition via Multi-Scale Spatiotemporal Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01558)
*Lan Chen,Xingxing Xiong,Xiao Wang,Ziyan Zhang,Zikang Yan,Yuanhao Zheng,Bo Jiang,Yonghong Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MSTOT-EPR，利用多尺度时空最优传输实现事件流与文本的跨模态语义对齐，用于事件相机视觉位置识别（VPR）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机具有高动态范围、高时间分辨率、低功耗等优势，低空经济背景下基于事件相机的VPR研究成为热点。已有方法引入自然语言描述以缓解事件相机结构空间信息稀疏的问题，但仍未充分解决两个核心挑战：高效编码事件流，以及事件流与文本的语义对齐。

Method: 输入事件流与场景文本，先用视觉编码器和文本编码器分别提取特征表示；采用最优传输约束实现跨模态对齐；设计跨模态瓶颈融合模块进一步融合双模态特征；并构建多尺度空间最优传输模块与帧间时间最优传输模块，挖掘高质量时空事件特征用于场景识别。

Result: 在NYC-Event-VPR与EPRBench数据集上的大量实验充分验证了所提框架在事件相机VPR任务上的有效性。

Conclusion: 多尺度时空最优传输框架可有效编码事件流并实现事件-文本语义对齐，提升事件相机VPR性能；源代码将在论文接收后公开。

Abstract: Benefiting from the high dynamic range, high temporal resolution, and low energy consumption of event cameras, low-altitude economic research leveraging event cameras has become a popular topic. Several existing attempts introduce natural-language descriptions into visual place recognition (VPR) to mitigate the sparsity of structural spatial information inherent to event cameras. Nevertheless, these methods still fail to fully address two core challenges: effectively encoding event streams and semantically aligning event streams with text. In this paper, we propose a multi-scale spatial-temporal optimal transport approach, MSTOT-EPR, to address these challenges. Specifically, given event streams and scene text information, we first adopt a visual encoder and a text encoder to extract respective feature representations. We then apply optimal-transport constraints to achieve cross-modal alignment. We then design a cross-modal bottleneck fusion module to further fuse bimodal features. Furthermore, we develop multi-scale spatial optimal transport and inter-frame temporal optimal transport modules to mine high-quality spatial-temporal event features for scene recognition. Extensive experiments on the NYC-Event-VPR and EPRBench datasets fully validate the effectiveness of our proposed framework for event-based VPR. The source code of this paper will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [129] [CUFormer: Modality-Aware CT-Ultrasound Point Cloud Registration for Orthopedic Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01536)
*Lixing Tan,Qing Xia,Yuting Guo,Shuai Li,Aimin Hao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CUFormer——一种模态感知的跨模态点云配准框架，用于术中超声骨面点云与术前CT模型的配准，通过模态感知Transformer与可见性加权匹配解决部分覆盖与对称歧义问题，在三个数据集上取得最低配准误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无辐射骨科导航需要将术中US骨表面点云配准到术前CT模型，但成像物理差异导致表面采样模式不同，跨模态特征匹配困难；同时骨强反射超声并产生声影，US仅捕获探头朝向侧骨面，CT大部分点无对应，形成严重部分覆盖，在近似对称骨骼上易产生歧义对应。

Method: CUFormer包含：1）模态感知Transformer（MAT），通过身份嵌入编码输入模态，并在共享几何匹配器中以模态专属adapter更新特征；2）显式建模成像可见性，用预测的参考侧可见性对粗、细两级对应进行加权。

Result: 在UltraBones100k、UltraBonesHip两个CT-US数据集及CT-RGB-D数据集SpineDepth上，CUFormer平均配准误差最低。UltraBones100k上平均旋转误差4.53°、平移误差3.19 mm、RMSE 2.54 mm，RMSE相对最优基线降低65.8%。

Conclusion: 结果验证了CUFormer在跨解剖部位、部分骨表面条件下对齐US与术前CT的有效性，模态感知建模与可见性加权是应对跨模态部分配准的关键。

Abstract: Registering intraoperative Ultrasound (US) bone-surface point clouds to preoperative Computed Tomography (CT) models can support radiation-free orthopedic navigation. Differences in imaging physics produce distinct surface sampling patterns, complicating cross-modal feature matching. Bone strongly reflects ultrasound and casts an acoustic shadow, so US captures only the probe-facing bone surface and leaves most CT points unmatched. This partial coverage makes correspondences ambiguous on near-symmetric bones. We propose CUFormer, a modality-aware registration framework. We introduce a Modality-Aware Transformer (MAT) that encodes input modality through identity embeddings and updates features through modality-specific adapters within a shared geometric matcher. We model imaging visibility and use predicted reference-side visibility to weight coarse and fine correspondences. CUFormer achieves the lowest mean registration errors among evaluated methods on two CT-US datasets, UltraBones100k and UltraBonesHip, and the CT-RGB-D dataset SpineDepth. On UltraBones100k, it reaches mean rotation error 4.53$^\circ$, translation error 3.19\,mm, and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) 2.54\,mm, reducing RMSE by 65.8\% relative to the best-performing baseline by this metric. These results demonstrate CUFormer's effectiveness in aligning partial bone surfaces with preoperative CT across anatomical sites.

</details>


### [130] [AR-RRG: Anatomy-Guided Retrieval-Driven Radiology Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01529)
*Xiang Zhang,Shijie Song,Wanqing Zhao,Wei Zhou,Rui Cao,Dekui Wang,Qiyao Hu,Xianlin Peng,Hangzai Luo,Sheng Zhong,Jianping Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出解剖引导的检索驱动放射报告生成框架AR-RRG，通过病灶检测与双粒度检索抑制幻觉、补全漏检，在三个数据集上优于SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型仅捕捉全局视觉线索，缺乏解剖区域与诊断文本的细粒度对齐；多数检索增强方法直接检索完整历史报告，引入冗余噪声与严重的视觉-文本错配，导致临床风险性幻觉与病灶漏报。

Method: AR-RRG含两模块：ASLDNet（解剖感知自训练病灶检测网络），采用解剖感知空间验证ASV与类别自适应动态阈值CDT进行自训练，输出精确病灶定位；RRRG（检索驱动报告生成分支），通过双粒度检索DR消除临床幻觉、邻域共识NC机制补全漏检病灶，并用并行连续视觉感知PCVP流经固定医学编码与重采样将X光片转为视觉token；随后多尺度文本-视觉特征融合，结合LoRA高效微调大语言模型生成临床一致、视觉有据的报告。

Result: 在MS-CXR、MIMIC-CXR与IU X-Ray上评测，AR-RRG在主流指标上一致优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 解剖引导的检索驱动设计可有效缓解检索噪声与视觉-文本错配带来的幻觉和漏检问题，验证了检测与生成协同、细粒度检索增强在放射报告生成中的有效性；代码将公开。

Abstract: Radiology report generation (RRG) streamlines clinical workflows and alleviates the burden of radiologists' documentation. Standard vision-language models capture global visual cues and lack fine-grained alignment between anatomical regions and diagnostic text. Most retrieval-augmented methods retrieve complete historical reports, introducing redundant noise and severe vision-text mismatches that trigger clinically risky hallucinations and missed lesions. In this paper, we introduce AR-RRG, an anatomy-guided retrieval-driven method for the generation of radiology reports. AR-RRG consists of two core modules: the anatomy-aware self-training lesion detection network (ASLDNet) and the retrieval-driven radiology report generation (RRRG). ASLDNet leverages anatomy-aware spatial verification (ASV) and class-adaptive dynamic thresholding (CDT) via self-training, delivering accurate lesion localization to support subsequent generation. As the generative branch of AR-RRG, RRRG eliminates clinical hallucinations through dual-granularity retrieval (DR) and complements missing lesions with a neighborhood consensus (NC) mechanism. A parallel continuous visual perception (PCVP) stream converts radiographs into visual tokens through fixed medical encoding and resampling. Multi-scale text and visual features are fused, followed by LoRA-efficient large language model tuning to generate clinically consistent, visually grounded radiology reports. Extensive evaluations on MS-CXR, MIMIC-CXR, and IU X-Ray demonstrate that AR-RRG consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across mainstream metrics. Our code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [131] [PhoneValue-Bench: A Multimodal Benchmark and Datasets for Consumer Smartphone Recommerce Valuation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00791)
*Zihan Deng,Jun Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文针对二手智能手机回收(recommerce)场景中"发货前远程报价"问题,提出 PhoneValue-Bench(双真值评测套件+分级门控计分卡)、PhoneValue-Corpus(2万+订单、数十万带描述图像)与 ValueAgent(分阶段 感知-融合-估价 流水线)及可执行公开评分器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 远程估价需将带噪外观证据与来自截图、员工表单的身份/电池/锁/渠道风险联合推理,任一模态出错都会改变成色等级与赔付金额。现有资源多面向通用VLM能力、屏幕阅读或工厂缺陷检测,缺乏员工对齐的以旧换新字段、外观/员工双真值以及可执行估价计分卡,也缺少大规模真实带审核双标注数据与独立于训练标签的紧凑排序基准。

Method: 构建 PhoneValue-Bench(双真值、分级门控 scorecard 的评测套件,含与训练标签隔离的紧凑排名基准)与 PhoneValue-Corpus(弱标注训练集);提出 ValueAgent 分阶段流水线,依次进行多视图无序外观感知、多源诊断信息融合与按运营扣减规则的可执行估价,并公开 scorer 与提交格式。

Result: ValueAgent 在 Bench-Full 上测得 84.1/100,其中外观字段填充率 97.0、员工字段填充率 54.1。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了面向多模态二手回收估价的实用双真值基准;员工字段填充(54.1)显著低于外观字段(97.0),表明诊断截图/表单类结构化信息理解仍是主要瓶颈。

Abstract: As consumer smartphone recommerce scales, buyers must quote binding repurchase prices from seller-uploaded multi-view photos and diagnostic screenshots before devices reach the warehouse. Accurate remote valuation requires fusing noisy cosmetic evidence with identity, battery, lock, and channel risk from screenshots and staff forms, since an error in any modality changes both grade and payout. However, existing multimodal resources mainly target general VLM competence, screen reading, or factory defect detection, and largely overlook staff-aligned trade-in fields, dual appearance/staff ground truth, and executable valuation scorecards. This gap stems from two challenges: (1) the lack of large-scale real trade-in data with audited dual annotations and a compact ranking benchmark kept separate from training labels, and (2) the need to jointly reason over unordered multi-view cosmetics and diagnostic screens under operational deduction rules. To address these challenges, we propose PhoneValue-Bench, a dual-GT evaluation suite with tier-gated scorecards, together with PhoneValue-Corpus, a matched weakly labeled training set of over twenty thousand orders and hundreds of thousands of captioned images. We further present ValueAgent, a staged perception-fusion-valuation reference pipeline aligned with production inspection, plus an executable public scorer and submission schema. Experiments show that ValueAgent reaches a measured 84.1/100 on Bench-Full, with 97.0 appearance fill and 54.1 staff-field fill, establishing a practical dual-GT benchmark for multimodal recommerce valuation.

</details>


### [132] [DADKC: Distribution-Aware Adaptive Differentiated Knowledge Consolidation for Cloth-Hybrid Lifelong Person Re-identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00768)
*Yan Zhang,Minghao Long,Meiqi Wan,Yan Yang,Xin Yuan,Wei Wang,Xiao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DADKC框架，通过分布感知的自适应差异化知识巩固，解决无样本回放的布衣混合终身行人重识别中的域偏移与遗忘问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LReID在实际长期部署中同时面临跨摄像机/场景的域偏移与同一身份不规律换衣问题，形成CH-LReID任务。现有回放或蒸馏式LReID方法在无样本（exemplar-free）训练下难以充分建模阶段感知的域分布与跨阶段特征连续性。

Method: 在差异化知识巩固（DKC）范式上引入自适应分布建模，设计三个轻量模块：(1) Anchor Pool Adapter (APA)，检索可学习锚点线索以精炼身份特征；(2) Phase Path Mixer (PPM)，进行阶段感知的专家路由以融合域特定分布路径；(3) Stage Bridge Alignment (SBA)，正则化相邻阶段间基、锚点与路径表示的连续性。

Result: 在CH-LReID与LReID基准上，相较DKC基线，Order-1提升4.1%/4.5% mAP/R1，Order-2提升3.6%/3.4% mAP/R1；加权遗忘率由2.4%/1.7%降至1.8%/1.4%，且不存储历史图像与逐图像特征。

Conclusion: 分布感知的自适应知识巩固能在无回放存储条件下有效兼顾布衣相关与无关知识、抑制灾难性遗忘，为CH-LReID提供可行方案。

Abstract: Lifelong Person Re-identification (LReID) aims to match the same person using sequentially collected data. In practical long-term deployments, however, the model must handle both domain shifts across cameras and scenes, and irregular clothing changes of the same identity. This gives rise to the Cloth-Hybrid Lifelong Person Re-identification (CH-LReID) task, which demands balancing cloth-relevant and cloth-irrelevant knowledge in streaming data. While existing LReID methods have explored replay-based or distillation-based anti-forgetting strategies, they typically fail to sufficiently model stage-aware domain distributions and cross-stage feature continuity under exemplar-free training. To address this problem, we propose a Distribution-Aware Adaptive Differentiated Knowledge Consolidation (DADKC) framework. The core idea is to enhance the existing Differentiated Knowledge Consolidation (DKC) paradigm with adaptive distribution modeling. To this end, three lightweight modules are designed: (1) an Anchor Pool Adapter (APA) to retrieve learnable anchor cues for refining identity features; (2) a Phase Path Mixer (PPM) to perform stage-aware expert routing for integrating domain-specific distribution paths; and (3) a Stage Bridge Alignment (SBA) module to regularize the continuity of base, anchor, and path representations between adjacent stages. Extensive experiments on the CH-LReID and LReID benchmarks show that DADKC gains 4.1%/4.5% mAP/R1 on Order-1 and 3.6%/3.4% mAP/R1 on Order-2 over the DKC baseline, and lowers weighted forgetting from 2.4%/1.7% to 1.8%/1.4%, while storing neither historical images nor per-image features. The code is available at https://github.com/fire667/DADKC.

</details>


### [133] [Old Is Not False: Valid-Time Memory for Interactive Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00758)
*Ziming Wang,Chuyue Gong,Hongliang Cao,Jingmin Zhu,Chutian Wang,Yuheng He,Xiuyu Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReDate将时间数据库的"有效时间"概念引入交互式视频世界模型：保留全部帧、按智能体动作日志为每个检索到的token标注有效时间，使冻结生成器在动作撤销后仍能正确渲染当前状态，无需训练。理论上证明"取最新时间戳"仅在每帧当前视图的日期晚于全部过期视图时正确，并证明重标注优于删除的条件；实验将FAR当前状态步数占比从0.36提升至0.62，HY-WorldPlay从0.003提升至0.19。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式视频世界模型通过记忆库中带捕获时间戳的历史帧生成新帧，并默认以最新时间戳为真值。该假设在状态单调推进时成立，但智能体撤销动作后，区域的最新视图已过期，而唯一表征当下的视图反而更旧。现有两类记忆机制均失效：删除型记忆会丢掉旧视图，保留型记忆则把过去的画面交还给生成器，导致状态渲染错误。

Method: 借鉴时间数据库区分记录存储时间与内容有效时间的思想，ReDate对捕获时间（存储时间）与有效时间解耦：保留所有帧不作删除，依据智能体动作日志为每个被检索的token推导并标注其有效时间；冻结的生成器据此将"被撤销的区域"理解为"刚刚到达新状态"，从而在零训练条件下完成正确条件生成。此外提出一种校准的状态度量，用于在动作撤销后检验任意记忆机制。

Result: 理论上给出三项结论：(1) 信任最新时间戳恰在"每个当前视图日期均晚于所有过期视图"时正确；(2) 若不存在回退之后的视图，则仅动作日志可区分被撤销区域与最新状态区域；(3) 对于能基于自身预测继续绘制的生成器，当被移动token权重较小时，重标注比删除获益更多。实证上，撤销动作后，ReDate使FAR中呈现当前状态的时间步占比由0.36升至0.62，HY-WorldPlay由0.003升至0.19。

Conclusion: 帧的时间戳应被理解为"内容有效时间"而非单纯捕获时间；以动作日志为依据的重标注可在不训练、不删除记忆的前提下修复撤销导致的时序错乱，且附带可推广的状态评估指标。

Abstract: Interactive video world models draw each frame from a memory bank of earlier frames stamped with their capture times. With frames, weights and noise fixed, reversing the timestamps of two views flips the state that generators of two families draw: they take the newest timestamp as the truth. That reading is right as long as states never return. After an agent undoes an action, the newest view of a region is outdated and the only view of the present is older; memories for changing worlds delete that older view, and memories that keep it hand the generator the past. Temporal databases separate when a record is stored from when its content holds, its valid time. ReDate keeps every frame and dates each retrieved token by its valid time, read from the agent's action log. The frozen generator then reads a reverted region as one that has just reached a new state, so ReDate needs no training. We prove that trusting the newest timestamp is right exactly when every current view is dated after every outdated one, that without a view taken after the return only the action log tells a reverted region from an up-to-date one, and that a generator able to draw from its own prediction gains more from re-dating than from deletion when the moved tokens keep little weight. After an undo, ReDate raises the share of FAR's steps showing the current state from 0.36 to 0.62 and HY-WorldPlay's from 0.003 to 0.19. We also propose a calibrated state metric to test any memory after undos.

</details>


### [134] [[Re] Pure Noise to the Rescue of Insufficient Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01295)
*Seungjae Ryan Lee,Seungmin Brian Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文是对Zada, Benou, Irani (2021)关于"纯噪声过采样(OPeN)+专用批归一化"提升不平衡分类的复现研究，复现了四项主要声明，但补充实验表明其增益与更大网络或更强数据增强带来的增益较为正交，并非替代关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原论文提出用纯噪声图像扩充少数类并结合特殊BN层来改善类别不平衡下的泛化，但此类"反直觉"结论缺乏独立验证；作者希望通过第三方复现检验其训练流程可复现性与结论稳健性，并厘清性能提升的来源。

Method: 用PyTorch按论文描述重建训练流程，并直接集成作者提供的纯噪声图像采样代码片段及"噪声/自然图像分别批归一化"的实现；针对四项主要声明逐一设计实验进行验证，并额外比较OPeN与更大网络容量、更复杂数据增强之间的交互效应。

Result: 四项声明均被成功复现：(i) 纯噪声过采样通过提升少数类精度改善泛化；(ii) 所提BN方法优于基线；(iii) 该提升在不同数据增强强度下保持稳健；(iv) 即便在平衡训练数据上加入纯噪声图像也能提升分类性能。额外实验显示OPeN带来的增益与更大网络、更复杂增强带来的增益更接近正交。

Conclusion: 原论文方法具有较好可复现性，其四项主要声明成立；但OPeN的效果并非源自与模型容量或增强复杂度相互替代的机制，而可能是互补的独立增益来源，提示应将其视作与网络/增强正交的额外改进手段。

Abstract: We examine the main claims of Zada, Benou, and Irani (2021), which states that in an image classification task with imbalanced training data, (i) using pure noise to augment minority-class images encourages generalization by improving minority-class accuracy. This method is paired with (ii) a new batch normalization layer that normalizes noise images using affine parameters learned from natural images, which improves the model's performance. Moreover, (iii) this improvement is robust to varying levels of data augmentation. Finally, the authors propose that (iv) adding pure noise images can improve classification even on balanced training data. We implemented the training pipeline from the description of the paper using PyTorch and integrated authors' code snippets for sampling pure noise images and batch normalizing noise and natural images separately. We reproduced the main claims that (i) oversampling with pure noise improves generalization by improving the minority-class accuracy, (ii) the proposed batch normalization (BN) method outperforms baselines, (iii) and this improvement is robust across data augmentations. Our results also support that (iv) adding pure noise images can improve classification on balanced training data. However, additional experiments suggest that the performance improvement from OPeN may be more orthogonal to the improvement caused by a bigger network or more complex data augmentation.

</details>


### [135] [StreamClarify: Proactive Clarification for Grounded Streaming Video Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01263)
*Zhuchen Shao,Bo Chen,Klara Nahrstedt*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: StreamClarify：面向流式视频问答的免训练框架，用"作答前不确定性检查"+分层记忆实现主动澄清，Macro准确率最高提升8.2点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式VQA需在严格时延与有限活跃上下文预算下实时推理。现有流式VLM在查询模糊、含错误前提或相关视觉证据已滑出活跃上下文时，常给出高置信但无依据的答案。主动澄清可缓解该问题，但必须满足同等时延与内存约束。

Method: 提出免训练框架StreamClarify：(1) 用二元"预作答判断"的熵作为轻量不确定性分数，决定直接作答还是请求澄清；(2) 为支持再作答，构建时间金字塔KV缓存以维持有界活跃视觉上下文，并配CPU侧语义检索归档以访问历史帧；(3) 构建诊断基准StreamClarify-QA，含1,837条QA对（取自StreamBench与OVO-Bench），覆盖标准、指代模糊、不可回答三类场景。

Result: 在三种VLM骨干上，Macro准确率较同骨干基线最高提升8.2点；在可比触发率下，基于熵的选择识别初始错误答案的精确率比随机选择高18点以上；在oracle用户引导下，澄清使Macro准确率最高提升3.5点；在Ambiguous QA上以Qwen3-VL进行受控oracle辅助模拟（生成式提问+仅指代式用户回复），熵门控条件准确率提升8.3点。

Conclusion: 以熵为门控的主动性澄清机制可在流式约束下有效提升答案可靠性与准确率，分层记忆设计支撑低成本再作答，为流式VLM的可信问答提供了可复用的免训练方案与诊断基准。

Abstract: Streaming video question answering (QA) requires real-time reasoning over continuous video streams under strict latency and active-context budgets. Current streaming vision-language models (VLMs) often give confident yet ungrounded answers when queries are ambiguous or have false premises, or when relevant visual evidence is no longer in the active context. Proactive clarification can help, but must satisfy the same latency and memory constraints. We present StreamClarify, a training-free framework for grounded streaming QA that combines a pre-answer uncertainty check with hierarchical memory. The check uses the entropy of a binary pre-answer judgment as a lightweight uncertainty score to decide whether to answer directly or request clarification. To support re-answering, a temporal-pyramid KV cache maintains a bounded active visual context, while a CPU-side semantic retrieval archive provides access to historical frames. We further construct StreamClarify-QA, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,837 QA pairs from StreamBench and OVO-Bench, spanning standard, referential ambiguity, and unanswerable scenarios. Across three VLM backbones, StreamClarify improves Macro accuracy by up to 8.2 points over backbone-matched baselines. At comparable trigger rates, entropy-based selection achieves more than 18 points higher precision than random selection in identifying initially incorrect answers. Under oracle user guidance, clarification improves Macro accuracy by up to 3.5 points. We also report a controlled, oracle-assisted Qwen3-VL simulation on Ambiguous QA with generated questions and referent-only user replies, where the entropy-gated condition improves accuracy by 8.3 points.

</details>


### [136] [Modeling Fat-shift for Improved Head Segmentation from MRI Scans using a Probabilistic Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01222)
*Merle Diedrichsen,Koen Van Leemput,Douglas N. Greve,Oula Puonti,Axel Thielscher*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FLOW概率模型，用变分推断在T1w MRI分割中显式建模脂肪化学位移伪影，校正全头分割并降低电场仿真偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: T1w MRI对颅内解剖对比度好，但颅骨密质骨几乎无信号，且脂肪组织存在化学位移伪影：海绵骨与皮下脂肪沿频率编码方向（常为上下方向）下移，使颅骨看起来变薄。现有分割方法未建模该伪影，导致颅骨与头皮标记不准确，进而给生物物理仿真引入偏差。

Method: 利用扫描参数可确定脂肪位移的方向与幅度，据此提出FLOW（Fat-shift-informed Label Optimization of the Whole head）：一个基于变分推断的概率模型，在分割头部与脑结构的同时显式建模脂肪位移伪影，从而恢复正确的颅外解剖。

Result: FLOW比不考虑位移的分割方法更准确地重建颅外解剖，同时在其他结构上保持高分割精度；基于FLOW位移校正的分割相比未建模位移的方法显著降低了电场仿真中的偏差。

Conclusion: 将扫描参数可推导的脂肪化学位移作为先验显式纳入变分分割框架，可有效校正T1w全头分割的颅骨/头皮偏差，提升个性化头模型在生物物理仿真中的准确性。

Abstract: Personalized computational head models for biophysical simulations rely on accurate whole-head segmentations from T1-weighted (T1w) magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans. While T1w scans provide excellent contrast for intracranial anatomy, extracerebral tissues have partly almost no signal (compact bone) and also suffer from the so-called chemical shift artifact, which affects the fatty tissues in MRI and causes them to spatially shift in the frequency encoding direction of the scan. This artifact occurs primarily in two structures of the head: the spongy bone, a fatty compartment inside the compact bone, and the subcutaneous fat, located directly underneath the skin. The frequency-encoding direction is often set in the superior-inferior direction, causing the fatty tissues to shift down and, as a result, making the skull appear thinner than it actually is. Existing segmentation methods do not model this artifact, consequently leading to inaccurate labeling of the skull and scalp, which introduces a bias in biophysical simulations. The direction and magnitude of the fat-shift can be determined from the scan parameters, thus making it possible to explicitly model the shift and to recover the correct anatomy. This study introduces a probabilistic model that uses variational inference to segment head and brain structures from a T1w scan while accounting for the fat-shift artifact. The proposed Fat-shift-informed Label Optimization of the Whole head (FLOW) method reconstructs extracerebral anatomy more accurately than a fat-shift-agnostic segmentation approach while maintaining high segmentation accuracy in all other structures. FLOW-based fat-shift corrected segmentations significantly reduce bias in electric field simulations compared to a segmentation method that does not model the shift.

</details>


### [137] [GESTALT: Fast, Generalizable Histopathology Image Synthesis from Gene Expression with Pretrained Pathology Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01141)
*Felix Ho,Alexandros Graikos,Dimitris Samaras*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GESTALT将基因表达→图像合成重构为预测病理基础模型图像嵌入的任务，用轻量基因token transformer预测嵌入并由冻结/LoRA扩散解码器渲染，训练成本大幅降低，在三个Xenium数据集上感知指标超越SoTA，并实现零样本跨面板/数据集迁移及细胞级转录场与组织图像的配对合成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间转录组保留了细胞在组织中的位置，但"给定转录组状态对应的形态学外貌"这一逆向问题探索不足；其价值在于可视化分子状态的形态学后果，并用真实组织结构解释空间检测的分子判定。现有SoTA GeneFlow在Xenium基因表达→图像基准上从零训练，每个新目标数据集都需高成本重训。

Method: 将基因表达到图像的合成重构为预测病理基础模型图像嵌入：轻量级基因token transformer从多细胞基因表达预测该嵌入；再由冻结或LoRA适配的扩散解码器（PixCell）渲染为图像。视觉知识被复用而非重新学习。原生支持1024×1024合成。结合空间表达的统计模型，实现细胞解析转录组场与组织图像的配对合成，并可显式控制细胞类型、密度与组成。

Result: 在多细胞与单细胞两种设置下，于全部三个Xenium数据集的感知指标上均优于SoTA；训练时间仅为现有方法的一小部分；原生1024×1024合成；在三种泛化设置下评估：跨基因面板与数据集的零样本迁移、留出患者与疾病状态、跨研究与组织来源迁移。

Conclusion: 复用病理基础模型的视觉知识可显著降低基因表达→图像合成的训练开销并提升图像质量与泛化性；GESTALT首次（据作者所知）实现具细胞类型、密度、组成显式控制的细胞级转录组场与组织图像配对合成。

Abstract: Spatial transcriptomics measures gene expression while preserving where each cell sits in the tissue. The inverse, what a given transcriptomic state looks like, is less explored but equally useful: it lets researchers visualize the morphological consequence of a molecular state and interpret a spatial assay's molecular calls against real tissue structure. GeneFlow, the current state of the art on the Xenium gene expression-to-image benchmark, trains a model from scratch, incurring a high cost on every new target dataset it is applied to. We instead propose GESTALT, which reformulates gene expression-to-image synthesis as predicting a pathology foundation model's image embedding. A lightweight gene-token transformer predicts this embedding from multi-cell gene expression, and a frozen or LoRA-adapted diffusion decoder (PixCell) renders it as an image. Because this visual knowledge is reused rather than relearned, GESTALT trains in a fraction of the time. In both multi-cell and single-cell settings, our method outperforms the SoTA on perceptual metrics across all three Xenium datasets. Beyond improved image quality, GESTALT natively synthesizes at 1024 x 1024, and is evaluated in three generalization settings: zero-shot transfer across gene panels and datasets, held-out patients and disease states, and transfer across studies and tissue sources. Coupled with a statistical model of spatial expression, GESTALT also provides, to our knowledge, the first paired synthesis of cell-resolved transcriptomic fields and tissue images with explicit control over cell type, density, and composition. Code is available at https://github.com/trongnhandev1011/Gestalt.

</details>


### [138] [Grounding Across Views: Cross-View Referring Reasoning for Visual Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01074)
*Hao Gan,Liuqian Wang,Shuang Li,Yufei Gao,Wentao Chao,Chong Fu,Chengming Liu,Lei Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出跨视角视觉定位(CVVG)新任务，将点/框提示的CVOGL扩展为语言指代+视觉样例联合引导的实例定位，并提出视角感知框架GAV与新基准CVOGL-Text。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨视角物体定位(CVOGL)仅用点击点或边界框指定目标，忽略了自然语言蕴含的语义属性与关系；且指代表达常依赖查询视角，难以直接在卫星图中落地。

Method: 形式化CVVG任务；提出GAV框架，核心为视角感知指代推理：从带标注的查询图像生成以目标为中心的描述、校验目标类别一致性、加入无方向角色线索，并结合样例提示、跨视角对齐与场景级判别将语义证据锚定到卫星实例。

Result: MoP-UAV上Acc@0.5达62.55%为新SOTA；在新建CVOGL-Text基准的街景与无人机视角划分上，较点击点基线分别提升7.09与6.79 Acc@0.25。

Conclusion: 语言-视觉联合引导的跨视角定位优于纯视觉提示，且对更大视角差异更鲁棒；代码与标注将公开。

Abstract: Cross-view object geo-localization (CVOGL) aims to localize a target in a satellite image from an observation captured under another viewpoint. Existing methods typically specify the query with a click point or bounding box, marking the target region but underusing the semantic attributes and relations conveyed by natural language. Moreover, referring expressions are often viewpoint-dependent, making query-view descriptions difficult to ground directly in the satellite image. In this paper, we formulate cross-view visual grounding (CVVG), extending conventional point- or box-prompted CVOGL to instance grounding jointly guided by a referring expression and a visual exemplar.
