We present GAV (Grounding Across Views), a view-aware framework for selectively transferring visual and linguistic evidence across views. Its core is view-aware referring reasoning: target-centered descriptions are derived from the marked query image, checked for target-category consistency, and augmented with a direction-free role cue. Exemplar prompting, cross-view alignment, and scene-level discrimination ground this semantic evidence in a satellite instance. GAV achieves a new state of the art on MoP-UAV with 62.55% Acc@0.5. We also introduce CVOGL-Text, a benchmark for text-guided grounding from street- and drone-view queries to satellite images. GAV outperforms the click-point baseline by 7.09 and 6.79 Acc@0.25 points on the street- and drone-view splits, respectively, demonstrating robustness to larger viewpoint gaps. The code and annotations will be publicly released.

</details>


### [139] [4K Image Super-Resolution on Mobile NPUs: Mobile AI 2026 Challenge Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00963)
*Andrey Ignatov,Georgy Perevozchikov,Radu Timofte,Fubin Ren,Shihao Wang,Liwen Zhang,Zhe Xu,Zhipei Lei,Minjian Zhang,Kailing Tang,Dingyong Gou,Yanlin Wu,Cong Li,Xiaohui Cui,Kihwan Yoon,Ganzorig Gankhuyag,Heo MyeongCheol,Yonghyun Park,Juho Jung,Sungjei Kim,Phuong-Nam Nguyen-Pham,Nam-Tien Le,Tinh-Anh Nguyen-Nhu,Matin Fazel,Abdelhak Bentaleb,Xinrui Li,Xusheng He,Jianlong Wu,Mohsin Ikram,Dmitry Ignatov,Hao Chen,Long Sun,Jiangxin Dong,Jinshan Pan,Jinhui Tang,Siyue Teng,Yuxuan Jiang,Fan Zhang,David Bull,Zhe Xiao,Jun Xiao,Zhi-Song Liu,Jiayi Pei,Songtao Wu,Hong Shang,Kuanhong Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文是Mobile AI挑战赛的报告论文，目标是在高通与联发科移动NPU上实现从Full HD到4K（3倍）的高效图像超分辨率，最优方案可在5毫秒内重建4K图像并达到约30 dB PSNR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动设备上图像超分辨率需求广泛，需要既高性能又能在多数移动/IoT芯片的NPU上部署的深度学习模型，因此设立该竞赛以推动高效方案设计。

Method: 基于DIV2K数据集训练3倍上采样模型；设两条赛道：赛道一要求全整数量化（INT8），在高通Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 NPU上评测运行时间；赛道二为浮点方案，在联发科Dimensity 9500 NPU上评测。

Result: 顶尖方案可在5毫秒以内重建4K图像，PSNR约达30 dB。

Conclusion: 论文系统描述了参赛所开发的各类模型，展示了移动NPU上实时高质量超分辨率的可行性。

Abstract: Image super-resolution is widely used on mobile devices for upscaling various types of image data. This creates a need for efficient deep learning-based models that are not only performant but can also be deployed on neural processing units (NPUs) present in the majority of mobile and IoT chipsets. In this Mobile AI challenge, we address this problem and propose the participants to design fast solutions that can upsample images from Full HD to 4K resolution while running on popular mobile NPUs from Qualcomm and MediaTek. For this, the participants were provided with the DIV2K dataset and trained models to do an efficient 3X image upscaling. The competition had two tracks: in the first track, the models had to be fully quantized (INT8), and the runtime of all models was evaluated on the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 NPU. In the second track, the participants were developing floating-point solutions that were evaluated on the MediaTek Dimensity 9500 NPU. Top solutions proposed in this challenge are able to reconstruct 4K images under 5 milliseconds while reaching a PSNR score of 30 dB. A comprehensive description of the models developed in the challenge is provided in this paper.

</details>


### [140] [UI-UG 2: Advancing Mobile UI Understanding and Generation with Fine-Grained Supervision and Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00926)
*Hao Yang,Shuoyang Liu,Xiaoyu Lin,Zhou Fang,Maji Huang,Zhaosong Huang,Ruichao Mao,Teng Guo,Hai Rao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UI-UG 2 是一个 4B 参数的紧凑多模态大模型，通过前端对齐的 80 类两级 UI 分类体系、多源理解语料与 5000+ 需求-截图-JSON 三元组，结合分解式理解奖励与基于 Playwright 渲染的在线 GRPO 生成优化，在参考/密集定位与结构化 UI 生成任务上取得同规模最优表现，并揭示理解到生成的一致迁移效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动 UI 理解与生成同时需要细粒度组件感知与可靠的结构化合成；前作 UI-UG 虽提出统一方向，但任务覆盖有限、分类体系与前端口径不一致，且生成优化依赖离线的 DPO 式偏好优化，缺乏真实渲染反馈。

Method: 1) 构建来自 RICO、VINS、Android in the Wild、Android Control 的多源理解语料，标注为与前端组件语义对齐的 80 类两级 UI 分类体系；2) 配套 5000+ 需求-截图-JSON 三元组，经 DSL 实现渐进式结构化 UI 生成；3) 理解侧引入分解奖励（类别预测、OCR 保真、颜色识别、密集定位、GUI 定位）；4) 生成侧用端到端在线 GRPO 替代离线 DPO，采样 DSL 输出经 Playwright 服务端管线渲染，并由 LLM-as-a-Judge 与对比偏好排序评估。

Result: 在自建 80 类基准上，参考表达（referring）与密集定位（dense grounding）结果优于所评估模型；在 4B 紧凑规模下取得对比模型中最优的综合生成得分；并且在固定训练预算下，加入细粒度 UI 感知监督可稳定提升生成质量，呈现理解到生成的迁移。

Conclusion: 前端对齐的组件级语义可作为理解与生成共享的表征基础；渲染感知的在线强化学习与分解式感知奖励是提升紧凑 MLLM 移动 UI 能力的有效路径。

Abstract: Mobile UI understanding and generation require both fine-grained component perception and reliable structured synthesis. Inspired by the unified direction introduced by UI-UG, we present UI-UG 2, a compact 4B-parameter multimodal large language model (MLLM) that advances mobile UI Understanding and Generation with broader task coverage, a front-end-aligned taxonomy, and online render-aware reinforcement learning. UI-UG 2 constructs a multi-source understanding corpus from RICO, VINS, Android in the Wild, and Android Control, annotated with an 80-category two-level UI taxonomy aligned with front-end component semantics, and pairs it with over 5,000 requirement-screenshot-JSON tuples for progressive structured UI generation through a domain-specific language (DSL). For understanding, UI-UG 2 introduces decomposed rewards for category prediction, OCR fidelity, color recognition, dense grounding, and GUI grounding. Unlike the offline Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)-style generation optimization in UI-UG, UI-UG 2 optimizes generation through end-to-end online Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO): sampled DSL outputs are rendered with a Playwright-based server-side pipeline and evaluated using LLM-as-a-Judge and contrastive preference ranking. Experiments show that UI-UG 2 achieves the strongest referring and dense-grounding results among the evaluated models on our 80-category benchmark, and achieves the best composite generation score among compared models at a compact scale (4B). More importantly, we observe a consistent understanding-to-generation transfer: adding fine-grained UI perception supervision improves generation quality under a fixed training budget, suggesting that component-level semantics provide a shared representational foundation for both tasks.

</details>


### [141] [Multimodal BVP and Respiration for Automated Pain Recognition with Hankel-FCN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01978)
*Valentina Becchetti,Muhammad Umar Khan,Stefanos Gkikas,Alessandro Giuseppi,Raul Fernandez Rojas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于BVP与呼吸信号的深度学习框架用于客观疼痛评估，将信号经Hankel矩阵嵌入转为轨迹表示，由模态专属全卷积网络处理并晚期融合实现三类（无痛/低痛/高痛）分类，准确率67.09%、F1 66.41%，无需手工特征工程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 疼痛具有主观性与动态性，自动化疼痛识别是临床护理与共情式人机交互的关键挑战，需要客观、无需手工特征工程的评估方法。

Method: 基于AI4Pain数据集的BVP与RESP多模态生理信号；用Hankel矩阵嵌入将信号转换为结构化轨迹表示以刻画时序动态；各模态由专属全卷积网络处理；采用晚期融合进行三分类。

Result: 准确率67.09%、F1 66.41%，与现有方法相比具竞争力；多模态融合显著优于单一模态；Hankel嵌入呈现进一步提升的趋势。

Conclusion: 多模态生理信号结合Hankel轨迹嵌入与全卷积网络可实现无手工特征的客观疼痛分级；泛化到更广泛人群与临床场景仍需进一步验证。

Abstract: Automated pain recognition is a fundamental challenge for the advancement of clinical care and empathetic human-computer interaction, due to the subjective and dynamic nature of pain. In this study, we propose a deep learning framework for objective pain assessment based on multimodal physiological signals from the AI4Pain dataset. The approach focuses on Blood Volume Pulse (BVP) and Respiration (RESP), capturing complementary aspects of autonomic responses to nociceptive stimulation. To explicitly model their temporal dynamics, the signals are transformed into structured trajectory representations using Hankel matrix embeddings, enabling the learning of dynamical patterns beyond conventional time-series representations. These embeddings are processed by modality-specific Fully Convolutional Networks, and their outputs are integrated through a late fusion strategy for three-class classification (No Pain, Low Pain, High Pain). Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves an accuracy of 67.09% and an F1-score of 66.41%, providing competitive performance compared to existing approaches, while relying on no handcrafted feature engineering. Multimodal fusion significantly outperformed either modality alone, and the Hankel embedding showed a trend towards further improvement. Further validation is required to establish generalisability to broader populations and clinical settings.

</details>


### [142] [Knowledge-Guided Floodwater Level Reasoning for Cloud-Edge Collaborative Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01970)
*Zhengshu Zhou,Shaoyu Wang,Ziyi Geng,Lu Tao,Qian Long*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出HydroReasoner——基于Qwen2.5-VL与GRPO训练的云边协同积水水位显式视觉推理框架，结合HydroKG知识图谱路径奖励、4-bit量化与置信度路由机制，在自建HydroLevel数据集上显著优于传统视觉基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市积水威胁智能交通系统安全与效率。现有视觉水位检测方法存在两大局限：(1) 缺乏显式推理，检测性能差且可解释性低；(2) 难以泛化到多视角、复杂的真实道路场景。

Method: 将任务重构为显式视觉推理问题；以Qwen2.5-VL为基座，采用Group Relative Policy Optimization训练；构建积水领域知识图谱HydroKG，设计基于确定性图遍历的KG路径奖励，对推理过程进行细粒度监督；边缘部署采用4-bit量化；提出基于置信度的云边路由机制；构建3000张图像的HydroLevel基准数据集。

Result: 域内与域外检测准确率分别比传统视觉基线高4.0与13.6个百分点，域外性能仅下降4.4个百分点；4-bit量化使GPU显存降低57%、推理时延降低43%，域外准确率仅降0.2个百分点。

Conclusion: 显式视觉推理+知识图谱奖励监督可同时提升积水水位检测的准确性与跨场景泛化性，配合量化与云边路由实现安全、低负载的边缘部署。

Abstract: Frequent urban floodwater poses a serious threat to the safety and efficiency of intelligent transportation systems. Existing vision-based methods for floodwater level detection face two main limitations. First, the lack of explicit reasoning leads to poor detection performance and little interpretability. Second, these methods struggle to generalize to the complex and varied real-world road scenes seen from different viewpoints. To address this, we reformulate the task as an explicit visual reasoning problem and propose HydroReasoner, a floodwater level reasoning framework designed for cloud-edge collaboration. HydroReasoner builds on Qwen2.5-VL and is trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization. To address the scarcity of reasoning process annotations, we build a floodwater domain knowledge graph HydroKG and design a novel KG path reward. Through deterministic graph traversal over HydroKG, this reward supervises the model's reasoning process at a fine granularity, which improves both reasoning and generalization. For edge deployment, we apply 4-bit quantization to the model, cutting GPU memory usage by 57% and inference latency by 43% while out-of-domain accuracy drops by only 0.2 percentage points. We also propose a confidence-based cloud-edge routing mechanism, which improves system safety and eases the computational load on the cloud. In addition, we build HydroLevel, a floodwater benchmark dataset of 3,000 images, for training and evaluating the model. Experimental results show that HydroReasoner achieves detection accuracy 4.0 and 13.6 percentage points higher than conventional vision baselines in the in-domain and out-of-domain evaluations respectively, with performance dropping by only 4.4 percentage points out of domain.

</details>


### [143] [Event-Based Optical Flow Constraint via Time-Sliced Plane Fitting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01960)
*Masaki Koike,Yusuke Kameda,Shunichi Sato,Takayuki Hamamoto*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出沿时间轴扩展平面近似的事件相机光流估计方法，可在变分框架中建模运动的时间变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于时空平面近似的事件光流估计隐含假设速度恒定，会将时间上的速度变化平均化，导致快速变速运动下估计失真。

Method: 将平面近似沿时间轴扩展，推导出可嵌入现有变分光流公式的事件光流约束；把时空体划分为子区间并采用两步平面近似以一致地跟踪物体边缘；引入空间补偿机制修正边缘位移，并加入时间正则项稳定流量估计。

Result: 实验表明，建模时间运动变化相比传统常速假设方法提升了光流估计精度。

Conclusion: 沿时间轴扩展平面近似可有效表达运动的时间变化，所提约束与补偿、正则项设计提升了事件光流估计的准确性与稳定性。

Abstract: Event-based optical flow estimation using spatiotemporal planar approximation inherently assumes constant velocity and tends to average out temporal velocity variations. In this paper, we propose a flow estimation method that extends this planar approximation along the temporal axis. The resulting event-based optical flow constraint allows existing variational optical flow formulations to model temporal motion variation. Specifically, we partition the space-time volume into sub-intervals and apply a two-step planar approximation to track object edges consistently. Moreover, a spatial compensation mechanism and a temporal regularization term are incorporated to compensate for edge displacements and temporally stabilize the flow estimation, respectively. The experimental results show that modeling temporal motion variation improves flow estimation accuracy over conventional methods.

</details>


### [144] [Training-Free Motion-Corrected 3D Brain MRI Reconstruction via Event-Guided References](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01902)
*Wei Jiang,Hongli Chen,Tianyi Ding,Feng Liu,Nan Ye,Hongfu Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 EventMC，一种无需训练的事件引导运动校正方法，用于交错笛卡尔采集的 3D 脑 MRI，通过检测运动事件并用稳定区间重建的参考图像估计运动，从低频到高频迭代细化图像与运动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 头部运动在 3D 脑 MRI 中产生伪影并偏倚结构测量。基于模型的校正在图像与运动估计间交替迭代，但重建参考中的伪影会强化运动误差；学习型先验虽可减少伪影，却需要预训练并可能增加测试时计算量。

Method: EventMC 为训练-free 方法：交替（1）检测运动事件，（2）利用由稳定区间重建的参考图像估计运动，（3）按低到高空间频率逐步细化图像与运动估计。

Result: 在相同重建的公平仿真对比中，EventMC 的运动估计相比学习型 MotionTTT 将平均 PSNR 提升至多 4.0 dB；单次运行速度最快为 MotionTTT 的 7.5 倍，GPU 显存占用不到其一半。在真实运动损坏的在体扫描上，无需任何训练即可达到与 MotionTTT 相近的平均图像质量。

Conclusion: EventMC 以无须训练、低显存、高效率的方式实现与学习型方法相当甚至更优的运动校正效果，为运动鲁棒的 3D 脑 MRI 提供了实用替代方案。

Abstract: Head motion causes artefacts in 3D brain MRI and can bias structural measurements. Model-based correction alternates between image and motion estimation, but artefacts in the reconstructed reference can reinforce motion errors. Learned priors can reduce these artefacts but require pretraining and may add test-time computation. We propose EventMC (event-guided motion correction), a training-free method for interleaved Cartesian acquisitions. It iteratively detects motion events and estimates motion using reference images reconstructed from stable intervals. It then refines the image and motion from low to high spatial frequencies. In a fair comparison in simulation (same reconstruction), EventMC's motion estimates improve mean PSNR by up to 4.0 dB over those of the learning-based MotionTTT. A single run of EventMC is up to 7.5 times faster than MotionTTT with less than half the GPU memory. On in vivo motion-corrupted scans, EventMC achieves similar mean image quality to MotionTTT without any training. Code is available at https://github.com/bayesbreeze/EventMC.

</details>


### [145] [Prior-Guided Physics-Informed Deep Learning for Fast 4D MRI Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01888)
*Mojtaba Safari,Parag J. Parikh,Shansong Wang,Mingzhe Hu,Philip Connell,Stanley L. Liauw,Ralph R. Weichselbaum,Zhen Tian,Xiaofeng Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PGPI4MR 是一种先验引导、物理信息驱动的 4D MRI 深度学习重建方法，利用其他呼吸相位或前 30 s 设置扫描信息，在不增加扫描时间的前提下实现秒级、更高精度的 4D 与亚秒级 MRI 重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 4D MRI 在 MR 引导放疗中用于治疗计划与三维运动监测，但需在有限扫描时间内获得高时空分辨率的重建。作者希望借助已有相位间信息与设置扫描（同一扫描前 30 s）作为先验，在不延长扫描时间的情况下提升重建质量。

Method: 提出 PGPI4MR：一个展开式（unrolled）网络，将先验信息与物理模型（k 空间数据一致性）结合。可从 60、30 或 15 s 数据重建 16 个呼吸相位，也可从 0.29–0.49 s 数据重建单个 3D 体，并以设置扫描图像作为先验。网络在其他志愿者数据上一次性训练，不再针对新志愿者重新训练。在三个数据集的实测 k 空间上评估：自由呼吸 MR-linac（1.5T）、腹部（3T）扫描及袖带压迫大腿扫描（1.5T）；所有方法（含对照模型）使用相同样本并以相同方式评分。

Result: 体内实验中，PGPI4MR 在各扫描时长下的留出误差最低；在两块 GPU 上，16 个相位可在扫描结束后中位数 7.5–13 s 内完成。耦合 16 个呼吸相位使 60 s 数据误差较逐相位独立重建降低 9.1%。亚秒 MRI 中，0.49 s 处误差比最佳对照方法（面向同一先验的经典重建）低 15.5%；在较快 GPU 上，每个 0.29 s 窗口的采集与重建均在 0.5 s 内完成。未重新训练时，在 3T 腹部扫描上与最佳方法相当，但大腿扫描不及；在大腿数据上重新训练后，留出误差较最佳对照方法降低 6.6%。

Conclusion: 先验信息使 PGPI4MR 在数秒内、无额外扫描时间的情况下，比压缩感知和已发表的 4D 网络更准确地重建 4D 与亚秒级 MRI，有望支持 MR 引导放疗中的 4D MRI 治疗计划与三维运动监测。

Abstract: Background and purpose: We propose PGPI4MR (prior-guided, physics-informed 4D MRI reconstruction), a deep learning method that leverages information from other respiratory phases or a setup scan, the first 30 s of the same scan, to improve 4D MRI reconstruction without extra scan time. Materials and methods: PGPI4MR is an unrolled network that reconstructs 16 respiratory phases from 60, 30, or 15 s of data, and single 3D volumes, each from 0.29-0.49 s of data, using a setup-scan image. The networks were trained once, on other volunteers, and were not retrained for new volunteers. We evaluated PGPI4MR on measured k-space from three datasets: free-breathing MR-linac (1.5T) and abdominal (3T) scans, and thigh scans with cuff compression (1.5T). All methods, including comparative models, received identical samples and were scored similarly. Results: In vivo, PGPI4MR had the lowest held-out error for 4D MRI at every scan time, and its 16 phases were ready a median of 7.5-13 s after the scan on the 2 GPUs tested. Coupling the 16 respiratory phases reduced the error at 60 s by 9.1% compared with reconstructing each phase alone. For sub-second MRI, the error at 0.49 s was 15.5% lower than that of the best comparison method, classical reconstruction toward the same prior, and on the faster GPU, every 0.29 s window was acquired and reconstructed within 0.5 s. Without retraining, PGPI4MR matched the best methods on the 3T abdominal scans but not on the thigh scans; after retraining on thigh data, it reduced the held-out error by 6.6% relative to the best comparison method. Conclusion: Prior information allowed PGPI4MR to reconstruct 4D and sub-second MRI more accurately than compressed sensing and a published 4D network, within seconds and without extra scan time. This could support 4D MRI for treatment planning and 3D motion monitoring during MR-guided radiotherapy.

</details>


### [146] [Z-Cache: Accelerating Diffusion Transformers via Self-Reflection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01846)
*Zegang Cheng,Zhikai Wang,Jiacheng Liu,Xiaobing Tu,Chang Zou,Junjie Chen,Yue Ma,Zhiyuan Ma,Jinkui Ren,Likai Zou,Linfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Z-Cache：通过“自反思”机制改进扩散Transformer特征缓存的生成质量，在FLUX-dev上实现6.22倍加速且质量接近原模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散Transformer在视觉生成中效果强大但计算开销巨大。特征缓存通过复用前序步骤特征实现加速，却导致生成质量下降，本文旨在解决该质量退化问题。

Method: 观察到特征缓存误差在每次完整计算后急剧下降，据此设计Z-Cache：先预测未来缓存步的特征，再执行一次完整计算；随后返回缓存步，基于前序与当前计算步重新预测，从而对特征进行校正（自反思）。

Result: 在扩散Transformer上，Z-Cache达到与原模型相当的生成质量，同时推理速度更快，例如FLUX-dev文生图任务上6.22倍加速。

Conclusion: Z-Cache以特征预测—完整计算—重预测的反思式缓存策略，有效缓解缓存带来的质量退化，兼顾质量与加速，代码已开源。

Abstract: Diffusion transformers have become the most powerful models for visual generation, but still suffer from massive computation costs. To solve this problem, feature caching has been proposed to cache the features of diffusion models in the previous computation steps and then reuse them in the following caching steps, which brings significant acceleration but also degradation in generation quality. To address this problem, this paper proposes Z-cache as a feature caching method that can maintain high-quality generation through self-reflection. Concretely, we observe that the error from feature caching tends to be sharply reduced after each full computation. Based on this observation, Z-Cache is designed to first predict the features in the future caching steps and then perform a full computation. After that, Z-Cache returns to the caching steps and re-predicts them based on the previous and the current computation steps, which brings correction in features. Experiments demonstrate that with Z-Cache, diffusion transformers achieve comparable generation quality to the original model but with faster inference speed, for instance, 6.22X acceleration on FLUX-dev for text-to-image generation. Our code is released on GitHub.

</details>


### [147] [LUMEN: Geometry-Guided Diffusion Model for Spatially-Varying HDR Illumination Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01823)
*Hongze Chen,Fangyu Lin,Runze Zhang,Lingting Zhu,Weikai Chen,Zeyu Hu,Yingda Yin,Keyang Luo,Xin Wang,Zehong Lin,Jun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LUMEN：以生成式视角、几何条件化的扩散框架，从单/多视图图像在任意空间位置合成HDR环境贴图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光照本质上是空间变化的（受几何、遮挡与光源影响），而现有方法依赖局部环境贴图或探针表示并用回归/参数模型求解，导致光照过度平滑、真实感有限。

Method: 重建粗略3D场景，在任意位置渲染部分环境贴图以编码可见性与空间结构；将其与多视图图像特征融合，输入扩散Transformer生成完整HDR环境贴图；并构建含700个室内场景、带多视图RGB、深度及多采样位置HDR光照的稠密空间监督合成数据集用于训练。

Result: 大量实验表明，LUMEN在视觉保真度和空间一致性上显著优于已有方法。

Conclusion: 将空间变化光照估计重构为条件生成问题可有效缓解平滑化问题，实现更真实且空间连贯的HDR光照估计。

Abstract: Estimating scene illumination from images is challenging as lighting is inherently spatially varying, depending on geometry, occlusion, and light sources. Existing methods incorporate geometric cues by deriving local environment maps or probe-based representations, but largely rely on regression or parametric models, resulting in over-smoothed lighting and limited realism. We revisit spatially-varying illumination estimation from a generative perspective and introduce LUMEN, a geometry-conditioned diffusion framework for synthesizing high-dynamic-range (HDR) environment maps at arbitrary spatial locations from single or multi-view images. Specifically, we reconstruct a coarse 3D scene from input images and render partial environment maps at arbitrary locations to encode visibility and spatial structure. These signals are fused with multi-view image features and fed into a diffusion transformer to generate full HDR environment maps. To train the model, we build a synthetic dataset of 700 indoor scenes with dense spatial supervision, including multi-view RGB images, depth, and HDR illumination at multiple sampled locations. This dataset enables the model to learn spatially consistent lighting distributions across diverse scenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LUMEN significantly improves visual fidelity and spatial coherence compared to prior approaches.

</details>


### [148] [FinishStrong: Learning to End Well after Imperfect Start in Video Temporal Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01765)
*Yuda Zou,Boxiang Zhou,Xin Zhou,Yibo Chen,Dejia Song,Xu Tang,Yao Hu,Yongchao Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文发现自回归视频时序定位存在"终点性能不对称"（终点预测显著差于起点），提出两阶段后训练框架FinishStrong（Online-start SFT + Conditional-tree GRPO）来教会模型在给定欠佳起点下做条件最优的终点续接，在TimeLens-Bench取得61.7% IoU的SOTA，并将不良起点后的终点预测误差降低36.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频时序定位模型系统性地出现端点性能不对称：终点预测精度显著低于起点。一旦起点出错，其作为不可更改的物理约束会不可逆地压低可达重叠度（沉没损失）。理想情况下模型应最小化剩余的条件遗憾（即在给定差起点下做到最好的终点），但现有后训练范式无法教会这种适应能力：教师强制SFT存在严格前缀暴露偏差；标准GRPO对整个轨迹做整体评估，会在差起点之后反而惩罚那些条件最优的终点。

Method: 提出两阶段后训练框架FinishStrong。第一阶段Online-start SFT：让终点预测暴露于模型自身生成的上下文（而非仅真实前缀），缓解前缀暴露偏差。第二阶段Conditional-tree GRPO：重构采样拓扑，将终点奖励限定在同一开始分支内部进行中心化计算，从而在数学上将终点质量与继承的起点惩罚解耦，隔离出条件终点质量。

Result: FinishStrong-9B在TimeLens-Bench上取得61.7%的总体IoU，达到SOTA，超过Gemini-3.8-Flash、Qwen3.8-Max等旗舰闭源模型；在被迫从非完美起点续接时，后续终点预测误差降低36.5%。

Conclusion: "起点差会压低上限，但不否定善终的价值"：通过显式建模条件终点质量，FinishStrong证明模型可被训练为在既有错误起点约束下仍做出接近最优的终点预测，为自回归时序定位提供了一种针对端点不对称问题的有效后训练方案。代码将开源。

Abstract: A poor start lowers the ceiling, but does not negate the value of finishing well. In autoregressive video temporal grounding, models systematically exhibit an endpoint performance asymmetry, predicting ends significantly worse than starts. A committed flawed start acts as an immutable physical constraint, irreversibly capping the attainable overlap as a sunk loss. While models should minimize the remaining conditional regret, standard post-training paradigms fail to teach this adaptation. Specifically, teacher-forced SFT suffers from strict prefix exposure bias, and holistic trajectory evaluation in standard GRPO inadvertently penalizes conditionally optimal ends if they follow a poor start. To address this, we introduce FinishStrong, a novel two-stage post-training framework explicitly designed to teach optimal continuations. First, Online-start SFT exposes the end prediction to the model's own generated contexts. Second, Conditional-tree GRPO restructures the sampling topology, centering end rewards exclusively within the same-start branch to mathematically isolate the conditional end quality from the inherited start penalty. FinishStrong-9B achieves a state-of-the-art 61.7\% overall IoU on TimeLens-Bench, remarkably outperforming flagship closed-source models like Gemini-3.8-Flash and Qwen3.8-Max. Crucially, when forced to continue from imperfect starts, it reduces the subsequent end prediction error by 36.5\%, proving its exceptional ability to end well after flawed starts. Code will be open.

</details>


### [149] [Reproducing INP-Former: Reconstructing Intrinsic Normal Prototypes for Industrial Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01230)
*Yunfei Liang,Juan Pablo Osorio Rivera*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 复现INP-Former在多类工业异常检测中的核心主张：在MVTec AD/VisA上重现报告性能，并扩展至MVTec AD 2；消融表明性能主要来自INP机制，但默认6个原型设置在更难数据上不迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证INP-Former这一基于重建、无需memory bank的多类工业异常检测方法的结论是否稳健，特别是其默认超参（原型数量）与各组件贡献是否能在比原始基准更困难的数据上成立。

Method: 使用作者公开代码，从每张测试图像提取Intrinsic Normal Prototypes引导解码器重建正常特征；在MVTec AD与VisA上复现，并新增MVTec AD 2评测；在MVTec AD上做五种子消融（含禁用两项辅助损失的配对比较）；对比1–6个原型的数量效应；并测量分辨率、骨干规模、训练时长、LoRA适配等实用性权衡，按缺陷尺寸、光照条件及更严格AU-PRO限制分析性能。

Result: MVTec AD与VisA性能得以复现；MVTec AD 2默认设置图像AUROC为63.4，远低于MVTec AD的99.7；消融显示大部分性能来自INP机制，两项辅助损失影响小且方向随指标变化；配对实验确认INP在MVTec AD 2上的收益；原型数量在MVTec AD/VisA上超过4个后趋于平台，而在MVTec AD 2的公开与两个隐藏测试划分上单原型AU-PRO优于六原型。

Conclusion: 原文基于较易基准的若干结论（尤其默认原型数量）不能迁移到更难数据；需针对数据难度重新设定原型数与配置，且INP机制是主要性能来源。

Abstract: We reproduce the central claims of INP-Former, a reconstruction-based method for multi-class industrial anomaly detection. INP-Former extracts Intrinsic Normal Prototypes (INPs) from each test image and uses them to guide a decoder that reconstructs normal features, without a stored memory bank. Using the authors' released code, we reproduce the reported performance on MVTec AD and VisA and extend the evaluation to MVTec AD 2, where image AUROC with the default settings is 63.4, compared with 99.7 on MVTec AD. On MVTec AD, a five-seed ablation shows that most of the performance comes from the INP mechanism, while the two auxiliary losses add small changes whose direction depends on the metric. A paired comparison with both losses disabled confirms the benefit of INP on MVTec AD 2. The default of six prototypes transfers less well: the plateau beyond four prototypes reproduces on MVTec AD and VisA, but on MVTec AD 2 a single prototype outperforms six in AU-PRO on the public split and on both hidden test splits. We also measure practical trade-offs in resolution, backbone size, training length, and LoRA adaptation, and examine performance by defect size, lighting condition, and a stricter AU-PRO limit. Several conclusions from the original benchmarks, including the default prototype count, do not carry over to harder data. Code: https://github.com/garasnote/Repro-INPFormer

</details>


### [150] [FilmTogether: Cinematic Video Generation from Low-Cost Inputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00899)
*Shiying Zhang,Xiaobin Hu,Qianchi Zhang,Jiaqi Zhao,Xiaoda Yang,Bo Yin,Shuicheng Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 CineCraft-120K 大规模低成本-高成本对齐视频配对数据集与双记忆特征适配器，实现从随手拍到电影级质感的低到高成本视频编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动设备普及使视频录制门槛降低，但随手低成本拍摄与高成本电影级制作之间存在明显审美鸿沟。弥合该鸿沟需在不改变原片布局、身份与运动的前提下升级光照、服饰、材质等制作元素。现有方法受两大瓶颈制约：1）缺乏专为复杂低→高外观迁移设计的高质量配对训练数据；2）忽视现有视频编辑模型对多重低成本构件的感知与增强能力。

Method: 数据层面：构建 CineCraft-120K，含对齐的低/高成本视频对及配对感知编辑提示；建立跨数十年影视制作的高分辨率高成本 "Cinematic Crafting" 数据池，划分为 5 大领域、23 个细粒度子类；提供低/高成本对应物之间的元素级映射与锚定结构布局的丰富文本提示。架构层面：提出简单有效的双记忆特征适配器——文本记忆扩展低→高外观变化的语义容量，提示记忆在上下文注入前提供高成本元素的逐层视觉特征校正。

Result: 大量实验与消融研究表明，CineCraft-120K 在低→高成本视频编辑任务上具有优越性，双记忆适配器亦被验证有效。

Conclusion: 通过配对数据构建与双记忆适配器设计，可有效弥合低成本与电影级视频之间的审美差距，在保持结构布局、身份与时间运动一致性的同时实现多元素制作升级。

Abstract: The widespread adoption of mobile devices has democratized video recording, but a stark aesthetic divide persists between casual, low-cost captures and high-cost cinematic productions. Bridging this gap requires upgrading heterogeneous production elements, such as lighting, specialized costumes, and materials, without altering the core layout, identity, and temporal motion of the original footage. However, this task is heavily bottlenecked by two important challenges: 1) Lacking a high-quality paired training data specifically designed to handle complex low-to-high appearance shifts. 2) Ignoring the capacity of current video editing models to perceive and enhance the multiple low-cost compositions. To address these issues, we present CineCraft-120K, a large-scale dataset of aligned low- and high-cost video pairs annotated with pair-aware editing prompts. CineCraft-120K features a diverse, high-resolution and high-cost Cinematic Crafting bank spanning decades of media production, meticulously taxonomized into 5 broad domains and 23 fine-grained sub-categories. It also provides element-level mapping between low- and high-cost counterparts, offering pair-aware rich textual prompts that precisely detail the required aesthetic transformations while anchoring structural layout. Architecturally, we propose a simple yet effective dual-memory feature adapter, where a text-memory expands semantic capacity for low2high appearance changes, and a hint memory supplies layer-wise visual feature corrections of high-cost element before context injection. Extensive experiments and ablation studies demonstrate the superiority of CineCraft-120K for low-to-high-cost video editing, alongside the effectiveness of our dual-memory adapter.

</details>


### [151] [Fewer Tokens, More Answers: Verifiable-Reward Tuning of an Ornith-Style VLM for Multi-View Driving QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00833)
*T N Rickesh,Pranav Vinodh,Sowmya Kamath S*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在256 token上限下，GRPO将可提取率从78.25%提升至90.25%、准确率从55.50%提升至63.75%，但增益主要来自把"无法提取"的回复转为可提取答案；512 token下首个pass的准确率增益仅+0.75pp。全量2,511题上平均生成token由108.6降至47.1，而配对准确率区间包含零增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理型模型衍生物必须在部署预算内把中间思考转化为可用答案；作者希望刻画这一"从推理到答案交付"的转换过程，并检验以可验证奖励做强化学习（GRPO）是否主要改善答案交付而非推理能力本身。

Method: 在多摄像头驾驶问答任务上对Ornith检查点做GRPO适配（可验证奖励）。采用配对存档输出对比基座与适配器：400题开发筛选集、256 token上限下统计答案提取率与准确率；对错误→正确样本做逐例归类；在512 token下做检查点验证的重构实验；另设"答案提示续写"（answer-cued continuation）对照；最后在2,511题全量开发集上评估recovery-enabled流水线的token消耗与配对准确率。

Result: 256 token下提取率78.25%→90.25%，准确率55.50%→63.75%；39个错误→正确转换中33个始于基座不可提取回复；基座87个不可提取回复全部触顶。512 token下首个pass准确率增益仅+0.75pp（对比256 token的+8.25pp）。答案提示续写对基座帮助更大、缩小适配器差距。全量集上平均生成token 108.6→47.1，配对准确率区间含零。

Conclusion: 作者将结论定位为"有限预算下答案交付的适配"：GRPO的收益主要是把触顶的、不可提取的思考压缩为可用答案，而非提升推理质量；结果仅针对Ornith，不构成共享架构机制或跨模型迁移的证据，并明确承认选择偏差与出处（provenance）限制。

Abstract: Reasoning-enabled model derivatives must turn intermediate deliberation into a usable answer within a deployment budget. We study that transition in an Ornith checkpoint adapted to multi-camera driving question answering with verifiable rewards. Paired archived outputs show that, on a selected 400-question development screen with a 256-token cap, GRPO increases answer extraction from 78.25% to 90.25% and accuracy from 55.50% to 63.75%. Of 39 wrong-to-correct transitions, 33 begin with an unextractable base response. The base's 87 unextractable responses all reach the token cap. Checkpoint-verified reconstruction on those same questions gives a much smaller first-pass accuracy gain at 512 tokens: +0.75 percentage points, versus +8.25 at 256. A later answer-cued continuation is analyzed separately; it helps the base more and narrows the adapter difference. On the full 2,511-question development set, this recovery-enabled pipeline reduces mean generated tokens from 108.6 to 47.1, while the paired accuracy interval includes zero gain. We frame these findings as adaptation of answer delivery under finite budgets, with explicit selection and provenance limits. Ornith's self-scaffolding lineage and newer reasoning-enabled derivatives such as Bonsai motivate the problem, but our measured results concern Ornith alone and do not establish a shared architectural mechanism or cross-model transfer.

</details>


### [152] [Answer Correction with Verifiable Rewards: A Gemma-Family Study of Multi-View Driving QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00828)
*T N Rickesh,Pranav Vinodh,Sowmya Kamath S*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文研究多摄像头驾驶问答中后训练增益究竟来自"改变所选答案"还是"改进答案抽取"，基于WaymoQA对Gemma系列做受控诊断，发现12B的GRPO配对增益为+1.65pp但主要来自选择而非抽取，且存在安全类别的非对称性能退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多摄像头驾驶问答常被当作视觉语言模型的离散测试，但后训练后的准确率提升难以区分两种来源：模型选择了不同答案，还是模型更好地把已有知识抽取/表达为可解析答案。若不区分二者，可能把格式合规性改善误读为视觉推理能力提升。

Method: 使用存档的、与任务关联的WaymoQA评测做零样本诊断（5,519题），覆盖effective-small、MoE、unified与dense检查点，并披露服务差异而不将其解释为架构效应。核心证据为同构评测框架下Gemma-4-12B的base/GRPO配对比较，采用场景簇自助法（scene-cluster bootstrap）估计置信区间；将正确性与可抽取状态交叉制表，区分"正确但格式不合规"与预测错误；并按类别统计增益与退化。另对存档的Gemma-31B thinking配置做对照。

Result: 12B配对准确率由73.78%升至75.43%（+1.65pp，场景簇自助区间[+0.84,+2.41]）。共215项改善、124项退化；其中213项改善源自"基础模型答案可抽取但错误"，仅2项挽救了此前不可抽取的回答。类别计数显示安全非对称性：常规感知类提升+5.93pp，而安全关键的危险预测类下降-1.82pp。31B thinking比较未检出平均提升，但其不确定性不足以确立等价性。奖励饱和被解释为采样训练动力学而非架构上限。

Conclusion: 结果支持在记录的调参配置下存在适度的"答案选择"增益，并提供可复现的诊断性核算方法；作者不将纠正后的标签归因于特定grounding机制，也不宣称优于匹配的监督式微调。

Abstract: Multi-camera driving question answering provides a discrete test of vision-language models, but post-training gains can reflect changed selected answers or improved answer extraction. We investigate this distinction within the Gemma model family using archived, task-linked WaymoQA evaluations. A zero-shot diagnostic on 5,519 test questions spans effective-small, mixture-of-experts, unified, and dense checkpoints, with serving differences disclosed rather than interpreted as architecture effects. The strongest controlled evidence is a matched-harness Gemma-4-12B base/GRPO pair: accuracy rises from 73.78% to 75.43%, a gain of 1.65 percentage points with a scene-cluster bootstrap interval of [+0.84, +2.41]. There are 215 improvements and 124 regressions; 213 improvements start from an extractable but incorrect base answer, and only two recover previously unextractable responses. Crossing correctness with extraction state shows why correct noncompliant outputs cannot be counted as prediction errors. Category counts reveal a critical safety asymmetry: routine perception gains (+5.93 pp) mask a regression in safety-critical hazard prediction (-1.82 pp), demonstrating that unweighted outcome rewards can trade off rare edge cases for aggregate accuracy. Reward saturation describes sampled training dynamics rather than an architectural ceiling. A separate archived Gemma-31B thinking comparison yields no detected average improvement, with uncertainty that does not establish equivalence. These results support a modest answer-selection gain for the recorded tuning configuration and a reproducible diagnostic accounting, without attributing corrected labels to specific grounding mechanisms or claiming superiority over matched supervised tuning.

</details>


### [153] [UniCaMo: Unified Camera and Motion Control for Video Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00810)
*Long Vu,Tan Ngo,Animesh Karnewar,Amir Habibian,Binh-Son Hua,Hung Bui,Minh Hoai Nguyen,Phong Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UniCaMo是一个统一的相机与物体运动联合控制框架，通过构造3D接地的运动一致输入噪声实现图像+文本到视频的可控生成，无需改架构或额外控制模块，仅用轻量LoRA微调即可适配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型对相机运动与物体运动的联合控制往往需要专用控制模块或架构修改，且依赖对未见场景几何的重建，代价高、泛化受限。作者希望以极简先验方式同时精确控制相机与物体轨迹。

Method: 给定参考图像、文本提示、稀疏3D物体轨迹与3D相机轨迹，直接构造编码目标运动的运动一致输入噪声：一方面对参考图像噪声进行传播，另一方面对相机运动新暴露区域采用球面高斯噪声表示；该噪声作为运动先验注入，无需重建不可见几何，也无需修改网络结构或增加控制模块，配合低数据量LoRA微调即可使用。

Result: 在标准可控视频生成基准上取得最先进的运动可控性与高视觉质量，且推理开销极小。

Conclusion: 将相机与物体运动统一编码进输入噪声是一种简单高效的运动控制范式，兼具强可控性、低训练成本与低推理开销，为可控视频生成提供了通用且易适配的方案。

Abstract: We present \textbf{UniCaMo}, an unified framework for joint control of camera and object motion in image-and-text-to-video diffusion models. Given a reference image, text prompt, sparse 3D object trajectories, and a 3D camera trajectory, UniCaMo constructs motion-consistent input noise that directly encodes the desired motion. Our 3D-grounded noise construction combines reference-derived noise propagation with a spherical Gaussian noise representation for newly revealed regions, providing a simple and effective motion prior without requiring reconstruction of unseen scene geometry. UniCaMo requires no architectural modifications or dedicated control modules and can be adapted using lightweight LoRA fine-tuning with low training data volume. Experiments on standard controllable video generation benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art motion controllability and high visual quality with minimal inference overhead.

</details>


### [154] [Training-free Conditional Object Composition for Multi-object Image Generation with Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00804)
*Hsuan-Fu Wang,Hsuan-Tien Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练框架"条件物体组合"，将N个物体的生成分解为先生成N-1个物体、再以已生成内容为条件组合剩余物体的两阶段过程，并用基于交叉注意力图的选择机制决定单独生成的物体，在MS COCO多物体生成上取得有竞争力或更优的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型在多物体生成上仍具挑战：组合式方法分别生成各物体难以刻画物体间交互，联合生成方法则易出现物体间相互干扰，难以可靠生成提示中所有指定物体。

Method: 免训练的两阶段"条件物体组合"：先联合生成N-1个物体的子集，再在以已生成内容为条件下组合剩余物体；采用基于inpainting的公式化建模并引入布局引导，以保留已有区域并促进空间一致的布局；为选择单独生成的物体，提出基于交叉注意力图的注意力打分机制，并探索现成目标检测器的使用。

Result: 在MS COCO多物体图像生成上的实验表明，本方法相较现有方法取得有竞争力或更优的性能，且随物体数量增加优势更明显；消融研究验证了各设计选择的重要性。

Conclusion: 通过向组合式方法"退一步"、以条件组合方式缓解联合生成的物体间干扰，该免训练框架在多物体生成中有效，且物体数越多收益越显著；代码已开源。

Abstract: Multi-object image generation in text-to-image diffusion models remains challenging, as existing approaches struggle to reliably generate all objects specified in a prompt. Compositional approaches that generate objects independently often fail to capture the interactions among them, whereas joint generation methods tend to suffer from inter-object interference. In this work, we propose a training-free framework, termed conditional object composition, that relaxes joint generation methods by taking one step back toward compositional approaches. Our framework decomposes the generation of $N$ objects into two stages: it first generates a subset of $N-1$ objects and then composes the remaining object conditioned on the generated content. To enable effective composition, we adopt an inpainting-based formulation with layout guidance to preserve existing regions and encourage spatially coherent placement. To address the challenge of selecting which objects to generate separately, we introduce an attention-based scoring mechanism based on cross-attention maps and further explore the use of off-the-shelf object detectors. We evaluate our method on multi-object image generation using the widely adopted MS COCO dataset. Experimental results show that our approach achieves competitive or improved performance compared to existing methods, particularly as the number of objects increases. Further studies highlight the importance of the proposed design choices. The source code is available at https://github.com/ShampooWang/condComp_imageGen/tree/main

</details>


### [155] [IMPACT: Image-Conditioned Motion with Physics-Aware Collision and Trajectory Guidance for Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01372)
*Shiwei Yang,Yunlong Yu,Zhao Wang,Jungong Han*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: IMPACT：物理状态驱动的图像到视频框架，通过联合"显式动力学预测"与"稀疏—稠密物理引导"，缓解生成视频中物理不一致及预测—合成失配问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉逼真的视频生成并不保证物理一致：生成物体可能出现不合理的碰撞响应或无能量耗散的反弹；即使物理预测正确，合成阶段也未必忠实实现。核心问题是"预测—生成失配"及缺乏统一物理约束。

Method: 提出IMPACT框架：1）可学习校准的Physics State Generator，将连续自由飞行动力学与离散碰撞响应统一为一致的物理状态序列，关联撞击时刻、碰撞后速度、反弹衰减与最终静止；2）从同一物理rollout中导出稀疏轨迹与稠密区域级运动先验：稀疏轨迹约束全局物体位移，稠密先验引导扩散采样以保证物体区域运动连贯并抑制背景多余变化；3）二者共享物理基础，协同全局与局部运动引导。

Result: 在100个受控球—平面碰撞场景（覆盖不同材质组合与视觉环境）上，相较通用型、物理落地型及运动可控型代表性基线，物理合理性指标均有提升。

Conclusion: 以物理状态序列为核心、辅以稀疏—稠密共享物理先验的引导方式，可有效提升图像到视频生成的物理合理性，并缩小动力学预测与扩散合成之间的差距。

Abstract: Visually realistic video generation does not guarantee physically consistent motion. Generated objects may exhibit implausible collision responses or rebounds without energy dissipation, while even physically valid motion predictions may not be faithfully realized during synthesis. We propose \textbf{IMPACT}, a physics-state-driven image-to-video framework that addresses these challenges by coupling explicit dynamics prediction with complementary sparse--dense physical guidance. A learnably calibrated Physics State Generator unifies continuous free-flight dynamics with discrete collision responses, linking impact timing, post-impact velocity, rebound attenuation, and eventual settling within a coherent physical-state sequence. To translate this evolution into effective generative constraints, IMPACT derives sparse trajectories and dense region-level motion priors from the same physical rollout. Sparse trajectories constrain global object displacement, while dense priors guide diffusion sampling to encourage coherent object-region motion and suppress unwanted background changes. Their shared physical basis coordinates global and local motion guidance to reduce prediction--generation mismatch. Experiments on 100 controlled sphere--plane collision scenes spanning different material combinations and visual environments demonstrate improved physical plausibility over representative general-purpose, physics-grounded, and motion-controllable baselines. The project repository is available at https://weiweiwiewei.github.io/impact

</details>


### [156] [RSI-Env: An Open-Ended Environment for Recursive Self-Improvement of Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01736)
*Wanying Qu,Zhiyuan Fan,Jiyao Liu,Jiang Zhou,Jianghan Shen,Yanwei Fu,Dongrui Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出持久化环境RSI-Env，支持模型与harness协同递归自我改进，并在三种设置下验证跨代持续提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有递归自我改进（RSI）方法限制了优化目标、可编辑组件或评估流程，导致开放式探索与跨代连续性不足。

Method: 构建RSI-Env持久环境：由独立Host Controller管理服务、评估与版本控制；Self以被接受的模型-harness版本接管下一轮改进；设定Open-General、Capability-Directed、Benchmark-Guided三种目标具体度与反馈访问条件，在七个任务上与两个固定外部Teacher对比，初始配置为Qwen3.8-27B加最小harness。

Result: 无基准反馈的Open-General Self将GPQA Diamond从65.2%提升至73.2%、AIME 2026从53.3%至56.7%；三次Capability-Directed Self均获目标对齐增益；Knowledge Self跨版本持续提升，SimpleQA由82.0%→85.0%→88.0%；基准引导与Teacher的收益因任务而异。

Conclusion: RSI-Env在实验范围内支持开放式探索与持续递归改进，但跨能力保持增益仍具挑战。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) envisions agent systems that autonomously improve their own models and harnesses, with each updated system continuing to improve itself. Existing approaches typically restrict optimization objectives, editable components, or evaluation procedures, limiting open-ended exploration and continuity across generations. We introduce RSI-Env, a persistent environment for coordinated model-harness improvement, supporting autonomous training, harness modification, and retention of research state. An independent Host Controller manages services, evaluation, and versioning. Under Self, each accepted model-harness version takes over the next improvement round. We define three settings that vary goal specificity and access to benchmark feedback: Open-General, Capability-Directed, and Benchmark-Guided. Across these three settings, we compare Self with two fixed external Teachers on seven tasks, starting from Qwen3.8-27B with a minimal harness. Without benchmark feedback, Open-General Self raises GPQA Diamond accuracy from 65.2% to 73.2% and AIME 2026 accuracy from 53.3% to 56.7%. All three Capability-Directed Self runs achieve target-aligned gains. Knowledge Self demonstrates continued improvement across system updates, with SimpleQA accuracy rising from 82.0% to 85.0% and then 88.0%. Benchmark guidance and Teacher benefits vary by task. These results demonstrate RSI-Env's support for open-ended exploration and sustained recursive improvement within the studied runs, while highlighting challenges in preserving gains across capabilities.

</details>


### [157] [Deep Learning for Cervical Cytology Screening: Methods, Algorithms, Challenges and Prospects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01730)
*Jiang Yangbo,Zheng Nenggan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇综述系统梳理了深度学习用于宫颈细胞学筛查的研究，沿数据规模、功能任务、监督方式三条轴组织文献，并提出两条临床落地路线（全切片置信度聚合与细胞级检测+Bethesda分类）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 宫颈癌死亡90%以上发生在中低收入国家，当地受限于缺乏训练有素的细胞病理医师，传统细胞学筛查难以覆盖；深度学习使自动化筛查成为可能，但现有文献在细胞、图像块、全切片三个尺度以及任务定义和监督范式上高度割裂，难以横向比较并阻碍临床转化，因此需要系统综述以整合领域。

Method: 综述性研究：按数据规模、功能任务、监督方式三轴组织文献；区分全切片置信度聚合与细胞级检测结合Bethesda分类两条临床路线；梳理16个公开或公开文档化的细胞学数据集及CAISHI组织病理数据集；对量化性能进行横向比较，同时揭示指标不可比与数据泄漏问题；并评估商用系统、监管现状、HPV时代的筛查路径及低资源部署条件。

Result: 在Herlev与SIPaKMeD上的单细胞精度已趋于饱和，但这反映的是基准饱和而非临床可用性；前瞻性与随机化证据正在出现但仍有限；性能比较因指标不一致和数据泄漏而受限。作者将证据归纳为五大挑战领域——数据与基准、架构与标签高效学习、可信AI、临床转化与卫生经济学、评估与可复现性，并给出"证据—议程映射"与部署决策矩阵。

Conclusion: 领域进展的关键不再是饱和单细胞基准上的精度提升，而取决于多中心基准、经外部验证的标签高效方法、经校准且公平的预测，以及务实的临床试验。

Abstract: Cervical cancer remains a leading cause of cancer death among women, with more than 90\% of deaths occurring in low- and middle-income countries, where cytology screening is constrained by a shortage of trained cytopathologists. Deep learning has made automated cytology screening increasingly feasible, but the literature is fragmented across cell, patch and whole-slide-image scales, task formulations and supervision regimes, hindering comparison and clinical translation. This Review synthesizes the deep learning literature for cervical cytology screening, organizing the field along three axes---data scale, functional task and supervision---and distinguishing two clinical roadmaps: whole-slide-image confidence aggregation and cell-level detection with Bethesda classification. We examine 16 publicly available or publicly documented cytology datasets alongside the CAISHI histopathology dataset, compare quantitative performance while exposing incomparable metrics and data leakage, and assess commercial systems, regulatory status, HPV-era screening pathways and low-resource deployment. Single-cell accuracy on Herlev and SIPaKMeD has plateaued, but this reflects benchmark saturation rather than clinical readiness; prospective and randomized evidence is emerging but remains limited. We consolidate the evidence into five challenge areas---data and benchmarks, architecture and label-efficient learning, trustworthy AI, clinical translation and health economics, and evaluation and reproducibility---and provide an evidence-to-agenda map and a deployment decision matrix. Progress now depends on multi-center benchmarks, externally validated label-efficient methods, calibrated and fair predictions, and pragmatic clinical trials rather than further gains on saturated single-cell benchmarks.

</details>


### [158] [GatedVLA with Camera-Based Emergency Braking: AlpaSim E2E Closed Loop Challenge Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01663)
*Kaneyoshi Hiratsuka,Naoki Takada,Makoto Kawano*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GatedVLA 将驾驶预训练的 Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B VLM 与分层流匹配动作专家结合，输出 2.5 s 时域的加速度/曲率控制，并通过软视觉掩码与部署期规则 AEB 提升闭环评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向 Physical AI AV（PAI-AV）赛道构建学习式 VLA 驾驶策略，并探究视觉掩码对交叉注意力与转向行为的影响，以及部署期安全模块能否提升闭环表现。

Method: 以驾驶预训练的 Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B 为视觉语言主干，接分层（layer-wise）流匹配动作专家，输出 2.5 s 时域的加速度与曲率控制序列；在专家交叉注意力上施加软视觉掩码。与同配置基线做开环误差对比，并在 150 个场景×2 次 rollout 的本地闭环评测中进行配对比较，另外在部署时接入规则式 AEB。

Result: 掩码策略整体开环误差与基线相当，但左转误差下降。闭环平均场景分由 0.479 提升至 0.517（配对差 +0.038，95% bootstrap CI [-0.018, +0.093]，胜/负 37/26，符号检验 p = 0.21），未达统计显著。加入规则式 AEB 后均分升至 0.599（+0.082，CI [+0.023, +0.143]），平均有责碰撞场景数由 34.0 降至 11.0。

Conclusion: 软视觉掩码对左转等特定工况有定向改善，但闭环总体增益在统计上不显著；显著且幅度更大的提升主要来自部署期规则 AEB，说明安全兜底模块对闭环指标贡献突出。整体属于以 VLM 主干+流匹配动作头为主体的竞赛型系统报告，方法创新度与统计证据强度有限。

Abstract: This report presents GatedVLA, our entry for the Physical AI AV (PAI-AV) track. Our learned vision-language-action (VLA) policy pairs the driving-pretrained Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B vision-language model with a layer-wise flow-matching action expert that outputs a 2.5 s horizon of acceleration and curvature controls, augmented with a soft visual mask applied to the expert's cross-attention. Compared to an identically trained baseline, the masked policy achieves comparable overall open-loop error while reducing error on left turns. In local closed-loop evaluation across the same 150 scenes (two rollouts per scene), the visual mask increases the mean scene score from 0.479 to 0.517 (paired difference +0.038, 95% bootstrap CI [-0.018, +0.093], wins/losses 37/26, sign test p = 0.21). Incorporating a rule-based automatic emergency braking (AEB) module at deployment further increases the mean score to 0.599 (+0.082, CI [+0.023, +0.143]) and reduces the mean number of scenes with at-fault collisions from 34.0 to 11.0.

</details>


### [159] [NatureFusion: Rethinking Infrared and Visible Image Fusion as Natural Complementary Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01607)
*Jianfeng Ding,Linfeng Tang,Hao Zhang,Han Xu,Xunpeng Yi,Yibing Zhang,Meiqi Gong,Zhongyuan Wang,Jiayi Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出NatureFusion，将红外与可见光图像融合重新定义为"自然互补增强"而非源保真，借助生成式基础模型作为教师、轻量融合适配器与条件流匹配微调，并用检测器监督任务适配器，生成视觉自然且利于下游任务的融合图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有融合方法在缺乏真值条件下追求对源图像的保真，直接叠加两种物理属性不同的模态，导致红外显著目标呈现为贴在场景上的亮热辐射斑块，遮蔽目标原本的颜色与纹理，融合结果对人眼不自然，且偏离可见光预训练视觉模型所学到的数据分布。

Method: 1) 将问题重定义为自然互补增强，利用跨模态互补线索从低质量可见光与红外图像对推断清晰、自然的可见光风格图像；2) 因缺乏真值，采用生成式基础模型作为教师直接生成视觉自然的融合图像进行监督；3) 以轻量融合适配器，通过条件流匹配微调预训练生成模型，在蒸馏教师生成能力的同时降低计算开销；4) 冻结融合适配器，引入检测器监督的任务适配器，在不牺牲自然外观的前提下增强红外的互补贡献。

Result: 与七种多模态融合方法和七种单模态增强方法的广泛对比表明，NatureFusion生成的融合图像在感知质量上最优、视觉上自然；在可见光图像上预训练的检测与分割模型在其融合图像上的精度显著高于任何对比方法。

Conclusion: 以自然互补增强替代源保真的融合范式可行：所得融合图像既符合人眼视觉自然性，又贴近可见光预训练模型的数据分布，从而显著提升下游检测与分割性能。

Abstract: In the absence of ground truth, most existing infrared and visible image fusion methods pursue fidelity to the source images and directly superimpose two physically distinct modalities. As a result, salient infrared targets appear as bright patches of thermal radiation pasted onto the scene. These patches obscure the original color and texture of the targets, so the fused images look unnatural to human observers and deviate from the data distribution learned by vision models pretrained on visible images. Therefore, we redefine infrared and visible image fusion as natural complementary enhancement rather than source fidelity, and propose NatureFusion, which exploits cross-modal complementary cues to infer a clear and natural visible-style image from low-quality visible and infrared image pairs. Specifically, to address the lack of ground truth, we employ a generative foundation model as the teacher to directly generate visually natural fused images for supervision. Furthermore, to fully distill the teacher's generative capability while reducing computational cost, we fine-tune a pretrained generative model with conditional flow matching through a light-weight fusion adapter. Last but not least, to further improve downstream performance without sacrificing natural appearance, we freeze the fusion adapter and introduce a detector-supervised task adapter that strengthens the complementary contribution of infrared. Extensive comparisons with seven multi-modal fusion and seven single-modality enhancement methods demonstrate that NatureFusion generates visually natural fused images with the best perceptual quality. Detection and segmentation models pretrained on visible images achieve substantially higher accuracy on our fused images than on those of any competing method.

</details>


### [160] [MedNet and U$^2$-ViT: A Nested Vision Transformer Diffusion Framework for Diverse Medical Images Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01605)
*Lakshmikar R. Polamreddy,Jialu Li,Youshan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文构建大规模多模态医学文本-图像数据集 MedNet（61 个疾病类别、160 个子类，涵盖人类与动物），并提出基于扩散模型的嵌套 U 形 ViT 架构 U²-ViT，用于生成多样且高保真的医学图像，在 FID 指标上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学图像领域缺乏多样、高质量的公开数据，现有数据集存在类别不平衡、疾病覆盖有限、成像条件变化不足等问题，制约了鲁棒且可泛化的 AI 诊断与治疗规划模型的研发，因此需要构建高质量数据集并配套生成能力。

Method: 一是从可信公共数据源构建 MedNet 文本-图像数据集，覆盖 61 个疾病类别、160 个类，兼顾多样性、质量与伦理合规；二是提出 U²-ViT，一种将 Vision Transformer 以嵌套 U-Net 结构组织的扩散式文本到图像生成架构，以提升生成图像的多样性与保真度。

Result: 大量实验表明，该模型在 FID（Fréchet Inception Distance）指标上取得最优结果，优于当前先进模型；代码已开源。

Conclusion: MedNet 数据集与 U²-ViT 架构共同为缓解医学图像数据稀缺、提升生成质量提供了可行方案，可作为医学图像生成与下游诊断任务的支撑基础。

Abstract: The scarcity of diverse, high-quality medical images remains a significant bottleneck in advancing AI-driven medical diagnostics and treatment planning. Traditional datasets often suffer from class imbalances, limited disease coverage, and insufficient variations in imaging conditions - challenges that hinder the development of robust, generalizable models. To address this, we introduce MedNet, a large-scale, multi-modal text-to-image dataset spanning 61 disease categories with 160 classes, covering both humans and animals. We built this with images from trusted public repositories, ensuring data diversity, quality, and ethical compliance. Additionally, we propose U$^2$-ViT, a novel diffusion-based text-to-image generation architecture arranging Vision Transformers (ViTs) in a nested U-Net structure to enhance the generation of diverse, and high-fidelity medical images. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our model achieves the best Fr'echet Inception Distance (FID) score compared to state-of-the-art models. The source code is available at https://github.com/LakshmikarPolamreddy/MedNet-U2-ViT.

</details>


### [161] [Accurate automated photo-identification of Near Eastern and European fire salamanders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01601)
*Maayan Yesharim,Hava Goldstein,Gabi Kolodny,Assaf Ben-Levy,Tamar Kis-Papo,Dor Gavish,Rotem Vidan,Nirit Lavie-Alon,Olga Rybak,Yoav Ram*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出基于零样本局部特征匹配（SuperPoint + LightGlue）的两栖动物个体重识别流水线，无需物种特定训练即可在逾千个体的数据库上高效、可迁移地完成照片识别与数据库审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 照片识别是个体捕获-重捕监测的基础，但参考库扩大后人工比对变慢且易出错，且现有方法多依赖物种特定训练数据，难以迁移。

Method: 以近东火蝾螈为对象，构建零样本局部特征匹配流水线：分离黄色斑点图案，用高置信度关键点匹配数评分相似度（缓解多斑点个体产生虚假匹配的混淆），并以两层聚类完成全库身份分配；再由专家复核流水线结果。在以色列海法与Tel Dan的2440张野外照片上评估，并在两种欧洲火蝾螈数据集上无修改测试。

Result: 流水线辅助专家复核纠正误判，使身份数量减少近四分之一；在留出个体上95.2%查询将正确个体排首位，ARI为0.958；在两个欧洲火蝾螈数据集上无修改达到95.1%和91.7%的top-1准确率，其中一个数据集的93.7%重捕被识别，高于五种现有程序的38%–77%，接近人工目检的93.9%。

Conclusion: 零样本局部特征匹配为两栖动物监测提供了无需训练数据、可跨近缘物种迁移、可扩展至千级个体库、并能在捕获-重捕分析前审计既有数据库的重识别工具。

Abstract: Photo-identification underpins non-invasive capture-recapture monitoring of amphibians, but manual identification becomes slow and error-prone as reference libraries grow. Focusing on the Near Eastern fire salamander (Salamandra infraimmaculata), we developed a pipeline based on zero-shot local-feature matching (SuperPoint and LightGlue) without species-specific training and evaluated it on $2{,}440$ field photographs from Haifa and Tel Dan in northern Israel. We isolated the yellow spot pattern, scored image similarity by the number of high-confidence keypoint matches, which reduced a confound whereby many-spotted individuals accumulate spurious matches, and assigned identities across the database by two-tier clustering. Pipeline-assisted expert review corrected misidentifications, reducing the number of identities by almost a quarter. On held-out individuals, the pipeline ranked the correct individual first for $95.2\%$ of queries and recovered identities with an ARI of $0.958$. Without modification, it reached $95.1\%$ and $91.7\%$ top-1 accuracy on two datasets of the European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) and recognised $93.7\%$ of recaptures in one of them, compared with $38$-$77\%$ for five established programs and $93.9\%$ for visual inspection. Zero-shot local-feature matching thus offers amphibian monitoring a re-identification tool that needs no training data, transfers between related species, scales to databases of over a thousand individuals, and can audit existing databases before capture-recapture analysis.

</details>


### [162] [Band2Net: Frequency-to-Network Transport Distillation for fMRI-Privileged, EEG-Only Session-Condition Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01548)
*Nishi Kanta Paul,Md Shihabul Islam Shovo,Dwarikanath Mahapatra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Band2Net将fMRI视为仅在训练期可用的特权信息，把EEG编码为五个频段特异性连接图、fMRI编码为七个规范网络token，并通过平衡熵传输为每个EEG频段分配独立的fMRI目标，实现仅用EEG的会话状态解码，取得0.801 ROC-AUC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: fMRI空间分辨率高但昂贵且需静止采集，EEG便携但定位能力差。作者希望把训练时可得、部署时不可得的fMRI作为特权信息，提升仅EEG条件下的解码性能。

Method: EEG与fMRI来自同一批被试、条件匹配但非同步采集。Band2Net将EEG编码为五个频段特异性连接图，用冻结教师模型将fMRI编码为七个规范网络token，并在两个token集合间求解平衡熵传输问题，使每个EEG频段获得对应的fMRI目标；在PsiConnect数据上采用按被试分组的交叉验证。

Result: EEG单模态会话状态解码ROC-AUC达0.801，比纯EEG学生模型高5.0个AUC点（95% CI 1.8–8.2）。相对于单一共享传输方案、KL松弛方案及无标签网络描述子的优势尚不明确；次级比较中频段特异传输目标优于logit、全局特征、对比及池化目标蒸馏，但经Holm校正后不显著。

Conclusion: 频段特异性fMRI传输目标可有效提升EEG解码性能，但相对若干强基线的增益尚未确立，需进一步验证与统计检验支持。

Abstract: Functional MRI resolves large-scale brain networks but is expensive and stationary, whereas EEG is portable but poorly localised. We treat fMRI as privileged information, available during training and absent at deployment, with EEG and fMRI acquired from the same participants under matched conditions but not simultaneously. Band2Net encodes EEG into five frequency-specific connectivity graphs and fMRI into seven canonical network tokens from a frozen teacher, and solves a balanced entropic transport problem between the two token sets that gives each EEG band its own fMRI target. In subject-grouped cross-validation on the PsiConnect psilocybin data set, Band2Net reaches 0.801 ROC-AUC for EEG-only session-condition decoding, 5.0 AUC points (95% CI 1.8-8.2) above an EEG-only student. Although its margins over a single shared plan, a KL-relaxed plan and label-free network descriptors remain unresolved, secondary comparisons favour band-specific transported targets over logit, global-feature, contrastive and pooled-target distillation, though not after Holm correction.

</details>


### [163] [Object-Only Is Not Context-Free: A Counterfactual Diagnostic for Context Removal in Object Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01962)
*Boaz Meivar,Shai Avidan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Keyhole Aperture Probe (KAP) 反事实诊断，证明"仅物体"描述子仍强依赖上下文，并给出可降低该依赖的轻量适配器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物体中心检索流程通常先用真值掩码屏蔽背景再池化主干特征，假定由此得到的是"仅表征物体"的描述子；但这一假设很少被检验，缺乏衡量描述子上下文依赖程度的诊断手段。

Method: KAP：复用 COCO、ADE20K 全景分割数据集的真值掩码，固定池化后的物体区域，仅改变区域外像素（中性填充或替换为其他真实场景），以单一数值量化主干的上下文依赖性；在十个现代主干上评测，并训练轻量适配器使描述子在上下文移除时保持稳定，与匹配的对比式微调对照比较。

Result: 池化物体区域已整合周围环境：替换上下文（中性填充或不同真实场景）会改变描述子；空白填充下检索失败时，描述子更匹配纯背景图像而非其自身物体。十个主干上，仅物体描述子仅保留全图精度的约 1/4 至 2/3；该效应不限于 Transformer 自注意力，卷积主干同样存在。轻量适配器降低依赖性并提升 INSTRE 全图实例检索性能，可迁移至 ILIAS（精度提升或保持），匹配的对比式微调对照未能复现该增益。

Conclusion: "仅物体"不等于"无上下文"，背景掩码无法隔离上下文信息。应在上线部署前用 KAP 这一主干无关的评估协议测量并降低该依赖。

Abstract: Object-centric retrieval pipelines often mask the background before pooling backbone features, aiming for a descriptor that reflects the object rather than its scene. Whether this truly yields an object-only descriptor, however, is rarely tested. We introduce the Keyhole Aperture Probe (KAP), a counterfactual diagnostic that repurposes the ground-truth masks of existing panoptic segmentation datasets (COCO, ADE20K) for retrieval: it holds the pooled object region fixed and varies only the pixels outside it, summarizing a backbone's context dependence in a single number. We find that the pooled object region has already integrated its surround. Replacing the context, with a neutral fill or even a different real scene, changes the descriptor, and when retrieval fails under a blank fill, the descriptor matches plain-background images rather than its own object. Object-only is not context-free. Across ten modern backbones, object-only descriptors retain only about a quarter to two-thirds of their full-image accuracy, and the effect is not unique to Transformer self-attention: a convolutional backbone shows it too. The dependence is also reducible: a lightweight adapter that encourages the descriptor to stay stable as context is removed lowers it and improves full-image instance retrieval on INSTRE, transferring to ILIAS with accuracy improved or preserved. A matched contrastive-fine-tuning control does not reproduce those gains. We release KAP as a simple, backbone-agnostic evaluation protocol to measure and reduce this dependence before deployment.

</details>


### [164] [Advances in Agentic Computer Graphics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01860)
*Hengyu Liu,Jihyeon Je,Ruiqi Wang,Mingxuan Wu,Haven Feng,Qixing Huang,Georgios Pavlakos,Hao Zhang,Jiajun Wu,Maneesh Agrawala,Leonidas Guibas,R. Kenny Jones,Shangzhe Wu,Guandao Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对"智能体化图形学"（agentic graphics）研究快速扩张、术语不统一的问题，提出统一分类法（unified taxonomy）与一个可规模化分析文献的智能体文献系统（agentic literature system），并据此梳理研究趋势与开放挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体已能生成并迭代精化图形代码，催生以智能体系统为核心的图形学新范式，相关任务研究激增；人工文献综述难以跟上进展，且不同任务对相似概念使用不同术语，阻碍系统化理解。

Method: 报告性质（survey/position）工作，含两项贡献：(1) 提出跨多种计算机图形任务的智能体系统统一分类法；(2) 构建智能体文献系统，辅助人类研究者大规模分析已有与新发表论文。

Result: 基于该分类法与文献系统，对新兴研究趋势进行分析，并识别出若干开放挑战：跨图形任务的智能体与工具协同、面向人-智能体协作的界面与表示设计、长程规划与迭代精化的维持、交互式图形系统的可靠评测。

Conclusion: 智能体化图形学正形成新范式，亟需统一术语框架与自动化文献分析工具支撑领域发展；未来需在智能体-工具协同、人机协作接口、长程规划与可靠评测等方向推进研究。

Abstract: Computer graphics is built on code. Large language model (LLM) agents can now generate graphics code and iteratively refine it through various feedback. This capability opens the door to a potentially new paradigm of computer graphics, with graphics algorithms increasingly built around agentic systems to automate progressively complex tasks. Over the past years, research on agentic graphics has expanded rapidly across a diverse range of tasks. This rapid growth makes it increasingly difficult for manual literature reviews to keep pace with new developments. At the same time, similar ideas are often described using different terminology across these tasks, further complicating efforts to develop a systematic understanding of the field. In this report, we address these challenges through two contributions. First, we introduce a unified taxonomy for characterizing agentic systems across diverse computer graphics tasks. Second, we develop an agentic literature system that can assist human researchers in analyzing existing and newly published papers at scale. Building on these contributions, we analyze emerging research trends and discuss open challenges in coordinating agents and tools across graphics tasks, designing interfaces and representations for human-agent collaboration, sustaining long-horizon planning and refinement, and reliably evaluating interactive graphics systems.

</details>


### [165] [SHield: Watermarking 4D Gaussian Splatting via Spherical Harmonic Coefficient Perturbation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01162)
*Kunal Bhosikar,Prajas Wadekar,Venkata Sai Pranav Bachina,Ankit Gangwal,Charu Sharma,Nicole Meng,Yingjie Lao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SHield——首个面向4DGS文件的非盲、免解码器水印方法，将全分辨率RGB图像原生嵌入球谐系数，验证时通过确定性算术闭式恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 4DGS训练昂贵但以参数文件形式易被复制。现有水印依赖神经解码器微调场景，从渲染视频中提取比特串，过程重且受动态场景时间动态性影响。若威胁模型针对被再分发的文件本身，验证可大幅简化：4DGS的规范SH系数具时不变与视角不变性，参数空间扰动可用确定性算术恢复，因而无需解码器。

Method: 密钥选取高斯子集，将零均值载荷分块平铺到其SH系数上，辅以短暂锚定优化以保视觉保真度。验证时利用规范高斯中心进行几何重关联以抵抗文件篡改，并闭式恢复载荷，实现非盲、免解码器水印。

Result: 30个场景（D-NeRF、HyperNeRF、DyNeRF）共150个模型上载荷恢复近乎完美（Pearson r≥0.991），平均渲染损失≤0.13 dB。留出评估中400次真实试验全部检出、1,600次错误子集零假设试验零误报。鲁棒性：图像载荷可抗INT8量化与30%不透明度剪枝；在激进SH一阶截断下比特载荷仍可解码。

Conclusion: 面向再分发4DGS文件的非盲、免解码器水印可行且高效，原生嵌入图像载荷、闭式验证、渲染代价极小，并对量化、剪枝与SH截断给出严格鲁棒性边界。

Abstract: 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) models are computationally expensive to train but distributed as easily copied parameter files. Existing watermarks protect these assets by fine-tuning the scene against a neural decoder to extract bit strings from rendered video, a heavy process vulnerable to the temporal dynamics of dynamic scenes. However, if the threat model targets the redistributed file itself, verification can be vastly simplified. Because the canonical Spherical-Harmonic (SH) coefficients of 4DGS are time- and view-invariant, parameter-space perturbations can be recovered via deterministic arithmetic. We propose **SHield**, the first non-blind, decoder-free watermarking approach that natively embeds full-resolution RGB images into 4DGS files. SHield tiles a zero-mean payload across the SH coefficients of a key-selected Gaussian subset, applying a brief anchored optimization to preserve visual fidelity. To verify ownership, it geometrically re-associates the key using canonical Gaussian centres to survive file tampering and recovers the payload in closed form. Across 30 scenes (D-NeRF, HyperNeRF, DyNeRF), SHield guarantees near-perfect payload recovery (Pearson $r \geq 0.991$) on all 150 tested models with a mean rendering penalty of $\leq 0.13$~dB. Held-out evaluation yields perfect detection on 400 true trials and zero false positives across $1{,}600$ wrong-subset null trials. We also strictly bound the method's robustness: SHield survives INT8 quantization and $30\%$ opacity pruning for the image payload, and on aggressive SH-degree-1 truncation bit payloads are still decodable.

</details>


### [166] [StreamDuo: A Live Commentator and a Research Agent for Unseen Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01120)
*Zixian Gao,Penghao Luo,Xiangcheng Cao,Lixin Xiu,Ziqi Cai,Zhen Li,Erwin Wu,Kaipeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出StreamDuo：可训练解说器+冻结的维基检索智能体，仅用单款游戏训练即可实现跨游戏实时解说。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流式视频LLM解说模型在训练与测试均使用同一游戏，存在过拟合风险。本文研究跨游戏流式解说（训练于一游戏、解说是未见过的游戏），发现现有模型能迁移"解说时机"却无法迁移"游戏世界知识"。

Method: StreamDuo将可训练解说器与冻结的research agent配对；后者读取当前所玩游戏维基。解说器遇到无法命名的实体时发送当前帧，agent在2秒内返回少量维基条目，且流式过程不中断。仅训练解说器，单游戏、两阶段：1）信息增益标签教会模型仅在答案有助于复述人类解说词时才提问；2）从可见理想答案的自身副本进行on-policy自蒸馏，学会利用带噪答案。

Result: 在Baldur's Gate 3训练、十个未见游戏测试：实体召回率由Proact-VL（同数据训练）的0.082提升至0.116；源游戏泄漏率由9.9%降至1.0%；在流式模型中取得最佳时机控制，并在生动性与整体质量的人类评测中最高。

Conclusion: 通过"按需检索+信息增益驱动提问+带噪答案自蒸馏"，可在不训练目标游戏、不更新检索端的情况下有效实现跨游戏流式解说，同时显著抑制源游戏知识泄漏。

Abstract: Streaming video LLMs can now commentate live gameplay, but they are trained and tested on the same games. We study cross-game streaming commentary, in which a model trained on one game commentates games it has never seen, and find that current commentators transfer their timing but not their knowledge of the game world. We propose StreamDuo, which pairs a trainable commentator with a frozen research agent that reads the wiki of the game being played. When the commentator sees something it cannot name, it sends the current frames, and the research agent returns a few wiki entries two seconds later while the stream continues. We train only the commentator, on a single game, in two stages. Information-gain labels teach it to ask only where an answer would help it say what the human caster said, and on-policy self-distillation from a copy of itself that sees the ideal answer teaches it to use noisy answers. Trained on Baldur's Gate 3 and tested on ten unseen games, StreamDuo raises entity recall from 0.082 to 0.116 over Proact-VL trained on the same data, cuts source-game leakage from 9.9% to 1.0%, and achieves the best timing and the highest judged liveliness and overall quality among streaming models.

</details>


### [167] [Efficient Image Denoising on Smartphone GPUs: Mobile AI 2026 Challenge Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00974)
*Andrey Ignatov,Georgy Perevozchikov,Radu Timofte,HaoDong Wu,Desheng Cai,Nikolay Falaleev,Faraz Kayani,Sarmad Kayani,Asad Ahmed,Dmitry Ignatov,Kihwan Yoon,Ganzorig Gankhuyag,Yoonsuk Kang,The Van Le,Jin Young Lee,Sunzhe Yang,Qiuhai Yan,Kang Chen,Tingting Wang,Faming Fang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Mobile AI 挑战赛聚焦移动端全高清图像去噪：基于真实噪声-干净图像对数据集，限制模型在骁龙8 Elite Gen 5（Adreno）与天玑9500（Mali）GPU上运行，最优方案在两平台均实现100毫秒内、PSNR 超过37 dB的实时高质量去噪，并汇总各参赛模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动摄影中图像去噪是基础问题，但现有方案多基于合成噪声数据训练，且计算量过大，难以在移动设备上处理全分辨率图像；因此亟需兼具性能与可部署性的高效深度学习模型。

Method: 组织Mobile AI挑战赛，要求参赛者设计可在主流智能手机GPU（Qualcomm Adreno与Arm Mali）上对Full HD分辨率照片实时去噪的快速方案；提供大规模真实场景采集的噪声-干净图像对数据集；在Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5与Dimensity 9500芯片上评测所有模型的运行时。

Result: 顶尖方案在Adreno与Mali两个平台上均能在100毫秒以内完成高质量去噪，PSNR超过37 dB。

Conclusion: 验证了深度学习方法在受限移动硬件上实现实时、高保真全高清去噪的可行性；论文系统描述了挑战赛中开发的各类模型。

Abstract: Image denoising is a fundamental problem in mobile photography. Despite a large number of solutions proposed for this task, the majority of them are trained on synthetically produced noisy images, and are additionally too computationally heavy for processing full-resolution images on mobile devices. This creates a need for efficient deep learning-based models that are not only performant but can also be deployed on constrained mobile hardware. In this Mobile AI challenge, we address this problem and propose the participants to design fast solutions that can denoise Full HD resolution photos while running on popular smartphone GPUs from Qualcomm and Arm. For this, the participants were provided with a large-scale dataset consisting of noisy-clean image pairs captured in the wild. The runtime of all models was evaluated on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and Dimensity 9500 chipsets with the Adreno and Mali GPUs, respectively. Top solutions proposed in this challenge are able to perform high-quality image denoising under 100 milliseconds on both platforms while reaching a PSNR score of over 37 dB. A comprehensive description of the models developed in the challenge is provided in this paper.

</details>


### [168] [ZOPGA-KD: Zeroth Order PGA Guided Data Free Knowledge Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00908)
*Tuhin Subhra Mukherjee,Tiya Rose Pulikunnel,Vaidhav Adit,Devanand Thanissery,S. H. Shabbeer Basha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种仅利用教师输出logits的黑盒无数据知识蒸馏方法：用零阶梯度估计做投影梯度上升（PGA）从平滑随机噪声生成合成样本，学生网络在合成样本上训练，性能与可用教师参数的white-box方法相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典KD需教师原始训练数据，但隐私约束下数据常不可得。现有无数据KD方案中，white-box法依赖教师参数/梯度，生成式方法计算开销大，黑盒法同样计算密集。因此需要一种既不访问教师架构、参数与梯度，又计算高效的合成数据方案。

Method: 仅查询教师模型的输出logits。以平滑随机噪声为初始点，通过Projected Gradient Ascent（PGA）迭代优化生成合成样本，使教师输出响应最大化；所需梯度不由教师参数反传获得，而采用零阶梯度估计（zeroth-order gradient estimation）近似。随后用生成的合成样本训练学生网络完成蒸馏。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上评估，蒸馏性能与可访问教师模型参数的方法（white-box）相当，同时避免了对教师架构、参数与梯度的依赖，并规避了昂贵的生成式训练。

Conclusion: 仅依赖logits的黑盒无数据KD是可行的：结合PGA与零阶梯度估计即可获得高质量合成数据，在保持蒸馏效果的同时降低对教师信息的访问要求与计算成本。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) enables the transfer of learned representations from a large teacher network to a small student network. In foundational KD, the student network uses the original training data of the teacher model to accomplish this task. However, due to privacy concerns, the original training data is often not available. To overcome this reliance on original training data, several data-free knowledge distillation methods have been developed. Some of these methods operate in the white-box setting, and a few methods generate synthetic data by training a generator network. White-box methods use the teacher model's parameters to obtain a synthetic dataset. To avoid relying on teacher parameters, some methods use computationally expensive generative approaches to obtain such a dataset. There also exist certain black-box methods that generate the synthetic data without accessing teacher parameters. These methods are also computationally intensive. We propose a data-free knowledge distillation method that utilizes just the teacher's output logits and does not require access to its architecture, parameters, or gradients. We generate synthetic data via Projected Gradient Ascent (PGA) starting from smooth random noise signals. Required gradients are obtained through zeroth-order gradient estimation rather than backpropagating through the teacher's parameters. The student is then trained on these synthetically generated samples. We evaluate the proposed method on several benchmark datasets and show that the distillation performance is comparable with approaches that have access to the teacher model parameters.

</details>


### [169] [Running a 20B Video Diffusion Transformer on Consumer Hardware: A Deployment and Measurement Report for MiniMax H3 on Apple Silicon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00843)
*Luke Shi,Steven Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在 Apple Mac mini（M5 Pro，64 GiB 统一内存）上本地完成 20.38B 参数视频 DiT（MiniMax H3）的 bf16→Q8 量化、端到端部署与性能/质量实测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证消费级 Apple Silicon 硬件能否在无云依赖条件下承载大规模视频扩散模型的完整推理流水线，并给出可复现的部署路径与真实测量数据。

Method: 在本地执行官方 bf16→Q8（group size 64）量化流程，基于 MLX 运行 MiniMax H3 文生视频管线；记录部署流程与两个关键阻塞点及修复方案；在四档分辨率（Draft 384x640 至 Native 768x1344）下测量构建时间、峰值内存与单片段渲染延迟；并将系统作为无人值守生产流水线连续运行，进行盲审人工评测。

Result: 15.08 秒 576x1024 片段渲染耗时 4838.49 秒，MLX 峰值内存 27.467 GiB；无人值守运行 26.49 小时完成 17 个片段，零渲染失败；盲审（隐去提示词）17 个生产片段在结构完整性、时序一致性、可见伪影三项均分分别为 3.12、3.18、2.94（满分 5）。

Conclusion: 消费级 Apple Silicon 单机可支撑 20B 级视频扩散模型的本地端到端部署与长时间稳定生产，但渲染延迟较高（约 320 秒/秒视频）；本工作属于系统/实证报告，不主张模型创新。

Abstract: We report the end-to-end deployment and measurement of MiniMax H3, a 20.38-billion-parameter video diffusion transformer (DiT) - the count measured from the safetensors headers of the Q8 checkpoint as deployed locally (Section 3.2) - running entirely on consumer Apple Silicon hardware: an Apple Mac mini with M5 Pro chip and 64 GiB of unified memory. Using the official bf16-to-Q8 (8-bit, group size 64) quantization path executed locally on the machine, we produced a working text-to-video pipeline with no cloud dependency. We document the full deployment procedure, including two non-trivial blockers and their fixes, and report measured figures for build time, peak memory, and per-clip render latency across four resolution tiers (Draft 384x640 through Native 768x1344). A 15.08-second 576x1024 clip rendered in 4838.49 seconds with a measured MLX peak of 27.467 GiB. We further operated the system as an unattended production pipeline, completing 17 clips in 26.49 hours with zero render failures. A blind human review of the 17 production clips (generation prompts withheld) averaged 3.12, 3.18, and 2.94 out of 5 for structural integrity, temporal consistency, and visible artifacts. All figures in this report are our own measurements except where explicitly labeled as third-party data. This is a systems/empirical report; we make no claim of model innovation.

</details>


### [170] [ODC: Orthogonal Drift Correction for Improved Text-to-Image Semantic Alignment at Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00819)
*Kasra Kamali,Basim Azam,Tuan Duong Trinh,Jean Honorio,Naveed Akhtar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出正交漂移校正（ODC），一种推理时引导方法，通过在两阶段流程中识别并剔除与提示方向正交的语义漂移分量，精炼文本嵌入，提升文生图模型的提示-图像对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文生图模型存在"语义漂移"问题，生成结果无法精确对齐复杂或多义文本提示；已有方法多针对属性绑定或物体缺失等局部语义错误，缺乏直接从初始用户提示的文本嵌入层面进行整体修正的方案。

Method: ODC 为免训练、免额外用户输入的推理时引导，分两阶段：①在共享视觉-语言嵌入空间中比对首轮生成图像与提示，计算漂移向量，提取其与提示方向正交的分量，并借助基于词表（vocabulary）的代理机制将其回译为文本；②将初始文本嵌入与重嵌入的漂移表示一并输入自适应秩缩减（rank-reduced）概念移除模块，生成精炼文本条件用于第二次生成。

Result: 在 COALBench-300 与 PartiPrompts 上 CLIP 分数较基线最高提升 5.4%；在 T2I-CompBench 复杂子集上，3-in-1 平均分较对比方法提升 4.5%。

Conclusion: ODC 作为即插即用模块，无需重训练即可持续改善提示-图像对齐，为提升文生图模型可靠性提供实用高效方案；代码已开源。

Abstract: Text-to-image models have achieved remarkable success in generating high-quality images from textual descriptions. However, they often struggle with "semantic drift," where the generated output fails to precisely align with complex or nuanced text prompts. While recent approaches have attempted to address semantic errors regarding attribute binding or object presence, there remains a gap for a more holistic method that addresses these issues by directly refining the text embeddings of the initial user prompt. In this work, we introduce Orthogonal Drift Correction (ODC), an inference-time guidance method designed to mitigate semantic drift without requiring model retraining or additional user inputs. ODC guides image generation through a two-stage process. In the first stage, it identifies the semantic drift by evaluating the initially generated image against the user prompt in a shared vision-language embedding space. It then isolates the component of this drift vector that is orthogonal to the prompt's direction and translates it back into text via a vocabulary-based surrogate mechanism. In the second stage, it produces refined text conditioning for a second generation pass by feeding both the initial text embedding and the re-embedded drift representation into an adaptive rank-reduced concept removal module. Our experiments demonstrate that ODC consistently improves prompt-image alignment, increasing CLIP scores by up to 5.4% over the baseline on the COALBench-300 and PartiPrompts benchmarks. Furthermore, on the T2I-CompBench complex subset, ODC improves the average 3-in-1 score by 4.5% over the competing methods. As a plug-and-play module, ODC offers a practical and efficient method for improving the reliability of text-to-image models. Code is available at https://github.com/kasrakamali/ODC.

</details>


### [171] [ConstraintMatch: Compositional Image-Text Matching through Constrained Regional Evidence Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00784)
*Yuhong Zhou,Yubo Gao,Xiangbo Shu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练推理方法 ConstraintMatch，将实体级区域一致性转化为显式匹配代价，在冻结骨干上改善图文组合匹配，尤其缓解属性—实体绑定错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 局部图像—文本匹配虽能为单个概念找到强证据，却偏向属性—实体绑定错误的描述，需要一种显式惩罚该问题的匹配准则。

Method: 在同一冻结的“条件—区域”相似度矩阵上，对每个类别与属性分别做独立裁剪选择，与实体内部的共享裁剪选择比较，其差值量化放宽共享区域约束所获的分数优势；用同图空间参考在固定类别证据下联合平移实体属性图以校准该差值；逐实体裁剪防止残差相互抵消，缩放后的平均代价从全局相似度中减去；仅用池化嵌入，空间校准无需额外编码器调用，参数按骨干固定。

Result: 在 Qwen~2B 与 CORE~2B 平均下，相对全局匹配在完整 ARO Attribute 上提升 7.70 个百分点、留出 SugarCrepe++ 属性交换上提升 5.63 点；相对适配到相同 13 裁剪预算的 SGI，分别提升 4.85 与 3.51 点；对照实验区分了共享区域匹配与候选分数校准的贡献。

Conclusion: 实体级证据选择是一种实用且有效的组合式多模态检索打分原则。

Abstract: Local image--text matching can find strong evidence for individual concepts yet favor captions with incorrect attribute--entity bindings. We introduce ConstraintMatch, a training-free inference method that turns entity-level regional consistency into an explicit matching cost. On the same frozen condition--region similarity matrix, it compares independent crop selection for each category and attribute with a shared crop choice within each entity. Their gap quantifies the score advantage obtained by relaxing the shared-region constraint. Spatial references from the same image calibrate this gap by keeping category evidence fixed while jointly shifting an entity's attribute maps. Per-entity clipping prevents cancellation across residuals, and the scaled mean cost is subtracted from global similarity. ConstraintMatch uses pooled embeddings, and spatial calibration requires no additional encoder calls. With parameters fixed per backbone across tasks, ConstraintMatch improves over global matching by 7.70 percentage points on full ARO Attribute and 5.63 points on held-out SugarCrepe++ attribute swaps, averaged across Qwen~2B and CORE~2B. Against SGI adapted to the same 13-crop budget, the respective gains are 4.85 and 3.51 points. Controlled analyses distinguish the effects of shared-region matching and candidate score calibration. The results establish entity-level evidence selection as a practical scoring principle for compositional multimodal retrieval.

</details>


### [172] [Now You See Them, Now You Dont FusionGhost Gait for Occlusion-Robust Gait Recognition with ArabGait dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00780)
*Seba Al Mokdad,Tamer Shanableh,Reham Mohamed Aburas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ArabGait 数据集揭示海湾服饰下骨架步态识别的失败主因是下肢遮挡导致的姿态退化，并提出轻量级 FusionGhost-Gait 模型在跨服饰场景取得 67.91% Rank-1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 骨架步态识别对表观变化更鲁棒，但依赖稳定的姿态提取。在海湾服饰（Kandoora/Abaya）条件下，主要失败模式由表观变化转变为严重遮挡引起的下肢姿态退化，而现有研究缺乏针对该场景的数据与模型。

Method: 构建 ArabGait 室内多视角数据集（45 名受试者、4 种行走条件、3 个视角，含 Protocol A/B）；提出 FusionGhost-Gait，在单一残差单元中融合空间图卷积块与时间建模，去除冗余通道投影，采用紧凑时间 Ghost 卷积核作为轻量正则化以应对姿态噪声轨迹，同时保持高效时间下采样。

Result: 海湾服饰使下肢平均置信度由 0.811 降至 0.683，下肢失败率由 7.98% 升至 17.82%，踝部受影响最大。ArabGait 跨服饰评测中 FusionGhost-Gait 最高达 67.91% Rank-1，参数量 108,970–133,674，计算量 0.035–0.052 GFLOPs，相比基线参数量减少 65% 以上、FLOPs 降低 75%。

Conclusion: 该模型在具有挑战性的海湾服饰条件下具备良好泛化能力，且保持轻量、可部署，适用于监控与门禁生物识别系统。

Abstract: Skeleton-based gait recognition is generally more robust to appearance changes than pixel-based methods, but this robustness depends on stable pose extraction.
