Clothing variation in gait recognition includes changes in garments, silhouette, and carried items; under Gulf clothing (Kandoora/Abaya), the dominant failure mode shifts from appearance change to lower-limb pose degradation caused by severe occlusion. To study this regime, we introduce ArabGait, a 45-subject indoor multi-view dataset with four walking conditions across three viewpoints, and show that Gulf clothing lowers mean lower-limb confidence from 0.811 to 0.683 and raises lower-limb failure rate from 7.98% to 17.82%, with ankles most affected. We propose FusionGhost-Gait, a fused spatiotemporal architecture that integrates spatial graph blocks and temporal modeling in one residual unit, removes redundant channel projections, and uses compact temporal Ghost kernels as a lightweight regularization mechanism for pose-noisy trajectories while preserving efficient temporal downsampling. On ArabGait cross-clothing evaluation, including Protocol A and Protocol B, FusionGhost-Gait reaches up to 67.91% Rank-1 while remaining compact (108,970- 133,674 parameters and 0.035-0.052 billion floating-point operations (GFLOPs)), achieving more than 65% fewer parameters and 75% lower FLOPs than existing baselines. These results indicate that the proposed model generalizes effectively to challenging Gulf-clothing conditions while remaining lightweight and deployable for surveillance and access-control biometric systems.

</details>


### [173] [DramaVQA: Probing Detailed Understanding of Ultra-Long TV Dramas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00769)
*Xinyue Huo,Pengfei Chen,Jiannan Ge,Kaiwen Duan,Jiacheng Shao,Yunning Cao,Lingxi Xie,Qi Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 DramaVQA——基于长篇电视剧构建的超长视频理解基准，含约2万条QA对，规模超出 Video-MME、LVBench 一个数量级，并引入多级时间结构与"LLM辅助生成+严格人工校验"的可扩展标注流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长视频理解基准多集中短视频或小时级视频，缺乏对数十小时级超长视频理解的评估手段，评测空白明显。

Method: 以长篇电视剧为素材构建大规模基准：采用可扩展的LLM辅助标注流水线，由多模态大模型（MLLMs）生成复杂问题，再经严格人工检查保证质量；同时设计多级时间结构，查询覆盖不同视频时长，最难题目需对整部剧集进行整体理解。

Result: 共约20K条QA对，规模较 Video-MME、LVBench 等已有长视频数据集高一个数量级；广泛评测显示当前先进MLLMs在此类超长视频上表现不佳，面临重大挑战。

Conclusion: DramaVQA填补了超长视频理解评测的空白，结果表明需要具备长期记忆管理能力的智能体式AI算法（agentic AI）来应对超长视频理解任务。项目已开源。

Abstract: Despite recent progress in long-form video understanding, current benchmarks mostly focus on short clips or hour-scale videos. This leaves a major gap in evaluating ultra-long video understanding, where videos often last tens of hours. To bridge this gap, we introduce DramaVQA, a large-scale benchmark built upon long-form TV dramas. Containing approximately 20K question-answering (QA) pairs, the scale of DramaVQA exceeds previous long-video datasets, such as Video-MME and LVBench, by an order of magnitude. Our benchmark has two main features that make it stand out from existing datasets. First, we establish a scalable, LLM-assisted annotation pipeline that uses multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to generate complex questions, followed by strict human checking to ensure high data quality. Second, DramaVQA introduces a multi-level time structure; queries are designed across different video lengths, with the hardest questions requiring overall understanding across the entire drama. Extensive evaluations show that state-of-the-art MLLMs face major challenges when tested on these very long videos, highlighting the need for agentic AI algorithms capable of managing long-term memory. The project is available at https://github.com/xinyuehuo/DramaVQA

</details>


### [174] [dKV Forcing: Separating Generation and Memory Representations through a Differentiable KV Cache](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01648)
*Zhiqi Li,Bo Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 dKV Forcing，将因果视频生成器中的"记忆写入"建模为可微的专用表征，通过持久化可微页面缓存在一次时序遍历中精确计算记忆梯度，以低开销学习写到未来读的KV记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 因果视频生成器每段存在两种KV：去噪时使用的KV与写入缓存供后续段读取的KV，二者在预训练模型中已显著不同，后续段对其注意力方式也不同；若用生成KV替换写入KV会降低续写质量。因此写入记忆应从其未来用途中学习，但常规可变缓存无法提供穿过缓存的梯度。

Method: dKV Forcing:在共享主干上添加写入器专用的低秩残差，将记忆写入与生成解耦；用持久化可微页面(persistent differentiable pages)+局部重物化(local rematerialization)替代训练期可变缓存，在单次时序遍历中精确计算与两遍重建目标等价的梯度。

Result: 单次遍历即获得完整记忆梯度，相较detached-write训练仅增加7%生成器更新开销，常驻内存减少28%，训练周期缩短20.8%（对比两遍重建）。相比SGF，VBench-Long美学质量在60s提升6.6分、240s提升8.5分，主体与背景一致性最佳；残差rollout dropout可保留大部分增益并恢复无写入梯度训练的运动性。

Conclusion: 写入记忆应从未来读取中学习，且可通过可微页面缓存在单次遍历中高效精确实现；写入器低秩残差显著提升长视频生成质量与一致性，兼具训练效率优势。

Abstract: A causal video generator produces two key--value (KV) states for every segment: the KV it uses while denoising that segment, and the KV it writes into the cache for later segments to read. In a pretrained generator the two already differ substantially, later segments attend to them differently, and replacing the written KV with the generation KV degrades the continuation. We propose dKV Forcing (dKV denotes differentiable KV) to learn a dedicated memory representation from its future use: a writer-specific low-rank residual on the shared backbone separates memory writing from generation and is trained through the future reads of what it writes. Learning a write from its future use needs gradients through the cache, which the mutable cache in common use cannot provide. dKV Forcing replaces the training-time cache by persistent differentiable pages with local rematerialization and, in one temporal traversal, computes exactly the gradient that a two-pass reconstruction of the same objective computes. One traversal computes the full memory gradient at $7\%$ generator-update overhead over detached-write training, with $28\%$ less resident memory and $20.8\%$ shorter training cycles than the two-pass reconstruction. Over Self Gradient Forcing (SGF), the same objective trained with the same traversal, writer adaptation raises VBench-Long aesthetic quality by $6.6$ points at 60\,s and $8.5$ points at 240\,s with the highest subject and background consistency, and rollout dropout of the residual keeps most of this gain while restoring the motion of training without write gradients.

</details>


### [175] [Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Urdu Nastaliq Handwriting Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01635)
*Haseeb Yaqoob,Fatima Azfar,Emaan Arif Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文在UNHD乌尔都语Nastaliq手写数据集上零样本评测6个系统（Tesseract、印刷体专用识别器UTRNet-Large、2个开源VLM、2个商用VLM），并考察VLM作为OCR后校正器的增益及其条件依赖性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Nastaliq连写体无固定基线与清晰字界，手写识别困难；同时缺乏对通用VLM在低资源手写文字上零样本能力的系统对标，也缺少对"VLM纠错"是否真正独立于其自身读图能力的量化分析。

Method: Part A：2465张单行图像，六系统均不做微调，四个VLM使用统一固定提示词（可配置时temperature=0，Claude Sonnet 5无法配置解码）。Part B：VLM以源图像+外部OCR噪声文本为输入进行纠错，将纠错收益与该模型自身直接识别能力分离，分别在Tesseract与UTRNet输出上测量。

Result: 两个商用VLM的错误率低于印刷体识别器UTRNet-Large和两个开源VLM；归纳出排名系统间三类失败模式，其一为商用模型对少数极难辨图像明确拒绝转写而非猜测。Part B中纠错收益在Tesseract输出上仅0.7%–7.4%，仅在两个商用校正器处理UTRNet文本时达17.9%与21.9%，且较弱校正器可能使原本较可读的文本变差。

Conclusion: 评测刻画的是零样本行为而非SOTA（未对比手写训练专用识别器）；VLM纠错收益高度依赖所给文本的可读性与校正器能力，并非稳定增益，需区别对待"读图能力"与"纠错能力"。

Abstract: Handwritten Urdu is hard to recognize because the cursive Nastaliq script has no fixed baseline and no clear character boundaries. We benchmark six systems on the Urdu Nastaliq Handwritten Dataset (UNHD): Tesseract (default configuration), a script-specific recognizer trained on printed Urdu (UTRNet-Large), two open-source vision-language models (VLMs), and two commercial VLMs. All six systems are evaluated without fine-tuning on 2,465 single-line images (Part A), and the four VLMs receive the same fixed prompt (decoding uses temperature 0 where configurable, except for Claude Sonnet 5, whose decoding cannot be configured). Both commercial VLMs reach lower error than the printed-Urdu recognizer and the open-source VLMs. We do not compare against handwriting-trained recognizers, which would likely do better in-domain; we characterize zero-shot behavior, not state of the art. We also describe three distinct failure modes among the ranked systems. In one of them, a commercial model explicitly declines to transcribe a few very hard-to-read images instead of guessing. In a second study (Part B), VLMs correct the output of a separate OCR system using both the source image and the noisy text. Once separated from each model's own reading ability, the benefit is small on Tesseract's output (0.7% to 7.4%) and larger (17.9% and 21.9%) only for the two commercial correctors given UTRNet's text. It appears to depend on how legible the supplied text already is, and a weaker corrector can make a more legible text worse.

</details>


### [176] [EgoMo3R: Joint Egocentric Motion and Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01627)
*Chaitanya Patel,Yusuke Kato,Rin Takahira,Kazuki Kozuka,Juan Carlos Niebles,Ehsan Adeli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EgoMo3R：面向随意第一视角视频的人体运动与场景几何联合优化框架


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 第一视角视频中的整体3D人体运动重建与环境几何理解对AR/VR与机器人应用至关重要，但现有方法将二者分离处理：第一视角运动重建通常依赖专用惯性传感器提供的度量、重力对齐相机轨迹，而从单目视频中恢复此类轨迹因快速头部运动与运动模糊而极具挑战。

Method: 提出EgoMo3R联合优化框架，同时重建3D人体运动与场景几何。方法利用低层视几何原语（单目深度、光流、点轨迹）的鲁棒性，并通过一阶优化与扩散式人体运动先验耦合。采用交替优化方案建立协同反馈回路：场景重建为运动先验提供物理锚定与轨迹条件，运动先验反过来正则化相机轨迹并将场景锚定至度量、重力对齐的世界坐标系。

Result: 在EgoExo4D与Nymeria数据集的高动态序列上评估，EgoMo3R在3D场景重建与第一视角运动估计两方面均优于专用基线方法。

Conclusion: 将人体运动重建与场景重建从分离处理转为联合优化，可借助低层几何原语与运动先验的相互约束，在无需惯性传感器的情况下从随意第一视角视频中获得度量尺度、重力对齐的结果。

Abstract: Understanding holistic 3D human motion and the surrounding environment from egocentric video is fundamental for applications in AR/VR and robotics. Although these tasks are inherently coupled, existing methods treat them separately. In particular, egocentric motion reconstruction methods typically assume access to metric, gravity-aligned camera trajectories from specialized inertial sensors. Recovering such trajectories from monocular egocentric video remains a significant challenge due to rapid head movements and motion blur. We present EgoMo3R, a joint optimization framework that simultaneously reconstructs 3D human motion and scene geometry from casual egocentric video. It leverages the robustness of low-level visuo-geometric primitives, including monocular depth, optical flow, and point tracks, integrated with a diffusion-based human motion prior via first-order optimization. We propose an alternating optimization scheme that establishes a synergistic feedback loop: scene reconstruction provides physical grounding and trajectory conditioning for the motion prior, while the motion prior regularizes the camera trajectory and anchors the scene in a metric, gravity-aligned world frame. We evaluate EgoMo3R on the highly dynamic sequences of the EgoExo4D and Nymeria datasets and show that it outperforms specialized baselines in both 3D scene reconstruction and egocentric motion estimation.

</details>


### [177] [GSExplorer: Interactive World Generation with a Persistent 3D Gaussian World State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01543)
*Sicheng Yu,Liu Liu,Xinjie Wang,Xinjiang Wang,Taojun Ding,Wenhao Hu,Beizhen Zhao,Puxin Yan,Zhizhong Su,Hao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GSExplorer，以持久化3D高斯世界状态为核心，构建"生成—重建"闭环框架，实现长程可交互世界生成中的局部控制与场景一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式世界生成需兼顾精确局部控制与长序列 rollout 的场景一致性。现有方法通过相机/几何条件提升局部生成、以记忆机制扩展历史上下文，但长程探索时目标视角引导不完整、重复场景更新导致不一致累积。

Method: 1）以持续维护的3DGS场景作为世界状态，每步为条件驱动视频生成器提供多模态渲染条件；2）相机几何通过独立的Relative Ray Encoding分支注入；3）生成视频回馈至基于SLAM的重建后端，采用不一致性过滤防止冲突内容污染场景，并用跨chunk bundle adjustment提升多步空间对齐；4）设计数据构造管线模拟3DGS在场景外推时的真实退化，生成293K对"退化多模态渲染—真实目标视频"训练样本。

Result: 在单步与三步WorldScore评测中综合性能最优，两种设置下相机控制与一致性均表现强，单步外推Camera Control得分99.07；在481帧leave-and-return rollout中展现较强的回访一致性。

Conclusion: 维护可靠的3D世界状态对持续探索具有重要价值，生成—重建闭环框架可有效缓解长程不一致累积。

Abstract: Interactive world generation requires both accurate local control and stable scene consistency over long rollouts. Existing methods improve local generation through camera or geometry conditioning and extend historical context with memory mechanisms. However, long-horizon exploration remains challenging as target-view guidance becomes incomplete and inconsistencies accumulate across repeated scene updates. We present \textbf{GSExplorer}, a generation--reconstruction framework built around a persistent 3D Gaussian world state. At each step, the current 3DGS scene provides multimodal rendering conditions for a condition-driven video generator, while camera geometry is injected through a separate Relative Ray Encoding branch. Generated videos are then fed back to a SLAM-based reconstruction backend, where inconsistency filtering prevents conflicting content from corrupting the scene and cross-chunk bundle adjustment improves spatial alignment across generation steps. We further design a data-construction pipeline that reproduces realistic 3DGS degradation during scene extrapolation, yielding 293K training pairs of degraded multimodal renderings and real target videos. GSExplorer achieves the best overall performance among the compared methods on both single-step and three-step WorldScore evaluation, with strong camera control and consistency across both settings, including a Camera Control score of 99.07 in single-step extrapolation. On 481-frame leave-and-return rollouts, it also shows strong revisit consistency, demonstrating the value of maintaining a reliable 3D world state for continued exploration.

</details>


### [178] [Vision-language classification of Torsades de Pointes risk from pseudo-coloured ECG images: do T-wave morphology and colour context help or hinder?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01921)
*Dario Labrador Alonso,Alaa Alahmadi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究以BiomedCLIP在ECG图像上的分类任务为例，解耦图像色彩通道与提示词色彩通道，证明对信号渲染图像任务，性能增益主要来自"如何绘制信号"而非"如何描述信号"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 上下文提示（contextual prompting）被认为是提升视觉模型性能的低成本途径，但其证据多来自属性同时出现在提示词与图像中的基准测试，两条信息通道相互混淆，无法判断收益究竟来自图像内容还是语言描述。

Method: 沿用前作将ECG信号经QT列线图与伪彩色技术渲染为彩色增强图像以标记Torsades de Pointes风险；在9,789张图像上，将4种上下文策略×4种T波形态标签集交叉组合，分别进行零样本评估与类别均衡线性探针评估，采用五折分层交叉验证。

Result: 零样本推理不可用。训练后彩色增强图像在所有指标上优于无色图像：平衡准确率0.903 vs 0.825，敏感度0.914 vs 0.827，特异度0.892 vs 0.823，ROC-AUC 0.955 vs 0.888，MCC 0.437 vs 0.311。交叉设计有效分离混淆通道：图像贡献+0.126 MCC（+0.078平衡准确率、+0.067 ROC-AUC），与提示词是否命名颜色无关；而命名颜色在任何指标下均无影响。上下文具有双向性：最佳提示集在有/无颜色时分别带来0.008与0.016 MCC增益，最差提示集则分别损失0.017与0.013。

Conclusion: 对以图像形式呈现的信号，增益杠杆在于信号绘制方式而非语言描述方式；当预测目标为区间测量量时，以T波形态命名的提示词描述的是错误的目标量。

Abstract: Contextual prompting is widely presented as a cheap route to better performance from vision models, but the evidence comes largely from benchmarks in which an attribute named in a prompt is also present in the image, confounding the two channels. We investigate the significance of context for a semantically complex biomedical signal classification task using a domain-adapted vision-language model, BiomedCLIP. Building on our previous work that renders electrocardiogram (ECG) signals as colour-enhanced images to flag Torsades de Pointes risk using the QT-nomogram and pseudo-colouring technique, we cross four context strategies with four T-wave morphology label sets, evaluated zero-shot and with a class-balanced linear probe, under five-fold stratified cross-validation on 9,789 images. Zero-shot inference is unusable. Once trained, the colour-enhanced images outperform the colourless ones on every metric: balanced accuracy 0.903 versus 0.825, sensitivity 0.914 versus 0.827, specificity 0.892 versus 0.823, ROC-AUC 0.955 versus 0.888 and Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) 0.437 versus 0.311. Crossing colour-in-image with colour-in-prompt separates the confounded channels: the image contributes +0.126 MCC (+0.078 balanced accuracy, +0.067 ROC-AUC) whether or not the prompt names colour, whereas naming it changes nothing under any metric. Context is two-sided: the best prompt set gains 0.008 MCC where colour is present and 0.016 where it is not, while the worst loses 0.017 and 0.013. For a signal rendered as an image, the leverage lies in how the signal is drawn rather than in how it is described - and where the endpoint is an interval measurement, prompts naming T-wave morphology describe the wrong quantity.

</details>


### [179] [Online Active Learning Architecture for Safety-Critical Control Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01907)
*Shuiwen Shen,Jinhua Zhang,Yan Wang,Huanqiang Zeng,Yueyun Xu,Song Gao,Haifeng Xiang,Yifu Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Control AI——一种受生物智能"预测-评估-修正"连续过程启发的在线主动学习（OAL）架构，通过跨重构机制防止恒等映射塌缩，并给出多种变体以支持大规模部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统离线训练范式在开放世界环境中存在局限，阻碍了信息中心人工智能向安全关键应用迁移；因此需要能够在运行中持续自适应的学习架构。

Method: 将深度神经网络的分层表示能力与自适应控制的实时误差反馈调节相结合：预测模型将感知输入映射到潜流形，可选的潜模型表示该空间中的状态转移，重构模型将潜状态映射回可观测信号；预测与实测间的残差构成内部学习信号。采用空间与时间交叉重构防止 OAL 塌缩为平凡恒等映射；提出耦合型、双路型、局部化变体以缩短误差传递路径，并通过引导反向传播与目标反向传播实现局部化预测编码式 OAL，另设混合与缩放变体支持高维部署。

Result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果；所述为概念反馈回路到实用大规模配置的架构演进与设计论证。

Conclusion: 交叉重构是避免 OAL 退化的关键设计；局部化与混合、缩放变体为高维场景下的可扩展在线主动学习提供了可行路径。

Abstract: The transition of information-centric artificial intelligence to safety-critical applications is impeded by the limitations of conventional offline-training paradigms in open-world environments. This paper presents Control AI, an architecture for Online Active Learning (OAL) inspired by the continuous Prediction-Evaluation-Correction process of biological intelligence. The framework combines the hierarchical representation capacity of deep neural networks with the real-time error-feedback adaptation of adaptive control. A prediction model maps sensory input into a latent manifold, an optional latent model represents transitions in that space, and a reconstruction model maps the latent state back to observable signals. Residuals between predictions and measurements provide the internal learning signal. Spatial and temporal cross-reconstruction architectures prevent OAL from collapsing to a trivial identity mapping, while coupled, dual, and localized variants shorten error-transmission paths. Localized predictive coding style OAL is implemented through guidance-backpropagation and target-backpropagation architectures, and hybrid and scaled variants support high-dimensional deployment. The paper focuses on the architectural rationale and the progression from a conceptual feedback loop to practical large-scale configurations.

</details>


### [180] [Systematic Evaluation of Robustness in Fine-tuned Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01900)
*Angela John,Hamayoon Behmanush*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文系统评测不同数据集与攻击类型下微调预训练模型的鲁棒性，考察ResNet50、DenseNet、MobileNet在干净与对抗数据上的表现，为图像分类任务选择预训练模型提供依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究人员在选择图像分类预训练模型时缺乏针对性指导，尤其缺少对模型在受攻击情况下鲁棒性的系统认识，因此在兼顾算力、内存、干净精度等因素时难以做出合理取舍。

Method: 对预训练模型进行带权重的微调，使用MNIST、CIFAR10、CIFAR100、SVHN等公开图像数据集；分别在无攻击数据和多种攻击情形下评测模型，比较不同数据分布与样本规模对鲁棒性的影响，并对比ResNet50、DenseNet与MobileNet的表现。

Result: 微调模型的鲁棒性随数据分布和样本量变化而不同；ResNet50、DenseNet、MobileNet在不同数据集上抵御攻击的能力存在明显差异，说明需依据具体任务需求进行定制化模型选择。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了微调预训练模型鲁棒性的差异性，为图像分类实际应用中预训练模型的适用性选择提供了参考，并强调应按任务需求与资源约束做针对性选型。

Abstract: Our study systematically evaluates the robustness of fine-tuned pre-trained models across different datasets and attack types, aiming to provide insights for researchers in selecting pre-trained models for image classification tasks while prioritizing robustness against potential attacks. Our work explores the influence of fine-tuning pre-trained models with different datasets and attack types on their robustness and overview of the appropriate pre-trained model for image classification based on factors such as computation resources, memory usage, and accuracy on clean data. We fine-tune the models with weights. Evaluate the models on data before any attack and after different attack cases. The study utilizes publicly available image datasets such as MNIST, CIFAR10, CIFAR100, and SVHN to assess the robustness of pre-trained models. The results indicate that the robustness of fine-tuned models varies across different data distributions and sample sizes, emphasizing the need for tailored selection based on specific task requirements. The findings also highlight the varying performance of ResNet50, DenseNet, and MobileNet in defending against attacks on different datasets. Overall, this research provides valuable insights into the robustness of fine-tuned pre-trained models and their suitability for real-world applications in image classification.

</details>


### [181] [Biological Congruence: Evaluating Microscopy Generation Across Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01850)
*Duway Nicolas Lesmes-Leon,Shumpei Takezaki,Fabian Schmeisser,Ryoma Bise,Gillian Lovell,Bianca Migliori,Andreas Dengel,Sheraz Ahmed*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出"生物一致性"（biological congruence）评价原则，用一个文本条件扩散框架同时生成显微图像与实例掩码，从提示-掩码、提示-图像、图像-掩码及群体水平四方面考察生成数据是否在各表征间形成一致且符合经验生物学语境的信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成模型评估主要衡量视觉保真度与分布覆盖，无法刻画合成数据所承载的生物学信息是否真实、自洽；需要一种关系型评价视角来判断生成样本中的生物状态是否跨表征一致并与真实生物语境相符。

Method: 提出"生物一致性"评价原则，并构建文本条件扩散框架，联合生成显微图像与实例掩码，使同一生成生物状态同时体现在条件文本、视觉外观与实例结构三个通道；随后开展提示—掩码、提示—图像、图像—掩码及群体水平的一致性分析，并进行逐渐引入不受支持表型组合的压力测试。

Result: 各生物学特征表现高度依赖特征类型：密度与汇合度稳定保持；形态学出现反复不一致；最近邻距离显示强图像—掩码一致性可与较弱的条件遵循性和群体保真度并存。压力测试中，目标可控性可提升，但非目标表型发生重组，完整生成状态趋向更受真实数据支持的构型。

Conclusion: 生成质量、可控性、跨表征一致性与群体保真度刻画的是互补属性，不能相互替代；生物一致性提供了一个关系型评价视角，用于评估面向科学发现的生成模型。

Abstract: Generative models increasingly produce realistic microscopy images, yet conventional evaluation primarily characterizes visual fidelity and distributional coverage rather than the biological information represented by synthetic data. We introduce biological congruence as an evaluation principle describing whether biologically relevant information forms a coherent description across representations and remains consistent with its empirical biological context. To study this principle, we develop a text-conditioned diffusion framework that jointly generates microscopy images and instance masks, exposing the same generated biological state through conditioning, visual appearance, and instance structure. Across prompt--mask, prompt--image, image--mask, and population-level analyses, we find strongly feature-dependent behavior: density and confluency are consistently preserved, morphology exhibits recurrent disagreement, while nearest-neighbor distance reveals that strong image--mask agreement can coexist with weaker conditioning and population fidelity. Stress testing increasingly unsupported phenotype combinations further shows that target controllability can increase while untargeted phenotypes reorganize and the complete generated state moves toward configurations better supported by real data. These findings demonstrate that generative quality, controllability, cross-representation agreement, and population fidelity capture complementary properties, motivating biological congruence as a relational perspective for evaluating scientific generative models.

</details>


### [182] [RCFormer: Reliability-aware Context Transformer for Occlusion-Robust Facial Landmark Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01822)
*Ashish Kumar,Prashant Kumar,Mallika Garg*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出可靠性感知上下文Transformer（RCFormer），通过可见性引导的潜在图块恢复改善遮挡鲁棒的人脸关键点检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常规成像条件下人脸关键点检测已较成熟，但遮挡、差光照和大姿态会导致局部人脸证据不完整或具误导性；已有的上下文引导潜在图块恢复方法存在三个缺陷：上下文对输入人脸适配弱、受损坏邻域图块影响、融合时未保持局部空间连贯性。

Method: RCFormer包含三个可靠性导向组件：VCC（可见上下文条件化），用可见性加权的全局面部摘要自适应调整上下文表示；VGCA（可见性引导上下文聚合），在注意力中降低不可靠源图块的影响；SRC（空间残差校正），利用邻域图块信息精炼融合后的潜在特征。恢复的热图作为可靠性感知的结构线索接入现有检测网络。

Result: 在WFLW、COFW、300W数据集上，RCFormer改善了热图恢复质量，并取得较强的关键点定位性能。

Conclusion: 将可见性/可靠性建模显式引入上下文恢复与聚合过程，可有效缓解遮挡条件下的误差，且恢复热图可作为即插即用的结构先验增强现有检测器。

Abstract: Facial landmark detection has advanced substantially under regular imaging conditions, yet occlusion, poor illumination, and large pose changes remain major sources of error because local facial evidence can become incomplete or misleading. Context-guided latent patch recovery offers a promising way to address this issue by inferring unreliable patch representations from surrounding facial context before heatmap prediction. However, the recovered context can itself be unreliable when it is weakly adapted to the input face, influenced by corrupted neighboring patches, or blended without preserving local spatial coherence. We propose RCFormer, a Reliability-aware Context Transformer for occlusion-robust facial landmark detection. RCFormer strengthens latent patch recovery with three reliability-oriented components: visible-context conditioning (VCC), which adapts the context representation using a visibility-weighted global facial summary; visibility-guided context aggregation (VGCA), which reduces the influence of unreliable source patches during attention; and spatial residual correction (SRC), which refines blended latent features using neighboring patch information. The recovered heatmaps are then used as reliability-aware structural cues for existing landmark detection networks. Experiments show that RCFormer improves heatmap recovery and achieves strong landmark localization results on the WFLW, COFW, and 300W datasets.

</details>


### [183] [Teleoperation System for Service Robots using Virtual Reality Headset and Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01759)
*Eduardo Fernandes,Tiago Ribeiro,Antonio Ribeiro,Carolina Lopes,Gil Lopes,Fernando Ribeiro*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出融合人体姿态估计与VR的服务机器人遥操作系统：用Mediapipe做2D检测并结合RealSense D455的RGB-D数据实现3D人体姿态估计，映射至机器人运动学实现直观远程操控，配VR界面增强临场感，并在CHARMIE机器人上以物体操作任务验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 服务机器人需在复杂动态环境中作业，传统遥操作接口不够直观、操作者情境感知差，因此需要更自然、沉浸的远程控制方式。

Method: Mediapipe框架完成2D人体姿态检测，融合Intel RealSense D455的RGB-D数据扩展为完整3D姿态估计；提出实时关节角计算算法，将人体姿态映射到机器人运动学；开发VR界面提供沉浸式视角。

Result: 在CHARMIE服务机器人上开展真实世界实验，在物体操作任务中验证了系统有效性；同时暴露出腕部偏航等关节角捕捉不准确、人-机器人运动映射精度不足的问题。

Conclusion: VR遥操作方案具备可行性与潜力；后续将引入IMU改善旋转跟踪并采用更先进的控制算法，以提升映射精度，推动服务机器人在复杂动态环境中的部署。

Abstract: This paper presents a teleoperation system for service robots that integrates human pose estimation with virtual reality (VR) to enable intuitive remote control. By using the Mediapipe framework for 2D pose detection and extending it with RGB-D data from the Intel RealSense D455 camera, a comprehensive 3D human pose estimation is achieved. This data is then mapped to the robot's kinematics, allowing the operator to control the robot's movements naturally. A VR interface was developed to provide an immersive perspective, enhancing the operator's situational awareness. Real-world experiments were conducted using the CHARMIE service robot to validate the system's effectiveness in tasks involving object manipulation. While the current system successfully demonstrates the potential of VR-based teleoperation, challenges remain in accurately capturing certain joint angles (e.g., wrist yaw) and ensuring precise mapping between human and robot movements. Future work includes the integration of inertial measurement units (IMUs) for improved rotational tracking and the implementation of more advanced control algorithms. Overall, this research contributes to the development of more intuitive and effective teleoperation systems for service robots, facilitating their deployment in complex and dynamic environments. This work further introduces a novel approach to teleoperation by combining RGB-D sensing with an innovative algorithm for real-time joint angle computation using Mediapipe, enhancing the precision of human-robot motion mapping and enabling immersive control through a VR interface. These contributions represent significant advancements in the field of human-robot interaction, particularly for service robot applications.

</details>


### [184] [ContactCut: A Partition-Aware Contact Selection Framework for False-Merge Correction in Connectomics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01457)
*Byunghyun Ko,Won-Ki Jeong,Chaoli Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"三维原生分区感知接触选择"问题，用ContactCut（CC-Auto与CC-Search）实现局部错误合并的可执行3D分区修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连接组学中的局部假合并修正需要把已识别错误转化为可执行的原生3D分区，但中间修正预测与种子图求解器本身都无法决定哪些原生source-sink约束应定义该分区。

Method: 形式化为3D原生分区感知接触选择：依据候选接触所诱导的完整分区进行选择。CC-Auto采用可学习的单接触选择；CC-Search进行有界成对接触搜索、生成紧凑候选方案并施加可学习的候选面板排序。

Result: 在MICrONS与FlyWire历史双向假合并修正上，CC-Auto的FA-3D Part. mIoU较最强图方法基线提升5.9与3.4点，较最佳学习基线提升12.5与10.0点；MICrONS训练的排序器迁移到FlyWire几乎无性能退化；CC-Search扩展了oracle可达性并优先给出近oracle方案。

Conclusion: 以分区级评估驱动的接触选择优于图求解器与单接触预测，且排序器具备跨数据集迁移性；代码已开源。

Abstract: Localized false-merge correction in connectomics requires converting an identified error into an executable native 3D partition. Still, neither intermediate correction predictions nor seeded graph solvers alone determine which native source-sink constraints should define that partition. We formulate this problem as a 3D-native partition-aware contact selection problem: selecting candidate contacts based on the complete partitions they induce. Our solution comprises two components: ContactCut (CC)-Auto, which uses learned single-contact selection, and ContactCut (CC)-Search, which enables bounded paired-contact search, generates compact alternatives, and applies learned panel ranking. On historical two-way false-merge corrections from MICrONS and FlyWire, CC-Auto improves failure-aware 3D partition (FA-3D Part.) mIoU by 5.9 and 3.4 points over the strongest graph-based controls and by 12.5 and 10.0 points over the best learned baselines. A MICrONS-trained ranker transfers to FlyWire with negligible degradation. CC-Search expands oracle reachability and prioritizes near-oracle alternatives. The code is available at https://github.com/bentake/ContactCut.

</details>


### [185] [SpecUltra: A Unified Foundation Model for Heterogeneous Spectral Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01396)
*Weili Kong,Baisen Liu,Xiaojun Bi,Jiaming Pei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 SpecUltra——面向异构光谱图像（HSI/MSI）的统一基础模型。将不同传感器观测视为同一连续光谱的不同采样过程，用3D卷积tokenization与波长感知3D RoPE在共享坐标系统中建模；构建MultiHyper-200K大规模多传感器HSI数据集，采用辅助token辅助的掩码图像建模预训练，并提出光谱核变换（SKT）将HSI预训练知识迁移到MSI，在多个分类与分割基准上取得SOTA或可比性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高光谱（HSI）与多光谱（MSI）在波段数、波长、光谱分辨率上差异巨大，导致难以统一建模与跨传感器迁移。作者从成像物理出发，指出这些异构观测本质上是同一连续光谱经不同采样过程得到的离散测量，因此有条件在共享的光谱-空间坐标系下统一表征。

Method: 1）3D卷积tokenization + 波长感知3D RoPE，编码相对波长与空间关系，实现共享坐标系下的细粒度空间-光谱建模；2）构建MultiHyper-200K大规模多传感器HSI数据集；3）预训练采用辅助token辅助的MIM：level token标识辐射产品类型，register token吸收传感器与采集相关变异；4）提出Spectral Kernel Transformation（SKT），用细粒度HSI预训练核切片构造MSI嵌入核，在参数空间迁移知识，弥合HSI-MSI光谱粒度差且保持与预训练骨干兼容。

Result: 在HSI与MSI分类与分割基准上，跨不同传感器与下游任务均取得SOTA或具竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 以"连续光谱离散采样"为统一视角，可在单一基础模型中有效处理异构光谱图像，并通过参数空间的光谱核变换实现HSI→MSI知识迁移，验证了统一光谱基础模型的可行性与跨传感器泛化能力。

Abstract: Spectral imagery, including hyperspectral image (HSI) and multispectral image (MSI), exhibits substantial heterogeneity in band numbers, wavelengths, spectral resolutions, hindering unified modeling and cross-sensor transfer. From the perspective of imaging physics, these heterogeneous observations can be regarded as discrete measurements of an underlying continuous spectrum acquired through different sampling processes. Motivated by this perspective, we propose SpecUltra, a unified foundation model for heterogeneous spectral images. Specifically, SpecUltra employs 3D convolutional tokenization and wavelength-aware 3D RoPE to encode relative wavelength and spatial relationships, enabling fine-grained spatial-spectral modeling within a shared coordinate system. We further construct MultiHyper-200K, a large-scale multi-sensor HSI dataset, and pretrain SpecUltra using auxiliary-token-assisted mask image modeling (MIM), where a level token indicates the radiometric product type and register tokens absorb sensor- and acquisition-dependent variations. To bridge the spectral-granularity gap between HSI and MSI, we introduce Spectral Kernel Transformation (SKT), which transfers pretrained knowledge in parameter space by constructing MSI embedding kernels from fine-grained HSI-pretrained kernel slices. This design preserves pretrained spectral priors while maintaining compatibility with the pretrained backbone. Experiments on HSI and MSI classification and segmentation benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art or competitive performance across disparate sensors and downstream tasks.

</details>


### [186] [Zero-shot evaluation of open vision-language models as System 1 decision models on radiology tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01631)
*Bradley J Erickson,Sara Salehi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在7项放射学任务（文本解读3项、影像检出4项）上对比Clef 27B、Qwen3.8-27B与d1 3B三种多模态模型，以AUROC为主要终点，发现在低算力下System 1模型可达到接近LLM的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估"System 1"式单步决策模型能否在放射学任务中以更低计算成本替代常规用法下的LLM，并明确其适用边界（文本 vs 影像、单问题 vs 多问题）。

Method: 无微调条件下比较Clef、Qwen3.8-27B与d1；任务包括：CT-RATE胸CT报告与PadChest胸片报告中的征象存在性判断、CT-RATE 3D体积上的18种征象检出、AccessGUDID器械MR安全性判定、RANZCR CLiP胸片管路位置、MR-ART T1脑MRI运动伪影严重度、BraTS 2021序列识别；主要终点为AUROC，并记录请求耗时与能耗。

Result: 所有模型均无请求失败。报告文本征象提取近乎完美（AUROC>0.95）。Clef在CT-RATE 3D体积上优于其Qwen骨干，在MR-ART与RANZCR上较低；在BraTS、GUDID、PadChest上无差异，CT-RATE报告仅差0.002。BraTS上Clef正确识别90/100例FLAIR，Qwen从未选择FLAIR。d1在7项任务中6项低于Clef。所有模型在运动伪影严重度上表现均差。多问题/单输入场景下Clef单请求更快；d1单请求能耗比Clef低3–9倍。

Conclusion: System 1模型能以高准确率、更低算力完成放射学重要任务；LLM被约束为单token回答时，其成本与性能接近System 1模型，除非输入需回答多个问题。3B System 1模型在报告文本上接近27B模型，但在影像上不接近。运动伪影严重度评估无模型表现良好。

Abstract: Purpose: We compared two multimodal System 1 decision models, Clef 27B and d1 3B, with a traditional LLM (Qwen 3.8-27B) on seven radiology tasks covering text, radiographs, CT and MRI. Methods: Three models were compared: Clef, Qwen3.8-27B and d1. Three tasks were interpretation of text and 4 were detection of finding in images. The tasks were: 1. finding presence of finding in CT-RATE chest CT reports; 2. Presence of finding in PadChest chest radiograph reports; 3. the same 18 findings on CT-RATE chest CT but 3D volumes; 4. MR safety status of devices from AccessGUDID device records; 5. line and tube position on RANZCR CLiP chest radiographs; 6. motion-artifact severity on MR-ART T1-weighted brain MRI and 7. sequence identification on BraTS 2021 brain MRI. The primary endpoint was AUROC. There was no fine-tuning of the models on the tasks. Results: All models completed all tests without a failed request. All retrieved findings from reports almost perfectly (AUROC >0.95). Clef ranked higher than its Qwen backbone on CT-RATE volumes and RANZCR lower on MR-ART. The two did not differ on BraTS, GUDID or PadChest, and differed by 0.002 on CT-RATE reports. On BraTS, Clef correctly identified 90 of 100 FLAIR volumes while Qwen never chose it. d1 ranked lower than Clef on six of seven tasks. No model performed well on motion severity. Clef was faster per request than Qwen on tasks with many questions per input. d1 used 3 to 9 times less energy per request than Clef. Conclusions: System 1 models can perform important tasks in radiology with high accuracy, at lower compute cost than LLMs used in the usual way. When an LLM is constrained to a single answer token, its cost and performance is similar to System 1 models unless multiple questions are asked. A 3B System 1 model was close to the 27B models on report text but not on images. No model performed well on motion severity.

</details>


### [187] [Spend the Bits Where the Tiny Objects Are: Rate-Utility Region Coding for Aerial Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01573)
*Yanliang Qi,Jiacheng Ding,Cong Guo,Peihua Mai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出率-效用区域编码（RUO）：当区域的期望检测效用足以证明其字节成本时即发送，可选择丢弃或低/高质量发送，单一乘子跨图像共享；无需训练模型，基于标准编解码器，解码仅需数毫秒。在VisDrone-DET test-dev全部1,610张图像上，同等微小目标AP范围内比调优的阈值式ROI编码少用42.4%比特，且优于AVIF、HEVC及三种已发表学习式编解码器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带宽受限的航拍相机需在传输前压缩图像供远端检测器寻找大量微小目标。阈值式ROI编码仅发送高置信区域，而微小目标视觉证据有限、得分偏低，常被误丢弃，导致漏检。

Method: 以“期望检测效用 vs 实测字节成本”为判据决定区域编码策略：丢弃、低质量或高质量发送；以单一乘子跨图像统一调节，无需训练模型，使用标准图像编解码器。

Result: 在1,610张测试图上，于共同微小目标AP区间平均比调优阈值式ROI少42.4%比特；对微小目标所需比特少于AVIF、HEVC及三种学习式编解码器；收发端使用不同检测器时优势仍保持；但全尺寸目标AP下需多25.4%比特。

Conclusion: RUO适用于以微小目标为任务重点的带宽受限航拍检测场景；因低码率时优先丢弃大区域，不适用于全尺寸目标精度需求。作者计划开源代码。

Abstract: Bandwidth-limited aerial cameras must compress their images before a remote detector can find the many tiny objects in them. Threshold-based region-of-interest (ROI) coding sends only confidently detected regions, and because tiny objects provide limited visual evidence and often score low, it can discard the regions that contain them. We propose rate-utility region coding (RUO), which sends a region when its expected detection utility justifies its measured byte cost, choosing to drop it or to send it at low or high quality with one multiplier shared across images. RUO trains no model, uses a standard image codec and decodes in a few milliseconds. On all 1,610 VisDrone-DET test-dev images, RUO uses 42.4% fewer bits than a tuned threshold-based ROI coder, averaged over their shared tiny-object average precision (AP) range. RUO also needs fewer bits for tiny objects than the AV1 Image File Format (AVIF), High Efficiency Video Coding (HEVC) and three published learned codecs, and its advantage over threshold-based ROI coding persists when the sender and receiver use different detectors. For AP over all object sizes RUO needs 25.4% more bits than the tuned ROI coder, because its allocation drops large regions first at low rates, so it suits tasks that target tiny objects. We plan to release the code.

</details>


### [188] [TopoDPO: Dense Preference Alignment for Structure-Sensitive Aerial Referring Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01551)
*Huaiyuan Peng,Jisheng Dang,Wencan Zhang,Jingwen Zhao,Hong Peng,Wenjun Ma,Bin Hu,Qi Tian,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TopoDPO：面向航拍指代分割的拓扑感知稠密偏好对齐框架，用连通域差异与宏角点召回挖掘偏好对，并将偏好惩罚施加于每个局部margin后再空间聚合，在Topo-RS-Hard上将IoU从50.91%提升至51.24%、Betti-0误差从1.34降至0.90。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态分割的偏好优化存在粒度失配：稠密掩码含空间异质偏好信号，而图像级目标对所有空间margin赋同一非线性权重，难以刻画结构敏感任务中的局部拓扑错误。

Method: 提出TopoDPO。Topo-Prior基于连通域差异与宏角点召回挖掘信息量高的偏好对；稠密目标在空间聚合前对每个局部margin施加偏好惩罚，并以冻结的监督参考模型为相对基准；配合匹配的监督对照与完整析因分析解耦各组件贡献。

Result: 在4590实例的结构压力集Topo-RS-Hard上，IoU由50.91%升至51.24%，Betti-0误差由1.34降至0.90；相对图像级DPO的配对图像簇bootstrap区间在全部5项指标上均不含零。对39,244条验证记录的无过滤分层显示，预对齐连通域计数误差为中/重度时结构增益最明显。

Conclusion: 稠密、拓扑感知的偏好对齐优于图像级DPO，增益集中于结构误差严重的样本；组件效应可被析因分析区分，代码已开源。

Abstract: Preference optimization for multimodal segmentation faces a granularity mismatch: dense masks contain spatially heterogeneous preference signals, whereas image-level objectives assign one shared nonlinear weight to all spatial margins. We introduce TopoDPO, a topology-aware dense preference alignment framework for structure-sensitive aerial referring segmentation. Topo-Prior mines informative preference pairs using connected-component discrepancy and macro-corner recall, while the dense objective applies the preference penalty to each local margin before spatial aggregation against a frozen supervised reference. On Topo-RS-Hard, a 4590-instance structural stress set, TopoDPO improves intersection over union (IoU) from 50.91% to 51.24% over image-level direct preference optimization (DPO) and reduces Betti-0 error from 1.34 to 0.90; paired image-cluster bootstrap intervals against image-level DPO exclude zero for all five reported metrics. Matched supervised controls and a complete factorial analysis separate the effects of topology-aware pair mining, localized correction, and dense reference-relative preference weighting. An unfiltered stratification over all 39,244 validation records further shows the clearest structural gains on samples with moderate or severe pre-alignment component-count errors. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/phy709/TopoDPO.

</details>


### [189] [MoPort: A View-Aware 2D Interface for Motion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01541)
*Lixing Tan,Qing Xia,Yuting Guo,Shuai Li,Aimin Hao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出视图感知的2D接口MoPort，使运动语言模型（MoLM）可直接接受单目视频的2D姿态序列输入，并通过配对视图对齐（PVA）与相机调制编码（CME）解决2D-3D维度鸿沟与视角模糊问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoLM以离散token建模3D人体运动，但部署到单目视频时面临两个问题：(1) 姿态检测只给出2D关节序列，与训练所用的3D运动存在维度鸿沟；(2) 2D观测随相机视角变化，且投影丢失深度导致跨视角的2D姿态具有歧义性。

Method: 提出MoPort——视图感知的2D接口。核心包括：(1) Paired View Alignment (PVA)：对同一运动的两个视图施加共享的3D教师目标，并直接约束二者latent的一致性，使不同视角的2D观测映射到一致的语义表示；(2) Camera-Modulated Encoding (CME)：从2D序列估计相机外参并用其调制编码，为2D latent注入视角几何信息。

Result: HumanML3D上R@1为0.5674，KIT-ML上为0.3286，优于所有对比基线；HumanML3D上R@1从分布内视角的0.5763仅降至分布外视角的0.5585；在三个下游MoLM上验证了可移植性；真实RGB视频数据集Fit3D上准确率达80.36%。

Conclusion: MoPort以视图对齐与相机调制编码弥合2D观测与3D运动语义之间的差距，在保持视角鲁棒性的同时取得领先性能，并具备良好的跨模型可移植性与真实视频可用性。

Abstract: Motion language models (MoLMs) encode 3D human motion as discrete tokens for language-based understanding. Deploying them on monocular video raises two problems. Pose detection yields 2D joint sequences, leaving a dimensional gap from the 3D motion used in training. Moreover, the 2D observation changes with the camera viewpoint, while the depth lost in projection makes the 2D pose ambiguous across viewpoints. We propose MoPort, a view-aware 2D interface that enables MoLMs to take 2D observations as input. We introduce Paired View Alignment (PVA), which gives two views of the same motion a shared 3D teacher target and directly constrains the consistency of their latents, so that 2D observations from different viewpoints are mapped to a consistent semantic representation. Camera-Modulated Encoding (CME) estimates the camera extrinsics from the 2D sequence and uses them to modulate encoding, providing the 2D latents with geometric information about the viewpoint. MoPort achieves R@1 of 0.5674 on HumanML3D and 0.3286 on KIT-ML, outperforming all evaluated baselines. On HumanML3D, its R@1 decreases only from 0.5763 on in-distribution viewpoints to 0.5585 on out-of-distribution viewpoints. We validate portability on three downstream MoLMs. Furthermore, on the real-world RGB video dataset Fit3D, MoPort achieves 80.36\% accuracy. Code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [190] [VLMs Read Aloud: The Gap Between Recognizing and Using Visual Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01517)
*Zhiyun Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出"读取-使用差距"(read-use gap)概念：VLM 能逐字转录图像中的文本却无法据此作答，差距源于识别与使用文本的分辨率需求不同；提出 ALOUD 方法，将视觉分辨率用于定位与识别证据、将语言 token 用于使用证据，在 5x/10x 压缩长文档上将冻结的 Qwen3-VL-8B 准确率从 27.7% 提升至 54.8%（接近原文的 58.5%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前视觉-文本压缩（把长上下文渲染成图像）以"模型能恢复多少文本"为设计中心，但可恢复的文本不等于可用文本。作者发现 VLM 即便逐字转录图像文本仍会答错，而其自述的转录稿几乎能与原文一样作答，说明压缩的真正瓶颈不是识别保真度，而是文本的使用能力。

Method: 1) 定义并量化 read-use gap：对比模型从原图与从自身转录稿作答的差异；2) 分析分辨率需求差异（Qwen3-VL-8B 识别在 15 像素字符饱和，使用需 24 像素；2B→32B 仅提升识别不缩小差距）；3) 验证"将证据转成文字"可闭合差距（thinking 模型在思维链中复述证据，其未见问题所写转录可恢复大部分思考增益）；4) 预注册留出测试中以该差距预测八个 VLM 的"自有文字 vs 像素"增益（Spearman ρ=0.86）；5) 提出 ALOUD：视觉分辨率用于定位与识别证据，语言 token 用于使用证据，且不保留源文本。

Result: 冻结的 Qwen3-VL-8B 在 5x 与 10x 压缩长文档上准确率翻倍：5x 下从 27.7%→54.8%，接近原文 58.5%，且上下文小于压缩页面本身；在低于阅读原文的成本下，于同等预算各层级均领先所有不保留原文的方法，并优于回贴原文的 AGAR 与 VERA；5x 下亦优于经训练且保留原文的 LensVLM-9B。Spearman ρ=0.86 表明 read-use gap 可预测模型从自有文字获得的增益，而识别率不能。

Conclusion: 视觉-文本压缩的瓶颈不在于模型能恢复多少文本，而在于能使用多少文本；应以"可识别+可使用"的双分辨率视角重新设计压缩，ALOUD 通过视觉承担定位识别、语言承担推理使用，在不保留原文的前提下逼近原始文本性能。

Abstract: Visual-text compression renders long contexts as images and is engineered around how much of the text a vision-language model (VLM) can recover. Yet recovered text is not usable text. VLMs can transcribe the text in an image word for word and still fail to answer from it; given back their own transcript, they answer nearly as well as from the original text. We call this difference the read-use gap. Recognizing and using visual text have different resolution requirements: Qwen3-VL-8B's recognition saturates at 15-pixel characters while use catches up only at 24 pixels, and scaling from 2B to 32B raises recognition without narrowing the gap. Putting the evidence into words closes it: thinking VLMs recite the evidence in their thinking, and their own transcript, written without seeing the question, recovers most of what thinking adds. In a preregistered held-out test, the gap ranks how much eight VLMs gain from their own words over pixels (Spearman $ρ$ = 0.86), which recognition rates do not. We propose ALOUD, which spends visual resolution on finding and recognizing evidence and language tokens on using it. Without keeping the source text, it doubles the accuracy of a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B on long documents compressed 5x and 10x: at 5x, from 27.7% to 54.8%, near the original text's 58.5%, with a context smaller than the compressed pages themselves. For less than the cost of reading the original text, it leads at equal budget every method that does without it, at every level, and beats AGAR and VERA, which paste the original text back; at 5x it also beats LensVLM-9B, which is trained and keeps the original text. Visual-text compression is limited not by how much text a model can recover, but by how much it can use.

</details>


### [191] [Label-Free Localization and Test-Time Suppression of CLIP's Typographic Circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01513)
*Bohan Liu,Wenqian Ye,Guangzhi Xiong,Zhenghao He,Sanchit Sinha,Aidong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文用头分解稀疏字典学习解释 CLIP 视觉编码器中"文字识别"与"物体识别"纠缠的机制，并提出免训练测试时注意力重加权与自适应头路由来抵御排版攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP 视觉编码器因跨模态对比目标同时具备识别物体与读取文字的能力，导致词汇形状与语义形状编码纠缠，产生排版攻击脆弱性；而编码器黑箱性质使该纠缠缺乏机制层面的解释。

Method: 提出头分解稀疏字典学习（head-decomposed SDL）架构，将单个注意力头分解为可解释的头特异性隐变量；基于此归纳性解耦，复用 Clarity Score 并提出归一化 Text Attribution Score（二者均无需标签）定位携带排版信息的注意力头；作为因果验证，在测试时对识别出的"词汇头"中 patch token 的注意力进行重加权干预；并进一步提出测试时自适应注意力头路由。

Result: 干预可有效恢复排版攻击下的物体分类，在 5 个 CLIP 变体与 4 个排版基准上最高提升 46.9%，通用图像感知精度损失不超过 1%，优于既有监督式与免训练方法；自适应头路由在同等鲁棒性下进一步降低性能损失，突破当前鲁棒性—感知权衡的 Pareto 前沿。

Conclusion: 注意力头级别的稀疏分解可定量揭示 CLIP 中文字与语义的纠缠，并支撑精准的因果干预；免训练的注意力重加权与自适应头路由为排版攻击鲁棒性提供了高效、可解释的解决方案。

Abstract: CLIP-based Vision-Language Models have become cornerstones of modern multimodal systems. The cross-modal contrastive objective equips the CLIP vision encoder to both see objects and read text. These two abilities induce an entanglement between the encoding of lexical and semantic shapes, creating a distinctive vulnerability to typographic attacks, in which rendered text overrides an image's semantic content with its literal meaning. The black-box nature of these encoders has prevented a mechanistic interpretation of such entanglement. We introduce a head-decomposed Sparse Dictionary Learning (SDL) architecture that, by design, decomposes individual attention heads into interpretable, head-specific latents. Based on this inductive disentanglement, we re-purpose Clarity Score and propose normalized Text Attribution Score, which are both label-free, to identify attention heads that carry typographic information. As a causal validation of successful circuit separation, we perform a mechanistic intervention that reweighs attention away from the patch tokens in the identified lexical heads at test-time. Experiments show that the intervention effectively recovers object classification under typographic attack and, across five CLIP variants and four typographic benchmarks, achieves up to 46.9% improvement while incurring up to 1% accuracy loss in general image perception, outperforming prior supervised and training-free methods. Expanding on the mechanistic intervention, we propose a test-time adaptive attention head routing to further reduce the impact on performance at matched robustness, pushing beyond the Pareto frontier of current robustness-perception tradeoff.

</details>


### [192] [SurgStream: A Workflow-Anchored Proactive Streaming Framework and Benchmark for Real-Time Surgical Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01982)
*Ruipeng Ma,Qing Xu,Jie Liang,Zhen Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SurgStream——面向实时手术视频理解的工作流锚定主动式流式框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手术视频理解对术中辅助（工作流监测、器械准备、过程记录）至关重要，实时辅助要求模型同时感知当前场景、记忆历史手术事件并在临床关键时点前响应。现有方法难以在流式手术视频中同时保留过程证据并决定何时响应。

Method: 1) Workflow-Anchored Memory (WAM)：记录结构化的“器械-动作-目标”观察，并折叠为阶段级摘要，形成紧凑可查询的手术记忆；2) Deadline-aware Transition Learning (DTL)：在临床时间窗内监督响应状态，使模型在过程截止前及时响应；3) SurgStream-Bench：构建含11.7K流式交互的基准，覆盖实时感知、回溯记忆查询、前瞻主动问答、主动告警与描述记忆等任务。

Result: 在SurgStream-Bench上与SOTA方法相比取得提升，尤其在记忆与前瞻主动问答任务上表现突出。源码将公开。

Conclusion: 工作流锚定的结构化记忆结合截止期感知的响应学习，可有效支撑实时主动式手术视频理解。

Abstract: Surgical video understanding is essential for intraoperative assistance such as workflow monitoring, instrument preparation and procedural documentation. Delivering such assistance in real time requires a model to jointly perceive the ongoing scene, remember past surgical events, and respond before clinically relevant moments pass. Existing approaches provide limited support for jointly retaining procedural evidence and deciding when to respond in streaming surgical video. In this work, we propose SurgStream, a workflow-anchored proactive streaming framework for real-time surgical video understanding. We first introduce Workflow-Anchored Memory (WAM) to record structured instrument-action-target observations and fold them into phase-level summaries, providing compact and queryable surgical memory. Deadline-aware Transition Learning (DTL) is then devised to supervise response states within clinical windows, enabling timely responses before procedural deadlines. We further introduce SurgStream-Bench, comprising 11.7K streaming interactions across various tasks covering real-time perception, backward memory queries, forward proactive QA, proactive alerts and caption memory. Experiments on SurgStream-Bench show gains over state-of-the-art methods, especially in memory and forward proactive QA. The source code will be available.

</details>


### [193] [MUPA${}^2$S: Multimodal Unified Perception with Asymmetric Attention for Stress Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01974)
*Stefanos Gkikas,Thomas Kassiotis,Yu Fang,Christian Arzate Cruz,Miao Cheng,Zongyi Jiang,Zacharias Kamarianakis,Houshyar Asadi,Randy Gomez,Raul Fernandez Rojas,Giorgos Giannakakis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MUPA²S多模态压力评估框架，将面部视频与ECG映射为共享token表示，用分段局部交叉注意力与全局自注意力统一建模；在58人数据集上视频准确率69.44%，视频-ECG统一融合达69.58%且参数量约为特征级融合的一半。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 压力是长期身心健康下降的主要诱因，自动压力评估有利于持续监测并减少人工偏差；但生理与行为信号异质性强，统一建模困难，且不同融合策略的优劣缺乏系统比较。

Method: 构建MUPA²S统一感知架构：面部视频与ECG两模态均映射为共享token表示，不设模态专用组件；采用非对称注意力（分段局部交叉注意力＋跨分段状态的全局自注意力）处理；在58名受试者新采集数据集上以分层受试者级协议评估，并与特征级融合对比。

Result: 面部视频测试准确率69.44%，仅ECG在该表示下接近随机水平；视频-ECG统一融合测试准确率69.58%，参数量约为特征级融合的一半，额外计算开销可忽略；特征级融合未超过仅视频基线。

Conclusion: 统一输入级融合是参数高效且可联合处理视频与ECG的机制，优于特征级融合；但ECG单独判别力弱，融合增益有限，需进一步挖掘生理信号的有效表示。

Abstract: Stress is a leading contributor to long-term physical and mental health decline. The automatic assessment of stress is a promising approach for continuous monitoring and mitigating human biases. However, the development of automated systems remains challenging due to the heterogeneity of physiological and behavioral signals. This paper presents MUPA${}^2$S, a multimodal framework for automatic stress assessment that combines facial video and ECG signals within a unified perception architecture. Both modalities are mapped into a shared token representation without modality-specific components, and processed through asymmetric attention comprising segment-local cross-attention and global self-attention across segment states. Experiments on a newly collected 58-subject stress dataset, evaluated under a stratified subject-level protocol, show that facial video achieves 69.44% test accuracy, while ECG-only performance remains close to chance under the proposed representation. Unified Video-ECG fusion achieves a test accuracy of 69.58% at approximately half the number of parameters of feature-level fusion, with negligible additional computational cost. Feature-level fusion does not exceed the video-only baseline, while unified input-level integration provides a parameter-efficient mechanism for jointly processing the two modalities.

</details>


### [194] [VLSplat: Vision-Language Guided Object-Centric 3D Gaussian Splatting via Scene Graph](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01939)
*Yuntae Jeon,Younho Jeon,Sujin Jin,Sungho Jo,Seunghee Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VLSplat：利用视觉-语言模型提供对象级语义先验并借助对象群组场景图细化3DGS表示，实现以对象为中心的语义提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有2D到3D语义提升方法主要依赖2D分割监督，缺乏对象级先验，导致学到的表示由局部掩码证据驱动，而非整体对象结构。

Method: 在基于掩码的提升基础上，引入VLM导出的对象级语义先验，并用对象群组场景图细化高斯表示；细化由两个语言引导模块完成：组内细化抑制对象群内的语义噪声，组间获取通过引入相邻群组中结构相关的候选扩展对象支撑区域。

Result: 在室内场景数据集上的大量实验表明，VLSplat提升了对象级类别的语义一致性与结构完整性。

Conclusion: 将视觉-语言先验与对象群组场景图引入3DGS语义提升，可有效弥补仅靠2D掩码监督的不足，获得更一致、更完整的对象级语义表示。

Abstract: Learning semantic representations for 3D Gaussian Splatting has recently emerged as a promising direction for 3D scene understanding. However, existing 2D-to-3D semantic lifting approaches rely primarily on 2D segmentation supervision and lack object-level priors, causing the learned representation to be driven by local mask evidence rather than holistic object structure. In this paper, we present VLSplat, a vision-language guided approach for object-centric semantic lifting in 3D Gaussian Splatting. Our method augments mask-based lifting with object-level semantic priors derived from vision-language models and refines Gaussian representations using an object-group scene graph. The refinement is performed through two language-guided modules: intra-group refinement suppresses semantic noise within object groups, while inter-group acquisition expands object support regions by incorporating structurally relevant candidates from neighboring groups. Extensive experiments on indoor scene datasets demonstrate that VLSplat improves the semantic consistency and structural completeness of object-level categories. Our code and models are available at https://vlsplat.github.io/.

</details>


### [195] [Robust Pixel-wise Digital Image Correlation under Large Motions and Illumination Variations via a Global-to-Local Hybrid Neural Field](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01018)
*Xianglong Guo,Jianyang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出全局到局部的混合神经DIC框架：第一阶段通过粗旋转搜索、相位相关与掩膜细化估计主导刚体变换提供可靠初始化，第二阶段用KAN+MLP表示残差位移并以有效重叠、光照鲁棒的结构损失优化，实现噪声、大旋转与光照变化下的稳健像素级测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驱动深度学习DIC推理快，但对未见散斑、变形模式、噪声与光照泛化差；经典优化DIC与图像约束神经方法无需标注位移，却对初始化、大刚体运动、细非均匀变形和灰度扰动敏感，收敛与精度不稳。

Method: 两阶段混合框架。阶段1：粗旋转搜索+相位相关+掩膜细化，估计主导平面内刚体变换作为初始化；阶段2：以KAN与MLP混合网络表示残差位移，采用有效重叠、光照鲁棒的结构损失优化，局部灰度模型显式容纳乘性与加性光强变化。

Result: 仿真与实际实验表明，在噪声、非均匀变形、大旋转、光照变化及退化成像条件下均能准确、稳定地恢复位移。

Conclusion: 全局刚体估计与局部残差神经表示的结合可有效缓解初始化敏感与灰度扰动问题，兼具无标注训练与稳健收敛优势。

Abstract: Digital image correlation (DIC) is a widely used non-contact technique for full-field displacement measurement. Data-driven deep-learning DIC offers rapid inference but may generalize poorly to unseen speckle patterns, deformation modes, noise levels, and illumination conditions. Classical optimization-based DIC and recent image-constrained neural formulations avoid labeled displacement data, yet their convergence and accuracy remain vulnerable to initialization, large rigid-body motion, fine non-uniform deformation, and gray-value disturbances. This paper presents a global-to-local hybrid neural DIC framework for robust pixelwise measurement. Stage 1 estimates a dominant in-plane rigid transformation through coarse rotation search, phase correlation, and masked refinement, providing a reliable initialization under large translation and rotation. Stage 2 represents the residual displacement with a hybrid Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN) and multilayer perceptron (MLP), and optimizes it using a valid-overlap, illumination-robust structural loss. The local gray-value model explicitly accommodates multiplicative and additive intensity changes. Simulated and real experiments demonstrate accurate and stable displacement recovery under noise, non-uniform deformation, large rotation, illumination variation, and degraded imaging conditions.

</details>


### [196] [What Helps Denoising Can Hurt Memory: Rethinking History in Long Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00937)
*Yubin Jing,Ziyang Zhang,Meng Chen,Yuyao Li,Haofan Wang,Yichen Gong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究发现自回归视频生成中"提交"阶段对历史上下文的读取会带来负面影响，提出无需训练的 Commit Forcing 规则将提交组织为链式结构，在6个预训练生成器上显著提升长视频质量与一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频生成器逐块生成视频，去噪后通过"提交"（committing）阶段将干净块编码为 KV 供后续块读取，同一块因读取不同历史可产生不同 KV。现有工作仅将历史上下文视为去噪条件，忽视了它同时作为提交阶段输入的作用。作者发现较旧的历史上下文虽有助于去噪，但在提交阶段被读取时会损害后续生成。

Method: 通过控制上下文大小与时间位置，测量不同历史上下文对 clip-to-clip Subject Consistency 的影响；在5种支持更长上下文的生成器配置上观察一致性随提交上下文扩展呈现"上升—平台—下降"的趋势。据此提出 Commit Forcing：一种无需训练的规则，将提交组织成链，每个块在提交时只读取前一块存储的 KV，使更旧的历史只能通过链式传递间接影响新条目。

Result: 将 Commit Forcing 应用于6个预训练生成器：在60秒 VBench 上，全部6个生成器的 Quality 与 Total 指标均提升，最高提升1.27 Quality 分和1.10 Total 分；长程一致性增益可延伸至240秒视频。在120秒 LongLive 视频的盲测比较中（排除平局），对比基础生成器，在主体与场景一致性上胜率达83.5%，整体偏好胜率82.9%。

Conclusion: 历史上下文在提交阶段与去噪阶段的作用不同，旧上下文在提交时可能有害；通过链式提交（Commit Forcing）可有效隔离旧上下文的负面影响，作为一种免训练的即插即用方法，在多类生成器和长视频长度上普遍提升质量与时序一致性。

Abstract: Autoregressive video generators produce long videos block by block, using historical context to maintain temporal consistency. After denoising, a committing pass encodes each clean block into keys and values (KV) that later blocks read, and the same clean block can be encoded into different KV depending on the history it reads. We therefore study historical context not only as a condition for denoising but also as an input to committing. Older historical context that supports denoising can harm subsequent generation when read during committing. At fixed context size and temporal positions, older historical context lowers mean clip-to-clip Subject Consistency. Across 5 generator configurations supporting longer contexts, consistency rises, plateaus, and then declines as committing context expands. Motivated by these findings, we propose Commit Forcing, a training-free rule that organizes committing into a chain. During committing, each block reads only the preceding block's stored KV, so older historical context reaches new entries only through the chain. We apply this rule to 6 pretrained generators. On 60-second VBench, Commit Forcing improves Quality and Total on all 6 generators, by up to 1.27 Quality points and 1.10 Total points. Long-range consistency gains extend to 240-second videos. In a blinded comparison on 120-second LongLive videos, Commit Forcing achieves win rates of 83.5% for subject and scene consistency and 82.9% for overall preference against the base generator, excluding ties.

</details>


### [197] [Wave Forcing: Towards Speed-of-Light Streaming Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00859)
*Yijie Jin,Yuxuan Liu,Jiajun Xu,Ye Huang,Chuzhi Wang,Jiayang Li,Ruiyang Chen,Chenling Hong,Xu Wang,Zhijie Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Wave Forcing (WF)，协同设计生成、训练与执行，实现多步去噪的实时长视频连续生成，并以 WaveRT/Wave Parallelism 提升系统效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实时长视频生成需连续输出且保持外观一致与运动自然。现有 chunk-wise 自回归方法存在两大问题：效率上，序列化去噪与历史缓存刷新即使一步去噪也需两次前向；质量上，长 rollout 会退化并出现镜头漂移。

Method: 1) 生成侧：采用 chunk-wise 因果注意力，使当前块可访问尚未去噪完成但更早、更干净的块；将交错去噪与缓存刷新阶段分布到全模型副本上，实现 1F1C（流水填充后每轮并发前向产出一个输出块）。2) 训练侧：三阶段训练，依次引入混合噪声去噪、运动监督、以及用自生成历史做因果适配。3) 执行侧：Wave Runtime (WaveRT) 采用 Wave Parallelism (WP) 实现早期 K/V 交付与通信-计算重叠，并配合优化 kernel 与流水化 VAE 解码。

Result: 在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 上，5 步 WF 整体质量与 Rolling Forcing 相当，且在短视频与长视频上 Dynamic Degree 更高。8×H200 上 4 步 WF 达 147.6 DiT FPS、134.8 端到端 FPS，为单 GPU 端到端吞吐的 7.07×。在匹配 SageAttention+W8A8 后端、去噪步数与 GPU 数的 DiT-only 测试中，WP 在 1.3B–14B 六个规模上吞吐最高为 Ulysses 与 Ring 中较优基线的 2.53×。

Conclusion: WF 通过算法-训练-系统协同设计，在保持质量的同时提升动态性与长视频稳定性，并显著改善多步去噪连续生成的吞吐效率。

Abstract: Real-time long-video generation requires continuous output with consistent appearance and natural motion. Existing chunk-wise autoregressive methods face challenges in both generation efficiency and long-video quality: serialized denoising and history-cache refresh require two forward passes even with one-step denoising, and longer rollouts can degrade quality and cause camera drift. We propose Wave Forcing (WF), which co-designs generation, training, and execution for continuous video output with multi-step denoising. WF uses chunk-wise causal attention to access earlier, cleaner chunks before their denoising is complete, and distributes staggered denoising and cache-refresh stages across full-model replicas to achieve 1F1C: one output chunk per concurrent forward round after pipeline fill. To adapt the model to this continuous generation process, we develop a three-stage training procedure that successively introduces mixed-noise denoising, motion supervision, and causal adaptation using self-generated history. To execute this process efficiently, Wave Runtime (WaveRT) uses Wave Parallelism (WP) for early K/V delivery and communication-computation overlap, together with optimized kernels and pipelined VAE decoding. Experiments on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B show that 5-step WF maintains overall quality comparable to Rolling Forcing while achieving higher Dynamic Degree on both short and long videos. Our system efficiency experiments show that 4-step WF achieves 147.6 DiT FPS and 134.8 end-to-end FPS on eight H200 GPUs, yielding 7.07x the single-GPU end-to-end throughput. In DiT-only tests with matched SageAttention+W8A8 backends, denoising steps, and GPU counts, WP delivers up to 2.53x the throughput of the faster of the Ulysses and Ring context-parallel baselines across six model scales (1.3B-14B).

</details>


### [198] [DriftingPlanner: Drifting Generative Models for One-Step Trajectory Planning in End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01283)
*Ziming Liu,Yizhan Qu,Leichen Wang,Hao Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DriftingPlanner 仅用 drifting loss（无坐标回归项）训练单步轨迹规划器，并按场景计算漂移场、在推理时用反对称噪声对（z 与 −z）批量解码后取平均以消除“排斥壳”导致的线性偏移，从而避免多步扩散/流匹配推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端规划器存在两难：坐标回归快但会把多种可行机动混合成一条可能哪条都不合法的轨迹；扩散/流匹配能建模轨迹分布但需多步推理。drifting 模型把迭代移入训练、实现单步生成，但该方法原本面向类条件图像生成（每类有大量正样本）。规划中每个场景自成一类条件：跨场景汇聚会让某场景生成轨迹被无关场景真值吸引，而按场景计算又只有专家轨迹一个正样本，互斥使生成样本被压在其周围的“壳”上，单条样本偏离真值。

Method: 按场景计算 attraction–repulsion 漂移场；仅以 drifting loss 端到端训练单步生成器，不加入坐标回归项；推理时去除壳：一次性批量解码每个噪声向量及其相反数 −z，对每对反对称样本取平均，抵消来自壳中心的线性位移分量。

Result: 在 NAVSIM navtest 上达到 93.75 PDMS 的 SOTA；单步推理的 drifting 解码器仅比需十步推理的最优扩散/流匹配设置低 0.13 PDMS。

Conclusion: drifting 生成范式可用于轨迹规划：通过逐场景场构造与反对称配对平均，单步解码即可逼近多步扩散/流匹配的精度，兼顾分布建模能力与推理效率。

Abstract: End-to-end planners decode the ego trajectory either by coordinate regression, which is fast but blends plausible maneuvers into one trajectory that may follow none of them, or by diffusion and flow matching, which model the trajectory distribution but need several inference steps. Drifting models move this iteration into training: a one-step generator learns to follow an attraction--repulsion field between generated and ground-truth samples. Drifting was developed for class-conditional image generation, where every class supplies many positive samples. In planning, every scene is its own condition. Pooling scenes would attract the generated trajectories of one scene to the ground truth of unrelated scenes, whereas computing the field per scene leaves a single positive, the expert trajectory. Mutual repulsion then holds the generated trajectories on a shell around it, so any single generated trajectory deviates from the ground truth. We present DriftingPlanner, a trajectory planner trained with the drifting loss alone, without any coordinate regression term. It computes the field per scene and removes the shell at inference: it decodes every noise vector together with its negation in one batched pass, and averaging each antithetic pair cancels the linear part of the displacement from the shell center. On NAVSIM navtest, DriftingPlanner reaches a state-of-the-art 93.75 PDMS, and with single-step inference its drifting decoder comes within 0.13 PDMS of the best diffusion or flow matching setting, which needs ten inference steps.

</details>


### [199] [QVR3D: Query-Guided Visual Reasoning for Training-Free 3D Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01084)
*Jung-Hao Kao,Jing-En Huang,Jia-Wei Liao,Tzuhsuan Huang,Yu-Lun Liu,Cheng-Fu Chou,Jun-Cheng Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练框架QVR3D，用查询引导的视角选择与接地概率估计在RGB-D观测上实现零样本3D视觉接地。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练3D视觉接地方法依赖显式场景变换或场景级帧选择，会把有限视觉容量浪费在与查询无关的区域；作者认为有效接地应优先选取能为查询提供证据的观测，而非均匀表征整个场景。

Method: QVR3D基于现成基础模型处理RGB-D观测，包含两部分：Query-Guided Maximum Coverage（QGMC）选择互补的、与查询相关的视角；Grounding Probability Estimation（GPE）融合实例置信度、属性一致性与关系一致性进行概率估计。框架无需任务特定适配，支持单目标与多目标接地。

Result: 在ScanRefer与Nr3D上取得零样本state-of-the-art性能；QGMC在多个3D视觉-语言任务中同时提升帧效率。

Conclusion: 查询引导的证据优先视角选择是免训练3D视觉接地的有效方向，兼具精度与效率优势，并可跨任务泛化。

Abstract: 3D visual grounding localizes objects in 3D scenes from natural language descriptions, requiring reasoning over semantics, spatial relationships, and multi-view observations. Training-free approaches avoid costly annotations but often rely on explicit scene transformation or scene-level frame selection, which may waste limited visual capacity on query-irrelevant regions. We observe that effective grounding should prioritize observations that provide evidence for the query rather than uniformly represent the entire scene. Based on this insight, we introduce QVR3D, a query-guided visual reasoning framework that operates on RGB-D observations using off-the-shelf foundation models. QVR3D combines Query-Guided Maximum Coverage (QGMC) for selecting complementary query-relevant views with Grounding Probability Estimation (GPE) that integrates instance confidence, attribute consistency, and relationship consistency. The framework supports both single- and multi-object grounding without task-specific adaptation. Experiments on ScanRefer and Nr3D achieve state-of-the-art zero-shot performance, while QGMC also improves frame efficiency across multiple 3D vision-language tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/jwliao1209/QVR3D.

</details>


### [200] [Spade-SLAM: Sparse Correspondence Anchors for Dense Self-Supervised Visual SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01937)
*Julian Philipp Schmitt,Weirong Chen,Ganlin Zhang,Felix Wimbauer,Daniel Cremers*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Spade-SLAM：自监督稠密视觉SLAM框架，采用稀疏到稠密的互补训练机制，零样本性能显著逼近有监督方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稠密视觉SLAM的强性能依赖显式位姿与深度真值标签进行全监督预训练，标签成本高；而自监督方法与有监督方法之间长期存在显著性能差距。

Method: 提出"稀疏到稠密"的互补训练范式：以基于warping的光度损失提供稠密训练信号；同时引入由图像特征匹配导出的稀疏对应损失，用于稳定优化并抑制歧义区域的漂移。

Result: 在零样本设定下，相比现有自监督基线在鲁棒性与精度上有显著提升，性能接近使用显式位姿和深度监督训练的SLAM系统。

Conclusion: 无需位姿与深度真值标签即可实现高保真跟踪，为全监督预训练提供高效、低标签依赖的替代方案；代码将开源。

Abstract: We introduce Spade-SLAM, a self-supervised dense visual SLAM framework that substantially narrows the long-standing performance gap to supervised methods in a zero-shot setting. By demonstrating that high-fidelity tracking can be achieved without explicit ground-truth pose and depth labels, our approach offers a highly effective and label-efficient alternative to fully supervised pretraining. Our core contribution is a complementary sparse-to-dense training regime: While a warping-based photometric loss provides a dense training signal, we stabilize the optimization and suppress drift in ambiguous regions using a sparse correspondence loss derived from image feature matches. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Spade-SLAM significantly improves robustness and accuracy compared to existing self-supervised baselines, closely rivaling SLAM systems trained with explicit pose and depth supervision. The code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/JulianPSchmitt/Spade-SLAM.

</details>


### [201] [BGD-SF PolySegNet: boundary-guided dynamic selective fusion network for robust polyp segmentation in colonoscopy images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02603)
*Nishi Kanta Paul,Shamia Maherin,Morsheda Akter,Moinul Hossain,Md Kishor Morol*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出边界引导编码器-解码器 BGD-SF PolySegNet，将边界信息作为主动架构组件控制上下文聚合、跳跃特征融合与掩膜精修三阶段，显著提升息肉分割的边界性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结肠镜图像中息肉边界分割困难；现有深度模型在Dice指标上表现良好但边界精度差，且多数方法仅将边界信息用作训练时的附加损失，网络无法显式学习边界引导的特征选择或掩膜精修。

Method: 基于预训练EfficientNet-B4骨干的边界引导编码器-解码器，含三个模块：边界引导动态级联多尺度上下文聚合（BGD-CMSCA）、边界引导选择性注意力融合（BG-SAGF）、多级边界引导头（MBGH）；在Kvasir-SEG、BKAI-IGH NeoPolyp-Small、PolypGen共3,535张标注图像上训练，并在四个留出基准数据集上评估。

Result: 内部测试集Dice 0.887、IoU 0.839、Boundary F1 0.531、HD95 30.32、ASSD 18.10，较最强CNN基线在Boundary F1、HD95、ASSD上分别提升15.7%、27.5%、34.6%；外部验证CVC-ClinicDB/CVC-ColonDB/ETIS-Larib/CVC-300的Dice分别为0.891/0.776/0.863/0.885；35 FPS、22.51M参数；Wilcoxon符号秩检验显示对7个消融变体中的6个边界F1改善显著（p<0.001，r=0.215–0.434）。

Conclusion: 将边界引导作为主动架构组件（而非仅损失信号）可可量化地提升息肉边界描绘能力，并保持实时性与参数效率。

Abstract: Effective polyp segmentation in colonoscopy images is crucial for early detection of colorectal cancer, a leading cause of cancer-related death worldwide. While current deep learning models perform well on traditional Dice benchmarks, border segmentation remains difficult. Most methods use boundary information only as an additional loss signal during training, which prevents the network from explicitly learning border-guided feature selection or mask refinement. This paper introduces BGD-SF PolySegNet, a boundary-guided encoder-decoder architecture that controls three phases of the segmentation pipeline: dynamic multi-scale context aggregation, selective skip-feature fusion, and final mask refinement. The architecture comprises a pretrained EfficientNet-B4 backbone and three proposed modules: Boundary-Guided Dynamic Cascaded Multi-Scale Context Aggregation (BGD-CMSCA), Boundary-Guided Selective Attention Fusion (BG-SAGF), and a Multi-Level Boundary Guidance Head (MBGH). The model is trained on 3,535 annotated images from Kvasir-SEG, BKAI-IGH NeoPolyp-Small, and PolypGen, and evaluated on four held-out benchmark datasets. On the internal test set, BGD-SF achieves a Dice of 0.887, IoU of 0.839, mask-derived Boundary F1 of 0.531, HD95 of 30.32, and ASSD of 18.10, improving Boundary F1, HD95, and ASSD by 15.7%, 27.5%, and 34.6% over the strongest CNN baselines. External validation on CVC-ClinicDB, CVC-ColonDB, ETIS-Larib, and CVC-300 yielded Dice scores of 0.891, 0.776, 0.863, and 0.885, respectively. The model runs at 35 FPS with 22.51M parameters. Wilcoxon signed-rank tests confirm statistically significant mask-derived Boundary F1 improvements over six of seven ablation variants (p < 0.001; small-to-moderate effect sizes, r = 0.215-0.434), demonstrating that integrating boundary guidance as an active architectural component measurably advances polyp boundary delineation.

</details>


### [202] [SeMo3D: Unifying 3D Generation, Editing, and Completion via Selective Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02568)
*Xiaokun Sun,Jian Yang,Zhenyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Selective Modeling范式与SeMo3D，将3D生成、编辑、补全统一为"合成指定区域、保持其余区域不变"的任务，并配套Omni3DiT多条件扩散Transformer。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法把3D生成、编辑、补全当作任务特定的完整资产重生成，导致任务孤立、本应不变内容不一致，以及依赖任务特定的成对数据。

Method: 核心观察：三任务均在保持其余部分不变的前提下合成指定区域（生成=全区域，编辑=目标区域，补全=缺失区域）。训练上提出region-selective denoising，在标准3D资产上随机选取不同大小区域，仅对其加噪与计算损失，联合学习三任务，无需成对编辑/补全数据。架构上提出Omni3DiT，多条件3D扩散Transformer，区分待生成区域与待保留区域，并融合图像、文本、点云引导实现细粒度控制。

Result: 在三个基准上，SeMo3D在所有任务上超越SOTA；生成具备多模态可控性，编辑与补全具有强一致性与准确性；并可作为智能体统一建模工具，通过自然语言交互实现高效3D创作。

Conclusion: 通过统一"选择性建模"视角，SeMo3D在架构与训练层面自然实现生成、编辑、补全一体化，结构上保证未改区域一致性，并摆脱成对数据依赖，具备作为3D创作智能体底层工具的潜力。

Abstract: 3D generation, editing, and completion are typically treated as regenerating the complete 3D asset under task-specific constraints, even when only a local region needs modification. This leads to task isolation, inconsistency in content that should remain unchanged, and dependence on task-specific paired data. We address these issues with a key observation: the three tasks all synthesize a designated region while keeping the rest intact---the full region for generation, the target region for editing, and the missing region for completion. We term this paradigm Selective Modeling and build SeMo3D upon it; it naturally unifies the three tasks, preserves unchanged content by construction, and enables training without paired editing or completion data, since any 3D asset can be partitioned into a selected region and its context. For training, we propose region-selective denoising, which randomly selects regions of varying sizes on standard 3D assets and applies noise and loss only to them, jointly learning all three tasks. For architecture, we propose Omni3DiT, a multi-condition 3D diffusion transformer that distinguishes regions to create from those to retain and fuses image, text, and point guidance for fine-grained control. Experiments across three benchmarks show SeMo3D surpasses state-of-the-art methods on all tasks, delivering multimodal controllability in generation and strong consistency and accuracy in editing and completion. SeMo3D further serves as a unified modeling tool for agents, enabling efficient 3D creation through natural-language interaction. Project page: https://xiaokunsun.github.io/SeMo3D.github.io/.

</details>


### [203] [Gnomon4D: Learning Where and When to Focus for Geometric Motion-Grounded World-Action Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02474)
*Lingwei Dang,Yan Zhou,Juntong Li,Zhenhao Zhang,Yiteng Chen,Xiaoqiang Liu,Liang An,Hongwen Zhang,Wei Min,Guoxin Zhang,Pengfei Wan,Yebin Liu,Qingyao Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Gnomon4D 是一种世界-动作模型，联合生成未来视频、机器人动作与视频对齐的4D几何运动场 GeoDelta，在多个仿真与真机基准上取得领先。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界-动作模型（WAMs）中，RGB未来帧将物理状态变化与外观纠缠；逐帧深度图与点图缺乏时间对应；已有4D方法要么将运动隐式留在视觉特征中，要么需单独的接口把预测轨迹翻译为动作，无法直接向动作专家暴露具身与物体的运动关系。

Method: 提出Gnomon4D：联合生成未来视频、机器人动作，以及GeoDelta——一种视频对齐的4D几何运动场，编码具身点与物体点的跨帧图像平面位移与深度变化。GeoDelta将具身运动与物体响应置于共享空间，从而在推理时向动作专家暴露二者运动关系。交互显著注意力（InSAttn）利用该关系，将空间读出聚焦于任务相关交互区域；转移锚定聚合（TransAgg）在相对运动发生变化的时刻（如抓取、释放）聚合证据。此外，GeoDelta与具身特定控制无关，提供共享的人-机"准动作"，用于EgoManip-5000H上的无动作预训练，后在Robot-30H上进行机器人中期训练。

Result: 在RoboTwin 2.0、VLABench与RoboDojo上领先；在分布内与分布外设置下，分别以7.0与16.0个百分点超越最强真实机器人基线。

Conclusion: 以视频对齐的4D几何运动场作为显式、与具身无关的中间表征，可将具身-物体运动关系直接暴露给动作专家，并支持跨具身（人-机）的无动作预训练，显著提升操作策略的分布内与分布外泛化能力。

Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) use video-generation priors to jointly predict future observations and robot actions. Yet RGB futures entangle physical state changes with appearance, while frame-wise depth and point maps lack temporal correspondence. Existing 4D approaches either keep motion implicit in visual features or translate predicted traces into actions through a separate interface. We present Gnomon4D, a WAM that jointly generates future video, robot actions, and GeoDelta, a video-aligned 4D geometric motion field encoding the cross-frame image-plane displacement and depth change of embodiment and object points. By placing embodiment motion and object responses in a shared space, GeoDelta exposes their motion relations to the action expert at inference. Interaction-Salient Attention (InSAttn) uses these relations to focus spatial readout on task-relevant interaction regions, while Transition-Anchored Aggregation (TransAgg) aggregates evidence around changes in their relative motion, such as grasp and release. GeoDelta describes surface motion independently of embodiment-specific controls, providing a shared human--robot quasi-action for action-free pretraining on EgoManip-5000H followed by robot mid-training on Robot-30H. Gnomon4D leads on RoboTwin~2.0, VLABench, and RoboDojo, and outperforms the strongest real-robot baseline by 7.0 and 16.0 percentage points under in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, respectively.

</details>


### [204] [Evaluating Synthetic Skin Lesion Images for Classifier Training: A Safety-Aware Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02437)
*Amindu Kumarasinghe,Vinh Bui,Reza Ghanbarzadeh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文通过16种质量指标的"锦标赛"式比较，证明单一质量分数（如FID）无法满足所有皮肤病变类别的分类需求，并提出一种安全感知的评估算法，在ISIC-2018上使Swin-B的Macro-F2较FID基线提升约+0.0136~+0.0164。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 皮肤癌分类器缺乏标注图像，稀有病变尤甚；AI生成图像可填补缺口，但生成质量参差不齐，需筛选保留哪些图像。当前实践通常依赖单一质量分数（多为FID），但FID从未针对分类器实际需求进行验证，也无法判断生成器是否记忆了训练照片。

Method: 构建16种质量指标的锦标赛：每种指标单独从由扩散模型EDM2生成的275,472张图像池中选出训练子集，用各子集训练分类器并按类别评估该指标。基于各类别测量结果，将每个指标按其类别内实测价值加权，并剔除与真实训练图像过近的样本，形成安全感知的评估算法。

Result: 单一指标无法服务所有类别：基于Inception特征的FID对某一病变类型给出最佳分类器，对另一类型却相对随机采样无可测优势，且其偏好的生成设置恰是最接近训练图像的设置。在留出ISIC-2018测试集上，该算法使Swin-B的Macro-F2较FID基线提升+0.0136至+0.0164（四个安全阈值下，Bonferroni校正p<0.02），较随机采样提升约+0.03，但对ResNet-50无效。收紧阈值可提升记忆安全分数且效用无可测变化，但所有精选数据集仍不如随机采样安全。

Conclusion: 结果在主分类器上显示出适度但统计显著的增益，并提供了一套实用、安全感知的合成数据评估与使用流程；同时表明现有质量指标与安全性之间存在权衡，合成数据筛选仍需在效用与记忆风险间谨慎取舍。

Abstract: Skin cancer classifiers need large sets of annotated images, which are scarce, especially for rare lesion types. AI-generated images can fill the gap, but a generator produces images of widely varying quality, so selecting which images to retain is important. That choice usually rests on a single quality score, most often the Fréchet Inception Distance (FID), which has not been tested against what a classifier needs and cannot tell whether the generator memorizes its training photographs. We test that practice with a tournament of 16 quality metrics. Each metric alone selects a training subset from a pool of 275,472 images generated by a diffusion model (EDM2), and a classifier trained on each subset scores the metric per class. The tournament shows that no single metric serves every class: FID computed on Inception features gives the best classifier for one lesion type and no measurable advantage over random sampling for another, and the generation setting it prefers is also the one closest to the training images. We turn these per-class measurements into a safety-aware evaluation algorithm that weights each metric by its measured value in each class and removes images too close to a real training image. On the held-out ISIC-2018 test set, the algorithm improves Macro-$F_2$, a recall-weighted measure of classification performance, over the FID baseline for a Swin-B classifier by +0.0136 to +0.0164 across four safety thresholds (Bonferroni-corrected $p < 0.02$) and over random sampling by about +0.03, though not for ResNet-50. Tightening the threshold improves a memorization-safety score with no measurable change in utility, but every curated set remains less safe than random sampling. The results show a modest but statistically significant gain on the primary classifier, and offer a practical, safety-aware procedure for evaluating and using synthetic data.

</details>


### [205] [EarthJev: Calibrated, Non-Generative Answers to Natural-Language Questions about Sentinel-2 Land Cover](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02096)
*Domenico Benfenati,Antonio Maria Rinaldi,Cristian Tommasino*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EarthJev 是一个 0.8B 参数的多光谱遥感 VQA 模型，通过单步读取选项字母的 logits 直接输出答案而不生成任何 token，在保持接近大型多模态模型精度的同时实现 4.3–8.7 倍加速和良好校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遥感视觉语言模型通过生成文本回答问题，每个答案都需一次解码循环、需将文本解析回选项、且缺乏可用概率。作者希望在低参数量下避免自回归生成带来的延迟与不可靠不确定性。

Method: 基于 Qwen3.5-0.8B，将 Sentinel-2 全部 12 个波段通过由 RGB 卷积核初始化并加宽的输入层送入视觉编码器；遵循 OneJev 开放配方，在单一位置上读取选项字母 logits 作为答案，并以交叉熵加 Brier 分数联合训练。对照实验包括同骨干的生成式微调与三个 LoRA 微调的多模态语言模型，均在 5% BigEarthNet v2.0 的 70,890 个问题上训练，并在同一 GPU 同一作业中计时；另以固定答案词表分类的 VQA 模型作为成本参考。

Result: 单题回答耗时 19.9 ms，比多模态语言模型快 4.3–8.7 倍，比自身骨干生成式快 6.8 倍；整幅图像所有问题合并回答 42.8 ms，比批量生成式模型快 3.7–10.1 倍。在 36,028 个测试问题上（三随机种子）达 86.0% 准确率，低于两个 2B 多模态模型 0.6 与 1.2 个百分点，低于 EarthDial-4B 3.5 个百分点；答案结构性合法，ECE 为 0.006。将 9 个非 RGB 波段替换为均值使准确率下降 4.5 个百分点，证明模型确实利用了多光谱输入；全量微调视觉编码器可将准确率提升至 88.4% 且成本不变。

Conclusion: 以单步 logit 读取替代自回归生成，可在小参数量下为遥感多光谱 VQA 提供快速、合法且校准良好的答案，仅以小幅度精度代价换取显著效率收益，并验证了多光谱信息的有效利用。

Abstract: Vision-language models for remote sensing answer questions about satellite images by generating text: every answer costs a decoding loop, has to be parsed back to an option, and comes without a usable probability. We present EarthJev, a 0.8B-parameter model that answers typed questions about multispectral Sentinel-2 patches without generating any token.
