All 12 bands enter the vision encoder of Qwen3.5-0.8B through a widened input layer initialised from the RGB kernels, and, following the open OneJev recipe, the answer is read from the logits of the option letters at a single position and trained with cross-entropy plus Brier score. Under a pre-specified analysis plan, we compare it with the same backbone fine-tuned to generate the answer and with three multimodal language models fine-tuned with LoRA, all trained on the same 70,890 questions from 5% of BigEarthNet v2.0 and timed in one job on the same GPU; VQA models that classify over a fixed answer vocabulary are reported as a reference for the cost of answering only the questions seen in training. EarthJev answers a question in 19.9 ms, 4.3 to 8.7 times faster than the multimodal language models and 6.8 times faster than its own backbone used generatively; when all the questions about an image are asked together, it answers them in 42.8 ms, 3.7 to 10.1 times faster than the batched generative models. On 36,028 test questions it reaches 86.0% accuracy (three seeds), 0.6 and 1.2 points below the two 2B multimodal models and 3.5 points below the remote-sensing EarthDial-4B, with answers that are valid by construction and calibrated probabilities (ECE 0.006). Replacing the nine non-RGB bands with their mean costs 4.5 points, so the model uses the multispectral input, and in an ablation training the whole vision encoder raises accuracy to 88.4% at the same cost. Code and model: https://github.com/CosmoIknosLab/EarthJev

</details>


### [206] [Scene-Adaptive Readout and Decoding in Diffusion Driving VLAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02076)
*Seungjun Yu,Jiho Choi,Inha Kang,Hojun Choi,Seungwook Kim,Hyunjung Shim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出场景自适应读出与解码框架（SARD）：用场景条件读出MoE在单次backbone前向后融合多层轨迹预测，并仅在需要时进行额外扩散细化，兼顾规划质量与推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散式驾驶VLA在每个去噪阶段反复执行backbone，推理开销大；但并非所有场景都需要相同的解码计算量，缺乏"何时轨迹已可读、还需多少细化"的区分依据。

Method: 分析网络深度与解码进度的轨迹读出特性，发现"深度-解码解耦"现象：首次前向后深层表示即可支撑有效读出，浅层更受益于继续解码；且偏好的读出层与解码深度随场景变化。据此设计：(1) 场景条件读出MoE，在单次backbone扫描后对多个深层表示的轨迹预测自适应加权融合；(2) 自适应解码策略，仅在场景需要时施加原生细化。

Result: 在两个扩散驾驶VLA、Waymo E2E与nuScenes上验证：验证集RFS最高提升0.56，测试性能亦提升；Waymo E2E端到端加速最高6.0×，nuScenes上轨迹误差持续下降。

Conclusion: 场景级读出与解码资源分配可在避免冗余解码的同时提升规划质量，说明自适应计算分配是扩散驾驶VLA提效的可行方向。

Abstract: Diffusion driving vision-language-action models repeatedly execute the backbone at every denoising stage, incurring substantial inference cost, while it remains unclear whether all scenes require the same decoding computation. To distinguish when a trajectory becomes readable from how much further refinement it requires, we analyze trajectory readout across network depth and decoding progress. We identify a depth-decoding dissociation in which late-layer representations already support useful trajectory readout after the first forward sweep, whereas early-layer representations benefit more from continued decoding. We further find that both the preferred readout layer and decoding depth vary across scenes. Based on these observations, we propose a scene-adaptive readout and decoding framework. A scene-conditioned readout MoE adaptively weights and combines trajectory predictions from layer-specific late-layer representations after a single backbone sweep, while an adaptive decoding policy applies additional native refinement only when required by the scene. We evaluate our framework on two diffusion driving VLAs across the Waymo E2E and nuScenes benchmarks. Our method improves validation RFS by up to 0.56 while also improving test performance, and achieves an end-to-end speedup of up to $6.0\times$ on Waymo E2E, while consistently reducing trajectory error on nuScenes. These results demonstrate that scene-level readout and decoding allocation improves planning quality while avoiding unnecessary decoding. Our code is available at https://github.com/sjyu001/SARD

</details>


### [207] [UniGS-SLAM: Monocular Gaussian SLAM with Enhanced Geometry and Open-Vocabulary Semantics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02051)
*Xingyuan Ding,Sicheng Yu,Kaiyong Zhao,Hao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UniGS-SLAM是一个纯RGB的单目语义SLAM框架，将开放词汇语义与高斯重建解耦，语义融合于带观测溯源的独立稀疏体素图并支持历史证据修订，语义再反向引导高斯滤波与局部表面细化，在跟踪、渲染、几何重建与开放集语义建图上均领先，重建速度提升2.37倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于高斯的方法将语义标签或特征附着在不断演化的高斯基元上，语义融合难以维护且重建开销增大；高斯—体素混合表示虽提供更稳定的语义支撑，但多依赖RGB-D输入或已知位姿，且几何更新后不修订历史语义证据。

Method: 纯RGB框架；用基础模型先验增强单目深度与位姿估计；将语义观测融合进独立稀疏体素图并保留观测溯源（observation provenance），使重建演进时可修订历史贡献；融合语义反过来引导高斯滤波与局部表面细化，实现语义与高斯重建的双向交互。

Result: 在Replica、ScanNet、KITTI-360上，在代表性纯RGB方法中取得领先的跟踪、渲染与几何重建性能，并在Replica与ScanNet上实现较强开放集语义建图；相比最快的对比语义SLAM基线实现2.37倍重建加速。

Conclusion: 解耦式语义—高斯基建（独立体素语义+溯源修订+语义引导几何优化）可在纯RGB单目设定下兼顾语义稳定性与重建效率，无需RGB-D或已知位姿。

Abstract: Monocular semantic SLAM aims to reconstruct scene geometry and build semantic maps from RGB observations. Existing Gaussian-based methods often attach semantic labels or features to evolving Gaussian primitives, making semantic fusion difficult to maintain and increasing reconstruction overhead. Hybrid Gaussian--voxel representations provide more stable semantic support, but often rely on RGB-D input or known poses and do not revise historical semantic evidence after geometry updates. We present UniGS-SLAM, an RGB-only framework that decouples open-vocabulary semantics from Gaussian reconstruction while preserving bidirectional interaction. Foundation priors enhance monocular depth and pose estimation, while semantic observations are fused into an independent sparse voxel map with observation provenance, enabling historical contributions to be revised as reconstruction evolves. The fused semantics further guide Gaussian filtering and local surface refinement. Experiments on Replica, ScanNet, and KITTI-360 show leading tracking, rendering, and geometric reconstruction performance among representative RGB-only methods, together with strong open-set semantic mapping on Replica and ScanNet. We also achieve a 2.37-fold reconstruction speedup over the fastest compared semantic SLAM baseline. Project page: https://3dagentworld.github.io/UniGS-SLAM/.

</details>


### [208] [DR Pixel: Page-Native Deep Research with Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03097)
*Tiansheng Hu,Yichuan Wang,James V. Talwar,Nicholas Tomlin,Chen Zhao,Sewon Min*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出首个开源端到端多模态深度研究代理DR Pixel，以渲染页面图像作为唯一检索与推理单元，在106万页语料上运行；并构建DRPixelBench基准，配合反事实信用重加权训练方法，性能超越OCR基线与未训练基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度研究（DR）代理通常将论文压缩为OCR提取的纯文本，丢失了表格、图和公式中的丰富信息。作者质疑能否让视觉语言模型（VLM）实现"页面原生"深度研究——直接在渲染的文档页面上检索与推理。

Method: 1）构建DR Pixel：首个以渲染页面图像为唯一检索与推理单元的开源端到端多模态DR代理，语料规模106万页；2）构建DRPixelBench基准，要求对论文中的文本、图、表、公式进行联合推理；3）提出反事实信用重加权（counterfactual credit reweighting），对教师轨迹中单步推理与动作按其反事实贡献进行细粒度信用分配，以缓解智能体监督微调轨迹噪声问题。

Result: 无需训练的页面原生DR在GPT-5.4、Gemini-3.5-Flash、Qwen3.6-27B等模型上均优于OCR基线且工具调用更少；训练后DRPixelBench检索召回率提升约15个点、最终准确率提升超10个点，并在四个已有基准上优于未训练基线；在分布外ViDoRe-V3上与直接给定金标页面的oracle仅差1.8个点。

Conclusion: 传统"先OCR再检索"流水线既非必要也非最优；直接在视觉文档页面上检索与推理可使复杂深度研究更有效、更高效。

Abstract: Complex documents such as scientific papers contain rich information in tables, figures, and equations; however, existing deep research (DR) agents typically reduce papers to OCR-extracted text. We instead ask whether vision-language models (VLMs) can enable page-native deep research: directly retrieving and reasoning over rendered document page images. We introduce DR Pixel, the first open-source end-to-end multimodal DR agent that uses rendered page images as its sole retrieval and reasoning unit, operating over a corpus of 1.06M pages. To evaluate this setting, we construct DRPixelBench, a benchmark on scientific papers requiring reasoning over text, figures, tables, and equations. Surprisingly, page-native DR already works well without training, outperforming OCR-based baselines across state-of-the-art models like GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.5-Flash, and Qwen3.6-27B, while requiring fewer tool calls. We next turn to DR training. A key challenge is that teacher trajectories for agentic supervised finetuning are noisy, mixing critical reasoning and action steps with redundant or failed attempts. To address this, we introduce counterfactual credit reweighting, a fine-grained credit assignment method that weights individual reasoning and action steps by their counterfactual contribution to the final answer. Our training improves retrieval recall by about 15 points and final accuracy by over 10 points on DRPixelBench, and likewise outperforms the untrained baseline on four existing benchmarks. On out-of-distribution ViDoRe-V3, DR Pixel comes within 1.8 points of an oracle that is given the gold pages directly. Our results suggest that the conventional OCR-then-retrieve pipeline is not only unnecessary but suboptimal: directly retrieving and reasoning over visual document pages makes complex DR both more effective and more efficient.

</details>


### [209] [MuCHMDPoser: Multiview RGB-Camera Full-Body Pose Tracking for Virtual Reality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03062)
*Antoine Maiorca,George Fletcher,Thierry Ravet,Thierry Dutoit*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 通过引入外部多视角RGB相机并结合RGB姿态估计，缓解消费级稀疏传感器（HMD+双手柄）在VR全身追踪中下体欠约束问题，显著降低下体追踪误差，并实现60 FPS端到端动画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅依赖HMD与手持控制器等消费级稀疏传感器时，可追踪的上半身关节仅3个，全身（尤其下体）姿态推断严重欠约束，导致显著追踪误差。

Method: 将追踪配置扩展为外部多视角RGB相机；在该框架中融合基于RGB的姿态估计；提出无需物理标记、仅需一次的HMD-相机标定流程；并给出整体框架实现。

Result: 融合RGB姿态估计后显著降低下体追踪误差，即使在RGB估计存在常见伪影时依然有效；免标记的一次性标定可行；在Nvidia RTX3080上实现60 FPS端到端动画。

Conclusion: 多视角RGB相机可作为稀疏传感器VR全身追踪的有效补充，提升下体精度并保持实时性，代码已开源。

Abstract: Accurate full-body tracking in Virtual Reality (VR) is heavily underconstrained when relying solely on consumer-grade sparse sensors, such as Head-Mounted Displays (HMDs) and handheld controllers. Indeed, the self-avatar full-body pose must be inferred based on the 3 available upper-body joints tracked by these devices. This leads to significant tracking error, especially in lower-body pose. To overcome this issue, we propose to extend the tracking setup with external multiview RGB cameras. We show that integrating RGB-based pose estimation this framework is able to significantly decrease lower-body tracking errors, even under common artifacts in RGB-based estimates. Additionally, we evaluate a only-once HMD-camera calibration procedure that does not require any physical markers. We finally propose an implementation of the overall framework, achieving an end-to-end animation at 60 FPS on a Nvidia RTX3080 GPU. Codes are available at https://github.com/antmaio/MuCHMDPoser.

</details>


### [210] [Efficient Hybrid Distillation: Synergizing Score and Adversarial Objectives for One-Step Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03017)
*Fei Peng,Junqiang Wu,Haoxian Tan,Jun Zhou,Jie Hu,Xiaoming Wei,Jie Guo,Xiu Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究分数蒸馏与对抗蒸馏的协同机制，提出EASD框架，通过区间自适应采样让各目标作用于其有效区间，在ImageNet 256×256上实现1.39的一步FID。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有混合蒸馏方法多为目标的简单叠加，如何有效协同各蒸馏范式尚未被充分探索。

Method: 揭示分数蒸馏在高噪声区间擅长捕捉全局分布但低噪声区缺乏细粒度监督、对抗蒸馏在低噪声区有效但高噪声区不稳定且判别器易失效的互补特性；据此提出EASD，用区间自适应采样策略将各目标导向其有效区间，并推广至基于DiT的Flow Matching模型。

Result: 在ImageNet 256×256上，基于SiT-XL/2+REPA模型取得一步FID 1.39。

Conclusion: 为最大化混合蒸馏潜力提供了具体指导准则，代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: Numerous distillation methods have been developed to accelerate diffusion models. Recent research indicates that hybrid strategies---blending different paradigms---yield superior results compared to single-method approaches. However, current works predominantly rely on a simple combination of objectives, leaving the question of how to effectively synergize them largely underexplored. In this paper, we specifically investigate the synergy between Score Distillation and Adversarial Distillation. We reveal that their operating zones are distinct and complementary: Score Distillation is effective in high-noise regimes for capturing the global distribution yet lacks fine-grained supervision in low-noise regions. Conversely, Adversarial Distillation is effective in low-noise regions but is prone to instability and suffers from discriminator failure when applied to high-noise intervals. Leveraging this insight, we propose Efficient Adversarial Score Distillation (EASD), a framework that synergizes these objectives via a regime-adaptive sampling strategy, directing each objective to focus on its effective interval. We further apply this paradigm to DiT-based Flow Matching models. Empirically, our method achieves a promising one-step FID of 1.39 on ImageNet 256$\times$256 using the SiT-XL/2+REPA model. This work provides a concrete guideline for maximizing the potential of hybrid distillation. Our code and model are available at https://github.com/pf0607/EASD .

</details>


### [211] [TailorRig: Controllable and Structured Auxiliary Skeleton Generation for Garment-Aware Rigging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02902)
*Yajing Chen,Xin Chen,Saidan Lu,Yeqi Yuan,Weikai Chen,Changyu Hu,Cheng Zeng,Xin Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TailorRig将服装感知的人形骨骼绑定重新定义为结构化、可控的完整骨骼生成任务，通过用户指定身体骨骼模板与语义标签驱动自回归生成器合成辅助骨骼链，并采用层次化“链—骨”蒙皮权重分配，提升精度、稳定性与可控性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代角色服装复杂，需要稠密辅助骨骼与精确蒙皮控制。现有自动方法主要从几何恢复骨骼，对辅助关节的艺术家控制有限，且稠密服装骨骼缺乏显式语义与运动链结构，导致不稳定与权重渗透（weight bleeding）。

Method: 提出TailorRig框架，暴露两个显式控制轴：用户指定身体骨骼模板以保持身体绑定兼容性；艺术家提供语义标签驱动自回归生成器合成指定类别的辅助骨骼链。蒙皮上引入层次化chain-to-bone公式：先将顶点关联到运动链，再在链内细化骨骼权重，抑制语义无关但空间相邻结构间的权重渗透。

Result: 在多样角色集上评估，并构建Human-Mix大规模数据集（超38,000个人形模型，面向服装感知绑定）。实验表明相较现有方法，TailorRig在骨骼精度、形变稳定性、可控性与实用性上均有提升。

Conclusion: 将服装感知人形绑定表述为可控的完整骨骼生成问题，可实现从自动恢复转向艺术家驱动的骨骼创作，兼顾身体模板兼容性与辅助关节控制，并通过链级先验有效缓解稠密骨骼下的权重渗透。

Abstract: Humanoid rigging for modern characters with complex garments remains challenging due to the need for dense auxiliary skeletons and precise skinning control. Existing automatic methods primarily recover rigs from geometry, providing limited artist control over auxiliary articulation and often lacking explicit semantic or kinematic-chain structure for dense garment bones, leading to instability and weight bleeding. We present TailorRig, a framework that reformulates garment-aware humanoid rigging as a structured, controllable full-rig generation problem. This formulation shifts the goal from automatic rig recovery to artist-driven rig authoring, where both body-template compatibility and auxiliary articulation are explicit design choices. TailorRig exposes two explicit axes of artist control within a unified framework: a user-specified body skeleton template that preserves body-rig compatibility, and artist-provided semantic labels that drive an autoregressive generator to synthesize requested category-specific auxiliary bone chains. To robustly assign skinning weights under dense skeletal configurations, we further introduce a hierarchical chain-to-bone formulation: vertices are first associated to a kinematic chain, and bone weights are then refined within that chain, reducing weight bleeding between spatially adjacent but semantically unrelated structures. We evaluate TailorRig on a diverse set of characters and introduce Human-Mix, a large-scale dataset of over 38,000 humanoid models curated for garment-aware rigging. Experiments show that TailorRig improves skeleton accuracy, deformation stability, controllability, and practical usability over existing methods.

</details>


### [212] [PhotoGuider: Composition-Aware Cropping and 360$^{\circ}$ View Framing with Explainable Photographic Assessments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02897)
*Yuan-Kang Lee,Kuan-Lin Chen,Chia-Che Chang,Yu-Lun Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PhotoGuider：在360°全景中先用打分器选视角，再用共享构图特征的打分器精修取景，可输出相机参数与解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统图像裁剪默认构图已存在、只需决定裁剪位置；而360°全景没有现成"值得保留的构图"，视角方向本身需先被发现，再谈取景。

Method: "先测量后取景"的统一框架：用基础视觉模型与任务专用模型提取构图相关特征，结构化为Subject、Composition、Aesthetics、Integrity四个摄影token；在同一特征上训练紧凑学习型打分器，同时完成视角方向选择与精细取景；MLLM解释器经微调，以图像和token测量结果为条件生成构图解释；并输出相机参数以支持原生重渲染。

Result: 在两个标准2D裁剪基准上平均mIoU最高；盲评中120名参与者在Poly Haven HDRI的100个全景场景上排序三种方法，本方法取景53.2%居首，另两者为27.3%与19.5%。

Conclusion: 据称是首个将360°全景中显式基于构图的方向选择、精修取景、相机参数输出与测量条件化解释相结合的方法。

Abstract: Traditional image cropping assumes the photograph already contains the composition worth keeping, and asks only where to crop. A full 360$^{\circ}$ scene offers no such guarantee: the viewing direction in a scene has to be discovered before anything can be framed. We present PhotoGuider, a measure-then-frame method that answers both questions with compact learned scorers over one shared set of composition-aware features. The designed features are extracted using foundation and task-specific vision models and structured into four photographic tokens: Subject, Composition, Aesthetics, and Integrity. Our MLLM explainer is fine-tuned to generate composition-related explanations conditioned on images and measured token assessments. To our knowledge, PhotoGuider is the first method to combine explicit composition-based direction selection in 360$^{\circ}$ panoramas with refined framing, camera-parameter output for native re-rendering, and measurement-conditioned explanations. On two standard 2D cropping benchmarks, PhotoGuider achieves the highest average mIoU performance against ground-truth crops. In a blind ranking study, 120 participants ranked three cropping methods over 100 panoramic scenes from the public Poly Haven HDRI library, placing our framings first in 53.2% of cases, against 27.3% and 19.5% for two strong alternatives. Project page: https://ntuneillee.github.io/research/photoguider/

</details>


### [213] [Subspace Representations for Synthetic-to-Real Transfer in 3-D Surface Inspection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02744)
*Abdulla Nasir Chowdhury,Naish Ibrahim,Gulpi Qorik Oktagalu Pratamasunu,Kazuhiro Fukui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究子空间表示在三维表面检测的"仿真缺陷→真实数据"迁移中能贡献什么，在仅有良品扫描作真实参考的条件下，发现子空间的收益取决于其所张成的分布偏移量，且参考模板及其配准比子空间本身更关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三维表面检测中真实缺陷数据稀缺，模型通常只在合成缺陷上训练，部署前唯一可得的真实数据是良品扫描。作者希望厘清"子空间表示"这一经典工具在此类合成到真实的分布偏移下究竟提供了什么价值，而非笼统地声称其有效性。

Method: 以三种经典子空间构造作为分析工具：最近子空间分类器、单类模板子空间、广义差分子空间（GDS）。在 1,197 张 MVTec 3D-AD 扫描（无目标标注）上比较各决策规则的排序能力、图像级检测与阈值保持性；并从理论上刻画最近子空间规则的间隔随特征偏移中"落在类子空间之外的分量"（泄漏）而变化，用无标注良品扫描估计该泄漏量以约束未见过扫描上的位移。另在 597 个 Real3D-AD 物体上，用冻结特征上逐位置评估的配准模板单类子空间做零训练验证。

Result: MVTec 3D-AD 上：所有决策规则对真实缺陷的窗口 AUC 相近，图像级检测处于随机水平，且没有规则能保持其域内阈值。理论上界表明最近子空间规则的间隔位移不超过特征偏移中泄漏出类子空间的部分，且该泄漏（由无标注良品扫描测得）能约束未见扫描上的实际位移。Real3D-AD 上：零训练条件下，配准模板单类子空间在预注册扫描上达到点级 AUROC 0.957，类别平均物体级 AUROC 为 78–81。

Conclusion: 子空间在分布偏移下的帮助程度与其所张成的偏移量成正比；在基于参考的检测范式中，参考模板及其配准的质量比子空间的选择更为重要。图像级判定在此设定下仍不可靠，阈值需按目标域重新校准。

Abstract: This paper studies what subspace representations contribute to synthetic-to-real transfer in 3-D surface inspection, where models learn from synthetic defects and the only real data before deployment are scans of good parts. We use three classical constructions as instruments: the nearest-subspace classifier, one-class template subspaces and the generalized difference subspace (GDS). On 1,197 MVTec 3D-AD scans without target annotation we find that every decision rule ranks real defects at a similar window AUC, that image-level detection stays at chance, and that no rule keeps its in-domain threshold. We show that the margin of a nearest-subspace rule moves by at most the part of the feature shift outside its class subspaces, and that this leakage, measured from unlabeled good scans, bounds the displacement observed on unseen scans. On 597 Real3D-AD objects, a one-class subspace of registered templates evaluated at every location on frozen features reaches point AUROC 0.957 on pre-registered scans and a category-mean object AUROC of 78 to 81 with no training on the benchmark. Our results suggest that a subspace helps under shift in proportion to the shift it spans, and that in reference-based inspection the reference and its registration matter more than the subspace.

</details>


### [214] [Attention Residual U-Net for Enhanced Cross-Dataset Polyp Localization in Endoscopy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02726)
*Romil Imtiaz,Dimitris K. Iakovidis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于注意力残差U-Net的息肉检测框架，通过抑制背景、学习病灶相关空间表征再转换为边界框预测，在多设备公开数据集上AUC最高提升22.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内镜病灶精准定位关键，但YOLO等通用目标检测在真实临床条件下（设备差异、肠道内容物、数据偏置、小/低对比度病灶）鲁棒性下降。

Method: 不直接从全局特征回归边界框，而是学习病灶聚焦的空间表征，在推理阶段转换为边界框；编码器-解码器结构中在特征重建前选择性抑制无关背景响应，融合残差特征传播、注意力引导的编码器滤波与多尺度上下文学习。

Result: 在多个不同设备的公开内镜数据集上，相较相关SOTA方法AUC最高提升22.0%。

Conclusion: 注意力引导的编码器滤波与残差重建可提升异构成像条件下的息肉定位鲁棒性与准确性。

Abstract: Precise localization of pathologies in endoscopy is a critical task in medical imaging, with deep learning (DL) frameworks now serving as the primary methodology for automated lesion detection. Today, generic object detection methods, such as YOLO, provide state-of-the-art performance in this context. However, their robustness often decreases under real-world clinical conditions due to variations across endoscopic devices, intestinal content, dataset bias, and the presence of small or low-contrast lesions. Motivated by these challenges, we propose a novel polyp detection framework based on a Attention Residual U-Net offering enhanced polyp localization. Instead of directly regressing bounding boxes from global feature representations, the proposed method learns lesion-focused spatial representations and converts them into bounding-box predictions during inference. Unlike conventional encoder-decoder localization frameworks that directly propagate all encoder activations into the decoding pathway, the proposed method selectively suppresses irrelevant background responses before feature reconstruction. This encourages the network to focus on lesion-relevant spatial evidence under heterogeneous imaging conditions. To achieve this, the framework integrates residual feature propagation, attention-guided encoder filtering, and multi-scale contextual learning. The proposed framework was evaluated on multiple public endoscopic datasets acquired using different devices. The comparative experimental results validate its effectiveness over the relevant state-of-the-art methods, with an improvement up to 22.0% in terms of the area under the receiving operating characteristic (AUC).

</details>


### [215] [Discovering Semantic Granularity in Images through Clustering of Pretrained Visual Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02686)
*Ying Dai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出以聚类预训练视觉表示来发现多粒度语义区域的无监督框架：通过拼接特征图并用SVD投影得到像素级主表示图（PRM），以语义连续性率（SCR）与SCR剖面信噪比（SNR）评估并选择合适粒度，在COCO-2017与VOC-2012上用HIoU取得有竞争力的分割性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语义粒度（视觉表示将图像内容组织为有意义实体的层级）是图像理解的基础，但预训练视觉表示是否内在编码多粒度语义结构尚不清楚；同时缺乏无需语义监督即可发现有用语义粒度的手段。

Method: 1) 选取预训练模型的特征图进行拼接，经SVD投影得到像素级主表示图（PRM），以显式化表示中隐含的语义结构；2) 对PRM进行语义聚类以在不同候选粒度下发现语义区域；3) 基于轮廓系数原理提出语义连续性率（SCR），度量各候选粒度下簇内与簇间像素表示的一致性；4) 分析SCR剖面的信噪比（SNR），作为表示是否适合多粒度语义区域发现的判据。

Result: 在初始簇数区间内SNR更高的PRM往往能在多个粒度上产生更具语义意义的区域；在COCO-2017与VOC-2012验证集上以匈牙利匹配IoU（HIoU）评估，分割性能与对比方法相比具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 无需语义监督，仅通过聚类PRM即可发现有用的语义粒度，验证了预训练视觉表示中隐含多粒度语义结构的可行性，并提供了基于SCR/SNR的粒度可辨识性诊断工具。

Abstract: Semantic granularity, which refers to the levels at which visual representations organize image content into meaningful entities, is fundamental to image understanding. However, whether pretrained visual representations inherently encode semantic structures at multiple granularities remains poorly understood. This paper presents a representation-driven approach for discovering semantically meaningful image regions at different granularities through clustering of pretrained visual representations without semantic supervision. Specifically, we concatenate selected feature maps extracted from a pretrained visual model and apply a singular value decomposition (SVD)-based projection to derive pixel-wise principal representation maps (PRMs). The resulting PRMs capture implicit semantic structures embedded in pretrained visual representations, making them accessible to subsequent semantic clustering. We then introduce the semantic continuity rate (SCR), based on the silhouette principle, to quantify the coherence of pixel-wise representations within and between clusters at different candidate granularities. Furthermore, we analyze the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of SCR profiles to assess representation suitability for discovering semantic regions at multiple granularities. Our results indicate that PRMs exhibiting higher SNR values over an initial range of cluster numbers tend to yield more semantically meaningful regions across multiple granularities. We evaluate the proposed approach on the COCO-2017 and VOC-2012 validation datasets using Hungarian-matched intersection over union (HIoU). The results demonstrate competitive segmentation performance among the compared methods, supporting the feasibility of discovering useful semantic granularities through clustering PRMs without semantic supervision.

</details>


### [216] [Geometry-Constrained Dynamic Hypergraph Convolutional Network with Contrastive Score Refinement for Skeleton-Based Action Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02685)
*Minh Ta Tran Nhat,Yuning Ye,Yuseok Ban*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DyGCN——几何约束动态超图卷积网络，用动态超边构造+对比分数精炼捕捉动作特异的关节高阶交互，在NTU RGB+D、NTU RGB+D 120、NW-UCLA上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统GCN仅做成对关节建模，难以刻画人体运动中的高阶交互；现有超图方法依赖解剖先验的静态结构，缺乏捕捉动态、动作特有关节关联的灵活性。

Method: 核心为DyGCT块，含两个模块：(1) GeoHC利用几何约束的二阶兼容性动态构造动作特异超边，突破静态超边结构限制；(2) CSR通过基于原型的对比学习显式精炼超图构造中的成对兼容性分数，获得更具判别性的超边，且仅在训练时生效，推理零开销。

Result: 在NTU RGB+D、NTU RGB+D 120和Northwestern-UCLA三个基准上取得最优性能，验证了方法有效性。

Conclusion: 几何约束的动态超图构造结合对比分数精炼，可有效替代静态超边建模，在无推理额外开销下提升骨架动作识别性能。

Abstract: Skeleton-based action recognition is a pivotal task in computer vision; however, conventional Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) are often constrained by pairwise joint modeling, which fails to capture the intricate high-order interactions inherent in human movement. While recent hypergraph-based methods attempt to address this limitation, they typically rely on static structures derived from anatomical priors, lacking the flexibility to capture dynamic, action-specific joint correlations. To this end, we propose DyGCN, a Geometry-Constrained Dynamic Hypergraph Convolutional Network for skeleton-based action recognition. At the core of DyGCN is the Dynamic Hypergraph Construction Network with Contrastive Score Refinement (DyGCT) block, which comprises two novel components: the Geometry-Constrained Dynamic Hypergraph Construction (GeoHC) module and the Contrastive Score Refinement (CSR) module. Specifically, GeoHC dynamically constructs action-specific hyperedges by leveraging geometry-constrained second-order compatibility, transcending the limitations of static hyperedge structures. Furthermore, CSR explicitly refines the pairwise compatibility scores during hypergraph construction through prototype-based contrastive learning, fostering more discriminative action-specific hyperedges, with zero inference-time overhead as CSR operates only during training. Extensive experiments on NTU RGB+D, NTU RGB+D 120, and Northwestern-UCLA validate the effectiveness of DyGCN, achieving state-of-the-art performance on widely used benchmarks. The source code is available at https://github.com/marvineta0405/DyGCN.

</details>


### [217] [Depth Anyviewpoint? Evaluating Monocular Depth Over Viewpoint Sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02203)
*Theo Rode,Rui Zhang,Ryan Aubrey,Olivia Li,Jessica Huang,Liv Chu,Healani Dowd,Calden Wloka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种利用相机运动视频序列评估单目深度模型跨视角一致性的新协议，并用SfM将相对深度锚定为度量深度，揭示基础模型在长时间序列三维一致性上的开放挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单目深度模型（基于仿射不变损失与基础模型特征）在单帧基准上表现优异，但其预测为仿射不变（相对）深度，缺乏绝对度量；而在视频流等真实应用中需要场景的三维结构一致性与度量参考，这一能力尚未被充分检验。

Method: 构建基于运动相机视频序列的评估协议：利用多视角、视角变化的真实视频检验模型预测在视点变化下的一致性；并借助SfM（structure from motion）将模型输出的相对深度锚定为度量深度值。

Result: 在多样化的真实视频序列上验证该协议，显示模型在长时间跨度上的时间一致性存在明显不足，且SfM作为度量锚定工具在直接迁移至单目深度估计时存在局限。

Conclusion: 单目深度基础模型的广泛适用性（尤其长时序几何一致性）仍存在开放挑战；同时将SfM作为度量接地手段的朴素做法亦需谨慎，为后续评测与模型改进提供方向。

Abstract: Monocular depth estimation aims to predict depth maps from single RGB images (forgoing the need for stereo camera pairs) and has seen impressive leaps in performance in recent work due to the introduction of affine-invariant losses and the use of foundation model features. These monocular depth models predict affine-invariant depth, which describes the relative positions of objects in the scene instead of absolute depth. While these models demonstrate strong performance on single image benchmarks and qualitatively consistent predictions in video, their effectiveness at preserving consistent spatial structure has been less thoroughly explored. Many potential real-world applications, such as handling video streams as input, rely on coherent three dimensional consistency in scenes. Further, anchoring relative depth predictions to a metric reference for a given scene is a key challenge for applying monocular depth models to real-world situations. We develop a novel evaluation protocol for monocular depth models using video sequences with moving camera positions to test the consistency of prediction across variation in viewpoint. We demonstrate this methodology over diverse, real-world video sequences where we are able to anchor depth model output to metric depth values using structure from motion. Our work demonstrates open challenges in the development of broadly applicable monocular depth foundation models, particularly with their ability to provide temporal consistency over long time frames. We also identify challenges in the straightforward adoption of structure-from-motion as a metric grounding tool for monocular depth estimation models.

</details>


### [218] [Solv3R: 3D Looped Transformer as a Multi-view Solver](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02857)
*Jeong-gi Kwak,Andrea Tagliasacchi,Sho Kagami,Yuki Ono,Kwang Moo Yi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Solv3R——一个循环Transformer，学习从当前状态继续求解多视图几何，用与迭代次数无关的更新算子统一支持离线、增量、重定位与流式重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典SfM迭代式地精化相机位姿与场景几何，可增量扩展与逐步改进；而多数几何基础模型一次性前向预测全部几何或依靠循环状态顺序更新，难以自然地扩展与精化重建。

Method: 设计循环（looped）Transformer，其更新算子与迭代计数无关，因此已精化视图与新加入视图可被联合更新；训练算子在被持续迭代时保持准确重建、并纠正不准确状态；已解视图表示可缓存一次并作为几何上下文复用，实现紧凑高效的KV缓存。

Result: 分析了解算器动力学并与SOTA对比，表明单一学习到的解算器在无需任务特定训练或模块的情况下支持离线重建、增量重建、重定位和流式重建。

Conclusion: 循环式、迭代无关的几何求解器可作为统一框架，兼顾经典SfM的增量精化能力与学习式模型的效率，代码与模型将开源。

Abstract: Classical structure-from-motion reconstruction proceeds iteratively, refining camera poses and scene geometry from a current estimate. This allows maps to easily expand without recomputing already computed views, or geometry estimates to improve as more observations are provided. Most geometric foundation models, however, predict entire geometry in a single forward pass or update a recurrent state as frames arrive sequentially, making this expansion and refinement non-trivial. We introduce Solv3R, a looped transformer that learns to continue solving multi-view geometry from its current state. Importantly, its update operator is independent of the iteration count, allowing previously refined and newly introduced views to be jointly updated regardless of how ``solved'' they are. We train the operator to preserve accurate reconstructions under continued iteration and correct inaccurate states, enabling refinement of fixed image collections and integration of new observations. Representations of solved views can also be cached once and reused as geometric context across iterations, enabling compact and efficient key-value caching. We analyze the solver dynamics and compare it with the state-of-the-art, demonstrating that a single learned solver supports offline reconstruction, incremental reconstruction, relocalization, and streaming without task-specific training or modules. The code and models will be made publicly available at https://ubc-vision.github.io/solv3r/.

</details>


### [219] [ReinSeg: Retrieval-Guided Bounded Multimodal Refinement for 3-D Road Anomaly Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02648)
*Haifa Zhang,Yijing Wang,Zhiqiang Zuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReinSeg：一种检索引导的范数有界多模态细化框架，用于逐点3-D道路异常分割，在保持LiDAR异常评分接口的同时引入环视影像语义上下文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3-D道路异常分割的核心难点在于：将稀疏观测的异常排在大量正常路面结构之前，同时保持逐点度量定位。LiDAR提供精确3-D点支撑，环视影像提供互补语义上下文，但需解决如何在不破坏已有LiDAR异常评分接口的前提下融合二者。

Method: 以被占据的LiDAR BEV栅格从8张环视图像构成的共享记忆中检索场景相关上下文（不向检索模块提供标定变量）；通过相对范数有界残差将上下文回注到LiDAR点特征，从而保持冻结的LIDO异常评分接口；仅用分布内语义标签优化细化模块。

Result: STU基准上验证集AP由27.54%提升至35.67%，95%异常召回下FPR由34.85%降至10.61%，高召回筛选集从6754万点缩减至2055万点；相较REL，AP高24.99个百分点、FPR95低0.99个百分点。组件隔离实验表明检索影像与相对范数界均不可或缺；在相机缺失、损坏或未对齐时仍优于仅LiDAR方案，运行速度21.8 FPS。

Conclusion: 场景特异视觉证据的有界检索是通往可靠3-D道路风险感知的有效路径。

Abstract: 3-D road anomaly segmentation is essential for risk-aware perception in autonomous driving. Its central challenge is to rank sparsely observed hazards ahead of abundant normal road structures while preserving point-wise metric localization. LiDAR provides accurate 3-D point support, whereas surround-view imagery offers complementary semantic context for separating unexpected hazards from challenging normal structures. We propose ReinSeg, a retrieval-guided bounded multimodal refinement framework for point-wise road anomaly segmentation. Occupied LiDAR bird's-eye-view cells retrieve scene-specific context from a shared memory of eight surround-view images without supplying calibration variables to the retrieval module. A relative-norm-bounded residual returns this context to the LiDAR point features, so the frozen LIDO anomaly-scoring interface is preserved, and the refinement is optimized with in-distribution semantic labels only. On the Spotting the Unexpected (STU) benchmark, ReinSeg improves validation average precision from 27.54\% to 35.67\% and reduces the false-positive rate at 95\% anomaly recall from 34.85\% to 10.61\%, shrinking the high-recall screening set from 67.54 to 20.55 million points. Relative to REL, AP is 24.99 percentage points higher and FPR95 is 0.99 points lower. Matched interfaces and component isolation show that retrieved scene imagery and the relative-norm bound are both essential, and ReinSeg stays above LiDAR-only performance under missing, corrupted, or misaligned camera inputs while running at 21.8 frames per second. These results establish bounded retrieval of scene-specific visual evidence as an effective route to reliable 3-D road-hazard perception.

</details>


### [220] [Aerial Content-Aware Sample-Adaptive Classifier for Urban Photogrammetric Point Cloud Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02844)
*Chong Liu,Yonghua Lu,Zhanglin Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ACASAC方法，在特征融合基础上引入决策级自适应，用样本自适应分类器建模航拍场景与局部点块、2D与3D表示之间的差异关系，提升城市摄影测量点云分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市摄影测量点云通常按局部3D块处理，上下文有限，难以区分几何相似的类别；正交投影得到的DOM/RGB-D虽提供大范围上下文但与点云共配准，却压缩了垂直几何。现有投影—点云方法主要在特征层面融合两种表示，并对所有样本共享同一分类器，缺乏对样本差异的适应。

Method: 构建点对齐的航拍区域以桥接完整航拍裁剪与局部3D块；在投影内部建模场景到局部的变化，并对齐后的2D与3D支撑之间建模表示差异；将两类关系迁移用于精化局部分类表示；由精化表示、场景级航拍上下文与固定的融合头先验共同构成当前样本的分类器。

Result: 相比固定双表示头，在SensatUrban和UrbanBIS上分别提升2.1和2.7 mIoU，在四种测试的编码器组合上提升2.1–2.3 mIoU。

Conclusion: 在特征级融合之上补充决策级自适应是有效且通用的，可稳定提升城市点云语义分割的精度，且不依赖特定编码器组合。

Abstract: Urban photogrammetric point clouds are commonly processed as local 3D patches, limiting the context available for distinguishing geometrically similar categories. Orthographic projection of the same data yields a co-registered digital orthophoto map (DOM)/RGB-D representation that supports efficient large-context modeling but compresses vertical geometry. Existing projection--point methods mainly fuse these two representations at the feature level while retaining a classifier shared across all samples. We present the Aerial Content-Aware Sample-Adaptive Classifier (ACASAC), which complements feature fusion with decision-level adaptation. A point-aligned aerial region bridges the full aerial crop and local 3D patch. ACASAC models scene-to-local variation within the projection and the representation discrepancy between aligned 2D and 3D supports, then transfers both relations to refine the local point class representation. The refined representation, scene-level aerial context, and fixed fused-head prior jointly form a classifier for the current sample. ACASAC improves the fixed dual-representation head by 2.1 and 2.7 mIoU points on SensatUrban and UrbanBIS, respectively, and by 2.1--2.3 points across four tested encoder combinations.

</details>


### [221] [Risk-Constrained Evaluation of Financial Document Recognition: A Formal Framework for Evidence, Critical Errors, and Selective Automation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02775)
*Subodh Lonkar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文将财务文档识别重构为"风险约束下的证据恢复问题"，提出分层质量模型与非补偿性验收门控，用上置信界控制关键字段错误风险，并给出可复现性规范；全文为理论性工作，无实证结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有财务文档识别普遍采用字符错误率（CER）与词错误率（WER）评价，但聚合指标无法反映错误在财务工作流中的实际后果，且汇总分数无法证明关键字段（如金额、账号）的可靠性，观测零错误也不等于零风险。

Method: (1) 形式化"带类型的、与证据关联的财务事实"；(2) 构建覆盖文本、版面、表格、字段、语义关系、校准、鲁棒性与运行性能的多层质量模型；(3) 基于关键字段错误率的上置信界（UCB）设计非补偿性验收门控；(4) 将选择性自动化建模为带审核容量约束的风险—覆盖率（risk-coverage）约束优化；(5) 规定标注要求、防泄漏基准划分、统计估计量与可复现性卡片。

Result: 给出形式化命题，论证聚合分数无法认证关键字段可靠性、观测零错误不蕴含零风险；并以合成示例演示决策规则的运作方式。文中明确声明不提供任何经验基准或模型性能声明。

Conclusion: 应以风险约束、证据可追溯与统计保证替代单一聚合误差率来评价财务文档识别；关键字段可靠性需由保守置信界与非补偿门控来认证，选择性自动化须显式考虑审核容量与覆盖率权衡。

Abstract: Financial document recognition is commonly evaluated using character and word error rates, which do not adequately represent the consequences of errors in financial workflows. This paper formalizes financial document recognition as a risk-constrained evidence-recovery problem. It defines typed, evidence-linked financial facts and a multi-layer quality model spanning text, layout, tables, fields, semantic relations, calibration, robustness, and operational performance. It introduces non-compensatory acceptance gates based on upper confidence bounds for critical-field errors, and formulates selective automation as a constrained risk-coverage problem with review-capacity limits. The paper also specifies annotation requirements, leakage-resistant benchmark splits, statistical estimands, and a reproducibility card. Formal propositions establish why aggregate scores cannot certify critical-field reliability and why zero observed errors do not imply zero risk. A synthetic example illustrates the decision rule. The work is theoretical; no empirical benchmark or model performance claim is presented.

</details>


### [222] [Unlocking the Potential of Vision Foundation Models for Multi-Task Dense Prediction via Mixture of Task Adapters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02769)
*Yunzhi Zhuge,Xinzhuo Yu,Sitong Gong,Lu Zhang,Pingping Zhang,Huchuan Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出D2MoE，在冻结DINOv3主干上以"任务通用+任务特异"两级适配因子化多任务密集预测：TG-LoRA提供共享稳定通道，TA-MoE仅在每阶段最后一个注意力块做稀疏任务条件专家扰动，并辅以语义先验注入器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多任务密集预测需同时兼顾语义判别与几何/结构推断。预训练视觉基础模型的语义不变性与密集任务的频率、平滑性偏好存在冲突；联合微调或单路径适配器把竞争梯度压缩进单一更新通道，导致负迁移与跨任务一致性不稳定。

Method: 将适配视为两级问题：任务通用对齐（保留先验）与任务感知特化（解决后期冲突）。据此在冻结DINOv3上：(1) 全网络注意力投影中引入TG-LoRA，形成稳定共享适配通道；(2) 仅在各阶段最后一个注意力块注入TA-MoE，在单次前向中实现稀疏、任务条件的token混合扰动；(3) 语义先验注入器将多层级任务特征与冻结基础先验耦合，增强语义一致性并保持边界与结构保真。

Result: 在多个多样化基准上取得稳健的多任务性能提升，且可训练参数规模较小（小训练足迹）。

Conclusion: 结构化的两级因子化适配为"保先验、以基础模型为中心"的多任务密集感知提供了一条有原则且可扩展的路径。

Abstract: Multi-task dense prediction seeks a single, coherent representation that supports simultaneously discriminative semantic recognition and regularized geometric/structural inference. For vision foundation models, pretrained semantic invariances conflict with the frequency and smoothness biases of dense objectives; joint fine-tuning and single-route adapters therefore compress competing gradients into one update channel, causing negative transfer and unstable cross-task agreement. We frame this as two-level adaptation: task-generic alignment that preserves priors, and task-aware specialization that resolves late-stage conflicts. Based on this principle, we propose D2MoE , a Mixture of Task Adapters that explicitly factorizes these roles within a frozen DINOv3 backbone. D2MoE introduces Task-Generic Low-Rank Adaptation (TG-LoRA) in attention projections throughout the network to provide a stable, shared adaptation channel, and a Task-Adaptive Mixture of Experts (TA-MoE) injected only at the final attention block of each stage to enact sparse, task-conditioned perturbations of token mixing in a single forward pass. A Semantic Prior Injector further couples multi-level task features with frozen foundation priors to reinforce semantic coherence while preserving boundary and structural fidelity. Experiments across diverse benchmarks substantiate that this structured factorization yields robust multi-task improvements with a small trainable footprint, establishing a principled and scalable route to prior-preserving, foundation-centric multi-task dense perception.

</details>


### [223] [DINOFAS: Bonafide-Centric Representation Learning for Face Anti-Spoofing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02756)
*Shakeel Muhammad Ibrahim,Muhammad Sohail Ibrahim,Muhammad Shahid Jabbar,Shujaat Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DINOFAS将人脸反欺骗(FAS)重构为以真脸为中心的表示学习，基于DINOv3结合LoRA高效微调、注意力风格-内容解耦(ASCD)模块与双分支架构，在跨域泛化上取得SOTA级平均HTER。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有FAS模型易学到与特定攻击类型、特定数据集绑定的线索，在未见采集条件和未知呈现攻击下泛化性能显著下降。

Method: 基于DINOv3构建框架：(1) 采用LoRA进行参数高效适配；(2) 引入注意力风格-内容解耦(ASCD)模块以削弱域相关外观变化；(3) 设计双分支结构，将基于原型的活体学习与攻击语义监督分离。联合优化三项目标：以真脸为中心的原型损失、作用于detach特征的攻击语义分类损失、以及正交性正则化。

Result: OCIM留一域协议（三源域训练、留出未见域测试）下平均HTER为9.09%；SynthASpoof合成训练→四个真实域测试的合成到真实泛化中，取得最低平均HTER 21.41%与最高平均AUC 86.14%；OULU-NPU与SiW-Mv2上亦表现出对采集条件、设备变化及未见呈现攻击的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 以真脸为中心的表示学习范式配合预训练大模型高效适配与风格-内容解耦，可有效提升FAS在跨域及合成到真实场景下的泛化能力。

Abstract: Face anti-spoofing (FAS) models often learn attack- and dataset-specific cues that degrade performance under unseen acquisition conditions and presentation attacks. We present DINOFAS, a DINOv3-based framework that formulates FAS as bonafide-centric representation learning. The proposed framework combines parameter-efficient DINOv3 adaptation using low-rank adaptation (LoRA), an attention style-content disentanglement (ASCD) module for reducing domain-specific appearance variations, and a dual-branch architecture that separates prototype-based liveness learning from attack-semantic supervision. The model is jointly optimized using a bonafide-centric prototype objective, an attack-semantic classification loss applied to detached features, and orthogonality regularization. DINOFAS achieves an average HTER of 9.09\% under the standard OCIM leave-one-domain-out protocol, where training is performed on three source datasets and evaluation is conducted on the held-out unseen domain. We further evaluate synthetic-to-real generalization by training exclusively on SynthASpoof and testing on four unseen real-world datasets, where DINOFAS achieves the lowest average HTER of 21.41\% and the highest average AUC of 86.14\% among the compared methods. Evaluations on OULU-NPU and SiW-Mv2 additionally demonstrate robustness to variations in acquisition conditions, devices, and unseen presentation attacks.

</details>


### [224] [Pair-Relative Partial Equivariance for Rotation-Robust Keypoint Descriptor Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02751)
*Jongmin Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出成对相对部分等变性(pair-relative partial equivariance)与PaSteer框架，放松描述子引导的精确SO(2)表示约束，在冻结DeDoDe描述子上提升大旋转鲁棒匹配性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从直立图像学习的关键点描述子在大平面内旋转下性能显著下降。现有steerer方法对描述子空间施加单一精确SO(2)表示，但该全局群约束对关键点描述子过于刚性——其角度响应未必服从单一群表示。

Method: 1) 定义"成对相对部分等变性"：以图像对中相对旋转的经验分布度量等变性，而非要求全局群作用；2) 提出PaSteer松弛式描述子引导框架，允许引导映射偏离精确表示流形，同时保留轻量、无骨干网络的引导设计；3) 给出两个变体：保持恒等的残差steerer(PaSteer-soft)与自由形式傅里叶steerer(PaSteer-free)；4) 理论分析：对固定非等变描述子，逐角度的最优线性steerer一般不满足群复合律，说明精确表示在冻结描述子场景下可能次优。

Result: 在Roto-360、MegaDepth-1500、AIMS、IMC-PT四个基准上，PaSteer在冻结DeDoDe描述子上一致优于精确steerer，尤其在大相对旋转下提升明显，且直立性能退化极小。

Conclusion: 关键点描述子的旋转等变需求更适合以数据驱动的部分/相对等变性刻画，而非严格群表示；松弛引导可在保持轻量与直立性能的同时显著增强旋转鲁棒性。

Abstract: Learned keypoint descriptors trained on upright imagery often fail under large in-plane rotation. Steerers address this by applying a single exact SO(2) representation to the descriptor space, but this global group constraint can be too rigid for keypoint descriptors, whose angular responses need not follow a single group representation. We propose pair-relative partial equivariance, which measures equivariance under the empirical distribution of relative rotations in image pairs, and PaSteer, a relaxed descriptor-steering framework that allows the steering map to leave the exact representation manifold while retaining the lightweight, backbone-free design of steering. PaSteer instantiates this relaxation with two variants: an identity-preserving residual steerer (PaSteer-soft) and a free-form Fourier steerer (PaSteer-free). We show that the per-angle optimal linear steerer for a fixed non-equivariant descriptor generally does not obey the group composition law, explaining why exact representations can be suboptimal in the frozen-descriptor regime. On Roto-360, MegaDepth-1500, AIMS, and IMC-PT, PaSteer consistently improves rotation-robust matching over an exact steerer on frozen DeDoDe descriptors, especially under large relative rotations, with minimal upright degradation.

</details>


### [225] [Behavioral Affinity Transduction for Zero-Shot Vision-Language Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03132)
*Junxi Huang,Wenshuo Chen,Xiucheng Wang,Meitong Shen,Shaofeng Liang,Yuehan Kou,Yutao Yue,Nan Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BAT（Behavioral Affinity Transduction）利用无标签批内图像的类别响应画像构建稀疏图，将邻居证据注入冻结VLM的直推式预测，提升few-shot/zero-shot分类精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零样本视觉语言模型对每张图像独立打分，忽略了同一无标签批次中图像间的可互助信息。而单纯的视觉相似度可能受姿态或背景干扰，跨越类别边界，因此需要一种更可靠的邻居选择信号。

Method: 在无标注的小查询批次上，用每张图像对类别词表的打分分布作为"行为画像"，据此构建稀疏邻接图；图在预测阶段提供邻居证据，并用于EM-Dirichlet中的候选类别筛选与指派初始化；该方法可作为插件嵌入冻结VLM的直推式读出头（直接式与迭代式）。

Result: 在多种数据集上，BAT对每个测试读出头均提升平均准确率；主实验（RN50）中soft与hard EM-Dirichlet分别提升4.22与2.72个百分点。

Conclusion: 以类别响应画像而非纯视觉特征定义亲和度，是一种有效的无监督直推式增强手段，可即插即用地提升现成VLM读出头性能。

Abstract: An image that is hard to classify on its own may have a helpful neighbor in the same unlabeled batch. Zero-shot vision-language models (VLMs) score images independently and leave this evidence unused. We study small unlabeled query batches with no labeled examples. Visual similarity can reflect pose or background, so it may connect images from different classes. Each image's scores over the class vocabulary offer another way to choose neighbors. We introduce Behavioral Affinity Transduction (BAT), which builds a sparse graph from these class-response profiles. The graph supplies neighbor evidence during prediction. For EM-Dirichlet, it also screens candidate classes and initializes assignments. BAT plugs into direct and iterative readouts of a frozen VLM. Across diverse datasets, BAT improves the mean accuracy of every tested readout. In the main RN50 comparison, soft and hard EM-Dirichlet gain $4.22$ and $2.72$ percentage points.

</details>


### [226] [3D Gaussian Splatting within Self-Learned Neural View-Dependent Color Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03114)
*Yixiao Yang,Yu-Shen Liu,Zhizhong Han*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出用神经网络参数化的连续视角相关颜色场来约束3DGS，改善其深度与几何质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散3D高斯仅依赖自身颜色属性，导致深度质量差、几何细节少且存在大量漂浮物（floaters），难以建模平滑辐射场。

Method: 用神经网络学习连续的视角相关颜色场作为辐射场；利用网络对低频信号的偏置，促使几何建模承担图像高频颜色变化，而非仅依赖颜色属性；施加Lipschitz连续性约束，使每个高斯颜色变化与其位置变化在比例上匹配；并引入自学习策略，在无外部知识或先验下训练该神经颜色场。

Result: 在常用基准上进行了数值与视觉对比，验证了方法的有效性，并在3DGS中展现出更高保真度的几何恢复能力。

Conclusion: 在3DGS中引入连续神经颜色场及其Lipschitz约束可提升几何建模质量与对未见场景的泛化能力。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a vital tool in novel view synthesis. 3D Gaussian functions with attributes like color, opacity, and scale are stacked together to explicitly model a radiance field. However, discrete 3D Gaussians usually produce poor depth with few geometry details but lots of floaters, which hinders the effective modeling of smooth radiance fields. To address this issue, we propose to learn a radiance field within a continuous view-dependent color field parameterized by neural networks. With continuous constraints in color, the bias on low-frequency signals of neural networks can highly encourage the geometry modeling to contribute to high-frequency color variations on images, getting rid of solely relying on the color attribute itself. Moreover, we impose a constraint to improve the Lipschitz continuity of the neural color field, making large changes of each Gaussian's color also match with large changes of its position in terms of a ratio. To this end, we additionally introduce novel self-learning strategies to improve the learning of the neural view-dependent color field without any external knowledge or priors, aiming for better generalization on unseen scenes. Our numerical and visual comparisons on widely used benchmarks justify our idea and show better ability of high fidelity geometry recovery in 3DGS. Project page: https://github.com/yangyixi21/Neural-Color-Fields-3DGS.

</details>


### [227] [Ray-SCR: Generalizing Scene Coordinate Regression Across Camera Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03098)
*Jaemin Cho,Oleksii Nasypanyi,Francois Rameau*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Ray-SCR 通过将局部视觉特征以标定视角光线（viewing ray）为条件，并用浅层局部 Transformer 聚合邻近光线条件特征、在光线空间中进行监督，使单一场景坐标回归表示能跨不同相机模型（针孔、鱼眼、全景）泛化定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 场景坐标回归（SCR）紧凑、准确、快速，但跨相机模型泛化差：视场变化、镜头畸变或矫正重采样会使同一场景内容在不同像素位置呈现不同外观，从而降低定位精度。

Method: 提出 Ray-SCR：1）以标定视角光线对局部视觉特征进行光线条件化（ray conditioning）；2）用浅层局部 Transformer 对相邻光线条件特征做精化；3）直接在光线空间构建监督；4）以稀疏 SfM 点作为度量锚点，跨视角、跨相机模型关联观测。整体为对现有 SCR 架构的轻量扩展。

Result: 在多种 SCR 架构及含针孔、鱼眼、全景相机的数据集上评测，光线条件化显著提升跨相机泛化能力，在此类挑战性跨相机设置下取得 SOTA 定位性能。项目页：https://jaeminch0.github.io/ray-scr-generalizing-scene-coordinate-regression-across-camera-models/

Conclusion: 由全景建图序列构建的单一场景表示，可准确定位来自差异极大相机（针孔、鱼眼、全景）的查询图像；光线条件化是提升 SCR 跨相机泛化的一种有效且轻量方案。

Abstract: Among visual localization strategies, scene coordinate regression (SCR) has emerged as an attractive approach for its compactness, accuracy, and speed. Despite these advantages, SCR models generalize poorly across substantially different camera models, such as omnidirectional or strongly rectified imagery. This limitation arises because, changes in field of view, lens distortion, or rectification-induced resampling can make the same scene content appear differently depending on its pixel position, degrading localization accuracy. To cope with this limitation, we introduce Ray-SCR, a lightweight extension to existing SCR architectures that conditions local visual features on their calibrated viewing rays and refines neighboring ray-conditioned features with a shallow local Transformer. We further formulate supervision directly in ray space and use sparse SfM points as metric anchors that link observations across views and camera models. Taken together, these components enable a single scene representation built from a panoramic mapping sequence to accurately localize query images captured with very different cameras, including pinhole, fisheye, and omnidirectional cameras.
  We evaluate Ray-SCR across multiple SCR architectures and on datasets with pinhole, fisheye, and omnidirectional cameras. The proposed ray conditioning substantially improves generalization across cameras and leads to state-of-the-art localization performance in these challenging cross-camera settings. The project page is available at https://jaeminch0.github.io/ray-scr-generalizing-scene-coordinate-regression-across-camera-models/.

</details>


### [228] [MIRA: Reinforcing Multimodal Reasoning via Deceptive Contextual Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03087)
*Zhihan Yin,Jianxin Liang,Yifeng Yao,Nonghai Zhang,and Bingyue Peng,Chunguang Qie,Huishuai Zhang,Dongyan Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MIRA是一个无需人工标注的训练框架，通过在训练中注入经过滤的欺骗性视觉上下文构造"hard traps"，并引入组内反思触发机制，使模型自主检测并纠正视觉线索与逻辑约束间的不一致，从而缓解多模态推理中的"感知-推理鸿沟"，平均提升域内基准7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）虽推进了多模态推理，但存在"感知-推理鸿沟"：模型过度依赖貌似相关的视觉token，微小的感知扰动会在推理链中传播并导致累积幻觉。作者希望提升模型对错误视觉上下文的鲁棒性，同时增强逻辑推理能力。

Method: 提出MIRA训练框架：1）在训练中注入经过滤的欺骗性视觉上下文，构造具有挑战性的"hard traps"，对模型鲁棒性进行压力测试；2）引入组内（group-wise）反思触发机制，使模型能自主检测并纠正视觉线索与逻辑约束之间的矛盾，并将其内化为内在策略行为；3）整个流程不依赖人工标注。

Result: 在多个推理与感知基准上，域内基准平均提升7%，在以视觉为中心的基准上也取得一致提升；消融实验与分析进一步解释了MIRA有效的原因。

Conclusion: 主动的错误恢复能力对鲁棒的多模态推理至关重要；MIRA通过构造困难陷阱与内化反思机制，有效弥合感知-推理鸿沟。

Abstract: While Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has significantly advanced multimodal reasoning, existing frameworks suffer from a critical "perception-reasoning gap." Due to an over-reliance on seemingly relevant visual tokens, even minor perceptual perturbations can propagate through the reasoning process, leading to compounding hallucinations. To address this issue, we propose MIRA, a training framework that improves robustness to erroneous visual contexts while enhancing logical reasoning ability. By injecting filtered, deceptive visual contexts during training, we construct challenging "hard traps" that stress-test the model's robustness to misleading information. Furthermore, we introduce a group-wise reflection-triggering mechanism that enables the model to autonomously detect and rectify inconsistencies between visual cues and logical constraints, which is ultimately internalized as an intrinsic policy behavior. Importantly, MIRA does not rely on human annotations. Experimental results across multiple reasoning and perception benchmarks show that MIRA yields an average 7% improvement on in-domain benchmarks, with consistent improvements on vision-centric benchmarks. These findings highlight that active error recovery is essential for robust multimodal reasoning. Comprehensive ablation studies and analyses further provide insights into why MIRA is effective.

</details>


### [229] [VideoEditor-MoE: Scaling Complex Video Editing with Mixture of Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03043)
*Xiao Cao,Fuchen Long,Yansong Qu,Wen Xiao,Xin Zhang,Xinlong Sun,Xi Chen,Zhiyong Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出首个开源视频编辑混合专家框架 VideoEditor-MoE，通过路由式 KV 专家的 MoE-Attention 将稀疏专家扩展到 14B/56B（每 token 约激活 8B），在保持全局 token 交互的同时降低密集扩展的计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂视频编辑需同时理解复杂指令并满足多重编辑请求，仅靠密集模型缩放会显著增加计算成本，因此需要以稀疏激活方式提升容量。

Method: 在稀疏 MLP-MoE 层之外提出 MoE-Attention，用路由 key-value 专家扩展注意力容量并保留视频 token 的全局交互；以 5B 视频编辑模型初始化，扩至 14B 与 56B（每 token 激活约 8B）；与现有方法及 Explicit-MoE、MLP-MoE 两个基线对比；并进行专家活跃度、路由行为与空间分析；采用解耦权重衰减稳定专家缩放。

Result: 相较现有方法及 Explicit-MoE、MLP-MoE 基线表现出优势；分析显示所有专家保持活跃，路由对样本内容和扩散噪声水平的响应强于人工定义的编辑类别，空间上对物体级语义特征敏感；解耦权重衰减可稳定专家扩展。

Conclusion: MoE-Attention 结合稀疏 MLP-MoE 可有效扩展视频编辑模型容量而控制激活开销，路由由内容与噪声驱动而非编辑类别，解耦权重衰减是稳定专家缩放的有效策略。

Abstract: Complex video editing requires understanding complex instructions while jointly fulfilling multiple editing requests. Meeting these demands through dense model scaling substantially increases computational cost. We introduce VideoEditor-MoE, the first open-source mixture-of-experts framework for video editing. Beyond sparse MLP-MoE layers, MoE-Attention expands attention capacity through routed key--value experts while preserving global interactions among video tokens. Initialized from a 5B video editing model, VideoEditor-MoE scales to 14B and 56B parameters, with approximately 8B parameters activated per token in both variants. Comparisons with existing methods and two complementary baselines, Explicit-MoE and MLP-MoE, assess its benefits over explicit expert guidance and MLP-only expert architectures. Further analyses demonstrate that all experts remain active and reveal that learned routing responds more strongly to sample content and diffusion noise levels than to human-defined editing categories. Spatial analysis further indicates sensitivity to object-level semantic features. We also identify decoupled weight decay as a strategy for stabilizing expert scaling.

</details>


### [230] [GPU-Native Real-Time Textured Mesh Reconstruction with Seam-Aware Multi-View Radiometric Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03033)
*Hiroyuki Sato*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出全GPU驻留的多RGB-D传感器体积视频重建系统，输出可直接用于图形渲染的带纹理三角网格；各阶段（TSDF融合、Marching Cubes、连通域去噪、视图纹理映射、修补、辐射接缝校正）全程留在GPU，中间数据不回传主机；用定长数组表示网格拓扑实现常数时间邻域访问；逐相机低频增益场烘焙进纹理图集以消除曝光接缝。在CMU Panoptic上各体素分辨率与传感器数量下均快于基线，峰值加速超CUDA nvblox与CPU Open3D一个数量级以上，重渲染画质接近离线基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TSDF系统虽已GPU加速融合与网格提取，但要实现逐帧带纹理网格化仍需引入CPU端网格处理、CPU纹理工作或阶段间额外的CPU-GPU传输，成为实时性与带宽瓶颈；同时逐面单相机取纹理会带来平滑变化的曝光接缝。目标是构建全GPU管线，在保持实时性的同时输出图形兼容的带纹理网格并改善接缝一致性。

Method: 1）输入暂存后，融合与纹理化各阶段常驻GPU，阶段间无中间网格或图像数据回传主机；2）采用定长数组表示网格拓扑，在GPU上提供常数时间邻域访问，使网格级操作数据并行；3）逐面从单一相机取纹理，估计每相机低频增益场并在GPU上烘焙进纹理图集，做辐射接缝校正；流程含TSDF融合、Marching Cubes、连通域噪声去除、视图纹理映射与修补。

Result: 在CMU Panoptic数据集上，对每个测试的体素分辨率与传感器数量均优于基线；相对CUDA加速的nvblox与基于CPU的Open3D峰值加速超过一个数量级；感知重渲染质量接近离线带纹理网格化基线。

Conclusion: 全GPU驻留的融合-纹理一体化管线可显著提升多传感器体积视频的吞吐，并避免主机回传开销；定长数组拓扑与低频增益场烘焙是可行且有效的关键设计；质量上已接近离线方法，但尚未完全等同。

Abstract: We present a GPU-native volumetric-video system for real-time reconstruction of graphics-compatible textured triangle meshes from multiple RGB-D sensors. Existing TSDF systems accelerate fusion and mesh extraction, but extending them to per-frame textured meshing adds CPU mesh processing, CPU-side texturing work, or extra CPU-GPU transfers between stages. After input staging, our method keeps the reconstruction and texturing stages (TSDF fusion, Marching Cubes, connected-component noise removal, view-based texture mapping, inpainting, and radiometric seam correction) resident on the GPU; no intermediate mesh or image data returns to the host between these stages. A fixed-size-array representation of mesh topology gives constant-time neighbor access on the GPU and makes the downstream mesh-level operations data-parallel. Because we texture each face from a single camera, exposure seams that vary smoothly across each image remain; we estimate a per-camera low-frequency gain field and bake it into the atlas on the GPU. On the CMU Panoptic dataset, our method is faster than the baselines at every tested voxel resolution and number of sensors, achieves peak speedups of more than an order of magnitude over CUDA-accelerated nvblox and CPU-based Open3D, and approaches an offline textured-meshing baseline in perceptual re-rendering quality.

</details>


### [231] [VizDAGuide: Misleading Chart Question Answering in Compact Vision Language Models via DAG-Structured Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03023)
*Haiyang Zhang,Sicheng Song,Zixin Chen,Jie Gu,Huiya Ou,Chenhui Li,Changbo Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出VizDAGuide，将误导性图表问答的中间推理状态及其依赖建模为有向无环图，并按角色分配监督权重，序列化为统一训练目标；在Qwen3-VL与InternVL3.5上两种答案格式均优于内容与权重匹配的Linear CoT-SFT基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 误导性图表会使视觉语言模型得出与底层数据相悖的结论；现有工作多聚焦推理阶段策略，训练阶段的监督信号仍缺乏探索。

Method: VizDAGuide：以DAG表示中间推理状态及其依赖关系，依据各状态角色分配监督权重，并将图序列化为统一训练目标，支持开放式与多项选择问答且仅需单次推理。

Result: 在两个基准、Qwen3-VL与InternVL3.5模型上，开放式与多项选择两种格式均优于内容与权重匹配的Linear CoT-SFT基线；过程级评估显示在grounding与操作执行上有提升；消融表明依赖结构与加权监督需结合使用效果最佳。

Conclusion: 结果支持采用DAG结构化的加权监督用于误导性图表问答任务。

Abstract: Misleading charts can lead vision-language models to conclusions that conflict with underlying data. Existing work focuses on inference-time strategies, while training-time supervision remains less explored. We present VizDAGuide, a DAG-structured supervision method for misleading-chart question answering. The method represents intermediate reasoning states and their dependencies as a directed acyclic graph, assigns supervision weights according to their roles, and serializes the graph into a unified training target for open-ended and multiple-choice QA with single-pass inference. Experiments on two benchmarks across Qwen3-VL and InternVL3.5 models show improvements over a content- and weight-matched Linear CoT-SFT baseline on both answer formats. Process-level evaluation shows gains in grounding and operation execution, while ablations indicate that dependency structure and weighted supervision are most effective when combined. These results support DAG-structured weighted supervision for misleading-chart question answering.

</details>


### [232] [Balancing Representations by Identifying and Generating Under-represented Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02952)
*Filipe Laitenberger,Hirokatsu Kataoka,Yuki Asano,Cees Snoek,Mohammadreza Salehi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 BRIDGE 框架，通过识别并生成低覆盖区域的样本，为长尾无标注语料补充局部语义支持，从而平衡自监督学习得到的表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督学习直接继承源数据的覆盖分布，当无标注语料呈长尾分布时，表示在频繁模式附近密集、在覆盖薄弱区域稀疏。现有多数长尾 SSL 方法仅对已有图像重新加权，无法引入新样本，因而无法真正弥补覆盖空洞。

Method: BRIDGE 构建围绕源集的无标签反馈闭环：用当前编码器为每张源图像计算平均 kNN 距离作为评分，通过预算受限的采集规则在评分分布中挑选“支持薄弱但生成器仍能产生忠实变体”的带状区域；随后用冻结的图到图扩散模型对选中锚点生成局部变体，将扩充后的源集继续预训练。作者将采集形式化为“可恢复性加权”的局部支持分配问题，并推导在有限预算下应优先选择排除极端尾部的稀疏带、以及固定目标下每次修复后重新分配最优的条件。

Result: 在五种长尾（网络爬取与合成）源分布下，BRIDGE 取得七任务线性探针与 kNN 平均最高成绩；配对实验将该增益扩展到 ViT-S 上的对比学习与自蒸馏目标、少标签微调及语义分割；在掩码重建目标下线性探针增益较小。生成的修复效果可匹配“恢复被扣留真实图像”的 oracle；冻结编码器下，插入图像使选中锚点邻域收缩幅度约为匹配未选图像的两倍。

Conclusion: BRIDGE 无需标签、不改变预训练目标，可作为即插即用模块加入非精选网络数据的预训练流程，由编码器自主决定生成哪些图像，从而实现表示覆盖的主动平衡。

Abstract: Self-supervised learning inherits the coverage of its source data. When an unlabeled corpus is long-tailed, the representation becomes dense around frequent modes and thin where coverage is weak. Objectives for long-tailed SSL reweight the images already in the corpus and add no new ones. We introduce BRIDGE (Balancing Representations by Identifying and Generating Under-represented Data), a label-free feedback loop around the source set. The current encoder scores every source image by its mean kNN distance, and a budgeted acquisition rule selects images from a band of that score distribution where support is thin and the generator still produces faithful variants. A frozen image-to-image diffusion model then adds local variants of the selected anchors, and pretraining continues on the enlarged source set. We formulate acquisition as recoverability-weighted allocation of local support and derive when a finite budget should favor a sparse band that excludes the extreme tail and when reallocation after each repair is optimal under a fixed objective. Across five long-tailed, web-scraped and synthetic source regimes, BRIDGE has the highest seven-task linear-probe and kNN average of the compared methods, and paired experiments extend the gain to ViT-S under contrastive and self-distillation objectives, to low-label fine-tuning and to semantic segmentation. The linear-probe gain is smaller under masked reconstruction. Generated repair matches an oracle that restores the withheld real images, and under a frozen encoder the inserted images shrink the neighborhoods of the selected anchors about twice as much as those of matched unselected images. BRIDGE needs no labels and leaves the pretraining objective unchanged, so it can be added to pretraining on uncurated web data, where the encoder decides which images to generate.

</details>


### [233] [RouteREPA: Routed Representation Alignment for Just Image Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02941)
*Yi Tan,Beier Zhu,Sirui Chen,Cheng Chen,Xingyu Zhu,Yuan Zhou,Zhenshan Tan,Tianrun Chen,Hanwang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对像素空间扩散 Transformer（JiT）中 REPA 表征对齐与像素重建之间的表征冲突，提出 Routed Representation Alignment（RouteREPA），通过轻量级、表征依赖的路由器在多网络深度自适应地为对齐和生成分配表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: REPA 广泛用于加速潜空间 DiT 训练，但迁移到 JiT 等像素空间模型时效果受限。作者分析发现：JiT 学到的表征与 DINOv2 的对齐程度明显低于潜空间模型；对 JiT 施加 REPA 会持续降低其中间表征的重建性，而 Latent JiT 无此现象。原因在于 JiT 直接重建像素，其表征需在不同层深度上同时层级化地编码判别语义与重建相关视觉信息，从而产生判别对齐与像素生成之间的表征冲突。

Method: 提出 RouteREPA：使用轻量级、表征依赖（representation-dependent）的路由器，自适应地将面向任务的不同表征分别路由至对齐分支与生成分支；并将路由扩展到多个网络深度，以适配各深度差异化的表征需求。

Result: 在 ImageNet-1K 256×256 上的大量实验表明，RouteREPA 在不同模型规模与训练预算下均稳定提升 JiT，优于标准 REPA；在 JiT-H/16 上，仅用三分之一的训练轮次且无需 classifier-free guidance 即超过 PixelREPA。

Conclusion: 像素空间生成的表征冲突是 REPA 迁移失败的关键瓶颈，通过表征路由解耦对齐与生成可在多深度上缓解该冲突，实现高效且更优的像素空间扩散 Transformer 训练。

Abstract: Representation alignment (REPA) is widely used to accelerate the training of latent-space diffusion transformers (DiTs). However, applying it to pixel-space models such as Just Image Transformers (JiT) is challenging. Our analysis reveals a pronounced representation conflict between discriminative alignment and pixel-space generation. Compared with its latent counterpart, JiT learns representations that are substantially less aligned with DINOv2. Applying REPA to JiT consistently reduces the reconstructability of its intermediate representations, whereas this effect is not observed in Latent JiT. We attribute this conflict to JiT directly reconstructing pixels, which requires its representations to hierarchically encode discriminative semantics and reconstruction-relevant visual information across network depths. To address these challenges, we propose Routed Representation Alignment (RouteREPA), which uses lightweight, representation-dependent routers to adaptively route task-oriented representations for alignment and generation. We further apply routing across multiple network depths to accommodate their depth-dependent representation requirements. Extensive experiments on ImageNet-1K at 256x256 resolution show that RouteREPA consistently improves JiT across model scales and training budgets, outperforming standard REPA. On JiT-H/16, RouteREPA further surpasses PixelREPA using only one-third of its training epochs without classifier-free guidance.

</details>


### [234] [Reconstruction as Spatial Evaluation: Diagnosing Cross-View Spatial Intelligence in Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02026)
*Junfei Wu,Qiuyue Wang,Xuhong Huang,Qihang Peng,Mingsheng Li,Jian Guan,Qiang Liu,Shu Wu,Liang Wang,Shuai Bai,Tieniu Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 RECONSPATIAL 基准，用多视图 3D 场景重建评测 LVLM 的空间智能，从 Structure 与 Metric 两个维度揭示相对结构与度量精度间的系统性差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有静态空间基准只考察孤立的空间判断，交互式具身评测又混杂感知、探索、规划与控制等能力，难以单独衡量"将局部视觉观测整合为几何一致的物理世界表征"这一核心空间智能。

Method: 构建覆盖室内、桌面、户外场景的多视图 3D 重建基准：输入真实多视图图像与目标物体查询，要求模型在统一相机锚定的度量坐标系中联合预测带朝向的 3D 边界框；以 Structure（相对布局）与 Metric（物理尺度与相机锚定定位）双轴评估；设计 9 个原子空间 QA 任务（几何感知、空间关系）；通过离线导航扩展路径规划评测；并开展诊断分析、3D 地图注入实验与空间微调实验。

Result: 评测 18 个前沿 LVLM，发现相对结构与度量重建存在稳定差距，GPT-6-Astra 在 Structure 上达 81.4%，Metric 仅 58.7%；诊断表明关系一致性不能保证度量准确；3D 地图注入实验将场景构建与路径规划解耦，显示几何误差会限制导航成功率；空间微调在空间与通用视觉语言基准上均有广泛迁移。

Conclusion: LVLM 空间智能的瓶颈在于度量精度而非相对关系推理；RECONSPATIAL 提供了可分解、可诊断的重建式评测范式，并证明空间微调具有跨任务迁移价值。

Abstract: The spatial intelligence of large vision-language models (LVLMs) requires the ability to combine local visual observations into a geometrically consistent representation of the physical world. Many static benchmarks assess isolated spatial judgments, such as relative direction or distance, while interactive embodied evaluations combine perception with exploration, planning, control, and simulator-specific execution. To bridge this gap, we introduce RECONSPATIAL, a benchmark centered on multi-view 3D scene reconstruction across indoor, tabletop, and outdoor environments. Given real multi-view images and target-object queries, LVLMs are required to jointly predict oriented 3D bounding boxes in a shared, camera-anchored metric coordinate frame. Reconstructions are evaluated along two complementary axes: Structure for relative layout and Metric for physical scale and camera-anchored placement. Nine atomic spatial QA tasks, grouped into Geometric Perception and Spatial Relations, probe spatial capabilities involved in joint reconstruction. Offline navigation extends evaluation to path planning. Evaluation of 18 frontier LVLMs reveals a consistent gap between relative scene structure and metric reconstruction; even GPT-6-Astra scores 81.4% on Structure but only 58.7% on Metric. Tracing this gap, diagnostic analyses link atomic spatial capabilities to reconstruction quality and show that relational consistency alone does not ensure metric accuracy. Experiments with 3D map injection further separate scene construction from path planning, revealing how these geometric errors limit navigation success. Finally, spatial fine-tuning yields broad transfer across both spatial and general vision-language benchmarks.

</details>


### [235] [AVID: A 5T fMRI Dataset for Benchmarking Auditory-induced Visual Mental Imagery Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02593)
*Shiqi Shen,Shurui Li,Xilin Zhang,Yuanning Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AVID是首个面向听觉诱导视觉心理意象(VMI)解码的训练规模5.0T fMRI数据集（约67小时、9名被试），并配套标准化评测协议，以降低视觉与记忆混淆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VMI范式多依赖视觉提示或短时记忆图像，引入视觉与记忆混淆，难以区分内源性意象构建相关神经活动与视觉输入驱动信号；且缺乏对单个视觉属性的描述性控制，难以系统评估细粒度视觉细节；同时缺少专用的训练规模VMI数据集。

Method: 构建AVID数据集：9名被试、约67小时密集5.0T fMRI记录，采用听觉诱导而非视觉提示；划分为两个互补子集——使用自然汉语描述的场景级复杂子集，与显式指定视觉属性的受控简单子集；并形式化标准化评测协议，将源图像一致性与语义对齐解耦评估。

Result: 基线的定性与定量结果表明，现有重建流水线在AVID上表现仍受限；最成功的重建能够保留语音描述中可识别的场景级语义，但细粒度视觉细节恢复不足。

Conclusion: AVID通过训练规模神经记录与标准化评测资源，为意象专用模型开发提供数据基础，并作为显著降低感觉污染的VMI解码基准。

Abstract: Visual mental imagery (VMI) decoding uses brain activity to reconstruct internally generated visual scenes, providing a potential pathway for externalizing internal experiences and developing neuroprosthetic communication interfaces. However, progress is limited by the lack of dedicated, training-scale VMI datasets. Current VMI paradigms often rely on visual prompts or short-term memory images, introducing visual and mnemonic confounds that make it difficult to disentangle neural activity associated with endogenous image construction from signals driven by prior or concurrent visual input. Furthermore, existing VMI datasets offer limited descriptive control over individual visual attributes, making it difficult to systematically assess fine grained visual details. To address these gaps, we introduce AVID, the first dedicated training-scale 5.0 Tesla functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) resource for auditory-induced VMI decoding. AVID comprises approximately 67 hours of dense recordings from nine participants. The dataset is structured into two complementary splits: a scene-level complex split using naturalistic Mandarin descriptions and a controlled simple split with explicitly specified visual attributes. We further formalize a standardized evaluation protocol that decouples source-image consistency from semantic alignment, allowing for a more nuanced assessment of imagery reconstruction. Baseline qualitative and quantitative results show that current reconstruction pipelines remain limited on AVID, although the most successful reconstructions preserve recognizable scene level semantics from spoken descriptions. By combining dedicated training-scale neural recordings and standardized evaluation resources, AVID provides both a data foundation for imagery-specific model development and a benchmark for evaluating VMI decoding with substantially reduced sensory contamination.

</details>


### [236] [MedHEB: Benchmarking Medical Embeddings Across Heterogeneous Clinical Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02519)
*Yingshu Li,Shaoyang Zhou,Zhanyu Wang,Yunyi Liu,Xinyu Liang,Xi Zhang,Lingqiao Liu,Lei Wang,Luping Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MedHEB，一个涵盖54个数据集、107个检索任务的统一医学嵌入基准，从证据形式、配对类型、相关性粒度三轴评测，并给出MLLM基线MedEmb。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床证据本质上是关系性的（历史影像、跨模态检查、报告、局部发现），检索相关证据是临床解读的核心；但现有嵌入评测多聚焦孤立匹配，无法说明模型能否在模态、外观、粒度变化下保持有意义的检索。

Method: 构建MedHEB：107任务/54数据集，含分布内与留出源评测；三维度分类为证据形式（2D图像、3D体数据、文本）、配对类型（图-图、图-文、文-文、跨模态视觉匹配）、相关性粒度（全局、问题条件、区域级）。在统一排序协议下改变临床相关证据定义，检验嵌入邻近性在异质证据下是否仍有意义，包括跨模态视觉检索与区域级文本到区域检索。另训练MLLM式参考嵌入模型MedEmb（在ID划分上训练）作为统一2D-3D-文本检索的可复现基线。

Result: 代表性模型在各检索族上表现不均衡：在常规图-文或文-文检索上较强的模型，在跨模态桥接和区域级任务上可靠性明显下降。现有嵌入空间能较好捕捉部分临床关系，但尚未实现跨异质证据的平衡检索。

Conclusion: 当前医学嵌入在多模态、多粒度检索上仍不平衡，需以MedHEB式统一基准衡量"临床有意义"的嵌入；开源MedHEB（预处理脚本、评测代码、访问清单）与MedEmb以支持后续研究。

Abstract: Clinical evidence is inherently relational: medical images are interpreted with prior studies, cross-modal examinations, reports, and localized findings, and retrieving relevant evidence is therefore central to clinical interpretation. Recent foundation models increasingly encode these heterogeneous sources into shared embedding spaces, yet existing embedding evaluation often focuses on isolated matches, leaving unclear whether current models retrieve relevant evidence across changes in modality, appearance, and granularity. We introduce MedHEB, a unified benchmark with 107 retrieval tasks from 54 datasets, including both in-distribution and held-out-source evaluation, across three axes: evidence form (2D images, 3D volumes, text), pairing type (image--image, image--text, text--text, and modality-bridging visual matching), and relevance granularity (global, question-conditioned, region-level). Under a single ranking protocol, MedHEB varies clinically relevant evidence definitions to test whether embedding proximity remains meaningful across heterogeneous evidence, including modality-bridging visual retrieval and region-level text-to-region retrieval. Across representative models, performance is uneven across retrieval families: models strong on conventional image--text or text--text retrieval are less reliable on modality-bridging and region-level tasks. Current embedding spaces capture some clinical relationships well but do not yet provide balanced retrieval across heterogeneous evidence. We further provide MedEmb, an MLLM-based reference embedding model trained on the MedHEB ID split, as a reproducible baseline for unified 2D--3D--text medical retrieval. We release MedHEB with preprocessing scripts, evaluation code, access manifests, and MedEmb to support research on clinically meaningful medical embeddings.

</details>


### [237] [Blueprint2CAD: Benchmarking Foundation Models on Engineering Drawing-to-CAD Render Correspondence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02433)
*Alexander Valverde,Danny Xie-Li,Zhichao Wang,Marcos V. Conde*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Blueprint2CAD 基准，考察视觉模型能否判断正交工程图与不同视角渲染图是否属于同一零件，并揭示"视角"而非"骨干网络"是主要瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工程图通过正交投影表达机械零件，图-件对应识别支撑零件检索、设计复用与数字化，但此前缺乏公开基准来度量视觉模型是否具备该能力。

Method: 构建 BlueCAD-30K 数据层：对 29,925 个 Zero-to-CAD 模型施加开放制图流水线，补充视角对齐渲染、来自六个视角的干净图与标注尺寸图，以及表面类型元数据；并据此设计"图-渲染对应"任务，评估冻结编码器检索与零样本视觉语言模型验证，附加 LoRA 微调对照。

Result: 冻结编码器在 10,000 模型库检索中，已知视角时 Recall@1 最高约 65%，未知视角降至 43%；四种编码器差异在 6 个百分点内。六个零样本视觉语言模型验证准确率仅 0.52–0.67，存在模型特异的 Yes/No 偏置，思维链可改变但无法消除；LoRA 微调提升数个百分点，但加剧偏置且未解决视角失效。

Conclusion: 视角泛化是图-件对应的核心瓶颈，现有视觉骨干与视觉语言模型均不足以胜任；该基准为后续方法提供了可量化的评测基础。

Abstract: Engineering drawings specify mechanical parts through orthographic projections. Recognizing which part a drawing depicts underlies part search, design reuse, and digitization, yet no public benchmark measures whether vision models can do it. We introduce Blueprint2CAD, a benchmark for drawing-to-render correspondence: given an orthographic line drawing and a shaded render, usually from another viewpoint, decide whether they show the same part. Its data layer, BlueCAD-30K, applies an open drafting pipeline to 29,925 Zero-to-CAD models, adding view-aligned renders, clean and dimensioned drawings from six viewpoints, and surface-type metadata. Frozen encoders retrieve the matching part from a 10,000-model gallery with up to 65% Recall@1 when viewpoints are known but 43% when they are not, and the four encoders we test lie within six points of each other: viewpoint, not backbone, is the bottleneck. Six zero-shot vision-language models reach only 0.52-0.67 verification accuracy, with model-specific Yes/No biases that chain-of-thought shifts but does not remove; a quick LoRA fine-tuning on in-domain pairs improves verification accuracy by a few points but sharpens these biases and leaves the viewpoint failure intact.

</details>


### [238] [Exploiting Textual Semantics for Robust Cross-View Object Correspondence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02356)
*Bing Fan,Yunhe Feng,Yan Huang,Heng Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TeSCo框架，利用目标的文本语义（类别、纹理、颜色等视点与外观不变描述）作为视觉线索的补充，用于跨视角目标对应（CVOC），并引入文本引导跨模态融合（TCF）与迭代文本特征精炼（ITFR）模块，在Ego-Exo4D与HANDAL-X上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CVOC方法主要依赖视觉线索，在视角变化大、外观差异显著等复杂场景下因目标信息不足而失效。

Method: 先用视觉-语言模型从查询视角生成目标的文本表达式并提取文本特征；设计TCF模块以文本引导调制将文本特征注入视觉特征，形成更鲁棒的多模态目标表示；再提出ITFR模块，在TCF之前利用搜索视角信息迭代渐进地修正文本特征，得到搜索视角感知的文本语义。

Result: 在Ego-Exo4D与HANDAL-X上的大量实验中取得state-of-the-art结果，显著优于其他模型。

Conclusion: 文本语义提供的视点与外观不变信息可有效互补视觉线索，配合跨模态融合与迭代精炼，能显著提升复杂场景下的跨视角目标对应鲁棒性。

Abstract: Cross-view object correspondence (CVOC) aims to establish associations of the same target between query and search videos captured from different viewpoints. Existing methods often rely on visual cues for CVOC. Despite recent progress, these methods struggle in complicated scenarios with substantial viewpoint changes and appearance variations, due to lacking sufficient target information. Addressing this, we introduce TeSCo, a framework that exploits rich Textual Semantics of an object, in addition to its visual cues, for cross-view object Correspondence. Our key insight is, textual description of a target, by capturing diverse attributes such as category, texture, and color, provides viewpoint- and appearance-invariant semantics, which are complementary to visual cues and can hence enhance correspondence robustness in complicated scenes. Inspired by this, TeSCo first generates a textual expression of the target from the given query view using a vision-language model, and then extracts textual feature to enhance visual features for localization in the search view. To realize this, we introduce a text-conditioned cross-modal fusion (TCF) module that incorporates the textual feature into visual features with text-guided modulation, producing more robust multimodal target representation for object correspondence. Since not all textual cues are equally compatible with the target in current search-view frame, we propose an iterative textual feature refinement (ITFR) module that progressively adjusts textual feature using search-view information before the TCF module, enabling search-view-aware textual semantics to be fused into visual features and leading to better performance. In extensive experiments on Ego-Exo4D and HANDAL-X, TeSCo demonstrates state-of-the-art results and largely outperforms other models, validating its efficacy. Our code is released at https://github.com/VAIL-Fan/TeSCo.

</details>


### [239] [Findings-aware Language-Image Pretraining for CT Volume Interpretation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02327)
*Takuro Shimaya,Junya Inoh,Masahiro Saiko*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FiLIP（Findings-aware Language-Image Pre-training），利用大语言模型从CT报告中提取异常发现短语，并用生物医学文本嵌入模型构造显式的目标语义表示来监督图像编码器，避免CLIP对不同病例一律视为负样本的不当假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CT蕴含多样信息且临床任务众多，视觉-语言基础模型可借CT与放射报告的联合表征学习提取临床特征。但现有方法多沿用CLIP式对比学习，原则上将不同病例视为负样本并将体积与报告嵌入相互推开；而在生物医学影像中，不同病例间常存在临床相似性，强行作为负样本并不合理。因此需要超越CLIP弱监督的、基于临床知识的监督式表征学习。

Method: 采用大语言模型从放射报告中抽取异常发现短语；再以生物医学文本嵌入模型生成这些发现的语义表示，作为图像编码器应显式输出的目标特征，从而构建findings-aware的监督信号，替代CLIP的成对弱监督。

Result: 在多标签零样本发现分类任务上，FiLIP在域内与域外评估中均优于弱监督方法；在下游放射报告生成任务微调时同样有效。

Conclusion: 以语言基础模型提取的临床知识构造显式语义目标进行监督，比CLIP式负样本假设更契合医学影像，可提升CT视觉-语言表征的泛化性（含域外）与下游报告生成表现。

Abstract: Computed tomography (CT) provides diverse patient information and various clinical tasks, for which numerous deep learning models have been investigated. Recent years have seen the development of vision-language foundation models that can comprehensively extract clinical features, driven by representation learning that combines CT volumes with radiology reports.
