Existing approaches typically adopt Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP)-based representation learning, where pairs from different cases are, in principle, treated as negative pairs such that the volume and report embeddings are pushed apart. In the biomedical imaging, however, treating different cases as negative pairs is not always appropriate, particularly when clinical similarity exists. In this study, we propose a supervised representation learning framework grounded in clinical knowledge from language foundation models, rather than the weak supervision used in CLIP. Specifically, we utilized a large language model to extract abnormal finding phrases from reports. We then explicitly constructed the target features that the image encoder should output, as the semantic representation of the extracted findings using a biomedical text embedding model. Our Findings-aware Language-Image Pre-training (FiLIP) outperformed weakly supervised approaches in multi-label zero-shot finding classification in both in-domain and external-domain evaluations, and also proved effective when fine-tuned for the downstream task of radiology report generation.

</details>


### [240] [The DynaCell Evaluation Suite for Dynamic 3D Virtual Staining of Live Cells](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02324)
*Alexandr A. Kalinin,Dihan Zheng,Taylla Milena Theodoro,Ivan Ivanov,Eduardo Hirata-Miyasaki,See-Chi Lee,Aofei Liu,Sricharan Reddy Varra,Talon Chandler,Soorya Pradeep,Chad Liu,Manuel D. Leonetti,Carolina Arias,Bo Huang,Shalin B. Mehta*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出用于活细胞3D延时虚拟染色(evaluation suite)的评估套件，结合配对有无荧光标记的3D延时图像、基线模型与三级指标体系，揭示了回归与生成模型在结构保真与表型保真之间的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 活细胞成像需捕捉扰动诱导的表型动态，但荧光成像的标记与反复照明会损害细胞健康；虚拟染色可从无标记图像预测荧光图像，然而现有模型在体积（3D）延时数据上的表现缺乏系统表征，且单一指标评估掩盖了模型间的差异。

Method: 构建3D延时虚拟染色评估套件：包含配对的有/无荧光标记3D延时图像数据集、一组基线模型（回归类与生成类），以及三级评估指标——像素级保真度、细胞器分割性能、单细胞表型相似度。在3种细胞类型、2种显微镜、4种细胞器、3种扰动状态上系统评测指标与模型行为。

Result: 回归基线在预测目标细胞器的空间定位上更优，而生成基线在刻画跨细胞表型分布上更强；这些差异揭示了结构保真度与表型保真度之间的权衡，且被单指标评估所掩盖。

Conclusion: 虚拟染色模型需针对不同下游任务（定位、分割、追踪、表型分析）差异化开发；作者以DynaCell框架形式公开了精选数据集、基线检查点和评估代码。

Abstract: Understanding how cells respond to perturbations over time is central to cell biology and drug discovery. Live-cell imaging captures the dynamics of perturbation-induced phenotypes in individual cells. While fluorescence imaging can visualize specific molecular phenotypes, labeling and repeated illumination often affect cell health. Virtual staining offers an alternative by predicting these fluorescence images from images acquired without fluorescent labels. Although many virtual staining models have been developed, their performance on volumetric time-lapse data remains poorly characterized. We address this gap with an evaluation suite for 3D time-lapse virtual staining of live cells. The suite combines paired 3D time-lapse images acquired with and without fluorescent labels, a set of baseline models, and three metric tiers measuring pixel-level fidelity, organelle segmentation performance, and single-cell phenotype similarity. Using this evaluation suite, we study metric and model behavior across 3 cell types, 2 microscopes, 4 organelles, and 3 perturbation states. We find that regression baselines better predict the spatial localization of target organelles, whereas the generative baseline better captures the distribution of phenotypes across cells. These differences expose trade-offs between structural and phenotypic fidelity that are obscured by single-metric evaluation and suggest how virtual staining models can be developed for diverse downstream tasks such as localization, segmentation, tracking, and phenotypic profiling. We release the curated datasets, baseline checkpoints, and evaluation code as part of DynaCell, a broader framework for image-based profiling of cell-state dynamics.

</details>


### [241] [Lie Routing Vision Language Models for View-Robust 3D Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02306)
*Jingjun Yi,Chen Hu,Qi Bi,Hao Zheng,Huimin Huang,Yongkang,Wei Ji,Yawen Huang,Xian Wu,Yefeng Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LieVLM，将视角变化建模为SO(3)旋转，用VGGT几何token预测局部旋转参数与通道路由系数，通过Padé–Cayley闭式映射对投影特征做三维子空间内的旋转变换，并以残差门控回注原特征，缓解多视角3D理解中的"视角诱导语义漂移"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多视图RGB输入的MLLM在3D场景理解上进展显著，但同一物体与查询在不同相机视角下会产生不一致的目标相关回答，即视角诱导语义漂移；简单加性融合难以补偿视角相关的表示偏差。

Method: 动机来自视角变化的旋转分量。Lie routing在学到的三维子空间中对投影特征施加局部SO(3)变换：由VGGT提取的几何token预测局部旋转参数与通道级路由系数；用闭式Padé–Cayley映射变换投影后的视觉特征，将相对恒等的修正投影回原空间，并门控注入视觉与几何特征，从而保留预训练的语义与直接空间上下文，同时学习视角相关的特征调整。

Result: 在3D描述生成、定位（grounding）、检测与空间推理任务上，跨训练规模与骨干网络均稳定优于加性融合；受控消融验证了几何条件化与变换结构的作用；视角分析显示预测路由状态随视角系统性变化，目标响应更局部化，视角变化下任务性能更稳健。

Conclusion: 以李群旋转路由替代加性融合，是提升MLLM视角鲁棒3D理解的有效且轻量方式，且路由状态与视角变化具有可解释的系统对应关系。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made substantial progress in 3D scene understanding from multi-view RGB observations. Yet a fixed object and query can elicit inconsistent target-related responses across camera viewpoints, a phenomenon we characterize as viewpoint-induced semantic drift. We introduce LieVLM, a Lie routing framework for view-robust 3D understanding. Motivated by the rotational component of viewpoint change, Lie routing adapts visual representations by applying local $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ transformations to projected features within learned three-dimensional subspaces. Geometry tokens extracted by VGGT predict local rotation parameters and channel-wise routing coefficients. A closed-form Padé--Cayley map transforms projected visual features, whose identity-relative corrections are projected back and gated into the original visual and geometry features. This design retains the pretrained semantic and direct spatial context while learning view-dependent feature adjustments. Experiments on 3D captioning, grounding, detection, and spatial reasoning show consistent improvements over additive fusion across training scales and backbones. Controlled ablations examine the roles of geometric conditioning and transformation structure. Viewpoint analyses further reveal systematic variation in the predicted routing states alongside more localized target responses and stronger task performance across viewpoint changes.

</details>


### [242] [CNN-Based Retinal OCT Classification: Research Gap Analysis and a From-Scratch Baseline, ED126-A](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02114)
*Shkelqim Sherifi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究通过两项贡献填补从零训练的紧凑CNN基线缺失问题：一是综述OCT视网膜分类方法学要点，二是提出ED126-A——在Kermany OCT数据集上按规范化协议从零训练的四分类CNN基线（约124万参数），测试准确率95.03%、macro-F1 0.9205，主要瓶颈为Drusen类（精确率0.7493），可作为受控评测参考基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OCT图像中诊断相关形态模式存在显著类间相似性，分类仍具挑战；尽管基准数据集上准确率已很高，但评测协议异质、且缺乏对随机初始化训练的紧凑CNN基线的充分刻画，导致跨研究比较受限。

Method: （1）对基于CNN的视网膜OCT分类进行聚焦综述，梳理受控基准评测的方法学考量；（2）提出ED126-A：在Kermany标注OCT数据集上以文档化协议从零训练的四分类CNN，共1,241,380参数（可训练1,239,460），评估涵盖训练动态、类级指标、混淆矩阵、置信度分析、t-SNE表征可视化、Grad-CAM、分层特征图分析及一对多ROC/PR分析。

Result: 图像级留出测试集准确率95.03%，macro-F1 0.9205，weighted-F1 0.9521。主要类条件局限出现在Drusen：召回0.9605、精确率0.7493、F1 0.8419；混淆矩阵显示Normal→Drusen与CNV→Drusen为主要错误通道。

Conclusion: ED126-A可作为文档化的从零训练参考基线，并为后续迁移学习、加深网络、注意力机制、多尺度特征融合与置信度校准的受控评测提供经验依据。

Abstract: Automated classification of retinal pathologies from Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) images remains challenging because diagnostically relevant morphological patterns may exhibit substantial inter-class similarity. Although high classification accuracies have been reported on benchmark OCT datasets, cross-study comparison is limited by heterogeneous evaluation protocols and by the limited characterization of compact convolutional neural network (CNN) baselines trained from random initialization. This study addresses this gap through two contributions. First, it provides a focused review of CNN-based retinal OCT classification and identifies methodological considerations relevant to controlled benchmarking. Second, it presents ED126-A, a purpose-built four-class CNN baseline trained from scratch under a documented experimental protocol on the Kermany labeled OCT dataset. The model contains 1,241,380 total parameters, including 1,239,460 trainable parameters, and is evaluated using training-dynamics analysis, class-wise performance metrics, confusion-matrix analysis, confidence analysis, t-SNE representation-space visualization, Grad-CAM, hierarchical feature-map analysis, and one-vs-rest ROC/Precision-Recall analysis. On the image-level held-out test set, ED126-A achieved 95.03% accuracy, with a macro-F1 of 0.9205 and a weighted-F1 of 0.9521. The principal class-conditional limitation occurred for Drusen, which attained a recall of 0.9605 but a precision of 0.7493 and an F1-score of 0.8419. The confusion matrix identified Normal to Drusen and CNV to Drusen as major error channels. These results support the use of ED126-A as a documented from-scratch reference baseline and provide an empirical basis for controlled evaluation of transfer learning, increased depth, attention, multi-scale feature fusion, and calibration in subsequent studies.

</details>


### [243] [Synthetic Realities: Evaluating Human Ability to Distinguish AIGenerated Videos from Real Footage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01990)
*Danyal Sarfraz,Raja Mubashar Karim,KwanMyung Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究通过二选一判别任务比较人类对文本生成视频、图像动画、视频外扩三类AI视频的检测准确率，发现平均仅60%，且检测成功率同时受生成技术与内容主题影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI已提供文本生视频、图像生视频动画、视频外扩等多条高保真视频合成路径，但普通观众能否区分这些AI输出与真实影像，尚缺乏系统的并排实证评估。

Method: 构建真伪各18段、均衡的刺激集；AI片段均匀分布于Veo 3、LTX Video、Wan VACE三种方法，并在ComfyUI框架内统一质量与时长。87名被试对全部片段进行"真实/合成"二项强制选择判断，覆盖历史影像、影视媒体、自然环境三种主题；采用逻辑回归分析技术、主题及其交互效应。

Result: 平均判别正确率60%。按技术：图像生视频最高（79%），真实素材64%，外扩49%，文本生视频最低（43%）。按主题：影视与历史场景检测率高于自然环境（后者常被误判为AI）。逻辑回归显示技术、主题及二者交互均显著（p<0.001）。

Conclusion: 未经训练观众存在将内容倾向判定为合成的偏差；AI视频的感知真实感更多由内容语境而非模型类型决定。据此强调媒介素养教育与语境敏感型评估工具的重要性。

Abstract: Recent advances in generative AI have enabled multiple pathways for high-fidelity video synthesis: text-to-video, image-to-video animation, and video outpainting. Empirical side-by-side evaluations of how untrained viewers perceive and distinguish these outputs from real footage remain scarce. In this study, we systematically compare human detection accuracy across these three AI generation techniques within three thematic contexts: historical footage, film and media content, and natural environments. We constructed a balanced stimulus set comprising equal amounts of real and AI-generated videos (18 each). The AI clips were evenly distributed across the three generation methods using Google's Veo 3, Lightricks LTX Video, and Wan VACE. All videos were produced and standardized within the ComfyUI framework to ensure consistent quality and duration. 87 participants judged every clip in a binary forced-choice task ("real" vs. "AI-generated"). Participants correctly identified videos 60% of the time on average. Image-to-video clips were recognized most accurately (79%), followed by real footage (64%), outpainting (49%), and text-to-video (43%). Accuracy also varied by theme: film and historical scenes yielded higher detection rates than environmental clips, which were frequently mistaken for AI. Logistic regression confirmed significant effects of both technique and theme as well as their interaction (p < 0.001), indicating that detection success depends jointly on how the content was generated and what it depicts. Findings reveal a consistent bias toward assuming synthetic origins and highlight that perceptual realism in AI video is shaped more by context than by model type, underscoring the importance of media-literacy approaches and context-aware evaluation tools for navigating increasingly synthetic visual media.

</details>


### [244] [Testing concept-level audits of melanoma classifiers with diffusion counterfactuals and matched positive controls](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02119)
*Md. Shohanoor Rahman,Md. Hasibul Islam,Md Kishor Morol,Moinul Hossain,Dip Nandi,Liew Tze Hui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出基于扩散模型的反事实审计方法来检验黑色素瘤分类器的概念解释，并用已知目标的对照组和零假设分类器进行评估；审计能恢复多数对照目标但七点清单概念存在交叉干扰，匹配对照与零假设分类器是概念审计的实用校验手段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黑色素瘤分类器的概念解释很少用具有已知目标（known targets）的对照进行检验，缺乏有效的验证机制，因此需要构建可利用已知目标进行受控评估的审计框架。

Method: 构建以七个7点清单概念为条件的扩散模型，生成反事实样本进行反事实审计；采用颜色校准的起始噪声降低颜色离群；使用分位数正对照、伪标签匹配对照、第二评估者标注对照以及18个标签置换的零假设分类器做对照检验；并比较概念激活向量的恢复能力，计算标准化效应边际，在ISIC 2020与HAM10000分类器上做色素扫描，并尝试探索性分解以考察概念间交叉影响。

Result: 颜色校准起始噪声将颜色离群率从78.5-84.8%降至6.6-13.3%；七个旋钮中的四个呈目标主导但仍改变其他概念；分位数正对照存在混杂，审计未通过预设规则；在三个概念上恢复了全部16个伪标签匹配对照的目标及12/12个第二评估者标注对照的目标，而概念激活向量仅恢复11/16；18个标签置换分类器中也出现显著扫描响应和目标排序，但标准化效应边际可将对照与零假设分类器区分；色素扫描在15/15个ISIC 2020分类器上提升黑色素瘤logit（平均+3.12），在6/6个HAM10000分类器上提升（+4.01），约为零假设响应（无标度单位）的四倍，而回归效应未迁移；探索性分解提示旋钮交叉干扰部分掩盖了血管相关响应。

Conclusion: 匹配对照与零假设分类器是检验概念解释审计的有效且实用的手段；概念扩散旋钮虽具目标主导性但存在交叉干扰，可能掩盖部分概念响应，需在审计设计中加以控制。

Abstract: Concept-based explanations of melanoma classifiers are rarely tested against controls with known targets. We built a counterfactual audit from a diffusion model conditioned on seven 7-point checklist concepts and tested it with such controls. Colour-calibrated start noise reduced colour outliers from 78.5-84.8\% to 6.6-13.3\%. Four of seven knobs were target-dominant but also changed other concepts. Quartile-based positive controls were confounded, and the audit failed its pre-specified rule. It recovered the targets of all 16 controls matched on the generator's pseudo-labels and of 12 of 12 controls labelled by a second evaluator, for three concepts; concept activation vectors recovered fewer (11 of 16). In 18 permuted-label classifiers, significant sweep responses and target rankings also arose, whereas standardised effect margins separated the controls from these null classifiers. The pigmentation sweep raised the melanoma logit in 15 of 15 ISIC 2020 classifiers (+3.12 on average) and 6 of 6 HAM10000 classifiers (+4.01), about four times the null response in scale-free units; the regression effect did not transfer. An exploratory decomposition, evaluated against the controls, suggested that knob cross-talk partly hides vascular responses. Matched controls and null classifiers are practical checks of concept audits.

</details>


### [245] [AgiWorld: An Agentic Video World Model for Building Persistent Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02341)
*Shaoheng Fang,Yiqun Mei,Hanwen Jiang,Xin Sun,Haitian Zheng,Hao Tan,Kalyan Sunkavalli,Georgios Pavlakos,Qixing Huang,Yiwei Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AgiWorld 是一个智能体式（agentic）视频世界模型：由 AgiWorld-Agent 根据单张图像和自由文本指令做高层世界规划与探索调度，AgiWorld-WM 逐块生成视频并连同几何存入空间记忆，二者通过共享空间记忆与“度量相机轨迹+结构化提示”接口构成闭环，从而在分钟级长旅程中构建持久一致的世界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有交互式视频世界模型仅支持由用户逐帧给出相机运动与文本提示的低层控制，用户需耗费大量精力才能把高层意图转成具体操作；同时随着探索推进，生成世界难以保持持久性（persistence），易出现不一致与漂移。

Method: 提出两层协同设计：(1) AgiWorld-Agent 在“世界状态”中规划世界布局与旅程路径，指导探索；(2) AgiWorld-WM 以 chunk-by-chunk 方式生成视频，并将其与几何信息一并写入空间记忆，智能体据此更新世界状态，形成闭环。两层围绕共享空间记忆与“度量相机轨迹 + 结构化提示”接口协同。针对长 rollout 中的遮挡与累计几何误差，提出遮挡感知历史选择（按表面可见性检索历史视角）和可靠性驱动记忆维护（偏好可靠几何与更早观测）。

Result: 在世界重访（world revisiting）与探索基准上取得最优整体性能；定性结果与消融实验表明，AgiWorld 可在自由形式指令下、跨越分钟级旅程构建持久世界。

Conclusion: 持久性并非仅源于视频生成模型本身，而是源于其与智能体构成的闭环；高层意图规划与低层生成通过空间记忆相互约束，可保持世界与用户意图一致、智能体世界状态与生成内容一致。

Abstract: Recent interactive video world models generate visually compelling videos from a single image, following user-provided camera motion and text prompts. However, such low-level control demands substantial user effort to realize a high-level intent, and the generated world struggles to remain persistent as the exploration proceeds. In this work, we present AgiWorld, an agentic video world model that explores and builds a persistent world from a single image and a free-form instruction. For high-level planning, our agent AgiWorld-Agent designs the world and the journey through it in a world state and directs the exploration. For low-level realization, our video world model AgiWorld-WM generates the video chunk by chunk and stores it with its geometry in a spatial memory, from which the agent updates its world state. This closed loop keeps the world faithful to the user's intent and keeps the agent's world state consistent with the generated content throughout the exploration. We co-design the two levels around the shared spatial memory and an interface of metric camera trajectories and structured prompts. In AgiWorld-WM, to handle occlusion and accumulated geometric errors in the spatial memory over long rollouts, we propose occlusion-aware history selection, which retrieves past views by surface visibility, and reliability-based memory maintenance, which prefers reliable geometry and earlier observations. AgiWorld-WM achieves state-of-the-art overall performance on world revisiting and exploration benchmarks, and qualitative results and ablations show that AgiWorld builds persistent worlds from free-form instructions over minute-long journeys. Persistence thus arises not from the video model alone but from its closed loop with the agent.

</details>


### [246] [SVD-Prune: Spectral Vision Token Pruning under Extreme Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02284)
*Yvon Apedo,Martyna Poreba,Michal Szczepanski,Samia Bouchafa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练框架SVD-Prune，用SVD与统计杠杆分数选取视觉token，以保留视觉表征的主导低秩谱结构，实现极端压缩下的全局token剪枝。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM与VLA模型需处理数百个视觉token，视觉表征成为主要计算瓶颈；作者认为视觉token剪枝不应视为挑选单个重要token，而应视为保留视觉表征的主导低秩谱结构。

Method: 基于上述表述，设计SVD-Prune：免训练框架，利用奇异值分解（SVD）结合统计杠杆分数（leverage scores）进行全局信息引导的token选择；与架构无关，可应用于多模态流程的编码器端、解码器端及混合配置等不同阶段。

Result: 在VLM与VLA基准上实验表明极端压缩下鲁棒性强；视觉token预算最高减少99.3%；在16 token预算下，编码器端剪枝降低推理FLOPs 82.4%，端到端加速4.18倍（含剪枝开销）。

Conclusion: 将视觉token剪枝重构为低秩谱结构保留问题是有效且通用的思路，SVD-Prune作为免训练、架构无关方法，在极端压缩下仍保持性能并提供显著效率收益。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models process hundreds of visual tokens, making visual representations a major computational bottleneck. We argue that visual token pruning should be formulated not as identifying individually important tokens, but as preserving the dominant low-rank spectral structure of the visual representation. Based on this formulation, we introduce SVD-Prune, a training-free framework that leverages Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and statistical leverage scores for globally informed token selection. SVD-Prune is architecture-agnostic and can be applied at different stages of the multimodal pipeline, including encoder-side, decoder-side, and hybrid configurations Extensive experiments across VLM and VLA benchmarks demonstrate strong robustness under extreme compression. SVD-Prune reduces the visual token. SVD-Prune cuts the visual token budget by up to 99.3%, while, at a 16-token budget, encoder-side pruning lowers inference FLOPs by 82.4% and achieves a 4.18x end-to-end speedup, including pruning overhead.

</details>


### [247] [Learning from high-resolution 2D images to reconstruct 3D microstructures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02204)
*Wenbo Sui,Lars P. Mikkelsen,Jens W. Andreasen,Daniel Lichau,Harold Phelippeau,Philip J. Withers*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出特权跨模态关系蒸馏框架（PCRD），在训练阶段利用高分辨率2D图像作为特权模态，仅凭低分辨率体成像即可实现试样特定的高分辨3D微观结构重建，并在碳纤维增强复合材料上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率3D微观结构表征在规模化应用中受限：所需空间分辨率的体成像成本高、耗时长或具破坏性；而细分辨率2D成像与低分辨率体测量通常都易获取，如何弥合两者分辨率鸿沟是核心问题。

Method: 构建特权跨模态关系蒸馏（PCRD）框架：教师端为SEM细分辨率2D图像，学生端为micro-CT低分辨率体数据；通过匹配以对应空间锚点为中心的相似度分布来迁移空间组织信息，避免异构特征向量的直接对齐。

Result: 2D截面重建中mAP较直接micro-CT训练提升1.66个百分点；与同步辐射X射线CT高分辨数据的独立3D验证显示纤维体积分数、直径与局域间距高度一致；重建纤维中心线长度匹配率达89.97%，而插值低分辨率体仅为75.08%。

Conclusion: 关系型跨模态蒸馏可有效利用训练期特权2D信息提升低分辨率体数据的三维重建质量，为规模化、无损的微观结构表征提供可行路径。

Abstract: High-resolution three-dimensional (3D) microstructure characterization remains difficult to undertake at scale because volumetric imaging at the required spatial resolution is expensive, time-consuming or destructive. In many settings, however, fine-resolution two-dimensional (2D) imaging and lower-resolution volumetric measurements are both readily available. We introduce a Privileged Cross-modal Relational Distillation (PCRD) framework that leverages fine-resolution 2D observations during training to improve specimen-specific 3D reconstruction from lower-resolution volumetric imaging alone. We demonstrate PCRD on pultruded carbon fiber-reinforced polymer composites, using scanning electron microscopy as the privileged modality and micro-CT as the inference input. The framework transfers spatial organization by matching similarity distributions defined around corresponding spatial anchors in the teacher and student representations, avoiding direct alignment of heterogeneous feature vectors. In 2D cross-sectional reconstruction, PCRD improves mAP by 1.66 percentage points over direct micro-CT training. Independent 3D validation against high-resolution synchrotron X-ray CT data shows close agreement in fiber volume fraction, diameter and local spacing. The PCRD reconstruction matches 89.97% of the reference fiber centerline length, compared with 75.08% for the interpolated low-resolution volume.

</details>


### [248] [A conditional generative model for T2-weighted prostate MRI with downstream evaluation in clinically significant cancer classificatio](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02197)
*Xavier Rafael-Palou,Alejandro Vergara-Richart,Ignacio Iborra Roncales,Carmen Prieto-de-la-Lastra,Andreu Antolin-Redondo,Juan Morote,Ana Jimenez-Pastor*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出面向T2W前列腺MRI的条件生成模型（MAISI-v2扩展），显著提升合成保真度，并在模拟数据稀缺场景下提升csPCa分类AUC，但跨机构增益不显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前列腺MRI预测模型受限于训练数据稀缺且代表性不足；合成T2W MRI有望扩充含临床显著前列腺癌（csPCa）及移行区（TZ）病灶的训练数据。

Method: 回顾性单中心、经伦理委员会批准的研究。在MAISI-v2基础上扩展条件生成模型，引入csPCa类别条件、分区（zonal）条件与病灶掩膜引导条件，并采用相对优势加权损失（relative advantage weighted loss）在1303例患者（1654个病灶）上微调。通过增量消融评估保真度（FID）；下游效用用基于T2W的csPCa分类器在五种模拟训练数据场景、每种18种合成数据配置下评估。

Result: FID由预训练MAISI-v2的13.28降至内部数据的2.04±0.06（PI-CAI：3.83±0.51）。合成增强在全部五种场景中显著提升AUC（+0.027至+0.088；校正p=0.016–0.043）；但跨机构PI-CAI增强增益不显著（+0.013；p=0.397）。

Conclusion: 模型改善了T2W MRI保真度；在模拟数据受限条件下合成图像提升了csPCa分类性能，但该收益未能显著跨机构迁移。

Abstract: Scarce and unrepresentative training data limit the performance of prostate MRI prediction models. Synthetic T2-weighted (T2W) MRI may augment training data containing clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa) and transition zone (TZ) lesions. In this retrospective, single-center, ethics-committee-approved study, we developed a conditional generative model for T2W prostate MRI extending MAISI-v2 with csPCa class, zonal, and lesion-mask-guided conditioning, incorporating a relative advantage weighted loss fine-tuned on 1,303 patients (1,654 lesions). Fidelity was assessed by incremental ablation, and downstream utility was evaluated with T2W-based csPCa classifiers across five simulated training-data scenarios, each testing 18 synthetic-data configurations. The proposed model reduced Fréchet inception distance (FID) from 13.28 (pretrained MAISI-v2) to $2.04 \pm 0.06$ internally (PI-CAI: $3.83 \pm 0.51$). Synthetic augmentation significantly increased AUC in all five scenarios (+0.027 to +0.088; adjusted $p = 0.016$--$0.043$), though cross-institutional augmentation of PI-CAI yielded a non-significant gain (+0.013; $p = 0.397$). Overall, our model improved T2W MRI fidelity, and synthetic images improved csPCa classification under simulated data constraints, although benefit did not transfer significantly across institutions.

</details>


### [249] [Znaki: A Russian Fingerspelling Recognition Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03136)
*Petr Surovtsev,Pavel Korotaev,Alexander Nagaev,Alexander Kapitanov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出首个公开的俄罗斯手语（RSL）指语数据集Znaki，并建立两个识别基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 俄语手语有15万以上母语使用者，但与美国、英国、德国等手语不同，此前不存在公开的RSL指语（fingerspelling）数据集，阻碍相关研究。

Method: 构建Znaki数据集：通过众包流程采集37,252段视频（35.4小时），覆盖1,593个唯一序列（来自16个领域类别的专有名词），由68名母语级RSL签名者（37名聋人、29名重听者、2名认证手语译员）录制；采用两阶段签名者资格审查与专家验证。数据覆盖全部33个西里尔字母手形，字母频率分布与俄罗斯国家语料库一致。并迁移ASL指语识别方法建立两个基线：基于Squeezeformer的编码器-解码器，以及Fingerspelling-PoseNet。

Result: Squeezeformer基线达到字符级准确率（1-CER）0.932、序列准确率0.596；Fingerspelling-PoseNet分别达到0.886和0.545。

Conclusion: Znaki填补了RSL指语公开数据的空白，具备规模、母语者多样性与统计代表性，并为后续研究提供可复现的识别基线。

Abstract: Fingerspelling - the sequential signing of letters that compose proper names, technical terms, and out-of-vocabulary words - is an integral component of any sign language. Despite Russian Sign Language (RSL) being used by more than 150,000 native signers, no public fingerspelling dataset for RSL exists, in contrast to American, British, German, and several other sign languages. We introduce Znaki the first open RSL fingerspelling dataset: 37,252 video recordings (35.4 hours) of 1,593 unique sequences - proper names sampled from 16 domain categories - recorded by 68 native RSL signers (37 Deaf, 29 hard-of-hearing, and 2 certified interpreters) through a crowdsourcing pipeline with a two-stage signer qualification procedure and expert validation. The dataset covers all 33 Cyrillic handshapes, and its letter-frequency distribution matches the Russian National Corpus. As reference points for future research, we establish two baselines adapted from American Sign Language fingerspelling recognition: a Squeezeformer-based encoder-decoder, reaching a character-level accuracy ($1-\mathrm{CER}$) of 0.932 and a sequence accuracy of 0.596, and Fingerspelling-PoseNet, reaching 0.886 and 0.545, respectively.

</details>


### [250] [Q-CamTuning: A Multimodal Large Language Model for Fine-Grained Quality Reasoning in Livestreaming Camera Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03007)
*Yanchao Bi,Pengfei Chen,Yulong Yan,Qian Zhang,Biao Wang,Leida Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 构建直播相机调优数据集FGLive-Comments，并提出多模态大模型Q-CamTuning，实现细粒度画质区分、全局-局部证据推理与相机参数调节方向推荐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直播应用普及使自动相机调优成为保障普通用户QoE的关键，但现有IQA方法在相机调优场景下面临两大挑战：难以识别调优中常见的细微画质差异；缺乏对细粒度差异的解释能力及给出调优建议的能力。

Method: 先构建FGLive-Comments指令微调数据集，包含细粒度图像对的偏好标注及基于全局与局部视觉证据的画质推理，并支持相机参数选择性调节建议；据此开发多模态大语言模型Q-CamTuning，其渐进式“感知—证据—引导”框架依次学习质量感知视觉表征、利用全局-局部证据增强细粒度推理、将画质问题映射到相机参数调整方向。

Result: 大量实验表明，Q-CamTuning在画质打分与细粒度图像对排序两项任务上均优于现有IQA模型；用户研究亦验证其推荐相机调优建议的能力。

Conclusion: 该工作将IQA从单一打分拓展至细粒度判别与可解释调优建议，数据集与渐进式框架为直播场景相机自动调优提供了有效方案。

Abstract: With the popularization of livestreaming applications, automatic camera tuning has become indispensable for ordinary users to enjoy high Quality of Experience (QoE). However, the existing Image Quality Assessment (IQA) methods face two challenges in camera tuning. First, they struggle to identify subtle quality difference between images, which is common in camera tuning. Second, the ability to explain fine-grained differences and to provide suggestions for camera tuning are even more lacking. To address these challenges, we first construct FGLive-Comments, an instruction tuning dataset with rich annotations of both preferences for fine-grained image pairs and quality reasoning from global and local visual evidence, which supports selective adjustment recommendations of camera parameters. Based on FGLive-Comments, we develop Q-CamTuning, a multimodal large language model for livestreaming camera tuning. Its progressive perception-evidence-guidance framework learns quality-aware visual representations, enhances fine-grained reasoning with global-local evidence, and maps quality issues to camera-parameter adjustment directions. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that Q-CamTuning outperforms existing IQA models in both quality scoring and fine-grained image pair ranking. User study also validates its ability to recommend camera tuning suggestions.

</details>


### [251] [ILLRAW: Illumination-Aware RAW Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02995)
*Xinzhe Wang,Xiao Liang,Xiaoli Zhang,Kang Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ILLRAW——一种光照感知的端到端RAW目标检测框架，绕过RAW-to-sRGB重建，直接在输入阶段用轻量适配器学习面向检测的RAW特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于RAW的检测器引入可学习ISP模块将RAW转为类sRGB格式以适配现成检测器，但该RAW-to-sRGB范式使表示学习与下游检测任务解耦，并迫使网络继承以人为中心的视觉先验，丢弃了RAW的线性传感器响应、高比特位深和最小处理的场景线索等固有优势。

Method: 在现有检测器输入阶段插入轻量特征适配器，直接学习面向检测的RAW特征；估计光照掩码并引入通道敏感嵌入以建模Bayer通道响应；通过光照注意力融合模块（illumination attention fusion module）融合上述特征。

Result: 在多样化AODRaw基准上取得明显提升，在LOD与PascalRAW上表现具有竞争力，尤其在暗光曝光条件下结果突出。

Conclusion: 端到端RAW检测无需重构视觉上合理的sRGB图像，保留RAW固有信息并结合光照感知建模可有效提升检测性能，为RAW域目标检测提供了新范式。

Abstract: Existing RAW-based detectors typically introduce learnable ISP modules to convert RAW inputs into sRGB-like formats to fit off-the-shelf detectors. However, this RAW-to-sRGB paradigm decouples representation learning from the downstream detection task. Crucially, it forces the network to inherit human-centric visual priors while discarding intrinsic RAW advantages, such as linear sensor responses and high-bit-depth, minimally processed scene cues. In this paper, we propose \textbf{ILLRAW}, an \textbf{ILL}umination-aware end-to-end \textbf{RAW} object detection framework. Instead of reconstructing visually plausible sRGB images, ILLRAW directly learns detection-oriented RAW features through a lightweight feature adapter inserted at the input stage of existing detectors. ILLRAW estimates an illumination mask and introduces channel-sensitive embeddings to model Bayer-channel responses. These features are fused by an illumination attention fusion module. Experiments show clear improvements on the diverse AODRaw benchmark and competitive performance on LOD and PascalRAW, with particularly strong results under dark exposure.

</details>


### [252] [NAS-PO: Native Attention-Strategy Policy Optimization for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02008)
*Ke An,Shizhe Xiang,Yue Liu,Liang Chen,Pei Fu,Shaojie Zhang,Xiaoxing Hu,Yupei Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出NAS-PO框架，利用模型原生注意力作为奖励锚定的token级路由信号，替代图像扰动/掩码等间接代理来塑造VLM的视觉感知，在7个域外推理与感知基准上显著超越主流RL微调VLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准RLVR对所有生成token赋予相同的结果信用，忽视其感知相关性；现有感知感知方法依赖图像扰动或掩码估计视觉依赖，需额外扰动分支，且损坏敏感性并不必然反映推理真正使用的视觉证据。

Method: 将原生注意力建模为奖励锚定、token对齐的路由信号：视觉质量策略（visual mass policy）量化视觉注意力分配，条件视觉策略刻画视觉token上的空间路由，使优化良定。NAS-AS基于视觉质量策略为视觉参与度高的rollout重分配带符号的策略梯度信用；AAC损失在所有响应token上对齐视觉质量策略、在视觉活跃token上对齐条件视觉策略。

Result: 在7个域外推理与感知基准上大幅超越领先的RL调优VLM，效果在8B与32B规模上一致验证；VRS分析显示优化后的注意力优先集中于视觉承载关键区域。

Conclusion: 原生注意力可作为一种内在、无需额外分支的感知塑造信号，有效提升VLM视觉接地的推理能力，并具备跨模型规模的可扩展性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an effective post-training paradigm for vision-language models (VLMs). Standard RLVR, however, assigns identical outcome-derived credit to all generated tokens regardless of their perceptual relevance. Recent perception-aware methods estimate visual reliance through image perturbation or masking. These indirect proxies require perturbation branches, while corruption sensitivity does not necessarily identify the visual evidence used for reasoning. We instead shape model perception through native attention, an intrinsic model signal. Rather than treating attention as a post-hoc explanation, we formulate it as a reward-anchored, token-aligned routing signal that encourages attention patterns supporting visually grounded reasoning. To this end, we propose NAS-PO, a Native Attention-Strategy Policy Optimization framework. NAS-PO analyzes native attention with a visual mass policy that quantifies visual allocation and a conditional visual policy that captures spatial routing over visual tokens, making the optimization well-posed. Based on this, Native Attention-Strategy Advantage Shaping (NAS-AS) draws on the visual-mass policy to redistribute signed policy-gradient credit for visually engaged rollouts. The Adaptive Attention-Coupled (AAC) loss then aligns the visual-mass policy on all response tokens and the conditional visual policy on visually active ones, consolidating the visual-routing patterns that drive successful trajectories. Experiments demonstrate that NAS-PO substantially surpasses leading RL-tuned VLMs across 7 out-of-domain reasoning and perception benchmarks, with its effectiveness consistently validated across 8B and 32B. Visual-Routing Sensitivity (VRS) analysis further indicates that the optimized attention prioritizes visually load-bearing regions.

</details>


### [253] [Unified Loss-Aware Density Control for 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02044)
*Tae-Young Kim,Jiwoo Chung,Jae-Pil Heo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文将3D高斯泼溅(3DGS)的自适应密度控制重构为一组局部损失下降决策，利用Taylor展开推导每个高斯在分裂、克隆与不透明度衰减三种操作下对目标函数的预测变化量，从而实现统一的有损感知框架，在标准基准上以相当或更少的高斯预算取得更优渲染质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准3DGS密度控制依赖启发式的视空间梯度、尺度阈值与全局不透明度重置，而非显式评估每次分裂、克隆或不透明度更新对损失的降低效果。这种失配会把基元分配到已充分重建的区域、漏掉欠重建结构，并因"一刀切"的不透明度重置导致训练不稳定。

Method: 将密度控制表述为局部损失下降决策集合，推导高效的Taylor类逐高斯基元代理模型，预测分裂、克隆、不透明度衰减三种操作引起的目标变化；框架包含三部分：(1) 将二阶分裂扩展到归一化的联合位置-尺度空间，使子基元可同时调整位置与各向异性尺度；(2) 将重复克隆建模为代理最小化问题，仅选择复制贡献可改善重建的高斯，并为子基元赋予有原则的不透明度；(3) 以选择性软不透明度衰减替代全局重置，削弱有害基元而保留有用基元。

Result: 在标准3DGS基准上，该方法实现更具针对性的基元分配，并在相当或更小的高斯预算下相比基线获得更优的渲染质量。

Conclusion: 把密度控制从启发式规则转为显式的损失下降评估，可在不增加甚至减少基元数量的前提下提升3DGS的重建保真度与训练稳定性。

Abstract: The efficiency and fidelity of 3D Gaussian Splatting critically depend on adaptive density control, which grows and suppresses Gaussian primitives throughout optimization. However, the standard pipeline still relies on heuristic view-space gradients, scale thresholds, and global opacity resets, rather than explicitly assessing the loss-reducing effect of each split, clone, or opacity update. This mismatch can allocate primitives to already-sufficient regions, miss under-reconstructed structures, and destabilize training through blanket opacity changes. In this work, we recast adaptive density control as a collection of local loss-reduction decisions. We derive efficient Taylor-based per-Gaussian surrogates that predict the objective change caused by three primitive-level operations: splitting, cloning, and opacity decay. This yields a unified loss-aware framework with three components. First, we extend second-order splitting to a normalized joint position-scale space, enabling children to adapt not only their locations but also their anisotropic extents. Second, we formulate duplicate cloning as a surrogate minimization problem, selecting only Gaussians whose duplicated contribution is predicted to improve reconstruction and assigning each child a principled opacity. Third, we replace global opacity reset with selective soft opacity decay that weakens harmful primitives while preserving useful ones. Across standard 3DGS benchmarks, our method produces more targeted primitive allocation and achieves improved rendering quality with comparable or smaller Gaussian budgets compared to baselines.

</details>


### [254] [Comprehensive Evaluation of Monocular and Multi-view 3D Human Pose Estimation Models for Fitness Exercise Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02929)
*Néstor Ortega,Agustín Salgado,Javier Sánchez*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文在Fit3D多视角健身数据集上统一评测了单目方法TCPFormer、PoseMamba-L与多视角方法MVGFormer，并考察了GT关键点与RTMPose/YOLO-Pose检测输入以及三种时域滤波对精度、时序一致性和鲁棒性的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法虽在标准基准上精度很高，但在真实体育/健身场景下的表现研究不足；单目与多视角方法的权衡、以及后处理提升时序一致性的收益，尚未在健身类数据集上系统评估。

Method: 以Fit3D（同步多视角健身动作录制、带精确真值）为测试平台，在统一评测协议下比较两个单目提升方法（TCPFormer、PoseMamba-L）与一个多视角模型（MVGFormer）；单目方法分别以真值关键点和RTMPose、YOLO-Pose生成的2D检测为输入，分析三种时域滤波器在抑制抖动同时保持运动动态方面的效果。

Result: 给出了各方法在精度、时序一致性和对不完美2D检测鲁棒性方面的详细对比；揭示了检测器质量对基于提升（lifting）方法的影响，比较了基于Transformer与状态空间的时域架构，并讨论了单目与多视角系统在健身动作分析中的实际权衡。

Conclusion: 2D检测质量、时域建模与后处理必须在动作分析的人体姿态估计流程中被联合考虑。

Abstract: Three-dimensional human pose estimation has become a fundamental component of computer vision systems for sports analytics, rehabilitation, and motion understanding. Although recent deep learning approaches have achieved remarkable accuracy on standard benchmarks, their performance under realistic sports scenarios remains insufficiently studied. Furthermore, the trade-offs between recent monocular and multi-view approaches, as well as the benefits of post-processing techniques for improving temporal consistency, have not been systematically evaluated on fitness-oriented datasets. This paper evaluates recent state-of-the-art 3D human pose estimation methods on Fit3D, a dataset of synchronized multi-view recordings of a wide variety of fitness exercises with accurate ground-truth annotations. We study two recent monocular lifting approaches, TCPFormer and PoseMamba-L, and a multi-view model, MVGFormer, under a unified evaluation protocol. To investigate the influence of the input data, monocular methods are evaluated using ground-truth keypoints and detections generated by recent 2D pose estimators, RTMPose and YOLO-Pose. Additionally, we analyze the effectiveness of three temporal filters for reducing prediction jitter while preserving motion dynamics. Experimental results provide a detailed comparison of accuracy, temporal consistency, and robustness to imperfect 2D detections across the evaluated methods. Our analysis highlights the impact of detector quality on lifting-based approaches, compares transformer- and state-space-based temporal architectures, and discusses the practical trade-offs between monocular and multi-view systems for fitness motion analysis. Our results show that 2D detection quality, temporal modeling, and post-processing must be considered jointly in pose estimation pipelines for exercise analysis.

</details>


### [255] [PixelBench: Can LLMs Understand and Generate Images Pixel by Pixel?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02540)
*Haoquan Zhang,Feiyang Liu,Juanxi Tian,Wanhua Li,Haodong Duan,Weiyang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PixelBench基准，检验LLM能否直接用现有词表生成像素图像（调色板+索引网格），并给出像素生成/理解评估与Pixel Reconstruction Tuning监督方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM生成视觉资产依赖SVG、CAD等高层符号原语，并非显式栅格值；作者探究LLM能否不借助学习式图像tokenizer或解码器，仅用既有词表直接生成像素图像。

Method: 构建PixelBench，覆盖多分辨率下的文本到像素（T2P）与图像到像素（I2P）生成，以及补充的像素理解评测。模型先输出RGB调色板，再输出指定每个输出像素调色板颜色的索引网格。另提出Pixel Reconstruction Tuning（PRT），将caption-palette-grid轨迹与视觉指令调优数据混合，从预训练检查点对Molmo2-4B进行后训练。

Result: T2P中强模型可直接由文本生成可辨识图像；I2P中强模型在低分辨率下优于调色板匹配下采样与专用像素化算法；像素理解能力与生成能力强相关；分辨率缩放研究显示性能常先升后降；PRT在16个视觉中心基准上均带来提升。

Conclusion: LLM可依托原生词表完成显式像素级生成与理解，且该能力与理解水平相关；显式像素重建可作为有效辅助监督，但高分辨率下存在性能退化，需进一步研究分辨率扩展策略。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate visual assets through text-based formats such as SVG and CAD, but these symbolic representations describe images using high-level primitives rather than explicit raster values. We ask whether LLMs can instead generate pixel images directly through their existing vocabulary, without a learned image tokenizer or decoder. We introduce PixelBench, a benchmark for text-to-pixel (T2P) and image-to-pixel (I2P) generation across multiple resolutions, together with a complementary pixel-understanding evaluation. Models generate an RGB color palette followed by a grid of indices specifying the palette color of each output pixel. In T2P, the strongest models produce recognizable images directly from text. In I2P, the strongest models outperform palette-matched downsampling and specialized pixelization algorithms at low resolutions. Pixel-understanding performance correlates strongly with generation performance. A resolution-scaling study shows that pixel-generation performance often improves initially before declining at high resolutions. Finally, we introduce Pixel Reconstruction Tuning (PRT), which augments visual instruction tuning with caption-palette-grid trajectories. We post-train Molmo2-4B from its pretraining checkpoint by mixing general instruction data with our curated PRT data, improving performance across 16 visual-centric benchmarks, indicating that explicit pixel reconstruction can provide useful auxiliary supervision.

</details>


### [256] [INTERACT: Learning Interaction-Aware World Dynamics from Driving Videos for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02526)
*Zhan Chen,Songyan Zhang,Wenhui Huang,Zirui Li,Zhidong Wang,Qihang Huang,Shiyu Fang,Chen Lv*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出INTERACT三阶段框架：从无标注驾驶视频学习基于slot的以物体为中心的世界模型，并将其迁移至轨迹规划，实现交互感知与动作条件化的轨迹学习，在NAVSIM上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端自动驾驶需自车预判周围交通参与者在自身运动下的演化，但现有模型将场景编码为稠密视觉或BEV特征，物体级交互隐式表达、缺乏显式建模。

Method: 三阶段框架：①从无标注视频学习循环slot，将稠密视觉特征聚为具时序结构的场景实体表示，无需物体标注；②由slot上下文与视频转移推断潜在自车动作，并以此条件化未来slot预测，刻画自车运动与实体的协同演化；③将学习到的slot、潜在动作与未来slot预测蒸馏进轨迹规划器，指导轨迹生成与选择。

Result: 在NAVSIM与nuScenes上验证有效，NAVSIM上达到SOTA，安全关键碰撞类指标显著提升。

Conclusion: 以物体为中心、动作条件化的世界模型可作为隐式交互表征的有效中间监督，提升端到端规划的交互建模与安全性。

Abstract: Safe autonomous driving requires more than recognizing the current scene: the ego vehicle must anticipate how surrounding traffic participants will evolve under its own motion. However, existing end-to-end driving models typically encode scenes into dense visual or BEV features, leaving object-level interactions implicit. We propose (INTERACT INTERaction-aware Action-Conditioned Trajectory learning), a three-stage framework that learns a slot-based object-centric world model from unlabeled driving videos and transfers it to trajectory planning. INTERACT first learns recurrent slots that group dense visual features into temporally structured scene-entity representations without object annotations. It then infers latent ego actions from slot context and video transitions, and uses them to condition future slot prediction, capturing how ego motion and surrounding entities co-evolve. Finally, the learned slots, latent actions, and future slot predictions are distilled into a trajectory planner to guide trajectory generation and selection. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM and nuScenes validate the effectiveness of INTERACT. In particular, it achieves state-of-the-art performance on NAVSIM, with improvements in safety-critical collision metrics.

</details>


### [257] [Latent Spectral Prompting for Multimodal Hyperspectral Object Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02512)
*Wangshu Cai,Jun Zhou,Lei Wang,Mohammad Aminul Islam,Xu Han,Kuldip Paliwal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SProTrack是一个多模态跟踪框架，通过"潜空间光谱提示"将预训练RGB跟踪器的时间建模知识迁移至高光谱视频域，实现时间建模与光谱解耦，在HOT2020/HOT2023上取得最佳整体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高光谱视频在伪装、低照度等困难条件下具备鲁棒跟踪潜力，但高光谱标注稀缺且RGB与高光谱域间存在巨大鸿沟，使得现代时序预训练RGB跟踪器难以直接使用；现有波段选择方法丢弃大量光谱信息，基于提示的方法又依赖局部搜索裁剪。

Method: 核心思想是解耦时间建模与光谱适配：时间动态从RGB基础模型继承，高光谱信息以自监督方式从无标签数据学习。具体用自编码器从完整高光谱帧中学习全局、场景级光谱表示，该潜表示指导光谱提示的提取，同时预训练RGB跟踪器在RGB兼容输入上保持强时间建模能力；将光谱-空间结构编码为紧凑潜提示，无需大量重训练或稠密监督即可桥接模态鸿沟。

Result: 在HOT2020与HOT2023数据集上实验表明，SProTrack取得最佳整体性能，并在所有光谱域上均表现稳健。

Conclusion: 通过全局场景级潜提示编码光谱-空间结构并与预训练RGB时间模型结合，SProTrack以低标注、低重训成本有效弥合RGB-高光谱模态差距，为高光谱视频跟踪提供了可扩展的迁移范式。

Abstract: Hyperspectral videos provide rich spectral signatures for robust tracking under challenging conditions such as camouflage and low illumination. However, limited hyperspectral annotations and the large RGB-hyperspectral domain gap hinder the direct use of modern temporally pretrained RGB trackers. We propose SProTrack, a multimodal framework that transfers temporal knowledge from pretrained RGB trackers to the hyperspectral domain through latent spectral prompting. The key idea is to decouple temporal modeling from spectral adaptation, allowing temporal dynamics to be inherited from RGB foundation models while hyperspectral information is learned from unlabeled data in a self-supervised manner. Unlike band-selection methods that discard most spectral information or prompt-based approaches that rely on local-search crops, SProTrack learns a global, scene-level spectral representation from the full hyperspectral frame using an autoencoder. This latent representation is used to guide spectral prompt extraction while a pretrained RGB tracker preserves strong temporal modeling on RGB-compatible inputs. By encoding spectral-spatial structure into compact latent prompts, SProTrack bridges the RGB-hyperspectral modality gap without extensive retraining or dense supervision. Experiments on HOT2020 and HOT2023 demonstrate that SProTrack achieves the best overall performance, with strong results across all spectral domains.

</details>


### [258] [IMUdrape: Generating Garment-Mounted Virtual IMU Data from Text through Physics-Based Cloth Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02393)
*Zikang Leng,Thomas Plötz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: IMUdrape 通过基于物理的布料仿真，从文本生成服装安装式虚拟 IMU 数据，缓解服装传感器标注数据稀缺问题，在活动识别与全身姿态估计上优于现有虚拟数据方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 惯性传感器正被缝入衣物，但织物会滑移、扭转、摆动，使服装传感器记录的是织物运动而非刚体运动，且随服装而异。这类模型需用实际部署服装采集的标注数据训练，而标注数据稀缺。现有从视频或文本生成虚拟 IMU 的方法都把虚拟传感器刚性附着于身体，无法刻画服装运动。

Method: 从活动描述合成运动；从照片重建目标服装的缝纫纸样；在部署时的真实传感器位置放置虚拟 IMU；用无交叉接触求解器进行布料仿真，使每次仿真都产出配对的服装信号与身体信号。

Result: 在四个真实服装传感器数据集上，活动识别与全身姿态估计均优于现有虚拟数据方法。单被试条件下，其数据使识别 macro-F1 较仅用真实数据提升 7%–46%，较同运动的身体安装式虚拟数据提升 2%–11%。在录制运动上仿真服装时，无任何真实训练数据的姿态误差较生成运动下降 30%–33%，且服装数据比身体数据精度高 12%。

Conclusion: IMUdrape 可作为服装安装式传感的虚拟数据来源，减少所需真实数据量；服装级仿真优于身体级虚拟数据，验证了建模织物相对运动的重要性。

Abstract: Inertial sensors are moving into clothing, from sensorized sportswear to garments instrumented with hundreds of IMUs. Sewn into clothing, a sensor no longer moves rigidly with the body: loose fabric slides, twists and swings, so a garment-mounted sensor records the motion of the fabric as well as that of the body, and this extra motion differs from one garment to the next. Models for such sensors need training data recorded with the deployed garment, yet labeled data are scarce. Virtual IMU data generated from videos or text have eased this scarcity for body-attached sensors, but existing generators attach their virtual sensors rigidly to the body. We present IMUdrape, which generates garment-mounted virtual IMU data from text through physics-based cloth simulation. IMUdrape synthesizes motion from activity descriptions, reconstructs the target garment as a sewing pattern from photographs, places virtual IMUs at the deployment's real sensor positions, and simulates the garment with an intersection-free contact solver, so that every simulation yields paired garment and body signals. On four real datasets with clothing-mounted sensors, IMUdrape improves on existing virtual-data approaches for both activity recognition and full-body pose estimation. With one real subject, its data improve recognition macro-F1 by 7% to 46% over real data alone and by 2% to 11% over body-mounted virtual data from the same motion. When the garment is simulated on recorded motion, the pose error without any real training data falls by 30% to 33% relative to generated motion, and garment data remain 12% more accurate than body data. IMUdrape thus reduces the amount of real data that garment-mounted sensing requires.

</details>


### [259] [GEAR: Generative Editing for Scene-Conditioned Outfit Retrieval for VR Travel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02363)
*Gia-Huy Dinh,Thinh-Phuc Nguyen,Thanh-Hai Nguyen,Lam-Huy Nguyen-Ngoc,Hoang-Bach Nguyen-Phan,Nam-Quan Nguyen,Minh-Triet Tran,Trung-Nghia Le*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GEAR框架，通过生成中间视觉查询（VLM场景描述→扩散模型渲染到标准角色→裁剪服装区域检索）实现3D场景条件下的服装资产检索，并在Unity原型与基准/用户研究中验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虚拟环境中选择合适服装需与周围场景语境协调，但3D环境视图与目录化服装资产之间存在显著视觉域差异，直接相似度匹配难以弥合这一跨域鸿沟。

Method: GEAR（Generative Editing for Asset Retrieval）：(1) 用视觉语言模型从用户自我中心视角图像描述适宜服装；(2) 用指令引导扩散模型将该概念渲染到标准化参考角色上；(3) 裁剪服装区域，通过嵌入相似度检索已有2D服装资产；并构建Unity交互原型实现实时场景捕捉、资产检索与引擎内3D化身试穿。

Result: 在受控数据集上以自动化Swiss-system成对比较评测，对比直接视觉相似度、美学打分与VLM重排序：GEAR取得竞争性首位表现（mean Elo@5 = 1012.75，top-10重叠度0.180），成对一致率0.539；20个虚拟旅行场景的用户研究中，GEAR在视觉吸引力（34.5%）与语境适配性（34.5%）上均获得最高整体偏好。

Conclusion: 以生成式中间查询替代直接兼容性预测，可有效桥接3D场景与2D服装资产间的跨域差距，兼顾检索质量与实时交互可用性。

Abstract: In virtual environments, choosing appropriate outfits requires contextual harmony with surrounding scenes, yet bridging the visual gap between 3D ambient views and catalog garment assets remains challenging. This paper investigates scene-conditioned outfit retrieval for interactive 3D environments, where a user's egocentric view serves as the retrieval signal. We present GEAR (Generative Editing for Asset Retrieval), a framework that bridges the cross-domain gap by synthesizing intermediate visual queries rather than predicting direct compatibility. GEAR uses a vision-language model to describe suitable clothing from a captured scene, employs an instruction-guided diffusion model to render the concept onto a standardized reference character, and utilizes the cropped clothing region to retrieve existing 2D outfit assets via embedding similarity. An interactive Unity prototype demonstrates real-time scene capture, asset retrieval, and in-engine 3D avatar fitting. We benchmark GEAR against direct visual similarity, aesthetic scoring, and VLM-based reranking on a controlled dataset using automated Swiss-system pairwise judgments, where GEAR achieves competitive top-ranked performance (mean Elo@5 of 1012.75 and top-10 overlap of 0.180) alongside 0.539 pairwise agreement. Furthermore, a user study across 20 virtual travel scenes demonstrates that GEAR achieves the highest overall participant preference in both visual appeal (34.5%) and contextual suitability (34.5%).

</details>


### [260] [VerdictAD: Few-Shot Anomaly Detection via Decision-Guided Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02654)
*Shangquan Sun,Wenjun Luo,Yuanzhi Wang,Ruiqi Li,Ruoyu Chen,Jiachen Liu,Shijian Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VerdictAD是一个免训练、即插即用的框架，利用类型化决策模型对查询图像及其局部区域与少量正常参考进行判定，产出结构化决策概率以修正现有异常检测器的响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有少样本异常检测方法主要依赖查询图像与正常参考之间的特征差异度量，但视觉差异并不总等于真实缺陷（正常外观变化会产生高异常分），而结构/逻辑型异常又可能不产生强局部特征差异，导致误检与漏检。

Method: 提出免训练的VerdictAD框架，不替换现有检测器，而是引入类型化决策模型直接输出结构化决策概率（无需文本生成），提供互补证据。包含两个模块：全局判定修正（GVR）用图像级决策修正整体异常分数；局部判定修正（LVR）聚合区域判定以修正异常图。

Result: 与简单的DINOv2检测器结合时，在单样本和少样本设定下取得有竞争力性能；作为即插即用框架，在MVTec AD、VisA和MVTec LOCO AD上一致提升现有检测器，单样本与少样本设定均表现良好。

Conclusion: 通过引入基于结构化决策概率的视觉判定来补充特征差异度量，可有效缓解正常外观变化误报与弱特征差异异常漏报问题；VerdictAD兼具免训练、即插即用的通用性，可作为现有异常检测器的通用增强模块。

Abstract: Detecting defects in real-world industrial inspection often requires learning from only a few normal images per category. Recent few-shot anomaly detection methods have achieved strong performance by measuring feature differences between query images and normal references. However, visual differences do not always indicate genuine defects, as normal appearance variations can also produce high anomaly scores. Conversely, structural or logical anomalies may not produce strong local feature differences, making them difficult to detect. To address this limitation, we introduce VerdictAD, a training-free framework that refines existing anomaly detectors through visual decisions. Rather than replacing existing detectors, VerdictAD adopts a typed decision model to assess the query image and its local regions against a few normal references. By directly producing structured decision probabilities without text generation, the model provides complementary evidence for refining anomaly responses at different spatial scales. Building on this capability, we introduce two modules: Global Verdict Refinement (GVR) uses image-level decisions to refine the overall anomaly score, while Local Verdict Refinement (LVR) aggregates regional decisions to refine the anomaly map. Combined with a simple DINOv2-based detector, VerdictAD achieves competitive performance in one-shot and few-shot anomaly detection. More importantly, as a plug-and-play framework, it consistently improves existing anomaly detectors across MVTec AD, VisA, and MVTec LOCO AD, achieving strong results across one-shot and few-shot settings. Our code and experimental logs are publicly available at https://github.com/sgstq0811/VerdictAD-Jev-AD.

</details>


### [261] [Computer Vision Applications for Art History: Reflections and paradigms for future research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02649)
*Amalia Foka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文从计算机科学视角分析艺术史期刊论文，识别艺术史研究者实际使用的图像特征，并将其转译为计算机视觉可理解的术语，从而为面向艺术史的计算机视觉应用提供新的研究范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 艺术史学者对计算方法的争论持续不断，部分原因在于现有计算研究未触及当代艺术史研究的核心问题；同时两个研究群体缺乏紧密合作，使得将艺术史方法定义为明确的计算机视觉问题变得极为困难。

Method: 提出一种方法论：以计算机科学视角系统考察艺术史期刊中的论文，提取并归纳艺术史学者在其研究中使用的图像特征，再用直接且可操作的术语向计算机视觉社区描述这些特征。

Result: 识别出艺术史研究中实际采用的一类图像特征，并给出可供计算机视觉研究者理解的对应表述；同时提出若干可作为新起点的范式。

Conclusion: 通过跨学科术语转译与范式提出，本文旨在使面向艺术史的计算机视觉应用更贴合当代艺术史的核心研究问题，缓解两大学术群体间的分歧。

Abstract: One of the contributing factors to the continuing debate among art historians over the use of computational methods in art history research is that they do not consider the core of today's art history research questions. The lack of close collaboration between the two involved research communities makes the definition of contemporary art-historical methods as well-defined computer vision problems extremely difficult. For that purpose, it is devised as a methodology to study articles in art history journals from a computer science perspective. The objective is to identify which image features art historians utilise within their research and describe them in immediate and meaningful terms to the computer vision research community. Finally, some paradigms that could serve as a new starting point for exploring how computer vision applications for art history can address the core of today's art history research are given.

</details>


### [262] [ProtoFusion: Protocol-Guided Prompt Refinement for Generative Infrared and Visible Image Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02877)
*Pengwei Liang,Junjun Jiang,Junhui Hou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ProtoFusion：一种“协议引导”的生成式红外-可见光图像融合框架，用结构化协议替代固定融合算子/手工目标/一次性提示，并通过闭环提示精炼与结构化信念构造实现融合生成与保守校正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有融合方法依赖固定融合算子、手工设计目标函数或人工指定的一次性提示，缺乏对“保留/抑制哪些证据、结果应满足何种属性”的显式可控表达，难以适应场景与模态差异。

Method: 将融合重构为协议约束下的生成任务：协议由环境状态卡、接地原则（grounding principles）与风格剖面组成；提出协议引导的提示精炼（闭环的生成—评估—修订，在多模态证据下迭代优化协议，推理时固定该协议直接引导生成）；并引入结构化信念构造，将模态可靠性、场景证据与跨模态冲突组织为结构化表示，用于生成后的保守纠正以缓解残余源不一致。

Result: 在标准基准上的大量实验表明，ProtoFusion 提升了定量指标，在美学评价上取得较好结果，并生成视觉连贯的融合输出。

Conclusion: 以结构化协议显式表达融合意图、并以闭环精炼学习该协议，是替代固定算子与手工目标的有效范式；配合结构化信念的保守纠正，可在定量、美学与视觉一致性上同时获益。

Abstract: Infrared and visible image fusion integrates complementary information from both modalities to provide a more comprehensive representation of the scene. We propose ProtoFusion, a protocol-guided generative framework for infrared and visible image fusion. Instead of relying on fixed fusion operators, hand-crafted objectives, or manually specified one-shot prompts, ProtoFusion formulates fusion as protocol-constrained generation. It represents fusion intent with a structured protocol, consisting of environment state cards, grounding principles, and a style profile, which explicitly specifies which evidence should be preserved or suppressed and which properties the fused result should satisfy. To optimize this protocol, we introduce protocol-guided prompt refinement, a closed-loop learning framework that iteratively performs generation, evaluation, and revision under multimodal evidence. Once learned, the optimized protocol is fixed at inference time and directly guides fusion generation. To address residual source inconsistencies, we further incorporate structured belief construction, which organizes modality reliability, scene evidence, and cross-modal conflicts into a structured representation for conservative correction after generation. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks show that ProtoFusion improves quantitative performance, achieves favorable results in aesthetic evaluation, and produces visually coherent fusion outputs. Project Page: {https://erfect2020.github.io/ProtoFusion/}.

</details>


### [263] [Local-Global Joint Modeling for Point Cloud Super-Resolution Guided by Multi-Scale Spatial Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02786)
*Wang Yang,Wenyi Ge*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于多尺度空间先验与局部-全局联合建模的距离图像点云超分方法，含空间门控融合、多粒度局部-全局协同感知与2D中值残差去噪三个模块，在KITTI-360与nuScenes上IoU达0.4703与0.3593。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有距离图像超分方法存在三方面问题：(1) 距离图像垂直方向非均匀，远处稀疏、近处密集，部分跨尺度融合机制未考虑不同垂直位置特征可靠性差异，导致远处无效值与噪声传入解码器；(2) 单一卷积或序列建模难以同时保持局部高频几何细节与全局长程依赖，重建过平滑；(3) 前后景边界处深度过渡平滑，反投影回3D时产生尖峰伪影。

Method: 将低分辨率LiDAR扫描投影为规则2D距离图像；设计空间门控融合模块，依据垂直位置特征可靠性进行跨尺度融合；引入多粒度局部-全局协同感知模块，联合建模局部细节与全局依赖；采用2D中值残差去噪抑制边界反投影尖峰伪影。

Result: 在KITTI-360与nuScenes数据集上实现有效重建，IoU分别为0.4703与0.3593。

Conclusion: 多尺度空间先验与局部-全局联合建模可有效缓解垂直非均匀融合噪声、过平滑与边界尖峰伪影问题，验证了该距离图像超分方法的可行性。

Abstract: Range-image-based point cloud super-resolution provides an effective way to reconstruct sparse outdoor point clouds by projecting low-resolution LiDAR scans into a regular 2D representation. However, current methods still face three challenges. First, range images exhibit pronounced vertical nonuniformity, with sparse observations in distant regions and denser observations in nearby regions. Some cross-scale fusion mechanisms do not account for the varying reliability of features at different vertical positions, allowing invalid values and noise from distant sparse regions to propagate into the decoder. Second, a single convolutional or sequence-modeling architecture often struggles to preserve both local high-frequency geometric details and global long-range dependencies, resulting in over-smoothed reconstructions. Third, smooth transition depths near foreground-background boundaries can produce spike artifacts when the 2D range image is back-projected into 3D. To address these issues, we propose a point cloud super-resolution method based on multi-scale spatial priors and joint local-global modeling. The design comprises a spatially gated fusion module, a multi-granularity local-global cooperative perception module, and 2D median-residual denoising. Experiments on KITTI-360 and nuScenes demonstrate effective reconstruction, with IoU scores of 0.4703 and 0.3593, respectively, supporting the feasibility of the proposed method for range-image super-resolution.

</details>


### [264] [History Forcing: Distilling History-Dependent Continuations for Long-Horizon Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02782)
*Hangyi Kuang,Chengzhi Wang,Yefei He,Weijie Wang,Yuke Zhao,Zhuokun Chen,Zisu Huang,Yifan Yang,Xiaoxuan He,Feng Chen,Bohan Zhuang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 History Forcing，一种统一的在线策略蒸馏框架，通过历史残差加权修正在少步自回归视频生成的分数/速度预测目标，注入长程历史约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少步自回归视频扩散模型生成高效，但长rollout一致性差，尤其主体或场景离开视野后重现时难以保持一致；现有蒸馏方法未充分利用更丰富的历史信息来约束学生模型的当前预测。

Method: 以“有/无信息性历史上下文”两种教师预测之残差来解耦历史监督信号。历史上下文可由两类来源获得：漂移累积较少的早期已生成片段，或固定视角的教师 rollout（在学生视角离开时仍保持场景可见）。该残差经加权后加到用于蒸馏的分数或速度预测上，构成修正目标，再通过蒸馏使学生对齐该目标。

Result: 在1.3B模型中达SOTA：15s生成VBench质量分85.07，60s生成VBench-Long综合分79.82；出视野世界建模中场景演化更合理、镜头返回时状态更一致，PlayWorld的Evolution Quality由2.35升至2.70，MemoBench的Object Consistency由58.43升至62.18。

Conclusion: 将长程历史约束以残差修正形式融入少步自回归蒸馏，可有效提升长视频生成质量与出视野世界建模的一致性，且方法统一、可扩展至不同历史上下文来源。

Abstract: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion enables efficient generation, yet maintaining consistency over long rollouts remains challenging, especially when subjects or scenes reappear after going out of sight. Despite progress in fidelity and rollout robustness, existing distillation methods do not fully exploit richer historical information to constrain the student's current prediction. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{History Forcing}, a unified on-policy distillation framework that strengthens historical supervision for few-step autoregressive video generators. The framework uses the residual between teacher predictions with and without informative historical context to decouple this supervision. Such a historical context can be obtained using earlier generated chunks with less accumulated drift or a fixed-view teacher rollout that keeps the scene visible while the student looks away. The residual is then weighted and added to the score or velocity prediction used for distillation, forming a corrected target. By aligning the student with this corrected target through distillation, History Forcing incorporates long-range historical constraints into autoregressive generation. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance among 1.3B models, with a VBench quality score of 85.07 for 15s video generation and a VBench-Long aggregate score of 79.82 for 60s generation. For out-of-sight world modeling, evaluations further demonstrate more plausible scene evolution and more consistent states when the camera returns, with Evolution Quality improving from 2.35 to 2.70 on PlayWorld and Object Consistency from 58.43 to 62.18 on MemoBench.

</details>


### [265] [Trace4D: Grounded Spatiotemporal Reasoning via 4D State Sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02759)
*Wooseok Jang,Seungryong Kim,Yan Lu,Lei Ji*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Trace4D，训练VLM预测4D状态序列并基于时间步变化与时间视觉观测进行推理，构建含60万4D感知与约7万接地QA样本的数据集，结合SFT与几何感知GRPO训练，在Trace4D-Bench与VLM4D上提升QA准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM难以理解物体及其空间关系在3D空间中随时间的演化，尤其在视角变化下；已有方法虽引入几何信息，但缺乏对时序有序4D状态演化的显式监督，也未将其作为中间证据使用。

Method: 构建Trace4D：让VLM预测4D状态序列并推理跨时间步变化；设计4D接地的思维链（显式表示4D状态、分析时间视觉上下文并联结为证据）；从野外视频构建Trace4D-Train（600K 4D感知样本、约70K接地QA）；采用联合监督微调后接几何感知GRPO训练；推理时直接从视频预测4D状态与推理，无需参考标注或外部几何模型。

Result: 在Trace4D-Bench与VLM4D上，QA准确率优于基座VLM；对4D状态变化与时间视觉观测的推理带来收益。

Conclusion: 显式4D状态预测与跨时间步变化推理可作为有效中间证据，提升VLM在动态3D场景中的时空问答能力，且推理阶段无需外部几何依赖。

Abstract: Understanding how objects and their spatial relationships evolve in 3D space over time remains challenging for vision-language models (VLMs), particularly under changing viewpoints. Recent approaches incorporate geometric information into reasoning, but explicit supervision for temporally ordered 4D state evolution and its use as intermediate evidence remains limited. We introduce \textbf{Trace4D}, which trains VLMs to predict 4D state sequences and reason over their inter-timestep changes alongside temporal visual observations. Its 4D-grounded chain-of-thought (CoT) explicitly represents 4D states, analyzes temporal visual context, and connects both as evidence for the answer. We construct Trace4D-Train from in-the-wild videos with 600K 4D perception examples and approximately 70K grounded QA examples, and train with joint supervised fine-tuning followed by geometry-aware GRPO. At inference, Trace4D predicts 4D states and reasoning directly from video without reference annotations or an external geometric model. Experiments on Trace4D-Bench and VLM4D show improved QA accuracy over the base VLMs and benefits from reasoning over 4D state changes and temporal visual observations.

</details>


### [266] [4D Triangle Splatting Reconstruction of Dynamic Endoscopic Scenes from Monocular Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02034)
*Laura Salort-Benejam,Stamatia Giannarou,Antonio Agudo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SurgicalTS：一种基于三角splatting的自监督框架，从静态单目相机视频重建动态内窥镜场景，通过四元数变形建模显著提升4D重建鲁棒性并降低训练时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目内窥镜视频的4D形变场景重建受非刚性组织形变、光照变化、遮挡及未知相机轨迹等因素困扰；可靠的动态重建对内窥镜可视化、诊断准确性和微创手术术中引导具有重要价值。

Method: 采用三角splatting表示，以规范（canonical）三角面片集合与变形网络联合优化；引入基于四元数的变形模型、改进的颜色参数化、时空先验，以及重新设计的初始化策略以改善遮挡下的重建完整性；整体为自监督训练。

Result: 在多类手术的体内内窥镜视频上，方法能建模软组织形变与器械-组织交互，持续优于现有最先进方法；同时缩短训练时间，并保持有竞争力的几何与光度精度。

Conclusion: 实验表明，具有物理一致性的四元数变形建模在内窥镜场景的鲁棒、高效4D重建中具有显著有效性。

Abstract: Robust 4D reconstruction of deformable endoscopic scenes from monocular videos remains challenging due to non-rigid tissue deformation, illumination changes, occlusions, and unknown camera trajectories. Reliable dynamic reconstruction of endoscopies could significantly enhance visualization, diagnostic accuracy and intraoperative guidance of minimally invasive procedures. We propose SurgicalTS, a self-supervised triangle-splatting framework for dynamic endoscopic scene reconstruction from static monocular cameras. The scene is represented by a canonical set of triangles jointly optimized with a deformation network. We introduce a quaternion-based deformation model, an improved color parametrization, spatio-temporal priors, and a redefined initialization strategy that improves completeness under occlusions. Extensive evaluation on challenging in-vivo endoscopy videos from diverse procedures shows that SurgicalTS successfully models soft-tissue deformations and tool-tissue interactions over time, while consistently outperforming state-of-the-art methods. Our method also reduces training times while maintaining competitive geometric and photometric accuracy results, highlighting the effectiveness of quaternion-based deformation modelling with physical consistency for robust and efficient 4D reconstruction of endoscopic scenes.

</details>


### [267] [VL-Dedup: Graded Multimodal Entity Resolution for Image-Text Data Deduplication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03080)
*Zhenxi Liu,Guanze Chen,Dehui Yu,Xingyu Wang,Bingxu Hou,Chengwei Li,Tao Ma,Ke Wang,Gongsheng Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文将图文去重重新定义为分级多模态实体消解（graded multimodal ER），为每对记录判定视觉同一性、标题处理与失配，并在pair、cluster、retained set三层评估；提出VL-Dedup方法并构建VL-DedupBench基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图文语料中存在同一图像的多份拷贝、多风格描述、跨图复用标题及图文失配，各类情况需不同治理动作。然而去重与多模态实体消解仅判定记录是否相同且在标注pair上评估，pair级分数无法反映记录最终聚类归属、也无法说明哪些有用标题被删除。

Method: 形式化"分级多模态ER"：对每对判定视觉身份、标题处理与失配；VL-Dedup将同一视觉实体的记录聚成簇并限制簇大小，簇内用VLM与CLIPScore决定标题保留/标记；构建VL-DedupBench（50,000条COCO与SOP记录、66,788标注pair）。

Result: 在VL-DedupBench上，即便分类器在标注pair上不产生任何假边，仍会把数百万对不同实体的记录连到一起；将VLM调用花在簇内pair而非分数不确定的pair上，同一模型可给出更优标题决策；即使聚类几乎全对，"每簇留一条"会大量丢事实，而VL-Dedup的删除损失信息显著更少。

Conclusion: 仅靠pair级指标与"每簇保留一条"的范式不足，需在三层上评估分级多模态ER；簇内定向调用VLM与细粒度标题处理能在保留信息与去重之间取得更好折中。

Abstract: Image-text corpora contain copies of one image, captions that describe one image in different ways, captions reused for different images, and captions that do not match their images. Each case calls for a different curation action. Deduplication and multimodal entity resolution (ER) only decide whether records are the same, and they are evaluated on labeled pairs. Yet pair scores do not tell which records end up in the same cluster or which useful captions get deleted. We therefore formulate image-text deduplication as graded multimodal ER, which decides visual identity, caption handling, and mismatches for each pair, and we evaluate it at three levels: pairs, clusters, and the retained set. Our method, VL-Dedup, groups records of the same visual entity into clusters and caps the size of each cluster. Within each cluster, a vision-language model (VLM) and CLIPScore decide which captions to keep and which to flag. We also build VL-DedupBench, with 50,000 COCO and SOP records and 66,788 labeled pairs. On it, a classifier that selects no false edge among the labeled pairs still joins millions of record pairs from different entities. Spending VLM calls on the pairs inside clusters, rather than on pairs with uncertain scores, gives better caption decisions from the same model. Even when almost all clusters are correct, keeping one record per cluster loses facts in many deletions, while the deletions of VL-Dedup lose much less information.

</details>


### [268] [VLM-as-a-Judge for Person Re-Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03027)
*Bessie Dominguez-Dager,Miguel Cazorla,Vincent Lepetit*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将通用视觉语言模型（VLM）作为零样本"裁判"对短候选列表重排序，可在无需目标域微调的条件下显著提升换衣行人重识别（CC-ReID）性能，并可用"专家分歧门控"降低计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CC-ReID 现有方法依赖不同的身份线索，在单一基准上领先的方法在其他基准上失效，缺乏稳健主导方案；作者希望利用与专家模型互补的通用先验来突破专家模型的瓶颈。

Method: 在 CHIRLA 长期 CC-ReID 基准的四个场景上，取两个冻结专家模型的短候选列表并合并，由冻结的通用 VLM 以零样本方式作裁判进行重排序（reranking）；所有组件均未在目标数据上微调。为降低 VLM 的算力开销，引入无阈值门控：仅当两专家 rank-1 判断不一致时才调用 VLM 裁判。

Result: 重排序在每个场景均提升 rank-1，较最佳单专家平均 +12.9 点，较二者最佳朴素集成 +9.4 点；合并两专家短列表在更低成本下不劣于仅重排强专家列表。门控剔除 40% 的 VLM 调用及相当比例总算力，rank-1 无显著下降，代价是 mAP 下降 1.8–3.8 点。

Conclusion: 在专门专家模型停滞的基准上，冻结的通用 VLM 是更强的身份判别者；VLM 裁判虽仍是主要算力瓶颈，但通过分歧门控可实现有效的精度-成本折中。

Abstract: Cloth-changing person re-identification (CC-ReID) is still very challenging, and no method clearly dominates: methods that lead on one benchmark collapse on the others, because they rest on different identity cues. We show that a general-purpose vision-language model (VLM), used zero-shot as a judge for reranking a short candidate list, beats the expert retrieval models it reranks by a wide and consistent margin. On the four scenarios of CHIRLA, a long-term CC-ReID benchmark that no publicly released Re-ID model is trained on, reranking the candidates of two frozen experts raises rank-1 on every scenario, by 12.9 points on average over the best expert and 9.4 over the best naive ensemble of the two, with no component fine-tuned on the target data. Merging both experts' shortlists matches or beats reranking the stronger expert's shortlist alone, at lower cost. Introducing a VLM does, however, come at a cost: almost all of the pipeline's FLOPs are spent on it. We therefore borrow a criterion from ensembling and invoke the VLM judge only where the two experts disagree at rank 1. This threshold-free gate removes 40% of the calls, and a comparable share of total compute, with no significant drop in rank-1, trading 1.8 to 3.8 points of mAP. Judging remains the dominant cost, but on a benchmark where dedicated experts stall, we find a frozen general-purpose model to be the strongest judge of identity. The code is available at https://github.com/bdager/JudgeReID.

</details>


### [269] [Unlocking the Potential of Contrastive Regularization for Diffusion Transformer Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02921)
*Yi Tan,Beier Zhu,Sirui Chen,Yunzhe Lin,Yuan Zhou,Cheng Chen,Xingyu Zhu,Tianrun Chen,Yanbin Hao,Hanwang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示朴素的InfoNCE对比正则化在扩散Transformer训练中收益有限，原因是高噪声下近正交噪声分量形成"捷径"削弱正样本对齐；提出以干净样本表示距离锚定对比离散度的CRAN正则化，抑制噪声捷径并稳定提升DiT训练效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表示正则在扩散Transformer训练中已被证明有效，但最经典的InfoNCE式对比学习在此场景下研究不足。作者希望回答：标准对比学习能否作为DiT的有效正则器？实验发现朴素InfoNCE仅带来边际收益，需分析其失效原因并加以改进。

Method: 分析发现失效源于噪声捷径：扩散输入中近正交的噪声分量可被用于拉大负对距离而削弱正对对齐，尤其在高噪声水平下目标易被该捷径主导。为此提出Clean Representation-ANchored Contrastive（CRAN）正则化，用干净样本的表示距离来锚定对比的离散度，将干净样本的关系语义结构迁移到含噪扩散表示中，从而抑制噪声捷径导致的过度离散。

Result: 在ImageNet上的大量实验表明，CRAN在不同模型规模与训练预算下均能一致地改善扩散Transformer训练，优于内部特征对齐与离散型正则化基线，并与外部DINO引导的REPA方法相当。

Conclusion: 一旦噪声驱动的过度离散被恰当约束，基于InfoNCE的对比学习可重新确立为扩散训练中的有效正则器；CRAN以干净表示锚定的方式实现了这一目标，无需依赖外部教师模型。

Abstract: Representation regularization has emerged as an effective way to improve diffusion transformer training. Yet one of the most canonical regularizers--InfoNCE-style contrastive learning--remains largely underexplored in this setting. We naturally ask a question: can standard contrastive learning serve as an effective regularizer for diffusion transformers? Surprisingly, we find that naive InfoNCE regularization brings only marginal gains. Our analysis reveals that the objective is easily dominated by a shortcut: near-orthogonal noise components in diffusion inputs provide a bypass for enlarging negative-pair distances while weakening positive-pair alignment, especially at high noise levels. To unlock the benefit of contrastive regularization, we propose Clean Representation-ANchored Contrastive (CRAN) regularization. Specifically, CRAN anchors contrastive dispersion with clean-sample representation distances, transferring clean relational semantic structure to noisy diffusion representations to suppress the noise shortcut. Extensive experiments on ImageNet show that CRAN consistently improves diffusion transformer training across model scales and training budgets, outperforming internal feature-alignment and dispersive regularization baselines while matching external DINO-guided REPA. These results re-establish InfoNCE-based contrastive learning as an effective regularizer for diffusion training, once its noise-driven over-dispersion is properly constrained.

</details>


### [270] [Performance evaluation of super-resolution techniques for characterization and phenotyping of commodity crops using multispectral imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02862)
*Abhiram Karukayil,João F. C. Mota,Mateo Vásquez-Guevara,Tito Arevalo-Ramirez,Fernando Auat Cheein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究评估8种RGB预训练单图超分方法直接用于RGN作物图像，发现Transformer类方法在4×和16×重建中均最优，可提升空间细节并保持光谱与植被指数可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多光谱影像光谱信息丰富但空间分辨率有限，易模糊细小作物结构并影响植被指数估计，需验证RGB域超分方法能否迁移至RGN图像。

Method: 将双三次与最近邻插值、Real-ESRGAN、HAT、HiT-SR、SRFormer、ResShift、StableSR共8种预训练模型在无微调条件下直接应用于RGN图像，在4×与16×倍率下对整图及人工分割叶片区域重建；采用MAE、PSNR、SSIM、SAM、ERGAS评价重建质量，并用MAE、PSNR、SSIM评价由参考与超分图像计算的8种植被指数。

Result: Transformer类方法在两种评价设置下显著优于GAN与扩散类方法（p<0.001），HAT、HiT-SR、SRFormer构成最高性能统计梯队。

Conclusion: RGB训练的SISR可在保持光谱一致性与VI可靠性的前提下增强RGN作物图像空间细节，适用于高分辨率作物表型分析。

Abstract: Multispectral imagery provides spectral information beyond the visible range for vegetation monitoring, but it typically suffers from limited spatial resolution, which can obscure fine crop structures and affect vegetation-index (VI) estimates.} This study evaluates whether single-image super-resolution (SISR) methods developed for red, green, and blue (RGB) imagery can enhance the spatial resolution of red, green, and near-infrared (RGN) crop images while preserving spectral fidelity. Eight pretrained methods are applied directly to RGN images without fine-tuning: bicubic and nearest-neighbor interpolation, Real-ESRGAN, HAT, HiT-SR, SRFormer, ResShift, and StableSR. Reconstruction at $4\times$ and $16\times$ is evaluated for whole images and manually segmented leaf regions. Reconstruction quality is assessed using mean absolute error (MAE), peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity index (SSIM), spectral angle mapper (SAM), and erreur relative globale adimensionnelle de synthèse (ERGAS). Eight VIs, computed from reference and super-resolved images, are evaluated using MAE, PSNR, and SSIM. Transformer-based methods \modification{significantly} outperform GAN- and diffusion-based approaches in both evaluation settings \modification{($p < 0.001$)}, with \modification{HAT, HiT-SR, and SRFormer forming the highest-performing statistical tier}. These findings indicate that RGB-trained SISR can enhance spatial detail in RGN crop imagery while maintaining spectral consistency and VI reliability for high-resolution crop phenotyping.

</details>


### [271] [Scaling Action-Free Video Latent Prediction for Transferable Representations in End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02853)
*Xingtai Gui,Xubin Zhou,Yucheng Zhou,Dongqian Guo,Jiahao Gong,Feiyang Tan,Jianbing Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ScaleDrive：完全基于大规模互联网开放世界驾驶视频（无动作标注、无基准特定数据）进行无动作视频潜变量预测预训练，冻结视频编码器用于下游端到端规划，验证该预训练目标的可扩展性与表征可迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端自动驾驶策略需要同时编码空间场景结构与时间动态的视觉表征；视频潜变量预测已成为学习时空表征的有效范式，但"以无动作驾驶视频规模化扩展该目标能否产生有益于端到端规划的表征"仍不明确。

Method: 将无动作视频潜变量预测作为可扩展预训练目标；构建 ScaleDrive 驾驶导向框架，仅用大规模互联网开放世界驾驶视频预训练，不使用动作标注与基准特定数据；下游端到端规划训练中保持预训练视频编码器冻结，以隔离表征可迁移性；用 ego-motion 与深度探针（probe）诊断表征；跨多种端到端驾驶策略与闭环基准系统评估迁移效果。

Result: ego-motion 与深度探针显示，扩大无动作视频预训练规模可逐步增强冻结表征中的时间信息与几何信息；跨不同端到端驾驶策略与闭环基准的迁移实验中，ScaleDrive 一致提升下游性能，表明规模化无动作视频潜变量预测所得表征可跨规划策略架构、评估场景与协议泛化。

Conclusion: 无动作视频潜变量预测是面向端到端自动驾驶的可扩展预训练目标，互联网驾驶视频可在无动作标注、无基准数据条件下提供可迁移的时空视觉表征，且该表征的收益随预训练规模增长并具备跨架构、跨基准的通用性。

Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving policies require effective visual representations that capture both spatial scene structure and temporal dynamics. Video latent prediction has emerged as an effective paradigm for learning spatiotemporal visual representations, yet it remains unclear whether scaling this objective with action-free driving videos can yield representations that benefit end-to-end planning. We study action-free video latent prediction as a scalable pretraining objective and introduce ScaleDrive, a driving-oriented framework pretrained exclusively on large-scale internet open-world driving videos, without action annotations or benchmark-specific data. We keep the pretrained video encoder frozen during downstream end-to-end planning training to isolate the transferability of representations learned from internet driving videos. Ego-motion and depth probes show that scaling action-free video pretraining progressively strengthens the temporal and geometric information encoded in the frozen representation. We systematically study the visual representation transfer across different end-to-end driving policies and closed-loop benchmarks, where ScaleDrive consistently improves downstream performance and demonstrates that scaling action-free video latent prediction yields representations that generalize across both planning policy architectures and evaluation scenarios and protocols.

</details>


### [272] [OctreeSplat: Hierarchical Octree-Guided Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02658)
*Yibin Zhao,Yihan Pan,Wenli Yang,Jun Nan,Jianjun Yi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OctreeSplat是一种八叉树引导的前馈3D高斯泼溅方法，依据局部复杂度在空间上自适应分配高斯基元，兼顾新视角合成、深度合成与表面重建，并显著减少基元数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前馈式3DGS方法避免了逐场景优化，但其固定的图像或空间分辨率限制了根据局部复杂度自适应分配基元的能力，导致基元分配不够高效。

Method: 从冻结的视觉基础模型(VFM)中提取多视角特征与几何先验，构建分层八叉树并预测致密化分数(densification scores)，从而按局部复杂度以空间变化的密度分配高斯基元；采用随机实体体积渲染(stochastic solids volume rendering)改进深度渲染并强化几何监督以支持表面重建；在相机参数可得时，可选的测试时优化(TTO)模块提升预测参数与真值的一致性。训练仅新增7600万参数，耗时35 GPU小时。

Result: 在Replica、TUM、Tanks and Temples和DTU数据集上，RGB视角合成、深度合成与表面重建均取得有竞争力的结果，并在保持高重建质量的同时减少了高斯基元数量。

Conclusion: OctreeSplat表明，基于八叉树的分层、复杂度自适应基元分配可有效提升前馈式3DGS的表示效率，在减少基元数量的同时维持高质量重建，为高效前馈式NVS与表面重建提供了可行方案。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has shown considerable potential for novel view synthesis (NVS) and 3D reconstruction. Feed-forward methods avoid costly per-scene optimization, but fixed image or spatial resolutions limit their ability to allocate primitives according to local complexity. We present OctreeSplat, a hierarchical octree-guided feed-forward Gaussian splatting. OctreeSplat extracts multi-view features and geometric priors from a frozen visual foundation model (VFM), constructs a hierarchical octree, and predicts densification scores. The resulting representation allocates Gaussian primitives at spatially varying densities according to local complexity. Stochastic solids volume rendering improves depth rendering, strengthens geometric supervision, and supports surface reconstruction. When camera parameters are available, an optional test-time optimization (TTO) module improves agreement between predicted and ground-truth parameters. Training updates only 76 million additional parameters and requires 35 GPU-hours. Experiments on Replica, TUM, Tanks and Temples, and DTU demonstrate competitive RGB view synthesis, depth synthesis, and surface reconstruction. OctreeSplat reduces the number of Gaussian primitives while maintaining high reconstruction quality.

</details>


### [273] [Peripheral prototypical contrastive loss for supervised medical image segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02305)
*Takuro Shimaya,Ryosaku Shino,Masahiro Saiko*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Peripheral Prototypical Contrastive (PPC) loss，利用边界邻近区域的原型对比学习增强边界识别，并在噪声标注下保持稳定训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物医学图像分割受限于目标边界模糊；现有边界增强损失对由边界歧义导致的不稳定标注较为敏感，鲁棒性不足。

Method: 构建PPC损失：从目标边界附近的局部区域提取原型特征，进行原型对比学习，聚焦现有方法难以处理的歧义区域；并提出自适应确定原型计算局部区域的策略以提升鲁棒性。

Result: 多数据集实验表明PPC损失在噪声标签条件下持续提升分割性能；自适应局部区域策略进一步增强鲁棒性并优于现有方法。

Conclusion: PPC损失有助于实现可扩展、可靠的医学图像分割，并可支撑基于不完美标注的基础模型开发。

Abstract: Robust segmentation of biomedical images remains challenging primarily due to ill-defined object boundaries. Although several loss functions have recently been proposed to enhance object boundary recognition, concerns remain about the susceptibility to unstable annotations resulting from boundary ambiguities. Here, we introduce the Peripheral Prototypical Contrastive (PPC) loss, which leverages prototypical contrastive learning to improve boundary recognition and enable stable training even under noisy annotation conditions.
