The PPC loss utilizes prototype features obtained from local regions near object boundaries, focusing specifically on ambiguous areas that have been challenging for existing approaches. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrated that the PPC loss consistently improve segmentation performance even under conditions with noisy labels. A newly proposed strategy, which adaptively determines the local region for prototype calculation, enhanced robustness and outperformed existing methods. Our findings indicate the potential of the PPC loss in facilitating scalable and reliable medical image segmentation, including the development of foundation models with imperfect annotations.

</details>


### [274] [SMILE: A Structured Multi-Agent Clinical Reasoning for Liver Ultrasound Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02581)
*Haris Ghafoor,Minjee Seo,Seonaeng cho,Keungmo Yang,Jaejun Lee,Kyungho Yoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SMILE——结构化多智能体临床推理框架，用三个专科智能体分别做形态描述、分期推理和VQA，再由judge VLM共识过滤融合，显著超越现有VLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式视觉-语言模型采用单一路径将超声外观直接映射为文本，存在视觉-语言模态鸿沟；肝脏超声疾病判读受细微视觉证据、异质性疾病模式和有限配对监督制约，单路径推理不足。

Method: SMILE包含三个互补专科智能体：图像解读智能体（形态学描述）、临床分期推理智能体、面向定向查询的VQA智能体；三者的回答由judge VLM依据共识过滤提示进行聚合与审查，输出统一、临床连贯的报告。

Result: 在公开肝脏超声数据集与内部临床数据集上均稳定优于SOTA VLM，ROUGE-1最高提升19.0%，临床F1最高提升18.8%；VQA F1分别为0.82（公开）和0.65（内部）。

Conclusion: 多智能体结构化推理与judge引导的共识机制可有效缓解模态鸿沟与监督稀缺问题，适用于数据稀缺、弱监督的临床场景；模型、数据与代码已开源。

Abstract: Automated liver ultrasound report generation improves the diagnosis of liver diseases by producing clinically structured descriptions of anatomical and disease-related findings. However, current generative vision-language models (VLMs) often rely on a single reasoning pathway that maps ultrasound appearance directly to textual descriptions. In addition to the inherent vision-language modality gap, this design is limited for liver ultrasound because disease interpretation is constrained by subtle visual evidence, heterogeneous disease patterns, and limited paired supervision. To address these limitations, we propose SMILE, a Structured Multi-agent clInicaL rEasoning framework that uses multiple complementary specialist agents to interpret ultrasound images and consolidates their outputs through a judge-guided consensus mechanism. Our approach employs three specialized agents: an image interpretation agent for morphological descriptions, a clinical-stage reasoning agent, and a visual question answering (VQA) agent for targeted queries. These agent responses are then aggregated and scrutinized by a judge VLM using a consensus filtering prompt to produce a unified, clinically coherent output. Across a public liver ultrasound dataset and an internal clinical dataset, SMILE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art VLMs, achieving up to 19.0\% improvement in ROUGE-1 and 18.8\% improvement in clinical F1-score, while reaching VQA F1-scores of 0.82 and 0.65 on public and internal datasets, respectively. These results demonstrate the potential of SMILE for data-scarce and limited-supervision clinical settings. Our models, datasets, and code are available \href{https://github.com/CMME-Lab/SMILE}{here}.

</details>


### [275] [CellPlex: Benchmarking Single-Cell Spatial Proteomics Prediction from H&E](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02506)
*Zijun Gao,Yijiang Chen,Xiangde Luo,Pheng-Ann Heng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CellPlex 是一个细胞级基准，用 7 个队列（717 样本、4480 万细胞、149 种蛋白）的 H&E 与同片多重免疫荧光数据，在统一流程、统一细胞与切分下比较病理基础模型（PFM）与专用模型，用于评测从 H&E 推断单细胞空间蛋白组。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间蛋白组学可测每个细胞数十种蛋白，但成本高、只能用于小队列；而 H&E 切片几乎覆盖所有患者。将单细胞空间蛋白组从 H&E 推断出来可把相关分析带入常规病理。现有虚拟染色模型各自在自建队列、panel 和像素级指标上评估，模型跨队列迁移差，导致"该沿用哪种方法"以及"H&E 究竟能揭示哪些蛋白"仍无定论。

Method: 构建细胞级基准 CellPlex：纳入结直肠癌、乳腺癌、淋巴结转移、骨髓与胶质瘤等 7 个队列，提供同片 H&E 与多重免疫荧光；经单一流程处理为逐细胞目标（per-cell targets）。用统一的细胞级协议适配病理基础模型，在相匹配的预算下微调专用模型，并在相同细胞上统一评分。

Result: 适配后的 PFM 在每个队列上都是最准确的模型，即使专用模型微调后仍落后；但 PFM 在未训练队列上仅保留不到一半的精度。可预测的蛋白种类取决于组织类型，而与测到的细胞数量无关。

Conclusion: 通过固定被评判预测所用的细胞、目标与切分，CellPlex 为"从常规 H&E 推断高成本分子测量"建立统一标准，并量化了 H&E 可在多大程度上替代空间蛋白组；数据、切分、评测代码与基线将公开，作为开发与比较未来病理基础模型和虚拟染色方法的测试平台。

Abstract: Spatial proteomics measures tens of proteins in every cell of a tissue section, but its cost confines it to small research cohorts, whereas hematoxylin and eosin (H\&E) slides exist for nearly every patient. Inferring single-cell spatial proteomics from H\&E would bring its analyses to routine pathology, and a growing number of virtual staining models pursue this goal. Each is evaluated on its own cohort, panel and pixel-level metric, and released models transfer poorly to new cohorts, leaving open which approach to build on and which proteins H\&E can reveal. We introduce CellPlex, a benchmark that poses the task at the level of the cell: seven cohorts with same-section H\&E and multiplexed immunofluorescence, from colorectal and breast cancer to lymph-node metastases, bone marrow and glioma, with 717 samples, 44.8 million cells and 149 proteins, processed by one pipeline into per-cell targets. Pathology foundation models (PFMs) are adapted with one cell-level protocol, specialist models are fine-tuned under a matched budget, and all are scored on the same cells. Adapted PFMs are the most accurate models on every cohort, ahead of the specialists even after fine-tuning, but keep less than half of their accuracy on cohorts they were not trained on. Which proteins can be predicted depends on the tissue, not on how many cells were measured for them. By fixing the cells, targets and splits on which predictions are judged, CellPlex sets a common standard for inferring costly molecular measurements from routine H\&E and shows how far H\&E can stand in for spatial proteomics. We will release the data, splits, evaluation code and baselines as a testbed for developing and comparing future pathology foundation models and virtual staining methods.

</details>


### [276] [UniCross3D: Unified Cross-View and Cross-Domain Diffusion for Consistent Single-Image 3D Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02631)
*U-Chae Jun,Jaeeun Ko,Jiwoo Kang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UniCross3D：面向单图三维重建的统一跨视角—跨域扩散框架，通过跨视角隐空间正则化与跨域互信息目标提升几何一致性与语义对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单张RGB图像重建精细几何与真实外观存在遮挡、光照变化、纹理—几何耦合等固有歧义；现有扩散生成模型虽改进新视角合成，但存在两大缺陷：缺乏跨视角几何一致性、跨域语义对齐不足。

Method: 提出UniCross3D统一扩散框架，含两项贡献：(1)跨视角隐空间正则化，惩罚隐变量方差以在合成视角间强制几何一致性；(2)基于图像成像物理的跨域互信息目标，显式对齐合成的颜色图与法线图。

Result: 大量实验表明，在视角一致性与语义对齐上显著优于SOTA，并在挑战性纹理与歧义视角下获得更高保真重建。

Conclusion: 跨视角几何一致性与跨域语义对齐的联合建模可有效缓解单图三维生成的歧义问题，实现一致且物理合理的3D生成。

Abstract: Reconstructing detailed geometry and realistic appearance from a single RGB image is essential yet fundamentally challenging due to inherent ambiguities such as occlusion, lighting variations, and texture-geometry entanglement. While recent diffusion-based generative models have significantly improved novel view synthesis, existing approaches suffer from two critical limitations: lack of cross-view geometric consistency and insufficient cross-domain semantic alignment. To address these issues, we introduce UniCross3D, a unified cross-view and cross-domain diffusion framework designed explicitly for consistent and physically coherent 3D generation. UniCross3D features two novel contributions: (1) a cross-view latent regularization that enforces cross-view geometric consistency across synthesized viewpoints by penalizing latent variance, and (2) a cross-domain mutual information objective grounded in the physics of image formation, explicitly aligning synthesized color and normal maps. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UniCross3D achieves significantly improved view consistency and semantic alignment over state-of-the-art methods and yields higher-fidelity reconstructions, particularly under challenging textures and ambiguous viewpoints.

</details>


### [277] [Bayesian Sequential Optimal Experimental Design for Single-Pixel Imaging using Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03042)
*Marcos Antonio Obando,Tianyuan Wang,Tanja Tarvainen,Tristan van Leeuwen,Felix Lucka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文将单像素成像（SPI）中的自适应压缩感知测量选择建模为贝叶斯序贯最优实验设计（sOED），并将其重构为强化学习（RL）问题，学习一个从当前后验信念直接映射到下一个最优二值照明图案的策略网络，从而避免在每次测量时直接优化复杂的信息论目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应CS需要序贯挑选最具信息量的测量，本质是贝叶斯sOED问题；但SPI的设计空间由全部二值照明图案构成，维数极高，用传统方法直接优化贝叶斯sOED目标十分困难。

Method: 把SPI的sOED重构为RL问题：以期望信息增益（EIG，贝叶斯OED中最完整的 Uncertainty reduction 度量）作为奖励，智能体通过反复实验试次学习策略；训练后得到策略函数，直接将当前图像后验信念映射为下一个最优二值测量图案，计算高效，无需在线求解信息论目标。实验在一个简单但有代表性的SPI场景中，比较两种策略参数化下的可扩展性，并考察仅有近似后验信息或测量受噪声干扰时性能的退化，同时提出若干受生物医学应用启发的额外设计约束策略。

Result: 数值实验表明，所提出的贝叶斯sOED-RL框架在近似后验与噪声条件下仍保持鲁棒性，并可扩展到更复杂、更大规模的SPI场景。

Conclusion: 将sOED表述为RL可有效规避SPI中高维二值设计空间的直接优化难题，学习到的策略可高效地在线生成测量图案；该框架具有鲁棒性与可扩展性，适用于实际成像系统的自适应测量设计。

Abstract: Adaptive compressed sensing (CS) aims to select the most informative measurements sequentially, which is crucial for many modern imaging systems. This task can be formulated as a Bayesian sequential optimal experimental design (sOED) problem, where each new acquisition is chosen to maximally reduce uncertainty about the unknown image given prior information and subsequent data provided by acquisitions. However, in single-pixel imaging (SPI), the large design space consists of all possible binary illumination patterns. Directly optimizing the Bayesian sOED objective over this space using conventional methods is generally challenging.
  In this work, we reformulate sOED for SPI as a reinforcement learning (RL) problem. In RL, an agent learns a policy through repeated experimental trials to maximize a reward, here given as the expected information gain, the most complete measure of uncertainty reduction in Bayesian OED. This avoids the need to directly optimize complex information-theoretic objectives during a measurement to obtain the next design. Instead, the result is a learned policy function that directly maps the current posterior belief about the image to the next optimal binary measurement pattern, in a computationally efficient way.
  Using a simple yet representative SPI imaging scenario, this work evaluates the scalability of the learned policy under two different policy parameterizations. Furthermore, we investigate how performance deteriorates when only approximate posterior information is available or the measurements are impaired by noise, and propose several strategies to introduce additional design constraints motivated by biomedical applications. The numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed Bayesian sOED-RL framework remains robust and can be extended to more complex, large-scale SPI scenarios.

</details>


### [278] [One Image Is Enough: Self-Generated Supervision for Personalizing Human Video Diffusion at Test Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02964)
*Sadman Rakib Pinon,Adamo Orsini,Yanis Falaki,Linlian Jiang,Jacob Kingi,Yang Wang,Xinxin Zuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出用合成监督替代真实多姿态视频，通过域微调的姿态条件生成器产生伪真值，结合推理期参考采样与低秩适配，实现单张参考图下的身份保持人体视频生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 姿态驱动的人体视频扩散在姿态偏离参考图时难以保持身份，面部与服装失真；个性化是标准解法，但其监督缺失——单图只固定单一姿态身份，而实践中无法假定存在多姿态主体视频。

Method: 1) 域微调的姿态条件生成器在选定关键姿态合成伪真值帧；2) 推理期仅参考采样器将候选帧拉向主体并保留身份最一致者；3) 对每主体用这些静态片段训练低秩适配器（LoRA），仅由参考图配置，无需主体视频、真值或标签。

Result: 在 TikTok 与 UBC Fashion 上，适配后模型在所有指标上优于基线，反转了身份-运动权衡，并在不使用任何真实帧的情况下匹配或超过用五张真实帧适配的效果。合成帧虽保真度较低，但监督更有效。

Conclusion: 真实帧携带的运动侵蚀时间先验，而静态片段仅传递外观；因此低保真合成帧比真实帧更适合作为个性化监督，实现"一图足矣"。

Abstract: Pose-driven human video diffusion animates a person from a single reference image and a target pose sequence, yet it struggles to preserve identity, rendering the face and garments unfaithfully as the pose departs from it. Personalization is the standard remedy, but its supervision is missing: one image fixes identity at a single pose, while a multi-pose subject video cannot be assumed in practice. Instead, we synthesize the missing supervision. A domain-tuned, pose-conditioned generator produces pseudo-ground-truth frames at selected key poses. An inference-time reference-only sampler steers these candidates toward the subject and keeps the most identity-consistent. A per-subject low-rank adapter then trains on static clips of them, configured from the reference alone, with no subject video, ground truth, or labels. Although lower in fidelity, these synthetic frames supervise more effectively than real ones. Real frames as captured carry motion that erodes the temporal prior, while a static clip conveys appearance alone. On TikTok and UBC Fashion, the adapted model improves the base on every metric, inverts the identity-versus-motion trade-off, and matches or surpasses adaptation on five real frames despite using none. Code and weights are available at https://github.com/SadmanPinon/one-image-is-enough.

</details>


### [279] [Probe-Guided Gradient Balancing for Multimodal Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02651)
*Vu Vo,Haytham M. Fayek,Thuy Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Probe-Guided Gradient Boosting (PGGB)，通过独立探针估计各模态表征质量，以"利用差距"为信号自适应放大弱模态梯度，同时不削弱强模态，并在八个基准上验证及给出理论分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联合训练的多模态网络中，学习较快的模态主导共享融合目标并抑制流向较慢模态的梯度，导致弱模态利用不足。现有做法多是对主导模态"限流"（throttle），而直接增强弱模态往往失效，因为源自联合损失的监测信号仍被强模态主导。

Method: PGGB在每个模态的stop-gradient特征上附加轻量线性分类器，独立估计各模态表征质量；以各探针得分之差（utilization gap）作为不平衡信号，通过有界且平滑的调制自适应缩放弱模态梯度；不改变损失函数与融合结构，故可与限流类方法组合。

Result: 在跨四个领域、2–4个模态的八个基准上，PGGB在高度不平衡的多模态数据集上优于现有SOTA方法，在低不平衡或几乎无不平衡情形下保持竞争力；理论上给出有界缩放、自衰减性质，以及在光滑性与有界方差假设下标准SGD的下降界。

Conclusion: 以独立探针度量模态贡献、按利用差距有界放大弱模态梯度，是一种不侵入损失与融合结构的通用梯度调制策略；实验与理论共同支持其在模态不平衡场景下的有效性与稳定性。

Abstract: Jointly trained multimodal networks frequently underutilize weaker modalities, as faster-learning modalities dominate the shared fusion objective and suppress gradients reaching slower ones. Most existing approaches throttle dominant modalities, whereas directly boosting weaker modalities often fails because monitoring signals derived from the joint loss remain dominated by stronger modalities. We propose Probe-Guided Gradient Boosting (PGGB), a gradient modulation approach that boosts weaker modalities while preserving the strength of dominant ones. PGGB attaches lightweight linear classifiers to stop-gradient features from each modality to estimate representation quality independently. The gap between these scores, termed the utilization gap, provides an imbalance signal used to adaptively scale weaker-modality gradients through bounded and smoothed modulation. PGGB is composable with throttling methods, as it leaves the loss function and fusion architecture unchanged. Experiments across eight benchmarks spanning four domains and 2-4 modalities demonstrate that PGGB outperforms state-of-the-art methods on highly imbalanced multimodal datasets while remaining competitive under low or negligible imbalance. We further establish bounded scaling, self-attenuation, and a descent bound for standard SGD under smoothness and bounded-variance assumptions. Code is available at https://github.com/VuVoCodes/PGGB.

</details>


### [280] [Latent Diffusion-GAN: Adversarial Learning in the Autoencoded Latent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02625)
*U-Chae Jun,Jaeeun Ko,Jiwoo Kang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LD-GAN，将对抗学习无缝集成进潜空间扩散模型：复用预训练VAE作为能量型判别器，无需额外参数即可实现对抗训练，并引入结构一致性能量对齐编码器/解码器特征，提升样本保真度、感知锐度与多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于似然的目标（如去噪分数匹配）会使扩散模型对高频细节（细纹理、锐利边缘）产生局部过平滑，限制感知保真度与结构细节；而引入GAN判别器虽能提升锐度，却带来额外网络开销并破坏训练稳定性。

Method: LD-GAN框架：不改动原始扩散流程，把预训练VAE用作基于能量的判别器以提供对抗信号；并设计结构一致性能量，约束编码器与解码器特征表示相互对齐，从而保持与预训练潜空间的兼容性。全程不引入额外参数。

Result: 在多种生成任务上，相较SOTA基线显著提升样本保真度、感知锐度与多样性，同时保持高效的训练动态。

Conclusion: 对抗学习可在不增加判别器网络与参数的前提下有效嵌入潜扩散模型，为改善扩散生成的高频细节与感知质量提供了一种简洁、高效的方案。

Abstract: Diffusion models are powerful generative frameworks for producing high-quality images by denoising latent variables from random noise. However, training with likelihood-based objectives, such as denoising score matching, can lead to locally over-smoothed high-frequency details, including fine textures and sharp edges, thereby limiting perceptual fidelity and structural detail. Adversarial training with GANs enhances sharpness but typically requires additional discriminator networks, increasing computational costs and destabilizing training. To this end, we propose Latent Diffusion Generative Adversarial Networks (LD-GAN), a novel framework that seamlessly integrates adversarial learning into diffusion models without modifying their original pipeline. LD-GAN leverages the pretrained variational autoencoder (VAE) in latent diffusion models as an energy-based discriminator, enabling adversarial training without extra parameters and preserving the structured latent priors learned from large datasets. We also introduce a structural consistency energy that aligns encoder and decoder feature representations, thereby enhancing perceptual quality and compatibility with the pretrained latent space. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LD-GAN significantly improves sample fidelity, perceptual sharpness, and diversity over state-of-the-art baseline methods across various generation tasks while ensuring efficient training dynamics.

</details>


### [281] [Task Adaptation Through Guidance in Frozen Feature Upsampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02854)
*Pingan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文对比了在冻结上采样器（JAFAR/AnyUp）前后插入残差适配器，并设计"读出零变化"干预，证明适配增益主要来自空间引导权重的自适应，而非特征值或粗分类器输出的改变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 特征在上采样之前进行适配能提升稠密预测，但增益来源存在歧义：可能来自特征数值改变、空间聚合方式改变，或二者兼有。作者希望厘清这一机制。

Method: 在同一父模型下，比较匹配的残差适配器置于冻结JAFAR上采样器之前与之后的效果；构建"读出零变化"（readout-null）干预，在保持冻结线性分类器粗粒度logits不变的前提下允许空间注意力权重自适应；并在已训练模型上做guidance/value交换实验，以及固定引导的重训练对照。

Result: PASCAL VOC与Cityscapes三随机种子实验：上采样前适配相较之后适配，mIoU分别提升0.807与1.413个百分点；在两种数据集与JAFAR、AnyUp两种上采样器上，readout-null适配相对冻结线性基线平均提升1.379–1.987个百分点；重训练对照进一步支持自适应空间引导的收益。

Conclusion: 即使粗分类器输出不变，稠密预测仍可提升；增益来源于上采样过程中空间引导权重的自适应。研究将空间引导识别为适配冻结特征上采样系统的有效作用点，为稠密预测的适配设计提供机制性依据。

Abstract: Adapting features before upsampling can improve dense prediction, but the gains may arise from changes in feature values, spatial aggregation, or both. We investigate this ambiguity by comparing matched residual adapters before and after a frozen JAFAR upsampler under a shared parent. We construct a readout-null intervention that preserves a frozen linear classifier's coarse logits while allowing spatial attention weights to adapt. Guidance/value exchanges on trained models and retrained fixed-guidance controls test the utility of this adaptation route. In three-seed experiments on PASCAL Visual Object Classes (VOC) and Cityscapes, adaptation before upsampling improves mean intersection over union (mIoU) by 0.807 and 1.413 percentage points, respectively, over adaptation after upsampling. Across both datasets and the JAFAR and AnyUp upsamplers, readout-null adaptation produces mean gains of 1.379-1.987 points over the corresponding frozen linear baselines. Retrained controls further support the benefit of adaptive spatial guidance. These findings explain how dense predictions can improve despite unchanged coarse classifier outputs and identify spatial guidance as a useful target when adapting frozen feature upsampling systems.

</details>


### [282] [Disen-Forcing: Disentangling Semantic Anchoring from Motion for Autoregressive Video Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02822)
*Zhengyang Yu,Akio Hayakawa,Masato Ishii,Qingtao Yu,Xuesong Li,Takashi Shibuya,Yuki Mitsufuji,Jing Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文重新审视了自回归视频扩散模型中广泛使用的"帧汇"设计，发现长程一致性的锚定机制并非LLM式注意力汇，而是由稀疏注意力头子集承担；据此提出Disen-Forcing，通过解耦的上下文路由与运动解耦正则，在蒸馏阶段缓解过度条件化病理，同时提升长程一致性与运动动态性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AR-VDM虽支持实时长时程生成，但推理时程超出训练时程后会因累积曝光偏差而迅速退化。近期方法借鉴LLM注意力汇，启发式地将初始帧作为持久上下文（frame sink）以稳定长推演，但其机理未经验证，且可能带来隐性代价。

Method: 先进行机理分析：表明初始帧对长程一致性的稳定作用来自少数稀疏注意力头（负责长程锚定），而多数头仅捕捉局部时序动态，并非LLM式注意力汇。由此指出既有frame-sink策略的"过度条件化"病理——所有头被统一暴露于固定初始帧上下文，蒸馏时易使运动坍缩到教师的低动态模式。提出Disen-Forcing：一种蒸馏阶段的即插即用方法，包含解耦上下文路由（disentangled context routing）与运动解耦正则（motion-disentangling regularization），以分离并强化头部专门化。

Result: 在长时程视频生成基准上，Disen-Forcing同时提升了基础AR-VDM的长程一致性与运动动态性；而基于sink的方法难以在同一权衡中取得平衡。

Conclusion: 初始帧的稳定作用源于稀疏注意力头的专门化而非通用注意力汇；显式解耦上下文路由可避免过度条件化导致的运动坍缩，为长时程自回归视频生成提供了一种兼顾一致性与动态性的蒸馏方案。

Abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models (AR-VDMs) enable real-time, long-horizon video generation but degrade rapidly once the inference horizon outruns the training horizon, due to compounding exposure bias. To stabilize long rollouts, recent methods heuristically adopt frame sink, keeping initial frames as a persistent model context, inspired by attention sinks in LLMs. We revisit this design and find that the mechanism by which initial frames stabilize long-range consistency in AR-VDMs is not an LLM-style attention sink; instead, long-range consistency is anchored through a sparse subset of attention heads, while the majority of heads predominantly capture local temporal dynamics. This observation reveals an over-conditioning pathology in existing frame-sink strategies: by universally exposing every head to the pinned initial-frame context, the model becomes prone to collapsing motion toward the low-dynamic modes of the teacher during model distillation. We propose Disen-Forcing, a distillation-time plug-in for AR-VDMs that disentangles and reinforces this head specialization through disentangled context routing and motion-disentangling regularization. On long-horizon video generation benchmarks, Disen-Forcing simultaneously improves long-range consistency and motion dynamics of base AR-VDMs, a trade-off that sink-based methods fail to balance.

</details>


### [283] [OmniOPD: Stable On-Policy Distillation for Joint Audio-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02803)
*Zihao Fan,Xin Lu,Jie Huang,Hexin Zhang,Xueyang Fu,Zheng-Jun Zha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 OmniOPD，一种模态级在线策略蒸馏框架，通过不对称噪声调度、分组多噪声采样与时间步重要性加权，解决音视频联合生成中音频监督稀疏导致的蒸馏不稳定问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习提升音视频联合生成时，异构的模态专属奖励易引入跨模态干扰；在线策略蒸馏(OPD)可将音、视频 RL 教师能力迁移至单一学生模型以缓解该问题，但跨模态 token 数量严重失衡使音频监督稀疏、蒸馏不稳定。且简单提高音频损失权重无效，因音频学习高度依赖视觉上下文。

Method: 1) 利用不对称噪声调度构造特权视觉信息，使音频教师可从更干净的视频上下文中生成更具信息量的目标；2) 引入分组多噪声采样，扩大音频监督覆盖范围并稳定训练；3) 引入基于师生转移散度的时间步重要性加权，保留可靠监督、降低不可靠信号权重。

Result: 在 JavisBench 与 VBench 上的评测表明，OmniOPD 在保持音频质量的同时显著提升视频生成效果，实现有效的联合蒸馏。

Conclusion: 针对音视频 token 失衡导致的音频监督稀疏问题，应从提供更丰富的视觉线索与改进采样/加权机制入手，而非单纯调高音频损失权重，从而实现平衡稳定的音视频联合蒸馏。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) elevates joint audio-video generation, but optimizing heterogeneous, modality-specific audio and video rewards often introduces cross-modal interference. On-policy distillation (OPD) alleviates this issue by transferring the capabilities of specialized audio and video RL teachers into a single student model. However, a significant imbalance in cross-modal token counts leaves audio with sparse supervision, causing unstable distillation. We observe that naively increasing the audio loss weight fails to solve this problem since audio learning relies heavily on visual context, indicating richer visual cues are crucial to offset sparse audio signals. To address this, we propose OmniOPD, a modality-wise on-policy distillation framework designed for balanced and stable audio-video generation. First, we construct privileged visual information using asymmetric noise scheduling, allowing the audio teacher to generate more informative targets from cleaner video context. Second, we introduce grouped multi-noise sampling to expand audio supervision coverage and stabilize training. Third, we introduce timestep-wise importance weighting based on teacher-student transition divergence, preserving reliable supervision while down-weighting unreliable learning signals, to stabilize fluctuations in audio learning. Evaluated on JavisBench and VBench demonstrate OmniOPD preserves audio quality while significantly enhancing video generation, achieving effective joint distillation.

</details>


### [284] [Lookahead Prediction-Guided Adaptive Visual Refocusing for Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02780)
*Mengzhao Wang,Yanli Ji,Peng Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LPAVR：将多Token预测（MTP）的投机解码过程改造为前瞻信号，在推理时动态重聚焦视觉证据，缓解"时序证据近视"问题，训练无关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交错式多模态CoT依赖推理中动态引入视觉证据，但现有方法仅从历史上下文中选取证据。当推理焦点转移时，历史引导的证据仍停留在先前区域，无法覆盖下一步所需的视觉信息，作者称之为"时序证据近视"（Temporal Evidence Myopia）。

Method: 提出LPAVR，一种training-free的测试时框架。核心是把MTP从解码加速机制转用为前瞻信号：MTP解码时草稿头生成多个未来token，目标模型并行验证并保留与其解码轨迹一致的最长前缀；该目标模型验证过的前缀包含近未来语义，据此构造前瞻引导的视觉证据，并评估历史引导证据是否覆盖所指区域。覆盖充分则保留历史证据，否则切换为前瞻证据。

Result: 在多个多模态推理基准上，LPAVR同时提升推理准确率与MTP投机token的接受率，即联合改善视觉推理效果与投机解码效率。

Conclusion: 通过让视觉上下文与即将到来的推理需求对齐，LPAVR在不训练的前提下缓解证据滞后问题，并揭示了前瞻预测与投机解码效率之间的正向耦合。

Abstract: Interleaved multimodal chain-of-thought reasoning improves the visual reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models by dynamically incorporating visual evidence during reasoning. However, existing methods primarily select evidence from historical context. When the reasoning focus shifts, history-guided evidence may remain focused on prior regions and fail to cover the visual information required by the next step. We refer to this lag between visual evidence and subsequent reasoning demands as Temporal Evidence Myopia. To address this issue, we propose Lookahead Prediction-guided Adaptive Visual Refocusing (LPAVR), a training-free test-time framework. LPAVR transforms Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) from a decoding acceleration mechanism into a lookahead signal for anticipating upcoming reasoning intent. During MTP decoding, the draft head generates multiple future tokens, while the target model verifies them in parallel and retains the longest prefix consistent with its decoding trajectory. This target-verified prefix contains near-future semantics, which LPAVR uses to construct lookahead-guided visual evidence and assess whether history-guided evidence covers the indicated regions. If the coverage is sufficient, the history-guided evidence is retained; otherwise, LPAVR switches to the lookahead-guided evidence. This better aligns the visual context with upcoming reasoning and improves consistency between draft predictions and target-model decoding. Experiments on multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that LPAVR improves both reasoning accuracy and the acceptance rates of MTP speculative tokens, jointly enhancing visual reasoning and speculative decoding efficiency.

</details>


### [285] [GaussFlaw: Fine-Grained Perceptual Diagnosis for 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02767)
*Shaocheng Shen,Zihan Zheng,Kejin Li,Lu Liu,Xiaoyun Zhang,Qiang Hu,Wenjun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出首个3DGS细粒度感知诊断数据集GaussFlaw-80K（8万+伪影区域，像素级掩码+八类缺陷标签）及几何引导多任务模型GeoCritic，实现伪影定位与类型分类，并用于下游精化操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS伪影空间局部化且模式多样，全局质量指标与图像级基准无法指示伪影位置与类型，缺乏细粒度可测量诊断手段。

Method: 模型辅助的人机回环pipeline构建GaussFlaw-80K（80,049个伪影区域/14,289张渲染图，每区域含像素级掩码及几何、混合、光度三类共八种标签）；提出GeoCritic，融合RGB外观与深度线索的多任务模型，联合定位伪影并分类缺陷类型；并将诊断结果用于高斯致密化、属性校正、离群点剪枝三种下游操作。

Result: GeoCritic取得AUC-J 0.9507、Acc@1 80.08%；诊断引导的精化在多种数据集与3DGS骨干上提升所有全局与裁剪级指标。

Conclusion: 将3DGS伪影诊断转化为显式可测量任务，细粒度诊断不仅可评估，还能切实驱动渲染质量提升。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic novel- view synthesis with real-time rendering, yet fine-grained di- agnosis of its rendering artifacts remains challenging. These artifacts are typically spatially localized and exhibit diverse degradation patterns, making them difficult to character- ize using global quality metrics and image-level assessment benchmarks, which provide no explicit indication of where they occur or what types of artifacts they represent. To ad- dress this limitation, we introduce GaussFlaw-80K, the first large-scale dataset for fine-grained perceptual diagnosis in 3DGS. Constructed through a model-assisted human-in-the- loop pipeline, GaussFlaw-80K contains 80,049 artifact re- gions across 14,289 rendered images, each annotated with a pixel-level mask and one of eight flaw labels spanning ge- ometric, blending, and photometric degradations. These an- notations turn 3DGS artifact diagnosis into an explicit and measurable task. Building on this dataset, we propose Ge- oCritic, a geometry-guided multi-task model that integrates RGB appearance with depth-derived cues to jointly localize artifacts and classify their flaw types. Beyond evaluation, we further demonstrate the downstream benefits of fine-grained diagnosis through three complementary targeted operations: Gaussian densification, attribute correction, and outlier prun- ing. Experiments show that GeoCritic achieves an AUC-J of 0.9507 and an Acc@1 of 80.08%, while diagnosis-guided re- finement improves all reported global and crop-level metrics across diverse datasets and 3DGS backbones.

</details>


### [286] [3L-D: A Low-Light Level Dataset from a Sensor-Agnostic, Alignment-Preserving Acquisition Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02695)
*Léo Rueff,Maurgène Ghezal,Valentin Gorse,Astrid Dufaure,Esteban Monsalvo,François Atteia,Ludovic Escoubas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出3L-Dataset：基于模块化、传感器无关的物理标定采集框架构建的低光照图像与视频数据集，覆盖Midavaine夜天亮度Level 1（满月，约1000 mlx）至Level 5（阴天无月夜，约0.1 mlx）五个标准化亮度等级及可见光—近红外波段，通过高精度可编程机械驱动实现六个同步图像（1参考+5等级）的亚像素级空间对齐且无需后处理形变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有监督式低光照增强模型受限于数据集：主流方法依赖不受控环境拍摄、相机参数调节（曝光/ISO）或中性密度滤镜，无法复现真实夜空的近红外光谱内容与真实低光子噪声分布；同时动态配对序列的采集难以避免形变伪影与传感器特定偏差。

Method: 构建模块化、传感器无关的物理标定采集测试台，复现Midavaine标准化夜天亮度标尺（Level 1约1000 mlx至Level 5约0.1 mlx），覆盖乡村、森林、城市、沙漠等多样真实场景及可见—近红外光谱；采用高精度可编程机械驱动，对每个"六元组"（1参考图+5等级图）实现亚像素空间对齐，不依赖后处理图像形变。并在不同夜天等级下评测多种代表性深度学习基线。

Result: 在多夜天等级环境下对代表性深度学习基线的评测揭示了重度光子匮乏条件下重建保真度、感知质量与推理延迟之间的关键权衡关系。

Conclusion: 3L-Dataset为低光照图像/视频增强提供了物理标定、光谱真实、严格空间对齐的基准数据；其模块化框架可适配不同相机、光学系统、传感器技术与分辨率，支持数据集持续扩展。

Abstract: Supervised low-light image and video enhancement has achieved remarkable progress, yet current models remain fundamentally constrained by the limitations of existing datasets. Prevailing methods typically rely on uncontrolled ambient captures, camera parameter manipulation (e.g., exposure or ISO adjustments), or neutral density filters, failing to replicate authentic night-sky near-infrared spectral content and genuine low-photon noise distributions. Furthermore, capturing dynamic paired sequences without introducing warping artifacts or sensor-specific biases remains an open challenge. In this paper, we introduce 3L-Dataset, a physically calibrated low-light image and video dataset generated using a modular, sensor-agnostic acquisition framework. Our test bench faithfully reproduces the standardized Midavaine night level scale from Level 1 (full moon, approximately 1000 mlx) down to Level 5 (overcast moonless night, approximately 0.1 mlx), spanning the visible to near-infrared spectrum across diverse realistic environments, including countryside, forest, urban, and desert scale models. Using high-precision programmable mechanical actuation, our acquisition framework guarantees sub-pixel spatial alignment across synchronized sextuplets, each composed of one reference image and five corresponding images acquired at the five standardized night levels, without post-processing image warping. We evaluate multiple representative deep learning baselines across varying night levels, revealing critical trade-offs between reconstruction fidelity, perceptual quality, and inference latency under severe photon starvation. The modular acquisition framework can be adapted to different cameras, optical systems, sensor technologies, and resolutions, enabling the dataset to be continuously expanded.

</details>


### [287] [TME-ContextNet: Class-Conditioned Spatial Supervision and Grouped Decoding for Joint Nuclei Instance Segmentation and Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02671)
*Rukang Ma,Bingxue Wang,Liwen Zou,Yingying Cao,Zhenghua Cai,Yu Li,Dong Wang,Huiyu Zhou,Luying Gui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TME-ContextNet多任务框架，利用类别条件空间上下文监督与分组解码器，实现紧凑的核实例分割与分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核实例分割与分类需精确边界和邻域信息以区分形态相似的细胞类型，现有方法缺少有效的空间上下文建模且计算冗余。

Method: 用欧氏距离变换将核标签扩展为稠密类别条件空间监督（无需额外组织区域标注），推导其最近区域解释并分析对标注扰动的稳定性；局部-全局上下文模块结合空洞卷积与自注意力；分组任务解码器分为几何与语义两组以减少冗余计算，空间头仅训练时使用、推理时省略。

Result: PanMix、CoNSeP、PanNuke上Dice为80.23%/65.32%/79.13%，mPQ+为67.62%/35.50%/43.74%（PanNuke为三折平均）；参数量36.40M，低于HoVer-Net的54.74M。

Conclusion: 目标与解码器控制实验支持距离监督与分组解码的组合，并揭示其依赖任务配置；该框架为计算病理中的联合核分析提供了紧凑、上下文感知的范式。

Abstract: Joint nuclei instance segmentation and classification requires precise boundaries and neighborhood information that helps distinguish morphologically similar cell types. We present TME-ContextNet, a multi-task framework that learns class-conditioned spatial context from existing nuclear annotations and organizes decoding into geometry-related and semantic task groups. Class-conditioned spatial supervision extends nuclear labels into a dense target using Euclidean distance transforms, requiring no additional tissue-region annotation. We derive its nearest-region interpretation and characterize its stability to small annotation perturbations. A local--global context module combines dilated convolution and self-attention, while a grouped task decoder reduces redundant computation. The spatial head supplies training supervision and is omitted during inference. Experiments on PanMix, CoNSeP, and PanNuke yield Dice scores of 80.23%, 65.32%, and 79.13%, and mean multi-class panoptic quality (mPQ+) scores of 67.62%, 35.50%, and 43.74%, respectively. PanNuke results are averaged across three test folds. Target and decoder controls support the combination of distance-based supervision and grouped decoding while identifying their dependence on task configuration. The framework uses 36.40 million parameters, compared with 54.74 million for HoVer-Net. These findings support a compact, context-aware formulation for joint nuclei analysis in computational pathology.

</details>


### [288] [PriCBMs: Multi-granular Concept Bottleneck Vision-Language Models for Visual Privacy Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02661)
*Shenglei Pei,Haotian Sun,Pengfei Li,Bingxu Lu,Wenlong Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出隐私概念瓶颈模型（PriCBMs），以隐私概念作为中间语义表示，通过视觉-概念匹配识别与类别相关的隐私线索再做多标签隐私类别预测，并结合概念选择策略与全局-区域建模模块提升性能与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体图像广泛传播使视觉隐私识别需求上升。多标签视觉隐私识别存在两个挑战：(1) 隐私类别是高层语义属性，与视觉物体非一一对应——不同物体可对应同一隐私类别，同类物体也可能含不同隐私信息，直接预测方法缺乏对类别相关隐私线索的显式引导，该过程隐含于图像到标签的映射中，可能限制分类性能；(2) 隐私线索分布于图像多个区域，整图特征难以充分表达。

Method: 引入隐私相关概念作为中间语义表示：先经视觉-概念匹配识别与类别相关的隐私线索，再基于概念响应预测隐私类别；设计基于目标类别相关性、跨类别可分性与语义多样性的概念选择策略以提升概念质量；并引入全局-区域建模模块，在保留全局上下文的同时捕获局部隐私证据。

Result: 在 VISPR 与 FineViP 数据集上，PriCBMs 在四项多标签评价指标上均优于所对比方法；消融实验与概念质量分析验证了各设计模块的有效性。

Conclusion: 以概念为中间层可使隐私预测过程更具可解释性，且概念选择与全局-区域建模的联合设计能够有效提升多标签视觉隐私识别性能。

Abstract: Widespread image sharing on social media has increased the need for visual privacy recognition to identify inadvertently exposed privacy information. However, multi-label visual privacy recognition presents two challenges. First, privacy categories represent high-level semantic attributes and do not have a one-to-one correspondence with visual objects. Different visual objects may involve the same privacy category, while the same type of object may contain different types of privacy-sensitive information. In this setting, direct prediction methods generally lack explicit guidance for identifying category-relevant privacy cues, leaving this process implicit in the learned image-to-label mapping and potentially limiting classification performance. Second, privacy cues are often distributed across image regions and may not be adequately represented by whole-image features. To address these challenges, we propose Privacy Concept Bottleneck Models (PriCBMs). By introducing privacy-related concepts as intermediate semantic representations, PriCBMs first identify category-relevant privacy cues through visual-concept matching and then predict privacy categories based on concept responses. This process makes privacy predictions more interpretable. To improve the quality of these concepts, we design a concept selection strategy based on target-category relevance, cross-category discriminability, and semantic diversity. Meanwhile, we introduce a global-region modeling module to capture localized privacy evidence while retaining global context. Experiments on VISPR and FineViP show that PriCBMs outperform evaluated competitors across all four multi-label metrics. Ablation studies and concept-quality analyses support the effectiveness of the proposed design. Code is available at https://github.com/sun2293674491-dotcom/PriCBMs.

</details>


### [289] [SurgPace: Complexity-Aware Progressive Distillation for Surgical Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03125)
*Zhicheng He,Xiaohan Xing,Hongqiu Wang,Kun Yuan,Guankun Wang,Yanheng Li,Haoxuan Che,Nassir Navab,Hongliang Ren,Long Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SurgPace——一种复杂度感知的连续课程蒸馏框架，用于将大型手术多模态模型压缩为紧凑模型，通过样本难度排序与分层表示对齐提升蒸馏稳定性与效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手术MLLM计算开销大，限制临床部署；知识蒸馏是构建紧凑手术MLLM的可行途径，但直接蒸馏不适用于手术数据：样本在难度、视觉模糊性和所需临床上下文上差异很大，均匀的师生迁移不稳定；且监督角色随训练阶段变化（早期需强教师引导做多模态对齐，后期更依赖任务监督）。

Method: SurgPace包含两部分：(1) 样本级课程——用预测置信度与Lorentz几何一致性估计样本复杂度，融合得分引导连续的由易到难训练过程；(2) 目标级调度——分层表示对齐，在特征、logit、概率三个层面将学生与教师对齐，并逐步将训练重心从教师模仿转向任务监督，实现样本级课程与目标级调度的解耦。

Result: 在Surg-396K（由四个公开手术数据集构建、覆盖五种对话范式的基准）上，SurgPace持续优于强MLLM蒸馏基线；在受控基准下实现更快解码，构建出紧凑、内存高效的手术MLLM。

Conclusion: 复杂度感知的连续课程蒸馏结合分层表示对齐与监督重心迁移，可有效缓解手术数据异质性带来的蒸馏不稳定问题，为临床可部署的紧凑手术视觉语言模型提供实用方案。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential in robotic surgery for question answering, scene understanding, and grounded assistance, but their high computational cost limits real clinical deployment. Knowledge distillation provides a practical way to build compact surgical MLLMs, yet direct distillation is not well suited to surgical data because surgical samples vary greatly in difficulty, visual ambiguity, and required clinical context, making uniform teacher-student transfer unstable. In addition, the role of supervision changes during training: early stages require stronger teacher guidance for multimodal alignment, while later stages rely more on task supervision for effective optimization. To address these challenges, we propose SurgPace, a complexity-aware continuous curriculum framework for progressive distillation of surgical vision-language models. SurgPace estimates sample complexity using predictive confidence and Lorentz geometric consistency, and uses the fused score to guide a continuous easy-to-hard training process. We further introduce hierarchical representation alignment, which aligns the student with the teacher at the feature, logit, and probability levels, while gradually shifting the training focus from teacher imitation to task supervision. This design separates sample-level curriculum from objective-level scheduling, leading to more stable and effective distillation. We evaluate SurgPace on Surg-396K, a benchmark built from four public surgical datasets and covering five dialogue paradigms. SurgPace consistently outperforms strong MLLM distillation baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness for building compact, memory-efficient surgical MLLMs with faster decoding under controlled benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/hezhicheng2002/SurgPace.

</details>


### [290] [KAUSTics-Net: Diffusion-Based Through-Water UAV Restoration with a Semi-Synthetic Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03120)
*Dario Scilla,Omar A. Lopez,Kasper Johansen,Brian O. Nieuwenhuis,Matthew F. McCabe*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出半合成数据集KAUSTics与像素空间条件扩散模型KAUSTics-Net，用于无人机浅水图像复原（去折射、焦散、波长衰减等水体畸变）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: UAV浅水测绘受水体折射、焦散与波长相关衰减等畸变影响；且成对的畸变—参考图像稀缺，制约有监督复原方法的发展。

Method: 构建KAUSTics：32幅高分辨率UAV图像切出1,280个参考patch，经Blender水面渲染与经验性颜色/模糊增强生成12,800个退化观测。提出KAUSTics-Net：像素空间条件扩散框架，集成多尺度条件编码器、FiLM、交叉注意力与复合重建损失。

Result: 与8种复原方法对比，并做结构消融与跨数据集实验。KAUSTics上三个训练种子平均PSNR 31.715±0.439 dB、SSIM 0.849±0.002、LPIPS 0.145±0.007。在独立Sea-Undistort数据集上，采样器感知微调提升保真度至19.469±0.332 dB PSNR、0.554±0.005 SSIM（复合水面畸变下），但存在感知权衡；另在真实UAV影像上考察特征保持与分割表现。

Conclusion: 半合成训练结合条件扩散在浅水图像复原上具潜力；需同时评估重建保真度与下游遥感效用。

Abstract: Accurate mapping of shallow-water environments using unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery is challenged by water-induced distortions, including refraction, caustics, and wavelength-dependent attenuation. The scarcity of paired distorted and reference imagery further limits the development of supervised restoration methods. To address this challenge, we introduce KAUSTics, a semi-synthetic dataset combining 1,280 reference patches derived from 32 high-resolution UAV images with 12,800 degraded observations generated through Blender-based water-surface rendering and empirical color and blur augmentations. We further propose KAUSTics-Net, a pixel-space conditional diffusion framework integrating a multi-scale conditional encoder, feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM), cross-attention, and a composite reconstruction objective to restore shallow-water imagery. We evaluated the framework against eight image-restoration methods, complemented by architectural ablations and cross-dataset experiments. On KAUSTics, KAUSTics-Net achieved a mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 31.715 +/- 0.439 dB, structural similarity index (SSIM) of 0.849 +/- 0.002, and learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS) of 0.145 +/- 0.007 across three training seeds. On the independent Sea-Undistort dataset, sampler-aware fine-tuning improved restoration fidelity, reaching 19.469 +/- 0.332 dB PSNR and 0.554 +/- 0.005 SSIM under combined water-surface distortions, although perceptual trade-offs remained. Additional experiments on real UAV imagery examined feature preservation and segmentation behavior. These findings demonstrate the potential of semi-synthetic training and conditional diffusion for shallow-water image restoration while highlighting the importance of evaluating both reconstruction fidelity and downstream remote-sensing utility.

</details>


### [291] [Multimodal Prompt Learning with Dual-Granularity Contrastive Alignment for Preoperative Prediction of Lung Adenocarcinoma Invasiveness Using 3D CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03109)
*Qing Huang,Xiaotong Tan,Lintong Yao,Wufeng Xue,Ruobing Huang,Dong Ni,Hao Wu,Tian Xiao,Jun Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出双粒度图文对齐的多模态提示学习框架，用于3D CT肺腺癌浸润性（IAD vs Pre-IAD）分类，训练用报告监督、推理仅需CT，测试AUC达0.9499。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 术前准确预测肺腺癌浸润性对手术规划与个体化治疗至关重要，但IAD与Pre-IAD的CT表现重叠，仅凭影像难以区分。

Method: 3D ResNet-CBAM编码器提取全局与空间视觉特征；冻结RadBERT主干，分别引入报告级与关键词级可学习提示，并用真实临床报告衍生的语义表示初始化；全局对比对齐将全肺CT表征与基于临床标注影像学属性生成的报告对齐；基于多示例学习的局部对齐模块将空间CT特征与血管相关关键词关联；联合优化分类与对齐目标，推理仅用CT。

Result: 共纳入1,593个经病理证实的结节；测试集准确率87.92%、F1 87.78%、AUC 0.9499，显著优于同视觉主干的纯图像Res-CBAM基线（AUC 0.9297，DeLong检验p=0.0078）；消融实验支持全局与局部对齐的互补贡献及报告提示初始化的增益；可视化显示激活位于结节及邻近血管结构。

Conclusion: 双粒度影像学监督可在保持仅CT推理流程的前提下提升CT浸润性预测性能。

Abstract: Accurate preoperative prediction of lung adenocarcinoma invasiveness is important for surgical planning and individualized treatment. However, overlapping CT appearances make it challenging to distinguish invasive adenocarcinoma (IAD) from Pre-IAD lesions. We propose a multimodal prompt-learning framework with dual-granularity image-text alignment for 3D CT-based IAD classification. A 3D ResNet-CBAM encoder extracts global and spatial visual features. A frozen RadBERT backbone is adapted with separate learnable prompts for report-level and keyword-level text encoding. These prompts are initialized using semantic representations derived from real-world clinical reports. Global contrastive alignment connects whole-volume CT representations with reports generated from clinician-annotated radiological attributes to provide overall semantic supervision. A multiple instance learning-based local alignment module associates spatial CT features with vascular-focused radiological keywords, to capture local imaging characteristics potentially associated with tumor invasion. The framework jointly optimizes classification and alignment objectives, while inference requires only CT images. Experiments included 1,593 pathologically confirmed nodules. On the test set, the proposed method achieved an accuracy of 87.92%, F1-score of 87.78%, and AUC of 0.9499. Its AUC significantly exceeded that of the image-only Res-CBAM baseline with the same visual backbone (0.9297; DeLong test, p = 0.0078). Ablation analyses supported the complementary contributions of global and local alignment and the benefit of report-based prompt initialization. Qualitative visualizations showed activation within nodules and adjacent vascular structures. These findings suggest that dual-granularity radiological supervision can enhance CT-based invasiveness prediction while preserving a CT-only inference workflow.

</details>


### [292] [Training-Time Domain Transfer for Generator-Free Diagnostics on Novel Modalities in Computational Pathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02931)
*Julia A. Mielcarz,Andrea Camilloni,Nita Mulliqi,Jessica A. Frank,Anders Blilie,Emilius A. M. Janssen,Martin Eklund,Kimmo Kartasalo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"训练时域迁移"以替代推理时虚拟染色：从常规存档样本合成目标域训练数据，直接在真实输入上诊断。以未染色前列腺组织病理为概念验证，其与传统H&E检测的一致性优于推理时虚拟染色（κ=0.59 vs 0.37；AC1=0.73 vs 0.29）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新成像模态有望改善诊断，但AI开发受训练数据稀缺制约；推理时域迁移虽可复用已有诊断模型，却带来幻觉风险、计算开销与监管复杂性。

Method: 借鉴sim-to-real迁移思想，提出训练时域迁移：由存档常规样本生成合成目标域训练数据，使模型可直接在真实目标域输入上推理，免除推理时生成步骤；以前列腺未染色组织病理为案例，与推理时虚拟染色、常规H&E癌症检测基准进行对比。

Result: 训练时迁移与常规基准的一致性高于虚拟染色：原始切片κ=0.59 vs 0.37，AC1=0.73 vs 0.29；去石蜡组织κ=0.66 vs 0.61，AC1=0.73 vs 0.64。

Conclusion: 训练时域迁移在新兴诊断模态上具备应用潜力，可规避推理时生成带来的幻觉与合规负担。

Abstract: Novel imaging modalities promise improved diagnostics, but AI development is constrained by scarce training data. Inference-time domain transfer can address this by mapping novel modalities to established ones, enabling reuse of existing diagnostic models. However, this introduces hallucination risks, computational overhead, and regulatory complexity. Inspired by sim-to-real transfer, we propose training-time domain transfer, generating synthetic target-domain training data from archived routine samples to enable direct diagnosis on real inputs without inference-time generation. Using unstained prostate histopathology as a proof-of-concept, we compare this approach with inference-time virtual staining and conventional H&E-based cancer detection. Training-time transfer achieved higher concordance with the conventional benchmark than virtual staining for both raw (Cohen's $κ$=0.59 vs. 0.37; Gwet's AC1=0.73 vs. 0.29) and deparaffinized tissue ($κ$=0.66 vs. 0.61; AC1=0.73 vs. 0.64), supporting its potential for emerging diagnostic modalities.

</details>


### [293] [Flat Features, Detailed Images? Simple Detail Control for Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02551)
*Qingtao Yu,Zhen Wang,Jiyang Zheng,Minghao Sun,Hongdong Li,Dylan Campbell*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文发现细节增强提示词会提升每个token能量分布的熵而基本保留其排序，据此提出免训练、仅需几行代码的连续细节控制方法（时间感知调度将token的通道幅值平方推向更高熵分布，集中在中间采样步干预）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提示词工程虽能促使文生图模型生成更细节丰富的图像，但无法提供可靠、连续、解耦的控制。作者希望找到一种可解释的内在机制，从而实现连续可控的细节调节。

Method: 在六种扩散Transformer上对比有/无细节增强提示词时产生的特征token，发现共同规律：提示词提升每个token能量分布的熵但基本保持排序（分布"变平"即细节增加）。基于此提出免训练方法：以标量控制细节程度，将各token的通道幅值平方按时间感知调度器向更高熵分布偏移，把干预集中在中间采样步。

Result: 在多种扩散Transformer上的大量实验表明，该方法可连续控制细节指标，同时基本保持图像质量与语义结构；实现仅需少量代码，推理时间开销可忽略。

Conclusion: 细节水平与token能量分布的熵存在可操作的对应关系，据此可实现简单、免训练、连续且低开销的细节控制，为文生图提供比提示词工程更可靠的细节调节手段。

Abstract: Prompt engineering is commonly used to encourage text-to-image models to generate more detailed images. However, it does not provide reliable, continuous, or disentangled control. We analyze feature tokens produced with and without detail-enhancing prompts across six diffusion transformers and observe a common pattern: these prompts tend to increase the entropy of each token's energy distribution while largely preserving its ordering. That is, flattening the distribution increases the level of detail. Motivated by this counter-intuitive finding, we introduce a simple training-free approach that continuously adjusts the level of detail according to a scalar. Specifically, it shifts the squared channel magnitudes of each token toward a higher entropy distribution with a time-aware scheduler to concentrate the intervention at intermediate sampling steps. Across extensive experiments on different types of diffusion transformers, we show that our approach provides continuous control over detail metrics while largely preserving image quality and semantic structure. It requires only a few lines of code and adds negligible inference time overhead.

</details>


### [294] [QFacePlacement: From Arbitrary Tensorization to Semantic Spatial Correspondence in Modern Face Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02505)
*Krishna Bhatia,Kavita Choudhary,Pruthwik Mishra,Praveen Kumar Chandaliya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文通过两个受控接口研究张量网络模型在人脸验证中的放置位置，发现量子启发式张量分解只有在接口提供了任务对齐的轴与可压缩结构时才可信，并强调AUC需与低FAR操作指标联合评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子启发式计算机视觉常将高维特征重塑为张量并使用张量网络模型，但现代人脸嵌入是为余弦相似度优化的，单纯张量化并不天然具备张量列（TT）或矩阵乘积算子（MPO）所需的低秩结构，因此需要系统研究模型应放置在何处。

Method: 构建两个受控接口：(1) 跨模型嵌入对齐，用512×512算子将AdaFace嵌入映射到ArcFace空间，对比稠密Ridge、Procrustes、确定性TT-SVD与MPO压缩（含基变换与低秩残差）；(2) 在全局池化之前，用局部AdaFace描述子构造7×7×7×7的probe-gallery对应张量，采用几何感知对称张量列（bond dimension 2）匹配器并与稠密线性匹配器对比。

Result: 在64K参数预算下，平均方向AUC：稠密Ridge 0.9297，rank-64 SVD 0.8952，最佳低秩MPO混合 0.8685，原始MPO约0.649。局部张量匹配器仅用122个可训练参数（稠密线性匹配器为2,403），LFW AUC达0.9802；但在CFP-FP上FAR=0.001时TAR仅0.0102（全局余弦为0.1734），CPLFW上为0.7805（全局余弦为0.8737）。

Conclusion: 量子启发式因子分解的可信度取决于所选接口是否提供任务对齐的轴和可压缩结构；压缩带来的参数效率与AUC提升不能替代低FAR操作性能，聚合AUC必须与操作级低FAR指标一并评估。

Abstract: Quantum-inspired computer vision often reshapes high-dimensional features into tensors and applies tensor-network models. In face verification, this can be misleading: modern embeddings are optimized for cosine similarity, and tensorization alone does not establish the low-rank structure needed for tensor trains or matrix-product operators (MPOs). We study model placement through two controlled interfaces. First, cross-model embedding alignment requires a 512 x 512 operator to map AdaFace embeddings into ArcFace space. Dense Ridge and Procrustes mappings remain strong, while deterministic TT-SVD and MPO compression underperform even with basis changes and low-rank residuals. At a 64K-parameter storage budget, mean directional AUC is 0.9297 for dense Ridge, 0.8952 for rank-64 SVD, 0.8685 for the best low-rank-MPO hybrid, and approximately 0.649 for raw MPO. Second, before global pooling, we construct a 7 x 7 x 7 x 7 probe-gallery correspondence tensor from local AdaFace descriptors. A geometry-aware symmetric tensor train with bond dimension 2 uses 122 trainable parameters, compared with 2,403 for a dense linear matcher, while attaining an LFW AUC of 0.9802. Yet compression does not translate into better low-false-acceptance performance: on CFP-FP, TAR at FAR = 0.001 is 0.0102 versus 0.1734 for global cosine matching, and on CPLFW it is 0.7805 versus 0.8737. These results suggest that quantum-inspired factorization is most credible when the chosen interface provides task-aligned axes and compressible structure. They also show why aggregate AUC must be assessed alongside operational low-FAR metrics.

</details>


### [295] [Fast-Slow Evolutionary Occupancy Prediction via Controlled Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02499)
*Runhe Yang,Zhiyuan Zhou,Yuxiang Yan,Xuetong Yang,Yikai Pan,Jiacheng Tang,Zhuolin He,Jianhua Han,Hang Xu,Jian Pu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EvoOcc：将快-慢双系统占用预测建模为连续时间受控动力系统，在不改变上游架构的前提下兼顾精度与延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D语义占用预测需同时满足高精度与低延迟。现有方法中，性能导向模型精度强但延迟高，部署友好模型延迟低但精度弱，二者特性互补；作者希望融合二者优势以改善精度-延迟折中，且不改动上游架构。

Method: 提出EvoOcc快-慢演化占用预测框架：把演化式占用预测建模为连续时间受控动力系统，可灵活适应慢系统可变延迟与快系统不规则到达；并将演化分解为双状态演化——自车状态演化补偿确定性坐标偏移，场景状态演化建模真实几何与语义变化。

Result: 在三种不同的快-慢系统组合及不规则预测到达情形下实验，EvoOcc一致优于快系统基线，同时延迟远低于慢系统，展现出良好的精度-延迟平衡与推理稳定性。

Conclusion: EvoOcc通过演化式融合快慢系统优势，在保持低延迟下提升精度，为实际部署中的占用预测提供了稳定且高效的折中方案。

Abstract: 3D semantic occupancy prediction provides dense geometric and semantic scene representations for autonomous driving, where both high accuracy and low response latency are crucial for safe downstream forecasting and planning. Existing methods usually exhibit different accuracy-latency characteristics. Performance-oriented models provide stronger geometric and semantic predictions, while deployment-friendly models provide faster responses. This motivates EvoOcc, a fast-slow evolutionary occupancy prediction framework that jointly exploits their complementary strengths to improve the accuracy-latency balance without changing the upstream architectures. EvoOcc models evolutionary occupancy prediction as a continuous time controlled dynamical system, enabling flexible adaptation to variable slow system delays and irregular fast system arrivals. The framework further decomposes the evolution process into dual state evolution where ego state evolution compensates for the deterministic coordinate shifts and scene state evolution models the genuine geometric and semantic scene changes. Extensive experiments on three different fast-slow system pairs and irregular prediction arrivals show that EvoOcc consistently improves over fast system baselines while maintaining much lower latency than the slow system, indicating a favorable accuracy-latency balance and stable behavior under practical inference situations.

</details>


### [296] [TERA: Task-Evidence Restoration for Underwater Object Detection under Bandwidth-Constrained Transmission](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02419)
*Heejin Kim,Joon-Seok Song,Eunil Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出受传输退化影响的水下目标检测基准AquaTX与元数据盲的接收端恢复框架TERA，在保持检测器冻结下显著提升mAP。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有水下目标检测器多在传输前图像上评测，忽略了带宽受限下的下采样与压缩带来的附加退化，缺乏对真实传输链路的感知评估。

Method: 构建基于真实水下检测数据集的受控基准AquaTX，区分可见编解码器与留出编解码器；提出TERA，一种元数据盲的接收端框架，结合任务引导的像素级复原与双状态特征校正，且检测器保持冻结。

Result: 在可见复合退化下，TERA将mAP50:95从37.7提升至50.0（DUO-TX）、从31.5提升至41.3（RUOD-TX）；同时保持干净输入性能，并在留出的AVIF编解码器下与检测器微调相当。

Conclusion: 结果支持传输感知评测范式与任务引导复原在水下目标检测中的有效性。

Abstract: Underwater object detectors are typically evaluated on pre-transmission images, overlooking additional degradation from bandwidth-constrained downscaling and compression. We introduce AquaTX, a controlled benchmark built from real underwater detection datasets with seen and held-out codecs. We also propose TERA, a metadata-blind receiver-side framework combining task-guided pixel restoration and dual-state feature correction while keeping the detector frozen. Under seen compound degradation, TERA improves mean average precision (mAP50:95, averaged over IoU thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95) from 37.7 to 50.0 on DUO-TX and from 31.5 to 41.3 on RUOD-TX relative to the frozen detector without restoration. TERA also preserves clean-input performance and remains competitive with detector fine-tuning under the held-out AVIF codec. These findings support transmission-aware evaluation and task-guided restoration for underwater object detection. Code is available at https://github.com/hijinkim/TERA.

</details>


### [297] [Forecasting Earth Surface Change in Embedding Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02211)
*Jingtao Li,Sadiq Jaffer,Anil Madhavapeddy,Pedro Sousa,Anthony Ortiz,Kyle Gao,Zhengpeng Feng,Yanfei Zhong,Kevin White,Srinivasan Keshav*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出在嵌入空间（而非光谱值）进行遥感时间序列预测的 E²Forecast，利用双分支 Transformer 同时输出点预测与集合预测，显著提升精度与不确定性校准，并支持无监督异常/变化检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有卫星时间序列研究多在像素级预测未来日期的光谱值，但云、阴影与传感器噪声常污染观测，使光谱预测器把大量容量浪费在低层特征与噪声上，而非真实变化。随着地球基础模型（Earth foundation models）出现，作者主张在嵌入空间预测更可行且更有效。

Method: 设计可处理来自不同传感器与基础模型的不规则历史序列、并支持任意查询日期预测的 token 空间；将其输入 E²Forecast——一个双分支 Transformer：高斯分支直接预测均值点预测及逐维标准差，rectified-flow 分支生成预测集合。此外通过比较新观测与预测实现无标签、免重训的异常变化检测。

Result: 在 Sentinel-1 与 Sentinel-2 基准上，预测嵌入相较预测光谱值将余弦距离减半（0.20→0.10），并大幅降低过度自信（z-score 标准差 2.63→1.22）；在全球变化检测基准上，F₁ 由 41.58 提升至 48.70。结论在九个遥感基础模型上一致得到验证。

Conclusion: 在嵌入空间预测优于光谱空间预测，兼具精度与不确定性校准优势，并可扩展至无监督变化检测；该方法还可支持多样化预训练任务头的有效复用，代码已开源。

Abstract: Repeated satellite imagery permits understanding of how our planet changes over time, letting us predict its future and plan mitigating actions. Most existing studies that rely on a time series of satellite observations forecast the spectral values at each pixel for a future target date. However, clouds, shadows, and sensor noise often corrupt these observations, so that spectral forecasters waste much of their capacity on low-level features or noise rather than real change. With the advent of Earth foundation models, we argue that forecasting in embedding space is a feasible and more effective alternative. To this end, we design a token space that handles irregular histories from different sensors and foundation models and supports forecasts at any query date. Tokens from this space are inputs to our proposed forecaster, E$^2$Forecast, which is a transformer with two branches: a Gaussian branch that directly predicts a mean point forecast and per-dimension standard deviations, and a rectified-flow branch that generates forecast ensembles. On Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 benchmarks, forecasting embeddings instead of spectral values halves the cosine distance (from 0.20 to 0.10) and greatly reduces overconfidence, lowering the z-score standard deviation from 2.63 to 1.22. By comparing new observations with its forecasts, E$^2$Forecast can also detect anomalous changes without labels or retraining, raising F$_1$ from 41.58 to 48.70 on a global benchmark. This consistent superiority is validated on nine remote sensing foundation models. Beyond change detection, we believe our approach advances the field by permitting effective reuse of diverse pretrained task heads. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/ucam-eo/e2forecast.

</details>


### [298] [Refining Roadside 4D Radar Vehicle Classification Using Point-Cloud Dispersion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02147)
*Mohammed Alsakabi,Andreia Figueiredo,António Almeida,John Dolan,Miguel Luís,Pedro Rito,Ozan Tonguz,Susana Sargento*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出4D雷达与立体深度相机同步采集的路侧多传感器平台并构建真实数据集；发现两模态间显著类别分布差异（雷达对乘用车与摩托车高度混淆），进而提出基于时域平滑的雷达点云簇二维位置标准差、采用Neyman-Pearson准则的二分类器，将分类误差由52.1%降至42.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 路侧感知中，相机与传统传感器在探测距离、恶劣天气鲁棒性和深度精度上受限；4D雷达虽能在恶劣条件下解析距离、方位、俯仰与径向速度，但其点云稀疏且噪声大，可靠分类困难。

Method: 搭建4D雷达与立体深度相机同步采集的路侧多传感器平台并采集真实数据集；分析两模态类别分布差异；提出对雷达点云簇的时域平滑二维位置标准差建模，并基于Neyman-Pearson准则构建轻量二分类器。

Result: 揭示显著的模态间类别分布差异，其中雷达对乘用车与摩托车的混淆最强（分别占数据集的49.01%与48.60%）；所提方法将分类误差从52.1%降低至42.7%，且可边缘部署。

Conclusion: 该轻量化、可边缘部署的方法提升了纯雷达分类的可靠性，并为后续相机-雷达融合奠定基础。

Abstract: Roadside sensing infrastructure is essential for Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), but cameras and legacy sensors are limited in range, weather robustness, and depth accuracy. 4D radar complements these modalities by resolving range, azimuth, elevation, and radial velocity under adverse conditions, though its sparse, noisy point clouds make reliable classification difficult. We present a roadside multi-sensor platform combining a 4D radar and stereo depth camera under synchronized acquisition, used to collect a real-world dataset. Our analysis reveals a substantial class-distribution discrepancy between modalities, most notably a strong radar confusion between passenger cars and motorcycles (49.01% and\ 48.60% of the dataset). To address this, we propose a Neyman-Pearson-based binary classifier on the temporally-smoothed 2D positional standard deviation of radar point cloud clusters, reducing classification error from 52.1% to 42.7%. This lightweight and edge-deployable approach improves radar-only classification reliability and lays the foundation for future camera-radar fusion.

</details>


### [299] [Learning to Look: A Foundation for Visual Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02053)
*Wenshuai Zhao,Yihao Wang,Benjamin Robson,Juho Kannala,Arno Solin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 LOOK 任务，检验VLM在理解图像语义前是否知晓自身可见的视觉输入区域，并以自监督方式构建该任务；实验表明现有VLM无法定位可见区域，而在LOOK任务上微调可提升模型对视觉输入的感知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM存在视觉幻觉（如描述图中不存在的物体）。作者提出更根本的问题：模型在理解语义之前，是否意识到自己"看的是哪里"，即能否定位其视觉输入中实际可用的区域。

Method: 将问题形式化为LOOK任务：识别视觉输入中被模型可见的部分；该任务以自监督方式构建，无需人工标注可见区域；并在此基础上对VLM进行微调。

Result: 实验显示现有VLM无法定位可见区域（在该任务上失败）；在LOOK任务上微调后，模型对视觉输入的感知能力得到提升。

Conclusion: VLM缺乏对自身视觉输入可用范围的自我感知，这与视觉幻觉相关；通过自监督LOOK任务微调可增强这种感知，为缓解视觉幻觉提供新方向。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) suffer from visual hallucination, such as saying an object that is not present in an image. We ask a more fundamental question: whether a VLM is even aware of where it is looking before understanding the semantic meaning in the image. We formulate this question as a LOOK task: identifying which parts of its visual input were available to the model. We construct the task in a self-supervised way without manually labeling the available region to the model. Our experiments show that existing VLMs fail to localize the visible region. We further show that fine-tuning VLMs on the proposed LOOK task improves a model's awareness of visual input.

</details>


### [300] [MoviEdit: Long-form Multi-Shot Video Editing Made Easy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02737)
*Suhyeon Lee,Zhengang Li,Soo Ye Kim,Peihao Zhu,Jong Chul Ye,Chun-Hao Paul Huang,Duygu Ceylan,Yan Kang,Hyeonho Jeong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MoviEdit，一个面向长时多镜头视频编辑的端到端框架，同时解决数据、建模与评测三方面挑战：构建87K配对编辑数据、采用级联双向-自回归架构、并发布MoviEdit-Bench基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时多镜头视频编辑需在场景、视角与主体外观突变时保持编辑意图的跨镜头一致性，且处理远超单镜头编辑器的视觉上下文长度；现有工作缺乏规模化跨镜头监督数据、可扩展建模方案与系统评测基准。

Method: 数据：构建覆盖同步多视角素材、真实多镜头视频与生成式多镜头内容的自动数据生成流水线，产出87K无人工标注的配对编辑视频。架构：级联式双向-自回归设计——轻量双向阶段先在时空压缩表征上建立全局一致的编辑草稿，再在完整视频上自回归传播与精修。评测：提出MoviEdit-Bench专用基准。

Result: 在文本引导与图像引导编辑任务上，MoviEdit显著优于现有开源模型，并与业界前沿模型表现相当。

Conclusion: 通过数据、架构与评测的协同设计，可有效实现可扩展的长时多镜头视频编辑，并为该方向提供公开基准与项目资源。

Abstract: Long-form multi-shot video editing requires an intended edit to remain coherent across abrupt changes in scene, viewpoint, and subject appearance, while processing substantially longer visual context than conventional single-shot editors. We introduce MoviEdit, an end-to-end framework for scalable long-form multi-shot video editing that jointly addresses the challenges of data, modeling, and evaluation. To provide cross-shot supervision data at scale, we develop automatic data-generation pipelines spanning synchronized multi-view footage, real-world multi-shot videos, and generated multi-shot content, yielding 87K paired editing videos without manual annotation. Architecturally, MoviEdit employs a cascaded bidirectional-autoregressive design: a lightweight bidirectional stage first establishes a globally coherent editing draft over a spatiotemporally compressed representation, which is then autoregressively propagated and refined over the full video. We further introduce MoviEdit-Bench, a dedicated benchmark for systematic evaluation of long-form multi-shot video editing. Extensive experiments show that MoviEdit substantially outperforms existing open-source models and performs on par with industry frontier models across text-guided and image-guided editing. Visit our project page for complete results and to access the benchmark: https://multi-shot-edit.github.io/

</details>


### [301] [TaoMate-HD: Progressive-Resolution Autoregressive Audio-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03394)
*Qijun Gan,Chenwei Zhang,Xinyang Li,Meiguang Jin,Junfeng Ma,Shen Qiu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TaoMate-HD：面向高分辨率音视频流式生成的自回归模型，采用低分辨率粗结构两步去噪+高分辨率精修一步的三段式分块方案，并以跨文本更新的历史保留与续接训练（非对称文本条件）减少重复/中断语音，实现1.6×去噪加速、1.9×并行部署加速及CER降低11.18个百分点，支持小时级生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式数字人需在新文本到达时持续生成高分辨率音视频，但高分辨率去噪代价高昂；且文本更新易导致语音重复或中断，需要模型推断已说内容以平滑续接。

Method: 按短chunk自回归生成：每chunk先用两个去噪步在低分辨率建立粗结构，再以最终一步精修至高清，音频沿同一轨迹全程生成；各阶段将音视频预测作为下一chunk同阶段的历史传递；跨文本更新保留历史以推断已说内容；续接训练采用非对称文本条件，为生成与蒸馏设置独立文本窗口。

Result: 同模型同硬件下相较直接高分辨率生成提速1.6×；阶段并行部署在串行渐进生成基础上再获1.9×端到端加速；续接训练使字符错误率相对基线下降11.18个百分点；支持小时级音视频生成。

Conclusion: 通过分阶段分辨率渐进去噪、跨chunk历史传递与续接训练，可在保证高清画质的同时显著降低流式数字人生成的算力开销并提升语音连续性，具备长时生成能力。

Abstract: Streaming digital humans produce detailed video while continuing speech as new text arrives. High-resolution denoising is costly, and text updates can cause repeated or interrupted speech. We present TaoMate-HD, an autoregressive model for high-resolution audio-video streaming. For each short segment, or chunk, two denoising steps establish coarse video structure at low resolution. A final step refines the video to high resolution, with audio generated throughout the same trajectory. Each stage passes its audiovisual predictions to the same stage of the next chunk as history. Across text updates, the model retains this history to infer what has already been spoken. Continuation training utilizes asymmetric text conditioning, with separate text windows for generation and distillation. Experiments show a 1.6x speedup over direct high-resolution generation with the same model and hardware. Optimized stage-parallel deployment provides a further 1.9x overall speedup over serial progressive generation. Our continuation training reduces character error rate by 11.18 percentage points relative to the baseline. The model also supports hour-long audiovisual generation. Our project page is https://taoliveaigc.github.io/TaoMate-HD.

</details>


### [302] [ArabGeoText: Tool-Augmented Vision-Language Models for Arabic Geospatial Text Spotting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03339)
*Yakoub Bazi,Sarah Alsaleh,Mohamad M. Al Rahhal,Mohamed A. Mekhtiche,Mansour Zuair*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出阿拉伯语地理空间文本检测识别基准 ARABGEOTEXT（利雅得与吉达 970 个地点、每类视图 17,875 个标注实例），并提出"YOLO26 定位+裁剪矫正 + LoRA 微调 Qwen3.5-4B 识别"的工具增强视觉语言框架，在 OSM 与遥感叠加两种视图及跨城评估中优于直接 LoRA 微调的 Qwen3.5-4B spotting。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地理空间文本（道路名、区名、地标）常尺寸小、密集排布、任意朝向；阿拉伯语文本识别在文档与自然场景已有大量研究，但阿拉伯语地理空间文本 spotting 研究稀少，且缺乏专门基准，导致该类任务的检测、识别与端到端评估无法系统开展。

Method: 构建 ARABGEOTEXT：覆盖利雅得与吉达 970 个地理位置的成对视图——OSM 渲染图与其叠加在对应遥感影像上的合成图，两者保持标签内容与像素几何一致，从而可在不同背景下评估；按地理分区支持城内与跨城（city-disjoint）的检测、识别、端到端评估。方法上先做直接 Qwen3.5-4B spotting 实验，发现单瓦片内难以召回全部标签，遂提出工具增强框架：YOLO26 负责定位并做裁剪矫正，Qwen3.5-4B 经 LoRA 适配后负责识别。

Result: 直接 Qwen3.5-4B spotting 难以恢复瓦片内全部标签；所提工具增强框架在两种图像视图和两个测试城市上均优于直接 LoRA 微调的 Qwen3.5-4B spotting；在定位固定的条件下，reader 的 LoRA 适配相较预训练零样本 reader 进一步提升了识别性能。

Conclusion: 阿拉伯语地理空间文本 spotting 是一个独特且具挑战性的任务，分解为"定位+识别"的工具增强范式配合轻量适配更为有效；ARABGEOTEXT 及其地理分区协议为后续研究提供了可复现的评估基础，数据与代码将公开。

Abstract: Geospatial text spotting involves locating and transcribing geographic labels, such as road names, district names, and landmarks, in raster maps. These labels are often small, densely arranged, and arbitrarily oriented. Although Arabic text recognition has been studied extensively in documents and natural scenes, Arabic geospatial text spotting remains underexplored. We introduce ARABGEOTEXT, an Arabic-centric benchmark covering 970 geographic locations in Riyadh and Jeddah, with 17,875 manually annotated text instances per view type. For each location, we pair an OpenStreetMap (OSM) rendering with a composite created by overlaying that rendering on the corresponding remote sensing (RS) imagery. The paired views preserve label content and pixel geometry, allowing evaluation across different backgrounds. Geographic partitions support in-city and city-disjoint evaluation of detection, recognition, and end-to-end spotting. Experiments with direct Qwen3.5-4B spotting show difficulties in recovering all labels within a tile. We therefore propose a tool-augmented vision-language framework that combines YOLO26 localization and crop rectification with Qwen3.5-4B recognition adapted through low-rank adaptation (LoRA). The framework outperforms direct LoRA-adapted Qwen3.5-4B spotting across both image views and test cities. With localization held fixed, reader adaptation further improves recognition over the pretrained zero-shot reader. The dataset and code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/yakoubbazi/ArabGeoText.

</details>


### [303] [CL3DOD: Understanding the Stability-Plasticity Dilemma in Outdoor Class-Incremental 3D Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03229)
*Muhammad Ahmed Ullah Khan,Khalil Ahmed,Didier Stricker,Muhammad Zeshan Afzal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 首个跨KITTI与nuScenes多基准的室外类增量3D检测统一分析，提出CL3DOD框架，通过伪标签恢复旧类监督、查询级知识蒸馏与EMA时序一致性，缓解稳定性-可塑性困境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 室外3D目标检测的类增量学习（CIL）研究不足，现有工作仅在单一基准上评估（SDCoT++用KITTI、CL2OD用nuScenes，且增量设定不同），无法判断持续学习行为能否跨自动驾驶基准泛化。

Method: 构建统一的跨基准分析，覆盖两任务与多阶段增量设定；提出CL3DOD框架：用上一阶段检测器的预测为旧类恢复缺失监督，通过查询级知识蒸馏保留旧类响应，并引入基于EMA的时序一致性正则化。

Result: 在KITTI与nuScenes上均观察到一致的稳定性-可塑性困境；CL3DOD相比受控增量基线实现更优的稳定性-可塑性平衡，并在已报告的基准比较中优于现有方法；该优势在多增量阶段中保持，旧知识保留与新类获取均有效。

Conclusion: 室外类增量3D检测存在跨基准一致的稳定性-可塑性困境，CL3DOD可有效缓解；代码、评测设置与增量任务划分将公开。

Abstract: Class-incremental learning (CIL) for outdoor 3D object detection remains largely underexplored. Existing outdoor studies are limited to single-benchmark evaluations, with SDCoT++ considering KITTI and CL2OD considering nuScenes under different incremental settings. This makes it difficult to assess whether observed continual-learning behavior generalizes across autonomous-driving benchmarks. To the best of our knowledge, we provide the first unified cross-benchmark analysis of outdoor class-incremental 3D object detection across multiple autonomous-driving benchmarks, covering both two-task and multi-stage settings. We investigate: (1) how severely existing 3D detectors forget previously learned classes, (2) how incremental training exposes the stability-plasticity dilemma between knowledge retention and new-class acquisition, and (3) which forms of supervision are most effective for balancing these objectives. We introduce CL3DOD, a class-incremental 3D detection framework that restores missing supervision for previous classes using predictions from the previous-stage detector, preserves old-class responses through query-wise knowledge distillation, and employs EMA-based temporal consistency regularization. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes reveal a consistent stability-plasticity dilemma across both benchmarks. CL3DOD generally achieves a more favorable stability-plasticity balance than controlled incremental baselines and improves upon published prior methods in the reported benchmark comparisons. This advantage persists across multiple incremental stages, demonstrating strong retention of previously learned knowledge while maintaining effective new-class acquisition. Our code, evaluation setup, and incremental task splits will be publicly released.

</details>


### [304] [AnchorComplete: Recovering Complete Scene Meshes from Partial Point Clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03228)
*Weirong Chen,Ismail El-Yamany,Ganlin Zhang,Chuanxia Zheng,Andrea Vedaldi,Daniel Cremers*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AnchorComplete 提出一种从部分点云重建完整场景网格的框架，在保留已观测几何的同时补全未观测区域，并支持多尺度场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于图像的三维重建方法主要恢复可见表面，生成的点云残缺、空洞大，未观测几何无法解析。论文旨在从部分点云恢复完整场景网格，同时保留原始观测几何。

Method: 基于 TRELLIS.2，采用两项核心设计：(1) 部分点条件化，将全局场景 token 与局部空间证据结合，把生成锚定到输入；(2) 度量尺度粗到细生成，在固定尺寸窗口内渐进细化几何，同时保持全局结构一致性。

Result: 在 Replica 与 SCRREAM 数据集上，完整场景重建性能一致优于强基线，尤其在稀疏视角设置下优势明显。

Conclusion: AnchorComplete 可在多尺度场景中实现保留观测几何的完整场景网格重建，验证了部分点条件化与固定窗口粗到细细化策略的有效性。

Abstract: Most image-based 3D reconstructors primarily recover visible surfaces, producing partial point clouds with large holes and leaving unobserved geometry unresolved. To address this limitation, we introduce AnchorComplete, a framework that reconstructs complete scene meshes from partial point clouds while preserving observed geometry and supporting scenes of varying scales. Building on TRELLIS.2, our method combines partial-point conditioning, which integrates global scene tokens with local spatial evidence to anchor generation to the input, and metric-scale coarse-to-fine generation, which progressively refines scene geometry within fixed-size windows while maintaining global structural consistency. Experiments on Replica and SCRREAM demonstrate that AnchorComplete consistently outperforms strong baselines in complete-scene reconstruction, particularly under sparse-view settings.

</details>


### [305] [3D-BBDA: Backpropagation-Free Black-Box Domain Adaptation for Robust 3D Point Cloud Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03588)
*Shivangi Rai,Kunal Jangid,Vaibhav Kumar,Vinod K Kurmi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 3D-BBDA是一个无需反向传播的黑盒域自适应框架，仅利用源模型输出即可将3D点云分类器适配到无标签目标域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D点云分类器在传感器变化、环境差异和采集伪影导致的域偏移下性能下降，而现有自适应方法常需访问源数据或源模型内部参数，受隐私、许可与安全约束难以落地。

Method: 采用伪标签引导的原型对齐，并用加权预测模块融合源logits与对齐logits以降低伪标签噪声敏感性；针对伪标签覆盖不完整，从无标签目标预测构建高斯扰动原型先验，作为缺失或不可靠类原型的回退。

Result: 在四个损坏3D基准上稳定优于强基线；ModelNet-40C上平均错误率32.08%（PointNet）与29.62%（GDANet），优于Source-only（35.88%/34.03%）与BFTT3D（33.78%/32.36%）。

Conclusion: 方法仅需单次前向、无梯度更新，适合实时且隐私保护的可迁移3D识别流水线部署。

Abstract: Robust 3D point-cloud recognition is critical for robotics, mapping, and urban sensing, yet point-cloud classifiers often suffer performance drops under domain shifts caused by sensor changes, environmental variation, and acquisition artifacts. Many existing adaptation methods are difficult to deploy in practice because they require access to source data or the internal parameters of the source model, which may be restricted by privacy, licensing, or security constraints. We present 3D-BBDA, a backpropagation-free black-box domain adaptation framework that adapts a source-trained predictor to unlabeled target data using only black-box outputs. Our method performs pseudo-label guided prototype-based alignment and employs a weighted prediction module to fuse source logits with alignment logits, reducing sensitivity to noisy pseudo-labels. To stabilize prototype memory when pseudo-label coverage is incomplete, we construct a Gaussian-perturbed prototype prior from unlabeled target predictions and use it as a fallback for missing or unreliable class prototypes during alignment. Experiments on four corrupted 3D benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines. On ModelNet-40C, 3D-BBDA achieves mean errors of 32.08% (PointNet) and 29.62% (GDANet), outperforming Source-only (35.88% / 34.03%) and BFTT3D (33.78% / 32.36%). 3D-BBDA requires only a single forward pass with no gradient updates making it suitable for real-time, privacy-preserving deployment in transferable 3D recognition pipelines. Project page is available at https://visdomlab.github.io/3D_BBDA

</details>


### [306] [Bg-Mix: On Using Image Backgrounds for Data Augmentation in Electron Microscopy Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03455)
*Ankur Srivastava,Joana Sarah Grah,Katharina Ladewig,Nils Körber*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Bg-Mix 背景混合作数据增强方法，通过将训练图像分解为前景物体与背景并重组成新图像，缓解电镜病毒数据集小、标注稀疏的问题，提升目标检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电镜是病毒学中可视化病毒颗粒的重要手段，但计算机辅助分析受限于典型电镜病毒数据集规模小、标注稀疏，难以训练现成深度学习模型。为克服数据不足并利用内容丰富、多样的样本背景，作者采用基于背景的数据增强。

Method: 提出 Bg-Mix 数据增强：将训练图像分解为前景目标与背景，再将二者重新组合生成新的增强图像，从而扩充训练数据多样性并提升目标检测模型性能。

Result: 在两组数据集、两种架构上测试，Bg-Mix 相比基线在边框平均精度（box mAP）上提升 +0.8 至 +3.3 个点，验证了其有效性。

Conclusion: Bg-Mix 是一种简单有效、面向小样本稀疏标注电镜病毒图像的数据增强方案，能显著提升目标检测精度并增加训练数据多样性。

Abstract: Electron microscopy (EM) serves as a cornerstone in virology enabling the visualization of viral particles and is widely used in research, diagnostics and morphological characterization of pathogens. Computer-assisted image analysis can help facilitate and speed up this labor-intensive method, however, typical EM virus datasets are small and sparsely labeled, resulting in a lack of readily available deep learning models due to training limitations. To overcome data shortages and leverage content-rich, diverse sample backgrounds, we employed background-based data augmentation. To this end, we propose Bg-Mix, a form of data augmentation method, which decomposes training images into foreground objects and backgrounds and subsequently rearranges both into novel augmented images. This not only enhances the performance of object detection models but also increases the diversity of the training data. Using Bg-Mix provides an increase between +0.8 and +3.3 box mean average precision (mAP) points over the baseline when tested across two datasets using two architectures, thereby demonstrating its effectiveness.

</details>


### [307] [VidDub: Replacement-Aware Distillation for Two-Step Video Dubbing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03404)
*Yexin Liu,Yunlong Lin,Zehan Wang,Guangxin He,Xinli Xu,Jiajun Zha,Yaofu Liu,Yueze Wang,Bowen Ping,Yuanming Li,Amie Wang,Bernard Ghanem,Bing Li,Harry Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出替换感知的跨音频监督与两步行扩散编辑器 VidDub，解决视频配音中源嘴部重建与目标语音冲突的问题，实现强唇同步与高质量视觉生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频配音编辑器在原始配对音频下做自重建训练，当驱动语音被替换时，源嘴部成为冲突目标，模型会被迫回归到错误的口型。同时离线配音场景可预先获得完整源视频与目标语音，具备全上下文建模的条件，但现有方法未充分利用。

Method: 提出替换感知的跨音频监督：配对音频样本做全帧重建；非配对替换音频样本则屏蔽源嘴部重建损失，仅通过音视频同步约束监督嘴部，同时保留未遮罩的面部区域与背景。基于全上下文扩散编辑器 VidDub，先训练替换感知教师模型获得准确唇同步，再用匹配轨迹回归将 CFG 引导轨迹蒸馏到两步学生模型（2 NFE），最后用分布匹配蒸馏恢复压缩后的视觉质量。

Result: 三个训练种子下，屏蔽冲突源嘴重建使跨音频 Sync-C 提升 0.833；最终两步模型在四个基准上兼具强唇同步、更优视觉质量、身份保持与视觉语音识别性能。

Conclusion: 替换感知监督有效避免冲突目标回归，是跨音频配音训练的关键；结合轨迹匹配与分布匹配的两步蒸馏可在极低 NFE 下保持同步与画质。作者将发布 VidDub-Bench 数据集、配对/跨音频评测清单、预处理输出与统一评测代码。

Abstract: Video dubbing aims to synthesize lip movements that match target speech while preserving the speaker identity, head pose, and background of a source video. Existing editors are predominantly trained via self-reconstruction under original paired audio, even though the source mouth becomes a conflicting target when driving speech is replaced. We introduce replacement-aware cross-audio supervision: paired-audio samples use full-frame reconstruction, whereas unpaired replacement-audio samples mask out source-mouth reconstruction losses and supervise the mouth solely through audio-visual synchronization while preserving unmasked facial regions and background. Because offline dubbing provides the complete source video and target speech beforehand, we present VidDub, a full-context diffusion editor distilled into two denoising steps (2 NFE). Our replacement-aware teacher first learns accurate lip synchronization without regressing toward conflicting source mouth movements. Matched trajectory regression then transfers the teacher's CFG-guided trajectories to a two-step student, and distribution matching distillation recovers visual quality after step compression. We will release the curated training dataset, VidDub-Bench, fixed paired- and cross-audio evaluation manifests, preprocessing outputs, and unified evaluation code. Across three training seeds, masking out conflicting source-mouth reconstruction improves cross-audio Sync-C by 0.833; the final two-step model combines strong lip synchronization with superior visual quality, identity preservation, and visual speech recognition across four benchmarks.

</details>


### [308] [R$^2$-Omni: Reducing Structural and Precision Redundancy in Omni-LLMs for Long-Form Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03247)
*Bolong Feng,Pengfei Zhou,Zhenglin Wan,Wei Wang,Wangbo Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练框架 R²-Omni，通过结构感知 token 合并（STC）与语义敏感度引导的精度分配（SSPA），协同压缩 Omni-LLM 音视频 KV 缓存中的结构冗余与精度冗余，实现长文本生成场景下的高效推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Omni-LLM 处理大量音视频多模态 token，KV 缓存带来高昂计算与内存开销。激进 token 剪枝在多选题上表现尚可，但在开放式长文本生成时质量显著下降——原因是 query 引导的选择只保留"答题所需证据"而丢弃生成所需的细节。同时，保留下来的表示仍存在数值精度上的冗余。
