Method: 免训练框架，包含两级冗余削减：(1) Structure-Aware Token Consolidation (STC)：利用视频的时空相似性与音频的局部连续性，合并冗余表征，降低跨 token 的重叠信息并保留内容多样性；(2) Semantic-Sensitivity Guided Precision Allocation (SSPA)：依据量化 key 下注意力输出误差的估计降幅，为保留表征分配 value 精度，并以 query 注意力与音视频对齐作为语义先验。

Result: 在长文本生成基准上，平均内存占用降低 5.0×，保留 97.98% 的基线生成质量，端到端加速 1.48×。

Conclusion: 结构冗余与精度冗余的联合削减优于单一维度压缩，可在几乎不损失开放式生成质量的前提下显著降低 Omni-LLM 的内存与计算开销。

Abstract: Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) typically process large numbers of multimodal tokens from audio-visual inputs, incurring substantial computational costs and a large memory footprint for the key-value (KV) cache. Aggressive token pruning can alleviate this problem while maintaining competitive performance on multiple-choice tasks, which require only a single option as output. However, we observe substantial quality degradation when generating long-form, open-ended responses. We attribute this gap to query-guided selection, which can retain sufficient evidence for answer selection while discarding details needed for comprehensive generation. This motivates reducing overlapping information across tokens, termed structural redundancy, while preserving diverse content. However, the retained representations may still contain precision redundancy due to unnecessarily high numerical precision in their cached values. To address these two levels of redundancy in token representations, we introduce a training-free framework named R$^2$-Omni. First, Structure-Aware Token Consolidation (STC) consolidates redundant representations using spatiotemporal similarity in video and local continuity in audio. Then, Semantic-Sensitivity Guided Precision Allocation (SSPA) allocates value precision to the retained representations according to the estimated reduction in attention-output error under quantized keys, with query attention and audio-visual alignment providing a semantic prior. Extensive experiments on long-form generation benchmarks demonstrate an average 5.0$\times$ reduction in the memory footprint while preserving 97.98% of baseline generation quality and achieving a 1.48$\times$ end-to-end speedup, highlighting the benefits of jointly reducing structural and precision redundancy.

</details>


### [309] [MoSoLoco: Monocular 3D Human Localization through Visual Latent Features and Social Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03189)
*Yasamin Borhani,Javad Khoramdel,Yang Gao,Po-Chien Luan,Alexandre Alahi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MoSoLoco：一种逐帧单目3D人体定位器，复用姿态检测器内部视觉特征并结合检测到的2D骨架，无需额外RGB或深度编码器，且可利用同帧稀疏多人上下文修正位置，在JRDB/NuScenes上优于关键点基线并可在Jetson AGX Xavier高效推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人导航与运动预测需要单目相机估计人的度量3D位置；轻量级基于姿态的定位器依赖紧凑2D关键点、计算开销低，但通常丢弃姿态估计器已计算出的更丰富视觉表示，信息利用不足。

Method: MoSoLoco为逐帧单目3D人体定位方法：将姿态检测器的内部视觉特征与检测到的2D骨架融合，不引入额外RGB或深度编码器；并设计稀疏社会交互模块，融合同一帧内邻近人体检测以精化个体位置估计。

Result: 在JRDB与NuScenes上，复用姿态检测器表示改善了定位效果，JRDB最佳误差相对最强关键点基线降低约23%；稀疏社会交互模块进一步精化；受控轨迹预测实验显示下游收益；完整流程可在Jetson AGX Xavier上高效推理。

Conclusion: 复用姿态检测器内部特征是提升轻量单目3D人体定位的有效途径，且稀疏同帧多人上下文可进一步增益，同时保持硬件部署效率，对机器人应用具有实用价值。

Abstract: Estimating the metric 3D position of people from a monocular camera is important for robot navigation and motion prediction. Lightweight pose-based localizers are attractive for robotic hardware with limited computational resources because they operate on compact 2D keypoints. However, they typically discard the richer visual representations computed by the pose estimator. We introduce MoSoLoco, a per-frame monocular 3D human localizer that combines the pose detector's internal visual features with the detected 2D skeleton, without requiring an additional RGB or depth encoder. MoSoLoco can further incorporate sparse same-frame multi-person context to refine individual position estimates. Experiments on JRDB and NuScenes show that reusing pose-detector representations improves localization, reducing the best JRDB error by approximately 23 percent relative to the strongest evaluated keypoint-based baseline. A sparse social-interaction module incorporates nearby detections from the same image for further refinement. Controlled trajectory-forecasting experiments show downstream benefits, while the complete pipeline remains suitable for efficient Jetson AGX Xavier inference.

</details>


### [310] [EgoActionBench: Benchmarking Dense Action Captioning for Egocentric Human Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03646)
*Yujiao Shen,Jiahe Song,Haitian Li,Jingkang Yang,Ziwei Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 EgoActionBench 基准，将第一视角连续操作拆解为与左手/右手/双手关联的时间定位原子动作，并设计稠密预测评测协议与训练方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从人类数据学习是通向具身智能的可扩展路径，但需要模型从第一视角观测中准确理解细粒度人类动作；现有基准在动作原子性、时间精度和手—动作关联三方面存在不足。

Method: 构建 EgoActionBench：1,407 个片段、41,132 条人工精修动作标注，标注为带时间定位、关联左手/右手/双手的原子动作。提出评测协议：先检索时间上合法的候选，再按内容一致性选定预测，并同时计算语义保真度、时间重叠度以及动作精确率/召回率。基准测试 20 个基线模型与系统；并对 Qwen3-VL-4B 与 LLaVA-OneVision-2-8B 两个骨干先监督微调、后在自动标注训练片段上做强化学习。

Result: EgoAction 训练使两骨干的 EgoActionScore 分别提升 15.9 与 23.2 分，且两个适配模型均优于所有开源基线；实验显示当前模型在动作原子性、时间精度和手—动作关联上存在显著局限。

Conclusion: 现有模型在细粒度第一视角动作理解上仍远未满足具身智能需求，EgoActionBench 揭示了通用视频理解与具身所需动作理解之间的差距，并提供可用的评测与训练范式。

Abstract: Learning from human data offers a scalable path toward embodied intelligence, yet it requires models to accurately understand fine-grained human actions from egocentric observations. However, existing benchmarks remain limited in action atomicity, temporal precision, and hand-action association. We introduce EgoActionBench, a benchmark that represents continuous human manipulation as temporally localized atomic actions associated with the left hand, right hand, or both hands. EgoActionBench contains 1,407 episodes with 41,132 human-refined action annotations. To evaluate such dense predictions, we propose an evaluation protocol that retrieves temporally eligible candidates, selects a prediction by content agreement, and scores semantic fidelity and temporal overlap alongside action precision and recall, jointly capturing what happens, when it happens, and which hand performs it. We benchmark 20 baseline models and systems on EgoActionBench and further adapt two backbones, Qwen3-VL-4B and LLaVA-OneVision-2-8B, through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning on automatically annotated training episodes. EgoAction improves EgoActionScore by 15.9 and 23.2 points on the two backbones, and both adapted models outperform all open-source baselines. Our experiments reveal substantial limitations of current models in action atomicity, temporal precision, and hand-action association, highlighting the gap between general video understanding and the action understanding required for embodied intelligence.

</details>


### [311] [Image Guided Depth Upsampling using Anisotropic Total Generalized Variation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03399)
*David Ferstl,Christian Reinbacher,Rene Ranftl,Matthias Rüther,Horst Bischof*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于高阶正则化与各向异性扩散张量引导的凸优化深度图上采样方法，并给出高效并行的原始-对偶数值算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Kinect、ToF 等深度相机可提供稠密高质量深度，但横向分辨率受限，需将低分辨率深度图上采样到高分辨率。

Method: 将深度上采样建模为凸优化问题，采用高阶正则化；由高分辨率强度图计算各向异性扩散张量作为引导项；基于原始-对偶（primal-dual）形式推导可高效并行化的数值算法。

Result: 在广泛使用的 Middlebury 2007 数据集上，速度与精度均明显优于现有方法，可达每秒多帧；并引入带高精度真值的新数据集，首次支持用真实传感器数据评测深度上采样方法。

Conclusion: 高阶正则化结合强度图引导的凸优化框架可高效、准确地实现深度图上采样，且新数据集为真实场景评测提供了基准。

Abstract: In this work we present a novel method for the challenging problem of depth image upsampling. Modern depth cameras such as Kinect or Time of Flight cameras deliver dense, high quality depth measurements but are limited in their lateral resolution. To overcome this limitation we formulate a convex optimization problem using higher order regularization for depth image upsampling. In this optimization an anisotropic diffusion tensor, calculated from a high resolution intensity image, is used to guide the upsampling. We derive a numerical algorithm based on a primaldual formulation that is efficiently parallelized and runs at multiple frames per second. We show that this novel upsampling clearly outperforms state of the art approaches in terms of speed and accuracy on the widely used Middlebury 2007 datasets. Furthermore, we introduce novel datasets with highly accurate groundtruth, which, for the first time, enable to benchmark depth upsampling methods using real sensor data.

</details>


### [312] [Isekai3D SDG: A Platform for Diverse Synthetic Gameplay Visual Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03626)
*Rafal Karp,Gene Liu,Shih-Hsin Li,Eric Courtemanche,Shengze Wang,Josef Spjut,David Pankratz,Mischa Kolbe,Michael Stengel,Sven Elflein,Adam Grygielski,Liwen Wu,Anjul Patney*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Isekai3D 是一个基于虚幻引擎的合成3D游戏数据生成平台，采用“世界模拟—采集回放”两阶段解耦流程，可复用同一段游戏录制生成多种视觉输出，并以训练友好格式直接上传数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为视觉与世界模型、神经图形学、游戏智能体等研究提供多样化的合成游戏数据，同时减少中间存储、数据准备时间与人工处理成本。

Method: 平台结合可复用的环境与角色资产和虚幻引擎插件，构建两阶段工作流：第一阶段进行世界模拟，记录世界状态、角色动作、相机轨迹等回放所需信息；第二阶段在指定的分辨率、帧率、渲染与相机配置下回放录制内容，采集渲染视频、图像、深度图等输出。

Result: 通过模拟与采集分离，同一段录制游戏可在不重复模拟的情况下生成多种输出变体；视觉输出附带逐帧对齐的相机、角色与动作元数据；数据以训练友好格式直接上传。

Conclusion: 该报告阐述了Isekai3D系统整体设计，包括资产、插件及其功能如何协同生成多样化合成游戏数据，验证了该架构在效率与可复用性上的优势。

Abstract: We present Isekai3D Synthetic Data Generation (SDG), a platform for simulating and capturing synthetic 3D gameplay for research in vision and world models, neural graphics, gameplay agents, and other applications. The platform combines reusable environment and character assets with Unreal Engine plugins in a two-stage workflow. First, world simulation generates gameplay while recording the world state, character movements, actions, and camera tracks needed for replay. Second, the recorded simulation is replayed to capture selected outputs, such as rendered video, images, and depth maps, at a specified resolution and frame rate under selected rendering and camera configurations. Separating simulation from capture allows the same recorded gameplay to produce multiple output variants without repeating the original simulation. Visual outputs are accompanied by frame-aligned camera, character, and action metadata. The platform uploads generated data directly in a training-friendly format, reducing intermediate storage, preparation time, and manual processing. This report describes the design of our overall system, including the platform's assets, plugins, and their functionality, explaining how they work together to generate diverse synthetic gameplay data.

</details>


### [313] [Reviso: Not All Visual Evidence Deserves Equal Attention in Video Captioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03602)
*Tengfei Liu,Yang Shi,Yuran Wang,Yuqi Tang,Yizhuo Jia,Zhuoran Zhang,Qixun Wang,Shujie Li,Xuanyu Zhu,Xinyu Liu,Minghui Guo,Shixuan Liu,Haotian Wang,Yuanxing Zhang,Pengfei Wan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 agentic 视频描述框架 Reviso，通过 Context–Focus–Points 层次化观察计划与目标导向的主动感知，结合 GRPO 训练，在多基准上优于开源基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 生成的视频描述常过度强调细枝末节而忽略核心上下文与关键事件；作者认为并非所有视觉证据都应获得同等注意力，其重要性取决于视频内容本身，因此需要“学会看什么、如何收集证据”。

Method: 1) 从低帧率全局预览构建 Context–Focus–Points (CFP) 层次观察计划，明确视频上下文、优先关键方面并定义具体观察目标与对应工具；2) 按计划进行目标导向的主动感知，选择性回访时间片段并组合工具做细粒度检查，边解读证据边更新计划，融合全局与局部信息生成描述；3) 采用验证引导流程，通过事实核验与教师引导精修构建高质量训练轨迹；4) 用 GRPO 训练，奖励含关键事实奖励、Plan Alignment Reward (PAR，衡量重要观察目标识别）与 Unproductive Tool-Call Penalty (UTCP，依描述质量调整观察成本惩罚)。

Result: 在四个视频描述基准上，Reviso 优于所评估的开源基线；其生成的描述在下游视频问答任务中提供更好的支持。

Conclusion: 结果验证了“优先级引导的主动观察”对视频描述的有效性与潜力。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can generate detailed video captions, yet they may overemphasize minor details while overlooking essential context and key events. We argue that not all visual evidence deserves equal attention, as the importance of visual information depends on the content of each video. Motivated by this observation, we propose Reviso, an agentic video captioning framework that learns what to observe and how to gather relevant visual evidence. From a low-frame-rate global preview, Reviso constructs a hierarchical Context--Focus--Points (CFP) observation plan that identifies the video context, prioritizes key aspects, and defines concrete observation targets and corresponding tools. Guided by this plan, Reviso performs goal-directed active perception by selectively revisiting temporal segments and combining tools for fine-grained inspection. It interprets the acquired evidence, updates its plan as needed, and integrates global and local information to generate the final caption. To learn this observation strategy, we develop a verification-guided pipeline that constructs high-quality training trajectories through factual verification and teacher-guided refinement. We further train Reviso using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), incorporating a key-fact reward for caption quality, a Plan Alignment Reward (PAR) for identifying important observation targets, and an Unproductive Tool-Call Penalty (UTCP) that adjusts observation-cost penalties based on caption quality. Experiments across four video captioning benchmarks show that Reviso outperforms the evaluated open-source baselines, while its generated captions better support downstream video question answering. These findings highlight the effectiveness and potential of priority-guided active observation for video captioning.

</details>


### [314] [Structured Visual Landscape: Generating Preferred Representations in Biological and Artificial Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03597)
*Yusong Zhao,Edgar Y. Walker,Hao Wang,Mi Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Vis-Lens 框架，通过激活正则化的结构化视觉表征地形与 VAE-扩散生成模型，无需逐图迭代即可生成能调控目标神经元/脑区响应的自然偏好图像，并在人工神经网络与 fMRI 人类视觉皮层上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解神经元对视觉刺激的响应，对提升黑箱人工神经网络可解释性、理解人脑视觉表征均具重要意义；而现有生成偏好图像的方法需要逐图迭代优化，效率与真实性受限。

Method: 构建结构化的视觉表征地形（landscape），设计基于激活的先验，用脑区或网络单元的激活对该地形进行有效正则化；Vis-Lens 将变分自编码器与扩散模型整合为图像生成框架，直接修改经激活正则化的潜码即可生成图像，避免逐图迭代优化。

Result: 在人工神经网络与基于 fMRI 数据的人类视觉皮层上验证，框架在激活调控效果与图像真实感两方面均优于近期一个最先进的偏好视觉表征生成方法。

Conclusion: 激活正则化的结构化表征地形结合 VAE-扩散生成范式，可实现高效、免迭代的神经元偏好图像生成，为神经网络可解释性与人脑视觉表征研究提供通用工具。

Abstract: Understanding how neurons respond to visual stimulus is an important question in both deep learning and neuroscience. It has significant implications for enhancing the interpretability of black-box artificial neural networks and for understanding the visual representation in the human brain. We propose a structured visual representations landscape and design an activation-based prior that allows us to effectively regularize the landscape with activations from brain regions or neural network units. Our model Vis-Lens integrates a variational autoencoder and a diffusion model into an image generation framework. It enables the generation of natural, realistic preferred images by directly modifying the activation-regularized latent codes without per-image iterative optimization. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework on both artificial neural networks and human visual cortex using functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data. Our framework improves activation modulation and image realism compared with a recent state-of-the-art method for generating preferred visual representations of these neural targets.

</details>


### [315] [PlantVLM-Edge: Quantized Vision-Language Models for On-Device Crop Health Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03557)
*Gaurab Wagle,Bishal Adhikari,Jiajia Li,Xiaolei Huang,Dong Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PlantVLM-Edge——一个可完全在资源受限边缘设备上运行的量化视觉语言框架，用于对话式作物健康诊断，兼顾诊断质量与部署效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精准作物健康诊断依赖专家知识且不易获得，而现有视觉语言模型（VLM）计算与内存开销大，难以部署在资源受限的边缘设备上。

Method: 融合农业领域自适应、训练后量化与设备端服务（含离线对话界面）；采用骨干无关设计，用Qwen3-VL-2B与LLaVA-1.5-7B两种VLM、四种量化方案、两个诊断域（病害与虫害）进行验证，全部变体部署于NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin。

Result: 8比特量化对答案质量影响极小；4比特AWQ在两个诊断域上保留98.6%的全精度答案质量，同时将2B骨干权重内存降低49%；最紧凑配置下权重内存仅2.01 GiB，首token约0.12 s，64 token诊断响应0.78 s。

Conclusion: 在边缘设备上实现及时、准确的作物健康诊断具有可行性，为下一代作物监测与决策支持系统奠定基础。

Abstract: Timely and accurate crop health diagnosis is essential for sustainable agricultural production, yet accurate diagnosis often requires expert knowledge that is not readily available. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in visual understanding, reasoning, and natural-language interaction, creating new opportunities for intelligent crop health assessment. However, deploying VLMs on resource-constrained devices remains challenging due to their substantial computational and memory requirements. This paper presents PlantVLM-Edge, a quantized vision-language framework for conversational crop health diagnosis that can run entirely on resource-constrained edge devices. PlantVLM-Edge combines agricultural domain adaptation, post-training quantization, and on-device serving with an offline chat interface, allowing growers to ask open-ended questions and receive diagnoses, symptom explanations, and management guidance without cloud connectivity. The framework is backbone-agnostic: we validate it with two different VLM types with varying scale and architecture (Qwen3-VL-2B and LLaVA-1.5-7B), four quantization schemes, and two diagnostic domains (plant diseases and insect pests), and we deploy all variants on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. Eight-bit quantization affects answer quality minimally relative to the full-precision model, and 4-bit activation-aware weight quantization (AWQ) retains 98.6% of full-precision answer quality on both domains while reducing the weight memory of the 2B backbone by 49%. In its most compact form, PlantVLM-Edge requires 2.01 GiB of weight memory, returns its first token in about 0.12 s, and completes a 64-token diagnostic response in 0.78 s. These results demonstrate that timely and accurate crop health diagnosis is practical on edge devices, providing a foundation for next-generation crop monitoring and decision support systems.

</details>


### [316] [CoLa3D: Composable Latent 3D Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03533)
*Xudong Cai,Yongcai Wang,Deying Li,Chuanxia Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CoLa3D 提出一种简洁有效的可组合三维场景分解模型：输入单张图像或已有场景网格得到的整场景隐编码，直接输出一组空间布局一致、可拼回完整场景的物体网格。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常在规范空间逐物体生成，再用脆弱的位姿与尺度估计把物体粘合回场景，导致全局一致性与可组合性差。作者希望在同一整场景隐空间内完成分解，避免事后对齐。

Method: 提出新的"共享整场景隐编码内分解"范式：采用轻量、灵活、可扩展的 query-based transformer，接受多种查询类型（2D 掩码、3D 点、可学习查询），在紧凑隐空间中将场景学习分解为物体并直接输出带一致布局的物体网格。

Result: 在合成与真实数据集上达到可组合三维场景分解的 SOTA，显著提升场景级全局一致性与物体级质量；相比 SAM 3D 运行快 2 倍、训练数据不足其 1%；可见深度与 MoGe2 相当，证明隐空间分解能保持可见几何精度并生成物理完整、可分解的物体网格。

Conclusion: 在共享隐空间内直接分解场景是一种简单而有效的替代范式，兼具一致性、质量与效率优势，并具备多查询接口的灵活性。

Abstract: We introduce CoLa3D, a simple and effective model for composable 3D scene decomposition that, given a single whole-scene latent from either a single image or an existing scene mesh as input, directly outputs a set of object meshes with consistent spatial layout that can be assembled back into a coherent scene. CoLa3D introduces a novel paradigm for 3D scene decomposition within a shared whole-scene latent, unlike alternatives that perform per-object generation in canonical spaces and then glue the objects back together with fragile pose and scale estimation. The network is a lightweight, flexible, and scalable query-based transformer that accepts various types of queries, including 2D masks, 3D points, and learnable queries, and learns to decompose the scene into objects in a compact latent space. On both synthetic and real-world datasets, CoLa3D achieves state-of-the-art performance on composable 3D scene decomposition, substantially improving global scene-level consistency and object-level quality while running 2 times faster and using less than 1% of SAM 3D's training data. Visible depth on par with MoGe2 further confirms that latent decomposition preserves accurate visible scene geometry while producing physically complete, decomposable object meshes.

</details>


### [317] [Contrastive Adapter Training and Consensus Knowledge Distillation for Multi-Source-Free Domain Adaptation in Skin Cancer Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03528)
*Ali Abedi,Q. M. Jonathan Wu,Ning Zhang,Farhad Pourpanah*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CAT-CKD方法用于多源无源无监督域适应（MSFDA）的皮肤病变分类：先用监督对比学习训练轻量ConvPass适配器构建域不变特征空间，再用共识知识蒸馏在无标签目标域适配学生模型，平均AUROC达86.1%，仅需4.3M可训练参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 皮肤癌诊断中黑色素瘤与良性痣视觉相似，CNN/ViT在异构临床数据源上性能下降。传统域适应需访问源数据，受隐私法规限制难以实现；MSFDA虽无需源数据，但现有方法全骨干微调导致灾难性遗忘与小样本过拟合，仅在聚合阶段处理域偏移而未建立共享域不变特征空间，且依赖硬伪标签或置信度加权聚合，在域偏移下引入噪声监督。

Method: CAT-CKD包含两部分：(1) 对比适配器训练（CAT）——在冻结ViT骨干内训练轻量ConvPass适配器，采用监督对比学习（SCL）在源域特定模型训练之前建立共享域不变特征空间；(2) 共识知识蒸馏（CKD）——将多个源模型logits聚合为共识监督信号，以KL散度在无标签目标数据上适配学生模型。

Result: 在五个公开皮肤病变数据集上实验，平均AUROC为86.1%，优于现有MSFDA方法，且仅需4.3M可训练参数。

Conclusion: CAT-CKD通过适配器级对比学习与共识蒸馏相结合，在无需源数据、参数高效的条件下有效缓解域偏移与灾难性遗忘，为临床皮肤病变诊断中的跨源泛化提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Skin cancer diagnosis, particularly differentiating melanoma from benign nevi, is challenging due to the visual similarity between lesions. Although convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and vision transformers (ViTs) have shown promising performance, their effectiveness often deteriorates on data from heterogeneous clinical sources. Conventional domain adaptation methods address domain shift but require access to source data during adaptation, which is often infeasible due to privacy regulations. Multi-source-free unsupervised domain adaptation (MSFDA) addresses this limitation by leveraging multiple labeled source domains to generalize to an unlabeled target domain without requiring access to source data. However, existing MSFDA methods rely on full backbone fine-tuning, leading to catastrophic forgetting and overfitting on small clinical datasets, and address domain shift at the aggregation stage without establishing a shared domain-invariant feature space. Furthermore, their reliance on hard pseudo-labels or confidence-weighted aggregation introduces noisy supervision signals under domain shift. To address these limitations, we propose CAT-CKD, consisting of two components: (1) contrastive adapter training (CAT), which trains lightweight ConvPass adapters within a frozen ViT backbone using supervised contrastive learning (SCL) to establish a shared domain-invariant feature space before source-specific model training, and (2) consensus knowledge distillation (CKD), which aggregates logits from multiple source models into a consensus supervisory signal and adapts a student model on unlabeled target data using KL divergence. Experiments on five publicly available skin lesion datasets show that CAT-CKD achieves an average AUROC of 86.1%, outperforming existing MSFDA methods while requiring only 4.3M trainable parameters. The code is available at https://github.com/A-Abedi/CAT_CKD.

</details>


### [318] [Intent2CAD: How Semantic-Parametric Supervision Shapes Text-to-CAD Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03449)
*Jinbo Yang,Mingyue Yuan,Shikai Jing*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出面向设计意图的文本到CAD生成任务，将设计意图表示为可恢复的代码级信号（语义特征、可复用参数、轻量参数化关系），并构建IntentCAD-100K与IntentCAD-Edit-1K数据集，用两阶段保守提升管线Intent2CAD验证监督表示粒度对生成与零样本意图保持编辑的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际CAD工作流不仅需要可执行几何，还需要支持后续修改的可复用结构；而现有文本到CAD工作只关注生成可执行程序，缺乏对设计意图（结构、参数、关系）的显式表达与保留。

Method: 不改变模型架构与解码流程，仅研究监督表示的粒度影响；构建IntentCAD-100K（由低级CAD构造轨迹转换为可执行CadQuery程序得到的10万条文本-代码对）与IntentCAD-Edit-1K评测集；提出Intent2CAD两阶段保守提升管线：语义提升将可靠图元组重写为特征级操作，参数提升显式化轻量参数化关系；在受控微调下对比不同表示粒度。

Result: 语义提升主要提升生成可靠性与特征恢复，IR由2.39%降至0.22%，API Recovery达99.96%；参数提升使可复用关系结构显式化，并进一步改善关系感知的零样本编辑效果。

Conclusion: 监督表示的粒度（而非模型架构）是提升CAD生成可靠性、意图可恢复性与零样本意图保持编辑能力的关键因素；代码级意图信号可有效承载设计意图。

Abstract: Text-to-CAD generation aims to make CAD modeling more accessible by generating executable CAD programs from natural-language descriptions. However, practical CAD workflows require more than executable geometry: generated programs should also expose reusable structure that supports later modification. We introduce intent-oriented text-to-CAD generation, where design intent is expressed as recoverable code-level signals: semantic features, reusable parameters, and lightweight parametric relations. Rather than changing the model architecture or decoding procedure, we investigate how supervision representation granularity affects both CAD generation and zero-shot intent-preserving editing. To enable this study, we construct IntentCAD-100K, a 100K paired text--code dataset built by converting low-level CAD construction traces into executable CadQuery programs. We further construct IntentCAD-Edit-1K to evaluate zero-shot intent-preserving editing from the same representation perspective. Intent2CAD uses a two-stage conservative lifting pipeline: semantic lifting rewrites reliable primitive groups into feature-level operations, while parametric lifting exposes lightweight parametric relations. Under controlled fine-tuning, semantic lifting mainly improves generation reliability and feature recovery, reducing IR from 2.39% to 0.22% and achieving 99.96% API Recovery, while parametric lifting makes reusable relation structure explicit and further improves relation-aware zero-shot editing. Datasets and code are available at https://github.com/JinboYang94/Intent2CAD.

</details>


### [319] [Circumventing Magnitude Collapse via Modular Two-Stage Open-Set Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03421)
*Laurin van den Bergh,Halil Bisgin,Andres Palechor,Mike Suter,Manuel Günther*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将开放集识别(OSR)重构为"表示学习+后处理"的模块化两阶段流程，首次系统研究二者的交互作用，揭示了大规模下"幅度崩塌(magnitude collapse)"失效模式，并提出简单K+1分类器加强度感知后处理达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往OSR研究中表示学习方法与后处理方法相互独立地发展，二者交互作用未被探索；同时现有评估多在小规模、使用已知未知(known unknown)数据上进行，可能无法反映真实部署下的大规模表现。

Method: 将OSR视为模块化的两阶段流水线，在多种数据规模及是否使用known unknown数据的设置下，系统地交叉组合表示学习方法与后处理方法，分析其交互效应，并据此设计规避幅度崩塌的简单基线(K+1类分类器+强度感知后处理)。

Result: 发现幅度崩塌失效模式：依赖known unknown数据的表示学习方法在小规模表现优异，但在大规模下性能退化并不可逆地破坏判别性信息；两阶段处理可带来模块化增益，但交互效应也会放大崩塌导致的退化；所提简单基线在规避崩塌的同时取得SOTA性能。

Conclusion: 表示学习与后处理的模块化交互对OSR性能有显著且非平凡的影响；仅基于小规模known unknown数据的评估无法预测大规模表现，现行OSR研究最佳实践需被修正。

Abstract: Open-set recognition (OSR) requires neural networks to classify known classes while rejecting unknown samples, which is critical for real-world deployment. So far, OSR research studied and developed representation learning and postprocessing methods independently and their interactions remain unexplored. In this paper, we reconsider OSR as a modular two-stage pipeline and present the first systematic study of interactions between representation learning and postprocessing methods across dataset scales and usage of known unknown data. First, we discover a failure mode we term \emph{magnitude collapse}, where representation learning methods that utilize known unknown data can suffer performance degradation at large scale and irreversibly destroy discriminative information, despite excelling at small scale. Second, we study the modular interactions and reveal when they can be leveraged for modular performance gains via two-stage processing and where interaction effects amplify performance degradation due to magnitude collapse. Third, we show how these findings can be used to achieve state-of-the-art performance with a simple $K+1$ class classifier baseline and magnitude-aware postprocessing while circumventing magnitude collapse. Finally, our results demonstrate that small-scale evaluations with known unknown data are not predictive of large-scale performance, invalidating current best practices in OSR research. Code available at https://github.com/TwoDigitsOneNumber/Two-Stage-OSR.

</details>


### [320] [TaoMate-FVSR:Audio-Guided Facial Video Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03393)
*Xinyang Li,Zeran Xu,Qijun Gan,Chenwei Zhang,Meiguang Jin,Junfeng Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出音频引导的人脸视频修复框架，在参考引导的视频流模型中同时恢复小区域面部细节并保证唇齿与语音同步。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI生成视频中人脸区域分辨率低，单纯视觉超分虽能锐化细节，却无法判断恢复出的嘴唇与牙齿是否与语音一致。

Method: 在参考引导的视频流模型中：采用源-噪声混合（source–noise mixing）从部分保留观测初始化重建；结构化参考注入将外观锚点与连续运动上下文分离；训练同时包含退化图像/视频修复与目标音频下劣质配音源的校正，并用外观与同步监督。

Result: 在说话头修复基准上，配对感知相似度与同步分数均为对比方法中最佳；消融考察音频条件、重建形式与参考注入；原生AIGC样例中恢复出唇轮廓、牙齿结构与周围面部纹理。

Conclusion: 音频条件与参考引导相结合可统一人脸细节恢复与视觉配音，适用于场景级AIGC视频的面部修复。

Abstract: AI-generated videos often depict people within detailed scenes while leaving their small facial regions poorly resolved. Visual super-resolution can sharpen these regions without resolving whether the recovered lips and teeth agree with the spoken audio. We present an audio-guided facial video restoration framework that addresses this ambiguity within a reference-guided video flow model. Source--noise mixing initializes reconstruction from a partially preserved observation, and structured reference injection separates appearance anchors from continuous motion context. Training combines restoration of degraded images and videos with correction of degraded dubbed sources under target audio. Appearance and synchronization supervision allow the model to recover facial detail and support visual dubbing when the audio is replaced. On talking-head restoration benchmarks, our method achieves the best paired perceptual similarity and synchronization scores among the compared restoration methods. Component comparisons examine audio conditioning, the reconstruction formulation, and reference injection. Native AIGC examples further illustrate the recovery of lip contours, dental structure, and surrounding facial texture in scene-level footage. injection. Native AIGC examples further illustrate the recovery of lip contours, dental structure, and surrounding facial texture in scene-level footage.

</details>


### [321] [Progressive Multi-Scale Super-Resolution via Cascaded Bicubic Anchors and Inter-Scale Mutual Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03390)
*Chun-An Lin,Yu-Chia Chang,Chi-Mao Fan,Yen-Chieh Ouyang,Tsung-Jung Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PMS-SR：基于低分辨率网格Transformer主干，单次前向输出x2/x4/x8多尺度超分结果，两阶段（残差预测+尺度间互细化）设计，参数量仅7.95M即优于多尺度方法与x8专用模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超分网络通常针对单一放大倍数训练，要获得多种输出分辨率需训练多个模型，参数与计算冗余高。作者希望用单个模型、单次前向完成x2/x4/x8多尺度输出。

Method: 提出渐进式单输入多输出网络PMS-SR，主干为低分辨率网格上的Transformer。Stage 1：各尺度预测为上一尺度预测经detach的双三次上采样结果的残差，配合Dirac与零初始化，使训练精确起始于bicubic级联，每个头只补充前一尺度缺失的频带。Stage 2：尺度间互细化，通过space-to-depth反馈、可变形对齐与逐像素融合实现双向耦合，使x8特征反向细化x2输出。

Result: 在DF2K训练，7.95M参数模型在五个标准基准的x4与x8上PSNR均高于所有对比多尺度方法；x8时全面超过x8专用DRN-L，在Urban100领先所有对比方法，其余数据集与最佳结果差距在0.13 dB内。相比三个单尺度SwinIR-M，参数量仅22%，在BSD100输入上速度快2.9倍，输出一致性提升6.7–12.4 dB。

Conclusion: 渐进残差+尺度间互细化的单模型多尺度方案，可在显著降低参数与计算成本的同时达到或超越专用单尺度与多尺度方法的性能，验证了跨尺度信息双向耦合的有效性。

Abstract: Super-resolution networks are trained for one magnification factor, so several output resolutions require several models. We propose PMS-SR, a progressive single-input multiple-output network that produces x2, x4, and x8 results in one forward pass, with a Transformer backbone on the low-resolution grid. In Stage 1, each scale is predicted as a residual over the detached bicubic upsampling of the previous scale's prediction. With Dirac and zero initialization, training starts exactly from the bicubic cascade, and each head adds only the band the previous scale lacks. In Stage 2, inter-scale mutual refinement couples the scales in both directions through space-to-depth feedback, deformable alignment, and per-pixel fusion, so x8 features refine the x2 output. Trained on DF2K, the 7.95M-parameter model achieves a higher PSNR than every compared multi-scale method at x4 and x8 on all five standard benchmarks. At x8, it outperforms the x8-specific DRN-L on all of them, leads all compared methods on Urban100, and is within 0.13 dB of the best result elsewhere. Against three single-scale SwinIR-M models, PMS-SR uses 22% of the parameters, runs 2.9x faster on BSD100 inputs, and its outputs agree 6.7-12.4 dB more closely. Code and pretrained models will be released at https://github.com/julian135707/PMS-SR upon acceptance.

</details>


### [322] [Mesh-Agnostic Refinement Models for Latent Space Encoding of 3D Human Body Shapes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03285)
*Chaima Zouaouid,Jonathan Cerqueirab,Sylvain Arguillere,Martin Bauer,Nicolas Charon,Mohamed Daoudi,Emmanuel Hartman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无需顶点对应的参数化人体模型重建精化框架，含三个互补方法：Latent-VaRefine、Vertex-VaRefine、ElaOpt。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SMPL 等参数化人体模型的紧凑表示受限于隐参数估计误差与解码器表达能力不足，且现有精化往往需要顶点对应。

Method: 以初始解码曲面与目标网格的几何差异为驱动：Latent-VaRefine 用 varifold 距离梯度修正隐编码；Vertex-VaRefine 用 DiffusionNet 处理多尺度 varifold 梯度特征预测标准姿态下的顶点位移，实现近似姿态等变精化；ElaOpt 在弹性正则与法向约束下直接优化曲面形变。

Result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果。

Conclusion: 通过三条互补路径在潜空间、顶点级与直接形变层面统一精化人体重建，无需顶点对应。

Abstract: Parametric human body models such as the Skinned Multi-Person Linear (SMPL) model provide compact representations of human shape and pose, but their reconstructions remain affected by both errors in estimated latent parameters and limitations in the decoder's expressive capacity. We propose a framework for refining these reconstructions by exploiting the geometric discrepancy between an initial decoded surface and a target mesh, without requiring vertex correspondences between them. The framework comprises three complementary approaches. Latent-VaRefine uses varifold-distance gradients to correct the estimated latent code while preserving the original parametric representation. Vertex-VaRefine processes multiscale varifold-gradient features with a DiffusionNet backbone to predict vertex displacements in a canonical pose, yielding an approximately pose-equivariant refinement pipeline. ElaOpt directly optimizes surface deformations under elastic regularization and normal-direction constraints.

</details>


### [323] [ReVA-HPE: Relative 6DoF Head Pose Estimation with Synthetic Pose Supervision and Personalized Virtual Anchors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03283)
*Vasiliki Vasileiou,Panagiotis P. Filntisis,Petros Maragos,Kostas Daniilidis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReVA-HPE：用单张无标注注册图像重建个性化3D avatar并渲染已知姿态的虚拟anchor库，将相对头姿估计扩展到完整6DoF，无需求解anchor真实姿态，仅用合成数据训练即在BIWI/FaMoS取得SOTA旋转精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目头姿估计通常被表述为单张人脸裁剪的绝对回归；相对头姿估计利用同一人随时间的显式anchor图像，但现有方法在推理时仍需已知anchor图像的真实姿态，实用性受限。同时相对姿态此前仅限于旋转，缺乏平移。

Method: 1) 将相对头姿估计扩展至完整6DoF：额外预测深度归一化的相对平移，与anchor组合恢复相机坐标系下的度量查询姿态。2) 免真实anchor姿态：由单张无标注注册图像重建个性化avatar，渲染一批已知姿态的虚拟anchor，通过多anchor共识生成稳健旋转假设；平移分支以真实注册图像作anchor，用landmark PnP求取。3) 提出高效变体：在注册阶段一次性摊销anchor库开销，之后每次查询仅需一次real-to-real相对预测，精度损失有限。4) 相对姿态估计器仅在合成人脸渲染上训练，不使用真实姿态监督、伪标签、域适应或评测集微调。

Result: 在真实6DoF基准上，ReVA-HPE在BIWI上取得SOTA旋转精度，在给定近正面注册图像时于FaMoS亦达SOTA；尽管仅依赖合成姿态监督，度量平移仍具竞争力。

Conclusion: 通过虚拟anchor库与多anchor共识，ReVA-HPE解除了相对头姿估计对已知anchor姿态的依赖，并以纯合成监督实现完整6DoF估计，兼具精度与实用性；高效变体进一步降低推理成本。

Abstract: Monocular head pose estimation is usually formulated as absolute regression from a single face crop, yet many applications observe the same person over time and can supply an explicit anchor image. Recently, relative head pose estimation was proposed, which casts the problem as estimation of the relative geometric change between an anchor and a query image. However, existing methods still require the anchor image pose to be known at inference, significantly limiting their practical use. We first extend relative head pose estimation to full 6DoF by additionally predicting a depth-normalized relative translation, which composes with the anchor to recover metric query pose in the camera frame. To eliminate the need for a ground-truth anchor pose, we reconstruct a personalized avatar from a single unlabeled enrollment image and render a bank of virtual anchors with known poses. The bank provides robust rotation hypotheses through multi-anchor consensus, while the real enrollment image serves as the real anchor in the translation branch via landmark PnP. We also introduce an efficient variant that amortizes the bank cost once at enrollment, after which each query requires a single real-to-real relative prediction, with limited accuracy sacrifice. The relative pose estimator is trained exclusively on synthetic face renderings, without real pose supervision, pseudo-labels, domain adaptation, or fine-tuning on the evaluation sets. On real 6DoF benchmarks, ReVA-HPE achieves state-of-the-art rotation accuracy on BIWI and, given a near-frontal enrollment image, on FaMoS, while remaining competitive in metric translation despite relying solely on synthetic pose supervision. Project page and code: https://vasilikivas.github.io/ReVA-HPE/

</details>


### [324] [HyperFlow: Class-Incremental Semantic Change Detection via Hyperbolic Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03245)
*Manon Béchaz,Léo Buecher,Emanuele Dalsasso,Ciprian Tomoiaga,Patrick Jayet,Marcin Detyniecki,Laetitia Chapel,Lucas Drumetz,Nicolas Courty,Devis Tuia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出类别增量语义变化检测任务，在双曲空间中以Busemann原型建模语义流异常（HyperFlow），并发布细粒度层次标签数据集HiChange，验证渐进式类别细化可提升变化检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遥感语义变化检测方法假设变化类别集合固定，难以适应实际场景中随地域或时间变化而变化的目标类别。作者将问题建模为类增量语义变化检测，并利用地物语义的层次结构（新类别为已有类别的细粒度细分）来支撑渐进学习。

Method: 1）利用地物语义的层次结构，将语义类别表征于双曲空间以刻画层级关系；2）提出HyperFlow，基于Busemann原型在分割诱导的双曲嵌入空间中建模“语义流”，将变化判定为流中的异常；3）将变化检测与类增量语义分割耦合，实现类增量语义变化检测；4）构建HiChange大规模高分辨率遥感数据集，含细粒度层次标签。

Result: 实验表明HyperFlow在各增量步骤上同时取得较强变化检测与语义分割性能；且渐进细分类别（而非一次性学习全部类别）带来更优变化检测效果，体现增量学习对语义变化检测的增益。

Conclusion: 将类增量学习与层次化双曲表征结合可有效解决变化类别开放问题；增量式语义细化是提升语义变化检测的可行路径，并配套提供HiChange数据集支持后续研究。

Abstract: Semantic change detection in remote sensing aims to identify and characterize land-cover transitions observed in pairs of satellite or aerial images. Existing methods assume a fixed set of change categories, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios where changes of interest may vary, for example across geographies or over time. In this work, we tackle the problem of class-incremental semantic change detection, where a model progressively learns to detect new types of semantic change. To do so, we exploit the hierarchical structure of land-cover semantics, where newly introduced categories correspond to fine-grained refinements of existing ones, and represent said semantic categories in hyperbolic space, which is particularly well suited to represent such hierarchical relationships. To capture semantic changes, we introduce HyperFlow, a method relying on Busemann prototypes, modeling change as an anomaly in a learned semantic flow within the hyperbolic embedding space induced by segmentation. HyperFlow couples change detection to class-incremental semantic segmentation, enabling class-incremental semantic change detection. We also present HiChange, a new large-scale, high resolution remote sensing dataset with detailed, fine-grained hierarchical labels. Experimental results demonstrate that HyperFlow achieves both strong change detection and semantic segmentation performance across incremental steps. In particular, we show that progressively refining semantic categories, rather than considering them all directly, yields improved change detection, highlighting the benefits of incremental learning for semantic change detection.

</details>


### [325] [Calibrating Multimodal Test-Time Adaptation under Reliability and Availability Modality Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03232)
*Jiangmeng Li,Jinglin Xu,Yi Li,Yumeng Liu,Jiahuan Zhou,Fanjiang Xu,Hui Xiong,Gang Hua*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出自适应概率高斯校准方法AdaPGC，将类别条件高斯建模扩展到模态特定与多模态融合表示上，用概率预测校准源模型预测并指导可靠性修正，并通过联合分布恢复缺失的融合表示，从而应对模态可靠性漂移与可用性漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态测试时自适应用无标签测试数据应对分布漂移，但比单模态更复杂：多个表示视角共存且相互作用。尤其在模态可靠性漂移（模态可用但信息质量下降）和模态可用性漂移（模态完全不可访问）下问题更突出。类别条件高斯建模在单模态TTA中已证明能刻画表示分布，但扩展到多模态需更精细的建模。

Method: 提出AdaPGC，将类别条件高斯模型扩展到模态特定表示与多模态融合表示；持续更新这些高斯模型，以所得概率预测校准源模型预测、指导基于可靠性的修正，并利用二者的联合分布恢复不可用的融合表示。

Result: 在多种模态损坏与缺失条件下的大量实验表明，AdaPGC在模态可靠性漂移和可用性漂移下均有效提升鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 类别条件高斯建模经多视角扩展后可成为多模态TTA的通用概率校准框架，同时处理信息质量退化与模态缺失两类漂移；代码将开源。

Abstract: Multimodal test-time adaptation (TTA) enables pretrained multimodal models to accommodate distribution shifts during inference using only unlabeled test data, without recourse to the original training data. Compared with unimodal adaptation, multimodal adaptation is further complicated by the coexistence and interaction of multiple representation perspectives. This complexity is particularly pronounced under modality reliability shifts, which preserve modality availability but degrade information quality, and modality availability shifts, which render the corresponding modality entirely inaccessible. Category-conditional Gaussian modeling offers a natural starting point for handling such distributional variations, having proven effective in unimodal test-time adaptation for characterizing representation distributions, yet its extension to multimodal settings requires a more elaborate formulation. To this end, we propose Adaptive Probabilistic Gaussian Calibration (AdaPGC), which extends category-conditional Gaussian modeling across modality-specific and multimodal fusion representations for probabilistic calibration under multimodal distribution shifts. AdaPGC continuously updates category-conditional Gaussian models over modality-specific and fusion representations, using the resulting probabilistic predictions to calibrate source model predictions and guide reliability based rectification, while exploiting their joint distributions to recover unavailable fusion representations. Extensive experiments under diverse modality corruption and missingness conditions demonstrate that AdaPGC effectively improves robustness under both modality reliability and availability shifts. Our source code will be released at https://github.com/XuJinglinn/AdaPGC-plus.

</details>


### [326] [ASCoR: Asymmetric Semantic-Spatial Learning for Remote Sensing Domain Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03382)
*Zitong Wang,Shuchang Lyu,Meng Li,Qiang Wang,Guangliang Cheng,Zhenwei Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ASCoR框架，在SAM3上构建非对称语义-空间双分支，仅用源域监督实现遥感语义分割的源域泛化，在ISPRS、LoveDA、OpenEarthMap九个跨域迁移上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遥感语义分割的源域泛化需在无目标域数据下获得可靠预测。视觉基础模型虽提供可迁移知识，但类别识别仍依赖源域特有视觉线索，而任务特定适配又可能削弱预训练的可迁移性，二者存在张力。

Method: 基于SAM3的非对称语义-空间框架：文本条件语义分支用类名提示提供显式类别引导；Probe-Once Dynamic Adaptive LoRA将固定适配预算分配到各编码器块以限制源域特化；互补的任务特定稠密分支用独立冻结的SAM3图像编码器学习多尺度空间表征；轻量可靠性路由器依据局部预测可靠性以有界空间校正融合两分支；全部组件仅用源域监督训练。

Result: 六个ISPRS迁移平均mIoU达68.61%，较此前最佳方法提升2.69个百分点；LoveDA/OpenEarthMap三个迁移均最优，Rural-to-Urban 59.07%、Urban-to-Rural 47.95%、Urban-to-OpenEarthMap 49.38%。消融、特征可视化与空间可靠性分析支持各组件的有效性与互补性。

Conclusion: 语义引导与空间表征的非对称双分支结合受约束的适配预算，可在保持基础模型可迁移性的同时增强类别判别，实现强源域泛化性能。

Abstract: Source-only domain generalization (DG) for remote sensing semantic segmentation seeks reliable predictions in unseen domains without target-domain data during training. Although vision foundation models offer transferable knowledge, category recognition remains sensitive to source-specific visual cues, while task-specific adaptation may weaken pretrained transferability. We propose ASCoR, an asymmetric semantic-spatial framework built on SAM3. Its text-conditioned semantic branch uses class-name prompts to provide explicit category guidance. Probe-Once Dynamic Adaptive LoRA distributes a fixed adaptation budget across encoder blocks to limit source-specific specialization. A complementary task-specific dense branch learns multi-scale spatial representations using a separate frozen SAM3 image encoder. A lightweight reliability router integrates the two branches through bounded spatial correction based on local prediction reliability. All components are trained using source-domain supervision only. Experiments on the ISPRS, LoveDA, and OpenEarthMap benchmarks cover nine cross-domain transfers. ASCoR achieves a state-of-the-art mean IoU of 68.61% across six ISPRS transfers, outperforming the previous best method by 2.69 percentage points. It also achieves the best results on all three LoveDA/OpenEarthMap transfers, with 59.07%, 47.95%, and 49.38% mIoU on Rural-to-Urban, Urban-to-Rural, and Urban-to-OpenEarthMap, respectively. Ablation studies, feature visualizations, and spatial reliability analyses support the effectiveness and complementarity of the proposed components. Code: https://github.com/WangZitong42/ASCoR.

</details>


### [327] [Fuse To Align: Multimodal Representation Learning for Retrieval via Hypergraph Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03370)
*Anindya Nag,Ambuj Mehrish,Sebastiano Vascon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出训练期超图融合框架（wHyVol、wRHG），在样本内与跨语义相关样本间连接已观测模态，训练后丢弃超图、推理零开销，在11个零样本视频/音频-文本检索基准上稳定超越GRAM与HyperGRAM，包括严重缺失模态情形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态检索需融合互补证据，但视图可能缺失、含噪或信息量不均。仅依赖单样本自身视图学习，在可靠证据有限时难以获得有效检索表示；语义相关样本可提供互补观测，而现有基于volumes的目标只做样本内模态对齐，缺乏跨样本信息交换。

Method: 训练期超图融合框架：超图连接样本内观测模态与跨语义相关样本的模态，使表示学习可利用样本外证据，推理管线不变。含HyVol为特例，并给出两种配置——wHyVol学习视图贡献权重与对称语义亲和度；wRHG通过关系传播进一步建模类型化交互与参与者角色。缺失模态直接省略而非插补，训练后超图丢弃，无额外推理开销。

Result: 在11个零样本视频-文本与音频-文本检索基准上，GR...（GRAM）与HyperGRAM均有广泛提升。17个视频基准-模态设置双向评估共34组比较中，wRHG全部优于GRAM、34组中33组优于HyperGRAM。平均文本到视频R@1：GRAM由63.4升至68.2，HyperGRAM由64.8升至68.4；ActivityNet上视频到文本最大提升13.3个百分点。缺失模态评估中，两个加权配置在七个基准的所有缺失率下均保持对GRAM的正向文本到视频增益，即使90%片段缺失某一模态。

Conclusion: 跨样本的超图式证据交换可在不改变推理流程的前提下显著提升多模态检索表示质量，且对缺失模态具鲁棒性；wRHG的关系建模进一步带来增益，说明类型化交互与角色信息有价值。

Abstract: Multimodal retrieval must integrate complementary evidence from views that may be missing, noisy, or unequally informative. When a sample provides limited reliable evidence, learning from its views alone can hinder the acquisition of useful retrieval representations. Semantically related training samples may provide complementary observations, yet existing volume-based objectives jointly align modalities within each sample without explicitly enabling information exchange across samples. We therefore propose a training-time hypergraph fusion framework that connects observed modalities both within samples and across semantically related samples, allowing representation learning to draw on evidence beyond an individual sample while leaving the retrieval pipeline unchanged at inference. The framework includes HyVol as a special case and introduces two configurations: wHyVol learns view contribution weights and symmetric semantic affinities, whereas wRHG additionally models typed interactions and participant roles through relational propagation. Missing modalities are omitted rather than imputed, and the hypergraph is discarded after training, incurring no additional inference cost. Experiments on eleven zero-shot video-text and audio-text retrieval benchmarks demonstrate broad improvements with both GRAM and HyperGRAM. Across 17 video benchmark-modality settings evaluated in both retrieval directions, wRHG outperforms GRAM in all 34 comparisons and HyperGRAM in 33 of 34. Mean text-to-video R@1 increases from 63.4 to 68.2 with GRAM and from 64.8 to 68.4 with HyperGRAM, while the largest video-to-text gain reaches 13.3 percentage points on ActivityNet. Under missing-modality evaluation, both weighted configurations retain positive text-to-video gains over GRAM across seven benchmarks at every evaluated missingness rate, even when 90% of clips lack one modality.

</details>


### [328] [Evaluating Depth-Augmented Visual Features for Cross-Dataset Lunar Traversability Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03430)
*Jan Baturo,Bartosz Ptak*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于稀疏成对标注的弱监督月球地形可通行性估计框架，检验在视觉特征中融合深度/法线等几何信息是否能提升性能；结果表明朴素几何融合无明显收益，训练数据源的选择才是迁移质量的主导因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 月面自主移动受通信延迟与视线遮挡制约，难以持续遥操作，因此可通行性估计至关重要。现有深度学习方法依赖地面模拟环境，与真实月面存在域间差异，且真实月面可通行性标签稀缺，全监督训练困难。

Method: 构建弱监督框架，使用稀疏成对标注训练；以强视觉基线为对照，引入深度图、表面法线及组合几何描述子进行几何增强；在两个地面模拟数据集与真实嫦娥PCAM数据集上做域内与跨域评估；并在资源受限的边缘设备上部署推理。

Result: 与预期相反，朴素几何增强在域内与跨域设置下均未带来一致提升，效应量小于随机种子间方差；跨域迁移质量主要由训练数据源决定，使用域相关数据源训练带来的迁移增益显著大于几何融合带来的任何改进。

Conclusion: 朴素的几何信息融合并非月面可通行性估计的关键，数据源选择与域相关性更为关键；本文提供了边缘端受控基线，为未来设计更具表达力的多模态融合架构奠定基础。

Abstract: Autonomous mobility is essential for sustained lunar surface operations, as communication delays and line-of-sight occlusions limit continuous teleoperation. Although recent traversability estimation methods increasingly rely on deep learning, the domain gap between terrestrial analogue environments and real lunar terrain can limit their generalisation, and real lunar traversability labels are scarce, making fully supervised training difficult. To address these challenges, we build a weakly supervised framework trained on sparse pairwise annotations and study whether augmenting visual features with depth-derived geometric information: depth, surface normals, and combined geometric descriptors. We evaluate the models in both in-domain and cross-domain settings using two terrestrial analogue datasets and the real lunar Chang'E PCAM dataset. Contrary to expectations, we find that naive geometric augmentation yields no consistent improvement over a strong visual-only baseline in either setting, with effects small relative to seed-to-seed variance. Instead, the choice of training source emerges as the dominant factor in transfer quality: models trained on domain-relevant sources transfer substantially better to real lunar imagery than the geometric fusion strategy improves any single model. Our evaluation runs onboard a resource-constrained edge device and provides a controlled baseline for designing more expressive multimodal fusion architectures in future lunar perception systems.

</details>


### [329] [EO-Jev: Decision Model for Earth Observation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03371)
*Mohamed Atef Abouelhadid,Diaa Addeen Abuhani,Muhammad Akhtar Munir,Fahad Shahbaz Khan,Salman Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 对决策模型 d3-flash 在 23 个公开对地观测基准的 30 个设置上做诊断研究，并通过低秩微调得到 EO-Jev，使其成为具竞争力的遥感通才模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遥感（EO）工作流需要从已知候选中选择答案、估计置信度并处理大规摸影像；生成式视觉语言模型自回归解码开销大且置信度不可靠，而单次前向即输出候选概率分布的决策模型在遥感任务上的准确性、校准与迁移性尚缺乏系统认识。

Method: 以 d3-flash（8.4B 参数）为对象，在 23 个公开 EO 基准的 30 个设置上开展诊断性评测，涵盖准确率、校准与迁移；继而在公开 EO 训练划分上进行低秩微调（LoRA），得到 EO-Jev。

Result: d3-flash 的组合推理迁移良好，且在 24 个设置上校准优于其 Qwen3.5-9B 骨干；但计数、变化量化、损毁分级与缺失目标识别仍具挑战。EO-Jev 在 30 个设置中的 26 个上显著优于 d3-flash，在 28 个中的 20 个上达到或超过专用模型；12 个留出设置平均提升 8.0 分，28 个设置中的 21 个期望校准误差更低；代价是通用决策性能下降 1.8 分。

Conclusion: 将通用决策模型适配为具竞争力的遥感通才模型是可行的，但定量感知、选项顺序一致性与分布偏移下的校准仍是持续存在的难题。

Abstract: Earth observation (EO) workflows require selecting among known outcomes, estimating confidence, and processing large volumes of imagery. Generative vision-language models can address these tasks, but autoregressive decoding is computationally costly and their confidence estimates are unreliable. Decision models offer an alternative, returning probabilities over candidate answers in a single forward pass. However, their accuracy, calibration, and transfer across EO tasks remain insufficiently understood. We investigate these properties through a diagnostic study of d3-flash (8.4B parameters) across 30 settings from 23 public EO benchmarks. We find that compositional reasoning transfers well and calibration improves over its Qwen3.5-9B backbone on 24 settings, while counting, change quantification, damage grading, and absent-object recognition remain challenging. To address these limitations, we adapt d3-flash through low-rank fine-tuning on public EO training splits, producing EO-Jev. EO-Jev improves significantly over d3-flash on 26 of 30 settings and matches or exceeds specialist references on 20 of 28. It also achieves an average gain of 8.0 points across 12 held-out settings and lower expected calibration error than specialists on 21 of 28 settings. These improvements come at a modest cost of 1.8 points in general decision performance. Our results demonstrate the potential of adapting general decision models into competitive EO generalists while highlighting persistent challenges in quantitative perception, option-order consistency, and calibration under distribution shift.

</details>


### [330] [Visual-to-Executable Procedural Reconstruction of Buildings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03143)
*Zichong Zhu,Zhihao Liu,Andrei Sharf,Zhanglin Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种从单张真实场景图像重建可执行程序化建筑模型的两阶段结构化预测框架：先预测立面级的全局结构布局树，再对代表性立面瓦片进行组件参数化，最后确定性编译为 CGA 程序并挂接到简单体量模型上实例化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 程序化建模表示紧凑、可编辑、可复用，但依赖人工编写语法规则。单张图像仅提供部分且依赖视角的证据，直接生成低层程序脆弱。因此需要一种结构化中间表示，从野图（in-the-wild）图像恢复立面程序化描述。

Method: 两阶段结构化预测：(1) 全局结构布局树——用微调布局模型结合渲染引导的视觉-符号反射（视觉-符号循环），恢复立面尺度的 split-and-repeat 组织；(2) 组件参数化 schema——将代表性立面瓦片映射为结构化程序化属性，用于局部建筑构件合成。两种表示确定性编译为可执行 CGA 程序，并附着于简单体量模型实现整栋实例化，避免直接生成低层程序的脆弱性。

Result: 实验表明框架既能处理规则立面，也能应对具有挑战性的真实场景图像，并保持较高的结构一致性、程序可执行性与细粒度建筑细节；恢复的程序支持可控、可复用的三维建筑资产生成。

Conclusion: 以"结构布局树 + 组件参数化"作为中间表示并经确定性编译得到 CGA 程序，是图像驱动程序化建筑重建的有效路径，兼顾可执行性与可编辑可复用性；局限在于仅恢复主要可见立面并依赖简单体量模型完成建筑级实例化。

Abstract: Procedural modeling offers compact, editable, and reusable representations for architectural content, but building such models still depends heavily on manually authored grammars. We study image-based procedural building reconstruction from in-the-wild images, with the goal of recovering an executable procedural description that can be instantiated as an editable 3D building asset. Because a single image provides only partial and view-dependent evidence, we focus on recovering the dominant visible facade(s) and attach the recovered facade program to a simple mass model for building-level instantiation. Our method decomposes this task into two structured prediction stages. First, a Global Structure Layout Tree recovers facade-scale split-and-repeat organization through a fine-tuned layout model with render-guided visual-symbolic reflection. Second, a Component Parameterization schema maps representative facade tiles to structured procedural attributes for local architectural component synthesis. These two representations are then deterministically compiled into executable Computer Generated Architecture (CGA) programs, avoiding the brittleness of direct low-level program generation. Experiments show that the proposed framework handles both regular facades and challenging in-the-wild images, while maintaining high structural consistency, procedural executability, and fine-grained architectural detail. The recovered programs further enable controllable and reusable 3D building asset generation.

</details>


### [331] [When Optimization Meets Human Intent: Human-Centered Diffusion Model Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03140)
*Renye Yan,Jikang Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该综述系统分析人类意图如何进入并影响扩散模型优化过程，指出固定指标仅部分刻画人类多维需求，高分未必更符合人类期望，并以人本视角重构个性化扩散生成的优化框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型正从通用工具走向基于微调与引导的个性化系统，但现有优化主要针对美学等可量化目标，很少检验其是否与人类意图一致。人类需求具有多维、情境化与动态性，而现有方法以固定指标近似，指标只部分捕捉需求且在优化中可能放大对真实意图的偏离，因此需要理解人类需求如何进入并影响优化。

Method: 采用系统性综述/综合分析方法，围绕四个环节展开：人类意图的表达、向可优化目标的转换、在模型行为或生成过程中的施 加、以及通过输出进行评估；并进一步讨论个性化图像生成中人机意图对齐的权衡，以及自动化指标与真实用户判断之间的差距。

Result: 梳理出人类意图在扩散优化中的传递链条与失真环节，识别出个性化生成中影响意图对齐的权衡关系，并揭示自动化评价指标与真实用户判断之间的系统性鸿沟。

Conclusion: 以人为中心的综述重新组织了扩散优化研究，为面向人类偏好的个性化生成系统提供了系统化参考。

Abstract: Diffusion models are evolving from general tools into personalized systems that adapt to user needs through fine-tuning and guidance. However, diffusion optimization mainly targets measurable objectives such as aesthetics, rarely examining whether they align with human intent. Human needs are multidimensional, contextual, and dynamic, whereas existing methods approximate them with fixed metrics. Because these metrics capture human needs only partially and may amplify deviations from true intent during optimization, higher scores need not yield results better matching human expectations. To understand how human needs enter and influence optimization, we systematically analyze how human intent is expressed, translated into optimizable objectives, applied to model behavior or generation, and evaluated through outputs. We further discuss trade-offs affecting human-intent alignment in personalized image generation and gaps between automated metrics and real user judgments. This human-centered synthesis reorganizes diffusion optimization and provides a systematic reference for personalized generation systems designed for human preferences.

</details>


### [332] [Every Pixel Is an Option: A System One Model for Medical Ultrasound Biometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03360)
*Moein Heidari,Junbo Rao,Yudan Chen,Yasamin Medghalchi,River Jiang,Wenjin Chen,David J. Foran,Jasmine Grewal,Ilker Hacihaliloglu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Kev-Bio：用视觉-语言模型以临床测量问题引导超声关键点检测，将语言模型的决策表示转为查询并与共享稠密超声特征匹配生成空间概率图，从而导出关键点坐标与临床测量值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超声生物测量依赖手动放置游标，存在操作者间差异；传统方法为不同任务设专用预测头，缺乏灵活性；现有视觉-语言模型直接回归坐标，未显式建模空间似然分布，难以刻画定位歧义性。

Method: 提出Kev-Bio视觉-语言模型，以临床测量问题作为指令输入；借鉴System One决策模型，利用语言模型的决策表示生成对应每个游标端点的查询；查询与共享稠密超声特征做匹配，输出空间概率图，再由概率图推导关键点坐标与临床测量；采用关键点定位损失与临床测量损失端到端联合训练。

Result: 在九视角FU/GU Biometry 2026数据集上，平均径向误差（MRE）为22.50像素，临床测量平均绝对误差（MAE）为15.38，整体性能优于对比基线。

Conclusion: 结果验证了Kev-Bio在不同解剖视角下的超声关键点检测与临床测量中的有效性，代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: **Purpose:** Ultrasound biometry is widely used across various clinical applications, including prenatal and cardiac examinations, to obtain quantitative measurements by placing calipers at anatomical landmarks. However, these measurements remain subject to interoperator variability as they rely largely on manual caliper placement. Conventional methods often use specialized prediction heads for different ultrasound tasks, whereas vision-language models offer flexibility through text instructions. However, direct coordinate prediction does not explicitly model spatial likelihood distributions, limiting the representation of localization ambiguity.
  **Methods:** We propose Kev-Bio, a vision-language model that uses clinical measurement questions to guide ultrasound landmark detection. Inspired by System One decision models, Kev-Bio uses decision representations of the language model to generate queries for each caliper endpoint. These queries are matched against shared dense ultrasound features to produce spatial probability maps, from which landmark coordinates and clinical measurements are derived. The model is trained end-to-end using both landmark localization and clinical measurement losses.
  **Results:** On the nine-view FU/GU Biometry 2026 dataset, Kev-Bio achieves a mean radial error (MRE) of 22.50 pixels and a clinical measurement mean absolute error (MAE) of 15.38, outperforming the compared baselines in overall performance.
  **Conclusion:** These results demonstrate the effectiveness of Kev-Bio for ultrasound landmark detection and clinical measurement across different anatomical views. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/moeinheidari7829/Kev-Bio.

</details>


### [333] [Align Once to Explain: Feature Alignment for Scalable B-cosification of Foundational Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03438)
*Raphael Maser,Siddhartha Gairola,Sukrut Rao,Bernt Schiele*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ALOE 提出一种一次性、无需标签的特征对齐方法，将基础视觉模型高效转化为内在可解释的 B-cos 变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础视觉模型性能强但高度不透明、难以解释；而从头训练可解释模型成本高，现有 B-cos 化方法转化效果差。

Method: 通过 ALign Once to Explain（一次性标签无关的特征对齐），将预训练基础模型的对齐到 B-cos 骨干，对齐后可作为下游任务的即插即用替代，摊薄可解释性成本。

Result: 在分类上显著优于原生 B-cos 化（DINOv3 ViT-B/16 的 ImageNet top-1 提升 10.5 个百分点），在少得多的数据下保持教师级泛化；线性探测、k-NN、零样本迁移均具竞争力；保留空间结构化特征用于稠密预测，并产生定位良好、高度可解释的解释。

Conclusion: ALOE 跨监督、自监督、视觉-语言等多种预训练范式鲁棒，可低成本地赋予基础模型内在可解释性且几乎不损性能。

Abstract: Foundational vision models have become the de facto standard for many vision tasks due to their strong performance. However, they are notoriously opaque and remain hard to interpret. We present ALOE (ALign Once to Explain), a one-time, label-free feature alignment approach that efficiently converts foundational vision models into inherently interpretable B-cos variants. Once aligned, the B-cos backbone is used as a drop-in replacement across several downstream tasks-amortizing the cost of interpretability. ALOE is robust across pre-training paradigms (supervised, self-supervised, vision-language) and can preserve teacher-level generalization with orders of magnitude less data than training from scratch. On classification, it strongly outperforms vanilla B-cosification (e.g., +10.5 p.p. top-1 on ImageNet for DINOv3 ViT-B/16), retains strong linear probing, k-NN, and zero-shot transfer competitive with foundational backbones (DINOv3, SigLIP2) across diverse downstream datasets. It also preserves spatially structured features useful for dense prediction, while yielding well-localized and highly human-interpretable explanations by design.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [334] [Steering Readerly Dynamics: Trajectory-Guided Story Generation with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00469)
*Danrui Li,Yiwei Zhao,Mubbasir Kapadia,Lingxiao Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出从高质量人类故事中学习"读者动态"（readerly dynamics）并用于引导故事生成的框架：用小型LLM把未来读者反应预测为低维轨迹，再由大型现成写作LLM按轨迹生成故事片段，轨迹保真度提升12%-35%且基本保持连贯性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM生成的故事难以复现"读者动态"——即随叙事推进而演变的读者反应，而这正是叙事体验的核心；直接对高维故事内容建模既困难又难以刻画这种动态。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1) 训练一个小型LLM，将未来读者反应建模为低维轨迹（而非高维故事内容）；(2) 利用现成大型写作LLM的指令遵循能力，在给定故事设定下生成遵循预测轨迹的故事片段。

Result: 在基于轨迹的保真度（trajectory-based fidelity）上相对人类撰写故事提升12%-35%，同时基本保持故事连贯性。

Conclusion: 以低维读者反应轨迹作为生成引导信号，可在不牺牲连贯性的前提下更贴近人类叙事的读者体验动态，为可控、以读者体验为中心的故事生成提供可行路径。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate stories, but these stories struggle to reproduce engaging readerly dynamics, the evolving reader responses that shape narrative experience. To address this challenge, we propose a framework that learns readerly dynamics from high-quality human-written stories and uses them to guide story generation. Instead of directly modeling high-dimensional story content, we train a small LLM to predict future reader responses as low-dimensional trajectories. We then leverage the strong instruction-following capability of a larger, off-the-shelf writer LLM to generate story segments that follow these predicted trajectories within a given story setting. Our framework improves trajectory-based fidelity to human-written stories by 12%-35% while largely preserving story coherence.

</details>


### [335] [Humanized but Still True? Auditing Facts and Detection in AI-Text Humanizers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00359)
*Ziyuan Wang,Genliang Zhu,Xiaobo Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文检验AI"humanizer"改写后文本中可核查细节（数字、日期、人名/机构名、引文片段）是否被保留，发现11款商用工具在35-65%含此类单元的文档中至少改动或删除一个单元，且单元保真度与检测规避效果并无明确相关；并提出用通用决策模型Jev以单次零样本提问区分人类原文与humanized改写。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有humanizer公开排行榜仅衡量规避检测成功率与嵌入相似度，未评估可核查事实细节是否在改写中幸存；同时缺乏对"改写后文本仍可验证"这一维度的系统测量与相应检测手段。

Method: 构建基于规则的单元保留检查器（经两名AI标注员验证：精确率0.84-1.00，召回0.93-0.95，无人工标注）；在2026年10月与9月两个公开humanizer排行榜周期评测11款商用工具，并测试一个开源12B humanizer及其4个发布文件（含两个量化感知低比特版本）；以Spearman相关检验单元保留与检测规避的关系；在匹配的人类原文、AI风格改写与humanized改写联邦文本上，用通用决策模型Jev以单次零样本问题做起源判别，并与Binoculars、Fast-DetectGPT、RADAR对比；假设、数据规则与分析在主要实验前冻结。

Result: 10月周期中11款工具全部在35-65%的含单元文档里改动或删除至少一个单元；仅计数字与人名时，11款中仍有10款在≥20%文档中出现改动；9月周期为19-50%。开源12B模型在事实密集的美国联邦机构文本中保留≥97%的数字与人名，但违背自身提示改写了67-78%的引文片段。单元保留与检测规避无明确关系（Spearman rho=-0.46，95% CI -0.65至0.08），4个模型文件也未呈现预注册的单调权衡。Jev区分人类原文与humanized改写AUROC 0.864（0.827-0.902），比Binoculars、Fast-DetectGPT、RADAR高0.18-0.22，但在0.5阈值下将24%人类原文判为AI；对2026年模型的AI风格改写，两种困惑度检测器低于随机水平（AUROC 0.37与0.39）。

Conclusion: humanizer改写普遍破坏可核查细节，而事实保真度与规避检测能力并不呈权衡关系；现有困惑度类检测器在最新改写下失效，通用决策模型的零样本判别更有效但误报率偏高。作者公开检查器与逐条结果，强调评估应纳入可核查单元保留维度。

Abstract: AI "humanizers" rewrite machine-generated text so that detectors classify it as human-written. Public leaderboards score evasion and embedding similarity, but not whether checkable details survive. We check whether numbers, dates, person and organization names, and quoted spans survive each rewrite, using a rule-based checker validated by two AI annotators (precision 0.84-1.00, recall 0.93-0.95; no human annotation). In the October 2026 cycle of a public humanizer leaderboard, all 11 commercial tools changed or dropped at least one of these units in 35-65% of the documents that contained one. Most changes were to quoted spans; counting numbers and names alone, 10 of the 11 tools still altered at least one in 20% or more of the documents. The September 2026 cycle was similar (19-50%). An open 12B humanizer kept at least 97% of numbers and names in fact-dense U.S. federal agency text, but reworded 67-78% of the quoted spans, against its own prompt. Unit retention and detector evasion were not clearly related across tools (Spearman rho = -0.46, 95% CI -0.65 to 0.08), and the open model's four released files (two of them quantization-aware low-bit files) did not show the pre-registered monotone trade-off. On federal texts with matched human, AI-styled and humanized versions, a general-purpose decision model, Jev, asked a single zero-shot question, separated human originals from humanized rewrites with AUROC 0.864 (0.827-0.902), 0.18-0.22 higher than Binoculars, Fast-DetectGPT and the adversarially trained RADAR, while calling 24% of the human originals AI at a 0.5 threshold. On the AI-styled rewrites by 2026 models, both perplexity-based detectors scored below chance (AUROC 0.37 and 0.39), also with line breaks removed. Hypotheses, data rules and analyses were frozen before the main runs; two earlier data contacts are disclosed. We release the checker and the per-item results.

</details>


### [336] [Accounting for Irregular State Transitions through Belief Estimation in Online Medical Consultation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01474)
*Mingzhe Lu,Xiangru Chen,Jian Qin,Yunpeng Li,Xihan Gao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文刻画在线医疗问诊中患者自发披露与话题转移导致临床状态逐步暴露的对话动态，提出受POMDP启发的PRISM框架，将临床分诊分解为信念估计、策略优化与回复生成三部分，显著优于前沿LLM与临床智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线问诊扩大了医疗可及性，但患者不受提示的自我披露与话题切换频繁打断医生问诊，使临床状态是在对话推进中逐步显现的，现有方法难以应对这种漂移的对话轨迹。

Method: 1) 结合已有评测指标与本工作设计的任务特定交互指标刻画上述对话动态；2) 在16个医疗对话数据集上开展实证研究；3) 提出PRISM框架，受部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）启发，解耦潜在状态估计与动作选择，将临床分诊因子化为信念估计、策略优化和回复实现，维护对问诊状态的演化后验信念，并基于最大后验状态（MAP）条件化动作选择。

Result: 真实在线交互在上下文连续性和可预测性上显著低于离线与模拟基准；PRISM大幅超越前沿LLM与临床智能体，临床决策准确率提升22.40个百分点，BERTScore_F1超过最强基线5.51分；消融显示为所有基线提供oracle问诊状态可平均提升BERTScore_F1 5.58分。

Conclusion: 真实在线问诊的高不确定性与低上下文连续性需要显式建模临床状态的隐变量演化；PRISM通过解耦信念估计与动作选择有效应对患者主导的话题漂移，且准确的问诊状态引导是提升回复质量的关键因素。

Abstract: While online medical consultation broadens access, unprompted patient disclosures and topic shifts frequently disrupt clinician inquiry, leaving clinical states progressively revealed. We characterize these dynamics using both existing evaluation metrics and task-specific interaction metrics designed in this work. Through an empirical study across 16 medical dialogue datasets, we show that authentic online interactions exhibit substantially lower contextual continuity and higher unpredictability than offline and simulated benchmarks. We propose PRISM (Policy Reasoning with Inferred States for Medicine), a framework inspired by partially observable Markov decision processes that decouples latent state estimation from action selection to address drifting dialogue trajectories. Specifically, PRISM factorizes clinical triage into belief estimation, policy optimization, and response realization. By maintaining an evolving posterior belief over consultation states and conditioning action selection on the maximum a posteriori state, PRISM advances clinical goals while accommodating patient-initiated shifts. Extensive evaluations show that PRISM substantially outperforms frontier LLMs and clinical agents, achieving a 22.40 percentage point gain in clinical decision accuracy alongside decisive improvements in response generation, surpassing the strongest baseline by 5.51 points in BERTScore_F1. Furthermore, ablation studies show that providing oracle consultation states consistently boosts response quality across all evaluated baselines by guiding their action reasoning, yielding average gains of 5.58 points in BERTScore_F1.

</details>


### [337] [XDecideBench: Evaluating Typed Decision Models and Confidence Policies Across Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01370)
*Marek Šuppa,Jaroslav Kopčan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出XDecideBench（9套件、122种语言、88,425条文本、153,875个类型化问题），统一评分口径，揭示"单一最佳模型"假设在跨语言类型化决策任务中失效，并剖析微调增益与置信度阈值的跨语言迁移问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言应用中，类型决策模型（typed decision models）常用于路由与内容审核，且通常只对超过置信度阈值的决策采取行动。然而现有评测缺乏统一评分契约、跨语言可比性差，且隐含"存在一个跨语言通用的最佳模型"的假设。作者希望系统检验：模型排名是否随套件变化、英语 hindsight 选模能否跨语言泛化、多语言微调收益是否真实来自目标语言、以及英语校准的置信度阈值能否迁移。

Method: 构建XDecideBench：九个套件、覆盖122种语言、88,425条文本、153,875个类型化问题，所有套件共享同一评分契约；将条目分为对齐（aligned）、本地标注（locally labelled）与母语（native）三类分别报告。实验包括：(1) 跨套件比较模型排名；(2) 以后见之明在英语上选最优模型，检验其在各"套件—语言"单元的表现；(3) 对比针对类型化决策微调的三个开源模型与其基座Qwen模型（12种开发语言）；(4) 在本地运行Qwen，用预注册的留出队列验证"低网络文本语言增益更大"的假设，并分解错误修复比例；(5) 用英语数据设定5%错误率的置信度阈值，在其他语言上检验实际错误率。

Result: 模型排名随套件而变。英语 hindsight 最优模型在约四分之一的"套件—语言"单元中显著落后，在缅甸语Belebele上远不及最佳模型。三个微调开源模型在全部12种开发语言上均优于其基座Qwen。预注册留出队列确认：四个网络文本最少的语言上的准确率增益大于六个网络文本最多的语言；但两类语言中微调修复的基座错误比例相近，故增益更大可能反映基座模型更弱。英语数据设定5%错误率的阈值在XNLI上被超出，德语、法语亦然。

Conclusion: "在英语上后见之明选出的单一最佳模型"不可作为跨语言默认方案；应以套件与语言单元级评测替代聚合排名。低资源语言上微调的更大增益可能来自更弱的基座而非更强的迁移，需谨慎归因。置信度阈值不可跨语言迁移，须按语言本地校准。XDecideBench的统一评分契约与三类条目分报为多语言类型化决策提供了可复现的评测基础。

Abstract: Applications use Typed Decision Models to route and moderate text in many languages, and they often act only on decisions above a confidence threshold. We introduce XDecideBench, a benchmark of nine suites in 122 languages with 88,425 texts and 153,875 typed questions. All suites share one scoring contract, and we report aligned, locally labelled and native items separately. Model rankings change from suite to suite. The model that is best in English, chosen in hindsight, loses significantly in about a quarter of the suite-language cells, and on Burmese Belebele it falls far behind the best model. Three open models fine-tuned for typed decisions beat the Qwen models they were built from in all twelve development languages. When the Qwen models are run locally, a pre-registered held-out cohort confirms that the accuracy gain is larger in the four languages with the least web text than in the six with the most. In both sets of languages, however, fine-tuning fixes a similar share of the base model's errors, so the larger gain may reflect weaker base models. A confidence threshold set on English data to allow 5% errors exceeds that error rate on XNLI, even in German and French.

</details>


### [338] [Wrong Together: Shared Bias in User Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01354)
*Saber Zerhoudi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文检验语言模型用户模拟器之间的分歧能否作为估计可靠性的信号，并讨论共有偏差的处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在收集真实人类回答之前，研究者需要评估模拟器生成的估计（群体响应比例及组间差异）是否可靠，因此需要一种低成本的有效性信号。

Method: 使用6个语言模型模拟器和GlobalOpinionQA数据集（12个国家、60个问题），以模拟器间分歧预测无效性；通过一组群体估计共有偏差，并将其从另一组群体的预测中扣除以进行校正；并做回顾性分析，模拟将分歧最大的20%组间比较转交人工评估。

Result: 分歧对组间差异无效性的预测更准确（AUC 0.87），对单一群体响应比例的预测较弱（AUC 0.71）。模拟器共有的误差无法被该信号捕捉；当共有误差对两组影响相同时会在比较中抵消，从而解释了组间差异结果更强。偏差校正降低了预测误差而不改变模拟器间分歧。回顾性分析中，剩余有明确有效性判断的比较中判为无效的比例由63.7%降至54.8%。

Conclusion: 模拟器间分歧是识别不可靠估计的有用但不完备的信号，对组间差异尤为有效；共有偏差需单独估计与校正，转交人工评估可提升判断质量。

Abstract: User simulators generate responses in place of human participants, allowing researchers to estimate the result of a study. To use these estimates before collecting human responses, researchers need a way to assess their reliability. We test whether disagreement among simulators can identify unreliable estimates of a group's response proportions and of differences between groups. We evaluate this signal using 6 language-model simulators and existing GlobalOpinionQA responses for 60 questions in 12 countries. Disagreement predicts invalidity more accurately for differences between two groups than for a single group's response proportions (AUC 0.87 versus 0.71). Errors shared by the simulators remain invisible to this signal. When such an error affects both groups equally, it cancels in the comparison, helping explain the stronger result for group differences. We test this explanation by estimating the shared bias using one set of groups and subtracting it from predictions for a separate set. This correction reduces prediction error without changing disagreement among the simulators. In a retrospective analysis, we simulate referring the 20% of group comparisons with the greatest disagreement for human assessment. Among the remaining comparisons with a conclusive validity judgment, 54.8% are judged invalid, compared with 63.7% before referral.

</details>


### [339] [Character-Name Concentration in LLM Fiction: Measuring Displacement and Mitigating Repetition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01284)
*Alejandro Mozo Quesada,Sergio Gálvez Rojas,Francisco López Valverde*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究系统评测了8种提示层面的人名集中度控制策略，并提出免微调的"speculative naming"方法，在约4.5万篇故事上将Slop Ratio降低95%，且自然度接近基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM小说中角色名高度集中于Elara、Elias等少数重复名字，是"AI slop"的可量化表征。现有方案或需logit访问/重训练，或仅按单次请求控制、无法在语料层面约束集中度；同时，提示层面策略的降集中效果及其对名字自然度的代价缺乏系统测量。

Method: 在8种策略上开展实证研究，并提出speculative naming：将推测解码的draft-verify-reject范式从token迁移到人名。通过verbalized sampling请求候选名字集合，用结合模型指纹与运行时计数器的SlopTracker打分，再经温控选择规则或其严格变体HARD进行筛选。用20个LLM、4种语言、文本与视觉刺激生成44,782篇故事（88,919个具名角色），以无需固定名单的碰撞指标Slop Ratio评估，并分解为已知与涌现成分。

Result: 基于名单的策略无效：静态禁用表将集中度转移至涌现名，并使真实存在名字的占比下降一半以上。speculative naming仅靠采样脚手架即平均降低SR 89%，加动态追踪器后总降幅达95%，平均碰撞概率由7.3%降至0.4%，已知名碰撞保持为零，自然度接近基线（各语言42–69%可溯源为真实名字），故事内碰撞率由4.3%降至0.2%。策略排序在语言、模型家族与名字计数口径间稳定。

Conclusion: 人名集中度可在语料层面有效控制，且无需logit访问或重训练；命名之外更广泛的创造性多样性仍是开放问题。

Abstract: Character names in large language model (LLM) fiction concentrate on a handful of recurrent names such as 'Elara' and 'Elias', a measurable face of AI slop. Existing fixes either require logit access or retraining, or operate per request and cannot control concentration across a corpus. How much prompt-level strategies reduce concentration, and at what cost to name naturalness, has not been systematically measured. We present an empirical study of name-concentration control across eight strategies and introduce speculative naming, a fine-tuning-free method that adapts the draft-verify-reject paradigm of speculative decoding from tokens to names. The method requests candidate name-sets through verbalized sampling, scores them against a SlopTracker that combines a per-model fingerprint with a runtime counter, and selects through a temperature-controlled rule or its strict variant (HARD). We use 20 LLMs to generate 44,782 stories in four languages from text and visual stimuli (88,919 named characters), and measure concentration with a list-free collision metric (Slop Ratio, SR) decomposed into known and emergent components. List-based strategies do not remove slop: static banlists displace concentration to emergent names and more than halve the share of attested real names. Speculative naming removes it: the sampling scaffold alone cuts SR by 89% on average, the dynamic tracker brings the total reduction to 95%, mean collision probability falls from 7.3% to 0.4%, and known-name collisions hold at zero while naturalness stays close to baseline (42-69% attested by language) and within-story collisions drop from 4.3% to 0.2%. The strategy ranking is stable across languages, model families, and name-counting conventions. Name concentration is thus controllable at the corpus level without logit access or retraining; broader creative diversity beyond naming remains open.

</details>


### [340] [Does a Norwegian further-trained model give more outdated legal values than its base model? A preregistered paired comparison of Borealis 2 and Gemma 4](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02334)
*Eirik Botten Nicolaysen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该预注册研究在封闭基准 norregel 上比较 Borealis 2 与 Gemma 4 输出挪威法规过时数值的频率，主结果显示两者差异在预设最小感兴趣效应范围内，判定为无实质差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估对挪威国家图书馆基于 Gemma 4 继续训练的 Borealis 2 是否比原模型更少输出挪威法律与法规中的过时数值，即检验领域继续训练对时间性事实准确性的实际影响。

Method: 预注册研究（doi:10.5281/zenodo.23858965），使用封闭基准 norregel，按数值历史进行确定性评分。主分析限于 503 个主条目中两模型均给出可解释答案的 411 项，采用配对比较：各自单独过时的条目数、差值百分比点、95% 聚类自助法区间及精确单侧 McNemar 检验；预设判定规则为整个区间落在 ±10 个百分点的最小感兴趣效应内即视为无效应。次要指标采用 Holm 校正；另对两个较小的 Borealis 模型做探索性比较。

Result: 仅 Borealis 2 过时 10 项，仅 Gemma 4 过时 11 项；d = -0.2 个百分点，95% 聚类自助区间 [-2.7, +2.5]，精确单侧 McNemar p = 0.668。区间完全位于 ±10 个百分点内，按预注册规则判为无感兴趣效应。次要指标中仅"给出在提问日期之后生效的数值"这一项经 Holm 校正后仍有差异，且 Gemma 4 更频繁。两个较小模型的探索性比较无不一致对，不具信息量。

Conclusion: 在该基准上未发现 Borealis 2 相对 Gemma 4 在过时数值输出上的实质性改善；研究设计仅比较已发布模型，无法归因于训练的任何具体组成部分。

Abstract: We compare how often two released language models give outdated numeric values from Norwegian statutes and regulations: NbAiLab/borealis2-26b-a4b-preview (Borealis 2), which the National Library of Norway further trained from google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it (Gemma 4), and Gemma 4 itself. The study was preregistered (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23858965) and uses the closed norregel benchmark, scored deterministically against a value history. On the 411 of 503 primary items where both models gave an interpretable answer, Borealis 2 alone was outdated on 10 items and Gemma 4 alone on 11 (d = -0.2 percentage points, 95% cluster bootstrap interval [-2.7, +2.5], exact one-sided McNemar p = 0.668). By the preregistered rule this is no effect of interest: the whole interval lies within the smallest effect of interest of +/-10 percentage points. Among the secondary measures, only the share of answers giving a value that took effect after the question date differs after Holm correction; Gemma 4 gave such answers more often. An exploratory comparison of two smaller Borealis models had no discordant pairs and is not informative. The design compares released models and does not isolate the effect of any part of their training.

</details>


### [341] [Current state of LLMs for Arabic dialectal machine translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02271)
*Josef Jon,Rawan Bondok,Ondřej Bojar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 评估多种LLM在MADAR数据集上16种阿拉伯方言的英阿双向机器翻译能力，采用BLEU/CHRF/COMET/GEMBA及小规模人工评测，并测试方言分类能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿拉伯方言多样性给机器翻译带来显著困难，现有LLM在该任务上的能力与局限缺乏系统评测，且方言场景下的自动评测方法本身存在挑战。

Method: 在MADAR数据集上对英语↔阿拉伯语双向、16种方言进行评测；模型涵盖专用阿拉伯模型（Jais、Nile）、多语言模型（Gemma、Command-R、Mistral、Aya）与商用API（GPT-4.1）；使用BLEU、CHRF、COMET（有参考/无参考）、GEMBA（LLM-as-a-judge）及小规模人工评估；另测LLM的方言分类能力。

Result: 结果显示当前LLM在处理方言多样性方面存在明显困难，翻译质量受限；同时讨论了自动MT评测在阿拉伯方言语境下的局限，并提示结果可能受训练数据污染影响。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了现有LLM在方言阿拉伯语机器翻译上的能力与局限，强调方言多样性是主要瓶颈，且需警惕数据污染对评测结论的干扰。

Abstract: This work presents an evaluation of large language models (LLMs) for English to dialectal Arabic machine translation on the MADAR dataset. We evaluate both translation directions (English to Arabic and vice-versa) on 16 Arabic dialects. Our experiments cover a diverse set of models, including specialized Arabic models (Jais, Nile), multilingual models (Gemma, Command-R, Mistral, Aya), and commercial APIs (GPT-4.1). We employ multiple evaluation metrics: BLEU, CHRF, COMET (both reference-based and reference-less variants) and GEMBA (LLM-as-a-judge), as well as a small-scale manual evaluation, to assess translation quality. We discuss the challenges of automatic MT evaluation, especially in the context of Arabic dialects. We also evaluate the ability of LLMs to classify the dialect used in a text. The study offers insights into the capabilities and limitations of current LLMs for dialectal Arabic machine translation, particularly highlighting the difficulty of handling dialectal diversity, although the results may be influenced by possible training data contamination, which is always a concern with LLMs.

</details>


### [342] [Multi-Agent Collusion and the J-Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02153)
*Marco Molinari,Gabriele Bettineschi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文在 NARCBench 共谋基准上对 DeepSeek-V4-Flash（284B）做可解释性实验，发现共谋行为本身编码于智能体的 J-space 中（86% 的共谋者在回复前表征出虚假陈述、隐匿或悔意），并据此提出无监督共谋检测方法 J-PACT，在四个开源权重模型上保留监督探针 85% 的 AUROC 优势、在隐写场景持平，并在 99% 的检出运行中能定位共谋配对。


<details>
