Abstract: Software development sessions often involve several unfinished tasks rather than one issue carried through to completion. As coding agents take on repository-level development, they need to recover an earlier task's requirements and partial progress after intervening work. Existing repository-level benchmarks typically score one issue-to-patch episode and do not directly measure whether an agent can resume a task after advancing other unfinished work in the same repository. We introduce \textbf{\ourmethod}, a benchmark for focus-task resumption in sessions that interleave unfinished tasks drawn from the same source repository, with a persistent checkout for each task. Each focus task is evaluated in matched uninterrupted and switched sessions with identical focus requirements and executable verifiers. The switched session interleaves ordered stages from other unfinished tasks in the same repository, while only the final focus patch is scored. \ourmethod~contains 200 focus tasks from 19 Python repositories, reconstructed from issue, pull-request, and review histories and rendered as 400 matched session specifications. Across 7 coding agents, interleaved unfinished work produces an average focus-task resolution gap of 11.5 percentage points, ranging from 6.0 to 15.0 percentage points. Trajectory analysis identifies cross-task requirement confusion and loss of task state as recurrent resumption behaviors. We introduce a plug-in context-management module that selects task-relevant history and maintains concise task-state summaries. On OpenCode, the module improves focus-task completion under same-repository task switching by 5.5 to 15.5 percentage points across the evaluated models. Code is available at github.com/Miraclecsc/Switch-SWE.

</details>


### [411] [MedPsy: State-of-the-Art Small Medical Language Models for Efficient Edge Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02011)
*Davide Vitabile,Alexandro Buffa,Akshay Nambiar,Amril Nazir*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MedPsy：面向边缘部署的1.7B/4B医疗语言模型，通过合成数据+235B教师CoT蒸馏、四阶段后训练课程（2×SFT+2×RL含难例挖掘）与GGUF量化部署评测，在准确率-生成长度-效率间取得更优权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强开源LLM过大无法在私有边缘设备部署；紧凑医疗模型在知识密集型与真实医疗任务上明显落后；可纳入边缘内存预算的推理模型产生长思维链，导致顺序解码开销、端到端延迟、能耗及KV-cache内存压力上升。故需同时优化准确性、生成长度与效率。

Method: 构建覆盖生物、医学、健康的合成医疗数据流水线，并用235B医疗专用教师模型生成CoT目标；四阶段后训练课程（两阶段SFT+两阶段RL，含hard-sample mining）；边缘部署评测，覆盖多种GGUF量化变体与笔记本、手机真机推理。

Result: 7个封闭式医疗基准：MedPsy-4B超MedGemma-1.5-4B 19.34分，并匹配MedGemma-27B（小6.75倍）；MedPsy-1.7B超MedGemma-1.5-4B 11.42分（体量不足其一半）。HealthBench-Hard：4B超MedGemma-27B 15.33分，1.7B超11.66分（小约16倍）。平均响应长度较Qwen3基座缩短1.7倍（1.7B）/3.2倍（4B）；Q4_K_M量化综合分与BF16差距1分内，磁盘占用降约69%。真机推理：同量化下中位端到端延迟与单答案估算能耗均降75%，峰值RAM在测试的笔记本与手机配置上均<5GB。

Conclusion: 小规模医疗模型经合成数据+强教师CoT蒸馏与多阶段SFT/RL课程，可在边缘可承受的内存与延迟预算内达到甚至超越大得多的医疗模型；缩短生成长度是提升端侧效率的关键杠杆，且Q4_K_M量化近似无损。

Abstract: Medical language models promise expert clinical support, but the strongest open-source LLMs remain too large for private edge-device deployment, while compact medical models still trail substantially on knowledge-intensive and real-world healthcare tasks. Reasoning models that fit edge memory budgets can produce long reasoning traces, increasing sequential decoding, end-to-end latency, energy consumption, and KV-cache memory pressure. We present MedPsy, a family of text-only 1.7B and 4B medical language models designed for edge deployment, targeting this accuracy-generation-efficiency trade-off. Our recipe combines a synthetic medical data pipeline over biology, medicine, and health seeds with chain-of-thought targets from a 235B medical-focused LLM teacher; a four-stage post-training curriculum comprising two SFT stages followed by two RL stages with hard-sample mining; and an edge deployment evaluation spanning multiple GGUF quantization variants and real-device inference on laptop and smartphone hardware. On seven closed-ended medical benchmarks, MedPsy-4B surpasses MedGemma-1.5-4B by 19.34 points and matches MedGemma-27B while being 6.75x smaller; MedPsy-1.7B outperforms MedGemma-1.5-4B by 11.42 points despite being less than half its size. On HealthBench-Hard, MedPsy-4B surpasses MedGemma-27B by 15.33 points, while MedPsy-1.7B surpasses it by 11.66 points despite being ~16x smaller. Beyond accuracy, MedPsy reduces average response length by 1.7x (1.7B) and 3.2x (4B) versus its Qwen3 backbones, while Q4_K_M quantization preserves the aggregate score within 1 point of BF16 with ~69% lower disk footprint. In real-device inference, MedPsy-4B's shorter generations translate into 75% lower median end-to-end latency and estimated energy per answer than its Qwen3 backbone at matched quantization, while peak RAM remains below 5 GB across our tested laptop and smartphone configurations.

</details>


### [412] [GRIPS: An Empirical Study of Pre-SQL Grounding Information for SQL Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02314)
*Ekata Mitra,Yufei Tao,Kamalamalini Nagasundaram,Ameeta Agrawal*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究"SQL 生成前的结构化信息何时有助于 Text-to-SQL"，发现 grounding（问题提及到表/列/值/关系的链接）错误是最大失败类别，提出三阶段方法 GRIPS，在 20 个设置中 18 个优于基线，平均提升 11.8 个百分点并降低 47.8% token 消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Text-to-SQL 系统可能在 SQL 生成前就因错误的实体/关系链接（table、column、value、relation）而失败，即使生成合法 SQL 也返回错误答案。作者希望回答：哪些 pre-SQL 信息真正有助于 SQL 生成器，以及额外信息何时不再有帮助。

Method: 在 TempTabQA-C 与 BIRD 上审计 SQL Static 的失败类型，发现 grounding 错误占比最大；据此提出 GRIPS（Grounding Representation and Input Processing for SQL generation），一个三阶段方法，在查询生成前显式导出结构化 pre-SQL 信息，并含自适应变体 GRIPS-Adaptive。

Result: 在 GPT-5-nano 与 Llama-70B 上，GRIPS-Adaptive 在 20 个设置中 18 个优于 SQL Static，平均准确率提升 11.8 个百分点，同时减少 47.8% 的模型调用 token 消耗；受控分析显示部分 grounding 信息能改善生成，但增加更多 pre-SQL 信息并不稳定有效。

Conclusion: 将"问题-输入 grounding"与"SQL 生成"分离可使 Text-to-SQL 更准确、更高效且更易诊断；关键在于选择性引入有效的 grounding 信息而非盲目堆叠上下文。

Abstract: Text-to-SQL systems answer natural language questions over structured data, but can fail before SQL generation by linking question mentions to the wrong table, column, value, or relation. Even valid SQL can then return an incorrect answer. This raises a central question: What pre-SQL information helps a SQL generator, and when does additional information cease to help? We investigate this question on TempTabQA-C and BIRD. Among the audited SQL Static failures, grounding errors form the largest category on both benchmarks. We introduce GRIPS (Grounding Representation and Input Processing for SQL generation), a three-stage method that derives structured pre-SQL information to make these decisions explicit before query generation. Across GPT-5-nano and Llama-70B, GRIPS-Adaptive improves over SQL Static in 18 of 20 settings, with an average accuracy gain of 11.8 percentage points, while reducing model-call token usage by 47.8%. Our controlled analysis shows which grounding information can improve SQL generation, whereas adding more pre-SQL information does not consistently help. By separating question-input grounding from SQL generation, GRIPS makes text-to-SQL more accurate, efficient, and easier to diagnose.

</details>


### [413] [FOLLIE: Automated Reasoning over the First Dataset of Sentences with their First-Order Logical Representation for French](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02129)
*Maximos Skandalis*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: FOLLIE 是首个面向法语、可直接用于自然语言推理（NLI）的 NL-to-FOL 资源，含 19,983 条推理记录与 36,987 条句子槽—公式映射，并配套基于 Prover9/Mace4 的自动推理引擎。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法语的 NLI 研究缺乏将句子与组合式一阶逻辑表示相连接的可实验资源；作者希望为研究"句子解释如何衔接演绎推理"所依赖的表示与假设提供法语实验基础。

Method: 数据来自六个异质 NLI 源，保留法语词汇材料与源问题结构；银标注由神经—符号流水线生成（另含 111 条 LLM 辅助补充），流程包括形态句法分析、概率条件化的范畴多标记（categorial multitagging）、语法证明搜索、话语表示与一阶语义构造。推理端构建输入条件化的背景理论，覆盖词汇关系、量化、数量、事件结构与时间依赖，用 Prover9 证成蕴含与矛盾、Mace4 做有界一致性检验。

Result: 分阶段实验显示推导覆盖率显著提升；三分类准确率为 FraCaS-FR 65.37%（335 题）、GQNLI-FR 70.33%（300 题）、SICK-FR 71.35%（9,399 条）；在已判定决策中与参考标签一致率分别为 93.53%、100.00%、98.66%，对应承诺覆盖率 41.49%、37.00%、15.05%。

Conclusion: FOLLIE 通过实例化构造、公理模式与证明分析，辨识出辖域、指称、词汇知识与数值结构对推理结果的贡献，为法语 NLI 的符号化表示研究提供可复现的实验平台。

Abstract: FOLLIE (for First-Order Logic for Language Inference and Entailment for French) connects French sentences, compositional first-order representations and automated natural language inference (NLI). The first French NLI-ready, NL-to-FOL resource, it contains 19,983 inference records and 36,987 non-empty sentence-slot--formula mappings from six heterogeneous NLI sources, retaining French lexical material and source problem structure. Its silver annotations are produced by a neural--symbolic pipeline, with 111 separately identified LLM-assisted additions. The construction combines morphosyntactic analysis, probability-conditioned categorial multitagging, grammatical proof search, discourse representation and first-order semantic construction. Stage-wise experiments show substantial gains in derivation coverage; analyses of conjunction distributions, logical-operator incidence and scope alternation characterise the resulting resource. We then develop an automatic inference engine whose input-conditioned background theories address lexical relations, quantification, quantities, event structure and temporal dependencies. Prover9 supplies proofs for entailment and contradiction, while Mace4 supports bounded consistency checks. Three-way accuracies are 65.37% on all 335 FraCaS-FR problems, 70.33% on 300 GQNLI-FR problems and 71.35% on 9,399 eligible SICK-FR records pooled across splits. Agreement with reference labels among committed decisions is 93.53%, 100.00% and 98.66%, at commitment coverage of 41.49%, 37.00% and 15.05%, respectively. Worked constructions, axiom schemas and proof analyses explain these outcomes and identify the contributions of scope, reference, lexical knowledge and numerical structure. FOLLIE provides a French experimental basis for studying the representations and assumptions that connect sentence interpretation to deductive inference.

</details>


### [414] [Step-dLLM: Adaptive Step-aware Sparse Attention for Efficient Diffusion LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01320)
*Zhichen Zeng,Xichong Zhang,Junpan Wu,Yifei Zuo,Chi-Chih Chang,Jiayi Wang,Maohua Nie,Ji Liu,Ang Li,Banghua Zhu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Step-dLLM 通过在去噪轨迹的锚点步周期性刷新块稀疏掩码、并在局部一致区间内复用，同时采用头自适应全局稀疏预算，配合 Triton 核实现免重训的 dLLM 稀疏注意力加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）靠迭代去噪并行生成 token，但双向注意力使其无法使用 KV 缓存，每步都需重算完整注意力图，单步开销呈二次增长。现有 dLLM 稀疏注意力方法存在两点不足：一是在初始全注意力预热后构建一次稀疏掩码并沿用至剩余所有步；二是在各注意力头之间均匀分配稀疏预算。这两点忽略了 dLLM 注意力的关键结构特性。

Method: 作者观察到两个经验现象：注意力模式仅在步间局部一致，并在某些转折处突然变化；不同注意力头集中注意力质量的程度差异很大。据此提出 Step-dLLM：沿去噪轨迹在锚点步周期性刷新块稀疏掩码，并在每个局部一致区间内复用该掩码；同时采用头自适应全局预算，对注意力更集中的头施加更激进的压缩。实现上配备融合的 IO-aware Triton 块稀疏注意力核。

Result: 在免重训条件下应用于预训练模型 LLaDA-1.5 与 Dream-7B-Instruct。在 LLaDA-1.5、8K 上下文、256 去噪步、90% 稀疏度设置下，相比稠密 FlashAttention 取得 2.78x 端到端加速，并且在精度—延迟权衡上优于先前的稀疏注意力方法。

Conclusion: dLLM 的注意力在时间和头上均呈现非均匀结构，按此结构设计稀疏化策略（周期性掩码刷新 + 头自适应预算）可在不重训的情况下显著降低 dLLM 推理延迟并保持精度，为 dLLM 高效推理提供了可行方向。

Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate tokens in parallel via iterative denoising, but their bidirectional attention prevents the KV caching used by autoregressive models and recomputes the full attention map at every step, incurring quadratic per-step cost. Existing sparse attention methods for dLLMs construct a sparse mask after an initial full-attention warm-up and reuse it for the remaining steps, while allocating the sparsity budget uniformly across heads. We argue both choices ignore key structural properties of attention in dLLMs: empirically, attention patterns are only locally consistent across steps and shift abruptly at certain transitions, and different heads concentrate their attention mass to very different extents. To this end, we design Step-dLLM, which periodically refreshes a block-sparse mask at anchor steps along the denoising trajectory and reuses it within each locally consistent interval, while employing a head-adaptive global budget that more aggressively compresses heads with concentrated attention. Backed by a fused IO-aware Triton kernel for block-sparse attention, Step-dLLM applies to pre-trained LLaDA-1.5 and Dream-7B-Instruct without retraining, achieving a 2.78x end-to-end speedup over dense FlashAttention on LLaDA-1.5 at 8K context with 256 denoising steps and 90% sparsity, while improving the accuracy-latency trade-off over prior sparse-attention methods.

</details>


### [415] [Cross-Prompt Reuse of Entity-Replacement Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00352)
*Jinkun Chen,Xuemin Yu,Sijia Han,Vlado Keselj*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在固定模型权重下，测量实体替换响应在英语事实问题间的隐藏状态迁移程度：隐藏复用可降低其他关系源的无变化误差达45%-68%，但主要复现两关系共享的位移，未可靠降低关系选择性误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超越"答案是否改变"这一表层指标，量化实体替换响应在多大程度上以隐藏状态变化的形式在同类实体的不同问题之间迁移，并区分关系共享效应与关系选择性效应。

Method: 将两个源问题的隐藏状态变化加到同一实体的目标问题上；在已知答案前缀下，比较两关系公开答案间的预测对数概率位移与实测位移。隐藏复用在对齐变化注入至目标剩余层之前的50%深度处；直接复用则叠加源输出分数变化。采用不同关系源与目标关系源两类设置，并考察BOS token、模型规模、chat格式与新实体的影响。

Result: 其他关系源下，隐藏复用消除无变化误差：0.5-1B Qwen与Llama为45%和49%；Gemma-2-2B仅22%，纯文本且无默认BOS时三项比较仅通过一项；恢复BOS后达58%-68%，三个队列全部通过。更大检查点、chat格式与新实体显示可复现性，也存在格式或队列依赖的失败。目标关系源下，隐藏复用相对直接复用的后验优势为0.2-0.9 nats（chat格式外），未获确认且非替换特异。在两句实体token处施加同一关系中性变化，比随机或其他替换变化更能降低关系选择性误差，表明存在接收问题依赖性。

Conclusion: 小幅纯文本检查点上，其他关系隐藏复用主要复现两关系问题共享的位移，而未可靠降低关系选择性误差；隐蔽状态迁移受格式（如BOS）、队列与规模制约，且关系中性变化的效果依赖接收问题。

Abstract: With model weights fixed, we measure how much of an entity-replacement response transfers between English factual questions, beyond whether answers change. We add the hidden-state change from two source questions to a target question about the same entity, comparing the predicted log-probability shift between two relations' published answers, given known answer prefixes, with the measured one. Hidden reuse injects the aligned change at 50% depth before the target's remaining layers; direct reuse adds source output-score changes. With other-relation sources, hidden reuse removes 45% and 49% of no-change error on 0.5-1B Qwen and Llama. Gemma-2-2B removes 22% and passes one of three comparisons in plain text without its default beginning-of-sequence (BOS) token. A later protocol restoring it yields 58-68%, passing every comparison on three cohorts. Larger checkpoints, chat format and new entities show replication and format- or cohort-dependent failures. On small plain-format checkpoints, other-relation hidden reuse mainly reproduces the shift both relations' questions share, without reliably lowering relation-selective error. With target-relation sources, hidden reuse's post hoc advantage over direct reuse is 0.2-0.9 nats outside chat format, unconfirmed and not replacement-specific. The same relation-neutral change at both questions' entity tokens lowers relation-selective error more than random or other-replacement changes, indicating receiving-question dependence.

</details>


### [416] [Cross-Lingual Persona Effects in LLM Negotiation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00300)
*Saehee Eom,Tejas Khandwekar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 以同一LLM的买卖双方代理在英语与韩语中执行相同的CraigslistBargain谈判场景，检验"提示词设定的社会策略"能否跨语言产生一致的行为效应；结果发现不能，韩语下成交率显著更高，差异主要由卖方让步与礼貌缓和机制驱动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提示词层面的行为指令（如"headstrong"要求在价格上保持强硬）通常被默认为与语言无关的"社会策略"。但若在某一语言中校准出的指令在另一语言下产生不同行为，则基于该模型的谈判模拟、多语言智能体评估与策略迁移都缺乏可比性。作者因此提出并检验"跨语言社会策略保真度"这一性质。

Method: 采用预试验规模的 2×2×3 全因子设计：交互语言（英/韩）×卖方紧迫度（无/强）×买方人格（合作/中立/强硬）。同一模型的买方与卖方实例（先为 Gemini 3.6 Flash，再以 Qwen3.7 Flash 复现）就相同的 12 个 CraigslistBargain 场景进行谈判，共 432 次尝试。分析包含成交率的显著性检验（Holm 校正）、首次报价与后续让步的分解，以及语用层面的面子威胁行为与礼貌缓和的标注分析。

Result: 韩语成交率显著高于英语（77.3% vs. 52.5%，差 24.8 个百分点，Holm 校正 p = .0039），但该效应仅出现在中立与强硬买方，合作买方在两种语言中均已接近天花板。首次报价跨语言差异极小，差距产生于后期：韩语中卖方让步更大、最终价格差距更小、成交价更低。以 Qwen3.7 Flash 复现得到方向一致的证据（韩语 +13.9 个百分点，置信区间下界接近 0），卖方让步仍更大。语用分析显示，两种语言都频繁出现拒绝与还价等面子威胁行为，但韩语对话以显著更多的礼貌缓和加以修饰，尤其体现在卖方（11.7% vs. 3.6%）。

Conclusion: 仅改变交互语言，提示词定义的社会策略即可产生不同的模拟谈判行为（成交率、让步幅度、成交价格），而不仅是措辞差异。因此"跨语言社会策略保真度"不成立，提示词级人格/策略校准不可跨语言直接迁移，多语言LLM谈判模拟与智能体评估需按语言分别验证。作者提出的机制解释是语用层面的礼貌缓和差异。

Abstract: Tell an LLM negotiator to be "headstrong" and it should hold firm on price, but does that instruction retain the same behavior in every language? To test this, we use identical buyer and seller instances of Gemini 3.6 Flash to negotiate the same 12 CraigslistBargain scenarios in English and Korean. The pilot-scale 2 x 2 x 3 design crosses interaction language, seller urgency (none or strong), and buyer persona (cooperative, neutral, or headstrong), yielding 432 attempted negotiations. We call this property cross-lingual social-policy fidelity: whether a prompt-defined social policy produces the same behavioral effect regardless of interaction language. It often does not. Korean negotiations reached agreement far more often than English (77.3% vs. 52.5%, a 24.8-point gap, Holm-adjusted p = .0039), but only for neutral and headstrong buyers; cooperative buyers were already near-ceiling in both languages. Buyers' opening offers barely differed by language; the gap instead emerged later, through larger seller concessions and a smaller final gap in Korean, and agreed prices were also lower in Korean. Repeating the full design with Qwen3.7 Flash as both agents gives directional support: agreement was again higher in Korean (+13.9 points vs. Gemini's +24.8, with an interval whose lower bound is near zero), and sellers again conceded more. Pragmatic analysis reveals why: while both languages frequently featured face-threatening acts like rejections and counter-offers, Korean dialogue softened these threats with substantially more politeness mitigation, especially among sellers (11.7% vs. 3.6%). These results show that such a policy can produce different simulated negotiation behavior, not just different wording, when only the interaction language changes.

</details>


### [417] [Saidzoda-Tajik-E5-Large: Fine-Tuning a 560M Embedder for Tajik Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00592)
*Tohir Saidzoda,Nekruz Maxudov,Bedil Karimov,Abubakr Abdullozoda,Amin Jalilov,Jonibek Kishvarov,Rahmonali Sharipov,Mariyamkhon Shodyeva*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文提出 Saidzoda-Tajik-E5-Large，一个基于 multilingual-e5-large-instruct（560M 参数）的塔吉克语文本嵌入模型，用于段落检索；在法律未见数据上 Recall@10 提升至 93.6%，税务文档达 94.5%，但在人工撰写的 Belebele 上增益不显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在基于文档的检索系统中，定位回答问题所需段落是首要环节，而塔吉克语尚无公开描述的检索/嵌入模型，存在明显资源空白。

Method: 以 multilingual-e5-large-instruct（560M）为底座微调；用自研塔吉克语语言模型为法律、税务文档、维基百科与网页文本自动生成问题，构造 235,140 个问题—段落对，训练一个 epoch；难负样本由另一嵌入模型选取；混入英文与俄语平行对以防语言遗忘；并报告失败尝试（bfloat16 训练导致模型损坏、用相似俄文字母替换塔吉克字母无效）。

Result: 未见法律数据上正确段落进入 Top-10 的比例由 80.2% 升至 93.6%；税务文档由 82.6% 升至 94.5%；Belebele（唯一人工撰写测试集）由 92.2% 升至 95.2%，但置信区间重叠、增益不显著；俄语与英语性能不变。与五倍规模的 Giga-Embeddings-3B 在同风格法律/税务问题上持平，在 Belebele 上 3B/8B 模型略优，且仅在其于本数据上微调后显著领先。

Conclusion: 模型在领域内合成问题上取得显著检索提升，并对多语言能力保持稳健，但法律、税务与维基百科测试问题均出自同一生成模型，分数应视为上限；需待塔吉克语母语者撰写的问题以确认真实泛化能力。

Abstract: Finding the passage that answers a question is the first step of most practical systems built on documents, and for Tajik we found no openly described model for it. We present Saidzoda-Tajik-E5-Large, a Tajik text embedder built from multilingual-e5-large-instruct (560M parameters). We asked our own Tajik language model to write questions for passages from Tajik laws, tax documents, Wikipedia and web text, and trained on 235,140 question and passage pairs for one epoch, with hard negatives chosen by another embedder and English and Russian pairs mixed in so the model would not forget those languages. On laws the model had never seen, the right passage is among the top ten results for 93.6% of questions, up from 80.2%; on tax documents, 94.5% against 82.6%. On Belebele, the one test we have that was written by people, the gain is smaller and not confirmed (92.2% to 95.2%, with touching intervals), and Russian and English do not change. On law and tax questions written in the same style as its training questions, it is tied with Giga-Embeddings-3B, a model five times its size; on Belebele the 3B and 8B models score slightly higher, and only after we fine-tuned them on our data are they clearly ahead. We also report what failed: training in bfloat16 broke the model, and replacing Tajik letters with similar Russian ones did not help. Our law, tax and Wikipedia test questions come from the same model that wrote the training questions, so we treat those scores as an upper limit until questions written by Tajik speakers are available.

</details>


### [418] [Dual-Axis Policy Entailment: A Benchmark for Policy-Change Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00536)
*Charles Chang,Yuen Yuen Ang,Bolun Sun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出双轴政策蕴含（DAPE）任务，将“是否同一政策域”（二分类）与“延续/扩大/收窄/逆转”（五分类）两轴联合判定为五类主标签，构建1000对中文政策文件的专家标注基准与校准协议；零样本下最强前沿模型κ≈0.29远低于人类上限0.53，LoRA微调Qwen3-14B（五折交叉验证）达κ=0.524，接近编码员互评上限0.527，并用于映射中国AI政策（1980–2024）的变迁方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 政策是否跨域及后续的延续、扩展、收窄、逆转对公共政策研究至关重要，但既有设定把跨域与方向性变化混为笼统的“无关”标签，导致错误混淆与标注松弛。

Method: DAPE以有序指令对为输入，同时做二分类同域判定与五分类方向判定，两者组合成五类主指标；构建1000条中文政府政策指令对的专家标注基准，并提出含裁决包与前后一致性测量的标注校准协议作为方法学产物。

Result: 14个开源权重模型与4个前沿API旗舰模型零样本均失败；最佳前沿旗舰的校正一致性κ≈0.29，远低于人类上限0.53；Qwen3-14B经LoRA SFT五折交叉验证达κ=0.524，与编码员互评人类上限0.527基本持平。

Conclusion: 双轴拆解避免了维度错误混淆并使标注更具可核查性；通用模型零样本不足以胜任政策蕴含判定，而领域微调可逼近人类水平；方法可直接用于刻画政策变迁方向，实证上应用于中国AI政策1980–2024的分期变迁图谱。

Abstract: Whether a policy shifts domains and, by extension, continues, broadens, narrows, or reverses previous policy is of paramount importance to the study of public policy. We propose Dual-Axis Policy Entailment (DAPE), which evaluates an ordered pair of policy directives on both dimensions at once: a binary judgment determines whether the two directives govern the same policy domain, and a five-way judgment determines whether the later directive continues, broadens, narrows, or reverses the earlier policy, or governs a different domain altogether. Read together, the two judgments form one five-category label, our primary metric. The two-axis design captures two central dimensions of policy change without conflating errors on either dimension into a generic "irrelevant" label, and it makes annotation more rigorous: a coder cannot dismiss a difficult pair as domain-irrelevant without an explicit, checkable decision. We introduce an expert-annotated benchmark of 1,000 ordered directive pairs drawn from a large corpus of Chinese government policy, together with an annotation-calibration protocol (an adjudication packet with pre/post agreement measurement) that we contribute as a methodological artifact. Fourteen open-weight models and four frontier API flagships fail the task zero-shot: even the best frontier flagship's chance-corrected agreement with expert labels is far below the human ceiling (Cohen's $κ\approx 0.29$ vs. $0.53$). A fine-tuned open-weight model (LoRA SFT of Qwen3-14B, five-fold cross-validation) closes this gap, reaching the coder-mutual human ceiling ($κ= 0.524$ vs. $0.527$). Finally, we apply our method to China's AI policy (1980-2024) and map the direction of policy change across eras.

</details>


### [419] [AStockArena: Beyond Returns, Can We Entrust Real Capital to the Decisions of Financial Agents?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00515)
*Zeyu Liu,Sing Kwong Lai,Xuanzhi Feng,HaoYang Shang,Yang Li,Zihao Fang,Xuan Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出AStockArena——面向中国A股连续交易的实时决策审计基准，通过对报告、交易请求、执行响应与账户状态进行对齐与8项审计检查，揭示现有LLM交易智能体在可追溯性、证据充分性与金融元认知上的普遍缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有实时交易基准主要以累计收益与风险调整绩效评价智能体，属结果型指标，无法反映交易是否被如实报告、是否有可用证据支撑、是否与账户状态一致；因此需要面向决策过程的可验证评估手段。

Method: 在共享市场条件与执行约束下，对13个开源与闭源模型进行3,198次序贯决策评测；AStockArena通过将报告、交易请求、执行响应与账户状态对齐，重构实际入账动作，并用覆盖执行可追溯性(O)、证据充分性(RK)与金融元认知(B)的8项检查进行审计，结合记录核验与专家共识标注；另以历史交易过滤回放检验被标记交易对组合结果的影响。

Result: 1,070个交易时点中72.99%至少存在一项审计缺口，模型级别缺口率为52.2%至91.2%，其中证据缺口最为普遍；历史交易过滤回放显示组合结果对这些被标记交易敏感。

Conclusion: 决策过程审计为基于收益的金融智能体评估提供了可验证的补充维度。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in dynamic financial trading, yet real-time trading benchmarks mainly evaluate agents by cumulative returns and risk-adjusted performance. Such outcome metrics cannot show whether trades are faithfully reported, supported by available evidence, and consistent with account states. We introduce AStockArena, a real-time decision-auditing benchmark for continuous trading in China's A-share market. Under shared market conditions and execution constraints, we evaluate 13 open- and closed-source models over 3,198 sequential decisions. AStockArena reconstructsthe actions actually posted to accounts by aligning reports, trade requests, execution responses, and account states, and audits them with eight checks spanning execution traceability (O), evidence sufficiency (RK), and financial meta-awareness (B), combining record verification with consensus expert annotation. Of 1,070 trading points, 72.99% exhibit at least one audit gap; model-level rates range from52.2% to 91.2%, with evidence gaps most prevalent. Historical trade-filtering replay further shows thatportfolio outcomes are sensitive to these flagged trades. Decision-process auditing thus offers a verifiable complement to return-based evaluation of financial agents.

</details>


### [420] [TopoSteer: Topological Layer Selection for Activation Steering in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01493)
*Tuc Nguyen,Marcos Gutiérrez-del-Pozo,Eduardo Paluzo-Hidalgo,Yifan Hu,Adaku Uchendu,Thai Le*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TopoSteer 提出基于拓扑（位移点云 H_0 持续度，即欧氏最小生成树长度）的层选择方法用于激活引导，理论证明其与可分性准则可产生相反排序，在多模型多任务上取得更好的引导效果且无需留出验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有激活引导研究多关注如何构造引导向量，而忽视在何处（哪一层）添加向量；但层选择不当可能比不引导更差。已有层选择器在不实际引导的情况下打分，依据是目标行为的可分性或单样本位移与均值方向的一致性，作者认为这些指标并非真正关键。

Method: 提出 TopoSteer：对每层的逐样本位移点云计算总 H_0 持续度（即该点云欧氏最小生成树的长度）作为层评分；并分析该分数主要反映位移点云的相对几何，类间分离仅通过标准化产生影响。理论部分证明随样本级变异增大，TopoSteer 与可判别性朝相反方向变化，二者可对层给出相反排序。

Result: 在多个语言模型与多种引导任务上，TopoSteer 相比基于可判别性/可分性的层选择更有效，且无需留出验证集。

Conclusion: 关注“平均位移点云的延展程度”而非可分性或个体位移与均值的一致性，是层选择的原则性替代方案，可显著提升激活引导效果。

Abstract: Activation steering controls large language models at inference time by adding a vector to their internal representations. Most work asks how to build that vector, and far less attention has gone to where to add it, even though steering at a poorly chosen layer can be worse than not steering at all. Prior selectors choose a layer without ever steering the model to test it: they score how separable the target behavior is at that layer, and how consistently the individual examples point along the steering direction. We argue that what matters is not the separability of the two activation clouds, nor the alignment of individual displacements with their mean, but the extent of the cloud of per-example displacements that mean-difference steering averages. We propose a topology-based layer selection method, called TopoSteer, which scores a layer by the total H_0 persistence of its displacement cloud, computed as the length of the cloud's Euclidean minimum spanning tree. We show that the score focuses on the displacement cloud's relative geometry, while class separation affects it only through standardization. We also provide a theoretical explanation for our method by proving that, as example-level variation increases, TopoSteer and discriminability move in opposite directions, so the two criteria can rank layers in opposite ways. Across multiple language models and steering tasks, TopoSteer provides a principled alternative to discriminability- and separability-based layer selection and yields more effective steering without requiring held-out validation.

</details>


### [421] [A Bounded Evaluation Protocol for Representational Systematicity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01755)
*Boyu Cao,Wenshuo Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Bounded-RS评估协议，通过匹配的行为对比、控制校准的分数与门控规则，将"表征系统性"解释判定为Unsupported、Present-only、Causal-use或Undetermined四种有界状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络的"行为系统性"已被证实，但"表征系统性"（是否真正表征部件及其角色并用于生成输出）难以检验，因为单一证据都可能误导：正确输出可能来自捷径、可解码信号未必被使用、干预可能经非预期通路生效、搜索失败也不等于不存在。

Method: 提出Bounded-RS：针对将系统性行为归因于某声明表征的解释，在匹配的行为对比上检验该表征是否可恢复、是否被因果使用；用控制校准的分数、门控与停止规则验证证据有效性；输出四类有界判定状态；并在自建的96组匹配语义解析测试集上评估微调T5的role-filler Binding解释与分布式Geometry解释。

Result: Binding解释被判为Causal-use，Geometry解释在声明搜索空间内为Unsupported，结论跨校准兼容的参数配置、训练种子及T5-base稳健；在41个已知因果状态的案例中，完整裁决仅对34个非因果案例中的1个误判为Causal-use（仅凭可恢复性判为使用时为13个），且未漏掉任何因果案例。

Conclusion: Bounded-RS将自Fodor与Pylyshyn以来的表征系统性之争转化为针对声明解释的可比较、可证伪判定，每个判定附带其证据模式，负面结论还附带界定它的搜索空间。

Abstract: Multiple studies have shown that neural networks can be behaviorally systematic, producing correct outputs for novel combinations of familiar parts. Whether they are also representationally systematic, that is, whether they represent these parts and their roles and use them to produce the outputs, remains hard to test, because each kind of evidence can mislead on its own: correct outputs can come from shortcuts, a decodable signal need not be used, an intervention can act through unintended pathways, and a failed search does not show absence. We propose a bounded evaluation protocol for representational systematicity (Bounded-RS): for an explanation that attributes a systematic behavior to a declared representation, it tests on a matched behavioral contrast whether that representation is recoverable and whether it is causally used, checks the validity of this evidence, and assigns the explanation one of four bounded states, Unsupported, Present-only, Causal-use, or Undetermined, through control-calibrated scores, gates, and stop rules. On a semantic-parsing testbed of 96 matched sets that we release, the tested role-filler Binding explanation of fine-tuned T5 models is Causal-use and the distributed Geometry explanation is Unsupported within its declared search space, verdicts that hold across calibration-compatible parameter configurations, training seeds, and T5-base. On 41 cases with known causal status, full adjudication licenses a false Causal-use in 1 of 34 noncausal cases, against 13 when recoverability is taken as use, without missing any causal case. Bounded-RS thus turns the question of representational systematicity, debated since Fodor and Pylyshyn, into comparable and falsifiable verdicts on declared explanations, each reported with the evidence pattern that licenses it and, for a negative, the search space that bounds it.

</details>


### [422] [Less but Sufficient: Relation Knowledge Selects Compact Knowledge-Graph Contexts, and What External Checks Can and Cannot Catch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01733)
*Seunghui Jwa,Minsu Oh,Sangwoo Hong,Yeo Chan Yoon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出基于关系知识的紧凑事实上下文构建与可推导性/一致性检查机制，用验证选择的门控决定何时以推导答案替换LLM答案，在多个基准上以更少token匹配或超越SubgraphRAG。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM按相关性排序读取知识图谱事实，但未明确这些事实是否充分或彼此冲突，缺乏对上下文的充分性与一致性的检验。

Method: 使用人工编写或从带关系路径标注的训练问题中学习得到的关系知识，选取能导出答案的紧凑事实上下文并进行推导演绎；设置可推导性检查（判断答案是否可推出）、一致性检查（判断事实是否冲突），以及由验证集选择的门控路由，决定推导答案是否替换LLM答案；另有精确门控，仅当检查通过且恰好导出一个实体时返回推导答案。

Result: 7个开源LLM在精确匹配上读紧凑上下文优于相关性排序事实；在CWQ上以四分之一的prompt token匹配SubgraphRAG的事实效果，而更强LLM读SubgraphRAG更佳；在门控通过的场景下，本文方法在全部53个LLM、基准与prompt设置中精确匹配领先SubgraphRAG。预注册测试中精确门控在WebQSP和CWQ留出集上分别作答18%和5%的问题，正确率90%和96%。一致性检查仅在其他路径连接实体时依据路径证据判断事实，该情况占紧凑上下文中命名实体事实的2.5%。

Conclusion: 通过关系知识驱动的紧凑上下文与推导/一致性检验及门控路由，可在显著降低token开销的同时提升或匹配合格基准上的答案准确性，并以高精度门控实现可信的答案替换。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) read knowledge-graph facts ranked by relevance, leaving open whether they suffice or conflict. Our checks use relation knowledge, written by hand or learned from training questions labelled with their relation paths. It selects a compact context of facts yielding an answer, and derives it; a derivability check tests whether an answer follows, a consistency check whether facts conflict, and a validation-chosen routing gate decides where the derived answer replaces the LLM's. Seven open LLMs read the compact context better in exact match than relevance-ranked facts; on ComplexWebQuestions (CWQ) they match SubgraphRAG's facts at a quarter of the prompt tokens, and stronger LLMs read SubgraphRAG's better. Where the routing gate passes, ours leads SubgraphRAG's in exact match in all 53 LLM, benchmark and prompt settings. A precision gate, returning the derived answer only when the check passes with exactly one derived entity, answered 18 and 5 percent of held-out WebQSP and CWQ questions in a pre-specified test, right for 90 and 96 percent. The consistency check judges facts by path evidence only where another path joins their entities, true of 2.5 percent of named-entity facts in our compact WebQSP and CWQ contexts.

</details>


### [423] [CST: Lightweight Risk Triage with Source-Grounded Evidence for Web Discussions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01710)
*Zhihua Wang,Yifeng Gao,Yunhao Feng,Rui Pan,Baiheng Zhao,Zixing Chen,Nan Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CST是一个轻量级内容审核分诊流水线，先定位"看哪里"再决定"读什么"，将风险评分转化为可核查的原文证据，在六项任务上优于全量微调多语言模型，用户研究显示阅读时间减少≥27%且准确率>94%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有审核工具仅输出单条消息的风险分数，只能告知版主该看哪里，却无法说明该读什么、如何核验。而语义依赖上下文（如"I agree."既可支持也可反对移除某人），因此版主需要的是有原文依据的证据，而非单纯分数。

Method: 提出CST三阶段流水线：1）风险打分阶段，将字符级模式（捕捉精确措辞）与固定多语言模型的句向量语义相结合，支持多语言且可在普通CPU上运行；2）分组阶段，将相关消息聚类；3）选择阶段，在各组间轮转挑选，使有限阅读预算覆盖讨论的不同部分；4）每条挑选结果回溯链接至原始讨论串，形成有出处的证据。

Result: 在5个数据集、多语言的6项任务上，CST的有害消息排序准确率高于全量微调多语言模型；相同预算下比仅按分数阅读发现更多有害消息。用户研究中，版主使用分组证据的用时减少至少27%，决策准确率仍高于94%。

Conclusion: CST将风险分数转化为版主可快速阅读、可在上下文中核查的证据，兼顾效率与准确性；代码与数据集重建资源将在GitHub发布。

Abstract: Web communities rely on moderators to catch harmful messages such as insults, hate speech, and scams, but no one can read every message. Existing tools give each message a risk score, which tells moderators where to look but not what to read or how to check it. Yet meaning depends on context: the same reply, "I agree.", can support or oppose removing someone from a group. Moderators therefore need source-grounded evidence, not just scores: a few key messages kept with their original wording and replies. We present CST, a lightweight triage pipeline that first decides where to look, then what to show. It scores risk by pairing character patterns, which capture exact wording, with sentence meaning from a fixed multilingual model, so it handles several languages and runs on an ordinary CPU. It then groups related messages and picks from each group in turn, so a small reading budget covers different parts of a discussion, and links every pick back to the original thread. Across six tasks from five datasets in several languages, CST ranks harmful messages more accurately than a fully fine-tuned multilingual model and, under the same budget, finds more of them than reading by score alone. In a user study, reviewers needed at least 27% less time with CST's grouped evidence while keeping decision accuracy above 94%. CST turns risk scores into evidence that moderators can read quickly and check in context. Code and dataset reconstruction resources will be released at https://github.com/Kirito14IT/CST-MIL.

</details>


### [424] [EEG-HealthLLM: Hierarchical Adaptation of Large Language Models for Unified Heterogeneous EEG Health Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01652)
*Ruidong Ma,Jisheng Dang,Ronghao Lin,Bimei Wang,Jingwen Zhao,Wenjun Ma,Wei-Shi Zheng,Meng Wang,Qi Tian,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出EEG-HealthLLM统一参数高效框架，通过非对称分层适配（任务专属EEG适配器+共享LoRA）实现异构EEG健康评估，并构建五任务基准EEG-HealthBench。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EEG模型通常针对单一任务开发，难以在异构信号配置与多样评估目标间统一；而直接借助LLM作为通用接口时，如何保留任务特定的信号特征同时实现语言侧参数共享成为关键难题。

Method: 提出非对称分层适配策略：任务专属EEG适配器保留异构时空动态特征，在LLM主干（如Phi-3）注入统一共享LoRA以捕获跨任务共享的高层评估语义；并整合五个EEG资源构建EEG-HealthBench，覆盖癫痫检测、重度抑郁评估、焦虑风险、抑郁症状风险及情绪状态评估，采用统一被试独立协议。

Result: 平均平衡准确率（BAC）达69.58%，在平均BAC与macro-F1上均排名第一；相较独立单任务LoRA适配，BAC由67.70%提升至69.58%，语言侧适配器总规模减少80.0%。

Conclusion: 验证了分层适配策略的有效性，揭示任务相关的跨任务交互与权衡关系；代码已开源。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive means for neurological and mental health assessment, yet existing EEG models are typically developed for individual tasks and are difficult to unify across heterogeneous signal configurations and assessment objectives. Large language models (LLMs) offer a common interface for multiple tasks, but adapting heterogeneous EEG signals to a shared LLM raises a key challenge: how to preserve task-specific signal characteristics while enabling effective language-side parameter sharing. To address this problem, we propose EEG-HealthLLM, a unified and parameter-efficient framework for heterogeneous EEG health assessment. We introduce an Asymmetric Hierarchical Adaptation Strategy: task-specific EEG adapters preserve heterogeneous spatio-temporal dynamics, while a unified shared LoRA is injected into the LLM backbone (e.g., Phi-3) to capture shared high-level assessment semantics across tasks. We further establish EEG-HealthBench by reorganizing five existing EEG resources into paradigms covering epileptic seizure detection, major depressive disorder assessment, anxiety risk assessment, depressive symptom risk assessment, and emotional state assessment under a unified subject-independent protocol. Extensive experiments show that EEG-HealthLLM achieves an average balanced accuracy (BAC) of 69.58%, ranking first among the evaluated methods in both average BAC and macro-F1. Compared with independent single-task LoRA adaptation, it improves average BAC from 67.70% to 69.58% while reducing the aggregate language-side adapter footprint by 80.0%. Further analyses reveal task-dependent cross-task interactions and trade-offs, supporting the proposed hierarchical adaptation strategy. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/Marui-88/EEG-HealthLLM.

</details>


### [425] [BanglishDepYT: Depression Detection in Native Bengali Social Media with Emotion-Preserving Preprocessing and Domain-Adaptive Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01633)
*Ayon Roy,Sadman Sharif,Syed Shams Islam*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出原生孟加拉语抑郁检测数据集BanglishDepYT与情感保留混合预处理EPH，证明预处理策略对非正式文本性能影响巨大，DAPT-SahajBERT取得最高F1，LLM辅助标注+半监督可扩展扩标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有孟加拉语抑郁检测数据集几乎全部由英语数据翻译而来，无法捕捉真实痛苦表达中的表情符号、罗马化孟加拉语（Banglish）与拉长拼写等非正式语言特征，导致检测系统与真实文本分布不匹配。

Method: 构建原生采集自YouTube的数据集BanglishDepYT（191,000条无标注评论 + 1,000条双语双人标注样本）；提出EPH预处理（表情符号转语义标签、保留Banglish词元、保护否定词、归一化情感性拉长拼写）；在SahajBERT上做领域自适应预训练（DAPT）；用Qwen2.5-7B进行LLM辅助标注（κ=0.611）并生成96,071条伪标签用于半监督训练；以CESS、Banglish Survival Rate、F1、MCC、AUC评估。

Result: 标准清洗使Banglish存活率降为0（SVM F1=0.7062），EPH保持信号（CESS 0.9996 vs. 0.6694）并将SVM F1提升至0.8570（+0.1508）；DAPT-SahajBERT取得最高平均F1 0.8161、MCC 0.6272，显著优于基线（F1 0.7805，p=0.0013，d=1.450）并与MuRIL相当（p=0.589）；半监督训练将AUC从0.8499提升至0.8731（p=0.044）。

Conclusion: 针对非正式孟加拉语文本，预处理设计是性能的关键决定因素；面向领域的定向预训练可作为大规模多语言预训练的竞争性替代方案；LLM辅助标注结合半监督学习提供了可扩展的标注扩充路径。代码、模型与数据均公开以支持可复现研究。

Abstract: Depression affects millions of Bengali speakers across South Asia, yet automated detection systems have relied almost entirely on datasets translated from English. Such datasets cannot capture the emoticons, romanized Bengali words, and elongated spellings that characterize real expressions of distress. We introduce BanglishDepYT, a Bengali depression dataset collected natively from YouTube, comprising 191,000 unlabeled comments and 1,000 samples verified through dual bilingual annotation. We propose EPH (Emotion-Preserving Hybrid preprocessing), which converts emoticons to semantic tags, preserves Banglish tokens, protects negation words, and normalizes emotional elongation. A key finding is that preprocessing choice substantially affects performance on informal text: standard cleaning reduces the Banglish Survival Rate to zero (SVM F1: 0.7062), while EPH preserves signals (CESS: 0.9996 vs. 0.6694) and raises SVM F1 to 0.8570, an improvement of 0.1508. We further apply domain-adaptive pretraining (DAPT), continuing SahajBERT pretraining on unlabeled in-domain comments. DAPT-SahajBERT achieves the highest mean F1 (0.8161) and MCC (0.6272), significantly outperforming the baseline (F1: 0.7805, p = 0.0013, d = 1.450) and matching MuRIL (p = 0.589). These results suggest that targeted domain pretraining is a competitive alternative to large-scale multilingual pretraining. LLM-assisted annotation using Qwen2.5-7B achieves substantial human agreement (kappa = 0.611), enabling pseudo-labeling of 96,071 comments. Semi-supervised training improves AUC from 0.8499 to 0.8731 (p = 0.044), offering a scalable path to expanding annotation. All code, models, and datasets are publicly released to support reproducible research.

</details>


### [426] [TrackMem: Tracking Evolving Beliefs in Long-Horizon Financial Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02001)
*Austin M. Y. Cheung,Harsh Vardhan Gupta,Go Nam Lui,Lok Kan Chan,Ginny Y. Wong,Simon See*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出面向金融对话的按说话人图记忆系统 TrackMem 及基准 FinLoCoMo，在修订数值、隐匿规则、跨会话立场等问题上显著优于现有记忆系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体记忆系统多在社交对话上评测，此类场景事实单调累积、极少变更，"记忆"退化为定位某句话所在轮次；而金融对话中数值会被修订、立场悄然转变而不重述、一次性陈述的规则约束后续提问、同一公司需在多分析视角下讨论。基于相似度或最近性的检索因此会返回已被取代的数值、漏掉无字面重合的规则、无法恢复跨会话分散的立场。

Method: TrackMem：按说话人构建的图记忆，追踪数值的历史版本，按实体与分析视角切分不同观点，并按时间顺序保留每位说话人的行为记录。同时构建 FinLoCoMo 基准：15 段长程投资对话、765 个问题，分两个划分——一个沿用 LoCoMo 类别，另一个针对四类失效模式。

Result: 在两种阅读器配置下，TrackMem 在两个划分上均优于现有记忆系统；失效模式划分上宏平均准确率 73.9%，最强基线为 69.4%；在涉及修订数值的问题上提升最大（86.5% vs. 73.4%）。

Conclusion: 面向时效性与视角结构的专用记忆设计在动态、多视角领域（如金融对话）中必要且有效；FinLoCoMo 为长程金融对话记忆能力提供了针对性评测手段。

Abstract: Memory systems for LLM agents are evaluated mostly on social dialogue, where facts accumulate and rarely change, so remembering reduces largely to finding the turn in which something was said. Financial dialogue breaks this assumption: figures are revised, stances shift without being restated, rules stated once govern later questions, and a single company is discussed under several analytical lenses. Memory systems that retrieve the passages most similar to a question, or the most recent ones, therefore return superseded values, miss rules that share no wording with the question, and cannot recover a stance spread across sessions. We present TrackMem, a per-speaker graph memory that tracks the history of figures, separates perspectives by entity and lens, and preserves each speaker's actions in chronological order. To evaluate it, we introduce FinLoCoMo, a benchmark of 15 long-horizon investment conversations with 765 questions in two splits: one following the LoCoMo categories and one targeting four failure modes. With two readers, TrackMem outperforms existing memory systems on both splits. On the failure-mode split it reaches 73.9% macro accuracy against 69.4% for the strongest baseline, with the largest gains on questions about revised figures (86.5% against 73.4%).

</details>


### [427] [TAC-CoT: Tool-Empowered Implicit Chain-of-Thought via Interleaving Explicit Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01926)
*Juseon Do,Sangmin Bae,Jeesu Jung,Hwanjun Song*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TAC-CoT：以紧凑隐式潜空间推理段替代显式推理文本，仅在工具调用、观察与最终答案处保留文本token的工具增强自适应隐式CoT框架，兼顾推理精度与生成效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体系统依赖CoT推理以完成需准确推理、外部知识与多步思考的任务；但显式CoT生成开销大，而隐式CoT（用紧凑连续token替代文本理由）天然不支持智能体工具使用所需的显式通信接口，二者难以兼得。

Method: 提出TAC-CoT框架：用紧凑的隐式潜空间推理段替换显式推理轨迹，仅在工具调用、工具观察和最终答案处使用文本token，形成"潜推理—文本工具交互"交错的生成结构，使工具使用无需逐字化中间推理步骤。

Result: 在智能体数学与问答基准上，准确率最高提升8.8个百分点，模型前向次数最多减少6.8倍；分析表明其在单工具与多工具设定下均提升了工具使用质量。

Conclusion: 隐式CoT与智能体工具使用可有效结合：交错的潜推理段设计在保持工具调用接口的同时显著降低生成开销，并提升推理准确率与工具使用质量。

Abstract: LLM-based agentic systems are increasingly combined with CoT reasoning to solve tasks that require accurate reasoning, external knowledge, and multi-step deliberation. Yet, explicit CoT incurs substantial generation overhead, while implicit CoT, which replaces textual rationales with compact continuous tokens, does not naturally support the explicit communication interface required for agentic tool-use. We propose TAC-CoT, a tool-empowered adaptive implicit CoT framework that replaces explicit reasoning traces with compact latent reasoning segments while retaining textual tokens only for tool calls, observations, and final answers. This interleaved design enables agentic tool-use without verbalizing every intermediate reasoning step. Experiments on agentic math and QA benchmarks show that TAC-CoT improves accuracy by up to 8.8 points while reducing model forward passes by up to 6.8x. Furthermore, analyses show that TAC-CoT improves tool-use quality in both single- and multi-tool settings.

</details>


### [428] [Precedent Labels and Facts Shift LLM Approval Decisions in Opposite Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00672)
*Junwei Yao,Zike Yang,Yongxi Zhou,Yanxian Chen,Jianan Liu,Jiaxi Wen,Zhijun Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 将检索到的历史案例拆分为"事实"与"记录决策"两部分后发现：近似的记录决策会强烈左右模型的批准结果（30–55个百分点），而支持批准的事实反而降低批准率；两部分应分别测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实系统常以备忘的相似历史案例辅助模型判断退款/理赔类政策请求，但历史案例同时含有事实与已记录决策，混杂在一起无法判断模型究竟依据哪一部分。作者希望解耦二者，刻画模型对"结果标签"与"案情事实"的各自敏感性。

Method: 构造政策+请求+3个历史案例的输入，保持请求不变，分别操纵历史案例的(1)记录决策(APPROVE/DENY翻转)与(2)事实(移除记录决策、只呈现支持批准或支持拒绝的事实)。选取"临界请求"：无历史案例时 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 在四次尝试中结果不一致的请求。设置近拷贝事实、非近拷贝事实两种条件；材料含自拟政策与9条由真实政策改写的公开政策。用 DeepSeek、GPT-5.6 Luna、Claude Haiku 5.5 测试，并加入人类标注判断作为参照。

Result: 1) 近拷贝历史案例把记录决策由DENY改为APPROVE，使批准率提升约30–55个百分点（三个模型在自拟政策上均出现；DeepSeek与Luna在9条公开政策上复现）。2) 只给事实时，支持批准的事实反而使批准率低于支持拒绝的事实。3) 该"事实推力"不是向正确答案的纠偏：在人类判定可批准与可拒绝的请求上估计效应相近。4) 历史案例为非近拷贝的另一请求时，决策翻转仅带来9个百分点变化（对比43），而支持批准的事实仍降低批准率22个百分点。

Conclusion: 模型对历史案例的"记录决策"高度敏感且易被近拷贝案例同化，对"案情事实"则呈现反向（对比效应）倾向，且该倾向与人类正确答案无系统性关联。建议检索式决策系统分别评测决策部分与事实部分，并警惕近拷贝案例带来的标签驱动偏差。

Abstract: When a language model decides refund or claim requests under written policies, the system can show it similar past cases. Each past case has two parts: its facts and the decision recorded for it. We separate the two. A model sees a policy, a request and three past cases, and we change either the recorded decisions or the facts, keeping the request fixed. We select requests that are close calls: deciding without past cases, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash approved each in some of four tries and denied it in others. When the past cases are near-copies of the request (its facts with a few details changed), switching their recorded decisions from DENY to APPROVE raises approval by about 30 to 55 percentage points in DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GPT-5.6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 on policies written for the study, and DeepSeek and Luna show the same on nine public policies paraphrased from real ones. The facts push the other way: shown without their recorded decisions, past cases whose facts support approval make these two models approve less often than past cases whose facts support denial. One reading is that the request looks weaker next to them. This push is not just a correction toward the right answer: in an additional DeepSeek analysis, it was of similar estimated size on requests that human annotators judged approvable and on those they judged deniable. In a separate DeepSeek run on the public policies, when the past cases are near-copies of a different request, switching their decisions moves approval by 9 points instead of 43, while facts that support approval still lower it by 22 points against facts that support denial. Systems that retrieve past decisions should test the two parts separately.

</details>


### [429] [Self-Refining Prompt Induction for Streaming Text-to-SQL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00960)
*Gaetano Rossiello,Alfio Gliozzo,Nandana Mihindukulasooriya,Erick Lee,Nabila Siregar,Lisa Amini*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出SRPI离线方法，将生成失败转化为可复用的方言提示指令，在冻结权重前提下显著提升Flink SQL文本到SQL助手的跨域、跨模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式引擎的文本到SQL助手需处理方言专有类型、窗口规则与时间语义，通用提示难以覆盖这些构造，而微调又需改动模型权重、成本高且不可迁移。

Method: SRPI为离线提示归纳方法：Refiner基于三个LLM评审的参考答案条件反馈修订Generator提示；采样回归守卫校验此前成功案例以防退化；独立Compressor压缩提示长度；推理阶段使用冻结提示，无检索、无查询修复。在Confluent Cloud Flink SQL上以30个专家示例为种子构建可控合成负载（335个归纳样本、257个来自留出域的问题），开展跨域与跨模型迁移评估。

Result: 同一归纳提示使七个Generator的平均评审分提升7.1–19.2个百分点，其中归纳模型自身由85.3%升至97.5%；压缩研究将提示长度缩短52.7%，评分仅下降0.19个百分点。

Conclusion: 提示层面归纳可在不改模型权重的情况下有效注入方言知识并具良好迁移性；压缩近似无损，支持低成本部署；助手已进入早期访问阶段，将依据初始用户反馈迭代优化。

Abstract: Text-to-SQL assistants for streaming engines must handle dialect-specific types, windowing rules, and temporal semantics, including constructs poorly handled by generic prompts. We present Self-Refining Prompt Induction (SRPI), an offline method that converts generation failures into reusable dialect instructions while keeping model weights fixed. A Refiner revises the Generator's prompt using reference-conditioned feedback from three LLM judges; a sampled regression guard checks earlier successes, and a separate Compressor reduces prompt length. Inference uses the frozen prompt without retrieval or query repair. We evaluate cross-domain and cross-model transfer on Confluent Cloud Flink SQL using a controlled synthetic workload seeded by 30 expert-written examples, with 335 induction examples and 257 questions from held-out domains. The same induced prompt improves mean judge scores across seven Generators by 7.1-19.2 percentage points, including an increase from 85.3% to 97.5% for the induction model. A separate compression study reduces prompt length by 52.7% with a 0.19-percentage-point score decrease. An assistant using the induced prompt is in early access, with initial user feedback to inform subsequent refinement.

</details>


### [430] [Labadain-MedQA: A Tetun Medical QA Dataset for Fine-Tuning and Evaluating Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00935)
*Gabriel de Jesus,Sérgio Nunes*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文将MedAlpaca医学问答数据自动翻译为德顿语构建39,077条QA对，验证翻译质量并证明PEFT微调可显著提升模型德顿语医学问答准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型为高资源语言向低资源语言的医学知识跨语言迁移提供了可能，但德顿语（Tetun）缺乏用于微调与评测的医学问答数据集，制约了当地医疗信息获取。

Method: 使用Gemini 2.5 Flash将MedAlpaca的Medical Flashcards与WikiDoc Patient Information翻译为德顿语，得到39,077条医学QA对；在50条随机抽样（100份文档）上，以自动指标对照人工参考译文，并由两名德顿语母语医疗专业人员就医学准确性与语言流畅性评分；随后用PEFT（QLoRA）在Gemma与Llama系列上微调，并在325道翻译为德顿语的USMLE多选题上评测。

Result: 人工译文在两项标准上的平均评分均高于LLM译文（4.43/5 vs. 4.02/5），差异具统计显著性（Wilcoxon符号秩检验，p<0.001）。Gemma 4 12B经QLoRA微调后，4-bit NF4推理下平均准确率相对提升10.79%，LoRA适配器合并至BF16基座后相对提升10.42%。

Conclusion: 自动翻译构建数据集对德顿语医学问答切实可行，PEFT能有效提升低资源语言医学QA性能；数据、模型与评测资源已开源以支持可复现研究。

Abstract: Advances in large language models (LLMs) have created opportunities for cross-lingual transfer of medical knowledge from high-resource to low-resource languages to support access to healthcare information. However, medical question-answering (QA) datasets for fine-tuning and evaluating LLMs remain scarce for Tetun. To address this gap, we translated MedAlpaca's Medical Flashcards and WikiDoc Patient Information collections into Tetun using Gemini 2.5 Flash, producing 39,077 medical QA pairs. Translation quality was assessed on 50 randomly sampled QA pairs (100 documents) using automatic metrics against human reference translations and evaluations by two native Tetun-speaking healthcare professionals, focusing on medical accuracy and Tetun fluency. Human translations achieved higher mean ratings than LLM-generated translations for both criteria (4.43/5 vs. 4.02/5), with statistically significant differences (Wilcoxon signed-rank test, p < 0.001). To assess downstream utility, we fine-tuned Gemma and Llama variants on the translated MedAlpaca dataset using parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) and evaluated them on 325 Tetun-translated United States Medical Licensing Examination multiple-choice questions. Gemma 4 12B fine-tuned using QLoRA achieved relative improvements in mean accuracy of 10.79% with 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4) inference and 10.42% after merging the LoRA adapters into the BF16 base model, compared with the corresponding base models. These results highlight the viability of automatic dataset translation for Tetun medical QA and the effectiveness of PEFT in enhancing model performance. The datasets, models, and evaluation resources are accessible at https://github.com/labadain/labadain-medqa to support reproducible research on Tetun medical QA and facilitate machine translation, cross lingual, and multilingual research.

</details>


### [431] [Random Is Almost Enough? Stable and Low-Cost Benchmark Compression via BestRand](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00883)
*George Ling,Shanshan Zhong,Lijin Yang,Hao Yang,Nanxiang Li,Zhongzhan Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文从理论上推导了基准压缩（用小子集估计全基准分数）的误差分布，指出其呈长尾分布，会带来稀疏但巨大的误差；并据此提出低成本的 BestRand 方法，在保持随机采样效率的同时显著削减高误差尾部。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在全基准上评估模型耗时且昂贵，基准压缩可用小规模子集逼近全基准结果。但子集估计存在误差，现有方法缺乏对误差分布规律的准确刻画，且随机采样在高概率下表现意外好却因罕见大误差而不稳定，这种不稳定性来源与应对方式尚不清晰。

Method: 1）推导出估计全基准分数时误差分布的精确解析近似，用于量化估计误差；2）分析该分布形态及不稳定性对现代基础模型的固有性；3）基于长尾特征设计 BestRand 方法，保留随机采样的高效性并压低高误差尾部；4）在 70+ 文本、多模态、智能体基准及 VLA 评估上验证。

Result: 多数子集误差较小，少数子集误差很大，形成长尾分布；该不稳定为现代基础模型的固有属性，增加被评估模型数量亦无法消除。BestRand 相比竞争方法将高误差风险降低 50.2%、平均估计误差降低 16.4%，构建成本仅为 51.3%；在分数区间、模型家族和时间漂移三类 OOD 偏移下平均降低估计误差 21.8%。

Conclusion: 该理论为理解与预测基准压缩的准确性与可靠性提供了实用指导；BestRand 在低成本下实现稳定、准确的基准压缩。代码与数据已公开。

Abstract: Benchmark compression reduces the often prohibitive time and cost of model evaluation by evaluating models on a small benchmark subset that closely matches full-benchmark results. To quantify estimation error, we derive an accurate analytical approximation to the error distribution when estimating full-benchmark scores from a subset, showing that most subsets yield small errors, while a few produce much larger errors, resulting in a long-tailed distribution. This means random sampling alone can achieve surprisingly strong performance with high probability, but remains unstable due to rare large errors. We further show that this instability is inherent to modern foundation models and persists even as more models are evaluated. Based on these findings, we introduce BestRand, a stable and low-cost benchmark compression method that preserves the efficiency of random sampling while substantially reducing its high-error tail. We validate BestRand on 70+ text, multimodal, and agent benchmarks, and further extend it to VLA evaluation. Compared with competitive methods, BestRand reduces high-error risk by 50.2% and estimation error by 16.4% on average, while requiring only 51.3% of the construction cost. It further reduces OOD estimation error by 21.8% on average across score-range, model-family, and temporal shifts. Together, our theory provides practical guidance for understanding and predicting the accuracy and reliability of benchmark compression, while BestRand enables stable and accurate compression at low cost. The code and data are publicly available onhttps://github.com/George-Ling3/BestRand.

</details>


### [432] [Rethinking LLM Pruning via Test-Time Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01133)
*Mingyang Song,Mao Zheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文通过匹配采样预算下的pass@k对比原始与结构化剪枝模型，指出剪枝后的精度下降更多反映"采样正确解的难度"而非"推理能力覆盖范围"的收缩，并提出应从覆盖范围与采样成本双维度评估剪枝。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化剪枝（专家、FFN、层剪枝）降低大模型规模但常带来精度损失。现有评估多以pass@1等单次采样指标衡量，无法区分精度下降究竟源于推理能力真的减弱，还是仅因正确解更难被采样到。因此需要一个能将"能力覆盖"与"采样效率"解耦的评估框架。

Method: 在四个数学与编程基准上，对expert、FFN、layer三类剪枝模型与原始模型进行对比，采用匹配采样预算下的pass@k（多预算、多次采样）评估；同时分析生成CoT轨迹的多样性、重复率与生成可靠性，并考察达到共同覆盖目标所需尝试次数与总token开销。

Result: 即便大幅剪枝，部分模型在pass@1下降的情况下，其pass@k覆盖仍可持平或超过原模型，并能解出原模型样本中未解出的问题；但严重剪枝时，虽存在多样的CoT轨迹，却伴随重复增加与生成可靠性下降，正确解更难被采样到，导致总token消耗在单条响应变短的情况下仍急剧上升。不同pass@1的专家选择方法在充足预算下可解相同问题，但达到相同覆盖目标所需尝试次数不同。

Conclusion: 剪枝应同时用"仍可求解问题的范围"和"获得正确解的采样成本"两个维度评估；覆盖与采样效率的分离也解释了专家选择方法的收益差异。单看pass@1会误判剪枝对推理能力的影响。

Abstract: Structured pruning reduces the size of large language models, often at the cost of lower accuracy. Whether this decline reflects diminished reasoning capacity or greater difficulty in sampling correct solutions is less clear. We examine this question across expert, FFN and layer pruning on four mathematical and coding benchmarks, comparing original and pruned models through pass@k at matched sampling budgets. Even after substantial pruning, some models match or exceed the original model's reasoning coverage despite lower pass@1, and solve problems left unsolved in the original samples. Retaining broad coverage, however, does not mean that correct solutions remain easy to obtain. Under severe pruning, diverse generated chain-of-thought (CoT) traces can coexist with increased repetition and less reliable generation. As correct answers become harder to sample, the additional attempts can sharply increase total token use even when individual responses become shorter. This separation between coverage and sampling efficiency also clarifies expert-selection gains, as methods with markedly different pass@1 can solve the same problems at large budgets yet require different numbers of attempts to reach a common coverage target. Pruning should therefore be assessed by both the range of problems a model can still solve and the sampling cost of obtaining correct solutions.

</details>


### [433] [DuSE-Bench: Benchmarking Joint Reasoning over Evolving Dialogue and Documents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00755)
*Guanjie Cheng,Jianfeng Gao,Yufei Tong,Xinkui Zhao,Shuiguang Deng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 DuSE-Bench：1,000 个任务（五类场景、700 个前提同时来自对话与文档）的双源演化基准，用演化 Support Graph 保留更新事实与复用结论到原始对话轮/文档段落的链接，并支持对回答内容、回答类型与来源归因分别评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续运行的网页信息助手需同时处理演化的文档事实与会话中建立并修订的用户需求，但缺乏系统评测：已有基准难以量化双源变化对回答要求及证据归因的影响。

Method: 构建含 1,000 任务、五场景的基准（700 个双源接地任务）；以演化 Support Graph 驱动任务构造并维护事实更新与结论复用至原始轮次和段落的溯源链接；标注区分 grounding source 与 state dependence；在 11 种基线配置上进行评测，含匹配证据替换实验。

Result: 双源联合推理持续困难，联合接地任务内容准确率最高仅 56.7%；内容准确率提升可能与回答类型选择变差并存；内容正确的回答常缺失对原始证据的完整归因；替换某一源证据的效果取决于另一源的支持程度。

Conclusion: 需协同对话记忆与文档检索，在同一时刻联合应用当前用户需求与文档事实并保留其原始支撑；数据已开源。

Abstract: Persistent Web information assistants must combine evolving document facts with user requirements established and revised across sessions. Yet systematic evaluation of how changes in both sources affect response requirements and evidence attribution remains limited. To address this gap, we introduce Dual-Source Evolution Benchmark (DuSE-Bench), a benchmark comprising 1,000 tasks across five scenarios, including 700 whose required premises originate in both dialogue and documents. An evolving Support Graph guides task construction and preserves links from updated facts and reused conclusions to original turns and passages. Task annotations distinguish grounding source from state dependence and enable separate evaluation of response content, response type, and source attribution. Experiments across 11 baseline configurations reveal persistent challenges in joint reasoning over evolving dialogue and documents, with content accuracy on jointly grounded tasks reaching at most 56.7%. Moreover, improvements in content accuracy can coincide with poorer response choice, while content-correct responses frequently lack complete attribution to original evidence. Matched evidence substitutions further show that the effect of replacing one source's evidence depends on support from the other. These findings motivate coordinating dialogue memory and document retrieval to apply current user requirements and document facts together while preserving their original support. The data are available at https://github.com/JianfengGao7/DuSE-Bench.

</details>


### [434] [Ranked but Not Stopped: Detecting Prompt-Injection Hijacks from Typed Decision Models' Output Probabilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02522)
*Junwei Yao,Jianan Liu,Yongxi Zhou,Zike Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 以模型自身置信度作告警的"低置信度监控器"虽能把被劫持样本排序在干净样本之上（AUROC 0.86–0.90），但在实际5%误报率阈值下漏检51–70%的劫持；若注入文本声称"目标确定并索要全部概率"，漏检率升至99–100%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用语言模型作分类器时，注入输入文本可把最高概率标签移向攻击者指定标签（hijack）。一类自然的防御是不知情攻击者目标的监控器：读取模型自身置信度，当top概率偏低时告警。但"能排序"不等于"能在工作点拦截"，需要一个诚实的操作级评测。

Method: 在AG News主题分类上用5个系统（其中3个经供应商API服务）测试该监控器；汇聚5类注入文本家族；以分离校准文章设定阈值使干净样本告警率≤5%，在该操作点统计漏检率；并追加一个手工句子（声称目标标签确定、要求输出全部概率）作为更强的注入变体，同时报告AUROC排序指标。

Result: 5个系统中4个上低置信度对劫持答案的排序优于干净答案（AUROC 0.86–0.90）。但在≤5%误报率的阈值下，阈值落在最不自信的干净答案中，任何更自信的劫持都会通过。三个API系统的主实验中，普通注入便条导致51–70%的劫持漏检；加入"声称确定并要求全部概率"的句子后漏检99–100%，尽管此时低置信度排序仍有AUROC 0.70–0.79。

Conclusion: 排序能力与拦截能力严重脱节：置信度监控器必须在真实操作告警率下、并对会"声称确定性"的对手进行评测；仅报告AUROC会高估其防御价值。

Abstract: Programs that use a language model as a classifier act on its most probable label. Text injected into the input can move that label to one the attacker chooses, a hijack. A monitor that does not know the attacker's label can read the model's own confidence and raise an alarm when the top probability is low. We test this monitor on AG News topic classification with five systems, three of them served through a provider's API. Pooled over five families of injected text, low confidence ranks hijacked answers above clean ones on four of the five systems (AUROC 0.86-0.90). Ranking them does not stop many of them. A threshold set so that at most 5% of clean answers to separate calibration articles alarm falls among the least confident clean answers, and every more confident hijack passes. In our main gate run on the three API-served systems, the monitor misses 51-70% of the hijacks caused by a plain injected note (per-system point estimates). When the note adds one handwritten sentence that calls the target certain and asks for full probability, the monitor misses 99-100% of the hijacks, although low confidence still ranks them at AUROC 0.70-0.79. Confidence monitors should be tested at their operating alarm rate, against attackers who claim certainty.

</details>


### [435] [Same Sentence, Different Construct: Identity-Swapped Rationales Reveal Measurement Non-Invariance in LLM Hate Speech Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02491)
*Wenchang Wang,Yue Song*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文用421个对七个受保护群体做同一化实例化的仇恨言论模板，检验LLM分类器的测量不变性；四模型均衡准确率均超0.95，但其中两个对“女性”相关仇恨言论的漏报率显著更高（超额假阴性8.3与4.4个百分点），原因是模型改变了对同一构念的判定标准（将针对女性的陈述重构为“个人厌恶”或“针对个体”），而非阈值或定义问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益被当作测量社会敏感构念（如仇恨言论）的工具，但通常只以与人类标注的聚合一致性来验证。一个有效的测量工具必须对每个被测群体施加同一构念，即满足测量不变性；现有验证忽视这一要求，而2021年已在微调分类器上报告过类似群体差异，需检验LLM是否仍存在。

Method: 构建421个仇恨言论模板，对七个受保护群体做完全相同实例化，仅身份词变化，形成身份对照设计。评估四个LLM分类器的均衡准确率，并在同一模板内比较不同群体的错误率；进一步对比模型给出的判定理由（rationales），分析构念漂移；最后加入基准自身定义（明列性别为受保护特征）做干预，并检验假阳性差异是否由仅部分群体存在的“回收性侮辱语”导致。

Result: 四个分类器均衡准确率均超过0.95；但两个模型对女性相关仇恨言论的漏报率显著更高，超额假阴性分别为8.3和4.4个百分点。理由分析显示，模型对其他群体援引受保护群体身份，却把关于女性的同一陈述重构为“个人厌恶”或“针对个人”，某模型在30个漏报模板中有22个如此。加入基准定义未能缩小差距。表面上的假阳性差异在身份控制后基本消失，并可追溯到仅部分群体存在的回收性侮辱语。所有模型共有的错误集中在模型定义与基准定义分歧处；成对反事实准确率相对端点准确率增益甚微。

Conclusion: 聚合一致性与高均衡准确率不足以证明LLM是有效测量工具；验证LLM测量需采用身份控制的测量不变性测试，且必须同时考察判定结果与模型陈述的判定标准（理由），因为构念漂移会以标准改变而非阈值变化的形式出现。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as measurement instruments for socially consequential constructs such as hate speech, and are typically validated by their aggregate agreement with human labels. A valid instrument must also apply the same construct to every group it measures. We test this requirement using 421 \hc{} templates that are instantiated identically for seven protected groups, so that only the identity term varies. Four LLM classifiers each exceed 0.95 balanced accuracy, yet within identical templates two of them miss hateful statements about women at markedly higher rates than the same statements about other groups (excess false-negative rates of 8.3 and 4.4 percentage points), a gap first reported for fine-tuned classifiers in 2021. We show how the construct shifts. Comparing rationales within each template, we find that models invoke protected-group status for other groups but recast the identical statement about women as personal dislike or as aimed at an individual, in 22 of 30 missed templates for one model. Adding the benchmark's own definition, which lists sex as a protected characteristic, does not close the gap, and the contrast persists. Apparent false-positive disparities, by contrast, largely vanish under identity control and trace to reclaimed slurs present only for some groups. Errors shared by all models concentrate where model and benchmark definitions diverge, and pairwise counterfactual accuracy adds little beyond endpoint accuracy. We argue that validating LLM measurement requires identity-controlled tests of measurement invariance that examine both decisions and the criteria models state for them.

</details>


### [436] [EviCast: Forecasting Retrieval Gains Through Shared Response Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02387)
*Yibo Wang,Jisheng Dang,Bimei Wang,Jiongpei Hou,Jingwen Zhao,Wenjun Ma,Fei Shen,Juncheng Li,Meng Wang,Qi Tian,Bin Hu,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: EviCast通过干预式证据状态分解，在无需执行每种RAG配置的情况下预测检索净效用及其95%置信下界，实现低成本的检索配置决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相关证据并不保证生成器能有效利用；不加区分的检索反而会降低任务性能并增加检索与长上下文推理成本。现有方法既无法在大规模执行前判断某个生成器、任务分布与检索器配置是否值得部署，也无法在共享预算下诊断多个候选检索器。

Method: 提出EviCast框架：一次性测量生成器对受控证据状态的响应，得到共享画像，再结合每个候选检索器的离线证据状态分布，计算端到端净效用及95%置信下界；并通过状态精化分析刻画二值与拓扑感知两种实例的精确性条件及共享校准相对逐检索器校准的统计效率。

Result: 在冻结评测中，EviCast以2.75 F1的预测误差正确判定HotpotQA全部14种检索配置，同时将诊断性生成调用减少80%，在低预算区间预测误差最低（七个预测器中）；拓扑感知版本EviCast-T捕捉终止证据与桥接证据的互补性，在MuSiQue与HotpotQA上正确判定全部16种配置，前瞻性迁移至第三数据集后判定24种中的23种。

Conclusion: 检索部署不仅取决于证据可获得性，还取决于生成器将证据结构转化为稳定净效用的能力。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) extends large language models with external evidence, yet relevant evidence does not ensure that a generator can use it. Indiscriminate retrieval can degrade task performance while adding retrieval and long-context inference costs. Existing methods neither determine before large-scale execution whether a generator, task distribution, and retriever configuration is worth deploying nor diagnose multiple candidate retrievers under a shared budget. We introduce EviCast, a framework that forecasts retrieval value through interventional evidence-state decomposition. EviCast measures a generator's response to controlled evidence states once and combines this shared profile with the offline evidence-state distribution of each candidate retriever, yielding the end-to-end net utility and its 95% lower confidence bound without executing every RAG configuration. A state-refinement analysis characterizes when its binary and topology-aware instantiations are exact and when shared calibration is statistically more efficient than per-retriever calibration. In frozen evaluations, EviCast correctly decides all 14 HotpotQA retrieval configurations with a forecast error of 2.75 F1 points while reducing diagnostic generation calls by 80%, and it attains the lowest forecast error among seven predictors in the low-budget regime. Its topology-aware instantiation, EviCast-T, captures the complementarity between terminal and bridge evidence, correctly deciding all 16 configurations on MuSiQue and HotpotQA and 23 of 24 after prospective transfer to a third dataset. These results show that retrieval deployment depends on both evidence availability and the generator's ability to convert evidence structure into stable net utility. Code is available at https://github.com/YiboWang2002/EviCast.

</details>


### [437] [ACTOR: Action-Centered Temporal Organization for Literary Role-Playing Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03184)
*Yuxiang Gao,Tianjie Ju,Zheng Wu,Zongru Wu,Hao Fei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ACTOR框架，从小说原文自动抽取并结构化角色非对话行为，构建行为轨迹与反事实行为对，结合RPO训练与四选一评测，提升文学角色扮演中的行为一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文学角色扮演智能体主要围绕对话生成建模，角色的非对话行为及其在故事时间中的动态演变被严重忽视。

Method: ACTOR（面向文学角色扮演智能体的行动中心时间组织框架）：抽取对话与人物画像相关的非对话行为，用Thought-Action-Observation结构表示每个行为，并按故事内部时序组织行为轨迹；基于143部文学作品构建行为数据集，为每个源行为生成上下文合理但与人物画像不一致的反事实行为；采用正则化偏好优化（RPO），在DPO基础上加入源行为的负对数似然损失，联合优化偏好与生成；设计四选一"下一行为选择"任务评估角色行为模仿能力。

Result: 发现现有模型难以从历史行为和演化中的角色状态可靠推断角色一致行为；在17,560个评测实例上，用ACTOR偏好对训练的模型准确率显著提升。

Conclusion: 结构化、按时序组织的监督信号使模型能利用人物画像与先前行为推断后续行为，将文学角色扮演从单纯的对话模仿推进到行为层面。

Abstract: Large language agents for literary role-playing are typically modeled around dialogue generation, leaving characters' non-dialogue behaviors and their dynamic evolution over story time underrepresented. In this paper, we propose ACTOR (Action-Centered Temporal Organization for Literary Role-Playing Agents), an automated framework for constructing such behavior trajectories from raw novel texts. ACTOR extracts dialogue and persona-relevant non-dialogue behaviors, represents each behavior using a Thought-Action-Observation structure, and organizes behavior trajectories according to the internal temporal order of the story. We build a behavior dataset from 143 diverse literary works. For each source behavior, we generate counterfactual behaviors that are contextually plausible yet inconsistent with the character's persona. We find that existing models struggle to reliably infer character-consistent actions from historical behaviors and evolving character states. Using these behavior pairs, we train models with Regularized Preference Optimization (RPO), which augments DPO with a negative log-likelihood loss on the source behavior to jointly optimize behavior preference and generation. We further design a four-way next-behavior selection task to evaluate the model's ability to faithfully mimic character actions. Across 17,560 evaluation instances, the model trained on ACTOR's preference pairs achieves substantially improved accuracy. This result demonstrates that structured, temporally organized supervision enables models to leverage character profiles and prior behaviors to infer subsequent actions, greatly advancing literary role-playing beyond mere dialogue imitation. Code and data are available at https://github.com/SilentStar233/ACTOR.

</details>


### [438] [Tracing the Scientific Discovery Capacity of LLMs to Their Training Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03617)
*Arda Uzunoglu,Mahler Revsine,Michael Schatz,Benjamin Van Durme,Mehrdad Farajtabar,Daniel Khashabi,Eric Nalisnick*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出"单次事实"（monofacts，即训练集中仅出现一次的事实）决定大语言模型的科学发现能力，并通过理论建模与在材料科学、调控基因组学中的训练集操纵实验验证：monofact 比例越高，发现越多。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 在科学发现上展现潜力，但"什么因素使发现变得可靠"这一基本问题尚未解答；作者希望把科学发现能力追溯到训练数据层面，并给出可量化的解释框架。

Method: 将问题形式化为"缺失概率质量"（missing probability mass）问题并建立理论：训练集中只出现一次的 monofacts 决定发现能力。实证上在材料科学与调控基因组学两个领域直接操纵训练集中的 monofact 比例，跨两个开放权重模型族、多种采样策略与推理预算进行对照实验，并做多样性控制实验与跨领域迁移实验。

Result: monofact 比例越高，模型发现越多，且该规律在模型族、采样策略、推理预算下均稳定成立；该关系无法仅用训练集多样性解释；与领域内数据配对时，该效应可跨科学领域迁移。

Conclusion: 训练数据中的 monofact 比例是支配语言模型科学发现的关键因素，为通过数据构成调控 LLM 发现能力提供了理论与实证依据。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show growing promise for scientific discovery, yet basic questions remain about what enables reliable discovery. How can we trace the scientific discovery capacity of LLMs to their training data? We study this question as one of missing probability mass and develop a theoretical account in which monofacts-the facts observed once during training-set the discovery capacity. In materials science and regulatory genomics, we directly manipulate monofact rates in training sets and find that more monofacts consistently yield more discoveries across two open-weight model families, sampling strategies, and reasoning budgets. Further experiments show the relationship cannot be explained by training-set diversity alone and can transfer across scientific domains when paired with in-domain data. Together, our results identify monofact rate in training data as a key factor governing discoveries in language models.

</details>


### [439] [ufakzeka-kulak: Building and Evaluating a 31.6M-Parameter Turkish Speech Recognizer from Scratch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03605)
*Sait Furkan Teke*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ufakzeka-kulak：31.6M参数的开源土耳其语语音识别模型，FastConformer-TDT+CTC，Apache-2.0发布，WER优于Whisper base/small


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该工作旨在提供一个完全开源、可商用、可复现的小型土耳其语语音转文本模型，并建立严格的评估流程（预注册发布门槛、测试集仅评一次），以便与Whisper等模型进行公平比较。

Method: 模型为31.6M参数的FastConformer编码器，配TDT（token-and-duration transducer）与CTC双头，从零训练。训练数据4,977小时，均来自允许商用的许可来源：281小时人工转写，其余4,696小时的训练文本为上传者字幕或机器转写，仅在第二路独立音频读法与其一致时保留。输出带大小写与标点的土耳其语，数字写作词。配方、checkpoint、标注与导出方案均在开发集上确定；测试集在训练前固定发布门槛下仅评分一次。采用贪婪TDT解码。

Result: 归一化WER：FLEURS土耳其语测试0.0921（95%区间0.0792–0.1055），Common Voice 27.0土耳其语测试0.0916（0.0873–0.0958）；两者均低于Whisper base与Whisper small，配对区间完全位于零以下。Whisper large-v3（贪婪）分别为0.0604与0.0767。对话语音WER为0.3807。另报告标点与大小写、退化音频表现，以及各导出件对训练模型的复现程度。

Conclusion: 该模型以远小于Whisper的参数量在朗读类土耳其语基准上超越Whisper base/small，但距large-v3仍有差距；对话语音性能明显下降（WER 0.38）。其严格预注册评估与可商用许可为小型开源ASR提供可信基线。

Abstract: ufakzeka-kulak is an open Turkish speech-to-text model of 31.6M parameters, a FastConformer encoder with a token-and-duration transducer (TDT) and a CTC head, trained from scratch and released under Apache-2.0. It writes cased, punctuated Turkish with numbers as words. Its 4,977 training hours come from sources whose licences allow commercial use; 281 hours are human-transcribed, and for the other 4,696 the training text is an uploader subtitle or a machine transcript, kept only where a second, independent reading of the audio agrees with it. The recipe, checkpoint, labelling and export choices were made on development data, and the test sets were scored once, in a release gate fixed before training. With greedy TDT decoding the normalised word error rate (WER) is 0.0921 (95 percent interval 0.0792 to 0.1055) on FLEURS Turkish test and 0.0916 (0.0873 to 0.0958) on Common Voice 27.0 Turkish test, lower than Whisper base and Whisper small on both sets with paired intervals wholly below zero; Whisper large-v3 (greedy) scores 0.0604 and 0.0767. On conversational speech the WER is 0.3807. We also report punctuation and casing, degraded audio, and how closely each shipped export reproduces the trained model.

</details>


### [440] [DepthGraft: Structural Regularization through Hierarchical Cross-Layer KV Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03142)
*Xiaohan Qin,Xiangdong Zhang,Yu Wang,Huaijin Wu,Zhuo Xia,Yebin Yang,Junchi Yan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 DepthGraft，一种分层 KV 共享架构，用步长对齐的浅-中层 KV 对重构深层 KV，将非局部梯度流分散到多个源层，同时保持预填充早完成并将 KV 缓存减少约三分之一，在 0.5B–16B 稠密与 MoE 模型上取得一致的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Pre-LN 架构存在深度方向的信息稀释问题，深层网络无法被有效利用；已有的跨层连接方案虽能缓解该问题，但通常引入额外计算或显存访问开销。作者希望以高效的跨层 KV 共享形式获得跨层连接收益。

Method: 重新审视跨层 KV 共享：除缓存压缩外，每条 KV 复用边都会从深层到源 KV 投影建立直接梯度路径，使其成为 KV 表示几何的隐式结构正则。系统分析表明，合适的共享拓扑会锐化 key 的检索方向并丰富 value 的内容子空间，而现有的相邻层共享或全局锚点设计未能充分利用此效应。据此设计 DepthGraft：由步长对齐的浅层-中层源对重构深层 KV，将非局部梯度流分布到多个源层。

Result: 在 0.5B 至 16B 参数的稠密与 MoE 模型上，GQA 与 MLA 两种注意力下均取得一致的下游提升；16B MoE 模型上 MMLU-Pro 绝对提升 7.0%，CMMLU 提升 6.6%，C3 提升 6.4%。同时 KV 缓存减少约三分之一，并保留预填充早完成特性。

Conclusion: KV 共享不仅是缓存压缩手段，更是有效的隐式结构正则；共享拓扑的选择至关重要。DepthGraft 以分层、步长对齐的重构方式兼顾效率与效果，可作为大规模预训练的可扩展架构设计。

Abstract: Scaling depth is a key route to stronger large language models, but Pre-LN architectures often suffer from depth-wise information dilution, limiting the effective use of deep layers. While cross-layer connectivity has proven effective at mitigating this problem, existing designs usually introduce additional computation or memory access. We revisit cross-layer KV sharing as an efficient form of such connectivity. Beyond cache compression, each KV reuse edge creates a direct gradient path from deep layers to source KV projections, turning KV sharing into an implicit structural regularizer for KV representation geometry. We provide a systematic analysis of this mechanism, showing that proper sharing topologies sharpen key retrieval directions while enriching the value content subspace, whereas existing adjacent or global-anchor designs do not fully exploit this effect. Motivated by this, we propose DepthGraft, a hierarchical KV-sharing architecture that reconstructs deep-layer KV from stride-aligned shallow-middle source pairs. DepthGraft distributes non-local gradient flow across source layers, while preserving prefill early completion and reducing KV cache by roughly one third. Experiments on dense and MoE models from 0.5B to 16B parameters show consistent downstream improvements under both GQA and MLA. Notably, on the 16B MoE model, DepthGraft achieves a 7.0% absolute improvement on MMLU-Pro, along with gains of 6.6% on CMMLU and 6.4% on C3. These results validate the potential of DepthGraft as a scalable design for large-scale pretraining. The project page is available at https://github.com/jianke0604/DepthGraft.

</details>


### [441] [SAGE (Subjectivity-Aware Generation Estimator): A Linguistic Framework for AI-Generated Review Detection *](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03060)
*Gonzalo Freijedo Aduna,Charles Yaiche,Patrick Bas,Alda Mari*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出基于"主观性"语言特征检测AI生成同行评审的轻量方法，融合Sem-Detect后达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI生成同行评审泛滥，现有检测器缺乏可解释的、具有语言学依据的判别信号；作者认为"主观性"是人类写作的固有特质，可作为区分人机文本的线索。

Method: 在两个层面刻画主观性：(1) 语义层面的评价性语言与情态；(2) 语用层面的言语行为。利用言语行为标注特征与模型预测的主观性得分，训练轻量分类器，并与SOTA检测器Sem-Detect的输出融合。

Result: 仅用语言特征即达AUROC 0.9566；在APRDB基准上，FPR=1%时TPR由Sem-Detect的0.874提升至0.985，超越现有SOTA。

Conclusion: 主观性语言特征为AI生成同行评审检测提供可解释的信息来源，且易于集成进现有检测方法；代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: We propose a simple, linguistically motivated approach to detecting AI-generated peer reviews based on the inherently human trait of subjectivity. We capture subjectivity at two levels: the semantic level of evaluative language and modality and the pragmatic level of speech acts. Using features derived from speech act annotations and model-predicted subjectivity scores, we train a lightweight classifier that achieves an AUROC of 0.9566 with only these linguistic features. Combining its output with the state-of-the-art detector Sem-Detect raises the TPR at 1% FPR of Sem-Detect on the APRDB benchmark from 0.874 to 0.985, outperforming the current state of the art. Our results show that linguistic features of subjectivity provide an explainable source of information for detecting AI-generated peer reviews and can be readily integrated into existing detection methods. The code and models are publicly available on GitHub (https://github.com/Arys02/generated\_ text\_detection\_hub) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/Arys02), respectively.

</details>


### [442] [PlagiaCorpus: A Bilingual, Adversarial, and Cross-Lingual Dataset for Forensic Plagiarism Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02940)
*Adel Ammar,Serry Sibaee,Wadii Boulila*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: PlagiaCorpus：阿拉伯语-英语双语抄袭与文本复用检测基准数据集，含LLM生成与跨语言复用，共198,643条记录、五级复用类别加Safe类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有抄袭与文本复用检测基准缺乏阿拉伯语-英语双语覆盖，且未涵盖大语言模型改写与跨语言翻译式复用；需构建可同时评测逐字复制、字符混淆、LLM同语改写、英阿翻译改写等递进难度任务的基准。

Method: 构建源语料34,885段（英/阿维基百科及两个开放许可书籍集），并生成163,758条查询（训练147,381、测试16,377）；查询覆盖五类复用（逐字复制、字符级混淆、两种LLM同语改写、英阿翻译加结构改写）及Safe非复用类；每条正样本链接源段，训练/测试按源段分组划分以避免泄漏；经语言识别、LLM生成痕迹去除、单语与跨语言去重等清洗流程。

Result: 技术验证给出各类别长度统计、训练/测试划分自动检查结果，以及人工标注样本的标注者间一致性；数据以JSON与Parquet格式发布，许可为CC BY-SA 4.0。

Conclusion: PlagiaCorpus提供了难度递进、防泄漏划分的双语抄袭与文本复用检测基准，覆盖LLM改写与跨语言复用场景，可用于相关检测方法的标准化评测。

Abstract: PlagiaCorpus is a bilingual Arabic-English dataset for benchmarking plagiarism and text-reuse detection, including reuse produced by large language models (LLMs) and reuse across languages. It contains 198,643 text records: a source corpus of 34,885 passages drawn from English and Arabic Wikipedia and two openly licensed book collections, and 163,758 queries (147,381 for training and 16,377 for testing). The queries cover five reuse classes of increasing difficulty, namely verbatim copying, character-level obfuscation, same-language paraphrasing by two different LLMs, and English--Arabic translation with structural paraphrasing, together with a Safe class of non-reused passages. Every positive query is linked to its source passage, and the train/test split is grouped by source passage so that no passage contributes queries to both splits. The release was curated through language identification, removal of LLM generation artefacts, and exact and cross-lingual de-duplication. Technical validation reports per-class length statistics, automatic checks of the train/test split, and inter-annotator agreement on a manually rated sample.
