How this direction is read is far less stable: the reading circuit spreads across more attention heads as models grow, instruction tuning makes more questions read it in the opposite sense, and in one model changing only the system prompt reverses the circuit's sign. Ablating the direction while sparing the attention sink removes most of the coupling at under 1.3\% perplexity cost in 18 of 19 instruction-tuned models, though it shifts standalone answers in two. Without the sink spared, the direction's alignment with the leading principal component of ordinary text predicts which models pay a high cost. Written once, the commitment is read differently across scale, training and prompt.

</details>


### [478] [They Know Where It Is, But Not What It Says: A Bilingual Hallucination Benchmark of Hadith Recall in Open LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02587)
*Dayam Nadeem,Safdar Mustafa,Ameen Ur Rehman,Shahab Saquib Sohail,Mohammad Nadeem,Usman Naseem*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个英阿双语基准，测试五个开源权重模型对六大正统圣训集逐条精确复述的能力。3万条回复中0%达到词法与语义双重高保真，阿拉伯语表现更差，作者主张伊斯兰学术应用必须采用检索增强而非参数记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型被越来越多地用于宗教知识查询，而圣训召回是可验证的高风险任务：给定（集、章、编号）唯一对应一段正确文本，任何偏离都构成伪造，可能被误认为真实经文。因此需要量化评估模型在无检索条件下精确复述圣训的可靠性。

Method: 构建英/阿双语基准，覆盖六大正统逊尼派圣训集，每集抽500条（每模型每语言3,000条，共30,000条回复）。测试五个可本地部署的开源权重模型（Mistral-7B、Gemma3-4B、Jais-7B、ALLaM-7B、Phi4-mini-3.8B）。仅提供书目引用、不做检索增强，要求模型复现原文；以BLEU衡量词法保真、以多语言余弦相似度衡量语义保真，并单独标记拒答。

Result: 全部五个模型与两种语言合计30,000条回复中，0%同时达到高词法保真与高语义保真（即与源文本精确可验证匹配）；阿拉伯语回复表现一致差于英语。拒答被单独统计。

Conclusion: 当前开源权重模型在缺乏检索锚定时不具备精确复述宗教文本的可靠性，作为圣训来源存在潜在风险；面向伊斯兰学术的部署应强制采用基于经核验语料的检索增强生成，取代参数记忆。代码、提示、评估流程与打分输出已公开。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly consulted for religious knowledge, including the recall of specific Hadith (recorded sayings and actions of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him). Unlike open-ended generation, Hadith recall is a high-stakes, verifiable task: a reference (collection, chapter, and Hadith number) has exactly one correct text, and any deviation from it constitutes a fabrication that can be mistaken for authentic scripture. This study introduces a bilingual (English/Arabic) benchmark that probes five open-weight, locally-deployable language models (Mistral-7B, Gemma3-4B, Jais-7B, ALLaM-7B, and Phi4-mini-3.8B) across all six canonical Sunni Hadith collections (Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan Abi Da'ud, Jami' al-Tirmidhi, Sunan an-Nasa'i, Sunan Ibn Majah), sampling 500 Hadith per collection (3,000 per model per language, 30,000 responses total). Each model is given only the bibliographic reference and asked to reproduce the exact Hadith text, with no retrieval augmentation, and is scored on lexical fidelity (BLEU) and semantic fidelity (multilingual cosine similarity), with refusals flagged separately. Across all five models and both languages, 0% of 30,000 responses achieve both high lexical and high semantic fidelity, i.e., an exact, verifiable match to the source text. Arabic responses fare uniformly worse than English. These findings suggest that current open-weight LLMs, used without retrieval grounding, are unreliable and potentially dangerous sources for exact religious-text recall, and that deployment for Islamic scholarship should mandate retrieval-augmented generation over a verified corpus rather than parametric memory. The complete code, prompts, evaluation pipeline, and scored outputs are publicly available at https://github.com/dayam8696/Hadith-Hallucination-Benchmark.

</details>


### [479] [Re$^3$Rank: Listwise Reranking with Reasoning-Conditioned Retrieval Heads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02550)
*Ruiyi Yan,Zhuoyuan Mao,Yugo Murawaki,Yiwen Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Re³Rank：以推理轨迹token作为注意力查询驱动推理条件检索头（RRHeads）的列表级重排序器，并用直通估计器端到端联合训练生成器与打分器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于注意力的重排序器用检索头从问题向候选项分配的注意力质量打分，但问题作为固定查询所携带的信息有限，难以定位相关证据。

Method: 生成器先针对问题与候选项写出推理轨迹；打分器将轨迹token作为少数选定RRHeads的注意力查询，以连续分数形式读取相关性；引入直通估计器将排序损失穿过离散轨迹反向传播，实现生成器与打分器面向排序目标的联合训练。

Result: 在9个基准上平均，Re³Rank优于11个基线重排序器；4B版本平均超出最强基线3.11 NDCG@10，0.6B版本亦超过参数量达32B的重排序器。

Conclusion: 以推理轨迹替代固定问题查询可显著提升检索头式重排序效果，且参数效率极高，小模型即可媲美甚至超越大规模重排序器。

Abstract: Attention-based rerankers score each candidate by the attention mass that retrieval heads route to it from the question, but the question, serving as a fixed query, carries limited information for locating relevant evidence. We propose Re$^3$Rank, a listwise reranker built on reasoning-conditioned retrieval heads (RRHeads). A generator first writes a reasoning trace over the question and the candidates, and a scorer then uses the trace tokens as the attention query of a few selected RRHeads, reading relevance as continuous scores. We present a straight-through estimator to propagate the ranking loss through the discrete trace, so that the generator and the scorer can be trained jointly for ranking. Averaged over 9 benchmarks, Re$^3$Rank outperforms 11 baseline rerankers: our 4B variant exceeds the strongest baseline by 3.11 NDCG@10 points on average, and even our 0.6B variant surpasses rerankers with up to 32B parameters.

</details>


### [480] [Solver-Like Behavior in Large Language Models as Formalizers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02395)
*Rikhil Amonkar,Stuti Mohan,Kevin Nguyen,Ceyhun Efe Kayan,Ronan Le Bras,Li Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出并量化了"求解器式行为"（SLB）：推理型形式化器在生成程序前的长推理链中常常自行完成求解，这部分努力多数冗余，且可能通过输出评估掩盖错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在LLM-as-formalizer范式中，形式化器仅以程序输出被评判，但其推理轨迹可能在程序之前就完成了求解工作。作者希望揭示并系统刻画这种被评估盲区忽略的、冗余甚至有害的轨迹行为。

Method: 定义关于轨迹、程序与输出的SLB本体论；用经人工标注校验的LLM裁判，对3个推理模型在4个约束满足数据集（各用声明式与命令式两种形式语言）上生成的2,000条生成结果打标；并比较警示提示与"运行时占位符隐藏数值"两种干预手段。

Result: SLB出现在85%的轨迹中，占推理token的24%，但程序通常重新计算答案，故多为冗余；9%的程序直接继承轨迹答案及其错误，且只要答案正确即可通过基于输出的评估；SLB量与准确率无关，且在命令式Python中比声明式Z3/PDDL更常见；警示提示仅降低约四分之一，而运行时占位符隐藏数值可消除97%的SLB且不损失准确率。

Conclusion: 形式化器应以其"如何到达程序"来评估，而不仅以"输出什么"来评估；基于输出的评估会系统性地奖励冗余且可能继承错误的推理轨迹，需引入轨迹层面评估与过程约束。

Abstract: In the LLM-as-formalizer paradigm, a large language model translates a problem into a formal program and leaves the search to a solver, gaining the solver's guarantees. Formalizers are now often reasoning models that write a long reasoning trace before the program, yet they are judged only by the program's output. We find that the trace routinely does the solver's job, assigning, testing and ruling out values until it often reaches the full answer; we call this solver-like behavior (SLB). We define an ontology of SLB over the trace, the program and its output, and use LLM judges, checked against human labels, to label 2,000 generations from three reasoning models on four constraint satisfaction datasets, each formalized in a declarative and an imperative formal language. SLB appears in 85% of traces and takes 24% of reasoning tokens, yet the program usually recomputes the answer, so the effort is redundant. The 9% of programs that inherit the trace's answer also inherit its errors, and pass output-based evaluation whenever that answer is correct. The amount of SLB is not associated with accuracy, and SLB is more common in imperative Python than in declarative Z3 or PDDL. Cautionary prompts reduce it by only a quarter, but hiding the problem's values behind placeholders, which the program receives only at run time, removes 97% of it without loss of accuracy. Formalizers should therefore be evaluated by how their programs are reached, not only by what they output.

</details>


### [481] [Beyond Accuracy: How Quantization Affects Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02368)
*Areej Mehboob,Muhammad Ali Shafique,Muhammad Usman Qadeer,Hamza Farooq*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统评测BF16与4-bit AWQ/GPTQ量化对Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct（7B/14B/32B）及Devstral-Small-2507在OJBench编程任务上的影响，发现最终准确率无统计显著下降，但解题轨迹、工具调用与失败模式发生显著变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推理成本限制了编码智能体的部署场景，量化可压缩模型，但量化对"执行并迭代修正程序"的编码智能体行为影响尚缺乏研究。

Method: 在OJBench编程题上，对Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct（7B、14B、32B）与Devstral-Small-2507（24B）比较BF16与4-bit AWQ、GPTQ三种精度设置，每个配置运行三个随机种子；除最终准确率外，还分析解题轨迹（一次性求解 vs 循环迭代求解）、工具/执行器调用情况以及失败类型分布（编译错误、运行时错误、答案错误、超时）。

Result: 各编码智能体均未检测到统计显著的准确率损失。但行为层面变化明显：AWQ使Qwen-7B的一次性求解数由17降至0，循环迭代求解由10升至25；Qwen-32B的全部成功案例均依赖工具调用，而Devstral几乎无法产生有效的执行器调用。失败画像亦不同：Qwen-32B的编译错误远多于更小的Qwen模型，并在量化后略有上升；Devstral的失败由运行时错误显著转向错误答案与超时。

Conclusion: 编码智能体的量化鲁棒性评估不应只看最终准确率，还需结合解题轨迹、工具使用与失败模式进行多维分析。

Abstract: Agents are increasingly used for coding tasks, but the inference cost of large language models (LLMs) limits where they can run. Quantization reduces model size, but its effects on coding agents that execute and revise programs remain underexplored. We compare BF16 with 4-bit AWQ and GPTQ for Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct (7B, 14B, and 32B) and Devstral-Small-2507 (24B) on OJBench coding problems across three seeds. We detect no statistically significant accuracy loss for any of the coding agents. However, final accuracy can conceal substantial behavioral changes: AWQ reduces Qwen-7B one-shot solves from 17 to 0 while increasing loop-based solves from 10 to 25. All Qwen-32B successes involve tool use, whereas Devstral rarely makes a valid executor call. Failure profiles also differ: Qwen-32B produces far more compilation errors than the smaller Qwen models, rising slightly under quantization, while Devstral's failures shift significantly from runtime errors toward wrong answers and timeouts. These findings indicate that quantization robustness in coding agents should be assessed through solution trajectories, tool use, and failure modes, in addition to final accuracy.

</details>


### [482] [NitiBench+: A Temporal Thai Legal Question Answering Benchmark Across 17 Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03576)
*Pawitsapak Akarajaradwong,Sarana Nutanong,Chompakorn Chaksangchaichot*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文指出法律问答基准忽视法律的时间效力问题：在泰国四家法院156,650份判决中，最多67%引用了此后被修订或废止的法律。作者提出NitiBench+（1,670题、17个领域），为每个引用的法条同时提供"判决日有效文本"与"现行文本"，检索语料涵盖所有泰国法条的各版本；并按泰国律师理事会评分标准、Bar-standard分及引用F1进行评测。结果显示读现行文本会使Bar-standard降0.25、缺失已废止法条降0.79，且Citation F1对此不敏感；最终认为"判决时有效文本"才是公平设定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律随时间变化，法院依判决当日有效法律裁判，但现有法律问答基准只用"今天的法律"给答案打分，存在时间错配。作者实证量化了这一错配的普遍性（多数已决判决引用的法条此后被修订或废止），据此论证法律基准必须"跟踪日期"，需要一个同时保存历史与现行法条文本的基准。

Method: 1) 统计泰国四家法院156,650份判决中对已修订/废止法条的引用比例；2) 构建NitiBench+：基于三家法院判决的1,670个题目、17个领域，每个引用法条同时存"判决日有效文本"与"现行文本"，检索语料收录所有泰国法条的各个日期版本；3) 评分采用泰国律师理事会评分标准（Bar-standard）、答案与法院引用法条的重合度（Citation F1）。Part I在13个开放权重模型上做错文本对照实验，分解规则变更型（428题）与仅措辞变动型（331题）的惩罚；Part II在500题（按领域分层）留出测试集上，对26个模型在"仅记忆""提供法院法条""以检索代理查询有效法律"三种设定下评测，记录每题成本与幻觉引用。

Result: 最多67%的判决引用此后被修订或废止的法律。读现行文本使Bar-standard降0.25，缺失已废止法律降0.79；惩罚主要来自规则变更（428个规则变更题上0.45），措辞变动题无损失（0），而Citation F1检测不到该损失。Part II中最佳模型7.78/10，最佳开放权重模型6.39；无检索工具时仅5个开放权重模型能召回任何泰国法律，有工具时26个模型中20个提升、6个下降。

Conclusion: 法律基准必须追踪日期；以判决时有效文本评测，当今模型在泰国法律上仍存在较大差距。作者发布公开排行榜（500题分层留出测试集，同形态验证集公开），并将持续纳入新模型。

Abstract: Law changes over time. A court decides a case under the law in force on that day, and legal QA benchmarks grade answers against today's law. We checked 156,650 decisions of four Thai courts. Up to 67% of them cite law that has since been amended or repealed. We introduce NitiBench+, the sequel of our NitiBench, a Thai legal QA benchmark with 1,670 items across 17 domains, built from decisions of three courts. For each cited section it holds both the text in force on the decision date and the current text, and its retrieval corpus holds every dated version of every Thai statute section. Answers are graded on the Thai Bar Council rubric, the Bar-standard score, and on the overlap between the cited sections and the court's. The report has two parts. Part I measures the cost of the wrong text on 13 open-weight models. Reading the current text of amended law drops the Bar-standard score by 0.25 and missing repealed law drops it by 0.79. The penalty comes from rule changes, 0.45 on the 428 rule-changed items and none on the 331 wording-only items, and Citation F1 does not see it. The text in force is the fair setting. Part II benchmarks today's models on that setting. A public leaderboard ranks 26 models on a held-out test split of 500 items stratified by domain, with a validation split of the same shape released for public use, from memory alone, with the court's sections provided, and as a retrieval agent over the law in force, with the cost per item and the hallucinated citations. The best model scores 7.78 out of 10 and the best open-weight model 6.39. Without a search tool only five open-weight models recall any Thai law, and with it twenty of the 26 models gain and six lose. Leaderboard will take new models as they are released. Legal benchmarks must track dates, and on the right text today's models still leave a wide gap on Thai law.

</details>


### [483] [VisCodeBench: a new benchmark dataset for Text-to-Vis reflecting real-world practice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02353)
*Hy Nguyen,Thomas James Elton,Ella Wilson,Andrew Reeson,Cecile Paris,Josiah Poon,Jonathan K. Kummerfeld*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出VisCodeBench，一个覆盖教育、科学、大众三类场景、2672个样本的端到端text-to-vis基准，从执行、图表内容、视觉质量三维度七项指标评测Codex、Claude Code与LIDA搭配多种LLM的表现，发现基础执行已近饱和，但数据还原度仍低（最佳0.81，最困难子集0.69），且系统设计影响可与模型本身相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准难以覆盖具有挑战性的自然语言可视化请求，LLM在复杂text-to-vis任务上的真实能力缺乏系统性评估。作者希望构建一个多领域、分难度、端到端的基准，全面揭示当前系统的瓶颈所在。

Method: 构建VisCodeBench，包含来自教育、科学、大众场景的2,672个不同复杂度样本；选取Codex、Claude Code、LIDA三种可视化系统，搭配多种开源与商用LLM，采用覆盖执行、图表内容与视觉质量三方面的七项指标进行评测，并公开排行榜（数据集私有以防训练污染）。

Result: 强系统的基础执行已接近解决，但无系统能复现参考数据，最佳数据相似度仅0.81，在该指标最困难子集上降至0.69；前沿模型在图表正确性与效率上出现分化，ClaudeCode-Opus-4.7相较Codex-GPT-5图表正确性提升约5个点且快约20秒；同为GPT-5驱动时Codex明显优于LIDA；最强系统仍需39–78秒出结果。

Conclusion: text-to-vis的瓶颈已从"能否执行"转向"数据保真度、图表正确性与延迟"；提示、执行与精炼流水线等系统设计对结果的影响可与底层模型相当，未来改进应同时关注模型能力与系统架构。

Abstract: Generating visualisations from natural language requests (text-to-vis) enables users to explore data more efficiently. While LLMs can complete simple visualisation requests, their performance on challenging ones is not well covered by existing benchmarks. We introduce VisCodeBench, an end-to-end text-to-vis benchmark with 2,672 samples from three different domains: educational, scientific, and general audience scenarios with varying levels of complexity. We benchmark three visualisation systems---Codex, Claude Code, and LIDA---paired with a range of open and commercial LLMs across seven metrics covering execution, chart content, and visual quality. While basic execution is near-solved for strong systems, no system comes close to reproducing the reference data, with the best displayed data similarity reaching only $0.81$ and falling to $0.69$ on our hardest subset for this metric. We further find that frontier models separate on chart correctness and efficiency, with ClaudeCode-Opus-4.7 improving chart correctness by around 5 points over Codex-GPT-5 while running roughly 20 seconds faster. Separately, we find that system design matters as much as the underlying model: despite both running on GPT-5, Codex clearly outperforms LIDA, showing that the surrounding prompting, execution, and refinement pipeline can shape outcomes as much as the model itself. Finally, latency remains a practical obstacle, as even the strongest systems take 39-78 seconds to produce results. VisCodeBench is available at \href{https://github.com/SAIPLL/VisCodeBench}{https://github.com/SAIPLL/VisCodeBench} and accessed via a leaderboard; the full dataset is kept private to prevent LLM training use.

</details>


### [484] [CheXPoT: Post-Hoc Visual Verification and Correction of VLM-Generated Radiology Reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00785)
*Joey Guo,Rayan Ansari,Alaa Youssef*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CheXPoT是一个程序化思维（PoT）后处理框架，将生成的胸片报告分解为谓词，用DenseNet-121与Grad-CAM视觉证据表进行接地验证，删除无法接地的发现并重写报告，从而低成本抑制VLM幻觉。在4,145张图像的留出集上显著提升精确率与F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM在胸片报告生成中虽有潜力，但存在与图像不符的幻觉发现，限制了临床采用。已有方法（强化学习、偏好优化、思维链监督）虽能改进，却计算代价高昂，因此需要一种低成本的后处理验证手段。

Method: 提出CheXPoT：(1) 用RadGraph与LLM将生成报告分解为谓词（predicates）；(2) 基于DenseNet-121与Grad-CAM构建视觉证据表，对谓词进行接地；(3) 执行PoT验证代码，剔除不支持谓词；(4) 重写报告。方法为模型无关的后处理，在MedGemma-4B、LLaVA-Med、MAIRA-2上评测，留出集4,145张图像，按14个CheXpert类别评估精确率与F1。

Result: MedGemma-4B：微平均精确率19.2%→46.8%，F1 23.0%→49.4%（绝对提升27.6与26.4个百分点）；14类中8类精确率显著提升、5类F1显著提升，两项指标均无显著下降。LLaVA-Med：精确率4.5%→17.7%，F1 6.3%→19.4%。MAIRA-2：精确率15.6%→42.1%，F1 21.0%→45.3%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，低成本的事后视觉验证可通过纠正无依据发现来提升VLM可信度；CheXPoT为验证VLM生成的影像报告、减少无支持发现提供了基础工具，有望促进VLM在医学场景中的信任与采用。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promise for chest radiograph report generation, but adoption remains limited because of hallucinated findings that are not grounded in the image. Correcting these hallucinations and improving overall report quality remains a significant challenge. Prior work has addressed this problem by refining models with reinforcement learning, preference optimization, or chain-of-thought supervision, often at substantial compute cost. To address this gap, we introduce CheXPoT, a program-of-thought (PoT) framework that verifies each generated finding against image features and removes those it cannot ground. CheXPoT decomposes generated reports into predicates with RadGraph and an LLM, grounds these predicates against a DenseNet-121 and Grad-CAM visual evidence table, executes PoT verification code, and rewrites reports after removing unsupported predicates. On a 4,145-image held-out split, CheXPoT yields statistically significant precision gains on 8 of 14 CheXpert classes and F1 gains on 5, with no significant decreases in either metric. CheXPoT lifts micro-average precision from 19.2% (MedGemma-4B) to 46.8% (MedGemma-4B + CheXPoT) and micro-average F1 from 23.0% to 49.4%, absolute gains of 27.6% and 26.4% respectively. We also tested CheXPoT on other VLM report generators. On LLaVA-Med, CheXPoT lifts micro-average precision from 4.5% to 17.7% and micro-average F1 from 6.3% to 19.4%. On MAIRA-2, CheXPoT lifts micro-average precision from 15.6% to 42.1% and micro-average F1 from 21.0% to 45.3%. Our results suggest that inexpensive post-hoc visual verification may improve VLM trustworthiness by correcting unsupported findings from generated reports. CheXPoT lays a foundation for tools that help validate VLM-generated radiology reports and reduce unsupported findings. These innovations may subsequently help increase trust and adoption of VLM tools in Medicine.

</details>

### [485] [XLA from the Trenches: Correctness on TPU Workloads at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00624)
*Ignacio Cano,Amir Saadat,Rishipal Singh Bhatia,Samuel Ginzburg,Patrick C. Toulme,Ioannis Zarkadas,Praveen Narayanan,Pratik Bhatu,Nicolas Basile,Alexander Dietmüller,Ruishan Wang,Jacob Wahlgren,Victor Barros,Subhankar Shah,Michael Kuperstein,Farzin Houshmand,Emma Sevastian,Peter Gavin,Karthik Srinivasa Murthy,Berkin Ilbeyi,Amit Sabne,Eli Bendersky*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一套在超大规模场景下验证与分诊 Google XLA:TPU 编译器的方法：以合成程序生成+真实生产 trace 做模糊测试，并用 AI agent 集群自主生成压力测试、复现失败与起草修复，配合分层差分流水线将大计算图二分定位到融合内核内单个出错算子，已在生产中发现并推动修复 142+ 个编译器缺陷（另有 103 项待审）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代基础模型推动领域专用编译器走向复杂多层优化流水线，过度优化带来峰值性能与正确性的微妙权衡；细微 codegen 缺陷会引发数值退化、内存/缓冲区损坏，且不产生明显编译错误，从而浪费巨额训练成本并降低在线服务质量。因此需要面向超大规模的编译器验证与分诊方法。

Method: 1) 模糊测试：合成程序生成与真实生产 trace 相结合；2) AI agent 集群：自主生成压力测试、复现失败、起草修复；3) 分层差分流水线：对大计算图逐层二分（bisect），最终定位到融合内核内部单个失败算子；4) 从实战中提炼经验教训。

Result: 生产部署后已推动解决超过 142 个编译器 bug，另有 103 项发现处于审查中；验证了方法在超大规模下的有效性，并能将根因定位精度下探到融合内核内的单个算子。

Conclusion: 面向生产规模的编译器验证需将模糊测试（合成+真实负载）、AI agent 自动化与分层差分定位相结合；该组合可高效发现并分诊静默的 codegen 缺陷，为领域专用编译器的大规模正确性保障提供可复用的实战范式。

Abstract: Accelerating modern foundational models has pushed domain-specific compilers toward increasingly complex, multi-tiered optimization pipelines. However, this heavy optimization focus introduces delicate tradeoffs between peak execution performance and correctness. Subtle codegen defects can trigger numerical degradation and memory or buffer corruption, invalidating multi-million-dollar training runs and degrading live serving quality without raising obvious compiler errors. In this paper, we present a battle-tested methodology for verifying and triaging Google's XLA:TPU compiler at hyperscale. We leverage fuzzing techniques, combining synthetic program generation with real production traces, while orchestrating AI agent swarms to autonomously generate stress tests, reproduce failures, and draft fixes. To pinpoint root causes in full workloads, we pair this with a hierarchical differential pipeline that bisects large graphs down to individual failing operations inside fused kernels. Deployed in production, our framework has already driven the resolution of over 142 compiler bugs (with 103 additional findings under review), from which we distill pragmatic lessons learned.

</details>


### [486] [Decentralized Multi-Agent Coordination and Communication in Shared Codebases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00314)
*Rishabh Mediratta,Lingyun Xiao,Peter Stone,Joydeep Biswas,Elias Stengel-Eskin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 ParallACT 基准，研究"无编排器"的多智能体编码任务：多个智能体在共享代码库中各自独立接需求、独立实现，合并后产生冲突。评测显示并行多智能体显著劣于单智能体 oracle，矛盾任务上差距尤甚（62%→16%），仅告知"存在同伴"几乎无效，通信通道只能挽回少量性能且增加 token 开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实开发场景中，编码智能体常在共享仓库里接收来自不同人类开发者、彼此独立提出的需求，本质上是被迫形成的多智能体设置。此时各智能体的实现单独看可行，合并后却相互冲突。现有工作缺少一个隔离并刻画该核心协调难题的受控评测。

Method: 构建 ParallACT 基准，包含互补任务（各自有用、但必须共享接口才能有效组合）与矛盾任务对（两者对同一代码做出不兼容修改，简单合并无法得到可用实现）。以"给定全部任务的单智能体 oracle"为对照，系统变化多智能体配置中的执行顺序、可见性、对其他智能体的感知、以及是否提供通信通道；并在两种 agent harness × 三种开放权重模型的六个额外配置上重复验证。

Result: oracle 能解决大部分任务，而并行智能体表现显著更差；互补任务差距明显，矛盾任务尤为剧烈（Claude Code + Claude Opus 4.8 由 62% 降至 16%），合并后的代码通常只满足其中一个规格。该差距在全部六个额外配置中一致出现。仅告知智能体存在同伴无显著帮助；提供通信通道只能挽回小部分性能，且带来额外 token 成本。

Conclusion: ParallACT 识别并隔离了"独立主体多智能体编码"中的核心协调挑战，为评估各类协调策略的有效性与代价提供了受控测试平台，并预示该问题将随此类开发模式普及而愈发常见。

Abstract: Coding agents working in shared repositories may receive separate, independently-motivated requests from human developers, creating a setting that is multi-agent by necessity. When this scenario happens, their individual implementations may work separately but conflict when combined. To study this setting, we introduce ParallACT, a benchmark of orchestrator-free multi-agent coding tasks. ParallACT contains both complementary and contradictory tasks. In complementary tasks, each agent's task is separately useful and implementations must share an interface to be productively combined. In contradictory pairs, both agents' tasks require editing the same code in incompatible ways, and naively combining independent solutions fails to produce a useful implementation. We compare a single-agent oracle given the combined set of tasks against multi-agent settings that vary execution order, visibility, awareness of other agents, and access to a communication channel. We find that the oracle solves most tasks while parallel agents perform substantially worse. Their performance drop is notable for complementary tasks, and particularly sharp for contradictory tasks (e.g., from 62% to 16% for Claude Code with Claude Opus 4.8) where merged code typically satisfies only one specification, and the same gap appears in all six further configurations pairing two agent harnesses with three open-weight models. Simply telling an agent that a peer exists does not help significantly, and giving agents access to a communication channel recovers only a small part of the performance, at an additional token cost. ParallACT thus identifies and isolates a core challenge that will become more common as multi-agent coding by independent principals becomes standard, and provides a controlled test of which coordination strategies help, and at what cost.

</details>


### [487] [Conversational Interaction for LLM-Based Clinical Text-to-SQL: A User Study with Healthcare Professionals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00605)
*Jun-Min Lee,Suyoung Yoo,Gyubok Lee,Edward Choi,Meong Hi Son*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究通过14名医生的被试内实验与425轮对话日志分析，证明在MIMIC-IV数据库上，多轮对话式text-to-SQL界面相比单轮界面在可用性与接受度上显著更优，且明确澄清需求是真实临床自然语言查询的结构性特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话式text-to-SQL有望让医护人员以自然语言访问EHR数据，但现有证据多来自完全明确定义的策展基准或模拟用户，缺乏真实临床用户的实证可用性证据；同时真实查询的模糊性是否被基准评测低估尚不清楚。

Method: 采用被试内设计，14名常规处理EHR数据的医生在MIMIC-IV上分别使用单轮与多轮对话式text-to-SQL界面；结合主研究与两项预研共21名医护人员的交互日志，进行SUS量表、技术接受模型构念测量、强制选择对比及轮级对话分析（425轮）。

Result: SUS均值由68.2（接近行业平均）升至85.9（p<0.001）；绩效期望、努力期望、自我效能与行为意向等构念均显著占优。强制选择中93%更满意对话式界面，86%倾向其在真实场景采用，71%更信任其结果，无人偏好或更信任单轮界面。轮级分析显示自由表述查询触发澄清请求的比例为24.8%，预定义完整问题仅1.8%；64.3%的澄清回合源于EHR或临床领域知识。

Conclusion: 对话式交互是自然语言访问EHR的实用前提而非便利性附加项；真实临床查询频繁需要澄清，凸显对话界面的必要性，而基准式评测会显著低估真实临床使用中的模糊性。

Abstract: Conversational text-to-SQL interfaces could give healthcare professionals natural-language access to electronic health record (EHR) data, but evidence for their real-world usability remains limited: prior evaluations have relied largely on curated benchmarks with fully specified questions or on simulated users. We report a user study in which 14 physicians who regularly work with EHR data used both a single-turn and a conversational multi-turn text-to-SQL interface over the MIMIC-IV database in a within-subjects design; dialogue analyses additionally drew on interaction logs from 21 healthcare professionals across the main study and two pilot studies. The conversational interface was consistently favored: mean System Usability Scale scores rose from 68.2, near the industry average, to 85.9 (p<0.001), with significant advantages across technology-acceptance constructs including performance expectancy, effort expectancy, self-efficacy, and behavioral intention. In post-study forced-choice comparisons, 93% of participants reported greater overall satisfaction with the conversational interface, 86% preferred it for real-world adoption, and 71% trusted its results more; no participant preferred or trusted the single-turn interface more. Turn-level analysis of 425 logged user turns showed that freely composed queries triggered clarification requests in 24.8% of cases versus 1.8% for predefined, fully specified questions, and 64.3% of clarification episodes stemmed from EHR- or clinical-domain knowledge. Conversational interaction is a practical prerequisite, rather than a convenience, for natural-language EHR access. The frequent need for clarification in realistic clinical queries further underscores the importance of conversational interfaces, while benchmark-style evaluation can substantially underrepresent the ambiguity of real clinical use.

</details>


### [488] [Editing the Goal: Per-Token SAE Steering and Its Depth Limits in $π_{0.5}$](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00602)
*Rocio Perales Valdes,Animesh Garg*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 通过替换机器人基础模型π0.5中单个目标词的SAE特征（保持指令文本不变），可将其行为重定向到替代任务，但该效应依赖SAE架构，且简单的差值均值向量即可达到类似效果，说明SAE并非必需。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作从机器人基础模型（RFM，如π0.5）中恢复出可解释、具因果性的SAE特征，但单个指令token上的SAE特征可解释性弱于时间步池化特征，且这些特征能否重定向机器人目标尚未被检验。

Method: 在π0.5-LIBERO上，将单个目标词的SAE特征替换为另一目标词的特征（指令文本不变）；对比BatchTopK与Matryoshka等不同SAE架构及随机特征替换基线；并测试不依赖SAE的方案：以自然幅度两倍的固定差值均值（difference-in-means）向量进行干预；再用逐层激活修补（activation patching）定位编辑有效深度。

Result: 第0层BatchTopK特征替换在部分场景中最多20/20次rollout成功重定向，而随机特征替换为0；效果在六个场景、两个LIBERO套件及不同层间存在差异；词选择的Matryoshka编辑大多不优于随机编辑；固定差值均值向量（2倍幅度）可重定向8–10/10次rollout；逐层修补显示目标词编辑对物体位置有效至第6层、对物体身份至第2层，若同时修补相机token则两者均可达第13层。

Conclusion: 该结果为仿真环境中RFM目标重定向的存在性证明，并初步刻画了目标重定向编辑的有效深度范围；同时表明SAE并非实现该干预的必要条件。

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have recovered interpretable, causally relevant features in robot foundation models (RFMs) such as $π_{0.5}$ (arXiv:2603.19183, arXiv:2603.19233). SAE features on individual instruction tokens are less interpretable than timestep-pooled ones (arXiv:2603.19183), and whether they can redirect a robot's goal remains untested. We show that replacing the SAE features of a single goal word with those of an alternative goal word, leaving the instruction text unchanged, steers $π_{0.5}$-LIBERO into completing the alternative task. At layer 0, BatchTopK feature swaps redirect behavior in up to 20/20 rollouts in a scene where random-feature swaps redirect none, with success varying across six scenes in two LIBERO suites and across layers. The effect depends on SAE architecture: word-selected Matryoshka edits largely do not outperform random ones. SAEs are also not required. Adding a fixed difference-in-means vector at twice its natural magnitude redirects 8-10/10 rollouts. Layer-wise activation patching shows that goal-word edits remain effective up to layer 6 for object location and layer 2 for object identity, and up to layer 13 in both cases when patching also covers camera tokens. These results are proof of existence in an RFM in simulation and an initial map of how deep goal-redirecting edits remain effective. Visit https://doubleblind-sae-pi05.github.io for video rollouts.

</details>


### [489] [X-World 1.6: Building Controllable Virtual Cities with World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00596)
*XPeng,:,Boyang Wang,Boyi Sun,Chaoda Zheng,Dongbin Zhang,Guangfeng Jiang,Hanlong Chen,Hongbin Lin,Jianlei Zheng,Jinhao Deng,Kai Yang,Kangjie Chen,Linkun Xu,Minqi Wang,Puyi Wang,Rongliang Cheng,Ruixin Liu,Shijia Chen,Shuang Deng,Sijia Chen,Sin Wai Choo,Tianyuan Xie,Xiangyu Li,Xianming Liu,Xingjie Liu,Xinlong Zheng,Xuejie Lv,Xuezhi Yang,Yi Guo,Yixiao Zeng,Yu Zhang,Yuecheng Ma,Yuhao Wang,Yuqi Zhang,Yuxin Peng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本报告提出 X-World 1.6，一款面向自动驾驶的生成式世界模型/驾驶仿真器，在交通语义控制、多相机空间一致性、虚拟城市场景构建、少步因果生成与长时程质量保持以及专用评测套件等方面较 X-World 1.0 全面升级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端闭环评测与策略学习对生成式世界模型提出三项要求：精确的场景控制、一致的观测、长时交互中的持续生成质量。X-World 1.0 在这些方面尚不够可靠与通用，因此需要升级以扩大可仿真场景范围并提升生成观测的效率与可靠性。

Method: 1) 升级基础模型，增强对交通灯、道路标线等交通语义的细粒度控制，并提升跨相机空间一致性；2) 构建 Virtual City 能力，以一组以多样 2D/3D 参考为条件的模型族扩展场景构建，支持从单张图像生成多相机未来视频；3) 增强后训练框架，实现高效的因果少步生成，提升时序连贯性、长 rollout 的质量保持与人类偏好对齐；4) 引入专用评测套件，支持系统化评估并指导模型迭代。

Result: 交通语义（交通灯、道路标线）控制更细粒度，跨相机空间一致性提升；Virtual City 支持以多样 2D/3D 参考为条件构建场景，包括单图生成多相机未来视频；后训练后实现因果少步生成，时序连贯性更强、长时程 rollout 质量衰减更小、与人类偏好对齐更好；并提供专用评测基准用于系统评估。

Conclusion: X-World 1.6 扩展了可仿真场景范围，提升了生成观测的效率与可靠性，可更广泛地支撑自动驾驶研发中的闭环评测与策略学习。

Abstract: Deploying generative world models for end-to-end closed-loop evaluation and policy learning requires precise scenario control, consistent observations, and sustained generation quality during extended interactions. This report presents \emph{X-World~1.6}, advancing X-World~1.0 toward a more reliable and versatile driving simulator. The upgraded base model offers finer-grained control over traffic semantics, including traffic lights and road markings, together with improved spatial consistency across cameras. Virtual City capabilities broaden scenario construction through a family of models conditioned on diverse 2D and 3D references, including support for generating multi-camera future videos from a single image. An enhanced post-training framework enables efficient causal, few-step generation with stronger temporal coherence, better quality retention over longer rollouts, and improved alignment with human preferences. We also introduce a dedicated evaluation suite to support systematic assessment and guide model iteration. Together, these upgrades expand the scenarios X-World can simulate and improve the efficiency and reliability of its generated observations, supporting broader use in autonomous-driving development.

</details>


### [490] [State-Aware Activation Recomputation with Replay Contracts and Selective Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00590)
*Annan Zhang,Shengjie Song,Wenshuai Yao,Lihao Zhang,Tianmiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出“版本化重放契约”与联合规划器，显式建模重放所需的可变状态（可变缓冲区、别名字节、随机数状态），在保留、整缓冲快照与选择性区域保护间逐段选优，并以实测内存与恢复代价计费，从而保证激活重计算的正确性并优化显存/时间权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激活重计算通过在反向传播中重放前向片段来节省加速器内存，但重放只有在看到与原始前向相同状态时才正确。可变缓冲区、别名内存与随机数生成器状态可能在两次执行间改变，导致“代码未变”却微分了不同的计算，形成隐蔽的正确性风险。

Method: (1) 将重放所需状态显式化，定义带版本的重放契约，规定重放必须恢复哪些状态；(2) 设计联合规划器，逐段在激活保留、整缓冲区快照、选择性区域保护三种方案中选择，并按实测的内存开销与恢复代价进行计费；(3) 用独立的导数校验与字节级校验验证契约；(4) 构建Torch/JAX测试集，保留全部5,900条执行记录（含匹配、拒绝与发散）；(5) 在冻结的稀疏写入H100工作负载上每项测量重复五十次新进程，并在完整CIFAR-100稠密队列应用中跨六个训练种子对比七种方法。

Result: 在44 GiB预算的稀疏写入H100负载上，联合规划相较正确计费的eager/整快照规划器使配对步时降低18.16%（约97.5%比率区间[.8172,.8195]）；在32 GiB预算下，eager/整快照规划器无可行静态策略，联合规划以29.94 GiB（而非26.20 GiB）比固定区域方案快4.98%。CIFAR-100稠密队列应用中，各种子内测试分数逐字节一致；联合规划比整快照多22.41%分配内存，过程时间几何均值比为1.0080（种子区间[.9845,1.0191]）。

Conclusion: 结果界定了选择性保护策略的适用边界：稀疏写入且激活较大的场景收益明显，而稠密队列负载中整缓冲快照占用分配内存更少。版本化契约加代价感知的联合规划可在保证重放语义正确的前提下实现显存与时间的可调权衡。

Abstract: Activation recomputation saves accelerator memory by replaying forward segments during the backward pass, but replay is only correct if it sees the state the original forward pass saw. Mutable buffers, aliased bytes and random-generator state can change in between, so re-executing unchanged code can differentiate a different computation. We make this state explicit. A versioned replay contract specifies what replay must restore, and a joint planner chooses, per segment, between activation retention, whole-buffer snapshots and selective-region preservation, charging each option its measured memory and recovery cost. Independent derivative and byte-level checks validate the contract, and a Torch/JAX cohort retains all 5,900 execution records, including matches, rejections and divergences. On frozen sparse-write H100 workloads, each measured over fifty fresh processes, joint planning reduces paired step time by 18.16% against a correctly costed eager/whole planner at a 44 GiB budget (approximate 97.5% ratio interval $[.8172,.8195]$). At 32 GiB, where the eager/whole planner has no feasible static policy, joint planning is 4.98% faster than fixed regions at 29.94 rather than 26.20 GiB. A complete CIFAR-100 dense-queue application runs seven methods for 100 encoder and 25 probe epochs at six training seeds, with byte-identical test scores within each seed. There, joint planning uses 22.41% more allocated memory than whole snapshots, with a process-time geometric-mean ratio of 1.0080 (seed range $[.9845,1.0191]$). Together, the results map where selective preservation pays off: sparse writes with large activations benefit, while in the dense-queue workload whole snapshots use less allocated memory.

</details>


### [491] [Exo: An Architecture for Self-Improving Systems at Runtime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00463)
*Alexander Krentsel,Sylvia Ratnasamy,Ion Stoica,Martin Casado,Ankur Goyal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Exo 是一种 agent 运行时架构，将优化循环并入任务执行过程，使 agent 在持续工作中安全地修订自身 harness 与策略，显著降低模型成本并保持任务完成率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent harness 决定语言模型在环境中的行为方式，但手工设计其策略困难，而自动化设计方法又依赖代表性数据集和高昂的执行开销，缺乏在真实持续工作中安全学习的手段。

Method: 提出 Exo 运行时架构：将优化循环压缩进任务执行过程，agent 可同时修订 harness 与策略；设有一个最小化的受保护机制层，负责保存执行历史并管控策略激活，harness 则通过可审查的代码改动演化。

Result: 开放世界游戏长时任务中，相对 Codex 与 Pi，独立运行使模型成本降低 12–53%，迁移运行降低 45–82%，任务完成率持平；与不可编辑策略的同一初始策略相比，AppWorld 与 SREGym 上留出模型成本降低 35–61%，正确率相当，AppWorld 平均任务时间减少 13%，SREGym 诊断时间中位数减少 35%；Continual Learning Bench 编码任务中，含学习在内的模型成本下降 14%，两种策略均解决全部问题。

Conclusion: Exo 表明在任务执行过程中对 harness 与策略进行可检查、受保护约束的在线自我修订，能在不牺牲正确性的前提下大幅降低模型成本与耗时，为无需预置数据集和昂贵离线训练的 agent 自改进提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Agent harnesses govern how language models act in an environment; designing their policies by hand is difficult, while automated techniques require representative datasets and costly executions. We present Exo, an agent runtime architecture for safe learning during ongoing work that collapses the optimization loop into task execution, allowing agents to revise both their harness and their strategies for further improvement. A minimal protected mechanism layer preserves execution history and governs policy activation while the harness evolves through inspectable code changes. On long-running objectives in an open-world game, Exo reduces model cost by 12-53% relative to Codex and Pi in standalone runs and 45-82% in transfer runs, while matching task completion rates. Compared with the same starting policy without the ability to edit policy, Exo reduces held-out model cost by 35-61% on AppWorld and SREGym with comparable correctness, cutting AppWorld's mean task time by 13% and SREGym's median diagnosis time by 35%. On Continual Learning Bench coding tasks, model cost including learning falls by 14%, with both policies resolving every issue.

</details>


### [492] [Hacking or Just Failing? A More Capable LLM Monitor Better Separates Reward Hacking from Honest Failure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00407)
*Kaushik Kezendirane*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个沙盒任务，用反事实回放修复终态的方式为每个 episode 打标签，并开展五项预注册研究，考察小型本地监控器能否区分"刷分作弊"与"诚实失误"；结果显示小模型监控器难以区分，强模型虽达标但样本有限且对新式作弊不敏感，确定性规则检查反而最可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体可见得分可能因刷分作弊或单纯失误而高于真实进度，二者在分数差值上表现相同，因此有效的 reward-hacking 监控器必须能区分"作弊意图"与"诚实失败"，而现有工作缺乏带可靠标签的对照实验。

Method: 搭建可刷分的沙盒任务，通过回放并反事实修复最终状态为每个 episode 打标签；运行五项预注册研究，比较 Llama 3B/8B 本地监控器与 Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite 在相同输入下的判别能力，并测试提示词改动、全轨迹输入、额外结构化证据以及确定性规则检查的效果。

Result: 在 Llama 3.1 8B 智能体的 60 个 episode 上，本地 3B/8B 监控器无法区分同等分差的作弊尝试与诚实失败，提示词调整只是以一种错误换另一种，主监控器 AUC 仅 0.64；Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite 达到预注册标准（AUC 0.80，95% 区间 [0.66, 0.93]，35 个诚实失败仅误报 1 个），但仅 14 个作弊样本，估计不确定；对提示未命名的新式作弊，Gemini 能正确描述行为却从不报警（5 个及随后 25 个新 episode）；8B 监控器在给定完整轨迹时对 25 个复现 episode 全部报警、对 25 个诚实相似样本零误报，但解释描述了未发生的行为，加入结构化证据后又误报 15/25；两条规则的确定性检查捕获了全部已知作弊。

Conclusion: 小型本地监控器难以可靠区分刷分作弊与诚实失败，强模型监控在有标签分布内有效但泛化到新式作弊时失效且解释不可靠；监控器的报警与解释需分开评估，确定性规则检查在已知作弊上更稳健，作者公开环境、标签、预注册与逐条判定日志以支持可复现研究。

Abstract: An agent's visible score can exceed its real progress because it gamed the score or because it simply made mistakes, so a useful reward-hacking monitor must tell the two apart. We built a sandboxed task in which an agent can game a completion score, labelled every episode by replaying it and repairing the final state counterfactually, and ran five pre-registered studies. On 60 episodes from a Llama 3.1 8B agent, small local monitors (Llama 3B and 8B) did not separate exploit attempts from honest failures with the same score gap: prompt changes traded missed exploits for false alarms, and the pre-registered primary monitor reached AUC 0.64. On identical inputs, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, which completed 9/10 clean tasks against 2/10 for the 8B model, met our pre-registered criterion (AUC 0.80, 95% interval [0.66, 0.93]; 1/35 honest failures flagged); with only 14 exploit episodes, this estimate is uncertain. On an exploit that no prompt names, Gemini usually described the action correctly yet never flagged it, in 5 and then 25 new episodes, even when manipulation was defined by its effect on the score. Given the full trace, the 8B monitor flagged all 25 replication episodes and none of 25 honest look-alikes, but its explanations described actions that had not occurred; given additional structured evidence, it also flagged 15 of the 25 look-alikes. A two-rule deterministic check caught every known exploit. We release the environment, labels, pre-registrations and per-judgement logs.

</details>


### [493] [RE-SciVQA: Improving Scientific VQA With Context-Relevant Retrieval and Lightweight MLLM Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00242)
*Sheikh Tahmim Mehdi,Muminul Islam Jami*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 RE-SciVQA，通过查询扩展、相似度分数调整（结合图表引用与标题对齐）改进检索上下文质量，并用 LoRA 微调小模型，在 SciVQA 上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学文献中的图表承载关键信息，但现有 Scientific Visual QA 方法依赖资源密集的训练流程与大规模算力，门槛高、难以复现。作者希望不做复杂架构设计，而通过提升检索质量与参数高效微调来解决问题。

Method: 1) 查询扩展：将相关章节标题附加到原问题后，提升检索覆盖率；2) 对相似度分数做简单调整，利用图表引用（figure references）与图注对齐信息；3) 对小型 LLM 使用参数高效 LoRA 微调；4) 闭集无限视觉问题中，用图表数字化（plot digitization）替代合成图注。

Result: SciVQA 基准上 ROUGE-1 F1 达 73.9%，显著优于 UniChart（14.7%）、ChartGemma（6.9%）、Matcha-ChartQA（6.3%）；相较标准 RAG 基线，精确匹配提升 11.9%、模糊匹配提升 29.5%，总体增益 14.3%；闭集无限视觉问题使用 plot digitization 相比合成图注提升 18.5%。

Conclusion: 检索上下文质量与轻量微调比复杂架构更关键；相关性增强的 RAG 显著优于标准 RAG；对图表理解模型薄弱的闭集无限视觉问题，plot digitization 是有效替代方案。

Abstract: A deep understanding of scientific literature often relies on interpreting figures that contain key information beyond the main text. Leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to extract insights from these figures can significantly accelerate knowledge discovery. Existing works on Scientific Visual Question Answering rely on resource-intensive training pipelines that are often inaccessible and require large computational resources. Instead of designing complex architectures, we propose RE- SciVQA, which focuses on improving the quality of retrieved context and fine-tuning small LLMs with parameter-efficient LoRA training. Using a simple query expansion step, relevant section headers are appended to the original question to improve the retrieval coverage. In addition, a simple adjustment of similarity scores is applied using figure references and caption alignment. On the SciVQA benchmark, RE-SciVQA achieves a ROUGE-1 F1 score of 73.9%, outperforming chart-focused models such as UniChart (14.7%), ChartGemma (6.9%), and Matcha-ChartQA (6.3%). Our relevance-enhanced RAG setup also improves the exact match by 11.9% and the fuzzy match by 29.5% compared with a standard RAG baseline, resulting in an overall gain of 14.3%. We also examine closed-ended infinite visual questions, a category in which chart-understanding models often struggle. Our experiments show that using plot digitization instead of synthetic captions leads to an 18.5% improvement for this question type.

</details>


### [494] [Reimagining Text-to-SQL: A Survey of Large Language Model Architectures and Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00171)
*Shikhar Dave,Bhaskarjit Sarmah,Stefano Pasquali*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于LLM驱动Text-to-SQL的系统性综述，提出五范式统一分类（上下文学习、监督/参数高效微调、智能体与工具增强编排、检索增强生成、强化学习），并按模型粒度、监督层级、推理风格三维刻画方法，覆盖2022–2026年百余篇工作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Text-to-SQL经历了从规则/模板匹配到神经编码器-解码器，再到LLM驱动方法的演进，近期ReFoRCE、Agentar-Scale-SQL、Arctic-Text2SQL-R1、XiYan-SQL等系统在Spider、Spider 2.0、BIRD上不断刷新执行准确率，但领域缺乏统一的分类框架来系统梳理这些范式各异（模块化分解 vs. 多智能体协同）的方法，也难以对齐评测指标与真实部署需求。

Method: 作者构建统一分类体系：以五种范式（ICL、监督与PEFT微调、智能体与工具增强编排、RAG、强化学习）为主轴，从模型粒度（monolithic vs. modular）、监督水平（zero-shot、微调、强化学习）、推理风格（直接解码 vs. 分解式多步推理）三个维度刻画各方法；同时梳理模块化框架的子任务分解（模式检索、草稿式生成、修复、排序）与智能体系统的任务调度机制，并分析评测指标、数据集、语义层在生产系统中的作用及负责任AI实践。

Result: 综述综合了2022–2026年间100余篇论文与技术资源，形成了覆盖方法范式、粒度/监督/推理维度、评测体系与部署考量（领域泛化、效率、真实落地）的结构化图谱，并明确了模块化与智能体化路线在复杂基准上达到新SOTA的路径。

Conclusion: LLM驱动方法已成为Text-to-SQL主流并显著提升复杂查询的执行准确率；未来挑战集中于领域泛化、效率与生产部署，语义层与负责任AI（敏感数据库访问）需纳入系统设计，统一分类框架为后续研究提供了参照坐标。

Abstract: Text-to-SQL systems translate natural language questions into executable SQL queries, democratizing access to relational data. Early approaches relied on handcrafted rules and template matching, while subsequent neural methods introduced encoder-decoder architectures, schema linking, and constrained decoding to handle increasingly complex queries. The emergence of large language models (LLMs), exemplified by systems such as ReFoRCE, Agentar-Scale-SQL, Snowflake's Arctic-Text2SQL-R1, and the modular XiYan-SQL framework, has dramatically advanced the field, pushing execution accuracy to new state-of-the-art levels on challenging benchmarks such as Spider, Spider 2.0, and BIRD. In parallel, modular frameworks decompose the task into sub-problems (schema retrieval, sketch-based generation, repair, and ranking), while agentic systems coordinate multiple specialized agents that communicate and dynamically allocate sub-tasks. This survey systematically reviews these LLM-driven approaches within a unified taxonomy of five paradigms (in-context learning, supervised and parameter-efficient fine-tuning, agentic and tool-augmented orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, and reinforcement learning) and characterizes them by model granularity (monolithic vs. modular), level of supervision (zero-shot, fine-tuned, or reinforcement-based), and reasoning style (direct decoding vs. decomposed multi-step reasoning). We further analyze evaluation metrics, datasets, and open challenges, including domain generalization, efficiency, and real-world deployment, and we examine the role of the semantic layer in production systems. As LLMs increasingly access sensitive databases, we also discuss responsible AI practices. We survey over 100 papers and technical resources, focusing on work published between 2022 and 2026.

</details>


### [495] [Constraint Dependency Graph Retrieval for Compliance Detection on Long SKILL Documents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01042)
*Shuaitao Zhao,Feng Ni,Lichao Ma,Yuchen Wei,Shuaike Li,Jiaye Lin,Fei Han,Yang Wei,Lu Pan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SkillCDG将SKILL文档重构为约束依赖图，把规则检索从相似度匹配转为在上下文预算下的闭包选择，并结合图相对策略优化与选择性在线蒸馏实现联合训练，在三个企业数据集和两个公开基准上提升了准确率与F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业业务操作依赖SOP形式的SKILL文档，其冗长且密集交叉引用，超出小型部署审计器的上下文预算；相似度检索会引入无关规则并遗漏强制前置条件，且两阶段审计策略无法为检索阶段提供可训练信号。

Method: 将每个SKILL文档重构为约束依赖图：每条原子规则锚定到其原文片段作为节点，强制前置关系为唯一边类型；策略生成的关键词激活种子规则，通过依赖闭包在预算内得到紧凑且条件完备的规则上下文。该图支持联合优化：检索阶段用组相对策略优化训练，奖励由输出格式有效性与下游判定正确性构成，闭包非空作为有效性门控；同时用选择性在线蒸馏将教师监督集中于高熵推理token，并始终包含判定与终止token。

Result: 在三个企业数据集和两个公开基准上，SkillCDG相比全文档基线与基于检索的基线在准确率和F1上均有提升。

Conclusion: 以依赖闭包替代相似度检索、并以图结构统一检索与判定的联合优化，是提升预算受限LLM审计器合规检测性能的有效途径。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents carry out business operations under enterprise documents we refer to as SKILL documents, which take the form of standard operating procedures (SOPs) that state the conditions to verify and the actions to take before an operation proceeds. Long, densely cross-referenced SKILL documents exceed the context budget of small deployed auditors. Similarity-based retrieval then brings in irrelevant rules while omitting mandatory prerequisites, and the two-stage audit policy provides no trainable signal for the retrieval stage. We present SkillCDG, a compliance detection framework that reformulates each SKILL document as a constraint dependency graph, shifting rule retrieval from similarity-based matching to closure-based selection under the deployment's context budget. Each atomic rule is anchored to its source text span as a graph node, and mandatory prerequisite relations form the sole edge type. Policy-generated retrieval keywords activate seed rules, whose dependency closure yields a compact and conditionally complete rule context within that budget. The same graph also supports a joint optimization scheme. The retrieval stage is trained with group-relative policy optimization using a verifiable reward that combines output-format validity with downstream verdict correctness, with closure non-emptiness serving as a validity gate, while selective on-policy distillation concentrates teacher supervision on high-entropy reasoning tokens, with verdict and termination tokens always included, to improve verdict accuracy. Experiments on three enterprise datasets and two public benchmarks show that SkillCDG improves accuracy and F1 over the full-document and retrieval-based baselines.

</details>


### [496] [Leap-VLA: High-Rate Robot Control from a Low-Rate VLM Backbone](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01011)
*Lin Yang,Yunjie Shen,Zheyu Li,Zhenjie Tian,Yongli Wang,Dongze Huang,Weiqi Wang,Yucheng Zhu,Zhaoquan Jiang,Guofeng Xie,Peigen Fang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种解耦式VLA：低频VLM作为语义锚点并复用缓存上下文，高频流匹配动作专家消费缓存语义与轻量视觉流，通过缓存年龄τ的自适应层归一化与年龄相关训练策略弥合陈旧性差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA在每个控制步都用数十亿参数VLM重新编码完整观测，但场景语义约1 Hz演化，而反应式控制需20-50 Hz，计算严重冗余、延迟高。

Method: 1) 低频VLM作语义锚点，缓存上下文跨控制步复用；2) 高频流匹配动作专家接收缓存语义 + 紧凑编码器（机器人视频预训练，掩码重建/光流/深度）提供的低延迟新鲜视觉流；3) 用测得缓存年龄τ经自适应层归一化调制专家；4) 训练显式覆盖"策略是缓存年龄的函数"：从真实episode历史采样缓存年龄，并加入年龄递增的像素损坏以模拟部署陈旧；5) 前向式chunk边界修正（soft-nudge，无自动微分的RTC引导重构）实现零额外延迟的逐步重规划；6) 基于零成本负样本episode训练的CoT判定门控，在指令-场景不匹配时冻结执行。

Result: LIBERO-Spatial上，2 s语义刷新从61.4%提升至95.5%（1 s为95.9%，与频率匹配锚点差1.6点）；四套LIBERO平均，1 s刷新95.2%、2 s刷新94.5%，匹配锚点96.3%；soft-nudge以零额外延迟达到97.1%且无性能损失；指令-场景不匹配时判定门控可精确冻结执行且不损害可行任务成功率。

Conclusion: 通过频率解耦、缓存年龄条件化与针对性训练，异步部署的陈旧性差距基本闭合；前向式soft-nudge支持零延迟重规划；同一分析视角还揭示并修复了指令-场景不匹配下的误执行缺陷。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models re-encode the full observation through a multi-billion-parameter vision-language model (VLM) at every control step, even though scene semantics evolve at roughly 1 Hz while reactive control requires 20-50 Hz. We present a VLA that decouples the two: a VLM runs as a low-frequency semantic anchor whose cached context is reused across control steps, while a flow-matching action expert operates at high frequency, consuming the cached semantics with a fresh, low-latency visual stream from a compact encoder pretrained on robot video with masked reconstruction, optical flow, and depth. The measured age $τ$ of the cache conditions the expert through adaptive layer normalization. Reusing the cache makes the policy a function of its age, and training covers that function explicitly: cache ages sampled from real episode history, plus an age-ramped pixel corruption that erases the stale snapshot the way deployed staleness corrupts content. On the asynchronous deployment stack, the recipe closes most of the staleness gap: on LIBERO-Spatial, 61.4% to 95.5% at a 2 s semantic refresh (95.9% at 1 s, within 1.6 points of the frequency-matched anchor); averaged over the four LIBERO suites, the deployed policy holds 95.2% at a 1 s refresh and 94.5% at 2 s against a 96.3% matched anchor. A forward-only chunk-boundary correction (soft-nudge), an autograd-free reformulation of real-time-chunking guidance, carries per-control-step re-planning without loss (97.1%) at zero added latency. The same lens exposes a second defect: under an instruction-scene mismatch the policy keeps manipulating the scene, and a chain-of-thought verdict gate trained on zero-cost negative episodes freezes execution exactly on mismatched instructions without hurting feasible success.

</details>


### [497] [AdKnob: Ad Intensity Control and Labeling for LLM-Native Advertising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00822)
*Woo Jae Kim,Seongho Keum,Joonsung Jeon,Suhyeon Ha,Sooel Son,Sung-eui Yoon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出AdKnob框架，联合解决LLM原生广告的广告强度控制与广告标注两个问题，并构建首个多级广告强度偏好数据集MI-KnobSet。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM服务商寻求可持续收入，LLM原生广告成为可行变现渠道，但广告强度控制与广告标注两个关键问题研究不足。

Method: 引入无预训练语义关联的广告控制token，通过直接偏好优化（DPO）对齐模型以生成指定强度广告；广告标注采用基于注意力rollout的归因机制，通过追踪输出对输入广告相关token的归因来定位广告片段，无需额外推理成本。

Result: 在六个LLM上实验及人工评测表明：AdKnob实现均匀分布的广告强度（基线坍缩至狭窄区间），广告标注准确率最高且比最强基线快500倍以上，人工评测偏好率最高达89.6%。

Conclusion: AdKnob在广告强度可控性与广告标注效率、准确性上均优于现有基线，验证了统一框架的可行性。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-native advertising has emerged as a viable monetization channel as LLM service providers seek sustainable revenue streams. However, integrating native ads into LLM responses introduces two largely understudied challenges: (1) controlling ad intensity -- how prominently advertising content appears -- and (2) ad labeling -- identifying which segments of the generated text constitute advertising. We propose AdKnob, a framework jointly addressing both challenges. For ad intensity control, we introduce new ad control tokens without pretrained semantic associations and align the model via direct preference optimization to generate ads at each desired level. For ad labeling, we propose an attention rollout-based attribution mechanism that identifies ad segments by tracing their attribution to input ad-related tokens, requiring no additional inference cost. We further construct MI-KnobSet, the first multi-level ad intensity preference dataset for LLM-native ads. Experiments across six LLMs and human evaluations show that AdKnob achieves uniformly spaced ad intensities where baselines collapse to a narrow range, achieves the highest ad labeling accuracy while being over 500x faster than the strongest baseline, and is preferred over baselines by human evaluators up to 89.6% of the time.

</details>


### [498] [VCoT-SQL: Enhancing Text-to-SQL Generation through Dual Chain-of-Thought Validation Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00815)
*Rui Zhang,Yujia Su,Ruixuan Li,Yuhua Li,Yixin Su*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VCoT-SQL通过中间步骤验证的CoT监督与专用SQL验证器，使小型开源模型在Text-to-SQL任务上超越前沿闭源模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源LLM在复杂Text-to-SQL查询上仍表现不足；CoT微调可提升推理，但标准数据集缺乏CoT标注，需合成生成。现有合成方法仅验证最终答案，使错误推理步骤污染训练数据。

Method: 训练两个互补模型：(1) SQL生成器，采用子句级CoT模板，推理步骤经执行与模式对齐检查验证；(2) SQL验证器，采用诊断型CoT模板，检测语法、语义与类型层错误。另设计分层模式过滤流水线，整合并精炼互补检索策略以提取相关数据库元素。

Result: 在BIRD dev上达到66.82%执行准确率，Spider test上86.8%，较7B基座模型在BIRD上提升7%。其CoT合成仅依赖7B模型，却优于使用72B级甚至专有闭源教师模型生成数据的方法。

Conclusion: 严格的步骤级验证比单纯扩大教师模型规模更有效，验证驱动的CoT监督可显著提升小型开源模型的Text-to-SQL性能。

Abstract: Open-source LLMs provide a flexible alternative to closed-source models for Text-to-SQL but still struggle with complex queries. Finetuning with chain-of-thought (CoT) data improves reasoning, yet standard datasets lack CoT annotations, requiring synthetic generation. Existing synthesis methods only verify the final answer, allowing flawed reasoning steps to corrupt the training data. We propose VCoT-SQL, a framework that improves Text-to-SQL generation through intermediate-step validated CoT supervision and a dedicated SQL validator, which enables small open-source models to outperform frontier closed-source models. VCoT-SQL trains two complementary models on curated reasoning traces: an SQL generator using clause-level CoT templates where reasoning steps are verified via execution and schema alignment checks, and an SQL validator using diagnostic CoT templates to detect syntactic, semantic, and type level errors. We further design a hierarchical schema filtering pipeline that integrates and refines complementary retrieval strategies to distill relevant database elements. VCoT-SQL achieves 66.82% execution accuracy on challenging dataset BIRD dev and 86.8% on Spider test, improving the base 7B model by 7% on BIRD. Notably, our CoT synthesis relies on 7B models yet outperforms methods that use 72B-scale or even proprietary closed source teachers for data generation, demonstrating that rigorous step-level validation can be more effective than scaling up teacher model size. Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/INTREBID/VCoT-SQL.

</details>


### [499] [\textsc{ChatDify}: Automating End-to-End Dify Workflow Synthesis from Natural Language via Multi-Agent Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01563)
*Tao Fan,Guoqiang Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ChatDify：基于多智能体（Planner–Executor–Reviewer）Actor-Critic 架构，将自然语言需求自动合成为 Dify 工作流（DSL），在 100 条生产级任务基准上取得最高 0.96 成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Dify 等 LLM 应用平台通过模块化节点编排支持构建复杂工作流，但手工配置需要深厚平台专业知识，耗时且易错，对非专家用户构成显著门槛。作者希望实现从自然语言描述到可运行工作流的端到端自动化。

Method: 提出多智能体框架 ChatDify，采用 Actor-Critic 结构，含三个专用智能体：Planner Agent 将用户请求分解为结构化执行计划；Executor Agent 执行上下文感知的参数合成与模式增强（schema-augmented）的 DSL 编译；Reviewer Agent 通过混合验证与闭环迭代精化保证可靠性。

Result: 在含 100 条生产启发任务的定制基准上，跨三种先进 LLM 后端评测，Qwen-3.7、GLM-5.1、DeepSeek-v4 的成功率分别为 0.96、0.91、0.75。

Conclusion: ChatDify 在多种后端模型下均表现稳健，验证了其在降低构建复杂 LLM 应用技术门槛方面的实用性与鲁棒性；结果同时显示性能对底层模型能力存在一定依赖。

Abstract: The proliferation of Large Language Models has catalyzed powerful application development platforms like Dify, which enable users to build sophisticated LLM-powered workflows through modular node orchestration. However, manually configuring these workflows requires deep platform expertise and remains time-consuming and error-prone, creating a significant barrier for non-expert users. To address this challenge, we propose \textsc{ChatDify}, a novel multi-agent framework that automates end-to-end Dify workflow synthesis from natural language descriptions. \textsc{ChatDify} employs an Actor-Critic architecture comprising three specialized agents: the \textit{Planner Agent} that decomposes user requests into structured execution plans, the \textit{Executor Agent} that performs context-aware parameter synthesis and schema-augmented DSL compilation, and the \textit{Reviewer Agent} that ensures reliability through hybrid verification with closed-loop refinement. We evaluate \textsc{ChatDify} on a curated benchmark of 100 production-inspired tasks across three state-of-the-art LLM backends, achieving 0.96, 0.91, and 0.75 success rates with Qwen-3.7, GLM-5.1, and DeepSeek-v4, respectively. These results demonstrate its robustness and practical applicability for lowering the technical barrier to creating sophisticated LLM applications.

</details>


### [500] [CONFIRM: Governing Scientific Reporting for Trustworthy Agentic Neuroimaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01449)
*Yuxiang Wei,Lijing Zhu,Qizhen Lan,Yanteng Zhang,Vince D. Calhoun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CONFIRM框架与NeuroClaimBench基准，将"运行分析"与"决定报告哪些发现"分离，用预先指定的分析计划与五类确定性门控过滤结果，可将对照组假阳性支持率从23–38%降至≤3%，同时保留最多61%的文献支持性结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体虽可用工具校验代码运行与报告数值一致性，但"哪些结果值得科学报告"仍依赖LLM判断。作者发现LLM评判者会把站点混杂的发现当作证据予以认可，说明报告决策环节缺乏方法论约束，是自主科学发现可信性的关键缺口。

Method: 将每个假设编码为机器可读、预先指定的分析计划，在计算前固定论断与通过标准；结果经五个确定性门控过滤：搜索历史与多重性、混杂、统计功效、分析稳定性、可复现性，并在Screen/Replicate/Full三档可配置报告标准下运行；未通过的论断生成诊断以指导后续分析。同时构建NeuroClaimBench，含489条可执行神经影像论断（冻结数据），包括文献支持发现与150个违反单项方法学要求的对照。

Result: 在NeuroClaimBench上，CONFIRM对对照组的错误支持率≤3%，基线为23–38%；同时找回最多61%的文献支持论断。审计既有智能体时，对照假支持率由23%降至0%且保留原有文献支持论断；其诊断反馈相比Self-Refine以更少LLM调用产生更多被支持的修订。

Conclusion: 以预先指定分析计划和确定性门控为基础的报告决策，是可信自主科学发现的必要条件；CONFIRM与NeuroClaimBench共同提供了该范式的框架与评测基础。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can autonomously run neuroimaging analyses from research questions to reported findings. Existing agentic systems use tools to check that code runs and reported values match its output, but rely on LLM judgment to decide which results warrant scientific reporting. We show that LLM judges endorse site-confounded findings even when the confound is presented as evidence. We present \textbf{CONFIRM}, a framework that separates running an analysis from deciding which findings to report. CONFIRM encodes each hypothesis as a machine-readable, pre-specified analysis plan that fixes the claim and its pass criteria before computing results. It then filters results through five deterministic gates (search history and multiplicity, confounds, power, analytic stability, and replication) under three configurable reporting standards, from least to most demanding: \textit{Screen}, \textit{Replicate}, and \textit{Full}. Failed claims receive diagnoses that guide follow-up analyses. To evaluate reporting decisions at the claim level, we introduce \textbf{NeuroClaimBench}, comprising 489 executable neuroimaging claims with frozen data, including literature-supported findings and 150 controls designed to violate individual methodological requirements. On NeuroClaimBench, CONFIRM falsely supports at most 3\% of controls, compared with 23--38\% for the baselines, while recovering up to 61\% of literature-supported claims. When auditing an existing agent, CONFIRM reduces false support on controls from 23\% to 0\% while retaining the agent's literature-supported claims. Its diagnostic feedback also produces more supported revisions than Self-Refine with fewer LLM calls. Together, CONFIRM and NeuroClaimBench show that basing reporting decisions on pre-specified analysis plans and deterministic gates is essential for trustworthy autonomous scientific discovery.

</details>


### [501] [State-Aware Virtual Patient Simulation for Training Psychiatrists in Challenging Clinical Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02067)
*Harsh Mohta,C Chandrahas Reddy,Sunhith Reddy Bojja,Manik Inder Singh Sethi,Vinesh Gupta,Raghuram Bharadwaj Diddigi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种"状态感知"的虚拟病人仿真流水线，用于精神科医师在高风险临床情境下的对话训练：系统全程维护演化的病人心理状态，由学习型行为策略选择器决定挑战的类型与强度，再将策略、状态、医师回应、交互历史与临床知识作为接地上下文交由大语言模型生成语义相关且心理一致的病人回复，会话后自动分析并给出沟通与管理反馈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精神科医师需应对自杀意念、幻觉等高风险心理状态，但安全的实操练习机会稀缺。现有基于大语言模型的对话智能体直接让LLM决定病人回应，难以稳定维持心理状态、难以随医师回应自适应，也难以生成具有临床合理性的挑战，从而无法真正检验受训者。

Method: 构建状态感知虚拟病人仿真流水线：（1）在整个交互过程中维护不断演化的病人状态；（2）学习型行为策略选择器依据当前病人与医师语境判定挑战的类型与强度，系统"编排"病人行为而非完全交给LLM自由生成；（3）将被选策略、病人状态、医师回应、交互历史及相关临床知识作为接地上下文输入LLM，生成语义相关且心理一致的回应；（4）会话结束后对交互进行分析，就沟通与病人管理向医师提供反馈。

Result: 摘要未报告具体量化结果；所声明的能力为：维持心理状态一致性、根据医师回应自适应调整挑战、生成临床合理的挑战情境，并在训练后提供沟通与管理层面的反馈。

Conclusion: 将病人状态建模与行为策略选择同LLM生成解耦并组合，可提升虚拟病人模拟的一致性、可控性与临床检验力，为精神科高风险沟通训练提供可扩展、可反馈的仿真方案。

Abstract: Psychiatrists must be prepared to manage patients exhibiting challenging psychological states, including suicidal ideation, hallucinations, and other high-risk behaviors. However, opportunities to safely practice such interactions are limited. While recent conversational agents can simulate patients, existing approaches largely rely on large language models (LLMs) to determine patient responses, making it difficult to consistently maintain psychological state, adapt to the clinician's responses, and generate clinically plausible challenges that meaningfully test the clinician. We present a state-aware virtual patient simulation pipeline for training psychiatrists in challenging clinical scenarios. The proposed system maintains an evolving patient state throughout the interaction and orchestrates patient behavior rather than leaving response generation entirely to an LLM. At each interaction, a learning-based behavioral strategy selector determines the type and level of challenge appropriate to the current patient and clinician context. The selected strategy, patient state, clinician response, interaction history, and relevant clinical knowledge are then provided as grounded context to an LLM to generate a semantically relevant and psychologically consistent patient response. Following each session, the system analyzes the interaction and provides feedback to the clinician on their communication and management of the virtual patient.

</details>


### [502] [SPAR: Experience-Driven Strategy Evolution in Multi-Session B2B Sales](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01695)
*Hangming Zhang,Yao Zhao,Haotian Kuang,C. L. Philip Chen,Tong Zhang,Tengyue Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SPAR是一个无需参数更新的自进化销售智能体框架，将销售策略建模为可检验假设，通过"内循环（情景记忆适配单个商家）+外循环（因果归因与假设驱动进化共享策略手册）"的双环架构实现跨会话经验积累，在1688平台20万+商家的线上A/B测试中实现转化率+15.8%、高意向商家增长+35.8%，专家评分4.62/5。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: B2B外呼销售单笔金额高、依赖关系型信任，成交通常需多轮触达并延续既有上下文；而现有LLM销售智能体局限于单次会话，无法跨会话保留上下文或从经验中优化策略。已有经验学习方法以非结构化文本存储经验，且把所有结果视为同等有信息量，缺乏区分"策略缺陷"与"外部因素"的机制，导致错误归因与策略漂移。

Method: 提出SPAR自进化框架：将销售策略表述为可检验假设，在无参数更新条件下迭代精炼。采用双环架构——内循环借助情景记忆针对单个商家做自适应；外循环通过因果归因与假设驱动的演化，维护并进化一份共享的策略手册（strategy playbook）。

Result: 在1688平台面向20万+商家的线上A/B测试中，转化率提升15.8%，高意向商家增长35.8%；领域专家人工评估中，SPAR整体销售质量得分为4.62/5，为所有对比方法中最高。

Conclusion: SPAR表明，将销售策略作为假设进行因果归因驱动的双层进化，可在不微调模型的前提下使LLM销售智能体具备跨会话的持续学习能力，并在大规模真实业务中取得显著效果；其"区分策略缺陷与外部因素"的机制是相较现有经验型方法的关键优势。

Abstract: B2B outbound sales involves high transaction values and relationship-based trust, so closing a deal typically requires multiple rounds of outreach building on prior context. Existing LLM-based sales agents operate within single sessions and cannot carry forward context or refine strategies from experience. Methods that do learn from experience store lessons as unstructured text and treat all outcomes as equally informative, with no mechanism to distinguish a flawed strategy from an external factor. We propose SPAR, a self-evolving framework that models selling strategies as testable hypotheses and refines them without parameter updates. A double-loop architecture lets an inner loop adapt to individual merchants through episodic memory while an outer loop evolves a shared strategy playbook through causal attribution and hypothesis-driven evolution. In a live A/B test on the 1688 platform with over 200,000 merchants, SPAR achieves +15.8% conversion lift and +35.8% high-intent merchant growth. Human evaluation by domain experts rates SPAR at 4.62 out of 5 on overall sales quality, the highest among all methods.

</details>


### [503] [Autonomous Analysis of Thermoelectric Materials Big Data by Multi-Agentic AI and Construction of a Knowledge Base and Specialized AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00627)
*Yusuke Hashimoto,Takaaki Tomai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出多智能体系统MAA，让扮演不同角色的AI智能体按预定义指令与质量检查分析热电实验数据，并留下可溯源至原始数据的分析记录，进而考察这种"知识积累"的记录特征，并以检索型AI基于这些记录回答问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型实验材料数据库中的知识提取需要反复分析，并需要对分析选择与结果进行可复用的记录；现有做法缺乏系统化、可溯源的多智能体分析框架。

Method: 构建MAA多智能体系统，各智能体承担不同角色，在预定义指令与质量检查下分析热电实验数据并保存可溯源记录；开展四组实验，改变主题数与循环数，考察记录中概念共现、词汇共享与关系描述的出现时序；同时用专门AI检索该实验知识库并阅读分析记录来回答材料问题。

Result: 最大规模实验（10个主题×10轮共100次分析）中，概念共现集中于主题内部，词汇跨主题共享，部分关系描述在较晚轮次才首次被发现；检索型AI能带引用来源地回答材料问题；回溯性检查（包括将基于初步语料的回答回溯至源数据）暴露出错误。

Conclusion: 可溯源记录使错误易于被发现，但并不等于错误不存在；多智能体+可复用记录的框架有助于知识积累与审计，但需配套回溯核查。

Abstract: Extracting knowledge from large databases of experimental materials data requires repeated analyses and reusable records of their choices and results. We developed Multi-Agentic AI (MAA), a multi-agent system in which AI agents with distinct roles analyze experimental thermoelectric data under predefined instructions and quality checks, saving analysis records traceable to their sources. In four experiments varying theme and cycle counts, we measured what accumulated in these records. In the largest experiment (100 analyses across 10 themes and 10 cycles), concept co-occurrences were concentrated within themes, vocabulary was shared across themes and some relation descriptions were first detected in later cycles. A specialized AI that searches this experiment's knowledge bases and reads their analysis records answered materials questions with cited sources. Retrospective checks, including tracing an answer generated with a preliminary corpus back to the source data, exposed errors: traceability makes errors findable but not absent.

</details>


### [504] [LM6-CastBench: A Geometry-Aware Simulation Dataset for Transient Thermal Prediction in LM6 Sand Casting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00619)
*Suhani Kolhatkar,Anand Khandekar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出开放的LM6铝砂型铸造瞬态温度场仿真数据集LM6-CastBench（3类几何×10变体×5浇注温度×3模温，共450例），并按几何级划分对比MLP与U-Net基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 凝固过程瞬态热场是连接工艺条件与缺陷易发区形成的关键，但逐例求解热传导问题计算代价高，需数据驱动代理模型；然而现有铸造热行为机器学习研究依赖各自私有的仿真数据库，缺乏可复现的几何级基准。

Method: 构建LM6铝合金砂型铸造瞬态热场仿真数据集：3个几何族、每族10个变体、5种浇注温度、3种模具温度（450个几何-工艺案例）；每例保留CAD几何、非结构网格连接、空间描述符、工艺元数据及时间分辨节点温度；在几何级数据划分下对比逐点MLP与空间结构化U-Net。

Result: U-Net显著降低温度场预测误差，且在含局部特征与截面突变剧烈的几何上提升最大。

Conclusion: LM6-CastBench为铸造热行为的几何感知代理建模提供了可复现的数据集与基准。

Abstract: Transient thermal fields during solidification connect casting process conditions and cooling behaviour to the formation of defect-prone regions in aluminum cast ings. Repeatedly solving this thermal problem across geometries and process conditions is computationally expensive, motivating data-driven surrogate models. However, existing machine-learning studies on casting thermal behaviour rely on study-specific simulation databases that do not support reproducible geometry-level benchmarking. We introduce LM6-CastBench, an open simulation dataset for geometry-aware learning of transient thermal fields in LM6 aluminum sand casting, combining three geometry families, ten variants per family, five pouring tempera tures, and three mould temperatures (450 geometry-process cases in total). Each case retains CAD geometry, unstructured mesh connectivity, spatial descriptors, process metadata, and time-resolved nodal temperatures. We benchmark a point wise MLP against a spatially structured U-Net under geometry-level data splits; the U-Net reduces temperature-field errors by a large margin, with the biggest gains on geometries with localized features and abrupt section changes. LM6-CastBench gives researchers a reproducible dataset and benchmark for geometry-aware surro gate modelling of casting thermal behaviour.

</details>


### [505] [Evolving Scientific Intelligence: From Fragmented Evidence to Distributed Experimental Loops](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00580)
*Yuheng Ding*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"演化式科学智能"(ESI)架构蓝图：以共享可计算的科学记忆保存实验记录，使跨领域证据可重组为可检验假设，并通过分布式实验节点的物理验证、反馈修正与慢速元控制，形成证据驱动的链式发现，跨越"科学记忆墙"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以论文为中心的科学传播使实验结果碎片化、延迟或未被报告，在日益增长的计算能力与AI可获取的证据之间形成"科学记忆墙"；孤立的发现回路也阻碍了跨领域证据的碰撞与累积。

Method: 提出ESI架构蓝图：1) 以共享、可计算的科学记忆持久化实验记录（含失败与未报告结果）；2) 将跨域证据重组为可检验假设；3) 依据科学价值、可靠性与成本联合选择候选与评估方法；4) 跨分布式实验节点协调物理测试；5) 反馈修正假设与评估器；6) 由较慢的元控制层重审研究目标与决策准则，防止自我强化错误与目标错置。

Result: 本文为愿景/蓝图性工作，未报告实证结果；论证了"信息碰撞—经验验证"链可把孤立发现回路转变为累积式科学过程，并提出"信息曼哈顿计划"式的基础设施建设倡议。

Conclusion: 实现通过实验 grounded 的发现链条不断演化的科学智能，需要建设共享科学记忆与分布式实验协同的基础设施，并以元控制层保障稳健性，作者呼吁开展"信息曼哈顿计划"。

Abstract: Scientific discovery advances when evidence from different investigations is brought into contact. Yet paper-centric communication leaves experimental results fragmented, delayed, or unreported, creating a "scientific memory wall" between growing computational capabilities and the evidence accessible to AI systems. We envision a different dynamic: in a network of intelligent laboratories, a failed or overlooked experiment in one domain could trigger a hypothesis in another, whose testing generates evidence that stimulates further investigations. Such chains of information collision and empirical validation could transform isolated discovery loops into a cumulative scientific process. We propose Evolving Scientific Intelligence (ESI), an architectural blueprint for enabling these evidence-driven chain reactions. ESI preserves experimental records in shared, computable scientific memory, where evidence from different domains can be recombined into testable hypotheses. It jointly selects candidates and evaluation methods according to scientific value, reliability, and cost, then coordinates physical tests across distributed experimental nodes. Their feedback revises hypotheses and evaluators, while slower meta-control reassesses research objectives and decision criteria to guard against self-reinforcing errors and misguided optimization. We call for an Information Manhattan Project to build the infrastructure for scientific intelligence that evolves through experimentally grounded chains of discovery.

</details>


### [506] [Few Trials, Many Metrics: Beta Mixtures for Low-Budget AI Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00474)
*Gustavo Tironi,Felipe Maia Polo,Diego Mesquita*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出以BIC选择成分数的Beta混合分布，经一次边际极大似然拟合即可闭式得到任意horizon的Pass^k与AUC@k，并给出delta法置信区间；实验表明在超出观测试验数外推时比朴素估计更准确，区间能覆盖全数据参考。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机AI系统评估需每实例大量重复采样，尤其长horizon指标代价高；已有工作仅用Beta分布建模实例级成功概率以少量样本估计Pass@k，适用范围有限。

Method: 以边际极大似然拟合Beta混合分布，成分数由BIC确定；从单次拟合闭式推导任意horizon的Pass^k与AUC@k，并用delta法给出这些指标及Pass@k的置信区间（无需额外模型调用）；将配置而非任务视为实例以扩展到敏感性分析。

Result: 在竞赛数学与研究生级科学基准上，外推超出观测试验数时混合先验估计比朴素估计更准，且区间覆盖全数据参考；以prompt为实例时，比无外部协变量的IRT基线更准确地刻画prompt敏感度分布。

Conclusion: Beta混合框架可支撑更广泛的评估目标；但试验数达到目标horizon后，直接估计仍更可取。

Abstract: Evaluating a stochastic AI system often requires many repeated samples per instance, especially for metrics defined over long horizons. Recent work has shown that modeling instance-level success probabilities with a Beta distribution recovers Pass@$k$ from far fewer samples than direct estimation. We show that this framework supports a broader range of evaluation targets. We fit a mixture of Beta distributions by marginal maximum likelihood, with the number of components chosen by BIC. From that one fit, we compute Pass$^k$ and AUC@$k$ at any horizon in closed form. We also derive delta-method confidence intervals for these metrics and for Pass@$k$, which require no additional model calls. Treating configurations rather than tasks as instances extends the same model to sensitivity analysis. For repeated success metrics, we find that mixture priors yield more accurate estimators than naive estimation across competition mathematics and graduate-level science benchmarks when extrapolating beyond the observed number of trials, and the resulting intervals cover the full-data reference. When prompts are treated as instances, it estimates the distribution of prompt sensitivity more accurately than a comparable item-response baseline without external covariates. Direct estimators remain preferable once trials reach the target horizon.

</details>


### [507] [Nonconformal Distortion and Local Orientation Reversal in the Fourier Circuit of a Modular-Addition Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00414)
*Eduardo Fuentes,Gonzalo Riera,Héctor Allende-Cid*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文对已逆向解析的单层Transformer模加电路中基于傅里叶的MLP子模块做局部微分几何刻画：在五个关键频率对应的傅里叶输入平面上测量方向性Beltrami系数，发现训练后映射普遍非共形（中位|μ|约0.39），其几何畸变主要形成于傅里叶电路成形之前，且与正确logit margin几乎无关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有工作已把模加电路的算法（傅里叶频率、MLP读写）逆向重构出来，但只停留在算法层面，缺少对该计算子模块作为映射的局部几何（形变、共形性、方向结构）的定量描述。作者希望补充这一视角：理想复乘法的非退化限制应为共形，而实际训练网络的限制会偏离共形多少、如何组织、何时形成。

Method: 将单层Transformer中MLP对五个关键傅里叶频率的贡献限制为"傅里叶输入平面→对应读出"的实平面映射；对连续输入扰动测量方向性Beltrami系数μ（|μ|度量非共形程度，arg μ刻画空间组织与局部定向反转）；以随机平面作对照并控制坐标框条件数差异；在单次训练500个checkpoint上追踪|μ|与傅里叶电路形成度的时间关系；在6次运行、个体样本层面分别检验与correct-logit margin的相关性及跨运行的频率间一致性。

Result: 训练后映射显著非共形：中位|μ|=0.304–0.446，Beltrami辐角呈空间组织，并存在局部定向反转区域；中位|μ|从初始化的0.939降至训练后0.390；关键频率平面畸变中位值低于多数随机平面控制，但分布重叠且坐标框条件数不同；500个checkpoint上，|μ|的总体下降大部分发生在傅里叶电路形成的主要增长之前；个体输入层面|μ|与correct-logit margin相关性可忽略（|ρ|≤0.026）；6次运行晚期checkpoint显示多数字频率畸变相近。

Conclusion: 结果为已识别神经电路中频率投影组件的局部形变提供了定量刻画，与算法重构互为补充：电路在算法上近乎理想，但在几何上并非共形，且畸变在训练早期即基本定型，并不直接决定单样本预测裕度。

Abstract: We study the local differential geometry of a Fourier-based modular-addition circuit in a one-layer transformer whose algorithm has previously been reverse-engineered. For each of the five key Fourier frequencies, we restrict the model's multilayer perceptron (MLP) contribution to a corresponding Fourier input plane and readout, and measure its directional Beltrami coefficient under continuous input perturbations. Whereas nondegenerate restrictions of ideal complex multiplication are conformal, the trained maps exhibit nonconformal distortion (median $|μ|=0.304$--$0.446$), spatial organization in the Beltrami argument, and regions of local orientation reversal. The median across frequencies decreases from $0.939$ at initialization to $0.390$ after training. The key-frequency planes also show lower median distortion than most random-plane controls, although their distributions overlap and the coordinate frames differ in conditioning. Across 500 checkpoints in one training run, most of the aggregate reduction in Beltrami magnitude occurs before the principal increase in the measured Fourier-circuit formation. At the individual-input level, Beltrami magnitude shows negligible association with the correct-logit margin ($|ρ|\leq0.026$). Late-checkpoint measurements across six runs show comparable distortion for most selected frequencies. These results provide a quantitative characterization of local deformation in a frequency-projected component of an identified neural circuit, complementary to its algorithmic reconstruction.

</details>


### [508] [CalVLA: Shaping Native Confidence in Vision-Language-Action Policies with Outcome Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00394)
*Boniface Chukwuemeka Godwin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CalVLA，用成功/失败轨迹联合ACal（squared margin-ranking）损失塑造VLA策略原生的动作token置信度，使低秩适配后的OpenVLA-7B能在无需额外失败检测器的情况下，从自身动作概率中判别任务失败；判别能力提升但任务成功率略有下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究问题：VLA策略能否仅凭自身动作概率预测任务失败。目标是避免引入辅助失败检测器，直接利用策略原生动作token置信度作为失败信号。

Method: 构建CalVLA：以成功与失败rollout为监督信号，用Action-Confidence Alignment（ACal）平方margin-ranking损失校准动作token置信度；通过低秩适配（LoRA）微调OpenVLA-7B，不加辅助检测器。观测配对在同一任务内、按相近归一化已用时间对齐（非物理进度等价）。在500个LIBERO-10配置的留出测试集上，用三个随机种子、在130与260步平均置信度得分评估联合失败判别AUROC，并与冻结策略探针（线性探针）比较。

Result: 适配后置信度的联合失败判别AUROC为0.7392±0.0480（三种子）；冻结策略探针为0.6146–0.6436，但相对线性探针的优越性统计上不显著。同一置信度汇总下，AUROC由适配前0.4485升至适配后0.7327。平均任务成功率由58%降至55%。

Conclusion: 结果支持失败判别能力提升，但不代表控制性能或安全性收益得到确立：成功率反而小幅下降，且对线性探针的优势尚不具统计结论性。

Abstract: Can a vision-language-action (VLA) policy signal likely task failure from its own action probabilities? We introduce CalVLA, which shapes native action-token confidence using successful and failed rollouts and an Action-Confidence Alignment (ACal) squared margin-ranking loss. Low-rank adapters update OpenVLA-7B without an auxiliary failure detector. Observations are paired within tasks at similar normalized elapsed times, not necessarily equivalent physical progress. On a held-out test split from 500 LIBERO-10 configurations, adapted confidence achieves a joint failure-discrimination AUROC of $0.7392\pm0.0480$ over three seeds, averaging scores at 130 and 260 steps. Frozen-policy probes reach 0.6146--0.6436, but superiority over the linear probe is statistically inconclusive. For the same confidence summary, AUROC rises from 0.4485 before adaptation to 0.7327 after adaptation. Mean task success decreases from 58% to 55%. These results show improved failure discrimination, not improved control or established safety benefits.

</details>


### [509] [Efficient NPN Classification for Large Functions using Graph Neural Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00339)
*Chengdi Cao,Hanyu Wang,Wan-Hsuan Lin,Jason Cong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将NPN等价分类重构为“NPN动作预测”问题，用双向异构图神经网络在AIG上直接预测输入取反、输出取反与输入置换，并借助图重写降低结构歧义，实现可扩展的近似精确分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精确NPN分类需穷举所有输入置换与取反，复杂度指数增长，难以用于输入数较多的布尔函数；而NPN分类在逻辑综合、量子计算与信息论中有重要价值，因而需要一种可扩展的高效方法。

Method: 把布尔函数表示为AND-Inverter Graph（AIG），将NPN分类表述为动作预测任务；采用双向异构图神经网络同时预测输入取反、输出取反与输入置换；并引入图重写技术以缓解逻辑网络的非规范性、减少结构歧义并在预测前恢复有用对称性。

Result: 实验表明NPN动作预测是可学习的；所得规范化质量优于启发式基线；在实际基准上，可处理情形下接近精确方法，并可扩展至多达16个输入的函数。

Conclusion: 首个基于学习的NPN分类框架可行且有效，兼顾了规范化质量与可扩展性，为大规模布尔函数的NPN分类提供了新范式。

Abstract: Two Boolean functions are considered NPN equivalent if one can be transformed into the other by negating inputs, permuting inputs, or negating the output. Efficient NPN classification is valuable in fields such as logic synthesis, quantum computing, and information theory. However, exact NPN classification demands exhaustive enumeration of all possible input permutations and negations. Its complexity grows exponentially, making it impractical for larger functions with more inputs. In this paper, we introduce the first learning-based formulation for NPN classification by recasting it as NPN action prediction. Our method represents Boolean functions as AND-Inverter Graphs (AIGs) and applies a bidirectional heterogeneous graph neural network to predict input negations, output negation, and input permutations. To mitigate the non-canonicity of logic networks, we further introduce graph rewriting techniques that reduce structural ambiguity and recover useful symmetries before prediction. Experimental results show that NPN action prediction is learnable, that the resulting canonicalization quality improves over heuristic baselines, and that on practical benchmarks our method approaches exact methods on tractable cases while scaling to functions with up to 16 inputs.

</details>


### [510] [From Cross-Section to Cross-Omics: Conditional Cell Nucleus Image Editing in Spatial Transcriptomics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00226)
*Yuechen Yang,Junchao Zhu,Junlin Guo,Yanfan Zhu,Ruining Deng,Zhengyi Lu,Tianyuan Yao,Chongyu Qu,Marilyn Lionts,Xingyi Guo,Yaohong Wang,Yu Wang,Shilin Zhao,Haichun Yang,Yuankai Huo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文将Manifold-Aware Diffusion（MAD）框架应用于空间转录组学中的双组学编辑任务，可在保持一组特征不变的前提下定向修改另一组特征，并在CosMx SMI肾组织足细胞上取得MAE=0.6636、FID=25.19的最优病理组学编辑性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间转录组（ST）平台同时测量基因表达与细胞核图像，但组织切片几何引入混杂：三维组织切成薄片后形成的二维截面面积取决于切割角度，截面越大暴露的胞质越多、mRNA计数越高，而核面积等病理组学特征又直接从同一二维边界测得。由此产生的基因表达—病理组学相关性反映的是测量过程而非独立生物学。现有基因到图像的方法只能由基因特征生成细胞图像，无法对既有图像实现跨两个组学层的条件驱动编辑。

Method: 将Manifold-Aware Diffusion（MAD）框架应用于双组学编辑设定，实现对一个特征组的定向修改同时保持另一特征组不变；并以CCDM（即去除VAE组件的MAD）作为对照，通过受控仿真研究考察VAE组件在保持跨组独立性的作用。

Result: 在CosMx SMI肾组织足细胞上，MAD的病理组学编辑达到MAE=0.6636、FID=25.19，优于所有对比基线；受控仿真进一步表明，MAD中的VAE组件相比CCDM能更好地保持跨组独立性。

Conclusion: MAD可有效支撑ST中基因表达与病理组学特征之间的条件驱动双向编辑，且VAE组件对维持两组学特征的独立性具有关键作用，为解耦切片几何混杂带来的伪相关问题提供了可行途径。
