Predictions select one candidate for direct evaluation, and held-out confidence bounds determine whether it corrects enough target errors while keeping new errors within prespecified limits. Measured effects update the model even when the edit is rejected. Across EIR (National), ASAP2.0, and ASAP-SAS with three frozen LLM graders, RubricWorld achieves the highest score in 20 of 27 metric comparisons. On ASAP2.0, it raises gpt-5-mini accuracy from 18.20% with the original rubric to 46.70%, exceeding the strongest baseline, APO, by 22.60 percentage points. code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [578] [Taurus: LLM-in-the-Loop CT Annotation Matches Coding Agents at Half the Cost](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00247)
*Bing Hu,Rishabh Sharma,Jatin Mehta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在6个公开主动脉CT数据集（939例）上通过隐藏人工标签进行盲测，比较"自由式LLM智能体自写分割代码"与"harness（自动化标注+LLM复核）"两种范式；最终版Taurus以固定规则平滑表面并对大错误做多项选择复核，达到与自由式Opus智能体相当的主指标，成本不到其一半（$1.22 vs $2.71/例）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动脉CT的密集标注耗时；公开主动脉CT数据集各自按其惯例标注不同结构，难以直接替代人工标注。LLM智能体已能写代码并读图像，因此需要回答：让这类模型作为自由式智能体自写分割代码，还是在harness中（自动标注+模型复核）表现更好。

Method: 构建harness系统Taurus，并与自由式智能体对比。评测采用盲标签恢复：扣留6个公开数据集（939卷）的人工标签，并按各数据集自身类别定义打分。第一版Taurus检验模型复核的增益；随后把自由式智能体的成功做法并入自动化标注环节（38例留出集验证）；最终版以固定规则平滑标签表面，并针对自动化环节常见的大错误（如动脉瘤只画出一半）设置检查项，每触发一项检查即向模型提出附有候选修正（绘制在扫描图像上）的多项选择题。

Result: 第一版Taurus中，模型复核仅在6个数据集中2个提升主指标，且提升小于同一病例两次复核之间的噪声；自由式Claude Opus 5.5智能体在多数数据集上得分更高。将自由式智能体的优势迁移至自动化环节后，在38例留出病例上获得了大部分增益。最终版在标签表面平滑度上与人工参考一致，主指标与自由式Opus智能体无显著差异，成本不到其一半（每例$1.22 vs $2.71）。

Conclusion: Taurus的竞争力主要来自harness及其自动化流程，而非语言模型本身；该类密集标注可被自动化，使专家时间从"绘制标签"转向"检查标签"。

Abstract: Dense labels of the aorta in CT are slow to draw, and the public aortic CT datasets that could stand in for them each label different structures under their own conventions. Large language model (LLM) agents can now write code and read images. We asked whether such a model labels these scans better as a free-form agent that writes its own segmentation code, or inside a harness, where an automated pass labels the scan and the model reviews the result. We built a harness, Taurus, and compared it with free-form agents by blind label recovery: we withheld the human labels of six public datasets (939 volumes) and scored every approach against each dataset's own classes. In the first version of Taurus, the model's review raised the primary metric on only two of six datasets, by less than the noise between two reviews of the same case. A free-form agent running Claude Opus 5.5 scored higher on most datasets. Moving what the free-form agents did well into the automated pass then carried most of the gain on 38 held-out cases. The final version smooths the label surfaces with a fixed rule and checks for the large errors the automated pass tends to make, such as an aneurysm drawn to half its size. Each check that fires puts a multiple-choice question to the model, with candidate corrections drawn on the scan. It matched the surface smoothness of the human references, and in the primary metric we found no difference from the free-form Opus agent, at under half its cost, $1.22 against $2.71 per case. Most of what made Taurus competitive came from the harness and its automation rather than from the language model itself. Taurus shows that this kind of annotation can be automated, so that expert time can move from drawing labels to checking them.

</details>


### [579] [Action Verification through Conjecture and Refutation for Language Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02950)
*Minhyeon Oh,Chiyeong Heo,Geonwoo Noh,Hoyoung Kim,Jangwon Son,Jungseul Ok*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出“证伪导向”的动作验证框架BlackSwan：对每个状态变更动作预测预期效果、构造可检验的证伪假设并加以检测，仅在无假设存活时执行，在AppWorld与WebShop上显著提升成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体依据高层指令通过工具操作外部环境，指令往往缺失关键的任务与环境语境，易产生错配动作。现有执行前验证工作多采用“确认/支持性”视角——检验支持该动作的条件是否成立；作者指出这存在根本盲区：一个错误动作常常能通过所有“它是否正确”的检查。因此需要把验证问题从“有何证据支持该动作”转为“能否找到反驳该动作的证据”。

Method: BlackSwan采用证伪导向的“expect–suspect–test”（预期—存疑—检验）流程：1）对每个会改变状态的候选动作预测其预期效果；2）针对该动作可能出错的方式，构造具体且可实证检验的假设；3）利用已有观测或额外的非变更动作（不改状态）检验这些假设；仅当没有任何证伪假设存活时执行该动作。全程无需微调，可结合骨干模型的thinking模式与上下文示例。

Result: 在具有挑战性的AppWorld任务上，配合与不配合骨干模型thinking模式，成功率相比最强基线分别提升14.9与25.2个百分点；即使不使用thinking或在上下文示例，仍优于配备这两者的更强基线。增益可迁移至AppWorld之外：在WebShop上性能提升12.7个百分点。

Conclusion: 结果表明语言模型智能体具备一种尚未被充分开发的识别与自我纠正错配动作的能力，这种能力可以通过执行前的主动猜想与证伪被系统性地激发；“证伪优于确认”为智能体动作验证提供了有效的新范式。

Abstract: Language model agents increasingly act on users' behalf by manipulating external environments through tools, often from high-level instructions that leave critical task- and environment-specific context unstated. To prevent resulting misaligned actions, recent work verifies proposed actions before execution, largely by establishing whether the conditions supporting them hold. We argue that this confirmation-oriented view leaves a fundamental blind spot: a wrong action often passes every check that asks whether it is right. This motivates a different question for verification: rather than asking what evidence supports an action, can the agent find evidence that refutes it? We pursue this direction with BlackSwan, a refutation-oriented, expect-suspect-test procedure that predicts the intended effect of each state-mutating action, formulates specific and empirically testable hypotheses for how it could be wrong, and tests them using existing observations or additional non-mutating actions, executing the action only if none survives testing. On challenging AppWorld tasks, BlackSwan improves success rate over the strongest baseline by 14.9 and 25.2%p with and without the backbone model's thinking mode, respectively. Even without thinking or in-context demonstrations, it outperforms stronger baselines equipped with them. The gains also transfer beyond AppWorld, with BlackSwan improving WebShop performance by 12.7%p. More broadly, our results suggest that language model agents have an underused capacity to recognize and self-correct misaligned actions, which can be systematically elicited through active conjecture and refutation before execution.

</details>


### [580] [SelfImprove-Bench: Evaluating Generalization in Self-Improving Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02797)
*Bangrui Xu,Jie Yang,Sidi Chen,Xuanhe Zhou,Jiantao Qiu,Qianyu Yang,Zijie Wang,Fan Wu,Zhoufutu Wen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Recursively Self-Improving (RSI) 评测框架 SelfImprove-Bench，以三大能力（探索、规划、推理）构成演化场景，通过游戏实例化任务并提供可扩展的任务模板与难度系数生成机制，用 G0–G4 泛化阶梯衡量能力增益的迁移程度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RSI 评测缺乏三方面支撑：一是缺乏区分"能力提升"与"场景拟合"的可靠指标；二是缺乏可持续、可扩展地面向未见任务与难度的评测协议；三是缺乏将改进归因到具体演化轨迹的细粒度分析手段。

Method: 构建 SelfImprove-Bench 框架：按 Exploring、Planning、Reasoning 三类主要能力组织任务作为模型演化场景；以游戏为载体实例化任务以保证可控性与可复现性；借助任务模板与难度系数实现任务的规模化生成与编排；并将评测组织为 G0 至 G4 的泛化阶梯，衡量增益从训练条件向外迁移的距离，同时支持对演化轨迹的细粒度归因。

Result: 实验表明，现有 RSI 方法所获得的演化增益在不同泛化层级上表现不一致（inconsistent across generalization levels），即增益难以稳定迁移到训练条件之外的场景。

Conclusion: RSI 方法的自我改进效果在泛化维度上并不稳健，需以分层泛化指标与可归因的评测协议取代单一任务分数；SelfImprove-Bench 为此提供了可控制、可复现、可扩展的评测基准。

Abstract: Recursively self-improving (RSI) systems are increasingly viewed as a promising means of accelerating progress toward artificial general intelligence. They aim to autonomously improve their capabilities by refining their working pipelines and recursively improving the strategies that guide subsequent refinements, with gains generalizing to unseen scenarios.However, existing evaluations lack reliable metrics to distinguish capability gains from scenario fitting, sustainable and extensible protocols for unseen tasks and difficulties, and fine-grained attribution of improvement to evolution traces. To this end, we propose SelfImprove-Bench,an RSI evaluation framework that organizes tasks into three primary capabilities (i.e., Exploring, Planning, Reasoning) as scenarios for guiding model evolution. We instantiated the tasks on games for controllability and reproducibility, and pairs them with scalable generation and orchestration driven by task templates and difficulty coefficients. Beyond task-level scores, SelfImprove-Bench organizes evaluation into generalization ladder levels G0 to G4 that measure how far gains transfer from training conditions. Experiments reveal that the evolutionary gains of existing RSI methods are inconsistent across generalization levels.

</details>


### [581] [What Do LLM Judges Actually Verify? Matched Controls and Record Gaps for Document Currency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01311)
*Unnati Shah,Samruddhi Kakade,Aum Patel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LLM 评审器依据修订记录判断引文是否仍有效时，若记录缺失链接反而会漏检；提示记录"不完整"可恢复大部分检出但带回误报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM judge 常用修订记录（amendment record）核查答案所引文档是否仍然有效，但这类记录往往不完整，存在缺失链接。作者想检验：当记录有缺口时，judge 是否会因"过度信任记录"而漏抓已失效的引用。

Method: 构造受控测试集：从替换表中生成配对答案，分别引用被替换文档、其后继文档、替换前的被替换文档、以及被更新但未被替换的旧文档；随后人为从记录中删除链接，并按各发现所陈述的理由打分。数据为 IETF RFC 索引中的 48 例替换；评估 Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.5、Gemma 4 26B 四个 judge，并做第二次删链抽样复现、冲突码探索性实验、以及将缺口改写为"未记录替换"、把记录标为"未核实说明"或加入"记录不完整"警告等干预。

Result: 记录完整时 judge 几乎全部抓到被替换引用，等同于查表。在删链的 24 个故障上，所有 judge 仅凭文本的检出都高于依赖记录：Gemini 3.1 Pro 23/24 vs 1/24，GPT-5.5 23/24 vs 9/24，Claude Opus 4.5 17/24 vs 9/24，Gemma 4 26B 13/24 vs 0/24；第二次删链抽样复现该下降。多数漏检没有给出任何 finding；探索性冲突码只有 Gemini 常用。改写为"未记录替换"无效；标注为未核实说明或警告记录不完整，为 Gemini、GPT-5.5、Claude 恢复大部分检出（前两者校正后显著），Gemma 最多恢复 13 个中的 5 个；且检出恢复时，对"更新"的误报也回归。给定双文本时 judge 大多能区分替换与更新，被误报的更新标题几乎完全相同。

Conclusion: 不完整的修订记录会系统性诱发 judge 漏检失效引用，且漏检多为静默失败；简单的措辞改写无效，需将记录降级为未核实信息并显式提示不完整性，但这会以更新场景的误报为代价，小模型受益有限。附带印度屋顶光伏规则的描述性案例研究，并开源评测框架。

Abstract: LLM judges often check, against an amendment record, whether the documents an answer cites are still in force. Such records are rarely complete. From a table of replacements, our test generates matched answers citing a replaced document, its successor, the replaced document before its replacement, and an older document that a newer one updated without replacing; it removes links from the record and scores each finding by its stated reason. On 48 replacements from the IETF RFC index, judges given a correct record caught nearly every replaced citation, as a lookup would. On the 24 faults whose link we removed, every judge caught more from the texts alone than with the record: Gemini 3.1 Pro 23/24 against 1/24, GPT-5.5 23/24 against 9/24, Claude Opus 4.5 17/24 against 9/24 and Gemma 4 26B 13/24 against 0/24. The drop recurred on a second draw of removed links. Most misses carried no finding; in an exploratory run with a conflict code, only Gemini used it often. Rewording the gap as "no replacement recorded" did not help; presenting the record as an unverified note, or warning that it was incomplete, restored most lost catches for Gemini, GPT-5.5 and Claude (significant after correction for the first two) but at most 5 of 13 for Gemma; where catches returned, so did false alarms on updates. With both texts, judges mostly told replacements from updates; every update flagged had a near-identical title. A descriptive case study on Indian rooftop-solar rules is appended; we release the harness.

</details>


### [582] [Quantiles, Not Points: Streaming Quantile Matching for Ordinal-Aware LLM-as-a-Judge Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00447)
*Ilija Subasic,Andrew Rabinovich,Zhao Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出流式分位数匹配（SQM），基于最优传输映射对齐LLM与人类评分分布，实现序数感知的事后校准，在分布保真度上最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM-as-a-judge 的评分相对人类评分存在系统性分布偏移，常用的事后校准方法多为逐点评分映射，未充分利用评分本身的序数性质与分布特性。

Method: 从两个立场出发：LLMaJ 分数是来自分布的序数评分而非孤立点。据此提出 streaming quantile matching（SQM），即经典分位数匹配在 LLMaJ 校准上的首次基准测试，通过计算 LLM 与人类评分分布间的最优传输映射完成校准；并构建评测框架。

Result: 与逐点校准不同，SQM 尊重人类锚点集的序数性，在分布保真度上表现最佳，并在多模型、多数据上取得总体最优排名；此外事后校准普遍缩小了小模型与大模型评审器之间的原始误差差距。

Conclusion: SQM 是有效的 LLMaJ 分布校准方法；事后校准可缓解模型规模带来的性能差距，为更高效的 LLM 评审器提供可能。

Abstract: LLM-as-a-judge scores are often distributionally shifted from human ratings on any given evaluation task, and post-hoc calibration (mapping LLM to human scores in a small labeled anchor set) has become a popular method to correct for this shift. In this paper we derive the calibration from two positions: that LLMaJ scores are ordinal ratings drawn from a distribution rather than isolated points. We present streaming quantile matching (SQM), a version of a classical method not previously bench marked for LLMaJ calibration, which is built on the two positions by computing the optimal-transport map between the LLM and human score distributions. We develop an evaluation framework and within it we show that unlike point-wise calibrations, SQM respects the ordinality of the human anchor set and achieves the best distributional fidelity and the top overall rank across models and data. We also show that in general, post-hoc calibration narrows the raw error gap between smaller and larger judge models, which opens the possibility of more efficient LLM judges.

</details>


### [583] [Concept-Guided Prompting Strategies Increase Diversity in LLM-Generated Recipe Populations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01171)
*Stuart Farmer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出概念引导提示法：在生成每条响应前先生成主题概念，从而提升LLM输出的语义覆盖率与多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在解空间生成任务中输出趋于重复，限制了其在自动化发现中的价值；需要一种简单方法来扩大探索范围、提升输出多样性。

Method: 提出概念引导提示（concept-guided prompting）：在每个概念下生成响应前先产出主题概念。在食谱书任务中生成1,000条食谱，与人类撰写语料对比，并设置两种朴素提示策略（先验标题提示 prior-title、无意义词提示 nonce）作为基线。

Result: 概念引导提示在所有情况下均优于两个基线，语义覆盖率达47.0%，而prior-title与nonce策略分别为35.1%和13.1%。

Conclusion: 结果表明该方法可实现更广的种群探索与多样性，但结论仅限于该特定任务；解的质量与可泛化性仍需进一步研究。

Abstract: Novelty in solution generation supports automated discovery, but LLM outputs can remain repetitive. To address this, we propose a simple concept-guided prompting method that generates thematic concepts before responses within each of these concepts. To demonstrate, we generated 1,000 recipes for a recipe book task and compared the results against a human-authored corpus. Two naive prompting strategies were compared as baselines. Concept-guided prompting outperformed both baselines in all cases and reached semantic coverage of 47.0% versus 35.1% and 13.1% in respective prior-title and nonce prompt strategies. These findings suggest broader population exploration and diversity, but remain contained to this specific task. Further work is needed to determine the quality of solutions and generalizability.

</details>


### [584] [Total Cost of Agency: Exact Attribution of Memory Injection Cost in Multi-Agent LLM Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23790)
*Vivek Kumar Singh,Preeti Priyam,Gautam Bhowmick*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"代理总成本"(TCA)框架，将多智能体LLM工作流成本分解为基础提示、推理、记忆注入、未命中惩罚与上下文累积五项，并用两遍非计费token计数法精确归因注入token。在200任务企业基准上，记忆注入约占可变成本13.6%、全额计费成本12%，且占比随工作流深度从0升至27.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产环境可观测性工具只报告总token成本，不区分节点生成与被注入的token，导致记忆注入这部分账单对付款团队不可见；现有估算多用词数代理，不够精确。

Method: 提出TCA成本分解（五项：基础提示、推理、记忆注入、未命中惩罚、上下文累积）；设计两遍、非计费（two-pass, non-billable）token计数法，直接度量注入token而非用词数代理估计；在200任务企业基准上调用真实模型API进行评测。

Result: 记忆注入占可优化可变成本13.6%、占全额计费成本约12%；其占比从深度1的结构性零升至深度6的27.6%。注入token在深度2–6内随深度线性增长（R²=0.9974），二次拟合首项系数为负，故在该深度范围未见凸增长。固定模型档位下将检索窗口从32降至2条，注入token下降28.7%，准确率变化在种子级波动范围内。

Conclusion: 记忆注入成本显著、随深度增长且可控制；作者如实报告图重写变换单独使用时近似成本中性、五项分解中有两项在该测试框架下按构造为零、总成本主要由模型档位决定（视为前人工作并固定），且未评估提示缓存，所有数据均为无缓存情形。

Abstract: Every node in a multi-agent large language model (LLM) workflow retrieves context from memory and injects it into its prompt, where those injected tokens are billed as input tokens at the same per-token price as the system prompt and the user query. Production observability tools report total token cost but do not separate the tokens a node generates from the tokens it is handed, so this component of the bill is invisible to the teams paying it. We introduce the Total Cost of Agency (TCA), a decomposition of multi-agent workflow cost into base prompt, inference, memory injection, miss penalty and context-accumulation components, and an exact attribution method: a two-pass, non-billable token count that measures injected tokens directly rather than estimating them from word-count proxies. On a 200-task enterprise benchmark executed against real model APIs, memory injection accounts for 13.6 percent of the variable cost a compile-time optimizer can act on, about 12 percent of the full billed cost, and its share rises from a structural zero at workflow depth one to 27.6 percent at depth six. Injected tokens grow linearly with depth over the measured range (R^2 = 0.9974, depths two through six); a quadratic fit yields a negative leading coefficient, so the data do not exhibit convex growth at these depths. We show the component is controllable at fixed model tier: reducing the retrieval window capacity from 32 to 2 entries lowers injected tokens by 28.7 percent with an accuracy change within seed-level variation. We report in full that our graph-rewriting transforms are approximately cost-neutral in isolation, that two of the five decomposition terms are zero by construction in this harness, and that total workflow cost is dominated by model tier assignment, which we hold fixed and treat as prior work. Prompt caching is not evaluated; all figures are for the uncached case.

</details>


### [585] [WebHarbor: Docking Real Websites for Evolving GUI Agent Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03634)
*Zhaoyang Wang,Qianhui Wu,Boyu Gou,Demi Wang,Jiacheng Zhang,Peichun Hua,Qize Li,Shi Qiu,Yifan Jiang,Yifan Zhang,Zexu Jin,Baolin Peng,Bolin Shen,Chetan Bansal,Dehan Kong,Deren Lei,Dongshen Peng,Fengqing Jiang,Hao Cheng,Haoqing Wang,Jiaming Shan,Jicheng Wang,Jingguang Zhou,Jixuan He,Kaide Zeng,Kangyu Zhu,Lama Moukheiber,Mufan Qiu,Peng Xia,Qihan Sun,Qingwei Lin,Qiushi Sun,Ruichen Zhang,Shuqing Luo,Si Qin,Sicheng Fan,Tao Xiong,Wenlin Yao,Xinyu Zhang,Xinyue Zeng,Xuanrui Li,Xuchao Zhang,Yian Wang,Yichao Liu,Yiming Liang,Yiyang Zhou,Yizhu Jiao,Yuetai Li,Yurun Chen,Yuxuan Zhang,Zheyuan Yang,Zhiyuan Yao,Zhongyang Li,Zihao Li,Zili Wang,Jianfeng Gao,Huaxiu Yao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 WebHarbor：153 个可执行、容器化的确定性网站环境与 3,518 个任务，兼具高保真评估与低成本 RL 训练，训练出的 Qwen 4B 级 GUI 智能体可泛化至未见任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GUI Web 智能体的评估与训练需要真实、可交互且稳定的环境。真实网站评估存在内容变动、访问受限、登录后流程覆盖不足等问题；现有合成训练环境则缺乏功能深度与视觉保真度。

Method: 构建 153 个 Docker 化可执行网站环境，重建真实 Web 服务的视觉界面、内容与功能流程，并在确定性控制下运行；采用“任务驱动的人机协作”流程：新任务扩展功能范围、编码智能体实现改动、人工审核视觉保真度/功能正确性/任务有效性。

Result: 环境套件包含 3,518 个任务，覆盖多步与登录后工作流；在该环境中用 RL 训练的 Qwen 4B 级 GUI 智能体可泛化到未见任务，并在四个基准上与领先开源 GUI Web 智能体表现相当。

Conclusion: WebHarbor 提供了可复现、高保真的合成 Web 环境，兼顾可靠评估与高成本效益的强化学习训练，并公开代码与数据。

Abstract: GUI web agents require realistic and interactive environments that remain stable during both evaluation and training. Live website evaluation suffers from changing content, access restrictions, and limited coverage of authenticated workflows, while existing synthetic environments for training often lack functional depth and visual fidelity. We propose WebHarbor, a suite of 153 executable and dockerized website environments that faithfully reconstruct the visual interfaces, content, and functional workflows of real-world web services under deterministic control. We build WebHarbor through task-driven human-agent collaboration, where environments evolve as new tasks expand their functional scope, coding agents implement the required changes, and human contributors audit visual fidelity, functional correctness, and task validity. The resulting suite comprises 3,518 tasks spanning multi-step and post-authentication workflows, where existing works often fail to cover. Beyond reliable evaluation, WebHarbor provides high-fidelity synthetic web environments for cost-efficient reinforcement learning (RL). We demonstrate that a Qwen 4B-level GUI agent trained with RL in WebHarbor generalizes to unseen tasks and performs competitively with leading open-source GUI web agents across four benchmarks. The code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/WebHarbor.

</details>


### [586] [Strategist: Evolving Reasoning with Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03618)
*Taiming Lu,Qi Xu,Zhigang Hua,Zhuang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出元智能体 Strategist，将推理策略以可执行"蓝图"代码形式表示并沉淀为可复用库，通过检索-生成-测试-修订的闭环演化出跨任务推理策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体系统由模型与推理策略两半构成，而后者长期依赖手工编写，且构建经验无法迁移到下一个任务，导致重复造轮子与效率低下。

Method: 每个策略写成蓝图（其他策略可复用的可执行代码），所有蓝图组成策略库；给定任务与小型开发集，Strategist 检索相关蓝图、生成候选策略、在真实样本上测试、依据结果修订，并将每个候选加入库中以供后续任务复用。

Result: 在30个基准上，24个优于最强基线，平均准确率74.7%（基线74.0%），推理成本降低39%；策略可无需额外搜索即迁移至未见任务与其他模型。

Conclusion: AI系统中此前无法自我改进的"推理策略"部分实现了自动化演化与跨任务积累，验证了策略层面的经验复用价值。

Abstract: A model is only half of an AI agent system. The other half is the inference strategy: the reasoning procedure that turns model calls into a response. Today that second half is written by hand, and the experience of building one strategy never carries to the next. We introduce Strategist, a meta-agent that evolves inference strategies across tasks. Each strategy is written as a blueprint,executable code that other strategies can reuse, and together the blueprints form a library. Given a task and a small development set, Strategist retrieves related blueprints, writes candidate strategies, tests them on real samples, and revises them from the results. Every candidate then enters the library, so later tasks build on earlier discoveries. On 30 benchmarks, Strategist beats the strongest baseline on 24 and matches its average accuracy (74.7% vs.74.0%) at 39% lower inference cost. Its strategies also transfer to unseen tasks and other models without further search. The part of an AI system that is not improved on its own now does.

</details>


### [587] [Agentic Context Management for Multi-Turn Human-AI Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00518)
*Matthew Ho,Chenglong Wang,Baolin Peng,Nebojsa Jojic,Philippe Laban,Michel Galley,Jianfeng Gao,Lianhui Qin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出免训练方法AC3：由独立分析器从用户消息中整合任务规范、审计助手历史输出并据此编辑上下文；实验显示其可修复多轮对话中的上下文污染，并揭示"污染传染"现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM多轮对话性能退化部分源于上下文污染：模型自身早期输出滞留上下文中，对后续轮次产生锚定效应，早期对用户意图的误读在用户纠正后仍会持续。直接丢弃全部助手消息（Assistant Omission, AO）可消除污染，但在指代性交互中失效——后续轮次需回溯仅存在于助手轮中的草稿、决策与工具调用结果。

Method: AC3（Agentic Conversation Context Curation）为免训练方法，引入独立分析器：(1) 仅从用户消息中整合任务规范；(2) 以该规范审计助手既有输出；(3) 编辑上下文——或追加分析结果，或丢弃助手侧内容并基于规范重建上下文。另一关键设计：污染具有传染性，分析器在提取规范时若可见助手推理会表现更差，且指令令其忽略也无法弥补差距，故采用结构化方式排除助手轮次。

Result: 在Lost in Conversation（回放难度筛选样本，AO按构造为oracle）上，AC3在四项任务中的三项上弥合全上下文与AO间差距的55–84%，在第四项上超越AO；忠实总结历史的LLM即使增加算力也无法复现该增益。在真实WildChat对话上，GPT-5-mini评判器在主表所有配置下均偏好AC3生成的下一轮，但该偏好依赖评判器；CollabLLM上结果混杂。在有状态工具使用（tau2-bench）中，AO在所有模型上均崩溃至0%，AC3不崩溃，但略逊于全上下文。检测器研究表明，Reset可移除注入的污染但不具备跨度选择性，增益主要来自规范重建。

Conclusion: 上下文污染是多轮对话退化的可控来源，结构性地隔离助手轮次并由用户侧规范重建上下文是关键；增益并非来自跨度选择性检测，而来自规范重建本身，且总结式方法无法替代。

Abstract: LLMs degrade in multi-turn conversation partly because of context pollution: the model's own earlier outputs stay in context and anchor later turns, so an early misreading of the user's intent can persist after the user corrects it. Assistant omission (AO), dropping every assistant message, removes this pollution but fails when interaction is referential: later turns refer back to drafts, decisions, and tool-call results that exist only in assistant turns. We propose Agentic Conversation Context Curation (AC3), a training-free method in which a separate analyzer (1) consolidates the task specification from the user's messages alone, (2) audits the assistant's prior outputs against it, and (3) edits the context, either appending the analysis or discarding the assistant side and rebuilding the context from the specification. A second finding: pollution is contagious. An analyzer that sees the assistant's reasoning while extracting the specification can do worse than no intervention, and instructing it to ignore them did not close the gap, so we exclude assistant turns structurally. On Lost in Conversation (replaying difficulty-selected instances), where AO is an oracle by construction, AC3 closes 55-84% of the gap between full context and AO on three of four tasks and exceeds AO on the fourth, and an LLM that faithfully summarizes the history does not reproduce the gain even with more compute. On real WildChat conversations, a GPT-5-mini judge prefers AC3's next turn over both full context and AO in every configuration of our main table, though this preference depends on the judge; on CollabLLM results are mixed. In stateful tool use (tau2-bench), AO collapses to 0% on every model; AC3 does not collapse, though it falls slightly behind full context. Detector studies show that Reset removes injected pollution but is not span-selective: the gain comes from rebuilding the specification.

</details>


### [588] [ParetoSaddler: Pareto-Guided Optimization of Agent Harnesses for Quality and Cost](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02079)
*Xingzhi Qian,Sungho Park,Rongyuan Tan,Jianbo Yu,Jue Zhang,Lorenzo Cavallaro,Menglin Xia,Yanzhi Chen,Xinnuo Xu,Yu Kang,Xinran Zheng,Gagan Somashekar,Xuchao Zhang,Chetan Bansal,Qingwei Lin,Victor Rühle*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 ParetoSaddler，将"中间候选晋级"与"最终部署选择"解耦，用贝叶斯自助帕累托支持筛选候选 agent harness，实现质量-成本联合优化，在 ClawMark 与 GAIA2 上同时提升质量并降低成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 的 harness 优化方法（不改模型权重即可提升表现）主要只优化回答质量。若要扩展到质量—成本联合优化，会面临错配问题：若在迭代过程中就套用部署偏好（如偏好低成本），会过早淘汰那些当前看似不优、但对后续改进有价值的候选。

Method: ParetoSaddler 分离中间晋级与最终部署选择两个阶段。每轮迭代中，优化器基于父 harness 生成候选，二者经重复执行对比，并用贝叶斯自助（Bayesian bootstrap）帕累托支持度判断候选是否在质量或成本任一维度上取得可信进步；满足者被晋级，获得更充分的发展评估，并可作为后续迭代的父代。

Result: 在 ClawMark 与 GAIA2 的领域不相交划分上评估：ClawMark 质量由 70.86% 提升至 81.35%，单任务成本由 \$1.17 降至 \$1.01；GAIA2 质量由 56.22% 提升至 62.89%，成本由 \$0.78 降至 \$0.45。帕累托选出的 harness 相比仅质量优化方案，质量更高且成本更低。

Conclusion: 帕累托感知优化能保留那些会被部署偏好提前丢弃、但可支撑后续改进的中间候选；贝叶斯自助筛选可过滤跨运行增益证据薄弱的候选。该方法在质量与成本上均优于质量单目标优化。

Abstract: Harness optimization can substantially improve LLM agents without modifying model weights, but existing methods primarily optimize response quality. Extending them to joint quality--cost optimization introduces a challenge: applying the deployment preference during intermediate updates can prematurely reject candidates that are valuable for later improvements. We introduce ParetoSaddler, which addresses this mismatch by separating intermediate candidate promotion from final deployment selection. At each iteration, an optimizer updates a parent harness to produce a candidate, and then compares the two over repeated executions and uses Bayesian bootstrap Pareto support to promote candidates showing credible progress in either quality or cost. Promoted candidates receive broader development evaluation and remain available as parents for later optimization steps. We evaluate ParetoSaddler on ClawMark and GAIA2 using domain-disjoint splits. On ClawMark, ParetoSaddler improves quality from 70.86\% to 81.35\% while reducing cost from \$1.17 to \$1.01 per task; on GAIA2, it improves quality from 56.22\% to 62.89\% while reducing cost from \$0.78 to \$0.45 per task. The Pareto-selected harnesses also achieve higher quality at lower cost than quality-only harness optimization. Analysis shows that Pareto-aware optimization retains intermediate candidates that would be discarded by deployment preference but can support later improvements, while Bayesian bootstrap screening filters out candidates whose gains are weakly supported across runs.

</details>


### [589] [ClickSight: An LLM Framework for Interpreting Student Clickstreams Through Learning Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02021)
*Bahar Radmehr,Lan Tran,Ekaterina Shved,Fatma Bet{ü}l G{ü}reş,Adish Singla,Tanja K{ä}ser*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ClickSight框架，用分阶段LLM流水线将学生点击流与文献定义的学习策略对应，识别证据、评估策略依从性并生成基于证据的行为解读。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字学习环境产生丰富的点击流数据，能反映学生的学习方式，但细粒度轨迹的解读通常需要大量专家投入，成本高、难扩展。

Method: 采用分阶段LLM流水线：给定学生点击流与预定义学习策略集合，先识别与策略相关的证据，再评估对每种策略的依从程度，最后生成有证据支撑的行为解读；在两个学习环境、365名学生、12个模型骨干上评估，使用专家评分量规和经人类专家评分校准的LLM评判器。

Result: ClickSight可在不同模型与环境下生成高质量的策略式解读；推理型模型比指令微调模型表现更稳定；提供从点击流中提取的外部定量指引，可提升需要精确量化信息策略的解读质量。

Conclusion: 将细粒度点击流与理论定义的学习策略连接，并保留判定所依据的证据，为研究数字学习环境中的学生行为提供了灵活、可扩展的方法。

Abstract: Digital learning environments produce rich clickstream data that can reveal how students approach learning tasks, yet interpreting these fine-grained traces often requires substantial expert effort. We introduce ClickSight, a framework for interpreting student clickstreams through learning strategies defined in the literature. Given a student clickstream and a predefined set of learning strategies, ClickSight uses a staged LLM-based pipeline to identify strategy-relevant evidence, assess adherence to each strategy, and generate an evidence-grounded interpretation of the student's behavior. We evaluate ClickSight across two learning environments, 365 students, and 12 model backbones using an expert-grounded quality rubric and an LLM judge calibrated with human-expert ratings. Our results show that ClickSight can generate high-quality strategy-based interpretations across different models and environments, with reasoning models performing more consistently than instruction-tuned counterparts. We further find that providing external clickstream-extracted guidance can improve interpretation quality for strategies that require precise quantitative information from the trace. By connecting fine-grained clickstreams with theoretically defined learning strategies and preserving the evidence underlying each judgment, ClickSight provides a flexible approach for studying student behavior in digital learning environments.

</details>


### [590] [Avatar Intelligence: Amplifying Human Agency Through Persistent Personal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03092)
*Zheng Wu,Xinbei Ma,Yao Yao,Zhaoyuan Huang,Haowen Hu,Yijie Lu,Taolei Wang,Yifei Yang,Wuyue Xiong,Pengzhou Cheng,Zhuosheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"化身智能（Avatar Intelligence）"范式：以持续存在的个人智能体代表用户的目标、价值观与约束，在跨情境、跨时间的决策委派中放大人的主体性；给出从人类主导执行到授权域内自主运行的成熟度路线图、以"智能体监督指数（AOI）"评估交付价值与监督负担的框架，并列出三项核心研究挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程任务型个人智能体虽能力增强，但用户仍需投入大量精力去明确目标、消解歧义、验证结果；因此应以"是否有效放大人的主体性"作为进展衡量标准，而非单纯提升自动化能力。

Method: 概念性立场与研究议程构建：定义 Avatar Intelligence 范式（持久个人智能体，通过持续决策委派表达用户目标、价值观与约束）；提出从人类主导执行到授权域内自主运行的成熟度路线图；构建 Agentic Oversight Index（AOI），将交付价值与智能体侧运行成本、人类监督负担对照评估。

Result: 识别三项核心研究挑战：(1) 身份连续的个人化——跨任务携带用户偏好；(2) 用户情境化演化——通过 Rehearsal Engineering 实现；(3) 安全机制——技术控制与问责、救济机制相结合。

Conclusion: 这些方向构成面向个人智能体、跨任务与长期可靠决策委派的研究议程，强调在保留对重大决策控制权的前提下减少常规监督。

Abstract: Personal AI agents are increasingly capable of handling long-horizon tasks across applications, yet users often need to invest substantial effort in specifying goals, resolving ambiguity, and verifying outcomes. We argue that progress should be measured by how effectively agents amplify human agency: enabling people to pursue their goals with less routine supervision while retaining control over consequential decisions. We advocate Avatar Intelligence, a paradigm of persistent personal agents that represent users' goals, values, and constraints through sustained decision delegation across contexts and time. We describe a maturity roadmap from human-directed execution to autonomous operation within delegated domains, and introduce the Agentic Oversight Index (AOI) as a framework for evaluating delivered value against agent-side operational cost and human oversight burden. We identify three core research challenges: identity-continuous personalization that carries user preferences across tasks, user-situated evolution through Rehearsal Engineering, and safety mechanisms that combine technical control with accountability and recourse. These directions define a research agenda for reliable decision delegation to personal agents across tasks and over time.

</details>


### [591] [User Attributes and Political Ideology Shape LLM Receptiveness in Online Political Debates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02908)
*Akram Elbouanani,Yousra Taleb,Gianluca Demartini,Adrian Popescu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文通过重建5,376个Debate.org辩论并运行近15万次受控多轮对话，发现LLM对左倾用户的接受度系统性高于右倾用户，且这种不对称无法由立场一致或对话者适配解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线政治讨论中，用户越来越多地借助LLM评估争议主张、仲裁分歧和回应对方观点，LLM由此成为讨论的参与者。作者关心这种"交互维度"：LLM是否会改变哪些发言者和论证策略在讨论中获得认可与验证。

Method: 将5,376个Debate.org辩论重构为LLM对话，并运行近150,000次受控多轮对话，系统操纵用户的政治倾向、专业程度、修辞策略与所辩护立场，并包含同一对话内相互对立的用户；同时结合自然主义与受控条件、多模型测试，并进行政治语料微调实验。

Result: LLM对左倾用户的接受度系统性高于右倾用户；即使不同政治倾向用户辩护同一立场、或对立用户出现在同一对话中，该不对称依然存在；重复交互提升接受度但不消除该排序；专业程度有影响，修辞差异影响较小；该模式在多个模型中出现，但可通过不同政治语料微调大幅消除或反转。

Conclusion: LLM会对同一场政治辩论中的不同参与者做出系统性差异化回应，这种交互层面的不对称对理解其在网络公共话语中的角色具有重要意义。

Abstract: Online political discussions increasingly involve AI-mediated participation, as users invoke LLMs to assess contested claims, arbitrate disputes, and respond to opposing viewpoints. As these systems become participants in online exchanges, they may alter which speakers and argumentative strategies receive validation within the discussion.
  We study this interactional dimension by reconstructing 5,376 Debate.org debates as LLM conversations and running nearly 150,000 controlled multi-turn conversations that vary user political orientation, expertise, rhetorical strategy, and defended position, including conversations with competing users.
  Across naturalistic and controlled debates, we find that LLMs are systematically more receptive to left-leaning than right-leaning users. The asymmetry persists when users with different political orientations defend the same position and when opposing users appear in the same conversation, indicating that it is not fully explained by stance agreement or simple accommodation to the current speaker. Repeated interaction increases receptiveness without eliminating this ordering; expertise also matters, while rhetorical differences are smaller. The pattern appears across multiple models, but is not fixed: fine-tuning on different political corpora can largely erase or reverse it. These results show that LLMs can respond systematically differently to participants in the same political debate, making such interactional asymmetries important for understanding their emerging role in online public discourse.

</details>


### [592] [Online Label-Free Gradient Matching for Continual Language Model Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03496)
*Sajjad Pakdamansavoji,Mohammad Reza Rezaei,Ilija Subasic,Pedro Garzon,Radu Paradovschi,Zhao Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出OLGA，用模型自身下一词预测作梯度匹配目标实现无标签数据蒸馏，支持在线流式更新，并通过蒸馏-选择混合管线扩展到大规模数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向客户的语言模型需随数据分布漂移持续更新，全量重训练不现实，而每次更新只需一小批携带全部历史数据训练信号的样本。现有梯度匹配方法依赖真实标签、仅在固定数据快照上一次性运行、且在大数据上速度慢。

Method: 基于梯度匹配的数据蒸馏：以模型自身的下一词预测作为梯度匹配目标，从而无需真实标签；在线场景下维护合成样本的重放记忆（rehearsal memory），每个新批次到达时与记忆一同重新蒸馏；大规模场景下采用蒸馏+选择的混合管线，由选择处理温和压缩阶段、蒸馏处理极端压缩阶段，并自行生成伪标签（无需ground-truth标签）。

Result: 在phi-1.5上、五个文本分类基准中，仅用5个样本即比最强选择基线提升10个百分点准确率；在线设置下比最强选择式持续学习基线在stream-AUC上高6.6个百分点；混合管线在相近准确率下比纯蒸馏减少30%运行时间，并比最佳纯选择管线最高提升12.6个百分点。

Conclusion: OLGA突破了梯度匹配蒸馏对标签的依赖、静态快照限制与大数据可扩展性问题，在少样本、在线流式与大规模三类设置下均优于强基线，为持续更新的语言模型提供了实用的数据蒸馏方案。

Abstract: Language models in customer-facing products must be continually updated, since the data they serve shifts over time. As retraining on the full accumulated data is impractical, each update should instead run on a small set of examples carrying the training signal of all data seen so far. The strongest current methods build this set by gradient matching, which synthesizes examples whose training gradients match those of the full data. However, they require ground-truth labels, run once on a fixed snapshot rather than on a growing stream, and are slow on large data. We introduce \textbf{OLGA}, which lifts these limitations. It distills unlabeled data by drawing the gradient matching targets from the model's own next-token predictions. Across five text classification benchmarks with phi-1.5, it improves accuracy by 10 percentage points over the strongest selection baseline using as few as five examples. OLGA also distills online data streams by keeping a running rehearsal memory of synthetic examples, which is re-distilled together with each new batch as it arrives. In the online setting, it outperforms the strongest selection-based continual baseline by 6.6 stream-AUC percentage points. Finally, our method scales to large data by pairing distillation with selection in a hybrid pipeline, letting selection handle the mild stage of compression and distillation the extreme one. It cuts runtime by 30\% versus distillation alone at similar accuracy, and beats the best selection-only pipeline by up to 12.6 percentage points.

</details>


### [593] [Optimize the Harness, Not the Model: Fitting a Minimal Agent to a Self-Hostable LLM for Investigative Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03434)
*Shai Nahum Gefen,Vered Chassida,Dmitry Basin,Guy Feigenblat*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CLEO 是一种为固定、可自托管 LLM 拟合最小化 agent harness（工具、护栏、记忆策略与循环组件）的方法，在受控约束下以极小体量逼近大型商业基线的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 政府情报团队需要能分析大规模、杂乱证据集合的 LLM agent，但安全与成本约束常排除托管的前沿模型，且难以审计的宽泛工具面也带来风险。因此需要为自托管 LLM 构建精简、可审计的 agent 框架。

Method: 提出 CLEO（Constrained Loop for Environment Optimization）：基于专家验证的数据集，仅在能提升准确率且保持通用性与可审计性的前提下，纳入工具、护栏、记忆策略与循环组件，从而将最小 agent harness 拟合到固定的自托管 LLM。

Result: 在留出数据集上，CLEO harness 达到 83.8% 通过率，与最强的开箱即用 Claude Code SDK 基线相差 1.2 个百分点以内，而体量小两个数量级。

Conclusion: 通过约束式、以审计性与通用性为准入条件的组件筛选，可在显著更小的规模下使自托管 LLM agent 接近大型商业 agent 框架的性能，满足安全与成本受限场景的部署需求。

Abstract: Government intelligence teams need LLM agents that can analyze large, messy evidence collections, but security and cost constraints often rule out hosted frontier models and broad, hard-to-audit tool surfaces. We report CLEO: Constrained Loop for Environment Optimization, a method for fitting a minimal agent harness to a fixed, self-hostable LLM. Given an expert-validated dataset, CLEO admits only the tools, guardrails, memory policies, and loop components that improve accuracy while remaining general and auditable. On our held-out dataset, the CLEO harness reaches an 83.8% pass rate, within 1.2 points of the strongest out-of-the-box Claude Code SDK baseline, while being two orders of magnitude smaller.

</details>


### [594] [Creating Hybrid Interactive Narrative Systems with LLM: From Formal Description to Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02807)
*Jules Clerc,Domitile Lourdeaux,Mohamed Sallak,Marc Ravaine*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一个基于LLM的交互式叙事平台，将经验管理器（EM）设计为可互换模块，运行在共享的符号化世界模型上，并通过统一的计划表示与四项指标实现跨管理器比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合型EM结合运行时自由文本生成与符号化叙事控制，但异质性强、难以比较：管理器行为与其特定场景绑定，且大量决策发生在显式可验证结构之外。

Method: 构建共享符号世界模型（事实、操作、目标），每个操作带显式前置条件与效果；会话可被解释为计划，通过共同的状态转移表示独立于内部机制进行评估；采用四项共享指标：玩家能动性、EM可控性、作者意图、鲁棒性。实现三个对比管理器（开放生成、蒙特卡洛修复、自主角色），在《小红帽》交互场景中做功能分析。

Result: 三个管理器各有优劣，没有任何管理器在全部属性上占优，结果为作者与EM设计者依据优先级选择管理器提供具体依据。

Conclusion: 通过共享符号世界模型与统一计划表示，实现了对异质EM的与实现无关的可比评估，揭示玩家自由与作者控制之间的权衡。

Abstract: Interactive narratives let users shape a story while an Experience Manager (EM) keeps it coherent, balancing player freedom against authorial control. Large Language Models now enable a new generation of hybrid EMs, which combine run-time generation from free-text input with symbolic narrative control. However, their heterogeneity makes them hard to compare: A manager's behaviour is generally tied to the unique and specific scenario in which it operates, and much of its decision-making takes place outside of any explicit and verifiable structure. We address this with an LLM-based narrative platform whose managers are interchangeable modules operating over a shared symbolic world model of facts, operations, and goals. Because every applied operation carries explicit preconditions and effects, each session can be analysed as a plan through a common state-transition representation and evaluated, independently of how the manager works internally, with shared indicators of four properties: player agency, EM controllability, author intent, and robustness. We implement three contrasting managers, based respectively on open generation, Monte Carlo repair, and autonomous characters, and compare them through functional analysis on an interactive Little Red Riding Hood scenario. The results show that no manager dominates on every property, giving authors and EM designers a concrete basis to select a manager according to their priorities.

</details>


### [595] [From Small to Large: Assessing Medical Reasoning, Benchmark Contamination, and Model Size in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00460)
*Navapat Nananukul,Mayank Kejriwal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究通过改变题型设置（标准选择题、隐藏选项、由选项反推题干）评估14个模型在4个医学基准共3076题上的表现，发现高分很大程度上受题目格式、记忆与难度影响，且小模型与推理性表现明显不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在医学考试题上已达或超过专家水平，但这些分数是否反映真实临床能力存疑：可能受题型格式（选择题vs开放式）、对公开基准的先前接触与记忆、题目难度影响；同时，可在合规院内本地部署的小模型是否达到人类水平亦不明确。

Method: 选取6家领先厂商各一大一小共14个模型（含2个开放权重模型），在MedQA-USMLE、MedMCQA、PubMedQA、MedBullets四个基准的3076题上，设置三种条件：标准多项选择、隐去选项的同题作答、仅凭选项重建隐藏题干；并做记忆分析、准确率-推理成本权衡及多模型集成测试。

Result: 标准选择题下最强模型在MedQA-USMLE与PubMedQA超过人类专家基线；小模型较大模型低8.7个百分点，六家中仅两家通过执业考试的人类专家门槛。隐去选项后所有模型显著下降，平均准确率从82.3%降至50.9%，两个最大降幅来自医学专用模型。最强模型可仅凭选项重建约四分之一题干，但在无法重建的题目上准确率保持稳定。研究还给出准确率与推理成本的权衡及集成效果评估。

Conclusion: 医学基准分数不足以代表临床胜任力，受题型格式、记忆与难度显著影响；小规模可部署模型尚未稳定达到人类专家水平；提示需采用更抗记忆、更贴近真实推理的评测设计。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) now answer medical exam questions at or above expert level, but it is unclear whether such scores reflect clinical competence, or are instead affected by the format of the questions being asked (e.g., multiple-choice versus open-ended), prior exposure to the benchmarks, and the difficulty of the questions. These benchmarks are also public and widely used online, which may be resulting in LLM memorization. Models may perform better on questions that they have seen before. It is also not evident whether smaller models, which are more locally deployable in HIPAA-compliant hospital settings, have achieved human performance. In this study, we evaluate fourteen current models from six leading providers, one smaller and one larger model from each provider with two additional open-weight models, on 3,076 questions from four medical benchmarks (MedQA-USMLE, MedMCQA, PubMedQA, and MedBullets) under standard multiple choice, the same questions with the answer choices withheld, and reconstruction of a hidden question from its choices alone. In the standard multiple-choice setting, the strongest models exceed the human-expert baseline on MedQA-USMLE and PubMedQA, but the smaller models trail their larger models by 8.7 percentage points and only two of the six pass the human-expert bar on the licensing examination. Withholding the answer choices, however, makes every model struggle: mean accuracy falls from 82.3% to 50.9%, and the two largest drops belong to the medically specialised models. On memorization, the strongest models reconstruct one question in four from the answer choices alone, yet accuracy holds on the questions they cannot reconstruct. We further weigh accuracy against inference cost and test whether ensembling several models improves medical question answering.

</details>


### [596] [Learning by Doing: Autonomously Compiling and Curating Agent Skills from Verified Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01386)
*Daniel Chalef,Peter Evans,Pavlo Paliychuk,Mehul Patel,Preston Rasmussen,Jack Ryan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Zep Agent Skills 是面向生产环境 LLM 智能体的程序性记忆服务：将经过验证的任务尝试（Trace）编译为带版本、可溯源、可治理的 Skills，并可通过开放标准与 API/MCP 检索；在 τ³-bench banking、AppWorld、EnterpriseOps-Gym 上使三种较弱执行模型的通过率提升 4.5–18.8 点，在 ALFWorld 上以零训练取得与持续微调相当或更优的增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生产级智能体记忆系统主要存储语义记忆（用户与领域事实）或情景记忆（过往交互），缺少对"程序性记忆"的生产化支持；Trace2Skill、WikiSkill、SkillRevise 等研究系统虽能从运行轨迹学习流程并打包为 Skills，但多为研究原型，未解决证据可信度、来源可溯、版本准入与分发治理等生产问题。

Method: 系统以 Trace 为基本单元，记录有序事件、结果与验证强度；仅采用已验证的尝试作为证据。编译流程由职责分离的 Reflector 与 Curator 两个角色组成，将已验证 Trace 转为带版本号的 Skill，并为 Skill 每个字段标注支撑事件。通过扫描与准入闸门控制候选 Skill 是否激活；已验证的使用结果用于调整各 Skill 的搜索排序。Skill 采用 Anthropic 发起并捐赠给 Agentic AI Foundation 的 Agent Skills 开放格式，任何宿主均可加载；检索采用词法搜索配合渐进式披露，通过 API 或 MCP 提供。

Result: 在 τ³-bench banking、AppWorld、EnterpriseOps-Gym 上，由教师模型 Trace 编译的 Skills 使三种较弱执行模型在同一任务、各推理努力档位下的通过率提升 4.5–18.8 点，且增益主要集中于教师模型成功解决的任务；在 ALFWorld 上，由小模型运行编译的 Skills 带来的增益与既往工作报告的持续微调相当或更大，且无需任何训练。

Conclusion: 程序性记忆可通过"验证—编译—治理—检索"的服务化路径在生产环境中复用，跨模型迁移有效（强模型经验可赋能弱模型），并在部分基准上以零训练方式替代或超越参数微调，为技能资产的标准化分发与持续演进提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Memory systems for production LLM agents mostly store semantic memory (facts about users and domains) or episodic memory (earlier interactions). Research systems such as Trace2Skill, WikiSkill, and SkillRevise learn procedures from agent runs, package them as Skills, and evaluate them on benchmarks. We describe Zep Agent Skills, a production service that gives deployed agents this procedural memory. The service uses only verified attempts as evidence, cites the supporting events for each field of a Skill, and governs the admission and distribution of each Skill version. The service records each task attempt as a Trace with ordered events, an outcome, and a verification strength. A compiler with separate Reflector and Curator roles turns verified Traces into versioned Skills. Scans and admission gates control which candidates become active, and verified use outcomes change the search rank of each Skill. The Agent Skills format is an open standard that Anthropic originated and donated to the Agentic AI Foundation, so any host of the format can load a compiled Skill. Agents retrieve Skills through lexical search with progressive disclosure, over an API or MCP. We evaluate Zep Agent Skills on $τ^3$-bench banking, AppWorld, and EnterpriseOps-Gym. Skills compiled from the Traces of a teacher model increase the pass rate of three weaker executor models on the same tasks, at every reasoning effort, by 4.5 to 18.8 points. Most of the gain is on the tasks that the teacher solved. On ALFWorld, Skills compiled from the runs of a small model give a gain similar to or larger than the gain that prior work reports for continuous fine-tuning, with no training.

</details>


### [597] [Self-Evolving Agentic Workflows via Semantic Decomposition of Complex Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01840)
*Zichuan Fu,Junjia Qi,Xian Wu,Wenlin Zhang,Yimin Deng,Kaifeng Guo,Xiangyu Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种通过语义任务分解实现自演化智能体工作流的框架，用带适用条件的子任务与按需调用代码或模型的流程替代逐步调用LLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体工作流可把复杂任务组织为可复用流程，但每一步都调用LLM带来重复推理成本与延迟。

Method: 将任务语义分解为子任务，每个子任务具有显式的适用性条件和一个过程，过程按需执行代码或调用模型；智能体利用执行反馈精化分解并更新这些过程。

Result: 在GLEE竞赛中针对议价、谈判与说服任务进行实验，观察到大多数最终决策过程以代码实现。

Conclusion: 以代码化子任务过程替代密集LLM调用可降低推理开销并支撑工作流自演化，最终决策逻辑倾向沉淀为可执行代码。

Abstract: Agentic workflows organize complex tasks into reusable procedures. However, invoking an LLM at every step incurs repeated inference costs and delays. We propose a framework for self-evolving agentic workflows through semantic task decomposition. Each subtask has explicit applicability conditions and a procedure that executes code or invokes a model as needed. An agent uses execution feedback to refine the decomposition and update these procedures. Experiments in the GLEE competition show the framework on bargaining, negotiation and persuasion. Most observed final-decision procedures are implemented in code. Code is available at https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/NeurIPS2026_SeaFlow.

</details>


### [598] [To Align Long, Plan Short: Simulating Diverse Profile-Aligned Students by Realizing Short-Term Plans in Long-Horizon Learning Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02002)
*Bahar Radmehr,Jiaxu Zhao,Fatma Betül Güreş,Adish Singla,Tanja Käser*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出分层式模拟学生 ALPS，通过"规划行为段—生成动作"交替的方式，在长程开放学习环境中保持行为画像一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的学生模拟器多针对短程、语言中心交互；而在开放式学习环境中，学生行为体现在长程轨迹的模式上，逐回合提示生成会逐渐偏离指定的行为画像。

Method: ALPS（Align Long-term by Planning Short-term）：以可观测、环境特定的行为画像为条件的分层模拟器，交替进行"规划画像一致的任务段"与"生成对应动作"；在数据充足与数据稀缺两种设定下，监督分别来自真实学生轨迹或教师 LLM，并对比 ICL、SFT、RAFT 及其串行组合（SFT+RAFT）。

Result: 在探究式物理游戏与药房模拟两个环境中，以留出真实数据评估行为密度与覆盖度，并用与人类对齐的 LLM 裁判评估画像一致性。两种设定下 ALPS 均稳定优于逐回合生成；在监督稀缺时达到可比的密度与裁判通过率，但覆盖度仍较低。

Conclusion: 分层规划使模拟器能在长程交互中实现忠实、画像对齐的行为模拟，即使真实学生数据有限亦可适用。

Abstract: Simulated students offer a scalable way to test learning platforms and AI tutors before deployment with real students and to augment scarce data for studying learning at scale. Existing LLM-based simulators primarily target short, language-centered interactions. In open-ended learning environments, however, student behavior emerges from patterns across long-horizon interaction trajectories, where turn-level prompting can drift from an assigned behavior profile. We introduce ALPS (Align Long-term by Planning Short-term), a hierarchical simulated student conditioned on observable, environment-specific behavior profiles. Rather than selecting every action independently, ALPS alternates between planning profile-aligned task segments and generating the corresponding actions. We evaluate ALPS in both data-sufficient and data-scarce settings, where supervision comes either from real student trajectories or from a teacher LLM. Across both settings, we compare in-context learning (ICL), supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reward-ranked fine-tuning (RAFT), and their sequential combination (SFT followed by RAFT). Experiments in an inquiry-based physics game and a pharmacy simulation evaluate behavioral density and coverage against held-out real data, and profile consistency using a human-aligned LLM judge. Across both settings, ALPS consistently outperforms turn-level generation, achieving comparable density and judge pass rates under scarce supervision, although coverage remains lower. These results show that hierarchical planning enables faithful, profile-aligned simulation over long interaction horizons, even with limited real student data.

</details>


### [599] [DiabAgent: Toward Agentic Physiological Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03601)
*Chengxi Li,Shaoxuan Li,Deyao Hong,Qingle Liu,Yi Huang,Puheng Bian,Minzhi Xu,Lanyue Zhang,Mingze Sun,Xin Li,Calvin Xiao,Shengyuan Wang,Huan-ang Gao,Jiazheng Xu,Kaisen Yang,Hongning Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DiabAgent研究套件（APC框架、DiabetSim模拟器、SweetBench基准），系统量化评估智能体通过持续干预实现生理控制的能力，在1型糖尿病血糖控制任务上APC优于OpenAPS基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学语言模型在临床问答上进步迅速，但其通过持续干预实现有效生理控制的能力仍缺乏系统性定量评估；1型糖尿病需要依据进餐、运动、疾病和血糖测量等信息持续调整外源胰岛素剂量，是合适的实证场景。

Method: 构建DiabAgent套件：APC框架通过医疗设备工具控制血糖，基于持续观测推断个体状态、积累个人经验并选择治疗动作；DiabetSim模拟不同患者、事件与设备状态以支持可扩展的虚拟测试与训练；用DiabetSim将32个情景设计实例化为212个血糖控制任务，形成SweetBench基准。

Result: 在Claude Opus 5.5、固定1小时决策间隔下，APC取得COGI 73.5，高于开源闭环基线OpenAPS的71.2；消融实验表明个体自适应与情境信息可改善血糖控制；高频规则控制与低频智能体决策结合有望平衡控制性能与计算成本。

Conclusion: 该工作为智能体参与人体生理控制提供了框架、模拟器与评估基础。

Abstract: As pretraining scales, medical language models have advanced rapidly in clinical question answering. Their ability to achieve effective physiological control through sustained intervention still lacks systematic quantitative evaluation. Type 1 diabetes provides a concrete setting: impaired insulin secretion creates dependence on exogenous insulin, with dosing continually adjusted using information about meals, exercise, illness, and glucose measurements. We introduce DiabAgent, a research suite for agentic physiological control comprising the Agentic Physiological Control (APC) framework, the DiabetSim simulator, and the SweetBench benchmark. APC controls glucose through medical-device tools, using ongoing observations to infer individual states, accumulate personal experience, and choose treatment actions. We build DiabetSim to simulate different patients, events, and device conditions for scalable virtual testing and training. Using DiabetSim, we construct SweetBench by instantiating 32 scenario designs as 212 glucose-control tasks. With Claude Opus 5.5 and a fixed decision interval of one hour, APC achieves a COGI of 73.5, compared with 71.2 for the open-source closed-loop baseline OpenAPS. Ablations further show that individual adaptation and contextual information improve glucose control. Combining high-frequency rule-based control with lower-frequency agent decisions shows potential for balancing control performance and computational cost. Our work provides a framework, simulator, and evaluation foundation for agents to participate in human physiological control.

</details>


### [600] [LEANGUARD: Lean-Verified Guardrails for Tool-Using Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02332)
*Sreehari Sankar,Debargha Ganguly,Vikash Singh,Mohsen Hariri,Weicong Chen,Yanyan Zhang,Shouren Wang,Wang Yang,Chaoda Song,Alexander Nemecek,Osama Zafar,Idan Davidovich,Yuting Shao,Kai Ye,Biyao Zhang,Xinpeng Li,Joe Stubbs,Erman Ayday,Jing Ma,Vipin Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LeanGuard 是一个在工具调用到达环境之前、用 Lean4 形式化策略对每次调用进行校验的运行时防护层，策略支持状态谓词与带作用域的过去时时序算子、采用失效闭合（fail-closed）语义并经证明与 LeanLTL 等价；在 Tau-Bench、DTap 上几乎消除违规与注入攻击，且不显著损害良性任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具使用型语言模型智能体常执行其领域策略所禁止的动作，现有做法缺乏在调用执行前的可证明、可解释的强制校验机制。

Method: 设计 LeanGuard 运行时：在执行前对每个候选工具调用按 Lean4 编写的策略做检查，策略由状态谓词与作用于执行历史的带作用域过去时时序算子组合而成；评估为 fail-closed，判定过程被证明与 LeanLTL 语义等价。对被拒调用提供两种纠错：反馈（返回被违反规则与提示）与证明引导修复（用 Lean 元编程搜索保持用户意图的邻近调用，并由模型之外的过程证明其满足策略）。

Result: Tau-Bench 上五个 Qwen 模型（0.8B–27B）：无防护智能体至少执行 33 次被 Lean 策略禁止的调用，LeanGuard 为零，带反馈时任务成功率无显著变化。DTap 上直接提示注入成功率由 57.9% 降至 5.9%；telecom 域良性任务无需写操作，良性成功率不变。反馈相对单纯拒绝可减少重复被阻断调用，并在五个模型中四个提升任务成功率。对重放的拒绝案例，修复在 252 个由参数值导致的拒绝中为 88 个证明了可接受的修改，中位耗时 2,ms。

Conclusion: 在调用前进行形式化、可证明的策略强制可有效阻止违规动作与提示注入，且代价可控地保持良性任务性能；反馈与证明引导修复能进一步恢复被阻断任务，修复覆盖率仍受限于参数值类拒绝。

Abstract: Tool-using language-model agents often execute actions that their domain policies forbid. We present LeanGuard, a runtime that checks every proposed tool call against a policy written in Lean4 before the call reaches the environment. Policies combine state predicates with scoped past-time temporal operators over the execution history, evaluation is fail-closed, and the decision procedure is proved equivalent to a LeanLTL semantics. A denied call can be corrected in two ways. With feedback, the agent receives the violated rule and a hint; with proof-guided repair, Lean metaprogramming searches for a nearby call that preserves the user's intent and proves that the policy admits it, without the model. On Tau-Bench with five Qwen models (0.8B-27B), unguarded agents execute at least 33 calls that the Lean policy forbids, while LeanGuard executes none; with feedback, task success does not change significantly. On DTap, LeanGuard reduces direct prompt-injection success from 57.9% to 5.9%, and in telecom, where benign tasks need no writes, benign success is unchanged. Feedback reduces repeated blocked calls and raises task success for four of five models over a bare denial. On replayed denials, repair proves an admissible edit for 88 of 252 denials caused by argument values, in a median of 2,ms.

</details>


### [601] [CoworkOS:Scaling Agent Coworkers for Real-world Automation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03178)
*Jiajie Jin,Guanting Dong,Chengjun Pan,Xin Deng,Zhuohui Sheng,Guoqiang Wang,Tao Gui,Yutao Zhu,Yujia Chen,Shihong Yi,Binze Hu,Zhixiong Yang,Zhichao Sun,Rui Wang,Han Han,Mingyu Ma,Junhao Huang,Xiaotao Wang,Huicheng Jiang,Yuyang Hu,Xinyu Yang,Wanghan Xu,Yajie Yang,Zhecan Wang,Honglin Guo,Xiaoyu Xing,Xiaoqian Zhang,Yulun Zhu,Xiaoxi Li,Jiahang Lin,Shaofan Liu,Shihan Dou,Zhiheng Xi,Qi Zhang,Yu-Gang Jiang,See-Kiong Ng,Yang Zhang,Tat-Seng Chua,Ji-Rong Wen,Zhicheng Dou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CoworkOS 是一个面向长时程协作智能体的通用 harness，将任务策略与执行管理分离，通过三层架构、共享应用层、层级工作区与持久语义记忆支撑人机协同与跨会话连续性，在 12 个基准与 6 类真实应用中与 Codex、DeepSeek Harness 等前沿智能体应用相比具有高度竞争力，并以 GLM-5.3 为骨干完成 RSI 驱动的自动后训练案例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协作型智能体正从对话走向真实世界自动化，交付软件、设计等制品；但生产力任务要求同时在复杂任务上高质量交付，并在长时程中持续监控与决策，这一组合仍是开放难题。

Method: 提出 CoworkOS：策略与执行管理解耦——模型负责动作、委派与验收，运行时负责状态与反馈；三层架构支持直接执行或同步/异步委派给 Subagent，并保持职责稳定；共享应用层让人与智能体共同查看、修改同一演进中的文档、演示、CAD 模型与 Blender 场景，人类既可通过对话、也可通过直接改动作业本身介入；层级工作区与持久语义记忆使工作文件、关键决策与长任务日志可共享、复用、中断后续跑。

Result: 在 12 个基准、6 类真实应用场景中，与 Codex、DeepSeek Harness 等前沿智能体应用相比表现高度竞争力；持续工作案例中以 GLM-5.3 为骨干对 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 进行 RSI 驱动的自动后训练，五轮后八个基准的平均分由 33.19 提升至 42.95（+9.76）。

Conclusion: CoworkOS 为通用协作智能体智能提供了一条有意义的路径。

Abstract: Rapid advances in cowork agents are shifting human-AI collaboration toward real-world automation, delivering software, designs, and other artifacts. However, such productivity work demands both high-quality delivery on complex productivity tasks and continued monitoring and decision-making over long horizons, a combination that remains an open challenge. We introduce CoworkOS, a general-purpose harness for long-horizon work that separates task strategy from execution management: the model decides actions, delegation, and acceptance, while the runtime maintains state and feedback. Its three-layer architecture enables direct execution or delegation to Subagents, synchronously or asynchronously, under stable responsibilities. Through a shared application layer, humans and agents inspect and revise the same evolving documents, presentations, CAD models, and Blender scenes, so human-in-the-loop participation can enter both through conversation and through direct modification of the work itself. To sustain continuity across agents and sessions, CoworkOS further introduces hierarchical workspaces and persistent semantic memory, so working files, key decisions, and long-running Job logs remain shareable, reusable, and resumable after interruption. Across 12 benchmarks and 6 categories of real-world applications, CoworkOS proves highly competitive with frontier agent applications such as Codex and DeepSeek Harness. As a sustained-work case study, CoworkOS uses GLM-5.3 as its backbone to conduct RSI-driven automated post-training on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Over five rounds, the model's average score across eight benchmarks rose from 33.19 to 42.95 (+9.76). Looking ahead, we believe CoworkOS opens a meaningful path toward general cowork-agent intelligence.

</details>


### [602] [Accessed, never disclosed: Silent access to protected health information by medical artificial intelligence agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02319)
*Jae Wang Lee,Abhirup Banerjee,Yeong Chan Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文通过嵌入金丝雀与工具调用-曝光关联分析，发现多数模型在无需标识符的临床任务中仍会静默调用PHI工具，主张"边界+前置门控+访问日志审计"三者结合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HIPAA"最小必要"原则要求仅当任务需要时才检索患者标识符，且Agent可以检索而不披露标识符，形成"静默访问"。仅检查输出的评测无法发现此类不可见访问，现有安全评估存在盲区。

Method: 在合成病历中嵌入金丝雀（canary），将每次工具调用与最终答案中的金丝雀曝光进行关联追踪；实验覆盖5个语言模型、4个边界等级、7种攻击框架，任务均为无需标识符的临床任务；并测试一个基于"任务必要性"判据的前置执行门控。

Result: 3个模型不必要地调用了PHI工具，Claude Opus 4.8与GPT-5.5未出现该行为；更严格的边界显著降低访问；最严格策略下的残余访问仅集中于用户覆盖策略或声称已获批准的框架中；前置门控几乎消除了这类访问。

Conclusion: 仅凭输出层评测无法验证最小必要访问合规性；必须将边界限制、执行前门控与访问日志审计三者结合使用。

Abstract: Medical artificial intelligence agents should retrieve patient identifiers only when a task requires them, the data-minimization principle behind the HIPAA minimum necessary standard for protected health information (PHI). An agent can retrieve identifiers without revealing them. Such silent access remains invisible to evaluations that inspect only the output. We embedded canaries in synthetic patient records and linked each tool invocation to canary exposure in the final answers across five language models, four boundary levels, and seven attack frames for identifier-free clinical tasks. Three models invoked the PHI tools unnecessarily, whereas Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5 did not. Stronger boundaries reduced this access, and the residual access under the strictest policy was confined to frames in which the user overrode the policy or asserted approval. A pre-execution gate given the task-necessity criterion nearly eliminated this access. Output-only evaluation cannot verify minimum-necessary access; boundaries, gates, and access-log audits are required together.

</details>


### [603] [Variable names provide priors: semantic grounding enables data-efficient numerical prediction by large language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02637)
*Xin-Rui Ma,Shi-Zhi Chen,Hai-Yan Jiang,De-Cheng Feng,Michael Beer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 大型语言模型在表格数据上做上下文数值预测时，变量名的“语义接地”使其能调用预训练获得的领域知识，并与上下文示例按贝叶斯方式整合，从而在少样本甚至跨领域场景下比肩或超越监督学习模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究发现LLM可通过上下文学习在表格数据上进行数值预测，但不清楚在何种条件下、以何种机制使用变量名与上下文示例完成数值预测，尤其缺乏对变量名语义作用及其与示例整合规律的解析。

Method: 在来自9个科学领域的20个数据集上，比较5个未做任务特定训练的LLM与7个监督机器学习模型；通过推理轨迹分析变量名的作用；并构建基于物理公式的受控任务，检验LLM对领域知识与上下文示例的整合是否符合贝叶斯更新框架（领域知识作为先验，示例作为似然）。

Result: 语义接地（变量名与所描述数值的匹配）使LLM在20个数据集上达到或超过七个监督ML模型，且在示例稀缺时优势更明显；推理轨迹显示变量名使LLM得以调用预训练获得的领域知识；受控实验表明当无法仅由示例推断输入—目标关系时LLM以领域知识为先验，随着矛盾示例累积，预测逐步向示例（似然）偏移，符合贝叶斯更新。

Conclusion: 论文揭示了LLM在数值预测中利用领域知识的方式，并将其定位为数据高效的预测器，适用于数据稀缺的科学领域。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across diverse tasks, from question answering to code generation. Recent studies have found that LLMs can perform numerical prediction on tabular datasets via in-context learning. However, it remains unclear under what conditions and how LLMs use variable names and in-context examples for numerical prediction. Here we show that semantic grounding, the match between variable names and the values they describe, allows five LLMs without task-specific training to match or outperform seven supervised machine learning (ML) models across 20 datasets from nine scientific domains, particularly when examples are scarce. Reasoning traces indicate that variable names allow LLMs to draw on domain-specific knowledge acquired during pretraining. Using controlled tasks based on physical formulas, we further show that LLMs integrate domain-specific knowledge with in-context examples in a way consistent with Bayesian updating. Specifically, when the relationship between the inputs and the target cannot be inferred from the examples alone, LLMs rely on domain-specific knowledge as the prior. Conversely, as contradicting examples accumulate, LLM predictions shift progressively towards these examples, which act as the likelihood. Our work reveals how LLMs use domain-specific knowledge in numerical prediction and positions them as data-efficient predictors for data-scarce scientific domains.

</details>


### [604] [Skill++: Towards Lifelong Agents via Routing-Aware Skill Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00544)
*Hanrong Zhang,Minghao Liang,Jiawei Wu,Yankai Chen,Shicheng Fan,Zhiwei Liu,Enze Ma,Junwei Yuan,Tianyi Wang,Dehai Min,Kening Zheng,Xue Liu,Philip S. Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文将技能库持续增长下、仅凭元数据路由导致的"路由干扰"问题形式化为终身技能路由（类增量持续学习），提出 Skill++：仅重写新技能的 name 与 description（声明正文支持内容、与最近前任的差异、排除的相关工作），无需训练路由器或标注数据，在 731 技能/10 会话下使必需技能全选率达 76.3%（原元数据为 36.4%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent 通过 skills（name/description/body）扩展能力，在 progressive disclosure 下路由器仅凭 name 与 description 选择技能并只加载被选中的 body。技能库被用户与 agent 不断扩充，故路由器只能依赖元数据；当新增技能与旧技能相似时，会挤占旧技能，使原本正确的路由失效——即便旧技能与路由器均未改变。对公开技能（描述可能与 body 不符）这一问题更严重。作者据此提出"路由干扰"，并需在保持旧技能可选的同时不压制新技能。

Method: 将问题形式化为 lifelong skill routing（类增量持续学习）。指出现有方案不足：持续重训路由器有灾难性遗忘风险；重写类方法或忽略相似技能，或需要逐技能反馈。提出 Skill++：只重写每个新到技能的 name 与 description，不做路由器训练、不需标注数据；新描述需陈述 (1) body 实际支持什么，(2) 与最接近前任技能的差异，(3) 排除哪些相关工作。

Result: 技能库在十个会话中增长至 731 个技能时，Skill++ 对 76.3% 的查询选中全部必需技能，原始元数据为 36.4%；在三个 benchmark、五种 LLM 路由器上均优于所有对比方法，且增益可迁移至 Codex CLI agent harness。

Conclusion: 元数据质量而非路由器本身，是技能库持续扩张下路由可靠性的关键瓶颈；通过面向差异化的最小化元数据重写（无需训练、无需标注）即可有效缓解路由干扰，并具备跨基准、跨路由器与跨 harness 的泛化性。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents extend their capabilities with skills, each with a name, a description, and a body. Under progressive disclosure, an LLM router selects skills by name and description alone and loads only the selected bodies. Skill libraries grow continually as users and agents add new skills. Because the router relies on this metadata, a similar new skill can displace an earlier one, breaking previously correct routing even though the earlier skill and the router are unchanged. This routing interference is aggravated for public skills, whose descriptions may not match their bodies. We formulate the problem as lifelong skill routing, a class-incremental continual learning problem. A solution must keep earlier skills selectable without suppressing new ones. Existing approaches fall short, since continually retraining the router risks catastrophic forgetting and rewriting methods either ignore similar skills or require per-skill feedback. We therefore propose Skill++, which rewrites only the name and description of each incoming skill, without router training or labeled data. The new description states what the body supports, how the skill differs from its closest predecessor, and what related work it excludes. As a library grows to 731 skills over ten sessions, Skill++ selects all required skills for 76.3% of queries, versus 36.4% under the original metadata. Across three benchmarks and five LLM routers, it outperforms all compared approaches, and its gains carry over to the Codex CLI agent harness.

</details>


### [605] [Robustness Starts with the Objective: Designing and Certifying Robust LLM-Generated Heuristics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00504)
*Pantea Karimi,Roozbeh Bostandoost,Dany Rouhana,Siva Kesava Reddy Kakarla,Pooria Namyar,Mohammad Alizadeh,Venkat Arun,Behnaz Arzani*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 TAILOR 框架，用候选方案与基线在同一工作负载上的成本差的 CVaR（配对 CVaR）指导 LLM 合成启发式，可同时保证平均性能与尾部最优性差距的改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 启发式合成多以平均性能评估候选，会掩盖特定工作负载上的严重性能回退；加入对抗性训练输入亦无法消除回退；而分位数目标（如 95 分位）又忽略了超出阈值部分的严重程度。

Method: 以候选与已有基线在同一工作负载上的成本差的 Conditional Value at Risk（CVaR）作为合成目标，度量最差比例工作负载上的平均差异（配对 CVaR），并给出理论保障：负的配对 CVaR 可保证相对未知最优解的平均性能与尾部最优性差距同时改善，且无需计算该最优解。

Result: 在 Azure GPU 批处理准入、Azure VM 打包、服务器放置三个案例中取得最佳的平均—尾部权衡；在七个优化基准中，有六个产出的启发式以 99% 置信度同时改善平均性能与尾部最优性差距；这六个基准上尾部优于已知鲁棒的人工设计方法，平均性能改进持平或更优。

Conclusion: 配对 CVaR 是评估与合成 LLM 启发式的有效目标，能规避平均指标掩盖的回退问题，并优于分位数目标与对抗训练，可作为系统性启发式的通用合成准则。

Abstract: LLMs are increasingly used to design heuristics for computer systems. However, most synthesis frameworks evaluate candidates by their average performance, which can mask severe regressions on specific workloads. Even adding adversarial training inputs doesn't eliminate these regressions, and percentile objectives (e.g., optimizing for the 95th percentile) overlook how severe regressions can be beyond the selected threshold.
  We present TAILOR, a framework that guides LLM synthesis using the Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR) of the cost difference between each candidate and an existing baseline on the same workload. This paired CVaR measures the average difference over the worst fraction of workloads. We show that a negative paired CVaR guarantees improvements in both average performance and tail optimality gap relative to the unknown optimum, without ever computing that optimum.
  We find that TAILOR achieves the best mean--tail trade-off among the synthesis objectives we evaluate across three case studies: Azure GPU batch admission, Azure VM packing, and server placement. Tested across seven diverse optimization benchmarks, TAILOR produces heuristics that are certified with 99% confidence to improve both average performance and tail optimality gaps over the baseline in six of them. On these six benchmarks, TAILOR also outperforms known robust, human-designed alternatives in the tail while achieving better or comparable average-performance improvement over the baseline.

</details>


### [606] [Swap, Replicate, Read the Mass: A Protocol for Auditing Demographic Bias in System One Decision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00496)
*Alejandro Mozo Quesada,Sergio Gálvez Rojas,Francisco López Valverde*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首个针对"系统一"式类型化决策模型的多模型偏见审计：在BBQ、CrowS-Pairs、SilverSpoon三基准上适配类型化接口，评测12个模型加一个no-thinking消融，共163.8万次决策，发现普遍的刻板印象对齐、顺序依赖与"自信却不稳定"的置信度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统一决策模型以带概率分数的类型化答案替代文本生成，已在生产中无人审核地执行；但现有偏见基准上缺乏多模型审计，无法评估其偏见与稳定性风险。

Method: 构建审计：三个基准（BBQ全部11类、CrowS-Pairs、SilverSpoon）适配到类型化接口；评测12个模型及no-thinking消融，共1,638,000次决策。所有顺序敏感项以交换选项方式各跑两次；原生类型化模型额外交换标签；10种配置在额外随机种子与batch 16下重复。

Result: 普遍存在刻板印象对齐、顺序依赖答案及随不稳定性而非偏见变化的置信度。BBQ中143个模型×类别分数有97个显著、94个对齐，商业参考模型在99.5%模糊项上弃答从而掩盖对齐概率质量；选项交换使0.0%–72.6%的选择翻转，类型化打分多低于10%（Laya达22–33%），未调优字母提示达73%；CrowS-Pairs偏好跨度0.496–0.816，布尔答案可由位置决定（1.00 vs 0.005）；SilverSpoon中8个决策模型有5个判断偏向低SES标签，源于9B骨干或由调优引入。

Conclusion: 审计应默认置换选项并反转问题顺序；顺序不变的打分应成为采购要求。

Abstract: System One decision models replace text generation with typed, probability-scored answers and are entering production. Answers execute without a person in the loop, and no multi-model audit exists on established bias benchmarks. We provide that audit: three benchmarks: BBQ (all eleven categories), CrowS-Pairs, and SilverSpoon, adapted to the typed interface, twelve models plus a no-thinking ablation, and 1,638,000 decisions. Every order-sensitive item runs twice with options swapped; native typed models also swap labels; ten configurations repeat under extra seeds and batch 16. We find widespread stereotype alignment, order-dependent answers, and confidence that tracks instability rather than bias. In BBQ, 97 of 143 model-by-category scores are significant and 94 aligned, while the commercial reference abstains on 99.5% of ambiguous items, hiding aligned probability mass. Option swaps flip 0.0% to 72.6% of choices; typed scoring stays below 10% except Laya (22-33%), and untuned letter prompting reaches 73%. CrowS-Pairs preference spans 0.496 to 0.816, and boolean answers can be decided by position (1.00 versus 0.005). SilverSpoon judgments shift toward lower-SES labels in five of eight decision models, inherited from the 9B backbone or induced by tuning. Audits must permute options and reverse questions by default; order-invariant scoring should become a procurement requirement.

</details>


### [607] [Are Fake Citations a Form of Reward Hacking? A Pre-Registered Study of Post-Training and Citation Cues](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01313)
*Zain Naboulsi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究用四个预注册实验检验"后训练模型虚构引用是否为奖励黑客"，发现请求引用会使后训练模型的虚构率骤升（47.8点交互效应），且仅凭表层引用特征训练的偏好模型86%偏好后训练输出，但注册的定向预测未成立，故只能得出"可能但未证实的奖励黑客"结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练语言模型高频虚构引用。作者试图判定这是否构成奖励黑客（reward hacking）——即在学术性代理指标上得分更高，却在实际所指的学术质量上更差。核心动机是区分"单纯的指令遵循/冗长倾向"与"奖励信号驱动的虚构行为"。

Method: 在900道冻结问题上开展四个预注册实验（美国联邦判例法、计算相关科学文献、医学文献三个领域）；覆盖三个模型家族四个后训练阶段的十二个开放权重检查点，并在十五个检查点上重拟合。关键设计为固定权重、仅改变提示的交互实验（"请求引用"提示 vs 控制），并加入长度匹配控制以排除冗长效应；另训练一个仅使用表层引用特征的偏好模型，并在固定引用数量条件下测试其偏好。

Result: 请求引用使后训练检查点虚构率显著上升而基座模型不变：十二检查点上47.8点交互（Holm校正 p=2e-34），十五检查点41.5点，三个领域一致；长度匹配控制显示效应特异于引用而非冗长。后训练整体将虚构率从4.8%升至56.7%。但注册的"在最易诱发虚构处上升最多"的预测未成立。仅凭表层引用特征训练的偏好模型86%偏好后训练输出，固定引用数量后仍显示其奖励引用数量。

Conclusion: 结论为"可能是，但未被证实"：后训练模型在被要求来源时虚构率大幅提高，且只计数量不核查的朴素评估器会因其引用更多而偏好其输出；但注册的定向模式未出现，普通指令遵循亦可解释同样结果。要证明奖励导致虚构，需在训练中改变奖励信号的实验，本研究未做。

Abstract: Post-trained language models fabricate citations at high rates. We ask whether that is reward hacking: scoring well on a proxy for scholarship while doing worse on what it stands for. We ran four pre-registered experiments on 900 frozen questions (US federal case law, computationally adjacent scientific literature, and medical literature) across twelve open-weights checkpoints covering four post-training stages of three model families, then refit on fifteen. The clearest result holds the weights fixed and changes only the prompt. Asking for citations raises fabrication sharply in post-trained checkpoints and not in base ones: a 47.8-point interaction on twelve checkpoints (Holm-adjusted p = 2e-34) and 41.5 points on fifteen, in all three domains. A length-matched control separates the citation cue from a demand for a longer answer, so the effect is specific to citations, not verbosity. Post-training also raises fabrication overall, from 4.8% to 56.7%, but our registered prediction that it would rise most where fabrication is most tempting did not hold. A preference model trained only on surface citation features prefers post-trained output 86% of the time, and holding citation count fixed shows it rewards quantity. Our answer: possibly, but not proven. Post-trained models produce fabricated citations at far higher rates when asked for sources, and a naive evaluator that counts sources without checking them would prefer their output for citing more. But the targeted pattern we registered did not appear, and plain instruction-following could explain the same results. Proving that the reward causes fabrication needs an experiment that changes the reward during training, which this study does not do. Pre-registration: doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/S53HY. Code and data: https://github.com/zainnab-sparq/citation-reward-hacking

</details>


### [608] [Opening the Black Box of Neural Auction Mechanisms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01981)
*Li Kong,Zilong Liu,Haoyang Zhou,Hanbing Liu,Qi Qi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个后验白盒审计框架，用稀疏自编码器分解神经拍卖（以CITransNet为测试平台）的隐藏表示，并以经济学目标为锚点、通过激活预测和因果干预验证特征，进而用这些可验证特征分析策略性谎报激励、与Myerson最优拍卖的一致性及个体拍卖诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经拍卖设计已成为Web平台自动机制设计的重要范式，但其学到的机制缺乏内部透明度，难以审计与建立信任，因此需要打开这个黑盒。后验审计面临两大挑战：(1) 激活上下文是稠密、相关的数值画像，缺少显式语义结构；(2) 特征解释只有映射到可测量拍卖状态或结果时才能被可证伪地审计。

Method: 以CITransNet为代表性测试平台，首先用稀疏自编码器分解隐藏表示，同时忠实保持下游拍卖行为；将特征解释锚定到原生经济学目标，并通过激活预测和因果干预进行验证，从重建字典中筛出经验证特征；最后在多种拍卖设置中应用该流程作为分析工具。

Result: 经验证特征可作为分析工具，用于考察内部表示如何调节策略性谎报激励、与Myerson最优拍卖对齐，以及支持对个体拍卖的诊断。

Conclusion: 本工作展示了白盒机制审计的潜力，可为神经拍卖作为广泛采用的Web技术部署建立基础性信任；实验结果为公开资源（GitHub仓库），以支持透明性与独立审查。

Abstract: Neural auction design has emerged as a powerful paradigm within automated mechanism design for modern Web platforms. Because these learned mechanisms directly dictate critical economic outcomes, their lack of internal transparency raises significant auditability and trust concerns. Opening this black box \textit{post-hoc} is therefore essential, yet presents two distinctive challenges: (1) activation contexts are dense, correlated numerical profiles devoid of explicit semantic structure, and (2) feature interpretations can only be falsifiably audited if they map to measurable auction states or outcomes. In this paper, we propose a post-hoc white-box auditing framework for unpacking trained neural auctions. Using CITransNet as a representative testbed, we first employ sparse autoencoders to decompose hidden representations while faithfully preserving downstream auction behavior. Anchoring feature interpretations to native economic targets, we validate them through activation prediction and causal interventions to isolate verified features from the reconstruction dictionary. Finally, applying this pipeline across varied auction settings, we show that the verified features can serve as analytical instruments to examine how internal representations modulate strategic misreporting incentives, align with Myerson's optimal auction, and support the diagnosis of individual auctions. Our work highlights the potential of white-box mechanism auditing to build the foundational trust necessary for neural auctions to be deployed as widely adopted Web technologies. To enhance research transparency and facilitate independent inspection, we publicly release the experimental results supporting our findings at https://github.com/Li-Beverly-Kong/opening-neural-auctions.git

</details>


### [609] [Beyond Multimodal Emotion Conflict: Temporal Context-Aware Hidden Emotion Detection with Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01943)
*Yonghao Wang,Jiaxin Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该提案提出构建带显式标注（外显情绪、内隐情绪、隐藏条件）的多模态基准，并开发基于多模态大模型（MLLM）的框架，融合细粒度面部动作单元（AU）、跨模态特征与时间上下文，以区分普通情绪不一致与情绪隐藏，并在有证据支持时推断真实内隐情绪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态情绪识别研究已开始关注模态间冲突，但冲突并不必然意味着个体在隐藏情绪，也可能源于混合情绪、个体表达风格或情境因素；因此需要将"普通情绪不一致"与"情绪隐藏"加以区分，并进一步推断潜在真实情绪。

Method: 1）构建多模态基准数据集，显式标注表达情绪、内部情绪与隐藏条件；2）提出基于MLLM的框架，整合细粒度面部动作单元（AUs）、跨模态特征与时间上下文信息。

Result: 摘要为提案性质，尚未给出实验数据；预期产出为可区分情绪不一致与情绪隐藏的基准数据集，以及具备证据驱动内隐情绪推断能力的MLLM框架。

Conclusion: 该工作将情绪冲突建模从"检测不一致"推进到"判别隐藏并推断真实情绪"，通过标注体系与MLLM框架的结合提升多模态情绪理解的可解释性与细粒度。

Abstract: Multimodal emotion recognition commonly combines textual, acoustic, and visual signals to infer affective states. Recent work has begun to study conflicts among modalities, but a conflict does not necessarily indicate that a person is concealing an emotion. It may also result from mixed emotions, individual expressive styles, or contextual factors. This proposal aims to distinguish ordinary emotional inconsistency from emotion concealment and to infer the underlying emotion when supported by evidence. We plan to construct a multimodal benchmark with explicit annotations of expressed emotion, internal emotion, and concealment conditions, and to develop an MLLM-based framework that integrates fine-grained facial Action Units (AUs), cross-modal features, and temporal context.

</details>


### [610] [Who Asks, Who Answers: Linear Attention Builds the Query in Hybrid Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01909)
*Wenqi Zeng,Chen Feng,YuAng Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 混合语言模型中线性注意力不仅压缩上下文，还通过Encode–Address电路直接构造softmax注意力的查询，干式分工为"线性注意力建查询、softmax注意力做检索"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往工作把上下文检索归因于softmax注意力，视线性注意力仅为上下文压缩机制，作者质疑并重新审视这一分工。

Method: 在Qwen3.5（Gated DeltaNet）与Granite4.0（Mamba-2）上做电路分析：定位早期Encode块与Address块；通过在查询键不同的提示间移植末位表示进行干预实验；跨架构交换Address块；并在六个Qwen3.5模型上考察规模变化下的计算分布。

Result: 表示移植在0.97–0.99的情况下改向检索；Address块循环状态携带检索目标；用Qwen的Address块替换Granite的可在不更新权重下恢复0.92–0.94准确率；大尺度上Address计算沿块链分布，各块依次引导后续reader。

Conclusion: 混合检索存在明确分工：线性注意力构造查询，softmax注意力执行查找；该机制跨架构可迁移且随规模由集中转为分布式。

Abstract: Hybrid language models interleave linear-attention layers with a small number of softmax-attention layers. Prior work largely attributes in-context retrieval to softmax attention, treating linear attention primarily as a mechanism for compressing past context. We revisit this division of labor and show that linear attention plays a direct role in retrieval by constructing the query used by softmax attention. Studying Qwen3.5 (Gated DeltaNet) and Granite4.0 (Mamba-2), we identify an Encode--Address circuit. An early Encode block preserves token identity, while an Address block constructs the final-position representation from which a softmax \emph{reader} forms its attention query. Transplanting this representation between prompts with different queried keys redirects retrieval in 0.97--0.99 of cases. The Address block's recurrent state carries the retrieval target, and its computation transfers across architectures: replacing Granite's Address block with Qwen's restores retrieval accuracy to 0.92--0.94 without updating either model's weights. Across six Qwen3.5 models, Address computation becomes distributed at larger scales over a chain of blocks, each guiding a successive reader, as the query no longer passes from one reader to the next through attention. These findings reveal a division of labor in hybrid retrieval: linear attention constructs the query, while softmax attention performs the lookup. Code is available at https://github.com/yuang-chen/LinearQuery

</details>


### [611] [Does reflective LLM feedback survive a wet-lab-scale label budget?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01908)
*Haoxuan Zeng,Xin Luo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在每轮仅获取一块板标签的低预算设定下，论文把"反思式语言模型反馈"的收益拆分为三部分（提出模型编辑、选择测量、反复反馈修正决策），并发现只有在受约束的专家化编辑场景下才有可检测增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者想回答：在标签预算极低（每轮只能测一块板）的生物学预测任务中，LLM 的反思式反馈是否真能提升预测器；并厘清其收益到底来自"提议编辑"、"选择测量"还是"反复反馈"。现有工作常把三者混在一起评估，导致增益归因不清。

Method: 重放 36 个 ProteinGym 测定；初始 96 个标签，每轮再获取 96 个，共 6 轮；采用封闭测试集与统一编辑模式（shared edit schema）。预注册比较：完整 LLM 控制 vs. 随机编辑。并做探索性消融：固定随机获取时比较 LLM 编辑 vs. 无编辑；固定获取策略为 UCB 时比较 LLM 编辑；单独评估 LLM 获取策略；以及完整控制下"多次反馈"vs."仅一次初始建议"。
